"""Blind human A/B calibration contract; no synthetic human judgements."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import math
from typing import Any

from apps.qualitylab.datasets import (
    ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS,
    ALLOWED_MEDIA_KINDS,
    _safe_key,
)
from platform_core.i18n import N_

ALLOWED_SELECTIONS = {"left", "right", "tie", "insufficient"}
REQUIRED_SLICES = {"face", "text", "nature", "animation", "low-light", "motion"}
MIN_CASES = {"image": 30, "video": 12}
MIN_RATERS = 3
MAX_CASES = 500


def _token(secret: str, value: str) -> str:
    if len(secret) < 16:
        raise ValueError(N_("Blind secret phải có ít nhất 16 ký tự."))
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), value.encode("utf-8"),
                    hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()


def validate_calibration_suite(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if payload.get("schema_version") != 1:
        raise ValueError(N_("Calibration suite phải dùng schema_version=1."))
    version = str(payload.get("calibration_version") or "").strip()[:80]
    dataset_hash = str(payload.get("dataset_manifest_sha256") or "").lower().strip()
    if not version or len(dataset_hash) != 64 or any(
            char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in dataset_hash):
        raise ValueError(N_("Thiếu calibration version hoặc dataset manifest hash."))
    raw_cases = payload.get("cases")
    if not isinstance(raw_cases, list) or not 1 <= len(raw_cases) <= MAX_CASES:
        raise ValueError(N_("Calibration suite phải có từ 1 đến 500 case."))
    seen: set[str] = set()
    cases: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for raw in raw_cases:
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise ValueError(N_("Calibration case phải là object."))
        case_id = str(raw.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not case_id or case_id in seen:
            raise ValueError(N_("Calibration case id rỗng hoặc trùng."))
        seen.add(case_id)
        media_kind = str(raw.get("media_kind") or "")
        degradation = str(raw.get("degradation") or "")
        if media_kind not in ALLOWED_MEDIA_KINDS:
            raise ValueError(N_("Calibration media_kind không hợp lệ."))
        if degradation not in ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS:
            raise ValueError(N_("Calibration degradation không hợp lệ."))
        slice_name = str(raw.get("slice") or "").strip().lower()
        if not slice_name or len(slice_name) > 80:
            raise ValueError(N_("Calibration slice rỗng hoặc quá dài."))
        metric = raw.get("metric_value")
        if metric is not None:
            metric = float(metric)
            if not math.isfinite(metric):
                raise ValueError(N_("metric_value phải hữu hạn."))
        cases.append({
            "id": case_id,
            "dataset_sample_id": str(raw.get("dataset_sample_id") or "")[:120],
            "media_kind": media_kind,
            "degradation": degradation,
            "slice": slice_name,
            "candidate_key": _safe_key(raw.get("candidate_key"), "candidate_key"),
            "baseline_key": _safe_key(raw.get("baseline_key"), "baseline_key"),
            "metric_value": metric,
        })
    normalized = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "calibration_version": version,
        "dataset_manifest_sha256": dataset_hash,
        "cases": cases,
    }
    canonical = json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                           ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    normalized["suite_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()
    return normalized


def _candidate_is_left(case: dict[str, Any], rater_id: str, secret: str) -> bool:
    assignment_id = _token(secret, f"assignment:{case['id']}:{rater_id}")
    return int(assignment_id[-2:], 16) % 2 == 0


def blind_assignment(case: dict[str, Any], rater_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    rater = str(rater_id or "").strip()
    if not rater:
        raise ValueError(N_("Thiếu rater id."))
    assignment_id = _token(secret, f"assignment:{case['id']}:{rater}")
    return {
        "case_id": case["id"],
        "assignment_id": assignment_id,
        "left_artifact_token": _token(secret, f"artifact:{case['id']}:{rater}:left"),
        "right_artifact_token": _token(secret, f"artifact:{case['id']}:{rater}:right"),
    }


def resolve_artifact_token(case: dict[str, Any], rater_id: str, token: str,
                           secret: str) -> str:
    """Resolve inside the trusted backend; never serialize the returned key."""
    assignment = blind_assignment(case, rater_id, secret)
    if hmac.compare_digest(token, assignment["left_artifact_token"]):
        side = "left"
    elif hmac.compare_digest(token, assignment["right_artifact_token"]):
        side = "right"
    else:
        raise ValueError(N_("Artifact token không hợp lệ."))
    candidate_left = _candidate_is_left(case, rater_id, secret)
    is_candidate = candidate_left if side == "left" else not candidate_left
    return case["candidate_key"] if is_candidate else case["baseline_key"]


def normalize_vote(case: dict[str, Any], rater_id: str, selection: str,
                   secret: str, rubric: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    choice = str(selection or "").strip().lower()
    if choice not in ALLOWED_SELECTIONS:
        raise ValueError(N_("Lựa chọn A/B không hợp lệ."))
    assignment = blind_assignment(case, rater_id, secret)
    if choice in {"tie", "insufficient"}:
        canonical_choice = choice
    else:
        candidate_left = _candidate_is_left(case, rater_id, secret)
        canonical_choice = ("candidate" if ((choice == "left") == candidate_left)
                            else "baseline")
    scores: dict[str, int] = {}
    for key in ("technical", "semantic", "aesthetic"):
        raw = (rubric or {}).get(key)
        if raw is None:
            continue
        score = int(raw)
        if not 1 <= score <= 5:
            raise ValueError(N_("Điểm rubric phải nằm trong 1..5."))
        scores[key] = score
    vote = {
        "case_id": case["id"],
        "rater_hash": _token(secret, f"rater:{rater_id}"),
        "assignment_id": assignment["assignment_id"],
        "preference": canonical_choice,
        "rubric": scores,
    }
    vote["vote_signature"] = _token(
        secret, "vote:" + json.dumps(vote, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
    return vote


def _average_ranks(values: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    order = sorted(range(len(values)), key=values.__getitem__)
    ranks = [0.0] * len(values)
    start = 0
    while start < len(order):
        end = start + 1
        while end < len(order) and values[order[end]] == values[order[start]]:
            end += 1
        rank = (start + 1 + end) / 2.0
        for index in order[start:end]:
            ranks[index] = rank
        start = end
    return ranks


def _pearson(left: list[float], right: list[float]) -> float | None:
    if len(left) < 3 or len(left) != len(right):
        return None
    left_mean, right_mean = sum(left) / len(left), sum(right) / len(right)
    numerator = sum((x - left_mean) * (y - right_mean)
                    for x, y in zip(left, right))
    left_var = sum((x - left_mean) ** 2 for x in left)
    right_var = sum((y - right_mean) ** 2 for y in right)
    if left_var == 0 or right_var == 0:
        return None
    return numerator / math.sqrt(left_var * right_var)


def _fleiss_kappa(counts: list[dict[str, int]]) -> float | None:
    usable = [item for item in counts if sum(item.values()) >= MIN_RATERS]
    if len(usable) < 2:
        return None
    agreements = []
    totals = {key: 0 for key in ("candidate", "baseline", "tie")}
    total_votes = 0
    for item in usable:
        n = sum(item.values())
        agreements.append((sum(value * value for value in item.values()) - n) /
                          (n * (n - 1)))
        for key in totals:
            totals[key] += item.get(key, 0)
        total_votes += n
    expected = sum((value / total_votes) ** 2 for value in totals.values())
    if expected == 1:
        return 1.0
    return (sum(agreements) / len(agreements) - expected) / (1 - expected)


def aggregate_reviews(suite: dict[str, Any], votes: list[dict[str, Any]],
                      secret: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cases = {case["id"]: case for case in suite["cases"]}
    by_case: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {case_id: [] for case_id in cases}
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for vote in votes:
        unsigned = {key: vote.get(key) for key in (
            "case_id", "rater_hash", "assignment_id", "preference", "rubric")}
        expected_signature = _token(
            secret, "vote:" + json.dumps(unsigned, sort_keys=True,
                                          separators=(",", ":")))
        if not hmac.compare_digest(str(vote.get("vote_signature") or ""),
                                   expected_signature):
            raise ValueError(N_("Chữ ký vote không hợp lệ."))
        case_id = str(vote.get("case_id") or "")
        rater_hash = str(vote.get("rater_hash") or "")
        preference = str(vote.get("preference") or "")
        if case_id not in cases or preference not in {
                "candidate", "baseline", "tie", "insufficient"} or len(rater_hash) != 64:
            raise ValueError(N_("Vote không hợp lệ."))
        identity = (case_id, rater_hash)
        if identity in seen:
            raise ValueError(N_("Một rater chỉ được chấm một lần mỗi case."))
        seen.add(identity)
        by_case[case_id].append(vote)

    case_rows = []
    agreement_counts = []
    metric_values, human_scores = [], []
    for case_id, case in cases.items():
        preferences = [vote["preference"] for vote in by_case[case_id]]
        counts = {key: preferences.count(key) for key in (
            "candidate", "baseline", "tie", "insufficient")}
        valid = counts["candidate"] + counts["baseline"] + counts["tie"]
        score = ((counts["candidate"] + 0.5 * counts["tie"]) / valid
                 if valid else None)
        complete = valid >= MIN_RATERS
        case_rows.append({"case_id": case_id, "valid_raters": valid,
                          "counts": counts, "candidate_preference": score,
                          "complete": complete})
        agreement_counts.append({key: counts[key] for key in (
            "candidate", "baseline", "tie")})
        if complete and score is not None and case["metric_value"] is not None:
            metric_values.append(float(case["metric_value"]))
            human_scores.append(float(score))

    kind_counts = {kind: sum(case["media_kind"] == kind for case in cases.values())
                   for kind in ALLOWED_MEDIA_KINDS}
    missing_slices = sorted(REQUIRED_SLICES - {
        case["slice"] for case in cases.values()})
    missing_degradations = sorted(ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS - {
        case["degradation"] for case in cases.values()})
    incomplete = sorted(row["case_id"] for row in case_rows if not row["complete"])
    reasons = []
    for kind, minimum in MIN_CASES.items():
        if kind_counts[kind] < minimum:
            reasons.append(f"{kind}_cases<{minimum}")
    if missing_slices:
        reasons.append("missing_slices")
    if missing_degradations:
        reasons.append("missing_degradations")
    if incomplete:
        reasons.append("cases_below_3_raters")
    spearman = _pearson(_average_ranks(metric_values),
                        _average_ranks(human_scores)) if metric_values else None
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "calibration_version": suite["calibration_version"],
        "suite_sha256": suite["suite_sha256"],
        "case_counts": kind_counts,
        "case_results": case_rows,
        "complete_case_count": len(case_rows) - len(incomplete),
        "missing_slices": missing_slices,
        "missing_degradations": missing_degradations,
        "incomplete_case_ids": incomplete,
        "fleiss_kappa": (round(value, 6) if (
            value := _fleiss_kappa(agreement_counts)) is not None else None),
        "spearman_metric_vs_human": (round(spearman, 6)
                                      if spearman is not None else None),
        "ready_for_threshold_review": not reasons,
        "readiness_reasons": reasons,
        "release_gate_eligible": False,
        "notice": N_("Ready chỉ cho phép review threshold; không tự bật release gate."),
    }

"""Hợp đồng kết quả Quality Lab — ổn định, có version và Honest UI."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from platform_core.i18n import N_

VERDICTS = ("PASS", "WARN", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE")
SCHEMA_VERSION = 1


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Metric:
    key: str
    label: str
    value: Any
    unit: str = ""
    verdict: str = "UNKNOWN"
    threshold: str = ""
    direction: str = ""
    valid_range: str = ""
    evidence: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self.verdict not in VERDICTS:
            raise ValueError(N_(f"Verdict không hợp lệ: {self.verdict}"))
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Dimension:
    key: str
    label: str
    verdict: str
    metrics: tuple[Metric, ...]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self.verdict not in VERDICTS:
            raise ValueError(N_(f"Verdict không hợp lệ: {self.verdict}"))
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "label": self.label,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "metrics": [metric.to_dict() for metric in self.metrics],
        }


def build_report(*, evaluation_id: str, pack: str, source_kind: str,
                 evaluator_version: str, dimensions: list[Dimension],
                 runtime: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
                 source_artifact: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
                 evaluators: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
                 environment: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Dựng report vector; hard FAIL thắng WARN/PASS, UNKNOWN không thành PASS."""
    verdicts = [item.verdict for item in dimensions]
    if "FAIL" in verdicts:
        overall = "FAIL"
    elif "WARN" in verdicts:
        overall = "WARN"
    elif "UNKNOWN" in verdicts:
        overall = "UNKNOWN"
    elif verdicts and all(value == "NOT_APPLICABLE" for value in verdicts):
        overall = "NOT_APPLICABLE"
    elif verdicts and all(value in {"PASS", "NOT_APPLICABLE"} for value in verdicts):
        overall = "PASS"
    else:
        overall = "UNKNOWN"
    return {
        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "evaluation_id": evaluation_id,
        "pack": pack,
        "source_kind": source_kind,
        "source_artifact": source_artifact or {},
        "evaluator_version": evaluator_version,
        "evaluators": evaluators or [],
        "calibration_version": "foundation-uncalibrated-v1",
        "release_gate_eligible": False,
        "overall_verdict": overall,
        "dimensions": [item.to_dict() for item in dimensions],
        "runtime": runtime or {},
        "environment": environment or {},
        "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "notice": N_(
            "Kết quả foundation dùng để chẩn đoán; chưa được hiệu chuẩn với "
            "đánh giá mù của con người và không được dùng làm release gate."),
    }

"""Hợp đồng dataset Quality Lab; chỉ lưu key/metadata, không nhét media vào JSON."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from typing import Any

from platform_core.i18n import N_

MAX_ITEMS = 500
ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS = {"bicubic", "blur", "noise", "compression", "mixed"}
ALLOWED_MEDIA_KINDS = {"image", "video"}
ALLOWED_SPLITS = {"development", "calibration", "blind-regression"}
REQUIRED_SLICES = {"face", "text", "nature", "animation", "low-light", "motion"}
_SHA256 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
_SAMPLE_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,79}$")


def _safe_key(value: object, label: str) -> str:
    key = str(value or "").replace("\\", "/").strip("/")
    if not key or ".." in key.split("/") or ":" in key:
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} không hợp lệ."))
    return key


def _safe_sha256(value: object, label: str) -> str:
    digest = str(value or "").lower().strip()
    if digest and not _SHA256.fullmatch(digest):
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} phải là SHA-256 hợp lệ."))
    return digest


def _safe_tags(value: object) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) > 12:
        raise ValueError(N_("tags phải là list tối đa 12 mục."))
    tags: list[str] = []
    for raw in value:
        tag = str(raw or "").strip().lower()
        if not tag or len(tag) > 40 or tag in tags:
            raise ValueError(N_("tag rỗng, trùng hoặc quá dài."))
        tags.append(tag)
    return tags


def _safe_sample_id(value: object) -> str:
    sample_id = str(value or "").strip()
    if not _SAMPLE_ID.fullmatch(sample_id):
        raise ValueError(N_("Sample id chỉ được gồm chữ, số, dấu chấm, gạch ngang hoặc gạch dưới."))
    return sample_id


def validate_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if payload.get("schema_version") != 1:
        raise ValueError(N_("Dataset manifest phải dùng schema_version=1."))
    if payload.get("app_slug") != "upscalevideo":
        raise ValueError(N_("Dataset này không thuộc pack Upscale."))
    raw_items = payload.get("items")
    if not isinstance(raw_items, list) or not 1 <= len(raw_items) <= MAX_ITEMS:
        raise ValueError(N_("Dataset phải có từ 1 đến 500 sample."))
    seen: set[str] = set()
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for raw in raw_items:
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise ValueError(N_("Sample dataset phải là object."))
        sample_id = _safe_sample_id(raw.get("id"))
        if sample_id in seen:
            raise ValueError(N_("Sample id rỗng hoặc bị trùng."))
        seen.add(sample_id)
        degradation = str(raw.get("degradation") or "")
        if degradation not in ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS:
            raise ValueError(N_("Kiểu degradation chưa được hỗ trợ."))
        license_name = str(raw.get("license") or "").strip()
        license_evidence_id = str(raw.get("license_evidence_id") or "").strip()
        if not license_name or not bool(raw.get("owned_or_licensed")):
            raise ValueError(N_("Sample chưa có bằng chứng sở hữu/license."))
        production = bool(raw.get("production_data"))
        consent_id = str(raw.get("consent_id") or "").strip()
        retention_days = int(raw.get("retention_days") or 0)
        if production and (not consent_id or retention_days <= 0):
            raise ValueError(N_("Dữ liệu production thiếu consent hoặc retention."))
        media_kind = str(raw.get("media_kind") or "image")
        if media_kind not in ALLOWED_MEDIA_KINDS:
            raise ValueError(N_("media_kind chưa được hỗ trợ."))
        split = str(raw.get("split") or "development")
        if split not in ALLOWED_SPLITS:
            raise ValueError(N_("Dataset split chưa được hỗ trợ."))
        items.append({
            "id": sample_id,
            "reference_key": _safe_key(raw.get("reference_key"), "reference_key"),
            "degraded_key": _safe_key(raw.get("degraded_key"), "degraded_key"),
            "degradation": degradation,
            "media_kind": media_kind,
            "split": split,
            "slice": str(raw.get("slice") or "general")[:80],
            "tags": _safe_tags(raw.get("tags")),
            "reference_sha256": _safe_sha256(
                raw.get("reference_sha256"), "reference_sha256"),
            "degraded_sha256": _safe_sha256(
                raw.get("degraded_sha256"), "degraded_sha256"),
            "license": license_name[:160],
            "license_evidence_id": license_evidence_id[:160],
            "owned_or_licensed": True,
            "production_data": production,
            "consent_id": consent_id[:160] if production else "",
            "retention_days": retention_days if production else 0,
        })
    normalized = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "app_slug": "upscalevideo",
        "dataset_version": str(payload.get("dataset_version") or "").strip()[:80],
        "items": items,
    }
    if not normalized["dataset_version"]:
        raise ValueError(N_("Thiếu dataset_version."))
    canonical = json.dumps(normalized, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                           separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    normalized["manifest_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()
    return normalized


def readiness_report(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Kiểm tra độ phủ MVP; không biến độ phủ thành release verdict."""
    manifest = validate_manifest(payload)
    items = manifest["items"]
    kinds = {kind: sum(item["media_kind"] == kind for item in items)
             for kind in sorted(ALLOWED_MEDIA_KINDS)}
    slices = {item["slice"] for item in items}
    degradations = {item["degradation"] for item in items}
    splits = {item["split"] for item in items}
    reasons: list[str] = []
    if kinds["image"] < 30:
        reasons.append("image_items<30")
    if kinds["video"] < 12:
        reasons.append("video_items<12")
    reasons.extend(f"missing_slice:{value}" for value in sorted(REQUIRED_SLICES - slices))
    reasons.extend(f"missing_degradation:{value}"
                   for value in sorted(ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS - degradations))
    reasons.extend(f"missing_split:{value}" for value in sorted(ALLOWED_SPLITS - splits))
    if any(not item["reference_sha256"] or not item["degraded_sha256"] for item in items):
        reasons.append("artifact_hash_missing")
    if any(not item["license_evidence_id"] for item in items):
        reasons.append("license_evidence_missing")
    return {
        "dataset_version": manifest["dataset_version"],
        "manifest_sha256": manifest["manifest_sha256"],
        "item_counts": kinds,
        "missing_slices": sorted(REQUIRED_SLICES - slices),
        "missing_degradations": sorted(ALLOWED_DEGRADATIONS - degradations),
        "missing_splits": sorted(ALLOWED_SPLITS - splits),
        "ready_for_human_calibration": not reasons,
        "readiness_reasons": reasons,
        "release_gate_eligible": False,
    }

"""Fail-closed verifier cho evaluator assets; tuyệt đối không tải mạng."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from platform_core.i18n import N_
from platform_core.runtime_paths import data_path

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
LPIPS_REQUIRED_ROLES = {"linear_alex_v0.1", "backbone_alexnet"}
LPIPS_SOURCE = "https://github.com/richzhang/PerceptualSimilarity"


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _safe_filename(raw: object) -> str:
    value = str(raw or "").replace("\\", "/")
    path = Path(value)
    if not value or path.name != value or value in {".", ".."}:
        raise ValueError(N_("Tên evaluator artifact không hợp lệ."))
    return value


def verify_manifest(evaluator_key: str, root: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Verify manifest + bytes + SHA; trả reason an toàn, không trả local path."""
    key = str(evaluator_key or "").strip()
    if key != "lpips":
        return {"ready": False, "reason": "evaluator_not_provisionable", "artifacts": []}
    base = (root or Path(data_path("qualitylab", "models"))).resolve()
    evaluator_dir = (base / key).resolve()
    if evaluator_dir.parent != base:
        return {"ready": False, "reason": "unsafe_evaluator_path", "artifacts": []}
    manifest_path = evaluator_dir / "manifest.json"
    if not manifest_path.is_file():
        return {"ready": False, "reason": "manifest_missing", "artifacts": []}
    try:
        payload = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if payload.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise ValueError(N_("Sai schema evaluator manifest."))
        if payload.get("evaluator") != key or payload.get("package_version") != "0.1.4":
            raise ValueError(N_("Evaluator hoặc package version không khớp registry."))
        if payload.get("source") != LPIPS_SOURCE or payload.get("license") != "BSD-2-Clause":
            raise ValueError(N_("Source hoặc license evaluator không khớp registry."))
        raw_artifacts = payload.get("artifacts")
        if not isinstance(raw_artifacts, list) or not raw_artifacts:
            raise ValueError(N_("Evaluator manifest không có artifact."))
        roles: set[str] = set()
        verified: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for raw in raw_artifacts:
            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
                raise ValueError(N_("Evaluator artifact phải là object."))
            role = str(raw.get("role") or "").strip()
            filename = _safe_filename(raw.get("filename"))
            expected_size = int(raw.get("bytes") or 0)
            expected_sha = str(raw.get("sha256") or "").lower()
            source_url = str(raw.get("source_url") or "").strip()
            artifact_license = str(raw.get("license") or "").strip()
            if (not role or role in roles or expected_size <= 0 or
                    expected_size > MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES or len(expected_sha) != 64 or
                    not source_url.startswith("https://") or not artifact_license):
                raise ValueError(N_("Metadata evaluator artifact không hợp lệ."))
            artifact = (evaluator_dir / filename).resolve()
            if artifact.parent != evaluator_dir or not artifact.is_file():
                raise ValueError(N_("Thiếu evaluator artifact đã khai báo."))
            actual_size = artifact.stat().st_size
            if actual_size != expected_size or _sha256(artifact) != expected_sha:
                raise ValueError(N_("Evaluator artifact lệch bytes hoặc SHA-256."))
            roles.add(role)
            verified.append({"role": role, "bytes": actual_size, "sha256": expected_sha})
        if not LPIPS_REQUIRED_ROLES.issubset(roles):
            raise ValueError(N_("LPIPS thiếu linear weight hoặc AlexNet backbone."))
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        return {"ready": False, "reason": type(exc).__name__, "artifacts": []}
    return {"ready": True, "reason": "verified", "artifacts": verified,
            "package_version": "0.1.4"}


def public_asset_status() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Chỉ expose trạng thái/reason; không lộ đường dẫn máy hoặc filename."""
    result = verify_manifest("lpips")
    return {"lpips": {"ready": result["ready"], "reason": result["reason"],
                       "verified_artifacts": len(result["artifacts"])}}

"""Worker handler cho evaluation foundation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import platform
import shutil
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

from apps.qualitylab.contracts import build_report
from apps.qualitylab.registry import enabled_pack, pack_evaluators
from apps.qualitylab.services.media import inspect_media, kind_for_name
from apps.qualitylab.services.subtitle import inspect_subtitle
from apps.qualitylab.services.upscale import inspect_upscale_pair
from apps.qualitylab.services.upscale_video import inspect_upscale_video_pair
from platform_core.i18n import N_
from platform_core.storage import get_storage

MAX_TEXT_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024


def _copy_from_storage(key: str, target: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with get_storage().open(key) as source, target.open("wb") as output:
        while chunk := source.read(1024 * 1024):
            digest.update(chunk)
            output.write(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _environment() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Không lưu hostname/user/path; chỉ fingerprint tái lập không định danh."""
    return {
        "device": "cpu",
        "os": platform.system(),
        "os_release": platform.release(),
        "architecture": platform.machine(),
        "python": platform.python_version(),
        "gpu_driver": "NOT_APPLICABLE",
    }


def _read_truth(params: dict) -> str:
    key = str(params.get("expected_text_key") or "").strip()
    if not key:
        # Chỉ giữ tương thích cho job test/legacy; UI không ghi transcript vào DB.
        return str(params.get("expected_text") or "")[:100_000]
    with get_storage().open(key) as stream:
        payload = stream.read(100_001)
    if len(payload) > 100_000:
        raise ValueError(N_("Transcript chuẩn vượt 100 KB."))
    return payload.decode("utf-8-sig")


def handle(params: dict, ctx=None) -> dict:
    pack_key = str(params.get("pack") or "")
    pack = enabled_pack(pack_key)
    source_key = str(params.get("source_key") or "").strip()
    source_name = Path(str(params.get("source_name") or source_key)).name
    if not source_key:
        raise ValueError(N_("Thiếu source artifact key."))
    source_kind = kind_for_name(source_name)
    if source_kind not in pack["accepts"]:
        raise ValueError(N_(f"Pack {pack_key} không nhận loại {source_kind}."))

    started = time.perf_counter()
    ephemeral = [str(value) for value in params.get("ephemeral_keys", []) if value]
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ltt_qualitylab_"))
    try:
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.stage("input_copy", N_("Đang đọc artifact để đánh giá."),
                      details={"pack": pack_key, "source_kind": source_kind})
            ctx.progress(10, N_("Đang đọc artifact"))
        local = work / (source_name or f"source{Path(source_key).suffix}")
        source_sha256 = _copy_from_storage(source_key, local)
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(35, N_("Đang kiểm tra contract"))

        extra_artifacts: dict[str, object] = {}
        if pack_key in {"upscale_paired_diagnostic", "upscale_video_diagnostic"}:
            reference_key = str(params.get("reference_key") or "").strip()
            if not reference_key:
                raise ValueError(N_("Pack paired thiếu ảnh HR reference."))
            reference = work / ("reference" + (Path(reference_key).suffix or ".bin"))
            reference_sha256 = _copy_from_storage(reference_key, reference)
            low_key = str(params.get("low_input_key") or "").strip()
            low_path = None
            low_sha256 = ""
            if low_key:
                low_path = work / ("low-input" + (Path(low_key).suffix or ".bin"))
                low_sha256 = _copy_from_storage(low_key, low_path)
            if pack_key == "upscale_video_diagnostic":
                dimensions, summary = inspect_upscale_video_pair(
                    local, reference, low_path, work,
                    dict(params.get("source_job_performance") or {}))
            else:
                dimensions, summary = inspect_upscale_pair(local, reference, low_path)
            extra_artifacts = {
                "reference_sha256": reference_sha256,
                "low_input_sha256": low_sha256 or None,
            }
        elif source_kind == "subtitle":
            if local.stat().st_size > MAX_TEXT_BYTES:
                raise ValueError(N_("File subtitle vượt 4 MB."))
            raw = local.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            dimensions, summary = inspect_subtitle(
                raw, _read_truth(params))
        else:
            source_kind, dimensions, summary = inspect_media(
                local, dict(params.get("expectations") or {}))

        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(85, N_("Đang tổng hợp bằng chứng"))
        report = build_report(
            evaluation_id=getattr(ctx, "job_id", "adhoc"), pack=pack_key,
            source_kind=source_kind, evaluator_version="qualitylab-foundation-1.0.0",
            dimensions=dimensions,
            runtime={"seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4),
                     "source_bytes": local.stat().st_size,
                     "summary": summary},
            source_artifact={"sha256": source_sha256,
                             "bytes": local.stat().st_size,
                             "kind": source_kind, **extra_artifacts},
            evaluators=pack_evaluators(pack_key),
            environment=_environment(),
        )
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.stage("evaluation_complete", N_("Đã tạo report chất lượng."),
                      details={"pack": pack_key,
                               "verdict": report["overall_verdict"]})
            ctx.progress(100, N_("Đã đánh giá xong"))
        return {"report": report, "overall_verdict": report["overall_verdict"],
                "pack": pack_key, "source_kind": source_kind}
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
        storage = get_storage()
        for key in ephemeral:
            try:
                storage.delete(key)
            except Exception:
                # Cleanup failure phải làm job fail để operator thấy và xử lý,
                # không lặng lẽ giữ raw upload ngoài retention contract.
                raise RuntimeError(N_("Không xóa được input tạm của Quality Lab."))

"""Materialize dataset được cấp quyền vào thư mục ngoài repo, theo kiểu fail-closed."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from apps.qualitylab.datasets import validate_manifest
from apps.qualitylab.services.media import inspect_media, kind_for_name
from platform_core.i18n import N_


def _source_path(root: Path, value: object, label: str) -> Path:
    raw = str(value or "").replace("\\", "/").strip()
    relative = Path(raw)
    if not raw or relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} phải là đường dẫn tương đối an toàn."))
    resolved_root = root.resolve()
    resolved = (resolved_root / relative).resolve()
    try:
        resolved.relative_to(resolved_root)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} nằm ngoài source root.")) from exc
    if not resolved.is_file():
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} không tồn tại hoặc không phải file."))
    return resolved


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _probe(path: Path, expected_kind: str, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    extension_kind = kind_for_name(path.name)
    if extension_kind != expected_kind:
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} có phần mở rộng không khớp media_kind."))
    actual_kind, dimensions, metadata = inspect_media(path, {})
    if actual_kind != expected_kind or any(item.verdict == "FAIL" for item in dimensions):
        raise ValueError(N_(f"{label} không giải mã được hoặc sai media_kind."))
    return metadata


def inspect_intake(payload: dict[str, Any], source_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate nguồn thật và dựng manifest deterministic nhưng chưa ghi file."""
    if payload.get("schema_version") != 1 or payload.get("app_slug") != "upscalevideo":
        raise ValueError(N_("Dataset intake phải dùng schema v1 cho Upscale."))
    raw_items = payload.get("items")
    if not isinstance(raw_items, list) or not raw_items:
        raise ValueError(N_("Dataset intake chưa có sample."))

    normalized_items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    probes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for raw in raw_items:
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise ValueError(N_("Sample intake phải là object."))
        evidence_id = str(raw.get("license_evidence_id") or "").strip()
        if not evidence_id:
            raise ValueError(N_("Sample thiếu license_evidence_id có thể kiểm toán."))
        media_kind = str(raw.get("media_kind") or "image")
        reference = _source_path(source_root, raw.get("reference_source"),
                                 "reference_source")
        degraded = _source_path(source_root, raw.get("degraded_source"),
                                "degraded_source")
        reference_metadata = _probe(reference, media_kind, "reference_source")
        degraded_metadata = _probe(degraded, media_kind, "degraded_source")
        sample_id = str(raw.get("id") or "").strip()
        reference_key = f"reference/{sample_id}{reference.suffix.lower()}"
        degraded_key = f"degraded/{sample_id}{degraded.suffix.lower()}"
        normalized_items.append({
            **raw,
            "reference_key": reference_key,
            "degraded_key": degraded_key,
            "reference_sha256": _sha256(reference),
            "degraded_sha256": _sha256(degraded),
        })
        probes.append({
            "id": sample_id,
            "reference_source": reference,
            "degraded_source": degraded,
            "reference_key": reference_key,
            "degraded_key": degraded_key,
            "reference_metadata": reference_metadata,
            "degraded_metadata": degraded_metadata,
        })
    manifest = validate_manifest({
        "schema_version": 1,
        "app_slug": "upscalevideo",
        "dataset_version": payload.get("dataset_version"),
        "items": normalized_items,
    })
    return {"manifest": manifest, "probes": probes}


def materialize_dataset(payload: dict[str, Any], source_root: Path,
                        output_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Copy atomically; không ghi đè dataset cũ và không giữ absolute path."""
    inspected = inspect_intake(payload, source_root)
    destination = output_root.resolve()
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError(N_("Output dataset đã tồn tại; không được ghi đè."))
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".qualitylab-stage-",
                                    dir=str(destination.parent)))
    try:
        for probe in inspected["probes"]:
            for source_label, key_label in (("reference_source", "reference_key"),
                                             ("degraded_source", "degraded_key")):
                target = staging / probe[key_label]
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(probe[source_label], target)
        manifest_path = staging / "manifest.json"
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(inspected["manifest"], ensure_ascii=False,
                                             sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n",
                                 encoding="utf-8")
        os.replace(staging, destination)
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    return inspected["manifest"]

def enabled_pack(key: str) -> dict:
    pack = PACKS.get(key)
    if pack is None:
        raise ValueError(N_(f"Pack không tồn tại: {key}"))
    disabled = [name for name in pack["evaluators"] if not EVALUATORS[name].enabled]
    if disabled:
        raise RuntimeError(N_(f"Pack còn evaluator chưa duyệt: {', '.join(disabled)}"))
    return pack


def pack_evaluators(key: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Snapshot version/license/hash để report cũ không đổi khi registry đổi."""
    pack = enabled_pack(key)
    snapshots = [asdict(EVALUATORS[name]) for name in pack["evaluators"]]
    for snapshot in snapshots:
        if snapshot["key"] == "ffmpeg_libvmaf":
            from apps.qualitylab.services.upscale_video import (
                libvmaf_runtime_fingerprint,
            )
            fingerprint = libvmaf_runtime_fingerprint()
            snapshot["model_sha256"] = fingerprint["binary_sha256"]
            snapshot["version"] = (fingerprint["ffmpeg_version"] +
                                   f"; model={fingerprint['model']}")[:240]
    return snapshots


def public_registry() -> dict:
    """Registry an toàn cho UI; không chứa đường dẫn model/cache hay cấu hình máy."""
    return {
        "packs": {key: dict(value) for key, value in PACKS.items()},
        "evaluators": {key: asdict(value) for key, value in EVALUATORS.items()},
    }

"""UI/API operator-only của Quality Lab foundation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
import uuid
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, RedirectResponse
from sqlalchemy import select

from apps.qualitylab.manifest import MANIFEST
from apps.qualitylab.evaluator_assets import public_asset_status
from apps.qualitylab.registry import PACKS, public_registry
from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
from platform_core.job_submit import dedupe_key_for, submit_with_credit
from platform_core.models import Job
from platform_core.storage import CLOUDFLARE_BODY_LIMIT, get_storage
from server.auth.csrf import issue_csrf_token, verify_csrf_token
from server.deps import get_db, require_operator, user_hien_tai
from server.templating import templates

router = APIRouter(tags=["qualitylab"])
MAX_LOCAL_UPLOAD = min(90 * 1024 * 1024, CLOUDFLARE_BODY_LIMIT)
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".bmp",
    ".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv", ".avi", ".webm", ".m4v",
    ".mp3", ".wav", ".m4a", ".aac", ".flac", ".ogg", ".srt",
}


def _recent(db, limit: int = 30) -> list[Job]:
    return list(db.execute(select(Job).where(
        Job.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug).order_by(Job.created_at.desc()).limit(limit)
    ).scalars().all())


def _context(request: Request, db, *, error: str = "") -> dict:
    return {
        "request": request, "app": MANIFEST, "nav": MANIFEST.slug,
        "csrf_token": issue_csrf_token(request), "packs": PACKS,
        "registry": public_registry(), "asset_status": public_asset_status(),
        "recent_jobs": _recent(db), "error": error,
    }


@router.get("", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def page(request: Request, _operator: str = Depends(require_operator),
         db=Depends(get_db)):
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "qualitylab.html", _context(request, db))


async def _store_upload(upload: UploadFile, owner_id: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    name = PurePosixPath(upload.filename or "").name
    ext = PurePosixPath(name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Định dạng input chưa được hỗ trợ."))
    data = await upload.read(MAX_LOCAL_UPLOAD + 1)
    if not data or len(data) > MAX_LOCAL_UPLOAD:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Input rỗng hoặc vượt 90 MB."))
    key = f"qualitylab/{owner_id}/ephemeral/{uuid.uuid4().hex}{ext}"
    get_storage().put(key, io.BytesIO(data),
                      content_type=(upload.content_type or "application/octet-stream"))
    return key, f"input{ext}"


def _store_truth(text: str, owner_id: str) -> str:
    payload = text.encode("utf-8")
    if len(payload) > 100_000:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Transcript chuẩn vượt 100 KB."))
    key = f"qualitylab/{owner_id}/ephemeral/{uuid.uuid4().hex}.truth.txt"
    get_storage().put(key, io.BytesIO(payload), content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8")
    return key


@router.post("/evaluate")
async def evaluate(
    request: Request,
    csrf_token: str = Form(...),
    pack: str = Form(...),
    source_key: str = Form(""),
    source_name: str = Form(""),
    expected_text: str = Form(""),
    expected_width: int = Form(0),
    expected_height: int = Form(0),
    expected_duration: float = Form(0),
    expected_fps: float = Form(0),
    expected_audio: str = Form(""),
    source_file: UploadFile | None = File(default=None),
    reference_key: str = Form(""),
    low_input_key: str = Form(""),
    source_job_id: str = Form(""),
    reference_file: UploadFile | None = File(default=None),
    low_input_file: UploadFile | None = File(default=None),
    _operator: str = Depends(require_operator),
    db=Depends(get_db),
):
    if not verify_csrf_token(request, csrf_token):
        return templates.TemplateResponse(
            request, "qualitylab.html", _context(
                request, db, error=_t("Phiên đã hết hạn — tải lại trang rồi thử lại.")),
            status_code=400)
    if pack not in PACKS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Pack đánh giá không hợp lệ."))
    current = user_hien_tai(request)
    if current is None:
        return templates.TemplateResponse(
            request, "qualitylab.html", _context(
                request, db, error=_t("Cần tài khoản quản trị CSDL để tạo evaluation job.")),
            status_code=400)

    ephemeral: list[str] = []
    key = source_key.strip()
    name = PurePosixPath(source_name or key).name
    ref_key = reference_key.strip()
    low_key = low_input_key.strip()
    try:
        if source_file is not None and source_file.filename:
            key, name = await _store_upload(source_file, current.id)
            ephemeral.append(key)
        if not key or not get_storage().exists(key):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Source artifact không tồn tại."))
        if reference_file is not None and reference_file.filename:
            ref_key, _ = await _store_upload(reference_file, current.id)
            ephemeral.append(ref_key)
        if low_input_file is not None and low_input_file.filename:
            low_key, _ = await _store_upload(low_input_file, current.id)
            ephemeral.append(low_key)
        if ref_key and not get_storage().exists(ref_key):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Ảnh HR reference không tồn tại."))
        if low_key and not get_storage().exists(low_key):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Ảnh LR đầu vào không tồn tại."))
        if pack in {"upscale_paired_diagnostic", "upscale_video_diagnostic"} and not ref_key:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t("Pack paired cần HR reference."))
        performance: dict = {}
        source_job_value = source_job_id.strip()
        if source_job_value:
            source_job = db.get(Job, source_job_value)
            if (source_job is None or source_job.app_slug != "upscalevideo" or
                    source_job.status != "done"):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t(
                    "Job nguồn phải là job Upscale đã hoàn tất."))
            result = source_job.result if isinstance(source_job.result, dict) else {}
            performance = {key: result.get(key) for key in (
                "processing_seconds", "frames", "encoder", "preset", "target_height")}
        audio_expectation = None
        if expected_audio in {"yes", "no"}:
            audio_expectation = expected_audio == "yes"
        truth_key = ""
        if expected_text:
            truth_key = _store_truth(expected_text, current.id)
            ephemeral.append(truth_key)
        params = {
            "pack": pack, "source_key": key, "source_name": name,
            "reference_key": ref_key, "low_input_key": low_key,
            "source_job_id": source_job_value,
            "source_job_performance": performance,
            "expected_text_key": truth_key,
            "expectations": {
                "expected_width": max(0, expected_width),
                "expected_height": max(0, expected_height),
                "expected_duration": max(0.0, expected_duration),
                "expected_fps": max(0.0, expected_fps),
                "expected_audio": audio_expectation,
            },
            "ephemeral_keys": ephemeral,
        }
        job = submit_with_credit(
            db, user_id=current.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
            job_type="qualitylab.evaluate", params=params,
            dedupe_key=dedupe_key_for("qualitylab.evaluate", params), max_attempts=2,
        )
        db.flush()
        return RedirectResponse(f"/qualitylab/reports/{job.id}", status_code=303)
    except Exception:
        for item in ephemeral:
            get_storage().delete(item)
        raise


def _quality_job(db, job_id: str) -> Job:
    job = db.get(Job, job_id)
    if job is None or job.app_slug != MANIFEST.slug:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t("Không tìm thấy evaluation."))
    return job


@router.get("/reports/{job_id}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def report_page(request: Request, job_id: str,
                _operator: str = Depends(require_operator), db=Depends(get_db)):
    job = _quality_job(db, job_id)
    report = (job.result or {}).get("report") if isinstance(job.result, dict) else None
    response = templates.TemplateResponse(request, "qualitylab_report.html", {
        "request": request, "app": MANIFEST, "nav": MANIFEST.slug,
        "job": job, "report": report,
    })
    if report is None and job.status in {"queued", "running"}:
        response.headers["Refresh"] = "2"
    return response


@router.get("/api/reports/{job_id}")
def report_api(job_id: str, _operator: str = Depends(require_operator),
               db=Depends(get_db)):
    job = _quality_job(db, job_id)
    report = (job.result or {}).get("report") if isinstance(job.result, dict) else None
    if report is None:
        return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "status": job.status}, status_code=409)
    return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "report": report})

"""Aggregate GPU evidence for isolated benchmarks; never a production profiler."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import subprocess
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Callable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GpuSample:
    timestamp_seconds: float
    memory_used_mb: int
    utilization_percent: int
    temperature_c: int


def query_gpu_sample(gpu_uuid: str, *, run=subprocess.run,
                     clock=time.monotonic) -> GpuSample:
    """Read one whole-device sample and select by immutable UUID, never index."""
    result = run([
        "nvidia-smi",
        "--query-gpu=uuid,memory.used,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu",
        "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
    ], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("nvidia-smi query failed")
    for raw_line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split(",")]
        if len(parts) != 4 or parts[0] != gpu_uuid:
            continue
        try:
            return GpuSample(clock(), int(float(parts[1])), int(float(parts[2])),
                             int(float(parts[3])))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError("nvidia-smi returned non-numeric metrics") from exc
    raise RuntimeError("assigned GPU UUID not found")


class GpuEvidenceSampler:
    """Sample aggregate GPU state in a background thread during one benchmark.

    `memory.used` is the whole-device allocation reported by nvidia-smi. The
    delta from an idle baseline is useful only when the benchmark owns an idle
    GPU; the caller must enforce that precondition and preserve this scope in
    the evidence instead of calling it per-process memory.
    """

    def __init__(self, gpu_uuid: str, *, interval_seconds: float = 0.2,
                 run=subprocess.run, clock=time.monotonic):
        if not gpu_uuid:
            raise ValueError("gpu_uuid is required")
        if not 0.05 <= interval_seconds <= 5.0:
            raise ValueError("interval_seconds must be between 0.05 and 5")
        self.gpu_uuid = gpu_uuid
        self.interval_seconds = float(interval_seconds)
        self._run = run
        self._clock = clock
        self._samples: list[GpuSample] = []
        self._errors = 0
        self._stop = threading.Event()
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None

    @property
    def baseline(self) -> GpuSample:
        if not self._samples:
            raise RuntimeError("sampler has not started")
        return self._samples[0]

    def _capture(self) -> None:
        try:
            sample = query_gpu_sample(self.gpu_uuid, run=self._run,
                                      clock=self._clock)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, RuntimeError):
            self._errors += 1
            return
        self._samples.append(sample)

    def start(self) -> "GpuEvidenceSampler":
        if self._thread is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("sampler already started")
        self._capture()
        if not self._samples:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot capture GPU baseline")
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._loop,
                                        name="qualitylab-gpu-sampler", daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()
        return self

    def _loop(self) -> None:
        while not self._stop.wait(self.interval_seconds):
            self._capture()

    def stop(self) -> dict:
        if self._thread is None:
            raise RuntimeError("sampler has not started")
        self._stop.set()
        self._thread.join(timeout=max(2.0, self.interval_seconds * 3))
        self._capture()
        self._thread = None
        return self.summary()

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        if not self._samples:
            raise RuntimeError("sampler has no evidence")
        baseline = self._samples[0]
        peak_memory = max(item.memory_used_mb for item in self._samples)
        duration = max(0.0, self._samples[-1].timestamp_seconds -
                       baseline.timestamp_seconds)
        return {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "gpu_id_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                self.gpu_uuid.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
            "scope": "whole_device_delta_from_idle_baseline",
            "sampling_interval_ms": round(self.interval_seconds * 1000),
            "sample_count": len(self._samples),
            "sampling_errors": self._errors,
            "duration_seconds": round(duration, 3),
            "baseline_memory_used_mb": baseline.memory_used_mb,
            "peak_memory_used_mb": peak_memory,
            "peak_delta_memory_mb": max(0, peak_memory - baseline.memory_used_mb),
            "baseline_utilization_percent": baseline.utilization_percent,
            "peak_utilization_percent": max(
                item.utilization_percent for item in self._samples),
            "peak_temperature_c": max(item.temperature_c for item in self._samples),
            "qualified": self._errors == 0 and len(self._samples) >= 2,
            "qualification_note": (
                "Valid only for an otherwise idle, exclusively assigned GPU; "
                "memory is whole-device allocation, not per-process memory."
            ),
        }

    def __enter__(self) -> "GpuEvidenceSampler":
        return self.start()

    def __exit__(self, _exc_type, _exc, _traceback) -> None:
        self.stop()

"""Evaluator media contract bằng Pillow/ffprobe, không dùng model học máy."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import subprocess
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from apps.qualitylab.contracts import Dimension, Metric
from platform_core.i18n import N_

IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".bmp"}
VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = {".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv", ".avi", ".webm", ".m4v"}
AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = {".mp3", ".wav", ".m4a", ".aac", ".flac", ".ogg"}


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def ffprobe_version() -> str:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-version"], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=10, check=False)
        first = (result.stdout or "").splitlines()
        return first[0][:240] if result.returncode == 0 and first else "unavailable"
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return "unavailable"


def kind_for_name(name: str) -> str:
    suffix = Path(name).suffix.lower()
    if suffix in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
        return "image"
    if suffix in VIDEO_EXTENSIONS:
        return "video"
    if suffix in AUDIO_EXTENSIONS:
        return "audio"
    if suffix in {".srt", ".vtt", ".ass"}:
        return "subtitle"
    return "unknown"


def _ratio(value: str) -> float:
    try:
        left, right = str(value or "0/1").split("/", 1)
        denominator = float(right)
        return float(left) / denominator if denominator else 0.0
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _number(value: object) -> float:
    try:
        number = float(value or 0.0)
        return number if math.isfinite(number) else 0.0
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _close(actual: float, expected: float, *, relative: float = 0.02,
           absolute: float = 0.1) -> bool:
    return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=relative, abs_tol=absolute)


def inspect_image(path: Path, expectations: dict) -> tuple[str, list[Dimension], dict]:
    try:
        with Image.open(path) as image:
            image.verify()
        with Image.open(path) as image:
            width, height = image.size
            mode, fmt = image.mode, image.format or ""
    except Exception as exc:
        metric = Metric("decodable", N_("Ảnh giải mã được"), False, verdict="FAIL",
                        evidence={"error_type": type(exc).__name__})
        return "image", [Dimension("technical", N_("Kỹ thuật"), "FAIL", (metric,))], {}

    metrics = [
        Metric("decodable", N_("Ảnh giải mã được"), True, verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("width", N_("Chiều rộng"), width, "px", "PASS"),
        Metric("height", N_("Chiều cao"), height, "px", "PASS"),
        Metric("format", N_("Định dạng"), fmt, verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("mode", N_("Kênh màu"), mode, verdict="PASS"),
    ]
    verdict = "PASS"
    for key, actual in (("width", width), ("height", height)):
        expected = int(expectations.get(f"expected_{key}") or 0)
        if expected and actual != expected:
            metrics.append(Metric(
                f"{key}_expected", N_(f"{key} đúng yêu cầu"), actual, "px", "FAIL",
                threshold=f"= {expected}", evidence={"expected": expected}))
            verdict = "FAIL"
    return "image", [Dimension("technical", N_("Kỹ thuật"), verdict, tuple(metrics))], {
        "width": width, "height": height, "format": fmt, "mode": mode,
    }


def inspect_av(path: Path, expectations: dict) -> tuple[str, list[Dimension], dict]:
    command = [
        "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_error", "-show_format", "-show_streams",
        "-of", "json", str(path),
    ]
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=60, check=False)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        metric = Metric("ffprobe", N_("FFprobe hoạt động"), False, verdict="FAIL",
                        evidence={"error_type": type(exc).__name__})
        return "unknown", [Dimension("technical", N_("Kỹ thuật"), "FAIL", (metric,))], {}
    try:
        payload = json.loads(result.stdout or "{}")
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        payload = {}
    streams = payload.get("streams") if isinstance(payload.get("streams"), list) else []
    videos = [item for item in streams if item.get("codec_type") == "video"]
    audios = [item for item in streams if item.get("codec_type") == "audio"]
    fmt = payload.get("format") if isinstance(payload.get("format"), dict) else {}
    duration = _number(fmt.get("duration"))
    decodable = result.returncode == 0 and bool(streams)
    kind = "video" if videos else ("audio" if audios else "unknown")
    first_video = videos[0] if videos else {}
    width = int(first_video.get("width") or 0)
    height = int(first_video.get("height") or 0)
    fps = _ratio(first_video.get("avg_frame_rate") or "0/1")
    metrics = [
        Metric("decodable", N_("Media giải mã được"), decodable,
               verdict="PASS" if decodable else "FAIL",
               evidence={} if decodable else {"return_code": result.returncode}),
        Metric("duration", N_("Thời lượng"), round(duration, 4), "s",
               "PASS" if duration > 0 else "FAIL"),
        Metric("video_streams", N_("Số luồng hình"), len(videos), verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("audio_streams", N_("Số luồng tiếng"), len(audios), verdict="PASS"),
    ]
    verdict = "PASS" if decodable and duration > 0 else "FAIL"
    if videos:
        metrics.extend((
            Metric("width", N_("Chiều rộng"), width, "px", "PASS"),
            Metric("height", N_("Chiều cao"), height, "px", "PASS"),
            Metric("fps", N_("Tốc độ khung hình"), round(fps, 4), "fps",
                   "PASS" if fps > 0 else "WARN"),
        ))
    expected_audio = expectations.get("expected_audio")
    if expected_audio is not None and bool(audios) != bool(expected_audio):
        metrics.append(Metric("audio_expected", N_("Luồng tiếng đúng yêu cầu"),
                              bool(audios), verdict="FAIL",
                              threshold=str(bool(expected_audio))))
        verdict = "FAIL"
    for key, actual, unit in (("width", width, "px"), ("height", height, "px"),
                              ("duration", duration, "s"), ("fps", fps, "fps")):
        raw = expectations.get(f"expected_{key}")
        if raw in (None, "", 0, 0.0) or (key in {"width", "height", "fps"} and not videos):
            continue
        expected = float(raw)
        ok = (actual == expected if key in {"width", "height"}
              else _close(float(actual), expected))
        metrics.append(Metric(f"{key}_expected", N_(f"{key} đúng yêu cầu"),
                              round(float(actual), 4), unit,
                              "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", threshold=f"≈ {expected}",
                              evidence={"expected": expected}))
        if not ok:
            verdict = "FAIL"
    return kind, [Dimension("technical", N_("Kỹ thuật"), verdict, tuple(metrics))], {
        "duration": round(duration, 4), "width": width, "height": height,
        "fps": round(fps, 4), "video_streams": len(videos),
        "audio_streams": len(audios), "ffprobe_version": ffprobe_version(),
    }


def inspect_media(path: Path, expectations: dict) -> tuple[str, list[Dimension], dict]:
    return (inspect_image(path, expectations) if path.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS
            else inspect_av(path, expectations))

"""Bộ đo SRT deterministic: cue, timing, readability và transcript error."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata
from dataclasses import dataclass

from apps.qualitylab.contracts import Dimension, Metric
from platform_core.i18n import N_

_TIME = re.compile(
    r"(?P<h>\d{1,2}):(?P<m>\d{2}):(?P<s>\d{2})[,.](?P<ms>\d{3})")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cue:
    start: float
    end: float
    lines: tuple[str, ...]

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return " ".join(part.strip() for part in self.lines if part.strip())


def _seconds(value: str) -> float:
    match = _TIME.fullmatch(value.strip())
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(N_("timestamp không hợp lệ"))
    return (int(match["h"]) * 3600 + int(match["m"]) * 60 + int(match["s"])
            + int(match["ms"]) / 1000.0)


def parse_srt(text: str) -> list[Cue]:
    normalized = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").strip()
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError(N_("subtitle rỗng"))
    cues: list[Cue] = []
    for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", normalized):
        lines = [line.rstrip() for line in block.splitlines()]
        timing_index = next((index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if "-->" in line), -1)
        if timing_index < 0:
            raise ValueError(N_("cue thiếu dòng thời gian"))
        sides = [part.strip() for part in lines[timing_index].split("-->", 1)]
        cue = Cue(_seconds(sides[0]), _seconds(sides[1]),
                  tuple(line for line in lines[timing_index + 1:] if line.strip()))
        if not cue.lines:
            raise ValueError(N_("cue không có nội dung"))
        cues.append(cue)
    return cues


def _normalize(text: str) -> list[str]:
    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).casefold()
    value = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", value, flags=re.UNICODE)
    return [part for part in value.split() if part]


def _distance(left: list[str], right: list[str]) -> int:
    previous = list(range(len(right) + 1))
    for i, lvalue in enumerate(left, 1):
        current = [i]
        for j, rvalue in enumerate(right, 1):
            current.append(min(current[-1] + 1, previous[j] + 1,
                               previous[j - 1] + (lvalue != rvalue)))
        previous = current
    return previous[-1]


def inspect_subtitle(text: str, expected_text: str = "") -> tuple[list[Dimension], dict]:
    try:
        cues = parse_srt(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        metric = Metric("parseable", N_("SRT đọc được"), False, verdict="FAIL",
                        evidence={"reason": str(exc)[:120]})
        return [Dimension("technical", N_("Kỹ thuật"), "FAIL", (metric,))], {}

    invalid_duration = sum(1 for cue in cues if cue.end <= cue.start)
    overlaps = sum(1 for prev, cue in zip(cues, cues[1:]) if cue.start < prev.end)
    non_monotonic = sum(1 for prev, cue in zip(cues, cues[1:])
                        if cue.start < prev.start)
    max_lines = max(len(cue.lines) for cue in cues)
    max_chars = max(len(line) for cue in cues for line in cue.lines)
    cps_values = [len(cue.text) / max(cue.end - cue.start, 0.001) for cue in cues]
    max_cps = max(cps_values)
    technical_verdict = ("FAIL" if invalid_duration or non_monotonic else
                         ("WARN" if overlaps else "PASS"))
    technical = Dimension("technical", N_("Kỹ thuật"), technical_verdict, (
        Metric("parseable", N_("SRT đọc được"), True, verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("cue_count", N_("Số cue"), len(cues), verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("invalid_duration", N_("Cue có duration sai"), invalid_duration,
               verdict="PASS" if invalid_duration == 0 else "FAIL", threshold="= 0"),
        Metric("non_monotonic", N_("Timestamp không tăng"), non_monotonic,
               verdict="PASS" if non_monotonic == 0 else "FAIL", threshold="= 0"),
        Metric("overlaps", N_("Cue chồng nhau"), overlaps,
               verdict="PASS" if overlaps == 0 else "WARN", threshold="= 0"),
    ))
    readability_warn = max_lines > 2 or max_chars > 42 or max_cps > 20
    readability = Dimension("readability", N_("Khả năng đọc"),
                            "WARN" if readability_warn else "PASS", (
        Metric("max_lines", N_("Số dòng tối đa"), max_lines, "line",
               "PASS" if max_lines <= 2 else "WARN", threshold="≤ 2"),
        Metric("max_chars_per_line", N_("Ký tự tối đa mỗi dòng"), max_chars, "char",
               "PASS" if max_chars <= 42 else "WARN", threshold="≤ 42"),
        Metric("max_cps", N_("Tốc độ đọc cao nhất"), round(max_cps, 2), "char/s",
               "PASS" if max_cps <= 20 else "WARN", threshold="≤ 20"),
    ))
    dimensions = [technical, readability]
    summary = {"cue_count": len(cues), "invalid_duration": invalid_duration,
               "overlaps": overlaps, "max_lines": max_lines,
               "max_chars_per_line": max_chars, "max_cps": round(max_cps, 2)}
    expected_words = _normalize(expected_text)
    if expected_words:
        actual_words = _normalize(" ".join(cue.text for cue in cues))
        edits = _distance(expected_words, actual_words)
        wer = edits / len(expected_words)
        dimensions.append(Dimension("content", N_("Nội dung"), "UNKNOWN", (
            Metric("wer", "Word error rate", round(wer, 4), "ratio", "UNKNOWN",
                   threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated — chỉ chẩn đoán"),
                   evidence={"reference_words": len(expected_words),
                             "hypothesis_words": len(actual_words), "edits": edits}),
        )))
        summary["wer"] = round(wer, 4)
    else:
        dimensions.append(Dimension("content", N_("Nội dung"), "UNKNOWN", (
            Metric("wer", "Word error rate", None, verdict="UNKNOWN",
                   threshold=N_("Cần transcript chuẩn")),
        )))
    return dimensions, summary

"""Paired-image diagnostics cho Upscale; chưa calibrated, không release gate."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

from apps.qualitylab.contracts import Dimension, Metric
from platform_core.i18n import N_


def _rgb(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    with Image.open(path) as image:
        image.verify()
    with Image.open(path) as image:
        return np.asarray(image.convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float32)


def _luma(rgb: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    return 0.2126 * rgb[:, :, 0] + 0.7152 * rgb[:, :, 1] + 0.0722 * rgb[:, :, 2]


def _box_mean(array: np.ndarray, radius: int = 3) -> np.ndarray:
    size = radius * 2 + 1
    padded = np.pad(array.astype(np.float64), ((radius, radius), (radius, radius)),
                    mode="reflect")
    integral = np.pad(padded, ((1, 0), (1, 0)), mode="constant").cumsum(0).cumsum(1)
    total = (integral[size:, size:] - integral[:-size, size:]
             - integral[size:, :-size] + integral[:-size, :-size])
    return total / float(size * size)


def _psnr(reference: np.ndarray, candidate: np.ndarray) -> float:
    mse = float(np.mean((reference.astype(np.float64) - candidate) ** 2))
    return 99.0 if mse == 0 else 20.0 * math.log10(255.0 / math.sqrt(mse))


def _local_ssim(reference: np.ndarray, candidate: np.ndarray) -> float:
    left, right = _luma(reference).astype(np.float64), _luma(candidate).astype(np.float64)
    mean_left, mean_right = _box_mean(left), _box_mean(right)
    var_left = np.maximum(0.0, _box_mean(left * left) - mean_left * mean_left)
    var_right = np.maximum(0.0, _box_mean(right * right) - mean_right * mean_right)
    covariance = _box_mean(left * right) - mean_left * mean_right
    c1, c2 = (0.01 * 255.0) ** 2, (0.03 * 255.0) ** 2
    numerator = (2 * mean_left * mean_right + c1) * (2 * covariance + c2)
    denominator = (mean_left * mean_left + mean_right * mean_right + c1) * (
        var_left + var_right + c2)
    return float(np.mean(numerator / np.maximum(denominator, 1e-12)))


def _gradient_energy(array: np.ndarray) -> float:
    gray = _luma(array)
    horizontal = np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(gray, axis=1))) if gray.shape[1] > 1 else 0.0
    vertical = np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(gray, axis=0))) if gray.shape[0] > 1 else 0.0
    return float(horizontal + vertical)


def _blockiness(array: np.ndarray, block: int = 8) -> float:
    gray = _luma(array)
    parts: list[float] = []
    for axis in (0, 1):
        delta = np.abs(np.diff(gray, axis=axis))
        length = delta.shape[axis]
        if length < block * 2:
            continue
        indices = np.arange(length)
        boundary = indices % block == block - 1
        interior = ~boundary
        moved = np.moveaxis(delta, axis, 0)
        if boundary.any() and interior.any():
            parts.append(float(moved[boundary].mean() - moved[interior].mean()))
    return float(np.mean(parts)) if parts else 0.0


def paired_scores(reference: np.ndarray, candidate: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
    return {
        "psnr_db": round(_psnr(reference, candidate), 4),
        "ssim_local": round(_local_ssim(reference, candidate), 6),
        "gradient_energy": round(_gradient_energy(candidate), 4),
        "blockiness": round(_blockiness(candidate), 4),
    }


def inspect_upscale_pair(candidate_path: Path, reference_path: Path,
                         low_input_path: Path | None = None
                         ) -> tuple[list[Dimension], dict]:
    try:
        candidate, reference = _rgb(candidate_path), _rgb(reference_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        metric = Metric("paired_decodable", N_("Candidate/reference giải mã được"),
                        False, verdict="FAIL",
                        evidence={"error_type": type(exc).__name__})
        return [Dimension("paired_contract", N_("Đối chiếu cặp"), "FAIL", (metric,))], {}
    same_shape = candidate.shape == reference.shape
    contract = Dimension("paired_contract", N_("Đối chiếu cặp"),
                         "PASS" if same_shape else "FAIL", (
        Metric("paired_decodable", N_("Candidate/reference giải mã được"), True,
               verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("same_dimensions", N_("Kích thước candidate khớp HR"), same_shape,
               verdict="PASS" if same_shape else "FAIL",
               threshold=f"= {reference.shape[1]}x{reference.shape[0]}",
               evidence={"candidate": list(candidate.shape[:2][::-1]),
                         "reference": list(reference.shape[:2][::-1])}),
    ))
    if not same_shape:
        return [contract], {"candidate_shape": list(candidate.shape),
                            "reference_shape": list(reference.shape)}

    candidate_scores = paired_scores(reference, candidate)
    full_reference = Dimension("full_reference", N_("Full-reference"), "UNKNOWN", (
        Metric("psnr_db", "PSNR", candidate_scores["psnr_db"], "dB", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="higher", valid_range="0..99",
               threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated — chỉ chẩn đoán")),
        Metric("ssim_local", "Local SSIM", candidate_scores["ssim_local"], "ratio",
               "UNKNOWN", direction="higher", valid_range="-1..1",
               threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated — chỉ chẩn đoán")),
    ))
    baseline_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    baseline_metrics: tuple[Metric, ...]
    baseline_verdict = "UNKNOWN"
    if low_input_path is not None:
        low = _rgb(low_input_path)
        baseline_image = Image.fromarray(low.astype(np.uint8), mode="RGB").resize(
            (reference.shape[1], reference.shape[0]), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
        baseline = np.asarray(baseline_image, dtype=np.float32)
        baseline_scores = paired_scores(reference, baseline)
        psnr_delta = candidate_scores["psnr_db"] - baseline_scores["psnr_db"]
        ssim_delta = candidate_scores["ssim_local"] - baseline_scores["ssim_local"]
        baseline_verdict = "WARN" if psnr_delta < 0 and ssim_delta < 0 else "UNKNOWN"
        baseline_metrics = (
            Metric("bicubic_psnr_db", N_("Bicubic PSNR"), baseline_scores["psnr_db"],
                   "dB", "UNKNOWN", direction="higher", valid_range="0..99"),
            Metric("bicubic_ssim_local", N_("Bicubic local SSIM"),
                   baseline_scores["ssim_local"], "ratio", "UNKNOWN",
                   direction="higher", valid_range="-1..1"),
            Metric("psnr_delta_vs_bicubic", N_("PSNR delta so với bicubic"),
                   round(psnr_delta, 4), "dB", baseline_verdict,
                   direction="higher", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
            Metric("ssim_delta_vs_bicubic", N_("SSIM delta so với bicubic"),
                   round(ssim_delta, 6), "ratio", baseline_verdict,
                   direction="higher", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
        )
    else:
        baseline_metrics = (Metric(
            "bicubic_baseline", N_("Bicubic baseline"), None, verdict="UNKNOWN",
            threshold=N_("Cần ảnh LR đầu vào")),)
    baseline_dimension = Dimension("baseline", N_("So với bicubic"),
                                   baseline_verdict, baseline_metrics)
    reference_gradient = _gradient_energy(reference)
    artifact_dimension = Dimension("artifacts", N_("Artifact proxy"), "UNKNOWN", (
        Metric("gradient_ratio", N_("Tỉ lệ năng lượng cạnh"),
               round(candidate_scores["gradient_energy"] /
                     max(reference_gradient, 1e-9), 6), "ratio", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="target", valid_range="0..inf",
               threshold=N_("Target gần 1; chưa calibrated")),
        Metric("blockiness", N_("Block boundary excess"),
               candidate_scores["blockiness"], "luma", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="lower", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
    ))
    return [contract, full_reference, baseline_dimension, artifact_dimension], {
        "candidate": candidate_scores,
        "bicubic": baseline_scores,
        "reference_gradient_energy": round(reference_gradient, 4),
    }

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@
