"""Paired-video diagnostics cho Upscale; CPU sampling, chưa calibrated."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

from apps.qualitylab.contracts import Dimension, Metric
from apps.qualitylab.services.upscale import paired_scores
from platform_core import media
from platform_core.i18n import N_

MAX_SAMPLES = 8
VMAF_MODEL = "vmaf_v0.6.1"


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def libvmaf_runtime_fingerprint() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Pin implementation/model embedded bằng hash binary, không lộ local path."""
    try:
        binary = Path(media.ffmpeg_bin())
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with binary.open("rb") as stream:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                digest.update(chunk)
        result = subprocess.run([str(binary), "-version"], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=10, check=False)
        version = (result.stdout or "").splitlines()[0][:160]
        return {"binary_sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "ffmpeg_version": version,
                "model": VMAF_MODEL}
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return {"binary_sha256": "", "ffmpeg_version": "unavailable",
                "model": VMAF_MODEL}


def _vmaf_metric(candidate_path: Path, reference_path: Path, work: Path) -> Metric:
    log_path = work / "vmaf.json"
    graph = (
        "[0:v]settb=AVTB,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[dist];"
        "[1:v]settb=AVTB,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[ref];"
        f"[dist][ref]libvmaf=model=version={VMAF_MODEL}:"
        "log_fmt=json:log_path=vmaf.json:n_threads=2")
    command = [media.ffmpeg_bin(), "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error",
               "-i", str(candidate_path), "-i", str(reference_path),
               "-lavfi", graph, "-f", "null", "-"]
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=300, check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0 or not log_path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(N_("FFmpeg/libvmaf không sẵn sàng."))
        payload = json.loads(log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        score = float(payload["pooled_metrics"]["vmaf"]["mean"])
        version = str(payload.get("version") or "")[:80]
        if not np.isfinite(score):
            raise ValueError(N_("VMAF trả điểm không hữu hạn."))
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError,
            TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        return Metric("vmaf_v0_6_1", "VMAF v0.6.1", None, "score", "UNKNOWN",
                      direction="higher", threshold=N_("Evaluator chưa sẵn sàng"),
                      evidence={"reason": type(exc).__name__, "model": VMAF_MODEL})
    fingerprint = libvmaf_runtime_fingerprint()
    return Metric(
        "vmaf_v0_6_1", "VMAF v0.6.1", round(score, 6), "score", "UNKNOWN",
        direction="higher", valid_range="0..100",
        threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated; model gốc nhắm 1080p HDTV ở khoảng 3H"),
        evidence={"libvmaf_version": version, "model": VMAF_MODEL,
                  "ffmpeg_binary_sha256": fingerprint["binary_sha256"]})


def _sample_times(duration: float) -> list[float]:
    count = max(2, min(MAX_SAMPLES, int(max(duration, 1.0) * 2)))
    # Không lấy sát EOF: container duration thường dài hơn timestamp frame cuối,
    # nên seek 0.95s trong clip 4fps/1s có thể không trả frame nào.
    start = min(0.05, max(duration * 0.1, 0.001))
    end = max(start, duration * 0.75)
    return [float(value) for value in np.linspace(start, end, count)]


def _extract(path: Path, directory: Path, times: list[float]) -> list[np.ndarray]:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    frames: list[np.ndarray] = []
    for index, timestamp in enumerate(times):
        target = directory / f"frame-{index:03d}.png"
        command = [media.ffmpeg_bin(), "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                   "-ss", f"{timestamp:.6f}", "-i", str(path), "-frames:v", "1",
                   str(target)]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0 or not target.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(N_("Không trích được frame video để đánh giá."))
        with Image.open(target) as image:
            frames.append(np.asarray(image.convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float32))
    return frames


def _mean(values: list[float]) -> float:
    return round(float(np.mean(values)), 6) if values else 0.0


def temporal_scores(reference: list[np.ndarray], candidate: list[np.ndarray]) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Residual theo thời gian; proxy chẩn đoán, không phải optical-flow metric."""
    if len(reference) != len(candidate) or len(reference) < 2:
        raise ValueError(N_("Cần ít nhất hai cặp frame đồng bộ."))
    delta_errors: list[float] = []
    luma_flicker: list[float] = []
    for index in range(1, len(reference)):
        ref_delta = reference[index].astype(np.float64) - reference[index - 1]
        out_delta = candidate[index].astype(np.float64) - candidate[index - 1]
        delta_errors.append(float(np.mean(np.abs(out_delta - ref_delta))))
        ref_luma = float(np.mean(reference[index])) - float(np.mean(reference[index - 1]))
        out_luma = float(np.mean(candidate[index])) - float(np.mean(candidate[index - 1]))
        luma_flicker.append(abs(out_luma - ref_luma))
    return {"temporal_delta_mae": _mean(delta_errors),
            "luma_flicker_residual": _mean(luma_flicker)}


def _performance(snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> Dimension:
    seconds = float(snapshot.get("processing_seconds") or 0.0)
    frames = int(snapshot.get("frames") or 0)
    peak_vram = int(snapshot.get("peak_vram_mb") or 0)
    throughput = round(frames / seconds, 4) if frames > 0 and seconds > 0 else None
    metrics = (
        Metric("processing_seconds", N_("Thời gian xử lý Upscale"),
               round(seconds, 4) if seconds > 0 else None, "s", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="lower", threshold=N_("Chưa có baseline theo model/slice")),
        Metric("processed_frames", N_("Số frame đã xử lý"), frames or None,
               "frame", "UNKNOWN"),
        Metric("throughput_fps", N_("Thông lượng xử lý"), throughput,
               "frame/s", "UNKNOWN", direction="higher",
               threshold=N_("Chưa có baseline theo GPU/model/resolution")),
        Metric("peak_vram_mb", N_("Peak VRAM"), peak_vram or None, "MB", "UNKNOWN",
               threshold=(N_("Chưa có baseline theo model/slice") if peak_vram else
                          N_("Runtime Upscale chưa ghi peak VRAM theo job"))),
    )
    return Dimension("performance", N_("Hiệu năng job nguồn"), "UNKNOWN", metrics)


def inspect_upscale_video_pair(candidate_path: Path, reference_path: Path,
                                low_input_path: Path | None, work: Path,
                                performance: dict[str, Any] | None = None
                                ) -> tuple[list[Dimension], dict[str, Any]]:
    try:
        candidate_info = media.probe(str(candidate_path))
        reference_info = media.probe(str(reference_path))
    except Exception as exc:
        metric = Metric("video_probe", N_("Candidate/reference giải mã được"), False,
                        verdict="FAIL", evidence={"error_type": type(exc).__name__})
        return [Dimension("video_contract", N_("Contract video"), "FAIL", (metric,))], {}
    same_dimensions = (candidate_info["width"], candidate_info["height"]) == (
        reference_info["width"], reference_info["height"])
    duration_delta = abs(float(candidate_info["duration"]) - float(reference_info["duration"]))
    duration_ok = duration_delta <= max(0.1, float(reference_info["duration"]) * 0.02)
    fps_delta = abs(float(candidate_info["fps"]) - float(reference_info["fps"]))
    fps_ok = fps_delta <= 0.05
    audio_ok = bool(candidate_info.get("audio_codec")) == bool(reference_info.get("audio_codec"))
    contract_ok = same_dimensions and duration_ok and fps_ok and audio_ok
    contract = Dimension("video_contract", N_("Contract video"),
                         "PASS" if contract_ok else "FAIL", (
        Metric("video_decodable", N_("Candidate/reference giải mã được"), True,
               verdict="PASS"),
        Metric("same_dimensions", N_("Kích thước khớp HR"), same_dimensions,
               verdict="PASS" if same_dimensions else "FAIL",
               evidence={"candidate": [candidate_info["width"], candidate_info["height"]],
                         "reference": [reference_info["width"], reference_info["height"]]}),
        Metric("duration_delta", N_("Sai lệch thời lượng"), round(duration_delta, 4),
               "s", "PASS" if duration_ok else "FAIL", threshold="<= max(0.1s, 2%)"),
        Metric("fps_delta", N_("Sai lệch FPS"), round(fps_delta, 4), "fps",
               "PASS" if fps_ok else "FAIL", threshold="<= 0.05 fps"),
        Metric("audio_parity", N_("Trạng thái audio được giữ"), audio_ok,
               verdict="PASS" if audio_ok else "FAIL"),
    ))
    if not contract_ok:
        return [contract, _performance(performance or {})], {
            "candidate_probe": candidate_info, "reference_probe": reference_info}

    try:
        duration = min(float(candidate_info["duration"]), float(reference_info["duration"]))
        times = _sample_times(duration)
        candidate_frames = _extract(candidate_path, work / "candidate-frames", times)
        reference_frames = _extract(reference_path, work / "reference-frames", times)
        scores = [paired_scores(ref, out)
                  for ref, out in zip(reference_frames, candidate_frames)]
        temporal = temporal_scores(reference_frames, candidate_frames)
        baseline_scores: list[dict[str, float]] = []
        if low_input_path is not None:
            low_frames = _extract(low_input_path, work / "low-frames", times)
            target_size = (reference_info["width"], reference_info["height"])
            for ref, low in zip(reference_frames, low_frames):
                resized = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(low.astype(np.uint8), "RGB").resize(
                    target_size, Image.Resampling.BICUBIC), dtype=np.float32)
                baseline_scores.append(paired_scores(ref, resized))
    except Exception as exc:
        metric = Metric("frame_sampling", N_("Lấy mẫu frame đồng bộ"), False,
                        verdict="FAIL", evidence={"error_type": type(exc).__name__})
        return [contract, Dimension("sampling", N_("Lấy mẫu"), "FAIL", (metric,)),
                _performance(performance or {})], {}

    mean_psnr = _mean([item["psnr_db"] for item in scores])
    mean_ssim = _mean([item["ssim_local"] for item in scores])
    baseline_psnr = _mean([item["psnr_db"] for item in baseline_scores]) if baseline_scores else None
    baseline_ssim = _mean([item["ssim_local"] for item in baseline_scores]) if baseline_scores else None
    vmaf = _vmaf_metric(candidate_path, reference_path, work)
    full_reference = Dimension("full_reference", N_("Full-reference theo frame"),
                               "UNKNOWN", (
        Metric("sampled_frames", N_("Số frame đã lấy mẫu"), len(scores), "frame",
               "UNKNOWN"),
        Metric("mean_psnr_db", N_("PSNR trung bình"), mean_psnr, "dB", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="higher", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
        Metric("mean_ssim_local", N_("Local SSIM trung bình"), mean_ssim, "ratio",
               "UNKNOWN", direction="higher", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
        Metric("psnr_delta_vs_bicubic", N_("PSNR delta so với bicubic"),
               round(mean_psnr - baseline_psnr, 6) if baseline_psnr is not None else None,
               "dB", "UNKNOWN", direction="higher", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
        Metric("ssim_delta_vs_bicubic", N_("SSIM delta so với bicubic"),
               round(mean_ssim - baseline_ssim, 6) if baseline_ssim is not None else None,
               "ratio", "UNKNOWN", direction="higher", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
        vmaf,
    ))
    temporal_dimension = Dimension("temporal", N_("Nhất quán theo thời gian"),
                                   "UNKNOWN", (
        Metric("temporal_delta_mae", N_("Sai số biến thiên frame"),
               temporal["temporal_delta_mae"], "luma", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="lower", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
        Metric("luma_flicker_residual", N_("Flicker độ sáng dư"),
               temporal["luma_flicker_residual"], "luma", "UNKNOWN",
               direction="lower", threshold=N_("Chưa calibrated")),
    ))
    return [contract, full_reference, temporal_dimension,
            _performance(performance or {})], {
        "sample_times_seconds": [round(value, 4) for value in times],
        "candidate_mean": {"psnr_db": mean_psnr, "ssim_local": mean_ssim},
        "bicubic_mean": {"psnr_db": baseline_psnr, "ssim_local": baseline_ssim},
        "temporal": temporal, "vmaf": vmaf.value,
        "candidate_probe": candidate_info,
        "reference_probe": reference_info,
    }

"""Validation và prompt contract cho Image Studio generate/edit."""
from __future__ import annotations

from platform_core.image_input import validate_reference

EDIT_MODES = ("generate", "edit", "semantic_inpaint", "outpaint", "style_transfer")


def clean_mode(value: str) -> str:
    value = (value or "generate").strip()
    return value if value in EDIT_MODES else "generate"


def edit_directive(mode: str, prompt: str, refs: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Dựng chỉ dẫn rõ vai trò ảnh; không giả vờ hỗ trợ precision mask."""
    mode = clean_mode(mode)
    labels = ", ".join(str(r.get("role") or "reference") for r in refs)
    prefix = {
        "generate": "Create a new image from the request.",
        "edit": "Edit the SOURCE image. Preserve all areas the request does not change.",
        "semantic_inpaint": ("Semantically replace or repair only the area described in "
                              "the request; preserve the rest of the SOURCE image."),
        "outpaint": ("Extend the SOURCE image naturally to the requested aspect ratio; "
                     "keep the original image as the central composition."),
        "style_transfer": ("Preserve the content and structure of the SOURCE image while "
                           "applying the visual language of the STYLE image."),
    }[mode]
    context = f" Input image roles in order: {labels}." if labels else ""
    return f"{prefix}{context}\nUser request: {prompt.strip()}"


__all__ = ["EDIT_MODES", "clean_mode", "edit_directive", "validate_reference"]

"""
Handler job app `image` (di trú A1). Sinh ảnh từ prompt TỰ DO qua Gemini Image API.

Lõi gọi Gemini + lưu storage + tính tiền theo ảnh giống `apps/thumbnail/jobs.py`
(L2 copy theo công thức di trú) nhưng KHÔNG ghép prompt từ catalog — prompt là
văn bản người dùng gõ thẳng. Key lấy từ bộ máy APIKEYS (H8), fallback env.

Hợp đồng handler: idempotent theo job (khoá lưu theo job_id) · báo tiến độ qua ctx
· NÉM exception khi thất bại → nền tảng hoàn credit đã giữ. Khoá API chỉ ở máy chủ.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
from platform_core.public_api import costing
import base64
import io
import os

_MODEL = "gemini-2.5-flash-image"
_BASE = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com"
_TIMEOUT_S = 110


class GeminiError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status_code: int | None = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code


def _sanitize(msg: str, key: str) -> str:
    if key and len(key) > 8:
        msg = msg.replace(key, "***")
    return msg[:400]


def _lay_key(model: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """Lấy credential Gemini từ APIKEYS (category image). Fallback env cho dev."""
    try:
        from platform_core import api_keys, api_pool
        from platform_core.db import get_session
        from platform_core.models import APIKEY_CAT_IMAGE
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            key = api_pool.lay_key(db, "gemini", category=APIKEY_CAT_IMAGE, model=model)
            cred = api_keys.lay_credential(db, key)
            db.commit()
            return cred, key.id
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
    except Exception:
        return (os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY") or "").strip(), None


def _ket_qua_key(key_id: str | None, *, thanh_cong: bool,
                 last_status: int | None = None) -> None:
    if not key_id:
        return
    try:
        from platform_core import api_keys, api_pool
        from platform_core.db import get_session
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            key = api_keys.lay_key_theo_id(db, key_id)
            if key is None:
                return
            if thanh_cong:
                api_pool.danh_dau_thanh_cong(db, key)
            elif last_status is not None:
                api_pool.danh_dau_loi(db, key, http_status=last_status)
            db.commit()
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
    except Exception:
        pass


def _canvas_reference_keys(params: dict, owner_id: str) -> list[str]:
    """Normalise typed Canvas image inputs and enforce workflow ownership."""
    raw: list[object] = []
    if params.get("image_key"):
        raw.append(params["image_key"])
    raw.extend(list(params.get("image_keys") or []))
    keys: list[str] = []
    for value in raw:
        key = str(value or "").replace("\\", "/").strip("/")
        parts = key.split("/")
        if not owner_id or len(parts) < 3 or parts[1] != owner_id:
            raise ValueError(_t('Ảnh đầu vào không thuộc tài khoản đang chạy workflow.'))
        if key not in keys:
            keys.append(key)
    if len(keys) > 8:
        raise ValueError(_t('Một node Image chỉ nhận tối đa 8 ảnh tham chiếu.'))
    return keys


def _load_canvas_references(params: dict, owner_id: str, storage) -> list[dict]:
    """Load and verify typed Canvas references before sending them to Gemini."""
    from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError

    mime_by_format = {"JPEG": "image/jpeg", "PNG": "image/png", "WEBP": "image/webp"}
    result: list[dict] = []
    total_size = 0
    for key in _canvas_reference_keys(params, owner_id):
        if not storage.exists(key):
            raise ValueError(_t('Ảnh đầu vào không còn tồn tại.'))
        size = storage.size(key)
        total_size += size
        if size <= 0 or size > 8 * 1024 * 1024 or total_size > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError(_t('Ảnh đầu vào vượt giới hạn 8 MB/ảnh hoặc 20 MB/node.'))
        with storage.open(key) as stream:
            data = stream.read()
        try:
            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as image:
                mime = mime_by_format.get(str(image.format or "").upper())
                image.verify()
        except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError) as exc:
            raise ValueError(_t('Ảnh đầu vào bị hỏng hoặc không đúng định dạng.')) from exc
        if not mime:
            raise ValueError(_t('Node Image chỉ hỗ trợ ảnh JPEG, PNG hoặc WebP.'))
        result.append({"data": data, "mime": mime, "role": "reference"})
    return result


def _goi_gemini(prompt: str, aspect_ratio: str, api_key: str,
                model: str = _MODEL, references: list[dict] | None = None) -> bytes:
    """Gọi Gemini Image API một lần → bytes PNG. Ném lỗi nếu thất bại."""
    import httpx
    from platform_core.providers import resolve_model_id
    provider_model = resolve_model_id(model or _MODEL)
    url = f"{_BASE}/v1beta/models/{provider_model}:generateContent"
    headers = {"x-goog-api-key": api_key}
    parts: list[dict] = [{"text": prompt}]
    for ref in references or []:
        parts.append({"text": f"The next image has role {ref['role']}."})
        parts.append({"inlineData": {
            "mimeType": ref["mime"],
            "data": base64.b64encode(ref["data"]).decode("ascii"),
        }})
    body = {
        "contents": [{"parts": parts}],
        "generationConfig": {
            "responseModalities": ["IMAGE", "TEXT"],
            "imageConfig": {"aspectRatio": aspect_ratio},
        },
    }
    try:
        resp = httpx.post(url, json=body, headers=headers, timeout=_TIMEOUT_S)
    except httpx.HTTPError as e:
        raise GeminiError(_sanitize(f"Lỗi kết nối Gemini: {e}", api_key), status_code=None)
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        raise GeminiError(_sanitize(
            f"Gemini HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}", api_key),
            status_code=resp.status_code)
    data = resp.json()
    pf = data.get("promptFeedback", {}) or {}
    if pf.get("blockReason"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Nội dung bị chặn: {pf['blockReason']}")
    candidates = data.get("candidates", []) or []
    if not candidates:
        raise RuntimeError(_t('Gemini không trả candidate nào.'))
    cand = candidates[0]
    if cand.get("finishReason") == "SAFETY":
        raise RuntimeError(_t('Bị chặn vì lý do an toàn nội dung.'))
    for part in cand.get("content", {}).get("parts", []) or []:
        inline = part.get("inlineData") or part.get("inline_data")
        if inline and inline.get("data"):
            return base64.b64decode(inline["data"])
    raise RuntimeError(_t('Gemini không trả ảnh nào (chỉ có văn bản).'))


def handle(params: dict, ctx=None) -> dict:
    """Sinh 1-4 ảnh từ prompt tự do, lưu qua storage, trả danh sách khoá ảnh."""
    prompt = str(params.get("prompt", "")).strip()
    if not prompt:
        raise ValueError(_t('Chưa nhập mô tả ảnh (prompt).'))
    aspect_ratio = str(params.get("aspect_ratio", "16:9")) or "16:9"
    owner_id = str(params.get("owner_id", "")) or "unknown"
    model = str(params.get("model") or _MODEL)
    from apps.taoanh.features import clean_mode, edit_directive
    edit_mode = clean_mode(str(params.get("edit_mode") or "generate"))
    try:
        count = max(1, min(int(params.get("count", 1)), 4))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        count = 1

    api_key, key_id = _lay_key(model)
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("Chưa có API key Gemini (thêm ở /admin → APIKEYS, "
                           "hoặc đặt GEMINI_API_KEY cho dev).")

    from apps.taoanh.manifest import unit_credit
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    storage = get_storage()
    job_id = getattr(ctx, "job_id", "") or "adhoc"

    references: list[dict] = _load_canvas_references(params, owner_id, storage)
    for spec in list(params.get("references") or [])[:2]:
        key = str(spec.get("key") or "")
        if not key.startswith(f"taoanh/{owner_id}/") or not storage.exists(key):
            raise ValueError(_t('Ảnh tham chiếu không hợp lệ hoặc không thuộc người dùng.'))
        with storage.open(key) as stream:
            references.append({"data": stream.read(),
                               "mime": str(spec.get("mime") or "image/png"),
                               "role": str(spec.get("role") or "reference")})
    if len(references) > 8:
        raise ValueError(_t('Một node Image chỉ nhận tối đa 8 ảnh tham chiếu.'))
    if edit_mode != "generate" and not any(r["role"] == "source" for r in references):
        raise ValueError(_t('Chế độ chỉnh sửa cần ảnh nguồn.'))
    final_prompt = edit_directive(edit_mode, prompt, references)

    keys: list[str] = []
    errors: list[str] = []
    last_status: int | None = None
    for i in range(count):
        key = f"taoanh/{owner_id}/{job_id}/{i}.png"
        if storage.exists(key):
            keys.append(key)
            continue
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(int(i * 100 / count), f"đang tạo ảnh {i + 1}/{count}")
        try:
            img = _goi_gemini(final_prompt, aspect_ratio, api_key, model, references)
        except GeminiError as e:
            errors.append(str(e)); last_status = e.status_code; continue
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append(str(e)); continue
        storage.put(key, io.BytesIO(img), content_type="image/png")
        keys.append(key)

    if not keys:
        _ket_qua_key(key_id, thanh_cong=False, last_status=last_status)
        raise RuntimeError(errors[-1] if errors else "Không tạo được ảnh nào.")
    _ket_qua_key(key_id, thanh_cong=True)
    if ctx is not None:
        ctx.progress(100, "xong")
    return {"image_keys": keys, "count": len(keys), "prompt": prompt,
            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
            "edit_mode": edit_mode,
            "credit_cost": len(keys) * unit_credit(model), "errors": errors[:3],
            # Bang chung chi phi: bao SO ANH THAT DA TAO, khong phai `count` khach
            # xin. Mot luot hong o anh thu ba thi ta chi tra tien hai anh — bao
            # theo yeu cau la tu thoi phong chi phi cua chinh minh.
            # Khong lo ra khach: tang API chi tra nhung truong `returns` da khai.
            costing.KHOA_GOI_PROVIDER: [{"model": model, "count": len(keys)}]}

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@

SHA256=4d36f94763773189548f1526a905ff425a0e33e1fbb23f813c6cd9e7d5655ba0 BYTES=7832 LINES=162

"""
App `taoanh` — Tạo ảnh AI từ mô tả (Gemini Image). Di trú từ BOT GEMINI
`app/modules/gemini_image` (Đợt A1, xem CONG_THUC_DI_TRU_APP.md).

Slug đặt là `taoanh` (không phải "image") vì slug phải là chuỗi RIÊNG — "image"
là từ phổ biến trong code nền tảng (image/png, category image…) làm test chống
hardcode-slug (`test_60`) báo nhầm. Bài học: slug app phải đặc trưng.

Gốc: prompt tự do (không catalog), chọn model + tỉ lệ + số ảnh. Giữ trung thành
UI/tính năng, chỉ đổi vỏ + hạ tầng (key qua APIKEYS, lưu qua storage, tính credit).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from platform_core.i18n import N_
from platform_core.registry import AppManifest, NavEntry, ToolSpec

MODEL_CREDIT_PER_IMAGE = {
    "gemini-2.5-flash-image": 5,
    "gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image": 5,
    "gemini-3.1-flash-image": 8,
    "gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview": 8,
    # ⛔ Bậc `pro` ĐÓNG 2026-08-23: gia von 35,2 credit, ban 16 => lo 1.924d/anh.
    #    Giữ hai dòng giá này vì job CŨ trong lịch sử vẫn tra giá qua đây; xoá đi
    #    thì một trang lịch sử sẽ hiện giá 5 credit cho việc đã tính 16.
    "gemini-3-pro-image": 16,
    "gemini-3-pro-image-preview": 16,
}
CREDIT_PER_IMAGE = 5  # tương thích code/test cũ: đơn giá model mặc định


def unit_credit(model: str) -> int:
    return MODEL_CREDIT_PER_IMAGE.get(str(model or ""), CREDIT_PER_IMAGE)


def _cost(params: dict) -> int:
    try:
        count = int(params.get("count", 1))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        count = 1
    count = max(1, min(count, 4))
    return count * unit_credit(str(params.get("model") or ""))

"""
UI app `image` (di trú A1). Prompt tự do → ảnh. Router KHÔNG tự viết prefix.

Ảnh output phục vụ qua `/f/{key}` (kiểm sở hữu theo key `image/{owner_id}/...`).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse, StreamingResponse

from apps.taoanh.manifest import MANIFEST
from server.auth.csrf import issue_csrf_token, verify_csrf_token
from server.auth.session import require_login
from server.deps import user_hien_tai
from server.templating import templates

router = APIRouter(tags=["image"])

_ASPECTS = ("16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4")


def _models() -> list:
    from platform_core import providers
    from platform_core.models import APIKEY_CAT_IMAGE
    return [(m.id, m.label())
            for m in providers.models_for("gemini", category=APIKEY_CAT_IMAGE)
            if m.is_active]


def _render(request: Request, user: str, *, error: str = "", jobs=None,
            form_values: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200) -> HTMLResponse:
    from apps.taoanh.features import EDIT_MODES
    from apps.taoanh.manifest import MODEL_CREDIT_PER_IMAGE
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "image.html", {
        "user": user, "nav": MANIFEST.slug, "app": MANIFEST,
        "csrf_token": issue_csrf_token(request),
        "aspects": _ASPECTS, "models": _models(), "error": error, "jobs": jobs or [],
        "edit_modes": EDIT_MODES, "form_values": form_values or {},
        "model_costs": MODEL_CREDIT_PER_IMAGE,
    }, status_code=status_code)


def _jobs_cua_toi(request: Request):
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        return []
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import Job
    from sqlalchemy import select
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        def safe_count(value) -> int:
            try:
                return max(1, min(4, int(value or 1)))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return 1
        rows = db.execute(
            select(Job).where(Job.user_id == u.id, Job.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug)
            .order_by(Job.created_at.desc()).limit(12)
        ).scalars().all()
        return [{"id": j.id, "status": j.status, "progress": j.progress,
                 "progress_msg": j.progress_msg, "error": j.error,
                 "created_at": j.created_at, "finished_at": j.finished_at,
                 "prompt": str((j.params or {}).get("prompt", ""))[:240],
                 "aspect_ratio": str((j.params or {}).get("aspect_ratio", "16:9")),
                 "requested_count": safe_count((j.params or {}).get("count", 1)),
                 "model": str((j.params or {}).get("model", ""))[:100],
                 "edit_mode": str((j.params or {}).get("edit_mode", "generate")),
                 "image_keys": (j.result or {}).get("image_keys", []) if j.result else []}
                for j in rows]
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass


def _owned_output(user_id: str, key: str) -> bool:
    if not key.startswith(f"taoanh/{user_id}/"):
        return False
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import JOB_DONE, Job
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    from sqlalchemy import select
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        results = db.execute(select(Job.result).where(
            Job.user_id == user_id, Job.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug,
            Job.status == JOB_DONE
        ).order_by(Job.created_at.desc()).limit(60)).scalars().all()
        return (any(key in ((result or {}).get("image_keys") or []) for result in results)
                and get_storage().exists(key))
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass


@router.get("", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def page(request: Request, user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    return _render(request, user, jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request))


@router.get("/thumbnail", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def thumbnail_mode(request: Request, remix_job_id: str = "", image_index: int = -1,
                   user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    """Shell canonical của mode Thumbnail, compose qua HTTP thay vì import app.

    App con vẫn sở hữu form, preset, history, queue và file route. Trình duyệt
    nạp fragment authenticated từ contract công khai của app con nên hai app
    không gọi Python internals của nhau.
    """
    from urllib.parse import urlencode
    query = {}
    if remix_job_id:
        query = {"remix_job_id": remix_job_id, "image_index": image_index}
    fragment_url = "/thumbnail/studio-fragment"
    if query:
        fragment_url += "?" + urlencode(query)
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "image_thumbnail_shell.html", {
        "user": user, "nav": MANIFEST.slug, "app": MANIFEST,
        "fragment_url": fragment_url,
    })


@router.post("/queue", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def queue(
    request: Request,
    csrf_token: str = Form(...),
    prompt: str = Form(""),
    model: str = Form(""),
    aspect_ratio: str = Form("16:9"),
    count: int = Form(1),
    edit_mode: str = Form("generate"),
    source_image: UploadFile | None = File(None),
    style_image: UploadFile | None = File(None),
    saved_source_key: str = Form(""),
    user: str = Depends(require_login),
):
    from platform_core import credit, upload_sessions
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.job_submit import dedupe_key_for, submit_with_credit
    from platform_core.registry import RegistryError

    if not verify_csrf_token(request, csrf_token):
        return _render(request, user, error="Phiên đã hết hạn — tải lại trang.",
                       jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)
    from apps.taoanh.features import clean_mode, validate_reference
    edit_mode = clean_mode(edit_mode)
    prompt = prompt.strip()[:4000]      # cap do dai (nguon gemini_image cap 4000) — chong phi credit + 400 upstream
    if not prompt:
        return _render(request, user, error="Chưa nhập mô tả ảnh.",
                       jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)
    if aspect_ratio not in _ASPECTS:
        aspect_ratio = "16:9"
    count = max(1, min(int(count or 1), 4))
    model_ids = [m[0] for m in _models()]
    if model not in model_ids:
        model = model_ids[0] if model_ids else "gemini-2.5-flash-image"

    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        return _render(request, user, error="Cần đăng nhập bằng tài khoản người dùng.",
                       jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)

    references: list[dict] = []
    prepared_uploads: list[tuple[str, str, str, bytes]] = []
    if saved_source_key:
        if not _owned_output(u.id, saved_source_key):
            return _render(request, user, error="Ảnh nguồn đã lưu không hợp lệ.",
                           jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)
        references.append({"key": saved_source_key, "mime": "image/png", "role": "source"})
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    storage = get_storage()
    for upload, role in ((source_image, "source"), (style_image, "style")):
        if upload and upload.filename:
            data = await upload.read()
            try:
                mime, _dimensions = validate_reference(data, upload.content_type or "")
            except ValueError as exc:
                return _render(request, user, error=str(exc), jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request),
                               status_code=400)
            prepared_uploads.append((role, upload.filename, mime, data))
            references = [r for r in references if r["role"] != role]
    if edit_mode != "generate" and not any(r["role"] == "source" for r in references):
        if not any(role == "source" for role, *_rest in prepared_uploads):
            return _render(request, user, error="Chế độ chỉnh sửa cần ảnh nguồn.",
                           jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)
    if (edit_mode == "style_transfer" and
            not any(r["role"] == "style" for r in references) and
            not any(role == "style" for role, *_rest in prepared_uploads)):
        return _render(request, user, error="Chuyển phong cách cần thêm ảnh phong cách.",
                       jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)

    staged = []
    if prepared_uploads:
        stage_gen = get_session(); stage_db = next(stage_gen)
        try:
            try:
                for role, filename, mime, data in prepared_uploads:
                    session = upload_sessions.stage_bytes(
                        stage_db, storage, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
                        filename=filename, content_type=mime, data=data,
                        max_size=8 * 1024 * 1024,
                        allowed_types=("image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp"),
                    )
                    staged.append((role, session))
                    references.append({"key": session.staging_key, "mime": mime,
                                       "role": role, "upload_id": session.id})
                stage_db.commit()
            except Exception:
                stage_db.rollback()
                raise
        except upload_sessions.UploadSessionError as exc:
            return _render(request, user, error=str(exc),
                           jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)
        finally:
            try: next(stage_gen)
            except StopIteration: pass

    params = {"prompt": prompt, "model": model,
              "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio, "count": count, "owner_id": u.id,
              "edit_mode": edit_mode, "references": references}
    promotions = []
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        try:
            job = submit_with_credit(
                db, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
                job_type="taoanh.generate", params=params,
                dedupe_key=dedupe_key_for("taoanh.generate", params))
            if staged:
                final_references = []
                sessions = {session.id: upload_sessions.owned(
                    db, session_id=session.id, user_id=u.id,
                    app_slug=MANIFEST.slug) for _role, session in staged}
                for ref in references:
                    upload_id = str(ref.get("upload_id") or "")
                    if not upload_id:
                        final_references.append(ref)
                        continue
                    session = sessions.get(upload_id)
                    if session is None:
                        raise upload_sessions.UploadSessionError(
                            _t("Vé upload ảnh không hợp lệ."))
                    suffix = {
                        "image/jpeg": ".jpg", "image/png": ".png",
                        "image/webp": ".webp",
                    }.get(session.content_type, "")
                    final_key = (f"taoanh/{u.id}/refs/{job.id}/"
                                 f"{ref['role']}{suffix}")
                    key = upload_sessions.promote(
                        db, storage, session, job=job, final_key=final_key)
                    promotions.append((session.staging_key, final_key,
                                       session.content_type))
                    final_references.append({"key": key, "mime": ref["mime"],
                                             "role": ref["role"]})
                job.params = dict(job.params or {}, references=final_references)
            db.commit(); job_id = job.id
        except (credit.ThieuCreditError, RegistryError,
                upload_sessions.UploadSessionError) as exc:
            db.rollback()
            upload_sessions.compensate(storage, promotions)
            return _render(request, user, error=str(exc),
                           jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), status_code=400)
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            upload_sessions.compensate(storage, promotions)
            raise
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass
    # Ve trang app (co luoi "Anh cua toi") thay vi /jobs/{id} (chi hien JSON tho).
    return RedirectResponse(MANIFEST.route_prefix, status_code=303)


@router.get("/edit/{job_id}/{image_index}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def edit_output(request: Request, job_id: str, image_index: int,
                user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    """Nạp output thật làm ảnh nguồn; chỉ chủ sở hữu job DONE truy cập được."""
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import JOB_DONE, Job
    from sqlalchemy import select
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy ảnh.'))
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        job = db.execute(select(Job).where(
            Job.id == job_id, Job.user_id == u.id, Job.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug,
            Job.status == JOB_DONE)).scalar_one_or_none()
        keys = ((job.result or {}).get("image_keys") or []) if job else []
        if image_index < 0 or image_index >= len(keys) or not _owned_output(u.id, keys[image_index]):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy ảnh.'))
        values = {"prompt": str((job.params or {}).get("prompt") or ""),
                  "model": str((job.params or {}).get("model") or ""),
                  "aspect_ratio": str((job.params or {}).get("aspect_ratio") or "16:9"),
                  "edit_mode": "edit", "saved_source_key": keys[image_index]}
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass
    return _render(request, user, jobs=_jobs_cua_toi(request), form_values=values)


@router.get("/f/{key:path}", response_class=StreamingResponse)
def image_file(request: Request, key: str, user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    from fastapi import HTTPException
    from platform_core.storage import StorageError, get_storage
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    segs = key.split("/")
    if len(segs) < 2 or segs[0] != "taoanh" or u is None or segs[1] != u.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy ảnh.'))
    storage = get_storage()
    direct = storage.try_url_for(key)            # R2 (H10) → tải thẳng CDN
    if direct:
        return RedirectResponse(direct, status_code=302)
    try:
        stream = storage.open(key)
    except (StorageError, FileNotFoundError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy ảnh.'))
    return StreamingResponse(stream, media_type="image/png")

"""
cost.py — giá credit cho TẠO CLIP NGẮN.

Engine không có tính tiền. Chi phí thật ~ thời gian GPU = chép lời (theo độ dài
NGUỒN) + encode (theo SỐ CLIP xuất). Đề xuất người dùng chốt 2026-08-02
(Q31: 1 credit = 100đ):

  credit = phút_nguồn × hệ_số_tier × ĐƠN_GIÁ_PHÚT + số_clip × ĐƠN_GIÁ_CLIP
  hệ_số_tier: fast ×1.0 · balanced ×1.6 · high_quality ×2.2
  (balanced ≈ 8 credit/phút; fast ≈ 5; high ≈ 11)

Giữ chỗ theo phút client khai + số clip mục tiêu; worker đo phút THẬT + đếm clip
THẬT rồi nâng giữ chỗ (nếu thiếu) + quyết toán.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

DON_GIA_PHUT = 5            # credit/phút @ tier ×1.0
DON_GIA_CLIP = 5           # credit/clip xuất
MIN_CREDIT = 1
_TIER_MULT = {"fast": 1.0, "balanced": 1.6, "high_quality": 2.2}


def he_so_tier(tier: str) -> float:
    return _TIER_MULT.get(tier, 1.6)


def uoc_luong_credit(duration_s: float, tier: str = "high_quality",
                     n_clips: int = 3) -> int:
    minutes = max(0.0, float(duration_s or 0)) / 60.0
    raw = minutes * he_so_tier(tier) * DON_GIA_PHUT + max(0, int(n_clips)) * DON_GIA_CLIP
    return max(MIN_CREDIT, math.ceil(raw))


def uoc_luong(duration_s: float, tier: str = "high_quality", n_clips: int = 3) -> dict:
    credit = uoc_luong_credit(duration_s, tier, n_clips)
    return {"credit": credit, "vnd": credit * 100,
            "minutes": round(max(0.0, float(duration_s or 0)) / 60.0, 2),
            "tier": tier, "n_clips": n_clips}

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@

"""Governed brand, rationale and social package helpers for Clip Studio."""
from __future__ import annotations

import threading

from platform_core.i18n import N_

BRAND_PRESETS = {
    "auto": {"label": N_("Tự động theo thể loại"), "overrides": {}},
    "ltt_red": {"label": N_("LTT Red"), "overrides": {
        "color_preset": "cinematic", "caption_preset": "viral_pop",
        "hook_caption_preset": "viral_pop"}},
    "creator_clean": {"label": N_("Creator Clean"), "overrides": {
        "color_preset": "clear_fresh", "caption_preset": "clean_boxed"}},
    "cinematic": {"label": N_("Cinematic"), "overrides": {
        "color_preset": "cinematic", "caption_preset": "cinematic"}},
}
PLATFORMS = ("tiktok", "youtube_shorts", "instagram_reels")
ANALYSIS_ENGINES = ("scene", "motion", "speech", "audio", "visual", "content")


class AnalysisProgressTracker:
    """Gộp tiến độ engine song song thành một dòng job đơn điệu, có tiết lưu."""

    def __init__(self, *, start: int = 5, end: int = 58, min_step: int = 2) -> None:
        self._start = start
        self._end = end
        self._min_step = max(1, min_step)
        self._values = {name: 0.0 for name in ANALYSIS_ENGINES}
        self._last = start
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def update(self, engine_name: str, pct: float) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
        """Trả về progress mới hoặc None nếu chưa đủ bước để ghi activity."""
        name = str(engine_name or "analysis")
        try:
            value = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(pct)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None
        with self._lock:
            if name not in self._values:
                self._values[name] = 0.0
            self._values[name] = max(self._values[name], value)
            average = sum(self._values.values()) / max(1, len(self._values))
            current = self._start + int(average * (self._end - self._start))
            current = max(self._last, min(self._end, current))
            if current < self._last + self._min_step and current < self._end:
                return None
            if current == self._last:
                return None
            self._last = current
            return current, f"phân tích: {name}"


def clean_brand(value: str) -> str:
    return value if value in BRAND_PRESETS else "auto"


def brand_overrides(value: str) -> dict:
    return dict(BRAND_PRESETS[clean_brand(value)]["overrides"])


def clean_platforms(values) -> list[str]:
    if isinstance(values, str):
        values = values.split(",")
    out = []
    for value in values or []:
        item = str(value).strip()
        if item in PLATFORMS and item not in out:
            out.append(item)
    return out or list(PLATFORMS)


def score_rationale(candidate) -> dict:
    score = getattr(candidate, "score", None)
    explanation = getattr(candidate, "explanation", None)
    dimensions = {}
    for name in ("hook_strength", "pacing", "completeness", "visual_quality",
                 "audio_quality", "topic_coherence", "semantic_richness"):
        dimensions[name] = round(float(getattr(score, name, 0) or 0), 3)
    why = (getattr(explanation, "why_selected", "") if explanation else "") or \
          getattr(candidate, "why_selected", "") or \
          getattr(candidate, "strategy_reasoning", "") or "Xếp hạng từ tín hiệu nội dung và kỹ thuật."
    return {"overall": round(float(getattr(score, "overall", 0) or 0), 3),
            "dimensions": dimensions, "why_selected": str(why)[:1200],
            "intent": str(getattr(candidate, "clip_intent", "unknown"))[:80],
            "risk_level": str(getattr(explanation, "risk_level", "low") if explanation else "low")[:40],
            "risk_flags": [str(x)[:160] for x in
                           (getattr(explanation, "risk_flags", []) if explanation else
                            getattr(candidate, "risk_flags", []))][:12]}


def platform_copy(title: str, description: str, hashtags, platforms) -> dict:
    tags = [str(x).strip().lstrip("#")[:60] for x in (hashtags or []) if str(x).strip()][:12]
    if not tags:
        tags = ["shorts", "video"]
    base_title = str(title or "Clip ngắn").strip()[:120]
    base_description = str(description or "").strip()[:2000]
    limits = {"tiktok": 150, "youtube_shorts": 100, "instagram_reels": 125}
    out = {}
    for platform in clean_platforms(platforms):
        platform_tags = list(tags)
        if platform == "youtube_shorts" and "shorts" not in [x.lower() for x in platform_tags]:
            platform_tags.insert(0, "Shorts")
        out[platform] = {"title": base_title[:limits[platform]],
                         "description": base_description,
                         "hashtags": platform_tags}
    return out


def rebase_transcript(segments, *, source_start: float, source_end: float) -> list[dict]:
    """Đưa caption từ timeline video nguồn về timeline 0 của clip xuất."""
    start = max(0.0, float(source_start or 0))
    end = max(start, float(source_end or start))
    duration = end - start
    rows = [dict(item) for item in (segments or []) if isinstance(item, dict)]
    if not rows or duration <= 0:
        return []

    rebased = []
    for row in rows:
        try:
            local_start = max(0.0, float(row.get("start") or 0) - start)
            local_end = min(duration, float(row.get("end") or 0) - start)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if local_end <= local_start or not str(row.get("text") or "").strip():
            continue
        row["start"] = round(local_start, 3)
        row["end"] = round(local_end, 3)
        rebased.append(row)
    return rebased


def package_payload(*, job_id: str, original_clips: list[dict], drafts: list[dict],
                    platforms, brand_preset: str) -> dict:
    by_index = {int(x.get("index", -1)): x for x in drafts if isinstance(x, dict)
                and str(x.get("index", "")).lstrip("-").isdigit()}
    clips = []
    for index, source in enumerate(original_clips[:10]):
        draft = by_index.get(index, {})
        start = float(source.get("source_start") or 0)
        end = float(source.get("source_end") or
                    (start + float(source.get("duration_s") or 0)))
        text = str(draft.get("transcript_text") or "").strip()[:20000]
        transcript = rebase_transcript(source.get("transcript") or [],
                                       source_start=start, source_end=end)
        if text:
            transcript = [{"start": 0.0, "end": round(max(0.0, end - start), 3),
                           "text": text, "speaker": ""}]
        title = str(draft.get("title") or source.get("title") or f"Clip {index + 1}")[:120]
        clips.append({**source, "title": title, "transcript": transcript,
                      "platform_copy": platform_copy(title,
                          str(source.get("seo_description") or ""),
                          source.get("hashtags") or [], platforms)})
    return {"kind": "clip_social_package", "source_job_id": job_id,
            "brand_preset": clean_brand(brand_preset),
            "platforms": clean_platforms(platforms), "clips": clips}


def srt_text(segments: list[dict]) -> str:
    def stamp(value):
        total_ms = max(0, round(float(value or 0) * 1000))
        hours, rem = divmod(total_ms, 3_600_000)
        minutes, rem = divmod(rem, 60_000)
        seconds, millis = divmod(rem, 1000)
        return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d},{millis:03d}"
    blocks = []
    for index, segment in enumerate(segments or [], 1):
        text = str(segment.get("text") or "").strip()
        if text:
            blocks.append(f"{index}\n{stamp(segment.get('start'))} --> {stamp(segment.get('end'))}\n{text}")
    return "\n\n".join(blocks) + ("\n" if blocks else "")

"""
Handler job app `taoclipngan`. Chạy engine `cutclipshort` trong WORKER GPU (job dài:
chép lời + phân tích + render nhiều clip). Bọc 3 hàm lõi (theo blueprint
`test_local_run.py`): run_full_analysis → run_editorial → render_segment.

Hợp đồng: idempotent (resume: bỏ qua nếu đã có manifest kết quả) · báo tiến độ ·
NÉM khi lỗi (nền tảng hoàn credit). Giữ chỗ theo phút client khai → worker đo phút
THẬT + đếm clip THẬT → nâng giữ chỗ nếu thiếu → quyết toán.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
import json
import logging
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from apps.taoclipngan import cost

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_ASPECT = {
    "9:16": ("PORTRAIT_9_16", 1080, 1920),
    "1:1": ("SQUARE_1_1", 1080, 1080),
    "16:9": ("LANDSCAPE_16_9", 1920, 1080),
    "4:5": ("PORTRAIT_4_5", 1080, 1350),
}
_TIERS = ("fast", "balanced", "high_quality")


def _dam_bao_giu_cho(job_id: str, user_id: str, need: int) -> None:
    if not user_id or need <= 0:
        return
    from platform_core import credit
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        held = credit.so_da_giu(db, job_id)
        if held >= need:
            return
        try:
            credit.giu_cho(db, user_id, need - held, job_id)
            db.commit()
        except credit.ThieuCreditError as e:
            db.rollback()
            raise RuntimeError(f"Không đủ credit cho video dài thật ({need} credit): {e}") from e
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass


def handle(params: dict, ctx=None) -> dict:
    import sys
    if str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
    from platform_core import media
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage

    # Engine cutclipshort tự dò ffmpeg/ffprobe qua PATH (nhiều adapter gọi
    # FFmpegAdapter() không truyền path). Worker (LocalSystem) KHÔNG có ffmpeg trên
    # PATH → prepend thư mục ffmpeg của nền tảng (LTT_FFMPEG) vào PATH tiến trình.
    try:
        for _bin in (media.ffmpeg_bin, media.ffprobe_bin):   # ffprobe co the o dir khac
            d = os.path.dirname(_bin())
            if d and d not in os.environ.get("PATH", ""):
                os.environ["PATH"] = d + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PATH", "")
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass

    video_key = str(params.get("video_key", "")).strip()
    if not video_key:
        raise ValueError(_t('Thiếu video (video_key).'))
    tier = str(params.get("tier", "high_quality"))
    if tier not in _TIERS:
        tier = "high_quality"
    genre = str(params.get("genre", "talking_head")) or "talking_head"
    aspect = str(params.get("aspect_ratio", "9:16"))
    if aspect not in _ASPECT:
        aspect = "9:16"
    language = (params.get("language") or "").strip() or None    # None = auto detect
    try:
        min_dur = float(params.get("min_clip_duration_sec", 15) or 15)
        max_dur = float(params.get("max_clip_duration_sec", 60) or 60)
        target_n = int(params.get("target_clip_count", 3) or 3)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        min_dur, max_dur, target_n = 15.0, 60.0, 3
    target_n = max(1, min(target_n, 10))
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import (AnalysisProgressTracker,
                                           brand_overrides, clean_brand,
                                           clean_platforms, platform_copy,
                                           score_rationale)
    brand_preset = clean_brand(str(params.get("brand_preset") or "auto"))
    platforms = clean_platforms(params.get("platforms") or [])
    owner_id = str(params.get("owner_id", "")) or "unknown"
    job_id = getattr(ctx, "job_id", "") or "adhoc"

    storage = get_storage()
    out_prefix = f"taoclipngan/{owner_id}/{job_id}"
    manifest_key = f"{out_prefix}/clips.json"

    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ltt_clip_")
    project_dir = Path(tmp) / "project"
    render_dir = Path(tmp) / "clips"
    project_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    render_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = Path(tmp) / ("src" + (os.path.splitext(video_key)[1] or ".mp4"))
    try:
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(2, "tải video")
        with storage.open(video_key) as fsrc, open(src, "wb") as fdst:
            shutil.copyfileobj(fsrc, fdst, length=1024 * 1024)

        true_dur = media.duration_seconds(str(src))
        if true_dur <= 0:
            raise ValueError(_t("Không đọc được thời lượng video nguồn."))
        _dam_bao_giu_cho(job_id, params.get("owner_id", ""),
                         cost.uoc_luong_credit(true_dur, tier, target_n))

        # Resume: đã có manifest kết quả → không chạy lại.
        if storage.exists(manifest_key):
            data = json.loads(storage.open(manifest_key).read().decode("utf-8"))
            return {"clips": data.get("clips", []), "credit_cost": data.get("credit_cost")
                    or cost.uoc_luong_credit(true_dur, tier, len(data.get("clips", []))),
                    "brand_preset": data.get("brand_preset", brand_preset),
                    "platforms": data.get("platforms", platforms)}

        # ── 1. PHÂN TÍCH (whisper + scene + yolo + audio…) ────────────────────
        from cutclipshort.core.analysis_runner import run_full_analysis
        from cutclipshort.core.config import AppConfig

        config = AppConfig()
        config.set_quality_tier(tier)
        config.set("analysis", "whisper_language", language)

        analysis_progress = AnalysisProgressTracker()

        def _acb(engine_name, pct):
            update = analysis_progress.update(engine_name, pct)
            if ctx is not None and update is not None:
                ctx.progress(*update)

        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(5, "phân tích video (chép lời…)")
        analysis = run_full_analysis(video_path=src, project_dir=project_dir,
                                     genre=genre, config=config, progress_callback=_acb)

        # ── 2. EDITORIAL (chọn highlight) ─────────────────────────────────────
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(62, "chọn đoạn hay")
        from cutclipshort.editorial.brain import run_editorial
        from cutclipshort.types import EditConstraints
        from cutclipshort.types.base import AspectRatio
        aspect_enum, tw, th = _ASPECT[aspect]
        constraints = EditConstraints(
            min_clip_duration_sec=min_dur, max_clip_duration_sec=max_dur,
            target_clip_count=max(target_n, 5), platform="tiktok",
            aspect_ratio=AspectRatio[aspect_enum], target_width=tw, target_height=th)
        candidates, edit_plan = run_editorial(
            analysis=analysis, constraints=constraints, genre=genre,
            user_overrides=brand_overrides(brand_preset), tier_name=tier)

        # ── 3. RENDER N clip ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        from cutclipshort.render.segment_renderer import render_segment
        from cutclipshort.types import RenderSettings
        rs = RenderSettings(prefer_nvenc=True, nvenc_preset="p5", crf="18",
                            pixel_format="yuv420p", audio_codec="aac",
                            audio_bitrate="192k", audio_sample_rate=44100, audio_channels=2)
        selected = edit_plan.clips[:target_n]
        # Key theo candidate_id (CandidateClip KHONG co clip_id); ClipSpec.clip_id ==
        # candidate.candidate_id → join dung, title/score moi khong bi trong.
        cand_by = {getattr(c, "candidate_id", None): c for c in candidates}
        clips_out = []
        for i, clip_spec in enumerate(selected, 1):
            if ctx is not None:
                ctx.progress(min(97, 68 + int(i * 29 / max(len(selected), 1))),
                             f"dựng clip {i}/{len(selected)}")
            local = render_dir / f"clip_{i:02d}.mp4"
            try:
                out_path = render_segment(clip=clip_spec, source_path=src,
                                          output_path=local, render_settings=rs)
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                log.warning("[taoclipngan] render clip %d lỗi: %s", i, e)
                continue
            ckey = f"{out_prefix}/clip_{i:02d}.mp4"
            with open(out_path, "rb") as f:
                storage.put(ckey, f, content_type="video/mp4")
            cand = cand_by.get(getattr(clip_spec, "clip_id", None))
            title = (getattr(cand, "display_title", "") or "") if cand else ""
            score = round(float(getattr(getattr(cand, "score", None), "overall", 0) or 0), 3) if cand else 0
            rng = getattr(clip_spec, "source_range", None)
            dur = round(float(getattr(rng, "end", 0) - getattr(rng, "start", 0)), 1) if rng else 0
            captions = [{"start": round(float(getattr(seg, "start", 0)), 3),
                         "end": round(float(getattr(seg, "end", 0)), 3),
                         "text": str(getattr(seg, "text", ""))[:1000],
                         "speaker": str(getattr(seg, "speaker", "") or "")[:80]}
                        for seg in (getattr(clip_spec, "caption_segments", None) or [])]
            description = (getattr(cand, "seo_description", "") or "") if cand else ""
            hashtags = list(getattr(cand, "suggested_hashtags", []) or []) if cand else []
            clips_out.append({"video_key": ckey, "title": title[:120], "score": score,
                              "duration_s": dur,
                              "source_start": round(float(getattr(rng, "start", 0)), 3) if rng else 0,
                              "source_end": round(float(getattr(rng, "end", 0)), 3) if rng else 0,
                              "transcript": captions,
                              "score_rationale": score_rationale(cand) if cand else {},
                              "seo_description": str(description)[:2000],
                              "hashtags": [str(x)[:60] for x in hashtags[:12]],
                              "platform_copy": platform_copy(title, description,
                                                               hashtags, platforms)})

        if not clips_out:
            raise RuntimeError(_t('Không dựng được clip nào từ video (thử video khác/tier khác).'))

        credit_cost = cost.uoc_luong_credit(true_dur, tier, len(clips_out))
        # Lưu manifest kết quả (idempotent resume).
        import io as _io
        storage.put(manifest_key,
                    _io.BytesIO(json.dumps({"clips": clips_out, "credit_cost": credit_cost,
                                           "brand_preset": brand_preset,
                                           "platforms": platforms},
                                           ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")),
                    content_type="application/json")
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(100, f"xong — {len(clips_out)} clip")
        return {"clips": clips_out, "credit_cost": credit_cost, "tier": tier,
                "genre": genre, "aspect_ratio": aspect, "n_clips": len(clips_out),
                "brand_preset": brand_preset, "platforms": platforms}
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
