                "video/x-matroska", "video/x-msvideo", "video/x-m4v")


def _video_extension(filename: str) -> str:
    name = str(filename or "").strip()
    return ("." + name.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()) if "." in name else ""


def _video_content_type(filename: str, declared: str) -> str:
    value = str(declared or "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if value in _VIDEO_TYPES:
        return value
    return {".mov": "video/quicktime", ".webm": "video/webm",
            ".mkv": "video/x-matroska", ".avi": "video/x-msvideo",
            ".m4v": "video/x-m4v"}.get(_video_extension(filename), "video/mp4")


def _render(request: Request, user: str, *, error: str = "", status_code: int = 200):
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import BRAND_PRESETS, PLATFORMS
    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, "taoclipngan.html", {
        "user": user, "nav": MANIFEST.slug, "app": MANIFEST,
        "csrf_token": issue_csrf_token(request),
        "tiers": [(key, _t(label)) for key, label in _TIERS],
        "aspects": [(key, _t(label)) for key, label in _ASPECTS],
        "genres": [(key, _t(label)) for key, label in _GENRES],
        "langs": [(key, _t(label)) for key, label in _LANGS],
        "jobs": _jobs_cua_toi(request), "library": _source_library(request),
        "brand_presets": [(key, _t(value["label"]))
                          for key, value in BRAND_PRESETS.items()],
        "platforms": PLATFORMS,
        "error": error,
    }, status_code=status_code)


def _jobs_cua_toi(request: Request):
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        return []
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import APP_PROJECT_ACTIVE, AppProject, Job
    from sqlalchemy import select
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        rows = db.execute(
            select(Job).where(Job.user_id == u.id, Job.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug)
            .order_by(Job.created_at.desc()).limit(8)
        ).scalars().all()
        projects = db.execute(select(AppProject).where(
            AppProject.user_id == u.id, AppProject.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug,
            AppProject.status == APP_PROJECT_ACTIVE
        ).order_by(AppProject.updated_at.desc()).limit(100)).scalars().all()
        project_by_job = {}
        for project in projects:
            source_job_id = str((project.payload or {}).get("source_job_id") or "")
            if source_job_id and source_job_id not in project_by_job:
                project_by_job[source_job_id] = project
        out = []
        for j in rows:
            r = j.result or {}
            project = project_by_job.get(j.id)
            payload = (project.payload or {}) if project else {}
            tier_key = str((j.params or {}).get("tier") or "")
            status_label = {
                "done": _t("Hoàn tất"), "error": _t("Lỗi"),
                "queued": _t("Đang chờ"), "running": _t("Đang xử lý"),
                "cancelled": _t("Đã huỷ"),
            }.get(j.status, j.status)
            progress_label = _t("Đang chờ xử lý")
            if j.status == "running":
                progress_label = (_t("Đang phân tích video") if j.progress < 60 else
                                  _t("Đang dựng clip") if j.progress < 98 else
                                  _t("Đang hoàn tất"))
            out.append({"id": j.id, "status": j.status, "progress": j.progress,
                        "status_label": status_label,
                        "progress_label": progress_label, "error": j.error,
                        "clips": payload.get("clips") or r.get("clips") or [],
                        "source_name": str((j.params or {}).get("source_filename") or
                                           (j.params or {}).get("video_key") or "Video")[:160],
                        "tier": _t(dict(_TIERS).get(tier_key, tier_key)),
                        "aspect_ratio": str((j.params or {}).get("aspect_ratio") or ""),
                        "brand_preset": str((j.params or {}).get("brand_preset") or "auto"),
                        "platforms": payload.get("platforms") or r.get("platforms") or [],
                        "project": ({"id": project.id, "revision": project.revision}
                                    if project else None)})
        return out
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass


def _source_library(request: Request):
    """Recent owner source assets backed by Storage, never cross-user."""
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        return []
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import Job
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    from sqlalchemy import select
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        rows = db.execute(select(Job).where(
            Job.user_id == u.id, Job.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug
        ).order_by(Job.created_at.desc()).limit(60)).scalars().all()
        storage = get_storage(); seen = set(); out = []
        for row in rows:
            params = row.params or {}; key = str(params.get("video_key") or "")
            if not key.startswith(f"taoclipngan/{u.id}/") or key in seen:
                continue
            try:
                exists = storage.exists(key)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                exists = False
            if not exists:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append({"key": key,
                        "name": str(params.get("source_filename") or key.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])[:160],
                        "duration_s": float(params.get("duration_s") or 0),
                        "created_at": row.created_at})
            if len(out) >= 8:
                break
        return out
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass


@router.get("", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def page(request: Request, user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    return _render(request, user)


@router.post("/estimate", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def estimate(request: Request, duration_s: str = Form("0"), tier: str = Form("high_quality"),
             target_clip_count: str = Form("3"), user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    try:
        dur = float(duration_s or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        dur = 0.0
    try:
        n = int(target_clip_count or 3)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        n = 3
    e = cost.uoc_luong(dur, tier if tier in ("fast", "balanced", "high_quality") else "high_quality", n)
    if dur <= 0:
        return HTMLResponse(f'<span class="dim">{_t("Chọn video để tính chi phí.")}</span>')
    return HTMLResponse(
        f'<strong>{e["credit"]} credit</strong> '
        f'<span class="dim">(~{e["vnd"]:,}đ · {e["minutes"]} '
        f'{_t("phút nguồn")} · {_t(dict(_TIERS).get(e["tier"], e["tier"]))} · '
        f'{n} {_t("clip")})</span>')


@router.post("/upload-url")
def upload_url(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(...),
               filename: str = Form(""), content_type: str = Form(""),
               size_bytes: str = Form("0"),
               user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    def _ticket_error(message: str, status_code: int):
        return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "detail": _t(message)}, status_code=status_code)

    if not verify_csrf_token(request, csrf_token):
        return _ticket_error("Phiên đã hết hạn — tải lại trang.", 400)
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=_t('Cần tài khoản người dùng.'))
    from platform_core import upload_sessions
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    ext = _video_extension(filename)
    if ext not in _VIDEO_EXTS:
        return _ticket_error("Định dạng video không được hỗ trợ.", 400)
    declared_type = str(content_type or "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if declared_type not in _VIDEO_TYPES:
        return _ticket_error("MIME video không khớp định dạng được hỗ trợ.", 400)
    ct = _video_content_type(filename, content_type)
    try:
        declared_size = int(size_bytes or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        declared_size = 0
    if declared_size <= 0 or declared_size > _DIRECT_VIDEO_MAX:
        return _ticket_error("Video phải từ 1 byte đến 1 GiB.", 413)
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        try:
            session = upload_sessions.create(
                db, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug, filename=filename,
                content_type=ct, expected_size=declared_size,
                max_size=_DIRECT_VIDEO_MAX, allowed_types=_VIDEO_TYPES,
            )
            target = upload_sessions.upload_target(get_storage(), session)
            if target is None:
                db.delete(session); db.commit()
                return JSONResponse({"mode": "local"})
            db.commit()
        except upload_sessions.UploadSessionError as exc:
            db.rollback(); return _ticket_error(str(exc), 400)
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass
    return JSONResponse({"mode": "direct", "key": session.staging_key,
                         "upload_id": session.id, "url": target.url,
                         "method": target.method, "headers": target.headers or {}})


@router.post("/queue")
async def queue(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(...),
                video_key: str = Form(""), duration_s: str = Form("0"),
                source_filename: str = Form(""),
                tier: str = Form("high_quality"), genre: str = Form("talking_head"),
                aspect_ratio: str = Form("9:16"), language: str = Form(""),
                target_clip_count: str = Form("3"),
                min_clip_duration_sec: str = Form("15"),
                max_clip_duration_sec: str = Form("60"), ajax: str = Form(""),
                brand_preset: str = Form("auto"), platforms: list[str] = Form([]),
                video: UploadFile = File(default=None),
                user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    from platform_core import credit
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.job_submit import dedupe_key_for, submit_with_credit
    from platform_core.registry import RegistryError
    from platform_core import upload_sessions
    from platform_core.storage import CLOUDFLARE_BODY_LIMIT, get_storage

    def _fail(msg, code=400):
        msg = _t(str(msg))
        if ajax:
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": msg}, status_code=code)
        return _render(request, user, error=msg, status_code=code)

    if not verify_csrf_token(request, csrf_token):
        return _fail(_t("Phiên đã hết hạn — tải lại trang."))
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is None:
        return _fail(_t("Cần đăng nhập bằng tài khoản người dùng."))

    storage = get_storage()
    vkey = (video_key or "").strip()
    if vkey:
        if (not vkey.startswith("staging/") and
                (not vkey.startswith(f"taoclipngan/{u.id}/") or
                 not storage.exists(vkey))):
            return _fail(_t("Video chưa upload xong hoặc không hợp lệ."))
    else:
        if video is None or not getattr(video, "filename", ""):
            return _fail(_t("Chưa chọn video."))
        vdata = await video.read(min(_LOCAL_VIDEO_MAX, CLOUDFLARE_BODY_LIMIT) + 1)
        if not vdata:
            return _fail(_t("File video rỗng."))
        if len(vdata) > min(_LOCAL_VIDEO_MAX, CLOUDFLARE_BODY_LIMIT):
            return _fail(_t("Video >90MB cần upload trực tiếp; lưu trữ hiện chưa sẵn sàng."))
        ext = _video_extension(video.filename)
        if ext not in _VIDEO_EXTS:
            return _fail(_t("Định dạng video không được hỗ trợ."))
        stage_gen = get_session(); stage_db = next(stage_gen)
        try:
            try:
                staged = upload_sessions.stage_bytes(
                    stage_db, storage, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
                    filename=video.filename, content_type=_video_content_type(
                        video.filename, video.content_type or ""), data=vdata,
                    max_size=_LOCAL_VIDEO_MAX, allowed_types=_VIDEO_TYPES,
                )
                stage_db.commit(); vkey = staged.staging_key
            except Exception:
                stage_db.rollback(); raise
        except upload_sessions.UploadSessionError as exc:
            return _fail(str(exc))
        finally:
            try: next(stage_gen)
            except StopIteration: pass

    if tier not in ("fast", "balanced", "high_quality"):
        tier = "high_quality"
    if aspect_ratio not in dict(_ASPECTS):
        aspect_ratio = "9:16"
    if genre not in dict(_GENRES):
        genre = "talking_head"
    try:
        dur = float(duration_s or 0)
        n = max(1, min(int(target_clip_count or 3), 10))
        mn = float(min_clip_duration_sec or 15)
        mx = float(max_clip_duration_sec or 60)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        dur, n, mn, mx = 0.0, 3, 15.0, 60.0
    if mn < 5 or mx > 180 or mx < mn:
        return _fail(_t("Khoảng thời lượng clip không hợp lệ (5–180 giây)."))

    from apps.taoclipngan.features import clean_brand, clean_platforms
    params = {"video_key": vkey, "duration_s": dur, "tier": tier, "genre": genre,
              "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio, "language": language,
              "target_clip_count": n, "min_clip_duration_sec": mn,
              "max_clip_duration_sec": mx, "owner_id": u.id,
              "source_filename": (source_filename or
                                  getattr(video, "filename", "") or
                                  vkey.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])[:160],
              "brand_preset": clean_brand(brand_preset),
              "platforms": clean_platforms(platforms)}
    promotions = []
    gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    last_id = None
    try:
        try:
            upload_session = (upload_sessions.owned(
                db, staging_key=vkey, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug)
                if vkey.startswith("staging/") else None)
            if vkey.startswith("staging/") and upload_session is None:
                raise upload_sessions.UploadSessionError(
                    _t("Vé upload không hợp lệ hoặc không thuộc tài khoản."))
            if upload_session is not None:
                if upload_session.status == "promoted":
                    vkey = upload_session.final_key
                    params["video_key"] = vkey
                    from platform_core.models import Job
                    job = db.get(Job, upload_session.job_id)
                    if job is None or job.user_id != u.id or job.app_slug != MANIFEST.slug:
                        raise upload_sessions.UploadSessionError(
                            _t("Upload đã gắn với job không hợp lệ."))
                else:
                    upload_sessions.confirm(db, storage, upload_session)
                    job = submit_with_credit(
                        db, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
                        job_type="taoclipngan.render", params=params,
                        dedupe_key=dedupe_key_for("taoclipngan.render", {
                            **params, "video_key": upload_session.id,
                        }))
                    ext = _video_extension(upload_session.filename)
                    final_key = f"taoclipngan/{u.id}/inputs/{job.id}{ext}"
                    promoted_params = dict(job.params or {})
                    promoted_params["video_key"] = upload_sessions.promote(
                        db, storage, upload_session, job=job, final_key=final_key)
                    promotions.append((upload_session.staging_key, final_key,
                                       upload_session.content_type))
                    job.params = promoted_params
            else:
                job = submit_with_credit(
                    db, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
                    job_type="taoclipngan.render", params=params,
                    dedupe_key=dedupe_key_for("taoclipngan.render", params))
            last_id = job.id
            db.commit()
        except (credit.ThieuCreditError, RegistryError,
                upload_sessions.UploadSessionError) as exc:
            db.rollback()
            upload_sessions.compensate(storage, promotions)
            return _fail(str(exc))
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            upload_sessions.compensate(storage, promotions)
            raise
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass

    if ajax:
        return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "redirect": f"/jobs/{last_id}"})
    return RedirectResponse(f"/jobs/{last_id}", status_code=303)


def _owned_done_job(db, user_id: str, job_id: str):
    from platform_core.models import Job
    row = db.get(Job, job_id)
    if (row is None or row.user_id != user_id or row.app_slug != MANIFEST.slug or
            row.status != "done"):
        return None
    return row


@router.post("/package/{job_id}/save")
def save_package(request: Request, job_id: str, csrf_token: str = Form(...),
                 package_json: str = Form("{}"), project_id: str = Form(""),
                 revision: int = Form(0), user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    if not verify_csrf_token(request, csrf_token):
        return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": _t("Phiên hết hạn.")}, status_code=400)
    import json
    try:
        draft = json.loads(package_json)
        if not isinstance(draft, dict):
            raise ValueError
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": _t("Package không hợp lệ.")}, status_code=400)
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import package_payload
    from platform_core import app_projects
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    u = user_hien_tai(request); gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        job = _owned_done_job(db, u.id, job_id) if u else None
        if job is None:
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": _t("Không tìm thấy job.")}, status_code=404)
        payload = package_payload(job_id=job_id,
            original_clips=list((job.result or {}).get("clips") or []),
            drafts=list(draft.get("clips") or []), platforms=draft.get("platforms") or [],
            brand_preset=str((job.params or {}).get("brand_preset") or "auto"))
        try:
            if project_id:
                current = app_projects.get_owned(db, project_id, u.id, MANIFEST.slug)
                if (current.payload or {}).get("source_job_id") != job_id:
                    raise app_projects.ProjectNotFound("Không tìm thấy package.")
                row = app_projects.save(db, project_id=project_id, user_id=u.id,
                    app_slug=MANIFEST.slug, revision=revision,
                    name=f"Package {str((job.params or {}).get('source_filename') or job.id)[:120]}",
                    schema_version=1, payload=payload)
            else:
                row = app_projects.create(db, user_id=u.id, app_slug=MANIFEST.slug,
                    name=f"Package {str((job.params or {}).get('source_filename') or job.id)[:120]}",
                    schema_version=1, payload=payload)
            db.commit()
        except app_projects.ProjectError as exc:
            db.rollback()
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, status_code=409)
        return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "project_id": row.id,
                             "revision": row.revision})
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass


@router.get("/package/{job_id}.zip")
def download_package(request: Request, job_id: str, user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    import json
    import shutil
    import tempfile
    import zipfile
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import package_payload, srt_text
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import APP_PROJECT_ACTIVE, AppProject
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    from sqlalchemy import select
    u = user_hien_tai(request); gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        job = _owned_done_job(db, u.id, job_id) if u else None
        if job is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy package.'))
        project = db.execute(select(AppProject).where(
            AppProject.user_id == u.id, AppProject.app_slug == MANIFEST.slug,
            AppProject.status == APP_PROJECT_ACTIVE
        ).order_by(AppProject.updated_at.desc()).limit(100)).scalars().all()
        saved = next((row for row in project
                      if (row.payload or {}).get("source_job_id") == job_id), None)
        payload = (saved.payload or {}) if saved else package_payload(
            job_id=job_id, original_clips=list((job.result or {}).get("clips") or []),
            drafts=[], platforms=(job.result or {}).get("platforms") or [],
            brand_preset=str((job.params or {}).get("brand_preset") or "auto"))
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass
    spool = tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile(max_size=8 * 1024 * 1024)
    storage = get_storage()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(spool, "w") as archive:
        for index, clip in enumerate(payload.get("clips") or [], 1):
            key = str(clip.get("video_key") or "")
            if not key.startswith(f"taoclipngan/{u.id}/"):
                continue
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(f"clips/clip_{index:02d}.mp4")
            info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_STORED
            with storage.open(key) as source, archive.open(info, "w", force_zip64=True) as target:
                shutil.copyfileobj(source, target, length=1024 * 1024)
            archive.writestr(f"captions/clip_{index:02d}.srt",
                             srt_text(list(clip.get("transcript") or [])))
        archive.writestr("package.json", json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        archive.writestr("README.txt", "LTT Clip social package\nVideo dùng chung cho TikTok, YouTube Shorts và Instagram Reels; metadata theo package.json.\n")
    spool.seek(0)
    headers = {"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="ltt-clips-{job_id[:8]}.zip"',
               "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff"}
    return StreamingResponse(spool, media_type="application/zip", headers=headers,
                             background=BackgroundTask(spool.close))


@router.get("/v/{key:path}")
def clip_out(request: Request, key: str, user: str = Depends(require_login)):
    from platform_core.storage import StorageError, get_storage
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    segs = key.split("/")
    if len(segs) < 2 or segs[0] != "taoclipngan" or u is None or segs[1] != u.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy.'))
    storage = get_storage()
    direct = storage.try_url_for(key)
    if direct:
        return RedirectResponse(direct, status_code=302)
    try:
        total = storage.size(key)
    except (StorageError, FileNotFoundError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=_t('Không tìm thấy clip.'))
    rng = request.headers.get("range")
    if rng and rng.startswith("bytes="):
        try:
            s, _, e = rng[len("bytes="):].partition("-")
            start = int(s) if s else 0
            end = int(e) if e else total - 1
        except ValueError:
            start, end = 0, total - 1
        start = max(0, start); end = min(end, total - 1)
        if start > end:
            start = 0
        length = end - start + 1
        f = storage.open(key)
        try:
            f.seek(start); chunk = f.read(length)
        finally:
            f.close()
        return Response(content=chunk, status_code=206, media_type="video/mp4",
                        headers={"Content-Range": f"bytes {start}-{end}/{total}",
                                 "Accept-Ranges": "bytes", "Content-Length": str(len(chunk))})
    return StreamingResponse(storage.open(key), media_type="video/mp4",
                             headers={"Accept-Ranges": "bytes", "Content-Length": str(total)})

"""
assets.py — pipeline asset:// cho ModelArk (seedance Pha 2b). Di trú trung thành từ
`adapters/modelark_asset_adapter.py` + `face_detect.py`.

Dùng cho: ảnh > 8MB, video/audio tham chiếu, và "heal" ảnh người-thật khi ModelArk
chặn INPUT. Luồng: PUT file tạm lên R2 (private) → presigned GET 1h → volcengine
CreateAsset (ModelArk fetch + copy về TOS, kiểm duyệt tại đây) → poll GetAsset tới
Active → `asset://<id>` → xoá file tạm R2.

Ký AK/SK bằng volcengine SignerV4 (BytePlus OpenAPI, KHÁC S3). Creds ở env
`LTT_MODELARK_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET_KEY/REGION` (nhập từ BOT GEMINI). Nhận diện mặt
dùng opencv Haar (insightface cần MSVC — tạm Haar, đủ để quyết định heal).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
import threading
import time
import uuid

log = logging.getLogger("ltt.taovideo.assets")

HOST = "open.byteplusapi.com"
SERVICE = "ark"
_SHARED_GROUP_NAME = "ltt_seedance_aigc"
_shared_group_id = None
_group_lock = threading.Lock()
_create_lock = threading.Lock()
_create_last = 0.0
_CREATE_MIN_INTERVAL = 3.0
_CREATE_MAX_RETRY = 6

_ST_PROCESSING = ("process", "pending", "wait", "creat", "queue", "audit", "review", "run")
_ST_FAILED = ("fail", "reject", "illegal", "error", "block", "forbid", "violat", "denied", "expire")


class AssetError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _creds():
    ak = (os.environ.get("LTT_MODELARK_ACCESS_KEY") or "").strip()
    sk = (os.environ.get("LTT_MODELARK_SECRET_KEY") or "").strip()
    region = (os.environ.get("LTT_MODELARK_REGION") or "ap-southeast-1").strip()
    if not (ak and sk):
        raise AssetError("Chưa có ModelArk AK/SK (LTT_MODELARK_*).")
    return ak, sk, region


def _err(d: dict) -> str:
    e = ((d.get("ResponseMetadata") or {}).get("Error")) or d.get("error") or {}
    if isinstance(e, dict):
        return f"{e.get('Code') or e.get('code') or ''}: {e.get('Message') or e.get('message') or ''}".strip(": ") or str(d)[:200]
    return str(d)[:200]


def _signed_api(action: str, version: str, body: dict, *, timeout: float = 30.0):
    """BytePlus OpenAPI call ký SignerV4 (volcengine SDK)."""
    import requests
    from volcengine.auth.SignerV4 import SignerV4
    from volcengine.base.Request import Request
    from volcengine.Credentials import Credentials
    ak, sk, region = _creds()
    r = Request()
    r.set_shema("https")
    r.set_method("POST")
    r.set_connection_timeout(10)
    r.set_socket_timeout(timeout)
    r.set_headers({"Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Host": HOST})
    r.set_query({"Action": action, "Version": version})
    r.set_host(HOST)
    r.set_path("/")
    r.set_body(json.dumps(body))
    SignerV4.sign(r, Credentials(ak, sk, SERVICE, region))
    resp = requests.post(f"https://{HOST}/", params={"Action": action, "Version": version},
                         headers=dict(r.headers), data=r.body, timeout=timeout + 5)
    try:
        return resp.status_code, resp.json()
    except Exception:
        return resp.status_code, {"_raw": resp.text[:400]}


def _list_groups() -> list:
    out, page = [], 1
    while len(out) < 500:
        try:
            code, d = _signed_api("ListAssetGroups", "2024-01-01",
                                  {"Filter": {"GroupType": "AIGC"}, "PageNumber": page, "PageSize": 100})
        except Exception:
            return []
        if code != 200 or ((d.get("ResponseMetadata", {}) or {}).get("Error")):
            return []
        r = d.get("Result") or {}
        items = r.get("Items") or []
        out += [{"id": it.get("Id"), "name": it.get("Name")} for it in items]
        if len(items) < 100 or len(out) >= int(r.get("TotalCount") or 0):
            break
        page += 1
    return out


def _shared_group() -> str:
    global _shared_group_id
    if _shared_group_id:
        return _shared_group_id
    with _group_lock:
        if _shared_group_id:
            return _shared_group_id
        for g in _list_groups():
            if g.get("name") == _SHARED_GROUP_NAME and g.get("id"):
                _shared_group_id = g["id"]
                return _shared_group_id
        c, r = _signed_api("CreateAssetGroup", "2024-01-01",
                           {"Name": _SHARED_GROUP_NAME, "GroupType": "AIGC"})
        gid = (r.get("Result") or {}).get("Id")
        if c != 200 or not gid:
            raise AssetError(f"CreateAssetGroup: {_err(r)}")
        _shared_group_id = gid
        return gid


def _create_asset(gid: str, asset_type: str, name: str, url: str):
    global _create_last
    c, r = 0, {}
    for attempt in range(_CREATE_MAX_RETRY + 1):
        with _create_lock:
            wait = _CREATE_MIN_INTERVAL - (time.time() - _create_last)
            if wait > 0:
                time.sleep(wait)
            c, r = _signed_api("CreateAsset", "2024-01-01",
                               {"GroupId": gid, "AssetType": asset_type, "Name": name, "URL": url})
            _create_last = time.time()
        if c == 200:
            return r
        msg = _err(r)
        if ("QPM" in msg or "rate limit" in msg.lower() or "QuotaWrite" in msg) and attempt < _CREATE_MAX_RETRY:
            time.sleep(min(2.0 * (2 ** attempt), 15.0))
            continue
        raise AssetError(f"CreateAsset: {msg}")
    raise AssetError("CreateAsset: hết lần thử")


def _wait_active(asset_id: str, timeout: float = 180.0) -> None:
    t0, last = time.time(), ""
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        c, r = _signed_api("GetAsset", "2024-01-01", {"Id": asset_id}, timeout=20)
        st = str((r.get("Result") or {}).get("Status") or "").lower()
        if c == 200 and st:
            last = st
            if any(k in st for k in _ST_FAILED):
                raise AssetError(f"Asset bị từ chối/kiểm duyệt (status={st})")
            if not any(k in st for k in _ST_PROCESSING):
                return
        time.sleep(6)
    raise AssetError(f"Asset chưa sẵn sàng sau {int(timeout)}s (status={last or '?'})")


def _delete_asset(asset_id: str) -> None:
    try:
        _signed_api("DeleteAsset", "2024-01-01", {"Id": asset_id}, timeout=20)
    except Exception:
        pass


def to_asset(kind: str, data: bytes, ext: str = ".png") -> str:
    """Đưa 1 ảnh/video (bytes) thành `asset://<id>` dùng được trong body ModelArk.

    Host tạm = R2 (qua platform storage) presigned 1h → CreateAsset → wait Active →
    xoá temp. Cần storage R2 (dev Local không có presigned → raise)."""
    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    import io
    storage = get_storage()
    tmp_key = f"sdv-tmp/{uuid.uuid4().hex}{ext}"
    storage.put(tmp_key, io.BytesIO(data),
                content_type="video/mp4" if kind == "video" else "image/png")
    try:
        url = storage.url_for(tmp_key, ttl_s=3600)
        if not url:
            raise AssetError("Cần R2 (presigned) cho asset:// — Local không hỗ trợ.")
        gid = _shared_group()
        asset_type = "Video" if kind == "video" else "Image"
        r = _create_asset(gid, asset_type, f"ltt_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}", url)
        aid = (r.get("Result") or {}).get("Id")
        if not aid:
            raise AssetError(f"CreateAsset không trả Id ({str(r)[:150]})")
        _wait_active(aid)
        return f"asset://{aid}"
    finally:
        try:
            storage.delete(tmp_key)
        except Exception:
            pass


# ── Nhận diện mặt (opencv Haar; insightface cần MSVC — dùng Haar) ─────────────
_haar = None
_haar_lock = threading.Lock()


def _get_haar():
    global _haar
    if _haar is not None:
        return _haar
    with _haar_lock:
        if _haar is None:
            import cv2
            _haar = cv2.CascadeClassifier(
                cv2.data.haarcascades + "haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml")
    return _haar


def has_face(data: bytes) -> bool:
    """True nếu ảnh có mặt người (để quyết định heal → asset://). Lỗi → False."""
    try:
        import cv2
        import numpy as np
        arr = np.frombuffer(data, dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.imdecode(arr, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        if img is None:
            return False
        h, w = img.shape[:2]
        if max(h, w) > 2000:
            sc = 2000.0 / max(h, w)
            img = cv2.resize(img, (int(w * sc), int(h * sc)))
        cas = _get_haar()
        faces = cas.detectMultiScale(img, scaleFactor=1.1, minNeighbors=9,
                                     minSize=(max(8, img.shape[0] // 12),) * 2)
        return len(faces) > 0
    except Exception:
        return False

"""
cost.py — mô hình giá seedance (di trú trung thành từ BOT GEMINI
`app/modules/seedance_video/cost.py`).

Giá theo TOKEN ≈ (w×h×fps×duration) × hệ số hiệu chỉnh, nhân rate USD/1M-token
theo model + có/không video input, cộng markup, quy ra VND, rồi ĐỔI RA CREDIT
của nền tảng (Q31: 1 credit = 100đ).

Hai điểm nối với sổ credit H3:
- `uoc_luong_credit(...)` = giá TRƯỚC khi chạy → dùng làm `credit_cost` trong
  manifest để nền tảng GIỮ CHỖ (reserve).
- `credit_tu_token(...)` = giá THẬT sau khi provider trả `usage.total_tokens` →
  handler trả về `credit_cost` này để worker QUYẾT TOÁN (hoàn phần giữ dư).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

VND_PER_CREDIT = 100          # Q31
USD_TO_VND = 26000            # manifest BOT GEMINI
MARKUP_PERCENT = 0

_RES_DIM = {"480p": (854, 480), "720p": (1280, 720),
            "1080p": (1920, 1080), "4k": (3840, 2160)}

# Rate USD / 1.000.000 token = (có_video_input, KHÔNG_video_input)
_RATE_PER_M = {
    "seedance-2.0":      (4.3, 7.0),
    "seedance-2.0-fast": (3.3, 5.6),
    "seedance-2.0-mini": (2.1, 3.5),
}
_DEFAULT_RATE = (4.3, 7.0)

DEFAULT_FPS = 24
# Hiệu chỉnh từ 1 job thật (mini 480p/16:9/5s): total_tokens = 50638.
_CAL_TOKENS, _CAL_W, _CAL_H, _CAL_FPS, _CAL_DUR = 50638, 854, 480, 24, 5
_TOKENS_PER_UNIT = _CAL_TOKENS / (_CAL_W * _CAL_H * _CAL_FPS * _CAL_DUR)


def _rate(model: str, has_video_input: bool) -> float:
    pair = _RATE_PER_M.get(model, _DEFAULT_RATE)
    return pair[0] if has_video_input else pair[1]


def uoc_tinh_token(resolution: str, duration: int, fps: int = DEFAULT_FPS) -> int:
    w, h = _RES_DIM.get(resolution, (1280, 720))     # lạ → 720p (ước cao, an toàn)
    dur = max(1, int(duration))
    return int((w * h * fps * dur) * _TOKENS_PER_UNIT)


def _vnd_tu_usd(usd: float) -> int:
    return int(round(usd * USD_TO_VND))


def _credit_tu_vnd(vnd: int) -> int:
    return max(1, math.ceil(vnd / VND_PER_CREDIT))


def usd_tu_token(model: str, tokens: int, has_video_input: bool = False) -> float:
    return round(tokens / 1_000_000 * _rate(model, has_video_input) * (1 + MARKUP_PERCENT / 100.0), 4)


def credit_tu_token(model: str, tokens: int, has_video_input: bool = False) -> int:
    """Credit THẬT sau khi biết token provider dùng (để quyết toán)."""
    return _credit_tu_vnd(_vnd_tu_usd(usd_tu_token(model, tokens, has_video_input)))


def uoc_luong(model: str, resolution: str, duration: int,
              has_video_input: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Ước tính trước khi chạy: token/usd/vnd/credit + công thức (để hiện UI + reserve)."""
    tokens = uoc_tinh_token(resolution, duration)
    usd = usd_tu_token(model, tokens, has_video_input)
    vnd = _vnd_tu_usd(usd)
    credit = _credit_tu_vnd(vnd)
    return {"tokens": tokens, "usd": usd, "vnd": vnd, "credit": credit,
            "formula": f"~{tokens:,} token x ${_rate(model, has_video_input)}/1M = "
                       f"${usd} ~ {vnd:,}d = {credit} credit"}


def uoc_luong_credit(model: str, resolution: str, duration: int,
                     has_video_input: bool = False) -> int:
    return uoc_luong(model, resolution, duration, has_video_input)["credit"]


def has_video_reference(params: dict) -> bool:
    refs = params.get("refs") if isinstance(params.get("refs"), list) else []
    return bool(params.get("video_key")) or any(
        isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("kind") == "video" for item in refs)


def customer_charge_cap(params: dict) -> int:
    """Mức khách xác nhận và nền tảng giữ; là trần thu cuối cùng của job."""
    from apps.taovideo.models import DEFAULT_MODEL
    model = params.get("model") or DEFAULT_MODEL
    resolution = params.get("resolution", "480p")
    try:
        duration = int(params.get("duration", 5))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        duration = 5
    est = uoc_luong_credit(
        model, resolution, duration, has_video_reference(params))
    return max(1, math.ceil(est * 1.25))

"""
Handler job app `seedance` (A2, Pha 1). Video ASYNC: submit → poll → tải → quyết toán.

Chạy trong WORKER (không dính trần 100s của Cloudflare). Vòng poll gọi `ctx.progress`
mỗi nhịp → cập nhật heartbeat < ORPHAN_TIMEOUT (5') nên job dài KHÔNG bị nhặt lại.

Hợp đồng: idempotent (resume: nếu video đã lưu thì bỏ qua) · báo tiến độ · NÉM khi
lỗi (nền tảng hoàn credit đã giữ). Giá quyết toán theo token THẬT provider trả.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
import io
import os
import time

import random

from apps.taovideo import assets, cost, modelark, models, refs

POLL_INTERVAL_S = 5
POLL_MAX_MINUTES = 15          # đủ cho hầu hết job; worker giữ job suốt thời gian này
_POLL_MAX = POLL_MAX_MINUTES * 60 // POLL_INTERVAL_S
MOD_RETRY_MAX = 5              # kiểm duyệt đầu ra → đổi seed render lại (block bill 0 token)
HEAL_MAX = 2                  # bị chặn INPUT người-thật → chuyển ref sang asset:// (≤2 pass)

_PRIVACY_KW = ("real person", "may contain real", "portrait", "face", "privacy",
               "sensitive", "inputimage", "inputvideo")
_MOD_KW = ("moderat", "risk control", "output_video")


def _looks_privacy(msg: str) -> bool:
    return any(k in msg for k in _PRIVACY_KW)


def _looks_output_mod(msg: str) -> bool:
    return any(k in msg for k in _MOD_KW)


def _lay_key():
    """Key byteplus từ APIKEYS (category video). Fallback env BYTEPLUS_API_KEY (dev)."""
    try:
        from platform_core import api_keys, api_pool
        from platform_core.db import get_session
        from platform_core.models import APIKEY_CAT_VIDEO
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            key = api_pool.lay_key(db, "byteplus", category=APIKEY_CAT_VIDEO)
            cred = api_keys.lay_credential(db, key)
            db.commit()
            return cred, key.id
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
    except Exception:
        return (os.environ.get("BYTEPLUS_API_KEY") or "").strip(), None


def _ket_qua_key(key_id, *, thanh_cong, last_status=None):
    if not key_id:
        return
    try:
        from platform_core import api_keys, api_pool
        from platform_core.db import get_session
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            key = api_keys.lay_key_theo_id(db, key_id)
            if key is None:
                return
            if thanh_cong:
                api_pool.danh_dau_thanh_cong(db, key)
            elif last_status is not None:
                api_pool.danh_dau_loi(db, key, http_status=last_status)
            db.commit()
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
    except Exception:
        pass


def _reference_specs(params: dict, owner_id: str, storage) -> list[dict]:
    """Normalize legacy form refs and typed Canvas inputs behind one owner gate."""
    raw = [dict(item) for item in (params.get("refs") or []) if isinstance(item, dict)]
    typed = (("image_key", "image"), ("video_key", "video"),
             ("audio_key", "audio"))
    for field, kind in typed:
        if params.get(field):
            raw.append({"storage_key": params[field], "kind": kind})
    for key in params.get("image_keys") or []:
        raw.append({"storage_key": key, "kind": "image"})
    clean: list[dict] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in raw:
        key = str(item.get("storage_key") or "").strip()
        kind = str(item.get("kind") or "image").strip()
        parts = key.split("/")
        if kind not in {"image", "video", "audio"}:
            raise ValueError(_t('Loại tài nguyên tham chiếu không hợp lệ.'))
        if len(parts) < 3 or parts[1] != owner_id:
            raise ValueError(_t('Tài nguyên tham chiếu không thuộc người dùng.'))
        if not storage.exists(key):
            raise ValueError(_t('Tài nguyên tham chiếu không còn tồn tại.'))
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        clean.append({"storage_key": key, "kind": kind,
                      "role": str(item.get("role") or
                                  ("reference_image" if kind == "image" else f"reference_{kind}")),
                      "handle": str(item.get("handle") or "")})
    if len(clean) > 4:
        raise ValueError(_t('Một video chỉ nhận tối đa 4 tài nguyên tham chiếu.'))
    return clean


def _luu_task_id(job_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
    """Lưu remote task_id vào job.params NGAY sau khi submit ModelArk — để lần chạy lại
    (worker chết/orphan) POLL lại task cũ thay vì submit MỚI (chống double-bill provider)."""
    if not job_id or job_id == "adhoc" or not task_id:
        return
    try:
        from platform_core.db import get_session
        from platform_core.models import Job
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            j = db.get(Job, job_id)
            if j is not None:
                p = dict(j.params or {}); p["_remote_task_id"] = task_id
                j.params = p; db.commit()
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass


def handle(params: dict, ctx=None) -> dict:
    prompt = str(params.get("prompt", "")).strip()
    if not prompt:
        raise ValueError(_t('Chưa nhập mô tả video.'))
    model = str(params.get("model") or models.DEFAULT_MODEL)
    m = models.get(model)
    if m is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Model không hợp lệ: {model}")
    resolution = str(params.get("resolution", "480p"))
    aspect = str(params.get("aspect_ratio", "16:9"))
    try:
        duration = int(params.get("duration", 5))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        duration = 5
    audio = bool(params.get("generate_audio", True))
    owner_id = str(params.get("owner_id", "")) or "unknown"
    job_id = getattr(ctx, "job_id", "") or "adhoc"

    from platform_core.storage import get_storage
    storage = get_storage()
    vkey = f"taovideo/{owner_id}/{job_id}/video.mp4"
    if storage.exists(vkey):                      # resume: đã tạo xong trước đó
        return {"video_key": vkey, "credit_cost": cost.customer_charge_cap(params)}

    # Refs (Pha 2): ảnh ≤8MB → inline (Pillow); ảnh >8MB / video / audio → asset://
    # (R2 temp presigned → ModelArk CreateAsset). Giữ `data` để heal người-thật sau.
    ref_items = []
    has_video_input = False
    for rs in _reference_specs(params, owner_id, storage):
        if ctx is not None:                 # heartbeat: to_asset có thể mất ~200s/ref
            ctx.progress(3, "chuẩn bị tài nguyên tham chiếu…")
        kind = (rs.get("kind") or "image").strip()
        skey = (rs.get("storage_key") or "").strip()
        if not skey:
            continue
        data = storage.open(skey).read()
        role = rs.get("role") or "reference_image"
        handle = rs.get("handle") or ""
        if kind == "image":
            try:
                url = refs.image_to_inline(data)
            except refs.RefError:
                url = assets.to_asset("image", data)       # >8MB → asset://
        else:                                              # video/audio → asset://
            ext = ".mp4" if kind == "video" else ".m4a"
            url = assets.to_asset(kind, data, ext)
            if kind == "video":
                has_video_input = True
        ref_items.append({"kind": kind, "url": url, "role": role,
                          "handle": handle, "data": data})

    def _content():
        return refs.build_content(prompt, [{"kind": it["kind"], "url": it["url"],
                                            "role": it["role"], "handle": it["handle"]}
                                           for it in ref_items])

    def _heal(faces_only: bool) -> int:
        n = 0
        for it in ref_items:
            if it["kind"] != "image" or it["url"].startswith("asset://"):
                continue
            if faces_only and not assets.has_face(it["data"]):
                continue
            if ctx is not None:             # heartbeat: to_asset chậm, tránh false-orphan
                ctx.progress(6, "bảo vệ ảnh người thật…")
            try:
                it["url"] = assets.to_asset("image", it["data"])
                n += 1
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        return n

    content = _content()
    api_key, key_id = _lay_key()
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError(_t('Chưa có API key BytePlus (thêm ở /admin → APIKEYS).'))

    endpoint = models.provider_model(model)
    try:
        seed = int(params["seed"]) if params.get("seed") is not None else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        seed = None
    if seed is not None and not 0 <= seed <= 2_147_483_647:
        seed = None
    result = None
    mod_try = heal_stage = 0

    # Chống DOUBLE-BILL: lần chạy trước (crash/orphan) có thể đã submit task rồi. Poll
    # lại task đó tới khi xong thay vì submit MỚI. Chỉ submit mới nếu task cũ hỏng/hết hạn.
    resumed = (params.get("_remote_task_id") or "").strip()
    if resumed:
        try:
            for i in range(_POLL_MAX):
                if ctx is not None:
                    ctx.progress(min(90, 10 + int(i * 80 / _POLL_MAX)), "tiếp tục dựng video…")
                time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_S)
                try:
                    st = modelark.poll(api_key, resumed)
                except modelark.ModelArkError:
                    break
                if st["status"] == "succeeded":
                    result = st; break
                if st["status"] in ("failed", "expired", "cancelled"):
                    break
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    while result is None:
        if ctx is not None:
            ctx.progress(5, "gửi yêu cầu tạo video")
        err = None
        task_id = None
        try:
            task_id = modelark.submit(
                api_key, model_endpoint=endpoint, content=content,
                resolution=resolution, duration=duration, aspect_ratio=aspect,
                generate_audio=audio, seed=seed)
            _luu_task_id(job_id, task_id)   # persist NGAY để retry poll lại, không submit mới
        except modelark.ModelArkError as e:
            err = str(e).lower()
            if not (e.status_code == 400 and _looks_privacy(err)):
                _ket_qua_key(key_id, thanh_cong=False, last_status=e.status_code)
                raise

        if task_id is not None:
            st_final = None
            for i in range(_POLL_MAX):
                if ctx is not None:
                    ctx.progress(min(90, 10 + int(i * 80 / _POLL_MAX)), "đang dựng video…")
                time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_S)
                try:
                    st = modelark.poll(api_key, task_id)
                except modelark.ModelArkError:
                    continue
                if st["status"] in ("succeeded", "failed", "expired", "cancelled"):
                    st_final = st
                    break
            if st_final is None:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Quá thời gian chờ ({POLL_MAX_MINUTES} phút) — thử lại sau.")
            if st_final["status"] == "succeeded":
                result = st_final
                break
            err = (st_final.get("error") or "").lower()

        # Bị chặn INPUT người-thật → chuyển ref sang asset:// rồi gửi lại (≤2 pass).
        if err and _looks_privacy(err) and heal_stage < HEAL_MAX and \
                any(it["kind"] == "image" and not it["url"].startswith("asset://") for it in ref_items):
            if ctx is not None:
                ctx.progress(6, "bảo vệ ảnh người thật (asset://)…")
            n = _heal(faces_only=(heal_stage == 0))
            heal_stage += 1
            if n > 0:
                content = _content()
                continue
        # Kiểm duyệt ĐẦU RA → đổi seed render lại (block bill 0 token).
        if err and _looks_output_mod(err) and mod_try < MOD_RETRY_MAX:
            mod_try += 1
            seed = random.randint(1, 2_147_483_647)
            continue
        _ket_qua_key(key_id, thanh_cong=False)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Tạo video thất bại: {err or 'không rõ'}")

    if ctx is not None:
        ctx.progress(92, "tải video về")
    if not result.get("video_url"):
        raise RuntimeError(_t('Provider không trả URL video.'))
    video = modelark.download(result["video_url"])
    storage.put(vkey, io.BytesIO(video), content_type="video/mp4")
    _ket_qua_key(key_id, thanh_cong=True)

    tokens = int(result.get("tokens") or 0)
    credit_cost = (cost.credit_tu_token(model, tokens, has_video_input) if tokens
                   else cost.uoc_luong_credit(model, resolution, duration, has_video_input))
    if ctx is not None:
        ctx.progress(100, "xong")
    return {"video_key": vkey, "credit_cost": credit_cost, "tokens": tokens,
            "resolution": resolution, "duration": duration, "model": model,
            "refs": len(ref_items), "seed": seed}

"""
modelark.py — adapter BytePlus ModelArk (di trú từ `adapters/modelark_adapter.py`).

Async video: POST tạo task → GET poll tới khi xong → tải video. Auth Bearer (key
lấy từ APIKEYS provider `byteplus`). Chỉ phần API thuần — KHÔNG kéo asset://
AK/SK (Pha 2).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

BASE_URL = "https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3"
DOWNLOAD_CAP = 200 * 1024 * 1024      # 200MB an toàn


class ModelArkError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status_code: int | None = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code


def _che(msg: str, key: str) -> str:
    if key and len(key) > 8:
        msg = msg.replace(key, "***")
    return msg[:500]


def submit(api_key: str, *, model_endpoint: str, content: list, resolution: str,
           duration: int, aspect_ratio: str, generate_audio: bool = True,
           seed: int | None = None, timeout: int = 30) -> str:
    """Tạo task video → trả task_id. `content` = list part đã dựng sẵn (text + refs)
    theo `apps/taovideo/refs.build_content`."""
    import httpx
    body = {
        "model": model_endpoint, "content": content,
        "ratio": aspect_ratio, "resolution": resolution,
        "duration": int(duration), "generate_audio": bool(generate_audio),
        "watermark": False,
    }
    if seed is not None:
        body["seed"] = int(seed)
    try:
        r = httpx.post(f"{BASE_URL}/contents/generations/tasks",
                       headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
                       json=body, timeout=timeout)
    except httpx.HTTPError as e:
        raise ModelArkError(_che(f"ModelArk mang loi: {e}", api_key), None)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise ModelArkError(_che(f"ModelArk submit HTTP {r.status_code}: {r.text}", api_key),
                            r.status_code)
    data = r.json()
    tid = data.get("id") or data.get("task_id") or (data.get("data") or {}).get("id")
    if not tid:
        raise ModelArkError(_che(f"ModelArk khong tra task_id: {r.text}", api_key), None)
    return str(tid)


def poll(api_key: str, task_id: str, *, timeout: int = 30) -> dict:
    """Đọc trạng thái task → {status, video_url, tokens}. status: pending/running/
    succeeded/failed/expired/cancelled."""
    import httpx
    try:
        r = httpx.get(f"{BASE_URL}/contents/generations/tasks/{task_id}",
                      headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}, timeout=timeout)
    except httpx.HTTPError as e:
        raise ModelArkError(_che(f"ModelArk poll loi: {e}", api_key), None)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise ModelArkError(_che(f"ModelArk poll HTTP {r.status_code}: {r.text}", api_key),
                            r.status_code)
    d = r.json()
    status = (d.get("status") or "").lower()
    content = d.get("content") or {}
    video_url = content.get("video_url") or d.get("video_url") or content.get("output_url") or ""
    usage = d.get("usage") or {}
    tokens = usage.get("total_tokens") or usage.get("completion_tokens") or 0
    err = ""
    if status in ("failed", "expired", "cancelled"):
        err = (d.get("error") or {}).get("message") if isinstance(d.get("error"), dict) else str(d.get("error") or "")
    return {"status": status, "video_url": video_url, "tokens": int(tokens or 0),
            "error": _che(err or "", api_key)}


def download(video_url: str, *, timeout: int = 300) -> bytes:
    """Tải video (stream, chặn trần DOWNLOAD_CAP)."""
    import httpx
    buf = bytearray()
    try:
        with httpx.stream("GET", video_url, timeout=timeout, follow_redirects=True) as r:
            if r.status_code != 200:
                raise ModelArkError(f"Tai video HTTP {r.status_code}", r.status_code)
            for chunk in r.iter_bytes():
                buf.extend(chunk)
                if len(buf) > DOWNLOAD_CAP:
                    raise ModelArkError("Video vuot tran 200MB", None)
    except httpx.HTTPError as e:
        raise ModelArkError(f"Tai video loi: {type(e).__name__}", None)
    return bytes(buf)

"""Báo giá ký và submit một-lần cho Seedance.

Quote khóa đúng cấu hình ảnh hưởng giá trước khi app lưu asset hay tạo job.
``intent`` là idempotency key của cả batch: gửi lại cùng form sau double-click,
retry mạng hoặc refresh không tạo thêm job/hold, kể cả job cũ đã terminal.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import uuid

from itsdangerous import BadSignature, SignatureExpired, URLSafeTimedSerializer
from sqlalchemy import select, text

from apps.taovideo import cost
from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t


QUOTE_TTL_S = 15 * 60
_SALT = "ltt-taovideo-quote-v1"
_VERSION = 1


def _serializer() -> URLSafeTimedSerializer:
    secret = (os.environ.get("LTT_SESSION_SECRET") or "").strip()
    if not secret:
        raise RuntimeError(_t("Chưa cấu hình khóa ký báo giá."))
    return URLSafeTimedSerializer(secret)


def _configuration(params: dict, count: int, has_video_input: bool) -> dict:
    priced = dict(params)
    if has_video_input:
        priced["refs"] = [{"kind": "video"}]
    else:
        priced["refs"] = []
    return {
        "model": str(params.get("model") or ""),
        "resolution": str(params.get("resolution") or ""),
        "duration": int(params.get("duration") or 0),
        "aspect_ratio": str(params.get("aspect_ratio") or ""),
        "count": max(1, min(int(count), 2)),
        "has_video_input": bool(has_video_input),
        "unit_hold": cost.customer_charge_cap(priced),
    }


def issue(user_id: str, params: dict, count: int,
          has_video_input: bool) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    payload = {
        "v": _VERSION,
        "user_id": str(user_id),
        "intent": uuid.uuid4().hex,
        **_configuration(params, count, has_video_input),
    }
    return _serializer().dumps(payload, salt=_SALT), payload


def verify(token: str, user_id: str, params: dict, count: int,
           has_video_input: bool, *, max_age: int = QUOTE_TTL_S) -> dict | None:
    if not token:
        return None
    try:
        payload = _serializer().loads(token, salt=_SALT, max_age=max_age)
    except (BadSignature, SignatureExpired):
        return None
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None
    expected = _configuration(params, count, has_video_input)
    if payload.get("v") != _VERSION or payload.get("user_id") != str(user_id):
        return None
    if any(payload.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
        return None
    intent = str(payload.get("intent") or "")
    if len(intent) != 32:
        return None
    return payload


def _dedupe_key(user_id: str, intent: str, variant: int) -> str:
    from platform_core.job_submit import dedupe_key_for
    return dedupe_key_for("taovideo.generate", {
        "user_id": user_id, "quote_intent": intent, "variant": int(variant),
    })


def _lock_intent(db, user_id: str, intent: str) -> None:
    if db.bind is not None and db.bind.dialect.name == "postgresql":
        db.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(:k))"), {
            "k": f"taovideo-quote:{user_id}:{intent}",
        })


def existing_jobs(db, user_id: str, intent: str, count: int) -> list:
    """Trả đủ batch cũ (mọi status), hoặc danh sách rỗng nếu chưa submit."""
    from platform_core.models import Job
    keys = [_dedupe_key(user_id, intent, k) for k in range(count)]
    rows = db.execute(select(Job).where(
        Job.user_id == user_id,
        Job.app_slug == "taovideo",
        Job.job_type == "taovideo.generate",
        Job.dedupe_key.in_(keys),
    )).scalars().all()
    by_key = {job.dedupe_key: job for job in rows}
    return [by_key[key] for key in keys] if all(key in by_key for key in keys) else []


def submit_batch(db, *, user_id: str, quote: dict, base_params: dict,
                 fixed_seed: int | None = None,
                 variant_refs: list[list[dict]] | None = None) -> list:
    """Tạo/reuse nguyên batch dưới khóa quote, giữ credit đúng một lần."""
    from platform_core.job_submit import submit_with_credit
    from platform_core.models import Job

    intent = str(quote["intent"])
    count = int(quote["count"])
    if variant_refs is not None and len(variant_refs) != count:
        raise ValueError(_t("Số bộ tham chiếu không khớp batch."))
    _lock_intent(db, user_id, intent)
    prior = existing_jobs(db, user_id, intent, count)
    if prior:
        return prior

    jobs = []
    for variant in range(count):
        key = _dedupe_key(user_id, intent, variant)
        old = db.execute(select(Job).where(
            Job.user_id == user_id, Job.app_slug == "taovideo",
            Job.job_type == "taovideo.generate", Job.dedupe_key == key,
        )).scalar_one_or_none()
        if old is not None:
            jobs.append(old)
            continue
        params = dict(base_params, _n=variant,
                      _quote_intent=intent, _quote_version=_VERSION)
        if variant_refs is not None:
            params["refs"] = list(variant_refs[variant])
        if fixed_seed is not None:
            params["seed"] = (fixed_seed + variant) % 2_147_483_648
        jobs.append(submit_with_credit(
            db, user_id=user_id, app_slug="taovideo",
            job_type="taovideo.generate", params=params, dedupe_key=key,
        ))
    return jobs

"""
refs.py — dựng phần tham chiếu (ảnh/video/audio) cho body ModelArk (seedance Pha 2).

Di trú trung thành từ `adapters/modelark_adapter.py` (build_content/_ref_to_part/
_provider_url/_image_role/normalize_tags):
- ảnh ≤ 8 MiB → INLINE `data:` base64 (chuẩn hoá về PNG/JPEG bằng Pillow);
- ảnh > 8 MiB / video / audio → BẮT BUỘC `asset://` (hoặc URL công khai) — không inline;
- role hợp lệ + remap legacy; @handle → tag vị trí @IMG_n/@VID_n/@AUD_n.

Ref (dict) worker nhận: {kind, url|data, role, handle}. `url` có thể là data:/http:/asset://.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import re

MAX_INLINE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024

VALID_IMAGE_ROLES = {"reference_image", "first_frame", "last_frame", "mask"}
_ROLE_REMAP = {"reference": "reference_image", "character": "reference_image",
               "start_frame": "first_frame", "end_frame": "last_frame"}
_TAG_PREFIX = {"image": "IMG", "video": "VID", "audio": "AUD"}


class RefError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def image_role(role: str) -> str:
    r = (role or "").strip() or "reference_image"
    r = _ROLE_REMAP.get(r, r)
    return r if r in VALID_IMAGE_ROLES else "reference_image"


def normalize_image(data: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    """Trả (bytes, mime). Giữ nguyên nếu đã JPEG/PNG; còn lại convert PNG (Pillow)."""
    if data[:3] == b"\xff\xd8\xff":
        return data, "image/jpeg"
    if data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n":
        return data, "image/png"
    import io
    from PIL import Image
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
    if im.mode not in ("RGB", "RGBA"):
        im = im.convert("RGBA" if "A" in im.mode else "RGB")
    out = io.BytesIO()
    im.save(out, format="PNG")
    return out.getvalue(), "image/png"


def image_to_inline(data: bytes) -> str:
    """bytes ảnh → data URL. Ném RefError nếu sau chuẩn hoá vẫn > 8 MiB (cần asset://)."""
    norm, mime = normalize_image(data)
    if len(norm) > MAX_INLINE_BYTES:
        raise RefError("anh > 8MiB — can asset:// / URL cong khai")
    b64 = base64.b64encode(norm).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{b64}"


def _ref_to_part(ref: dict) -> dict | None:
    kind = (ref.get("kind") or "image").strip()
    url = (ref.get("url") or "").strip()
    if not url:
        return None
    if kind == "image":
        return {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": url},
                "role": image_role(ref.get("role") or "")}
    if kind == "video":
        return {"type": "video_url", "video_url": {"url": url}, "role": "reference_video"}
    if kind == "audio":
        return {"type": "audio_url", "audio_url": {"url": url}, "role": "reference_audio"}
    return None


def normalize_tags(prompt: str, refs: list) -> str:
    """@handle (vd @swat) → tag vị trí @IMG_n/@VID_n/@AUD_n theo thứ tự ref mỗi loại."""
    counts = {"image": 0, "video": 0, "audio": 0}
    handle_to_tag = {}
    for r in refs:
        kind = (r.get("kind") or "image").strip()
        if kind not in counts:
            continue
        counts[kind] += 1
        h = (r.get("handle") or "").strip().lstrip("@").lower()
        if h:
            handle_to_tag[h] = f"@{_TAG_PREFIX[kind]}_{counts[kind]}"
    if not handle_to_tag:
        return prompt

    def _sub(m):
        return handle_to_tag.get(m.group(1).lower(), m.group(0))
    return re.sub(r"@(\w+)", _sub, prompt)


def build_content(prompt: str, refs: list) -> list:
    """content[] = [text] + các *_url part. @tag đã chuẩn hoá vào text."""
    content = [{"type": "text", "text": normalize_tags(prompt, refs)}]
    for ref in (refs or []):
        part = _ref_to_part(ref)
        if part is not None:
            content.append(part)
    return content
