    return {"thread_id": th.id}


class TurnIn(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    conv: str
    message: str
    settings: dict = {}
    images: list = []           # data-URL (vision) tuỳ chọn


@app.post("/thread/{tid}/turn")
async def thread_turn(tid: str, body: TurnIn, request: Request, _: None = Depends(_auth)):
    rt = get_runtime()
    settings = body.settings or {}
    turn_input = rt.build_turn_input(body.message, body.images or [])
    effort = rt.effort_of(settings.get("effort"))

    async def _open_turn():
        try:
            thread = await rt.get_thread(tid, body.user_id, body.conv, settings=settings)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            low = str(e).lower()
            if "rollout" in low or "not found" in low:
                thread = await rt.start_thread(body.user_id, body.conv, settings=settings)
                try:
                    rt._threads[tid] = thread
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
            else:
                raise
        try:
            return await (thread.turn(turn_input, effort=effort) if effort
                          else thread.turn(turn_input))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            rt.evict_thread(tid)
            thread = await rt.resume_thread(tid, body.user_id, body.conv, settings=settings)
            return await (thread.turn(turn_input, effort=effort) if effort
                          else thread.turn(turn_input))

    def _sse(obj) -> str:
        return f"data: {json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n"

    async def gen():
        handle = None
        completed = False
        ws_dir = rt.workspace_for(body.user_id, body.conv)
        try:
            handle = await _open_turn()
            _active_handles[tid] = handle
            failed = None
            async for ev in handle.stream():
                method = getattr(ev, "method", "")
                serialized = _serialize_event(ev)
                yield _sse(serialized)
                pl = serialized.get("payload") or {}
                tu = pl.get("token_usage") or pl.get("tokenUsage")
                if isinstance(tu, dict):
                    tot = tu.get("total") or {}
                    tk = tot.get("total_tokens") or tot.get("totalTokens")
                    inp = tot.get("input_tokens") or tot.get("inputTokens")
                    outp = tot.get("output_tokens") or tot.get("outputTokens")
                    if tk is not None:
                        yield _sse({"method": "tokens", "payload": {
                            "total": tk, "input": inp, "output": outp,
                            "context": tu.get("model_context_window") or tu.get("modelContextWindow")}})
                if method == "item/completed":
                    item = (serialized.get("payload") or {}).get("item") or {}
                    if item.get("type") == "imageGeneration":
                        abspath, name = _persist_image_abs(ws_dir, item)
                        if abspath:
                            yield _sse({"method": "image", "payload": {
                                "abs_path": abspath, "name": name,
                                "prompt": item.get("revised_prompt")
                                or item.get("revisedPrompt") or ""}})
                if method == "turn/completed":
                    turn = getattr(getattr(ev, "payload", None), "turn", None)
                    st = getattr(getattr(turn, "status", None), "value", None) \
                        or getattr(turn, "status", None)
                    if str(st) == "failed":
                        failed = turn
            if failed is None:
                yield _sse({"method": "done"})
                completed = True
            else:
                msg = getattr(getattr(failed, "error", None), "message", "") or "Lượt chạy thất bại"
                yield _sse({"method": "error", "payload": {"message": msg}})
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            log.exception("[sidecar] turn fatal")
            yield _sse({"method": "error", "payload": {"message": str(e)}})
        finally:
            if not completed and handle is not None:
                try:
                    asyncio.create_task(_safe_interrupt(handle))
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
            if _active_handles.get(tid) is handle:
                _active_handles.pop(tid, None)

    return StreamingResponse(gen(), media_type="text/event-stream",
                             headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"})


@app.get("/thread/{tid}/history")
async def thread_history(tid: str, user_id: str, conv: str, _: None = Depends(_auth)):
    rt = get_runtime()
    try:
        thread = await rt.get_thread(tid, user_id, conv, settings={})
        resp = await thread.read(include_turns=True)
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(502, f"Không đọc được lịch sử: {e}")
    d = resp.model_dump(mode="json")
    ws = rt.workspace_for(user_id, conv)
    msgs = []
    for turn in (d.get("thread", {}).get("turns") or []):
        for it in (turn.get("items") or []):
            t = it.get("type")
            if t == "userMessage":
                txt = "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in (it.get("content") or [])
                              if c.get("type") == "text")
                if txt:
                    msgs.append({"role": "user", "text": txt})
            elif t == "agentMessage":
                if it.get("text"):
                    msgs.append({"role": "assistant", "text": it["text"]})
            elif t == "imageGeneration":
                abspath, name = _persist_image_abs(ws, it)
                if abspath:
                    msgs.append({"role": "assistant", "type": "image",
                                 "abs_path": abspath, "name": name,
                                 "text": it.get("revised_prompt") or it.get("revisedPrompt") or ""})
    return {"messages": msgs}

"""
Adaptive backoff strategy mapped to Facebook Graph API error codes.

Why this exists:
  The existing chunk-retry in graph_uploader uses LINEAR backoff (5s, 10s,
  15s). That's fine for transient network errors but wrong for FB's deliberate
  throttling: when you get error 4/17 (rate limit), retrying every 5 s tells
  FB "this bot doesn't listen" → escalates to error 32 (page-suspended) →
  account-level limit. Each FB error code has a recommended cool-down range.

This module maps error → (cooldown_seconds, escalation_level) and exposes a
single helper, get_backoff_for_fb_error(), that the publisher pipeline can
consult to decide how long to wait before the next attempt.

Reference: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/guides/error-handling
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import random
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BackoffPolicy:
    """Result of consulting the FB error code map.

    cooldown_s   — recommended seconds to wait before retrying. Includes a
                   small random jitter to avoid synchronized retries across
                   parallel workers.
    severity     — "transient" | "rate" | "abuse" | "permanent"
    retryable    — False for permanent errors (token revoked etc.). Caller
                   must NOT retry these — escalate to the user.
    notify_user  — True when the user should be told (via Telegram / GUI).
    """
    cooldown_s:   float
    severity:     str
    retryable:    bool
    notify_user:  bool
    description:  str


# Error code → BackoffPolicy. Codes not in the map fall through to the default.
_BACKOFF_MAP: dict[int, BackoffPolicy] = {
    # ─── Permanent / non-retryable ─────────────────────────────────────────
    190: BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                       "Token expired/invalid — user must reconnect"),
    102: BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                       "Session expired — user must reconnect"),
    200: BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                       "Missing scope/permission — user re-grant during OAuth"),
    104: BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                       "Token missing"),
    10:  BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                       "App lacks the required permission"),
    230: BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                       "User blocked the app"),

    # ─── Rate-limit errors (retryable with significant cool-down) ──────────
    # FB rate limits reset every hour on the hour. Use 30 m cool-down so
    # we land safely in the next window with margin.
    4:   BackoffPolicy(1800,  "rate", True, False,
                       "App-level API rate limit (4)"),
    17:  BackoffPolicy(3600,  "rate", True, True,
                       "User-level rate limit (17) — > 1 h cool-down"),
    32:  BackoffPolicy(7200,  "rate", True, True,
                       "Page-level rate limit (32) — page throttled"),
    613: BackoffPolicy(3600,  "rate", True, True,
                       "App-level rate limit (613)"),

    # ─── Abuse / spam markers — long cool-down, alert user ─────────────────
    # 368 = "page suspended for spam". This is the FB signal that says
    # "stop posting to this page right now, we're watching". 24 h is the
    # conservative minimum cool-down recommended by FB community docs.
    368: BackoffPolicy(86400, "abuse", True, True,
                       "PAGE TEMPORARILY BLOCKED (368) — stop for 24 h"),
    322: BackoffPolicy(21600, "abuse", True, True,
                       "Content quality block (322) — 6 h cool-down"),

    # ─── Transient / connectivity (short backoff) ──────────────────────────
    1:   BackoffPolicy(30,    "transient", True, False,
                       "Unknown / transient error (1)"),
    2:   BackoffPolicy(60,    "transient", True, False,
                       "Temporary issue (2)"),
    # HTTP 5xx style — pass them through as transient
    500: BackoffPolicy(120,   "transient", True, False, "FB server error 500"),
    503: BackoffPolicy(180,   "transient", True, False, "FB unavailable 503"),

    # ─── Video-specific errors (mostly permanent — file is bad) ────────────
    100:   BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                         "Invalid parameter (100) — usually wrong video URL/format"),
    6000:  BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                         "Video format not supported (6000)"),
    6001:  BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                         "Video too large (6001)"),
    6002:  BackoffPolicy(0,    "permanent", False, True,
                         "Video corrupt (6002)"),
}


# Default policy used for any error code not explicitly listed.
_DEFAULT = BackoffPolicy(
    cooldown_s=60, severity="transient", retryable=True, notify_user=False,
    description="Unmapped error — default 60 s cool-down",
)


# ─── TikTok error code policies (string codes, not numeric) ─────────────────
# TikTok Content Posting API uses string error codes. Map → policy mirrors
# the FB layout. Used by TikTokPublisher / status_poller via get_backoff_for_tiktok_error.
#
# Reference: https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-reference-errors

_TIKTOK_BACKOFF_MAP: dict[str, BackoffPolicy] = {
    # Permanent / non-retryable
    "access_token_invalid":     BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Token TikTok hết hạn — reconnect"),
    "access_token_expired":     BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Token TikTok expired"),
    "scope_not_authorized":     BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Thiếu scope — reconnect với scope mới"),
    "invalid_param":            BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Param sai — kiểm tra task"),
    "url_ownership_unverified": BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Domain chưa verify trên TT portal"),
    "privacy_level_option_mismatch": BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "App chưa audit — phải dùng SELF_ONLY"),
    "video_pull_failed":        BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "TT không tải được video — check format"),
    "unaudited_client_can_only_post_to_private_accounts": BackoffPolicy(
                                              0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Acc privacy phải private trước khi audit"),
    "auto_cleanup_frame_rate":  BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Frame rate không hỗ trợ"),
    "auto_cleanup_duration":    BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Video duration không hỗ trợ"),
    "auto_cleanup_size":        BackoffPolicy(0, "permanent", False, True,
                                              "Video size không hỗ trợ"),

    # Rate-limit (long cooldown)
    "rate_limit_exceeded":      BackoffPolicy(3600, "rate", True, True,
                                              "TT rate limit — 1h cooldown"),
    "daily_publish_cap_exceeded": BackoffPolicy(86400, "rate", True, True,
                                              "Daily cap acc — 24h cooldown"),

    # Abuse / spam — long + notify
    "spam_risk_text":           BackoffPolicy(21600, "abuse", True, True,
                                              "Caption flagged spam — review content"),
    "spam_risk_user_banned_from_posting": BackoffPolicy(86400, "abuse", True, True,
                                              "User TẠM CẤM POST — 24h cooldown"),
    "spam_risk_too_many_posts": BackoffPolicy(86400, "abuse", True, True,
                                              "Quá nhiều post — 24h cooldown"),

    # Transient (short cooldown)
    "internal_error":           BackoffPolicy(120, "transient", True, False,
                                              "TT internal — short retry"),
    "network_error":            BackoffPolicy(60,  "transient", True, False,
                                              "Network blip"),
    "publish_id_not_found":     BackoffPolicy(60,  "transient", True, False,
                                              "Status poll race — short retry"),
}


def get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(code: str, *, jitter: bool = True) -> BackoffPolicy:
    """Return the backoff policy for a TikTok API error string code.

    Falls back to the default (60 s transient) when *code* isn't recognised.
    Mirrors get_backoff_for_fb_error() for FB so both platforms have parallel
    error-handling semantics.
    """
    key = (code or "").strip().lower()
    p = _TIKTOK_BACKOFF_MAP.get(key, _DEFAULT)
    if jitter and p.cooldown_s > 0:
        factor = random.uniform(0.85, 1.15)
        p = BackoffPolicy(
            cooldown_s   = round(p.cooldown_s * factor, 1),
            severity     = p.severity,
            retryable    = p.retryable,
            notify_user  = p.notify_user,
            description  = p.description,
        )
    return p


def is_tiktok_abuse_signal(code: str) -> bool:
    return get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(code, jitter=False).severity == "abuse"


def is_tiktok_permanent(code: str) -> bool:
    return not get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(code, jitter=False).retryable


def get_backoff_for_fb_error(code: int, *, subcode: int = 0, jitter: bool = True) -> BackoffPolicy:
    """Return the backoff policy for a Facebook Graph error code.

    Falls back to the default (60 s transient) when *code* is not in the map.
    If *jitter* is True (the default), the cooldown is multiplied by a
    random factor in [0.85, 1.15] — anti-synchronization for parallel workers.
    """
    # Subcode lookup first: some errors are disambiguated only via subcode
    # (e.g. 100 / 1366046 = malformed URL specifically). For now we only
    # look up by primary code.
    p = _BACKOFF_MAP.get(int(code), _DEFAULT)
    if jitter and p.cooldown_s > 0:
        factor = random.uniform(0.85, 1.15)
        p = BackoffPolicy(
            cooldown_s   = round(p.cooldown_s * factor, 1),
            severity     = p.severity,
            retryable    = p.retryable,
            notify_user  = p.notify_user,
            description  = p.description,
        )
    return p


def is_rate_limit_error(code: int) -> bool:
    """True if *code* is one of FB's rate-limit responses."""
    return get_backoff_for_fb_error(code, jitter=False).severity == "rate"


def is_abuse_signal(code: int) -> bool:
    """True if *code* indicates FB has flagged the account/page for abuse."""
    return get_backoff_for_fb_error(code, jitter=False).severity == "abuse"


def is_permanent(code: int) -> bool:
    """True if retrying *code* will keep failing without user action."""
    return not get_backoff_for_fb_error(code, jitter=False).retryable

SHA256=5723037657e6039a03a5088f1086d891fee3e11846e81c30f4aca0be082ac4e5 BYTES=9672 LINES=223

"""
Top-level aggregator used by the GUI dashboard (P4.1).

Gathers data from:
  • RateLimiter.get_global_page_metrics()  — per-page upload counts
  • core.circuit_breaker._default          — breaker state per target
  • core.token_health                      — expiry alerts
  • core.rate_tuner.parse_audit_log        — recent activity
  • core.content_history.get_default_store — total recorded posts

Returns a single dataclass that the Monitor tab renders as a card.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class AntiSpamSnapshot:
    """Snapshot of every anti-spam signal for the GUI."""
    # Token health
    n_critical_tokens:   int   = 0
    n_warn_tokens:       int   = 0
    token_messages:      list  = field(default_factory=list)

    # Circuit breaker
    open_breakers:       list  = field(default_factory=list)   # [(target, seconds_remaining)]
    halfopen_breakers:   list  = field(default_factory=list)

    # Activity (last 7 days from audit log)
    total_attempts_7d:   int   = 0
    total_successes_7d:  int   = 0
    success_rate_7d:     float = 0.0
    targets_with_abuse:  list  = field(default_factory=list)
    targets_with_rate:   list  = field(default_factory=list)

    # Content history
    total_content_records: int = 0

    # Recommendations
    recommendations:     list  = field(default_factory=list)   # list of TunerRecommendation

    # GAP-5: Page health (reach throttle detection)
    page_health_warnings: list = field(default_factory=list)   # list[PageHealthReport.message]
    n_pages_throttled:    int  = 0
    n_pages_dead:         int  = 0

    # GAP-5: Time-of-day intelligence
    time_intel_warnings:  list = field(default_factory=list)
    n_bot_flat_targets:   int  = 0

    # Round 2.2 — Phase 5 signals
    meta_app_status:        str  = ""    # "ok" | "disabled" | "suspended" | "unknown"
    meta_app_message:       str  = ""
    meta_app_pool_healthy:  int  = 0    # number of healthy apps in rotation
    meta_app_pool_total:    int  = 0

    # Sprint TT-2.3 — TikTok signals (parallel to FB)
    tiktok_app_status:        str = ""
    tiktok_app_message:       str = ""
    tiktok_client_pool_healthy: int = 0
    tiktok_client_pool_total:   int = 0


def collect_snapshot(current_config: dict) -> AntiSpamSnapshot:
    """Build a fresh AntiSpamSnapshot — safe to call from the GUI thread.
    All sub-systems return empty defaults on failure rather than raising."""
    snap = AntiSpamSnapshot()

    # ── Token health ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        from core.token_health import (
            TokenHealthLevel,
            all_facebook_reports, all_tiktok_reports,
        )
        for r in all_facebook_reports() + all_tiktok_reports():
            if r.level in (TokenHealthLevel.CRITICAL, TokenHealthLevel.EXPIRED):
                snap.n_critical_tokens += 1
                snap.token_messages.append(r.message)
            elif r.level is TokenHealthLevel.WARN:
                snap.n_warn_tokens += 1
                snap.token_messages.append(r.message)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # ── Circuit breaker ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        from core.circuit_breaker import _default as _cb_singleton
        if _cb_singleton is not None:
            for key, s in _cb_singleton._by_key.items():
                if s.state.value == "open":
                    snap.open_breakers.append(
                        (key, _cb_singleton.seconds_until_allowed(key))
                    )
                elif s.state.value == "half_open":
                    snap.halfopen_breakers.append(key)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # ── Activity (last 7 days) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        from core.rate_tuner import (
            health_summary, parse_audit_log, recommend_adjustments,
        )
        stats = parse_audit_log(within_days=7)
        sm = health_summary(stats)
        snap.total_attempts_7d  = sm["total_attempts"]
        snap.total_successes_7d = sm["successes"]
        snap.success_rate_7d    = sm["success_rate"]
        snap.targets_with_abuse = sm["targets_with_abuse_signal"]
        snap.targets_with_rate  = sm["targets_with_rate_limit_hit"]
        # Adjustments
        snap.recommendations = recommend_adjustments(stats, current_config)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # ── Content history total ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        from core.content_history import get_default_store
        snap.total_content_records = get_default_store().total_count()
    except Exception:
        pass

    # ── Page health (GAP-5) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Iterates pages in the FB token store and asks page_health for each.
    # Silent on absence: empty list when no token store / no reach samples.
    try:
        from core.page_health import all_page_reports, PageHealthLevel
        for r in all_page_reports():
            if r.level is PageHealthLevel.THROTTLED:
                snap.n_pages_throttled += 1
                snap.page_health_warnings.append(r.message)
            elif r.level is PageHealthLevel.DEAD:
                snap.n_pages_dead += 1
                snap.page_health_warnings.append(r.message)
            elif r.level is PageHealthLevel.SUSPECTED:
                snap.page_health_warnings.append(r.message)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # ── Meta App status + pool health (Round 2.2) ───────────────────────────
    try:
        from core.app_status import check_app_status, AppStatus
        report = check_app_status(current_config)
        snap.meta_app_status  = report.status.value
        snap.meta_app_message = report.message
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from core.multi_app import MetaAppPool
        pool = MetaAppPool.from_config(current_config)
        snap.meta_app_pool_total   = len(pool.records)
        snap.meta_app_pool_healthy = pool.healthy_count()
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Sprint TT-2.3 — TikTok app status + client pool
    try:
        from core.app_status import check_tiktok_app_status
        tt_report = check_tiktok_app_status(current_config)
        snap.tiktok_app_status  = tt_report.status.value
        snap.tiktok_app_message = tt_report.message
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from core.tiktok.multi_client import TikTokClientPool
        tt_pool = TikTokClientPool.from_config(current_config)
        snap.tiktok_client_pool_total   = len(tt_pool.records)
        snap.tiktok_client_pool_healthy = tt_pool.healthy_count()
    except Exception:
        pass

    # ── Time-of-day intelligence (GAP-3) ─────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        from core.time_intel import build_distributions, health_warnings
        tz_offset = 7
        try:
            from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
            from datetime import datetime as _dt
            tz_offset = int(_dt.now(ZoneInfo(
                current_config.get("timezone", "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")
            )).utcoffset().total_seconds() / 3600)
        except Exception:
            pass
        dists = build_distributions(within_days=30, timezone_offset_hours=tz_offset)
        warns = health_warnings(dists)
        snap.time_intel_warnings = warns
        snap.n_bot_flat_targets  = sum(
            1 for d in dists.values() if d.is_bot_flat()
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return snap


def format_oneline(snap: AntiSpamSnapshot) -> str:
    """Single-line status for the Monitor header."""
    parts = []
    if snap.meta_app_status in ("disabled", "suspended"):
        parts.append(f"☠️ Meta App {snap.meta_app_status.upper()}")
    if snap.n_critical_tokens > 0:
        parts.append(f"🔴 {snap.n_critical_tokens} token critical")
    if snap.n_pages_dead > 0:
        parts.append(f"☠️ {snap.n_pages_dead} page DEAD")
    if snap.n_pages_throttled > 0:
        parts.append(f"🔻 {snap.n_pages_throttled} page throttled")
    if snap.open_breakers:
        parts.append(f"⏸ {len(snap.open_breakers)} breaker OPEN")
    if snap.targets_with_abuse:
        parts.append(f"🚨 {len(snap.targets_with_abuse)} abuse signal")
    if snap.n_bot_flat_targets > 0:
        parts.append(f"🤖 {snap.n_bot_flat_targets} bot-flat pattern")
    if snap.meta_app_pool_total > 1 and snap.meta_app_pool_healthy == 0:
        parts.append("🚫 multi-app pool: 0 healthy")
    if snap.tiktok_app_status in ("disabled", "suspended"):
        parts.append(f"☠️ TT App {snap.tiktok_app_status.upper()}")
    if snap.tiktok_client_pool_total > 1 and snap.tiktok_client_pool_healthy == 0:
        parts.append("🚫 TT client pool: 0 healthy")
    if not parts:
        return f"✅ Anti-Spam OK ({snap.success_rate_7d*100:.0f}% success last 7d)"
    return " · ".join(parts)

"""
Meta App status monitor (Sprint B3).

Why this exists:
  If your Meta App gets disabled (TOS violation, app review fails, billing
  issue) you'll start getting cryptic 400/403 errors. Without a status
  check, the bot keeps retrying and burns through every account it has.
  Detecting "app disabled" → halt all uploads → notify user is a 30-line
  fix that saves hours of debugging.

This module exposes:
  • check_app_status(config) → AppStatusReport
  • is_app_disabled(report) → bool

It tries a cheap, side-effect-free call against the Graph API and
classifies the response. Designed to run periodically (every hour from
the MaintenanceDaemon).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional


class AppStatus(Enum):
    OK              = "ok"            # App responding normally
    DISABLED        = "disabled"      # App has been disabled by Meta
    SUSPENDED       = "suspended"     # Temporary suspension (still might recover)
    UNKNOWN         = "unknown"       # Couldn't determine (network down, etc.)
    NOT_CONFIGURED  = "not_configured" # Missing app_id / app_secret


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppStatusReport:
    """Result of one health probe against the Meta App."""
    app_id:      str
    status:      AppStatus
    error_code:  str
    message:     str
    checked_at:  str


def check_app_status(config: dict) -> AppStatusReport:
    """Probe Graph API with the app token to detect disabled/suspended state.

    The cheapest possible call is `GET /{app_id}?fields=name` with an
    APP access token (app_id|app_secret). It returns app metadata when
    healthy, and a specific error code when disabled.
    """
    app_id     = str(config.get("meta_app_id",     "")).strip()
    app_secret = str(config.get("meta_app_secret", "")).strip()
    now_iso    = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    if not app_id or not app_secret:
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=app_id, status=AppStatus.NOT_CONFIGURED,
            error_code="missing_credentials",
            message="meta_app_id hoặc meta_app_secret chưa cấu hình",
            checked_at=now_iso,
        )

    try:
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        from core.utils import graph_api_version
        client = GraphClient(version=graph_api_version(config), timeout=10, max_retries=0)
        app_token = f"{app_id}|{app_secret}"   # standard FB app-access-token format
        resp = client.get(app_id, params={"fields": "name,namespace"}, token=app_token)
        if resp.get("name"):
            return AppStatusReport(
                app_id=app_id, status=AppStatus.OK, error_code="",
                message=f"App '{resp.get('name')}' đang hoạt động bình thường",
                checked_at=now_iso,
            )
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=app_id, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN, error_code="",
            message="Phản hồi không có 'name' field — không rõ trạng thái",
            checked_at=now_iso,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return _classify_error(exc, app_id, now_iso)


def _classify_error(exc: Exception, app_id: str, now_iso: str) -> AppStatusReport:
    """Map exception → AppStatus. The interesting case is Graph error codes."""
    code     = str(getattr(exc, "code", "") or "")
    subcode  = str(getattr(exc, "subcode", "") or "")
    message  = str(exc)[:300]

    # Documented disabled-app codes:
    #   190: token errors (often disabled app)
    #   368: app suspension for spam
    #   200: missing perm — likely app review revoked
    #   459: app blocked
    if code in ("190", "200", "459"):
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=app_id, status=AppStatus.DISABLED,
            error_code=code, message=message, checked_at=now_iso,
        )
    if code in ("368", "322"):
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=app_id, status=AppStatus.SUSPENDED,
            error_code=code, message=message, checked_at=now_iso,
        )

    # Network / unknown
    return AppStatusReport(
        app_id=app_id, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN,
        error_code=code or type(exc).__name__,
        message=message, checked_at=now_iso,
    )


def is_app_disabled(report: AppStatusReport) -> bool:
    """Convenience predicate. DISABLED or SUSPENDED → bot should halt."""
    return report.status in (AppStatus.DISABLED, AppStatus.SUSPENDED)


# ─── TikTok app status probe (Sprint TT-1.5) ─────────────────────────────────

def check_tiktok_app_status(config: dict) -> AppStatusReport:
    """Probe TikTok client credentials by requesting a client_credentials
    token. A healthy app returns an access_token; a disabled app returns
    a documented error.

    Endpoint: POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/oauth/token/
    Auth:     client_id + client_secret in body
    """
    import time as _time
    import requests as _requests

    now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    # Pick the first healthy client from the pool, falling back to legacy keys
    try:
        from core.tiktok.multi_client import TikTokClientPool
        pool = TikTokClientPool.from_config(config)
        rec  = pool.next_healthy()
        if rec is not None:
            client_key, client_secret = rec.client_key, rec.client_secret
        else:
            client_key    = str(config.get("tiktok_client_key", "")).strip()
            client_secret = str(config.get("tiktok_client_secret", "")).strip()
    except Exception:
        client_key    = str(config.get("tiktok_client_key", "")).strip()
        client_secret = str(config.get("tiktok_client_secret", "")).strip()

    if not client_key or not client_secret:
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.NOT_CONFIGURED,
            error_code="missing_credentials",
            message="TikTok client_key hoặc client_secret chưa cấu hình",
            checked_at=now_iso,
        )

    try:
        url  = "https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/oauth/token/"
        # TikTok's docs accept form-encoded body for client_credentials.
        body = {
            "client_key":    client_key,
            "client_secret": client_secret,
            "grant_type":    "client_credentials",
        }
        resp = _requests.post(
            url, data=body,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
            timeout=10,
        )
        # Healthy: HTTP 200 + access_token field
        if resp.status_code == 200:
            try:
                j = resp.json()
            except Exception:
                j = {}
            if j.get("access_token"):
                return AppStatusReport(
                    app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.OK, error_code="",
                    message="TT client_credentials grant OK",
                    checked_at=now_iso,
                )
            # 200 without token → server confused, treat unknown
            return AppStatusReport(
                app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN,
                error_code="no_token_in_200",
                message=f"200 OK nhưng không có token: {str(j)[:200]}",
                checked_at=now_iso,
            )

        # Documented error codes:
        #   400 invalid_request / invalid_client → app disabled or key wrong
        #   401 unauthorized → key revoked
        #   403 forbidden → app suspended
        try:
            err_json = resp.json()
            err_code = str(err_json.get("error", "")) or str(err_json.get("error_code", ""))
            err_desc = str(err_json.get("error_description", ""))[:200]
        except Exception:
            err_code = f"http_{resp.status_code}"
            err_desc = resp.text[:200]

        if resp.status_code in (401, 403) or err_code in ("invalid_client", "unauthorized_client"):
            return AppStatusReport(
                app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.DISABLED,
                error_code=err_code, message=err_desc, checked_at=now_iso,
            )
        if resp.status_code == 400 and err_code in ("invalid_request",):
            # Could be wrong credentials or rate limit
            return AppStatusReport(
                app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN,
                error_code=err_code, message=err_desc, checked_at=now_iso,
            )
        # Fall-through: treat unknown HTTP status as suspended (defensive)
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN,
            error_code=err_code or f"http_{resp.status_code}",
            message=err_desc, checked_at=now_iso,
        )
    except _requests.RequestException as exc:
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN,
            error_code="network_error", message=str(exc)[:200],
            checked_at=now_iso,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return AppStatusReport(
            app_id=client_key, status=AppStatus.UNKNOWN,
            error_code=type(exc).__name__, message=str(exc)[:200],
            checked_at=now_iso,
        )

"""
core/auth_manager.py — Facebook OAuth2 + token lifecycle.

The OAuth flow is split so the web app can drive it across two HTTP requests:

    build_authorize_url(redirect_uri, state)  -> where to send the operator
    complete_oauth(code, redirect_uri)        -> code to a saved AccountInfo

The provider redirects back to the app itself
(`/oauth/facebook/callback`, see server/routes/oauth.py). There is no local
callback server: the earlier desktop build opened a browser on the bot's own
machine and bound localhost:8765, neither of which is possible on a server.
`state` and single-use/TTL enforcement live in server/services/oauth_service.py.

`import_system_user_token` is the other way in, and needs no browser at all.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Callable, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from core.graph_client import GraphClient, GraphError
from core.token_store import AccountInfo, PageInfo, TokenStore

# Facebook OAuth scopes
_SCOPES = ",".join([
    "pages_show_list",
    "pages_manage_posts",
    "pages_read_engagement",
])

class AuthManager:
    """
    Manages Facebook OAuth2 flow and token lifecycle.
    Cheap to construct; the web app makes one per request.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: dict, token_store: Optional[TokenStore] = None):
        # Round 1.5: pool-aware OAuth. When meta_app_pool is configured,
        # pick the next healthy app; otherwise fall back to legacy single-app
        # config keys (meta_app_id / meta_app_secret).
        self._config = dict(config)
        try:
            from core.multi_app import MetaAppPool
            self._app_pool = MetaAppPool.from_config(config)
            chosen = self._app_pool.next_healthy()
        except Exception:
            self._app_pool = None
            chosen = None

        if chosen is not None:
            self.app_id       = chosen.app_id
            self.app_secret   = chosen.app_secret
            self.redirect_uri = chosen.redirect_uri or str(config.get("meta_redirect_uri", "")).strip()
        else:
            self.app_id     = str(config.get("meta_app_id", "")).strip()
            self.app_secret = str(config.get("meta_app_secret", "")).strip()
            # Must be the app's own HTTPS callback, registered at Meta.
            # server/services/oauth_service.py validates it before use.
            self.redirect_uri = str(config.get("meta_redirect_uri", "")).strip()

        self.api_version = str(config.get("graph_api_version", "v21.0")).strip() or "v21.0"
        self.token_store = token_store or TokenStore()
        self._client     = GraphClient(version=self.api_version)

    # ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def update_config(self, config: dict):
        """Hot-update credentials without recreating the object."""
        self.app_id     = str(config.get("meta_app_id", "")).strip()
        self.app_secret = str(config.get("meta_app_secret", "")).strip()
        self.api_version = str(config.get("graph_api_version", "v21.0")).strip() or "v21.0"
        self.redirect_uri = str(config.get("meta_redirect_uri", "")).strip()
        self._client    = GraphClient(version=self.api_version)

    def is_configured(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.app_id and self.app_secret)

    # ── OAuth flow ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    #
    # Two halves with the browser round-trip in between. Neither opens a
    # browser nor binds a port, so the web app drives them from two separate
    # HTTP requests.

    def build_authorize_url(self, redirect_uri: str, state: str) -> str:
        """The Facebook login dialog URL.

        Every value is percent-encoded. An earlier build interpolated raw,
        which worked only because the scope list and a localhost URI contain
        no characters needing escapes; an HTTPS redirect_uri carrying a query
        string would have silently truncated the URL.
        """
        if not self.is_configured():
            raise ValueError(
                "Chưa cấu hình Meta App ID / Secret.\n"
                "Vào trang Cài đặt → mục 'Meta App (Facebook Login)' để nhập."
            )
        query = urlencode({
            "client_id":     self.app_id,
            "redirect_uri":  redirect_uri,
            "scope":         _SCOPES,
            "response_type": "code",
            "state":         state,
        })
        return f"https://www.facebook.com/{self.api_version}/dialog/oauth?{query}"

    def complete_oauth(
        self,
        code: str,
        redirect_uri: str,
        on_status: Callable[[str], None] = None,
    ) -> AccountInfo:
        """Code -> long-lived token -> user -> pages -> saved AccountInfo.

        `redirect_uri` must be byte-identical to the one used to obtain the
        code; Facebook rejects the exchange otherwise.
        """
        log = on_status or (lambda m: None)

        # ── Exchange code → short-lived token ──────────────────────────────
        log("Đang lấy Access Token...")
        resp = self._client.get("oauth/access_token", params={
            "client_id":     self.app_id,
            "redirect_uri":  redirect_uri,
            "client_secret": self.app_secret,
            "code":          code,
        })
        short_token = resp.get("access_token", "")
        if not short_token:
            raise RuntimeError("Không lấy được access_token từ Facebook")

        # ── Exchange short → long-lived (60 days) ──────────────────────────
        log("Đang đổi sang Long-Lived Token (60 ngày)...")
        long_token, expires_in = self._client.exchange_short_for_long(
            self.app_id, self.app_secret, short_token
        )
        expires_at = (datetime.now() + timedelta(seconds=expires_in)).isoformat()

        # ── Fetch user info ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        log("Đang lấy thông tin tài khoản...")
        user_info  = self._client.get_user_info(long_token)
        fb_user_id = str(user_info.get("id", ""))
        name       = str(user_info.get("name", "Tài khoản FB"))
        if not fb_user_id:
            raise RuntimeError("Không lấy được User ID từ Facebook")

        # ── Fetch pages ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        log("Đang lấy danh sách Pages...")
        pages_raw = self._client.get_pages(long_token)
        pages: list[PageInfo] = []
        for p in pages_raw:
            pic_url = ""
            pic = p.get("picture", {})
            if isinstance(pic, dict):
                pic_url = pic.get("data", {}).get("url", "")
            pages.append(PageInfo(
                id            = str(p.get("id", "")),
                name          = str(p.get("name", "")),
                access_token  = str(p.get("access_token", "")),
                category      = str(p.get("category", "")),
                picture_url   = pic_url,
                selected      = True,
            ))

        # ── Build & save AccountInfo ───────────────────────────────────────
        account = AccountInfo(
            fb_user_id       = fb_user_id,
            name             = name,
            user_token       = long_token,
            token_expires_at = expires_at,
            pages            = [pg.to_dict() for pg in pages],
            connected_at     = datetime.now().isoformat(),
        )
        self.token_store.save_account(account)

        log(f"✅ Kết nối thành công: {name} — {len(pages)} page")
        return account

    # ── System User token (Business Manager) ───────────────────────────────

    @staticmethod
    def _sanitize_token(raw: str) -> str:
        """Clean a pasted token: strip quotes, common prefixes, wrapped newlines.

        Users frequently paste `"EAAB..."`, `access_token=EAAB...`, or a token
        that copy-wrapped across lines. FB tokens contain no whitespace, so we
        can safely collapse all internal whitespace after removing prefixes.
        """
        t = (raw or "").strip()
        if len(t) >= 2 and t[0] in "\"'" and t[-1] == t[0]:
            t = t[1:-1].strip()
        for prefix in ("access_token=", "Bearer ", "OAuth ", "token="):
            if t.lower().startswith(prefix.lower()):
                t = t[len(prefix):].strip()
                break
        return "".join(t.split())

    def import_system_user_token(
        self,
        token: str,
        on_status: Callable[[str], None] = None,
    ) -> AccountInfo:
        """
        Import a Business Manager **System User** access token (dán thủ công).

        Khác OAuth: không cần trình duyệt. Token thường là long-lived hoặc
        không hết hạn (never-expiring). Luồng:
          1. GET /me                → id + tên System User
          2. GET /debug_token       → dò hạn thật (expires_at == 0 ⇒ vĩnh viễn)
          3. GET /me/accounts       → danh sách Page + Page Access Token riêng
          4. Lưu AccountInfo(is_system_user=True) vào TokenStore (mã hoá)

        Raise nếu token sai / không có Page nào được gán.
        """
        log = on_status or (lambda m: None)
        token = self._sanitize_token(token)
        if not token:
            raise ValueError("Token rỗng — hãy dán System User token.")

        # 1. Chủ sở hữu token
        log("Đang kiểm tra token...")
        try:
            user_info = self._client.get_user_info(token)
        except GraphError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Token không hợp lệ hoặc đã bị thu hồi: {exc}"
            ) from exc
        uid  = str(user_info.get("id", ""))
        name = str(user_info.get("name", "") or "System User")
        if not uid:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Token không hợp lệ — không lấy được ID (kiểm tra lại chuỗi token)."
            )

        # 2. Dò hạn thật qua debug_token (cần app access token = app_id|app_secret)
        expires_at = ""   # "" = vĩnh viễn (never expires)
        try:
            if self.app_id and self.app_secret:
                app_token = f"{self.app_id}|{self.app_secret}"
                dbg = self._client.get(
                    "debug_token",
                    params={"input_token": token},
                    token=app_token,
                )
                data = dbg.get("data", {}) or {}
                exp = int(data.get("expires_at", 0) or 0)
                if exp > 0:
                    expires_at = datetime.fromtimestamp(exp).isoformat()
                # exp == 0 → không hết hạn → giữ ""
        except Exception:
            # Không nghiêm trọng: coi như vĩnh viễn. Refresher vốn bỏ qua
            # System User nên sẽ không cố refresh nhầm.
            pass

        # 3. Lấy Pages (mỗi Page có Page Access Token long-lived riêng)
        log("Đang lấy danh sách Pages...")
        pages_raw = self._client.get_pages(token)
        if not pages_raw:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Token hợp lệ nhưng không thấy Page nào.\n"
                "Kiểm tra: System User đã được gán Page trong "
                "Business Settings → Người dùng hệ thống → Chỉ định tài sản chưa?"
            )

        # W1 fix — preserve the user's page-selection when re-importing (the
        # "add pages later" flow): pages previously unticked stay unticked.
        prior = self.token_store.get_account(uid)
        prior_selected = (
            {p.id: p.selected for p in prior.get_pages_list()} if prior else {}
        )

        pages: list[PageInfo] = []
        skipped: list[str] = []          # W2 — pages without a usable token
        for p in pages_raw:
            pid   = str(p.get("id", ""))
            pname = str(p.get("name", "") or pid)
            ptok  = str(p.get("access_token", "") or "")
            # W2 fix — a page with no Page Access Token can't be posted to: the
            # System User was assigned the page but NOT full control / content
            # permission. Storing it would only surface a cryptic error later.
            if not ptok:
                skipped.append(pname)
                continue
            pic_url = ""
            pic = p.get("picture", {})
            if isinstance(pic, dict):
                pic_url = pic.get("data", {}).get("url", "")
            pages.append(PageInfo(
                id           = pid,
                name         = pname,
                access_token = ptok,
                category     = str(p.get("category", "")),
                picture_url  = pic_url,
                selected     = prior_selected.get(pid, True),
            ))

        if not pages:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Token hợp lệ nhưng KHÔNG page nào có quyền đăng.\n"
                "Vào Business Settings → Người dùng hệ thống → Chỉ định tài sản, "
                "gán Page cho System User với quyền 'Toàn quyền' (Quản lý Trang)."
            )
        if skipped:
            log(
                f"⚠ Bỏ qua {len(skipped)} page thiếu quyền đăng "
                f"(chưa cấp Toàn quyền): {', '.join(skipped[:5])}"
                + (" ..." if len(skipped) > 5 else "")
            )

        account = AccountInfo(
            fb_user_id       = uid,
            name             = f"{name} (BM)",
            user_token       = token,
            token_expires_at = expires_at,
            pages            = [pg.to_dict() for pg in pages],
            connected_at     = datetime.now().isoformat(),
            is_system_user   = True,
        )
        self.token_store.save_account(account)

        msg = f"✅ Đã nhập token: {name} — {len(pages)} page sẵn sàng đăng"
        if skipped:
            msg += f" ({len(skipped)} page bị bỏ qua)"
        log(msg)
        return account

    # ── Token test & refresh ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    def test_token(self, account: AccountInfo) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        """Test if the account's user token is still valid."""
        try:
            info = self._client.get_user_info(account.user_token)
            return True, f"OK — {info.get('name', '?')}"
        except GraphError as exc:
            if exc.is_token_error():
                return False, f"Token hết hạn — cần làm mới ({exc})"
            return False, f"Lỗi API: {exc}"
        except Exception as exc:
            return False, f"Lỗi kết nối: {exc}"

    def revoke_account(self, fb_user_id: str):
        """Remove account from local TokenStore."""
        self.token_store.delete_account(fb_user_id)

    # ── Public helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @property
    def token_store_ref(self) -> TokenStore:
        return self.token_store

"""
Caption auto-rotation engine (Sprint A1).

Why this exists:
  Uploading the same video to 20 pages with identical captions = textbook
  page-farm signal. FB's text-similarity model flags duplicate captions
  even when videos differ slightly. The fix is content-side variation —
  generate a unique caption for each upload from a small template grammar.

Strategy: token-rotation grammar
  Each caption template is a string with {variable} placeholders. The
  rotator picks a value from the corresponding word-pool for each var,
  using a stable PRNG seeded on (target_id, video_hash, day) so reposts
  to the same target on the same day produce the SAME caption (idempotent),
  while different targets / different videos get different captions.

Example template:
    "{greeting} {emoji_open} Xem video mới {topic_phrase} {emoji_close}
     #{hashtag_main} #{hashtag_secondary}"

Pool entries are user-supplied via config or default pool.

This module is OFFLINE — no API calls. Safe to invoke from sheet_runner
right before publish.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import random
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional


# ─── Default pools ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Conservative, neutral Vietnamese-leaning pools. Power users override via
# config["caption_rotator_pools"] = {"greeting": [...], ...}.

_DEFAULT_POOLS: dict[str, list[str]] = {
    "greeting":     ["Chào bạn", "Hi cả nhà", "Xin chào",
                     "Hello mọi người", "Hôm nay rồi"],
    "emoji_open":   ["🌟", "✨", "🔥", "💫", "⭐", "🌸", "🎉", "👀"],
    "emoji_close":  ["💖", "🙌", "👇", "🎬", "📌", "✅", "💯"],
    "cta":          ["Đừng quên like + share nhé!", "Bấm theo dõi để xem nhiều hơn",
                     "Để lại 1 ❤ nếu bạn thích", "Chia sẻ cho bạn bè cùng xem",
                     "Comment ý kiến của bạn 👇"],
    "transition":   ["Đặc biệt là", "Đáng chú ý nhất", "Phải nói rằng",
                     "Thú vị nhất là", "Ấn tượng nhất"],
    "filler":       ["nhé", "nha", "ạ", "đó", "luôn"],
}


@dataclass
class CaptionRotationConfig:
    """Settings consumed by CaptionRotator."""
    pools:           dict[str, list[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    templates:       list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    keep_original:   bool = True   # If True, original caption is one of the templates

    @classmethod
    def from_app_config(cls, config: dict) -> "CaptionRotationConfig":
        """Build from the global config dict."""
        return cls(
            pools         = dict(_DEFAULT_POOLS,
                                  **(config.get("caption_rotator_pools", {}) or {})),
            templates     = list(config.get("caption_rotator_templates", []) or []),
            keep_original = bool(config.get("caption_rotator_keep_original", True)),
        )


class CaptionRotator:
    """Produces deterministic per-(target,video,day) caption variants.

    Determinism matters: if a row is retried, we must produce the SAME
    caption — otherwise the second attempt looks like a new post even
    though it's a retry, and FB's dedup would flag it.
    """

    _VAR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\{(\w+)\}")

    def __init__(self, cfg: Optional[CaptionRotationConfig] = None):
        self.cfg = cfg or CaptionRotationConfig(pools=dict(_DEFAULT_POOLS))

    def variant_for(
        self,
        original_caption: str,
        *,
        target_id:  str,
        video_hash: str = "",
        day_key:    str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """Return a varied caption for this (target, video, day) tuple.

        If no templates configured and keep_original=True → return original
        unchanged. If templates available → pick one deterministically and
        fill {var} placeholders from pools.
        """
        if day_key == "":
            day_key = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        # Choose a template — if keep_original, the original itself is in
        # the pool of choices so unchanged-text is one of the possible outputs.
        candidates = list(self.cfg.templates or [])
        if self.cfg.keep_original and original_caption.strip():
            candidates.append(original_caption)
        if not candidates:
            return original_caption

        rng = self._rng_for(target_id, video_hash, day_key)
        template = rng.choice(candidates)

        # Fill placeholders with deterministic picks from pools.
        # Special placeholder: {body} → injects the user-provided original_caption.
        # This lets templates *wrap* the user's caption with rotating intro/cta/hashtags
        # rather than *replacing* it. Pool entry named "body" takes precedence if
        # explicitly configured (advanced override).
        def replace(match):
            name = match.group(1)
            if name == "body" and "body" not in self.cfg.pools:
                # Auto-inject the caller's original caption when template uses {body}
                return original_caption
            pool = self.cfg.pools.get(name, [])
            if not pool:
                return match.group(0)   # leave unfilled {var}
            # Sub-rng to keep variable picks stable across multiple {var}
            return rng.choice(pool)

        return self._VAR_PATTERN.sub(replace, template)

    def _rng_for(self, target_id: str, video_hash: str, day_key: str) -> random.Random:
        seed_str = f"{target_id}|{video_hash}|{day_key}"
        h = hashlib.sha256(seed_str.encode("utf-8")).digest()
        seed = int.from_bytes(h[:8], "big")
        return random.Random(seed)

    # ── Sanity: caption text similarity check (used for cross-target warn) ──

    @staticmethod
    def similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:
        """Cheap Jaccard similarity on token sets (lower-case, alpha only).

        Returns a value in [0.0, 1.0]. 1.0 = identical, 0.0 = no overlap.
        Useful to flag captions that are "too similar across targets".
        """
        toks_a = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-ZÀ-ỹ]+", (a or "").lower()))
        toks_b = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-ZÀ-ỹ]+", (b or "").lower()))
        if not toks_a or not toks_b:
            return 0.0
        inter = toks_a & toks_b
        union = toks_a | toks_b
        return len(inter) / len(union)

"""
Rolling-window error-rate circuit breaker.

Purpose:
  Detect a sustained spike of failed publishes — usually a sign that Facebook
  is actively throttling the account — and AUTO-PAUSE further work until the
  storm passes. Pulling the brake fast is the difference between a "soft
  warning" period (where FB watches but doesn't ban) and a "hard limit"
  (where the account loses posting privileges for days).

Triggers (configurable, OR-combined):
  • >= MIN_SAMPLES events in window
  • AND failure_rate >= FAIL_RATE_THRESHOLD
  • OR last K events were all failures

Action:
  • State transitions: closed → open → half-open → closed
  • In OPEN state, allow_attempt() returns False until cooldown expires.
  • HALF_OPEN: lets exactly 1 attempt through to probe recovery.

Thread-safe. Per-key (use platform or account_id as the key).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional


class BreakerState(Enum):
    CLOSED    = "closed"      # normal — attempts allowed
    OPEN      = "open"        # paused — attempts blocked
    HALF_OPEN = "half_open"   # probing — 1 attempt allowed


@dataclass
class _BreakerStats:
    """Per-key rolling event log."""
    events:        collections.deque = field(default_factory=lambda: collections.deque(maxlen=50))
    state:         BreakerState  = BreakerState.CLOSED
    opened_at:     float         = 0.0
    cooldown_s:    float         = 0.0
    consecutive_failures: int    = 0


class CircuitBreaker:
    """
    Per-key error-rate breaker. The key is typically platform name or
    account_id; the breaker is independent for each so a bad FB account
    doesn't stop a healthy TikTok upload pipeline.

    Usage:
        cb = CircuitBreaker()

        if not cb.allow("acc_X"):
            log("Breaker open — skipping")
            return

        try:
            do_upload(...)
            cb.record_success("acc_X")
        except Exception:
            cb.record_failure("acc_X")
            raise
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        window_size:           int   = 20,
        fail_rate_threshold:   float = 0.40,    # 40% fails → trip
        min_samples_to_trip:   int   = 5,
        consecutive_fails_trip: int  = 3,
        initial_cooldown_s:    float = 600,     # 10 min first trip
        max_cooldown_s:        float = 14400,   # 4 h cap
        cooldown_multiplier:   float = 2.0,     # exponential per re-trip
    ):
        self.window_size            = max(1, window_size)
        self.fail_rate_threshold    = max(0.0, min(1.0, fail_rate_threshold))
        self.min_samples_to_trip    = max(1, min_samples_to_trip)
        self.consecutive_fails_trip = max(1, consecutive_fails_trip)
        # Floor at 0.01 so tests can simulate fast cooldowns; production values
        # come from settings (default 600 s) so the floor is never hit in real use.
        self.initial_cooldown_s     = max(0.01, initial_cooldown_s)
        self.max_cooldown_s         = max(self.initial_cooldown_s, max_cooldown_s)
        self.cooldown_multiplier    = max(1.0, cooldown_multiplier)

        self._lock: threading.Lock = threading.Lock()
        self._by_key: dict[str, _BreakerStats] = {}

    # ── Public: pre-attempt check ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    def allow(self, key: str) -> bool:
        """Return True if an attempt for *key* should proceed.
        Side effect: may transition OPEN → HALF_OPEN when cooldown expires.
        """
        now = time.time()
        with self._lock:
            s = self._stats(key)
            if s.state is BreakerState.CLOSED:
                return True
            if s.state is BreakerState.OPEN:
                # Cooldown elapsed? → probe with HALF_OPEN
                if now - s.opened_at >= s.cooldown_s:
                    s.state = BreakerState.HALF_OPEN
                    return True
                return False
            # HALF_OPEN: only one probe allowed; flip back to OPEN until result
            s.state = BreakerState.OPEN
            return True

    def seconds_until_allowed(self, key: str) -> float:
        """How many seconds remain in the current OPEN cooldown."""
        with self._lock:
            s = self._stats(key)
            if s.state is BreakerState.CLOSED:
                return 0.0
            remain = (s.opened_at + s.cooldown_s) - time.time()
            return max(0.0, remain)

    def state(self, key: str) -> str:
        with self._lock:
            return self._stats(key).state.value

    # ── Public: record outcomes ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    def record_success(self, key: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            s = self._stats(key)
            s.events.append(("ok", time.time()))
            s.consecutive_failures = 0
            # Success in HALF_OPEN → recovery confirmed → CLOSED + reset cooldown
            if s.state is BreakerState.HALF_OPEN:
                s.state = BreakerState.CLOSED
                s.cooldown_s = 0.0

    def record_failure(self, key: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            s = self._stats(key)
            s.events.append(("fail", time.time()))
            s.consecutive_failures += 1
            # Failure in HALF_OPEN → still broken → back to OPEN with longer cooldown
            if s.state is BreakerState.HALF_OPEN:
                s.cooldown_s = min(
                    s.cooldown_s * self.cooldown_multiplier,
                    self.max_cooldown_s,
                )
                s.opened_at  = time.time()
                s.state      = BreakerState.OPEN
                return
            # Closed → check trip conditions
            if s.state is BreakerState.CLOSED and self._should_trip(s):
                s.cooldown_s = self.initial_cooldown_s if s.cooldown_s == 0 else min(
                    s.cooldown_s * self.cooldown_multiplier,
                    self.max_cooldown_s,
                )
                s.opened_at = time.time()
                s.state     = BreakerState.OPEN

    # ── Public: stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def stats_for(self, key: str) -> dict:
        with self._lock:
            s = self._stats(key)
            n = len(s.events)
            fails = sum(1 for e, _ in s.events if e == "fail")
            return {
                "state":             s.state.value,
                "events":            n,
                "fail_rate":         (fails / n) if n else 0.0,
                "consecutive_fails": s.consecutive_failures,
                "cooldown_s":        s.cooldown_s,
                "opened_at":         s.opened_at,
            }

    def reset(self, key: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if key is None:
                self._by_key.clear()
            else:
                self._by_key.pop(key, None)

    # ── Internals ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _stats(self, key: str) -> _BreakerStats:
        s = self._by_key.get(key)
        if s is None:
            s = _BreakerStats(events=collections.deque(maxlen=self.window_size))
            self._by_key[key] = s
        return s

    def _should_trip(self, s: _BreakerStats) -> bool:
        """Internal trip-test (caller already holds lock)."""
        if s.consecutive_failures >= self.consecutive_fails_trip:
            return True
        n = len(s.events)
        if n < self.min_samples_to_trip:
            return False
        fails = sum(1 for e, _ in s.events if e == "fail")
        return (fails / n) >= self.fail_rate_threshold


# ─── Module-level singleton for the publish pipeline ─────────────────────────

_default: Optional[CircuitBreaker] = None
_default_lock = threading.Lock()


def get_default_breaker() -> CircuitBreaker:
    """Process-wide breaker shared by publishers + sheet runner."""
    global _default
    with _default_lock:
        if _default is None:
            _default = CircuitBreaker()
        return _default


class CircuitOpenError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when the breaker is OPEN and an attempt is requested.
    Caller should defer the job rather than retry immediately."""

"""
ConcurrentRunner — runs N SheetRunner workers in parallel.

Each worker handles its own sheet-tab → FB-page pipeline.
All workers share one RateLimiter to prevent per-page rate-limit collisions.

Usage:
    runner = ConcurrentRunner(
        workers=[{"tab": "Tab1", "page": "Page A"}, {"tab": "Tab2", "page": "Page B"}],
        config=config,
        on_log=lambda msg, level: ...,
        on_worker_update=lambda idx, status: ...,
        on_all_stopped=lambda: ...,
    )
    runner.start()
    # later:
    runner.stop()
    runner.is_running        # bool
    runner.worker_statuses() # list[WorkerStatus]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
import traceback
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

from core.rate_limiter import RateLimiter


@dataclass
class WorkerStatus:
    tab: str
    page: str
    sheet_id: str = ""    # multi-sheet: spreadsheet this worker addresses
    page_id: str = ""     # FB Page ID — disambiguates pages with same name
    account_id: str = ""  # FB account id — for log clarity
    account_name: str = ""  # cached account display name (for UI labels)
    state: str = "idle"    # idle | connecting | running | stopped | error
    current_job: str = ""
    jobs_done: int = 0
    jobs_error: int = 0
    last_msg: str = ""


class ConcurrentRunner:
    """Manages N parallel SheetRunner workers sharing one RateLimiter."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        workers: list[dict],
        config: dict,
        on_log: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_worker_update: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_all_stopped: Optional[Callable] = None,
        platform_filter: str = "",
    ):
        if not workers:
            raise ValueError("Cần ít nhất 1 worker")

        self._config           = config
        self._platform_filter  = (platform_filter or "").strip().lower()
        self._on_log           = on_log            or (lambda m, l: None)
        self._on_worker_update = on_worker_update  or (lambda i, s: None)
        self._on_all_stopped   = on_all_stopped    or (lambda: None)

        self._stop_event    = threading.Event()
        self._threads:  list[threading.Thread] = []
        self._lock      = threading.Lock()
        self._stopped_count = 0

        self._statuses: list[WorkerStatus] = [
            WorkerStatus(
                tab=w.get("tab", ""),
                page=w.get("page", ""),
                sheet_id=w.get("sheet_id", ""),
                page_id=w.get("page_id", ""),
                account_id=w.get("account_id", ""),
                account_name=w.get("account_name", ""),
            )
            for w in workers
        ]

        # Per-platform rate limit values: a TikTok runner uses tt_* keys (with
        # fallback to shared keys when tt_* is 0/empty); FB runners use the
        # shared keys directly. See core/utils.get_platform_config().
        from core.utils import get_platform_config
        _p = self._platform_filter or "facebook"

        shared_limiter = RateLimiter(
            max_concurrent             = int(config.get("max_concurrent_uploads_per_page", 1)),
            min_interval_s             = float(get_platform_config(config, _p, "min_interval_per_page_s", 30.0)),
            min_inter_page_interval_s  = float(get_platform_config(config, _p, "min_inter_page_interval_s", 0.0)),
            jitter_s                   = float(get_platform_config(config, _p, "jitter_s", 0.0)),
            active_hours_start         = int(get_platform_config(config, _p, "active_hours_start", 0)),
            active_hours_end           = int(get_platform_config(config, _p, "active_hours_end", 0)),
            max_posts_per_page_per_day    = int(get_platform_config(config, _p, "max_posts_per_page_per_day", 0)),
            max_posts_per_account_per_day = int(get_platform_config(config, _p, "max_posts_per_account_per_day", 0)),
            timezone_name                 = str(config.get("timezone", "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")),
        )

        from core.sheet_runner import SheetRunner
        self._runners: list[SheetRunner] = [
            SheetRunner(
                config       = config,
                page_name    = workers[i].get("page", ""),
                sheet_tab    = workers[i].get("tab", ""),
                sheet_id     = workers[i].get("sheet_id", ""),
                page_id      = workers[i].get("page_id", ""),
                account_id   = workers[i].get("account_id", ""),
                stop_event   = self._stop_event,
                on_log       = self._make_on_log(i),
                on_status    = self._make_on_status(i),
                on_job_start = self._make_on_job_start(i),
                on_job_done  = self._make_on_job_done(i),
                on_job_error = self._make_on_job_error(i),
                on_idle      = self._make_on_idle(i),
                on_stopped   = self._make_on_stopped(i),
                rate_limiter    = shared_limiter,
                platform_filter = self._platform_filter,
            )
            for i in range(len(workers))
        ]

    # ── Public ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def start(self):
        self._stop_event.clear()
        self._stopped_count = 0
        self._threads.clear()
        for i, runner in enumerate(self._runners):
            self._statuses[i].state = "connecting"
            self._on_worker_update(i, self._statuses[i])
            t = threading.Thread(
                target=self._thread_target, args=(i,), daemon=True,
                name=f"CWorker-{i + 1}-{runner.sheet_tab}",
            )
            self._threads.append(t)
            t.start()

    def stop(self):
        self._stop_event.set()

    @property
    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        return any(t.is_alive() for t in self._threads)

    def worker_statuses(self) -> list[WorkerStatus]:
        return list(self._statuses)

    # ── Thread target (crash-safe) ────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _thread_target(self, i: int):
        """
        Safe wrapper around runner.run() with P3 auto-restart.

        Clean exit  → runner.run() calls on_stopped itself → _stopped_count++.
        Crash       → caught here → log + Telegram → restart up to max_restarts.
        After all restarts exhausted → permanent error → _stopped_count++ manually.
        """
        max_restarts = int(self._config.get("worker_max_restarts", 2))
        restart_count = 0

        while True:
            runner = self._runners[i]
            try:
                runner.run()
                # Clean exit — on_stopped already incremented _stopped_count.
                return
            except Exception as exc:
                tb = traceback.format_exc()
                restart_count += 1
                err_msg = f"[W{i + 1}] Crash (lần {restart_count}/{max_restarts}): {exc}"
                logger.error("%s\n%s", err_msg, tb)

                st = self._statuses[i]
                st.last_msg = str(exc)[:80]
                self._on_log(err_msg, "error")

                if restart_count <= max_restarts and not self._stop_event.is_set():
                    wait = 30 * restart_count
                    st.state       = "connecting"
                    st.current_job = f"Restart sau {wait}s..."
                    self._on_worker_update(i, st)
                    self._on_log(
                        f"[W{i + 1}] Tự khởi động lại sau {wait}s "
                        f"(lần {restart_count}/{max_restarts})",
                        "warning",
                    )
                    # Reset stop event only for this runner? No — shared stop_event.
                    # We just sleep and retry; if stop fires during sleep, runner will
                    # detect it on next tick via check_stop().
                    time.sleep(wait)
                    continue

                # Permanent crash — notify and count as stopped
                err_msg_final = f"[W{i + 1}] Crash vĩnh viễn sau {max_restarts} lần restart: {exc}"
                logger.error(err_msg_final)
                st.state       = "error"
                st.current_job = ""
                self._on_worker_update(i, st)
                self._on_log(err_msg_final, "error")

                try:
                    from utils.notifier import get_notifier
                    get_notifier().notify_worker_crash(i + 1, str(exc))
                except Exception:
                    pass

                with self._lock:
                    self._stopped_count += 1
                    all_done = self._stopped_count >= len(self._runners)
                if all_done:
                    self._on_all_stopped()
                return

    # ── Callback factories ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _make_on_log(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb(msg: str, level: str):
            self._statuses[i].last_msg = msg[:80]
            self._on_log(f"[W{i + 1}] {msg}", level)
        return _cb

    def _make_on_status(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb(msg: str):
            self._statuses[i].last_msg = msg[:80]
            self._on_worker_update(i, self._statuses[i])
        return _cb

    def _make_on_job_start(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb(task: dict):
            st = self._statuses[i]
            st.state       = "running"
            st.current_job = f"#{task.get('row_idx', '?')} {task.get('title', '')[:30]}"
            self._on_worker_update(i, st)
        return _cb

    def _make_on_job_done(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb(task: dict, link: str):
            st = self._statuses[i]
            st.jobs_done  += 1
            st.current_job = ""
            st.state       = "running"
            self._on_worker_update(i, st)
        return _cb

    def _make_on_job_error(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb(task: dict, error: str):
            st = self._statuses[i]
            st.jobs_error += 1
            st.current_job = ""
            st.last_msg    = error[:60]
            self._on_worker_update(i, st)
        return _cb

    def _make_on_idle(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb():
            st = self._statuses[i]
            st.current_job = "⏳ Đang chờ job..."
            self._on_worker_update(i, st)
        return _cb

    def _make_on_stopped(self, i: int) -> Callable:
        def _cb():
            st = self._statuses[i]
            st.state       = "stopped"
            st.current_job = ""
            self._on_worker_update(i, st)
            with self._lock:
                self._stopped_count += 1
                all_done = self._stopped_count >= len(self._runners)
            if all_done:
                self._on_all_stopped()
                # P1: notify batch done via Telegram
                try:
                    total_done  = sum(s.jobs_done  for s in self._statuses)
                    total_error = sum(s.jobs_error for s in self._statuses)
                    from utils.notifier import get_notifier
                    get_notifier().notify_batch_done(total_done, total_error)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return _cb

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@
