"""
TikTokPublisher — implements the Publisher interface for TikTok.

Dispatches to the correct uploader based on task["post_type"]:

    post_type="tiktok_draft"   → TikTokDraftUploader  (inbox, safe for all apps)
    post_type="tiktok_direct"  → TikTokDirectUploader (direct post, needs audit)
    post_type="tiktok"         → alias for "tiktok_direct"

Account lookup:
    task["account"] (open_id) → TikTokTokenStore.get_account()
    If empty, uses the first available account.

Token refresh:
    If access_token has expired, automatically refreshes before uploading.

Audit logging (Phase 7):
    Every publish attempt is logged to data/audit_log.jsonl (JSONL format).
    Events: tiktok_publish_attempt, tiktok_publish_success,
            tiktok_publish_failure, tiktok_compliance_violation,
            tiktok_token_refreshed.
    Override log path via config["tiktok_audit_log_path"].
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from typing import Callable, Optional

from core.publisher import Publisher, PublishResult
from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError
from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount, TikTokTokenStore

_DRAFT_POST_TYPES   = frozenset({"tiktok_draft", "draft"})
_DIRECT_POST_TYPES  = frozenset({"tiktok_direct", "tiktok", "direct"})


class TikTokPublisher(Publisher):
    """
    Publish a video to TikTok via Content Posting API v2.

    task keys consumed:
        video_path      — local video file path (required)
        account         — TikTok open_id (optional; uses first account if empty)
        title           — post title (≤150 chars)
        description     — post description (≤2200 chars)
        keywords        — comma-separated hashtags (appended to description)
        post_type       — "tiktok_draft" | "tiktok_direct" | "tiktok"
        privacy_level   — "SELF_ONLY" | "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE" | etc. (direct only)
        row_idx         — sheet row index (forwarded to audit log)
    """

    platform_name = "tiktok"

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: dict,
        stop_event: threading.Event,
        on_log: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_status: Optional[Callable] = None,
        rate_limiter=None,
    ):
        self._config       = config
        self._stop         = stop_event
        self._on_log       = on_log    or (lambda m, l: None)
        self._on_status    = on_status or (lambda m: None)
        self._token_store  = TikTokTokenStore()
        # Anti-ban rate limiter (now actually used — was previously ignored).
        # acquire(account_key, account_id=open_id) → enforces per-account
        # interval, daily quota, jitter, active hours. Optional: None = legacy
        # behaviour (no rate limiting). See core/rate_limiter.RateLimiter.
        self._rate_limiter = rate_limiter

    def publish(self, task: dict) -> PublishResult:
        """
        Upload and publish to TikTok.

        Raises TikTokComplianceError (blocking violations), TikTokError,
        FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError, or InterruptedError.

        Audit events fired (never block publishing):
          • tiktok_publish_attempt      — always, after account resolved
          • tiktok_publish_success      — on success
          • tiktok_publish_failure      — on non-compliance exception
          • tiktok_compliance_violation — on TikTokComplianceError
        """
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import (
            TikTokComplianceGuard,
            TikTokComplianceError,
        )
        from utils.audit_logger import append_event

        account = self._resolve_account(task)
        account = self._ensure_token_fresh(account)

        # Build a common kwargs dict for all audit calls for this publish job
        _log_path = str(self._config.get("tiktok_audit_log_path", ""))
        _audit_kw = dict(
            log_path      = _log_path,
            open_id       = account.open_id,
            display_name  = account.display_name,
            row_idx       = task.get("row_idx", ""),
            post_type     = str(task.get("post_type", "tiktok_draft")),
            privacy_level = str(task.get("privacy_level", "")),
        )

        # ── Audit: publish attempt ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        append_event("tiktok_publish_attempt", **_audit_kw)

        # ── Anti-ban rate limit (NEW — was missing for TikTok) ─────────────────
        # Acquire BEFORE the upload work. The "page" key for TikTok is the
        # display_name (human-readable). account_id (open_id) drives the
        # per-account daily cap. Released in finally below.
        _rl_key = account.display_name or account.open_id
        _rl_acquired = False
        if self._rate_limiter is not None:
            wait = self._rate_limiter.wait_until_ready(_rl_key)
            if wait > 0:
                self._on_log(
                    f"[TikTok RateLimit] Chờ {wait:.0f}s → {_rl_key}", "info",
                )
                self._on_status(f"[TikTok] Chờ rate-limit {wait:.0f}s...")
            self._rate_limiter.acquire(
                _rl_key, self._stop, account_id=account.open_id,
            )
            _rl_acquired = True

        try:
            # ── Preflight compliance check ─────────────────────────────────────
            # Must run BEFORE the client is created; raises TikTokComplianceError
            # on any blocking violation.  Non-blocking advisories → logged as warnings.
            _guard = TikTokComplianceGuard(self._config)
            _compliance_warnings = _guard.check(task, account)
            for _w in _compliance_warnings:
                self._on_log(f"[Compliance] {_w.code}: {_w.message}", "warning")

            client = TikTokClient(
                access_token = account.access_token,
                on_log       = self._on_log,
                timeout      = int(self._config.get("tiktok_request_timeout_s", 60)),
                # Sprint TT-1.3: per-account UA + proxy when network_identity_enabled
                account_id   = account.open_id,
                config       = self._config,
            )

            post_type = str(task.get("post_type", "tiktok_draft")).lower().strip()

            if post_type in _DRAFT_POST_TYPES:
                result = self._upload_draft(client, task)
            elif post_type in _DIRECT_POST_TYPES:
                result = self._upload_direct(client, task)
            else:
                # Unknown post_type — default to draft (safe)
                self._on_log(
                    f"[TikTok] post_type='{post_type}' không rõ, dùng draft upload",
                    "warning",
                )
                result = self._upload_draft(client, task)

            # ── Audit: publish success ─────────────────────────────────────────
            append_event(
                "tiktok_publish_success",
                publish_id = result.external_post_id,
                **_audit_kw,
            )

            # ── STAGE 7: optional post-publish comment ─────────────────────────
            # Only attempt for direct posts (drafts in inbox can't be commented).
            # Fully optional — does NOT raise on failure (would lose successful publish).
            comment_text = str(task.get("comment", "") or task.get("tiktok_comment", "")).strip()
            if comment_text and post_type in _DIRECT_POST_TYPES:
                self._maybe_post_comment(
                    client       = client,
                    publish_id   = result.external_post_id,
                    comment_text = comment_text,
                    audit_kw     = _audit_kw,
                )
            elif comment_text and post_type in _DRAFT_POST_TYPES:
                self._on_log(
                    "[TikTok] Bỏ qua comment — draft inbox không hỗ trợ comment",
                    "info",
                )

            return result

        except TikTokComplianceError as exc:
            # ── Audit: compliance violation (blocking) ─────────────────────────
            append_event(
                "tiktok_compliance_violation",
                error_code = str(exc.error_code),
                details    = {"message": str(exc.message)},
                **_audit_kw,
            )
            # Sprint TT-1.8: Telegram alert
            try:
                from utils.notifier import get_notifier
                get_notifier().notify_tiktok_compliance_violation(
                    account = account.display_name or account.open_id,
                    code    = str(exc.error_code),
                    message = str(exc.message),
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise

        except Exception as exc:
            # ── Audit: general publish failure ─────────────────────────────────
            _ecode = getattr(exc, "error_code", "") or type(exc).__name__
            append_event(
                "tiktok_publish_failure",
                error_code = str(_ecode),
                details    = {"error": str(exc)[:500]},
                **_audit_kw,
            )
            # Sprint TT-1.8: Telegram alert for abuse-grade TT codes
            try:
                from core.adaptive_backoff import (
                    is_tiktok_abuse_signal, is_tiktok_permanent,
                )
                _code_str = str(_ecode).lower()
                if is_tiktok_abuse_signal(_code_str):
                    from utils.notifier import get_notifier
                    get_notifier().notify_tiktok_post_blocked(
                        account = account.display_name or account.open_id,
                        reason  = f"{_code_str}: {str(exc)[:200]}",
                    )
                elif is_tiktok_permanent(_code_str) and _code_str in (
                    "scope_not_authorized", "privacy_level_option_mismatch",
                    "unaudited_client_can_only_post_to_private_accounts",
                ):
                    from utils.notifier import get_notifier
                    get_notifier().notify_tiktok_audit_required(
                        account = account.display_name or account.open_id,
                        action  = f"{_code_str}: cần audit hoặc đổi config",
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise

        finally:
            # Release the rate-limit slot whether we succeeded or raised. This
            # also records the daily-count increment used by quota checks.
            if _rl_acquired:
                try:
                    self._rate_limiter.release(_rl_key, account_id=account.open_id)
                except Exception as _exc:
                    import logging as _lg
                    _lg.getLogger(__name__).debug(
                        "rate_limiter.release failed (non-fatal): %s", _exc
                    )

    # ── Stage 7: Comment (optional) ────────────────────────────────────────

    def _maybe_post_comment(
        self,
        client: TikTokClient,
        publish_id: str,
        comment_text: str,
        audit_kw: dict,
    ) -> None:
        """Optional Stage 7: post a comment under the just-published video.

        Never raises — comment failure must NOT bubble up and lose the
        successful publish_id from Stage 4-6.

        Logs result + writes audit event:
          tiktok_comment_posted   on success
          tiktok_comment_skipped  on empty / scope-missing / spam
          tiktok_comment_failed   on unexpected exception
        """
        from utils.audit_logger import append_event
        from core.tiktok.commenter import TikTokCommenter

        try:
            commenter = TikTokCommenter(
                client     = client,
                stop_event = self._stop,
                on_log     = self._on_log,
                on_status  = self._on_status,
                # Sprint TT-1.6: human-like delay before comment
                comment_delay_min_s = float(self._config.get("tt_comment_delay_min_s", 0)),
                comment_delay_max_s = float(self._config.get("tt_comment_delay_max_s", 0)),
            )
            result = commenter.post_comment(publish_id, comment_text)

            if result.success and not result.skipped:
                append_event(
                    "tiktok_comment_posted",
                    publish_id = publish_id,
                    details    = {
                        "comment_id": result.comment_id,
                        "text_len":   len(result.text),
                    },
                    **audit_kw,
                )
            elif result.skipped:
                append_event(
                    "tiktok_comment_skipped",
                    publish_id = publish_id,
                    details    = {"reason": result.message},
                    **audit_kw,
                )
            else:
                # API failure — log but do not break publish flow
                append_event(
                    "tiktok_comment_failed",
                    publish_id = publish_id,
                    error_code = result.error_code,
                    details    = {"message": result.message},
                    **audit_kw,
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            # Last line of defence: a bug in commenter must not break publish
            self._on_log(
                f"[TikTok Comment] Lỗi bất ngờ (đã bỏ qua): {exc}",
                "warning",
            )
            try:
                append_event(
                    "tiktok_comment_failed",
                    publish_id = publish_id,
                    error_code = type(exc).__name__,
                    details    = {"error": str(exc)[:300]},
                    **audit_kw,
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

    # ── Upload dispatchers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _upload_draft(self, client: TikTokClient, task: dict) -> PublishResult:
        from core.tiktok.uploader_draft import TikTokDraftUploader
        uploader = TikTokDraftUploader(
            client      = client,
            config      = self._config,
            stop_event  = self._stop,
            on_log      = self._on_log,
            on_status   = self._on_status,
        )
        publish_id, post_url = uploader.upload(task)
        return PublishResult(
            success           = True,
            external_post_id  = publish_id,
            external_post_url = post_url,
            status            = "draft",
        )

    def _upload_direct(self, client: TikTokClient, task: dict) -> PublishResult:
        from core.tiktok.uploader_direct import TikTokDirectUploader
        uploader = TikTokDirectUploader(
            client      = client,
            config      = self._config,
            stop_event  = self._stop,
            on_log      = self._on_log,
            on_status   = self._on_status,
        )
        publish_id, post_url = uploader.upload(task)
        return PublishResult(
            success           = True,
            external_post_id  = publish_id,
            external_post_url = post_url,
            status            = "published",
        )

    # ── Account resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _resolve_account(self, task: dict) -> TikTokAccount:
        """Find the TikTokAccount to use for this task."""
        open_id = str(task.get("account", "")).strip()
        if open_id:
            acc = self._token_store.get_account(open_id)
            if acc is None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"Không tìm thấy tài khoản TikTok với open_id='{open_id}'.\n"
                    "Vào tab 🔐 Tài khoản → Kết nối TikTok."
                )
            return acc

        # Fall back to first available account
        accounts = self._token_store.all_accounts()
        if not accounts:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Chưa kết nối tài khoản TikTok.\n"
                "Vào tab 🔐 Tài khoản → Kết nối TikTok."
            )
        return accounts[0]

    def _ensure_token_fresh(self, account: TikTokAccount) -> TikTokAccount:
        """Refresh access_token if expired. Returns updated account."""
        if account.is_token_valid():
            return account

        self._on_log(
            f"[TikTok] Token của {account.display_name} đã hết hạn — "
            "đang làm mới...",
            "warning",
        )
        try:
            from core.tiktok.auth_manager import TikTokAuthManager
            mgr = TikTokAuthManager(self._config, token_store=self._token_store)
            refreshed = mgr.refresh_access_token(account)

            # ── Audit: token refreshed ─────────────────────────────────────────
            from utils.audit_logger import append_event
            _log_path = str(self._config.get("tiktok_audit_log_path", ""))
            append_event(
                "tiktok_token_refreshed",
                log_path     = _log_path,
                open_id      = refreshed.open_id,
                display_name = refreshed.display_name,
            )
            return refreshed
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Token TikTok hết hạn và không thể làm mới: {exc}\n"
                "Vào tab 🔐 Tài khoản → Kết nối lại TikTok."
            ) from exc

"""
TikTok scope runtime verification (Sprint TT-5 / F2).

Compares the SCOPES the user actually granted at OAuth time against the
scopes the bot needs for the current operation. Catches the "you connected
before the app got Comment API approval" footgun where the bot tries to
post comments and gets `scope_not_authorized` for every upload.

Reads granted scopes from TikTokAccount.scopes (list[str]) — already stored
during OAuth callback in token_store.py.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterable


# Minimum scopes the bot uses per operation.
# user.info.basic is granted by default by TikTok OAuth so we don't include
# it here — checking it explicitly would false-positive on legacy accounts
# whose scopes field doesn't list the default scope.
_SCOPE_REQUIREMENTS: dict[str, set] = {
    "draft_upload":   {"video.upload"},
    "direct_upload":  {"video.upload", "video.publish"},
    "comment_post":   {"comment.create"},
    "research_read":  {"research.adlib.basic"},   # optional, for analytics
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ScopeCheckResult:
    operation:        str
    granted_scopes:   list
    missing_scopes:   list
    ok:               bool
    message:          str


def check_scopes(
    operation: str,
    granted_scopes: Iterable,
) -> ScopeCheckResult:
    """Verify *granted_scopes* covers what *operation* needs.

    operation: one of "draft_upload", "direct_upload", "comment_post",
               "research_read", or a custom required-set passed as
               iterable in granted_scopes (advanced).
    """
    required = _SCOPE_REQUIREMENTS.get(operation, set())
    granted_set = {str(s).strip().lower() for s in (granted_scopes or []) if s}
    missing = sorted(required - granted_set)
    if missing:
        return ScopeCheckResult(
            operation=operation,
            granted_scopes=sorted(granted_set),
            missing_scopes=missing,
            ok=False,
            message=(
                f"Acc thiếu scope cho '{operation}': {', '.join(missing)}. "
                f"User cần reconnect TT account với scope đầy đủ."
            ),
        )
    return ScopeCheckResult(
        operation=operation,
        granted_scopes=sorted(granted_set),
        missing_scopes=[],
        ok=True,
        message=f"Scopes OK cho '{operation}'",
    )


def required_scopes(operation: str) -> set:
    """Public accessor for required-scope set of an operation."""
    return set(_SCOPE_REQUIREMENTS.get(operation, set()))

"""
TikTok spam pre-flight checker.

Validates post content BEFORE upload to avoid:
- TikTok flagging the account/app as spam
- Wasted API quota on rejected posts
- App audit rejection due to spam-enabling behavior

H1 fix + M7 fix.

TikTok's spam signals (from their public guidelines):
- Empty captions or emoji-only captions
- Excessive hashtags (>30 is suspicious)
- Hashtag stuffing ("#fyp #foryou #viral #trending" generic spam)
- Duplicate captions across many posts
- Very short captions on commercial content
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Optional


# Hashtag spam patterns
_SPAM_HASHTAGS = {
    "fyp", "foryou", "foryoupage", "viral", "trending", "viralvideo",
    "explore", "explorepage", "fy", "trend", "trendingnow",
    "popular", "subscribe", "follow", "followme", "likeforlike",
}
# Caption length limits
_MAX_CAPTION_LEN     = 2200    # TikTok max
_MIN_CAPTION_LEN     = 0       # 0 is allowed but warned
_RECOMMENDED_MIN_LEN = 10      # below this triggers warning
# Hashtag limits
_MAX_HASHTAGS        = 30      # hard limit
_RECOMMENDED_HASHTAGS = 5      # 3-5 is sweet spot per TikTok analytics


@dataclass
class SpamCheckResult:
    """Result of a spam pre-flight check."""
    is_blocked: bool          # True → must not upload (hard violation)
    warnings:   List[str]     # Soft issues — display to user but allow override
    blockers:   List[str]     # Hard issues — prevent upload


def check_post_content(
    *,
    caption: str,
    description: str = "",
    keywords: str = "",
    allow_empty_caption: bool = True,
) -> SpamCheckResult:
    """Validate post content before TikTok upload.

    Args:
        caption:    main video caption/title
        description: longer description (some platforms combine)
        keywords:   comma-separated hashtags (will be appended to caption)
        allow_empty_caption: if True, empty caption only triggers warning (not block)

    Returns:
        SpamCheckResult with warnings + blockers lists.
    """
    warnings: list[str] = []
    blockers: list[str] = []

    # Build full text as TikTok will see it
    full_text = " ".join(filter(None, [caption, description, keywords])).strip()

    # 1. Caption length
    if len(full_text) > _MAX_CAPTION_LEN:
        blockers.append(
            f"Caption quá dài ({len(full_text)} ký tự, tối đa {_MAX_CAPTION_LEN}). "
            "TikTok sẽ từ chối."
        )

    if not full_text.strip():
        msg = "Caption rỗng — TikTok có thể flag là low-quality content."
        if allow_empty_caption:
            warnings.append(msg)
        else:
            blockers.append(msg)
    elif len(full_text) < _RECOMMENDED_MIN_LEN:
        warnings.append(
            f"Caption quá ngắn ({len(full_text)} ký tự). Khuyến nghị tối thiểu "
            f"{_RECOMMENDED_MIN_LEN} ký tự để tăng engagement."
        )

    # 2. Emoji-only check
    text_no_spaces = re.sub(r"\s", "", full_text)
    if text_no_spaces and not re.search(r"[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]", text_no_spaces):
        warnings.append(
            "Caption chỉ chứa emoji/ký tự đặc biệt — TikTok có thể flag là spam."
        )

    # 3. Hashtag count
    hashtags = re.findall(r"#(\w+)", full_text)
    hashtag_count = len(hashtags)

    if hashtag_count > _MAX_HASHTAGS:
        blockers.append(
            f"Quá nhiều hashtag ({hashtag_count}). TikTok flag spam khi >30 hashtag. "
            f"Giảm xuống dưới {_MAX_HASHTAGS}."
        )
    elif hashtag_count > 15:
        warnings.append(
            f"Số hashtag ({hashtag_count}) khá cao. Khuyến nghị 3-5 hashtag liên quan "
            "để TikTok algorithm hoạt động tốt nhất."
        )

    # 4. Generic spam hashtags
    hashtag_lower = [h.lower() for h in hashtags]
    spam_count = sum(1 for h in hashtag_lower if h in _SPAM_HASHTAGS)
    if spam_count >= 3:
        warnings.append(
            f"Phát hiện {spam_count} hashtag chung chung (#fyp, #foryou, #viral...). "
            "TikTok algorithm coi đây là tín hiệu spam yếu. Dùng hashtag chuyên đề "
            "(niche) cụ thể hơn để tăng reach."
        )

    # 5. Excessive repetition (same word 5+ times)
    words = re.findall(r"\w+", full_text.lower())
    if words:
        word_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for w in words:
            if len(w) >= 3:   # ignore short words
                word_counts[w] = word_counts.get(w, 0) + 1
        max_repeat = max(word_counts.values()) if word_counts else 0
        if max_repeat >= 5:
            most_common = max(word_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])
            warnings.append(
                f"Từ '{most_common[0]}' lặp lại {most_common[1]} lần. "
                "TikTok có thể flag là keyword stuffing."
            )

    return SpamCheckResult(
        is_blocked = len(blockers) > 0,
        warnings   = warnings,
        blockers   = blockers,
    )


def format_check_result(result: SpamCheckResult) -> str:
    """Format result as human-readable string for logs/dialogs."""
    parts = []
    if result.blockers:
        parts.append("❌ BLOCKED:")
        parts.extend(f"  • {b}" for b in result.blockers)
    if result.warnings:
        if parts:
            parts.append("")
        parts.append("⚠️ Cảnh báo (vẫn cho upload):")
        parts.extend(f"  • {w}" for w in result.warnings)
    if not parts:
        return "✅ Nội dung OK, không có cảnh báo spam."
    return "\n".join(parts)

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_BEGIN@@@ core/tiktok/status_poller.py
SHA256=9d3f416a197c15a1045ce1467e6839a29785afb79ccd541f5490d09f3ab44a62 BYTES=4024 LINES=113

"""
TikTok publish status poller.

Polls POST /v2/post/publish/status/fetch/ until the video reaches
PROCESS_SUCCESS or PROCESS_FAILED, or the timeout expires.

TikTok status values:
    PROCESSING_UPLOAD          — chunks still being received
    PROCESSING_DOWNLOAD        — server pulling video from URL
    PROCESSING_INTERCUT_AND_UPLOAD — server transcoding
    PROCESS_SUCCESS            — done; post is live (or in draft inbox)
    PROCESS_FAILED             — server-side failure
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from typing import Callable, Optional

from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError

_STATUS_URL = "/v2/post/publish/status/fetch/"

_TERMINAL_OK     = "PROCESS_SUCCESS"
_TERMINAL_FAIL   = "PROCESS_FAILED"
_PENDING_STATUSES = frozenset({
    "PROCESSING_UPLOAD",
    "PROCESSING_DOWNLOAD",
    "PROCESSING_INTERCUT_AND_UPLOAD",
    "SEND_TO_USER_INBOX",          # draft accepted, awaiting user action
})


# Exponential backoff bounds (MEH-06 fix)
_BACKOFF_MIN_S = 3.0      # don't poll faster than every 3s
_BACKOFF_MAX_S = 30.0     # don't wait longer than 30s between polls
_BACKOFF_FACTOR = 1.5     # each retry waits 1.5x longer


def poll_until_done(
    client: TikTokClient,
    publish_id: str,
    *,
    poll_interval_s: float = 5.0,
    timeout_s: float = 600.0,
    on_log: Optional[Callable] = None,
    stop_event=None,
) -> str:
    """
    Block until publish_id reaches a terminal status.

    Uses exponential backoff (MEH-06): starts at poll_interval_s, grows by 1.5x
    after each poll, capped at _BACKOFF_MAX_S. This avoids hammering TikTok's
    status endpoint and tripping their rate limits on long-running uploads.

    Returns the final status string (e.g. "PROCESS_SUCCESS").
    Raises TikTokError on PROCESS_FAILED, timeout, or stop_event.
    """
    log = on_log or (lambda m, l: None)
    deadline = time.time() + timeout_s
    attempt  = 0

    # Initial interval: respect user setting but clamp to safety bounds
    current_interval = max(_BACKOFF_MIN_S, min(float(poll_interval_s), _BACKOFF_MAX_S))

    while True:
        # Check stop_event (InterruptedError propagates to SheetRunner)
        if stop_event is not None and stop_event.is_set():
            raise InterruptedError("Dừng bởi người dùng trong lúc chờ TikTok xử lý")

        if time.time() > deadline:
            raise TikTokError(
                f"Quá {timeout_s:.0f}s chờ TikTok xử lý publish_id={publish_id}",
                error_code="timeout",
            )

        attempt += 1
        try:
            data = client.post(_STATUS_URL, {"publish_id": publish_id})
        except TikTokError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            raise TikTokError(
                f"Không thể kiểm tra trạng thái TikTok: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        process_info = data.get("process_info", data)
        status       = str(process_info.get("status", "")).upper()
        uploaded_bytes = process_info.get("uploaded_bytes", 0)

        log(
            f"[TikTok] Trạng thái publish #{attempt}: {status} "
            f"({uploaded_bytes:,} bytes đã nhận, wait={current_interval:.1f}s)",
            "info",
        )

        if status == _TERMINAL_OK:
            return status

        if status == _TERMINAL_FAIL:
            fail_reason = process_info.get("fail_reason", "unknown")
            raise TikTokError(
                f"TikTok từ chối video (publish_id={publish_id}): {fail_reason}",
                error_code="process_failed",
            )

        # For SEND_TO_USER_INBOX the draft is already accepted — treat as success
        if status == "SEND_TO_USER_INBOX":
            log("[TikTok] Video đã vào inbox người dùng (draft mode)", "success")
            return status

        # Still processing — wait then back off for next iteration
        time.sleep(current_interval)
        current_interval = min(current_interval * _BACKOFF_FACTOR, _BACKOFF_MAX_S)

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@

"""
Encrypted token storage for TikTok OAuth2 tokens.

Same Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) pattern as core.token_store,
but with a TikTok-specific salt so keys are distinct from Facebook.

File: data/tiktok_tokens.enc
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

# Reuse key derivation (machine-bound, or the ADR-013 external-key override)
# from the FB store; only the salt differs, keeping the two stores' keys
# distinct even when an external key is shared across both.
from core.token_store import _derive_key as _shared_derive_key

try:
    from cryptography.fernet import Fernet, InvalidToken
    _HAS_CRYPTO = True
except ImportError:
    _HAS_CRYPTO = False
    import warnings
    warnings.warn(
        "\n\n"
        "⚠️  SECURITY WARNING: 'cryptography' package is NOT installed.\n"
        "   TikTok OAuth tokens will be stored as PLAIN TEXT.\n"
        "   Run:  pip install cryptography\n"
        "   Then restart the application.\n",
        stacklevel=2,
    )

# None = tu dong giai qua LTT_DATA_DIR luc tao doi tuong. Dat duong dan cu the
# de ep buoc. Cung khuon voi core/token_store.py — xem giai thich day du o do.
_TOKEN_FILE: Optional[str] = None
_SALT = b"tiktok_bot_token_salt_v1_2026"


def _default_token_file() -> str:
    """Nơi lưu token TikTok, giải qua ranh giới đường dẫn của P2.

    Cùng lý do với `core/token_store.py::_default_token_file`: đường dẫn tương
    đối theo thư mục làm việc sẽ rơi vào `app\\data\\` trên máy chủ — thư mục
    bị thay toàn bộ mỗi lần cập nhật.
    """
    if _TOKEN_FILE:
        return _TOKEN_FILE
    try:
        from platform_core.runtime_paths import data_path
        return data_path("tiktok_tokens.enc")
    except Exception:
        return os.path.join("data", "tiktok_tokens.enc")

# P1-01 fix: singleton instance to avoid repeated Fernet decrypt on every
# GUI render. Callers without a custom path should use get_default_store().
_default_store: Optional["TikTokTokenStore"] = None
_default_store_lock = threading.Lock()


def get_default_store() -> "TikTokTokenStore":
    """Return the process-wide shared TikTokTokenStore singleton.

    Thread-safe. Prefer this over `TikTokTokenStore()` in GUI render code
    paths to avoid expensive re-decrypt of tiktok_tokens.enc per call.
    """
    global _default_store
    if _default_store is None:
        with _default_store_lock:
            if _default_store is None:
                _default_store = TikTokTokenStore()
    return _default_store


def _derive_key() -> bytes:
    return _shared_derive_key(salt=_SALT)


# ─── Data model ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class TikTokAccount:
    """
    Represents one connected TikTok user and their OAuth2 tokens.

    TikTok access_token TTL: 24 h (may change; check expires_at).
    TikTok refresh_token TTL: 365 days.
    """

    open_id: str               # TikTok's permanent user identifier
    display_name: str
    avatar_url: str
    access_token: str
    refresh_token: str
    expires_at: float          # Unix timestamp — when access_token expires
    refresh_expires_at: float  # Unix timestamp — when refresh_token expires
    scopes: list = field(default_factory=list)   # granted scope strings
    connected_at: str = ""     # ISO datetime string

    # ── Token state helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def is_token_valid(self) -> bool:
        """True if access_token has at least 60 s remaining."""
        return time.time() < self.expires_at - 60

    def is_refresh_valid(self) -> bool:
        """True if refresh_token has not expired."""
        return time.time() < self.refresh_expires_at - 60

    def days_until_expiry(self) -> int:
        remaining = self.expires_at - time.time()
        return max(0, int(remaining // 86400))

    def token_status_label(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """Returns (label_text, color_hex) for display."""
        if self.is_token_valid():
            d = self.days_until_expiry()
            if d > 1:
                return f"✅ Còn {d} ngày", "#4CAF50"
            hours = max(0, int((self.expires_at - time.time()) // 3600))
            return f"⚠️ Còn {hours}h", "#FF9800"
        return "❌ Đã hết hạn", "#F44336"

    # ── Serialization ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "open_id":            self.open_id,
            "display_name":       self.display_name,
            "avatar_url":         self.avatar_url,
            "access_token":       self.access_token,
            "refresh_token":      self.refresh_token,
            "expires_at":         self.expires_at,
            "refresh_expires_at": self.refresh_expires_at,
            "scopes":             list(self.scopes),
            "connected_at":       self.connected_at,
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "TikTokAccount":
        return cls(
            open_id            = str(d.get("open_id", "")),
            display_name       = str(d.get("display_name", "")),
            avatar_url         = str(d.get("avatar_url", "")),
            access_token       = str(d.get("access_token", "")),
            refresh_token      = str(d.get("refresh_token", "")),
            expires_at         = float(d.get("expires_at", 0)),
            refresh_expires_at = float(d.get("refresh_expires_at", 0)),
            scopes             = list(d.get("scopes", [])),
            connected_at       = str(d.get("connected_at", "")),
        )


# ─── Token Store ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TikTokTokenStore:
    """
    Encrypted JSON storage for TikTok OAuth2 tokens.
    Thread-safe; uses same Fernet pattern as Facebook TokenStore.
    """

    def __init__(self, path: Optional[str] = None):
        # Giai luc tao doi tuong, khong phai luc import.
        self.path = path or _default_token_file()
        self._accounts: dict[str, TikTokAccount] = {}
        self._load_error: Optional[str] = None
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        if _HAS_CRYPTO:
            self._fernet = Fernet(_derive_key())
        else:
            self._fernet = None
        self._load()

    # ── Persistence ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _load(self):
        """Populate self._accounts, recording *why* on failure.

        Mirrors core.token_store.TokenStore._load — see its docstring and
        docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md finding D2 for why an unreadable store must
        not look identical to a fresh install.
        """
        self._load_error = None
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            return

        try:
            raw = Path(self.path).read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            self._load_error = f"Không đọc được {self.path}: {exc}"
            self._accounts = {}
            return

        if not raw.strip():
            return   # empty file == no accounts yet

        payload = raw
        decrypt_failed = False
        if self._fernet:
            try:
                payload = self._fernet.decrypt(raw)
            except Exception as _dec_err:
                # Keep the plain-JSON migration path working for stores
                # written before encryption was introduced.
                decrypt_failed = True
                payload = raw
                import logging as _logging
                _logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(
                    "TikTokTokenStore: Fernet decrypt failed (%s) — "
                    "attempting plain-text fallback. "
                    "If this persists, re-connect your TikTok account.",
                    _dec_err,
                )

        try:
            data = json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            self._accounts = {}
            self._load_error = (
                f"Không giải mã được {self.path} bằng khoá của máy này. "
                "File token nhiều khả năng được tạo trên máy khác (hoặc sau "
                "khi cài lại Windows). Cần kết nối lại tài khoản TikTok. "
                "Đặt LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY để token dùng được trên nhiều máy."
            ) if decrypt_failed else (
                f"{self.path} không phải JSON hợp lệ — file có thể đã hỏng."
            )
            return

        try:
            self._accounts = {
                item["open_id"]: TikTokAccount.from_dict(item)
                for item in data
                if item.get("open_id")
            }
        except (AttributeError, TypeError) as exc:
            self._accounts = {}
            self._load_error = f"Cấu trúc dữ liệu token không hợp lệ: {exc}"

    def _save(self):
        """Atomic write: serialise → tmp → os.replace."""
        dir_ = os.path.dirname(self.path) or "."
        os.makedirs(dir_, exist_ok=True)
        data = [acc.to_dict() for acc in self._accounts.values()]
        raw = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
        if self._fernet:
            raw = self._fernet.encrypt(raw)
        tmp = Path(self.path).with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_bytes(raw)
        tmp.replace(Path(self.path))

    def reload(self):
        with self._lock:
            self._load()

    # ── CRUD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def upsert_account(self, account: TikTokAccount) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._accounts[account.open_id] = account
            self._save()

    def remove_account(self, open_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._accounts.pop(open_id, None)
            self._save()

    def get_account(self, open_id: str) -> Optional[TikTokAccount]:
        # BUG-02 fix: read under lock to avoid race with upsert_account/remove_account
        with self._lock:
            return self._accounts.get(open_id)

    def all_accounts(self) -> list[TikTokAccount]:
        # BUG-02 fix: snapshot under lock to avoid RuntimeError during iteration
        with self._lock:
            return list(self._accounts.values())

    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._accounts) == 0

    def count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._accounts)

    @property
    def is_encrypted(self) -> bool:
        return self._fernet is not None

    @property
    def load_error(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Human-readable reason the store could not be read, or None.
        See core.token_store.TokenStore.load_error."""
        return self._load_error

    @property
    def is_unreadable(self) -> bool:
        return self._load_error is not None

"""
TikTok upload shared utilities.

OPT-04 fix: _upload_chunks was duplicated identically in uploader_draft.py
and uploader_direct.py. Extracted here so both uploaders use the same
implementation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Callable, Optional


def upload_video_in_chunks(
    *,
    path: str,
    total_size: int,
    chunk_size: int,
    upload_url: str,
    client,
    check_stop: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,
    on_log:     Optional[Callable[[str, str], None]] = None,
    on_progress: Optional[Callable[[int, int], None]] = None,
    on_status:   Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
) -> None:
    """Upload a local video file to TikTok's upload URL in chunks.

    Uses Content-Range headers so the server can reassemble chunks in order.

    Parameters
    ----------
    path         : local file path to upload
    total_size   : total file size in bytes (from os.path.getsize)
    chunk_size   : chunk size in bytes (TikTok recommends multiples of 1 MB)
    upload_url   : pre-signed PUT URL returned by TikTok's init endpoint
    client       : TikTokClient instance with `put_binary(url, chunk, ...)`
    check_stop   : optional callable that raises InterruptedError on cancel
    on_log       : optional (message, level) callback for chunk-level logs
    on_progress  : optional (current_offset, total) callback for UI progress
    on_status    : optional (status_message) callback for human-readable status

    Raises
    ------
    InterruptedError    : if check_stop() raises
    Any TikTokError     : propagated from client.put_binary on HTTP errors
    """
    _log    = on_log    or (lambda m, l: None)
    _prog   = on_progress or (lambda c, t: None)
    _status = on_status  or (lambda m: None)
    _stop   = check_stop or (lambda: None)

    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        offset = 0
        chunk_idx = 0
        while offset < total_size:
            _stop()
            chunk = fh.read(chunk_size)
            if not chunk:
                break
            end = offset + len(chunk) - 1
            cr  = f"bytes {offset}-{end}/{total_size}"
            _log(f"[TikTok] Chunk {chunk_idx + 1}: {cr}", "upload")
            client.put_binary(
                upload_url, chunk,
                content_type  = "video/mp4",
                content_range = cr,
            )
            offset    += len(chunk)
            chunk_idx += 1
            _prog(offset, total_size)
            _status(f"[TikTok] Đang upload: {offset / total_size * 100:.0f}%")

"""
TikTokDirectUploader — uploads video as a direct public (or SELF_ONLY) post.

Endpoint: POST /v2/post/publish/video/init/
Required scope: video.publish

Privacy levels:
    PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE      — requires app audit (TikTok "Direct Post" review)
    FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR     — requires audit
    MUTUAL_FRIEND_FRIENDS   — requires audit
    SELF_ONLY               — available without audit (for testing / unaudited apps)

If the configured privacy_level is not SELF_ONLY and the app has not passed
audit, TikTok returns error code "privacy_level_option_mismatch". The uploader
catches this and raises a clear RuntimeError with instructions.

Upload flow: identical to TikTokDraftUploader (init → chunk upload → poll),
but uses a different endpoint and includes privacy_level in post_info.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import os
import threading
from typing import Callable, Optional

from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError
from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done

_INIT_URL   = "/v2/post/publish/video/init/"
_CHUNK_SIZE = 64 * 1024 * 1024   # 64 MB — TikTok's max single-chunk size.
# Previously 10 MB caused "The total chunk count is invalid" error for videos
# in the 10-64 MB range — TikTok's current spec prefers single-chunk for any
# video ≤ 64 MB, and chunked-upload only for larger files.

# Mapping from user-friendly strings → TikTok API enum values
_PRIVACY_MAP = {
    "public":    "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE",
    "followers": "FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR",
    "friends":   "MUTUAL_FRIEND_FRIENDS",
    "private":   "SELF_ONLY",
    "self_only": "SELF_ONLY",
    # Pass TikTok enum directly if already correct
    "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE":    "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE",
    "FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR":   "FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR",
    "MUTUAL_FRIEND_FRIENDS": "MUTUAL_FRIEND_FRIENDS",
    "SELF_ONLY":             "SELF_ONLY",
}
_DEFAULT_PRIVACY = "SELF_ONLY"   # safe default for unaudited apps


class TikTokDirectUploader:
    """
    Uploads a video to TikTok as a direct post.

    Returns (publish_id, post_url).
    post_url is "" until TikTok provides a shareable link
    (currently the API does not return it; users find it in the app).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        client: TikTokClient,
        config: dict,
        stop_event: Optional[threading.Event] = None,
        on_log: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_status: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_progress: Optional[Callable] = None,
    ):
        self._client   = client
        self._config   = config
        self._stop     = stop_event
        self._log      = on_log      or (lambda m, l: None)
        self._status   = on_status   or (lambda m: None)
        self._progress = on_progress or (lambda done, total: None)

    def upload(self, task: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """
        Upload video and create a direct TikTok post.

        Returns (publish_id, post_url).
        Raises TikTokError or InterruptedError.
        """
        video_path = task.get("video_path", "")
        if not os.path.isfile(video_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File không tồn tại: {video_path}")

        title         = str(task.get("title",         ""))[:150]
        description   = str(task.get("description",   ""))[:2200]
        privacy_raw   = str(task.get("privacy_level",
                           task.get("privacy", "SELF_ONLY")))
        privacy_level = _PRIVACY_MAP.get(privacy_raw, _DEFAULT_PRIVACY)

        # Collect hashtag keywords → append to description as #tags
        keywords_raw = str(task.get("keywords", "")).strip()
        if keywords_raw:
            tags = " ".join(
                f"#{k.strip().lstrip('#')}"
                for k in keywords_raw.replace(",", " ").split()
                if k.strip()
            )
            if tags and tags not in description:
                description = f"{description}\n{tags}".strip()

        # Per-post interaction flags: task value overrides global config
        def _bool_field(task_key: str, cfg_key: str) -> bool:
            task_val = str(task.get(task_key, "")).lower()
            if task_val in ("true", "1", "yes"):
                return True
            if task_val in ("false", "0", "no"):
                return False
            return bool(self._config.get(cfg_key, False))

        disable_duet    = _bool_field("tiktok_disable_duet",    "tiktok_disable_duet")
        disable_comment = _bool_field("tiktok_disable_comment", "tiktok_disable_comment")
        disable_stitch  = _bool_field("tiktok_disable_stitch",  "tiktok_disable_stitch")
        # Commercial / branded content toggle
        brand_content = _bool_field("tiktok_commercial_content", "tiktok_commercial_content")
        # AI-generated content disclosure (advisory — log notice; no API field in v2)
        is_ai = str(task.get("is_ai_generated", "")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")
        if is_ai:
            self._log(
                "[TikTok] Nội dung AI được đánh dấu — hãy bật nhãn 'AI generated content' "
                "trong TikTok app sau khi đăng.",
                "warning",
            )

        video_size   = os.path.getsize(video_path)
        chunk_size   = video_size if video_size <= _CHUNK_SIZE else _CHUNK_SIZE
        total_chunks = math.ceil(video_size / chunk_size)

        self._log(
            f"[TikTok Direct] Upload: {os.path.basename(video_path)} "
            f"({video_size:,} bytes, privacy={privacy_level}"
            f"{', commercial' if brand_content else ''}"
            f"{', AI' if is_ai else ''})",
            "upload",
        )
        self._status(f"[TikTok] Init direct upload ({privacy_level})...")

        # ── Phase 1: Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        post_info: dict = {
            "title":            title or description[:150],
            "description":      description,
            "privacy_level":    privacy_level,
            "disable_duet":     disable_duet,
            "disable_comment":  disable_comment,
            "disable_stitch":   disable_stitch,
        }
        # Only include brand_content_toggle when explicitly true — omitting it
        # is equivalent to false and avoids unnecessary API fields.
        if brand_content:
            post_info["brand_content_toggle"] = True

        init_payload = {
            "post_info": post_info,
            "source_info": {
                "source":            "FILE_UPLOAD",
                "video_size":        video_size,
                "chunk_size":        chunk_size,
                "total_chunk_count": total_chunks,
            },
        }

        self._check_stop()
        try:
            data = self._client.post(_INIT_URL, init_payload)
        except TikTokError as exc:
            if "privacy_level_option_mismatch" in exc.error_code.lower():
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"TikTok từ chối privacy_level='{privacy_level}'.\n"
                    "App chưa qua kiểm duyệt Direct Post — chỉ dùng được SELF_ONLY.\n"
                    "Đổi 'tiktok_privacy_level' thành 'SELF_ONLY' trong Cài đặt, "
                    "hoặc dùng 'post_type=tiktok_draft' để gửi vào inbox."
                ) from exc
            raise

        publish_id = str(data.get("publish_id", ""))
        upload_url = str(data.get("upload_url", ""))

        if not publish_id or not upload_url:
            from utils.logger import safe_response_repr
            raise TikTokError(
                f"TikTok không trả về publish_id/upload_url: {safe_response_repr(data)}",
                error_code="init_failed",
            )

        self._log(f"[TikTok Direct] publish_id={publish_id}", "info")
        self._status(f"[TikTok] Đang upload video ({total_chunks} chunk)...")

        # ── Phase 2: Upload chunks ─────────────────────────────────────────
        self._upload_chunks(video_path, video_size, chunk_size, upload_url)

        # ── Phase 3: Poll status ───────────────────────────────────────────
        self._status("[TikTok] Đang chờ TikTok xử lý video...")
        poll_until_done(
            client          = self._client,
            publish_id      = publish_id,
            poll_interval_s = float(self._config.get("tiktok_poll_interval_s", 5)),
            timeout_s       = float(self._config.get("tiktok_upload_timeout_s", 600)),
            on_log          = self._log,
            stop_event      = self._stop,
        )

        self._log(
            f"[TikTok Direct] Đăng thành công — publish_id={publish_id}",
            "success",
        )
        # TikTok API v2 does not return a public URL in the response.
        # Returning publish_id as the "external_post_id" for tracking.
        return publish_id, ""

    # ── Internal helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _upload_chunks(
        self,
        path: str,
        total_size: int,
        chunk_size: int,
        upload_url: str,
    ):
        """OPT-04 fix: delegates to shared utility to avoid code duplication."""
        from core.tiktok.upload_utils import upload_video_in_chunks
        upload_video_in_chunks(
            path        = path,
            total_size  = total_size,
            chunk_size  = chunk_size,
            upload_url  = upload_url,
            client      = self._client,
            check_stop  = self._check_stop,
            on_log      = self._log,
            on_progress = self._progress,
            on_status   = self._status,
        )

    def _check_stop(self):
        if self._stop and self._stop.is_set():
            raise InterruptedError("Dừng bởi người dùng")

"""
TikTokDraftUploader — uploads video to the creator's inbox (draft mode).

Endpoint: POST /v2/post/publish/inbox/video/init/
Required scope: video.upload

The video lands in the creator's TikTok app inbox as a draft.
The creator reviews and posts it manually (no privacy restriction).
This is the safe upload path for apps that have not passed TikTok's
"Direct Post" audit.

Upload flow:
  1. Init  — POST init endpoint with file metadata → publish_id + upload_url
  2. Upload — PUT raw bytes to upload_url in chunks (Content-Range)
  3. Poll   — POST status endpoint until PROCESS_SUCCESS / SEND_TO_USER_INBOX
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import os
import threading
from typing import Callable, Optional

from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError
from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done

_INIT_URL     = "/v2/post/publish/inbox/video/init/"
_CHUNK_SIZE   = 64 * 1024 * 1024   # 64 MB (TikTok max). Single-chunk upload for
                                   # videos ≤ 64 MB to avoid invalid_params errors
                                   # on the chunked-upload path. (Was 10 MB.)
_MIN_CHUNK    = 5  * 1024 * 1024   # 5 MB minimum per TikTok spec


class TikTokDraftUploader:
    """
    Uploads a video file to the TikTok creator's draft inbox.

    Returns (publish_id, "") — draft uploads have no public URL until
    the creator chooses to post.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        client: TikTokClient,
        config: dict,
        stop_event: Optional[threading.Event] = None,
        on_log: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_status: Optional[Callable] = None,
        on_progress: Optional[Callable] = None,
    ):
        self._client    = client
        self._config    = config
        self._stop      = stop_event
        self._log       = on_log      or (lambda m, l: None)
        self._status    = on_status   or (lambda m: None)
        self._progress  = on_progress or (lambda done, total: None)

    def upload(self, task: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """
        Upload video from task["video_path"] to inbox.

        Returns (publish_id, post_url).
        post_url is "" for drafts (no public link until posted by creator).
        Raises TikTokError or InterruptedError.
        """
        video_path = task.get("video_path", "")
        if not os.path.isfile(video_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File không tồn tại: {video_path}")

        title       = str(task.get("title",       ""))[:150]
        description = str(task.get("description", ""))[:2200]

        # Per-post interaction flags: task value overrides global config
        def _bool_field(task_key: str, cfg_key: str) -> bool:
            task_val = str(task.get(task_key, "")).lower()
            if task_val in ("true", "1", "yes"):
                return True
            if task_val in ("false", "0", "no"):
                return False
            return bool(self._config.get(cfg_key, False))

        disable_duet    = _bool_field("tiktok_disable_duet",    "tiktok_disable_duet")
        disable_comment = _bool_field("tiktok_disable_comment", "tiktok_disable_comment")
        disable_stitch  = _bool_field("tiktok_disable_stitch",  "tiktok_disable_stitch")

        # AI-generated content advisory
        if str(task.get("is_ai_generated", "")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes"):
            self._log(
                "[TikTok Draft] Nội dung AI — hãy bật nhãn 'AI generated content' "
                "trong TikTok app khi duyệt bản nháp.",
                "warning",
            )

        video_size = os.path.getsize(video_path)
        chunk_size = self._resolve_chunk_size(video_size)
        total_chunks = math.ceil(video_size / chunk_size)

        self._log(
            f"[TikTok Draft] Bắt đầu upload: {os.path.basename(video_path)} "
            f"({video_size:,} bytes, {total_chunks} chunk)",
            "upload",
        )
        self._status(f"[TikTok] Init draft upload...")

        # ── Phase 1: Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        init_payload = {
            "post_info": {
                "title":            title or description[:150],
                "description":      description,
                "disable_duet":     disable_duet,
                "disable_comment":  disable_comment,
                "disable_stitch":   disable_stitch,
                # Draft has no privacy_level — creator sets it when posting
            },
            "source_info": {
                "source":       "FILE_UPLOAD",
                "video_size":   video_size,
                "chunk_size":   chunk_size,
                "total_chunk_count": total_chunks,
            },
        }

        self._check_stop()
        data = self._client.post(_INIT_URL, init_payload)

        publish_id = str(data.get("publish_id", ""))
        upload_url = str(data.get("upload_url", ""))

        if not publish_id or not upload_url:
            from utils.logger import safe_response_repr
            raise TikTokError(
                f"TikTok không trả về publish_id/upload_url: {safe_response_repr(data)}",
                error_code="init_failed",
            )

        self._log(f"[TikTok Draft] publish_id={publish_id}", "info")
        self._status(f"[TikTok] Đang upload video ({total_chunks} chunk)...")

        # ── Phase 2: Upload chunks ─────────────────────────────────────────
        self._upload_chunks(video_path, video_size, chunk_size, upload_url)

        # ── Phase 3: Poll status ───────────────────────────────────────────
        self._status("[TikTok] Đang chờ TikTok xử lý video...")
        poll_until_done(
            client          = self._client,
            publish_id      = publish_id,
            poll_interval_s = float(self._config.get("tiktok_poll_interval_s", 5)),
            timeout_s       = float(self._config.get("tiktok_upload_timeout_s", 600)),
            on_log          = self._log,
            stop_event      = self._stop,
        )

        self._log(
            f"[TikTok Draft] Upload hoàn tất — publish_id={publish_id}",
            "success",
        )
        return publish_id, ""   # no public URL for drafts

    # ── Internal helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _upload_chunks(
        self,
        path: str,
        total_size: int,
        chunk_size: int,
        upload_url: str,
    ):
        """Upload file in chunks using Content-Range headers.

        OPT-04 fix: delegates to shared utility to avoid code duplication.
        """
        from core.tiktok.upload_utils import upload_video_in_chunks
        upload_video_in_chunks(
            path        = path,
            total_size  = total_size,
            chunk_size  = chunk_size,
            upload_url  = upload_url,
            client      = self._client,
            check_stop  = self._check_stop,
            on_log      = self._log,
            on_progress = self._progress,
            on_status   = self._status,
        )

    def _check_stop(self):
        if self._stop and self._stop.is_set():
            raise InterruptedError("Dừng bởi người dùng")

    @staticmethod
    def _resolve_chunk_size(video_size: int) -> int:
        """
        Choose chunk size:
        - Single-chunk if file fits in 10 MB
        - Otherwise 10 MB chunks (within TikTok [5 MB, 64 MB] bounds)
        """
        if video_size <= _CHUNK_SIZE:
            return video_size
        return _CHUNK_SIZE

"""
TikTok video pre-flight validator (Sprint TT-5 / F1).

Inspects a local video file and flags issues that would cause TikTok to
reject the upload — before we waste API quota / time chunk-uploading.

Two backends:
  • PRIMARY: `ffprobe` subprocess (part of FFmpeg). Reads container metadata.
  • FALLBACK: pure-Python — checks file size + a few magic bytes. Loses
    duration/resolution/codec but still catches truly broken files.

The validator returns a VideoReport with structured pass/warn/fail items
so the GUI can render a table and the compliance guard can hard-fail.

TikTok's documented limits (Content Posting API v2 — Direct Post, June 2025):
  • Duration:        3 s ≤ T ≤ 10 min (default; some apps unlock 30 min)
  • File size:       ≤ 4 GB
  • Resolution:      ≥ 540p; recommended 1080×1920 (9:16)
  • Aspect ratio:    Vertical preferred; 1:1 OK; 16:9 → letterboxed
  • Video codec:     H.264 (preferred), H.265, VP9
  • Audio codec:     AAC (preferred), MP3
  • Frame rate:      23-60 fps
  • Bitrate:         ≥ 516 kbps audio, ≥ 1 Mbps video recommended
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional


class CheckResult(Enum):
    PASS = "pass"
    WARN = "warn"
    FAIL = "fail"


@dataclass
class VideoCheckItem:
    name:    str
    result:  CheckResult
    message: str
    fix_hint: str = ""


@dataclass
class VideoReport:
    file_path:   str
    backend:     str          # "ffprobe" | "stat_only"
    duration_s:  float = 0.0
    width:       int   = 0
    height:      int   = 0
    fps:         float = 0.0
    bitrate_bps: int   = 0
    file_size_bytes: int = 0
    video_codec: str   = ""
    audio_codec: str   = ""
    has_audio:   bool  = False
    items:       list[VideoCheckItem] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def aspect_ratio(self) -> float:
        return (self.width / self.height) if self.height else 0.0

    @property
    def fail_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for i in self.items if i.result is CheckResult.FAIL)

    @property
    def warn_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for i in self.items if i.result is CheckResult.WARN)

    @property
    def ready_to_upload(self) -> bool:
        return self.fail_count == 0

    def summary(self) -> str:
        if self.ready_to_upload and self.warn_count == 0:
            return f"✅ Video sẵn sàng upload TikTok ({len(self.items)} checks pass)"
        if self.ready_to_upload:
            return f"🟡 OK với {self.warn_count} cảnh báo (không block upload)"
        return f"❌ {self.fail_count} blocking issues — sửa trước khi upload"


# ─── TikTok limits (overridable via config) ──────────────────────────────────

DEFAULT_LIMITS = {
    "min_duration_s": 3,
    "max_duration_s": 600,        # 10 min default; some apps unlock 30
    "max_size_bytes": 4 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024,
    "min_height":     540,
    "min_fps":        23,
    "max_fps":        60,
    "preferred_video_codecs": {"h264", "hevc", "h265", "vp9", "avc1"},
    "preferred_audio_codecs": {"aac", "mp3"},
}


# ─── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def validate_video(
    file_path: str,
    limits: Optional[dict] = None,
) -> VideoReport:
    """Inspect *file_path* and return a VideoReport.

    On ffprobe failure or absence, falls back to stat-only mode (file size
    + existence). Caller should NOT block when fail_count == 0 even if
    backend == "stat_only" — we couldn't really check.
    """
    limits = {**DEFAULT_LIMITS, **(limits or {})}

    if not file_path or not os.path.exists(file_path):
        rep = VideoReport(file_path=file_path, backend="stat_only")
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            name="File", result=CheckResult.FAIL,
            message="File không tồn tại", fix_hint="Check video_url / drive download",
        ))
        return rep

    size = os.path.getsize(file_path)
    rep = VideoReport(file_path=file_path, backend="stat_only",
                       file_size_bytes=size)

    # File-size check works without ffprobe
    if size <= 0:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            name="File size", result=CheckResult.FAIL,
            message="File rỗng (0 bytes)", fix_hint="Re-download video",
        ))
        return rep
    if size > limits["max_size_bytes"]:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            name="File size", result=CheckResult.FAIL,
            message=f"File quá lớn ({size / 2**30:.1f} GB > 4 GB)",
            fix_hint="Re-encode với bitrate thấp hơn",
        ))
    else:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            name="File size", result=CheckResult.PASS,
            message=f"{size / 2**20:.1f} MB", fix_hint="",
        ))

    # ffprobe metadata extraction
    meta = _ffprobe(file_path)
    if meta is None:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            name="ffprobe", result=CheckResult.WARN,
            message="ffprobe không khả dụng — bỏ qua check duration/codec",
            fix_hint="Cài ffmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) để kiểm tra đầy đủ",
        ))
        return rep

    rep.backend = "ffprobe"
    _extract_from_ffprobe(rep, meta)
    _add_metadata_checks(rep, limits)
    return rep


# ─── ffprobe ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def is_ffprobe_available() -> bool:
    return shutil.which("ffprobe") is not None


def _ffprobe(file_path: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Optional[dict]:
    """Run `ffprobe -v error -print_format json -show_format -show_streams`.

    Returns parsed JSON dict, or None on any failure (not installed, timeout,
    non-zero exit, malformed output)."""
    if not is_ffprobe_available():
        return None
    cmd = [
        "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-print_format", "json",
        "-show_format", "-show_streams", file_path,
    ]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            timeout=timeout, check=False,
        )
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):
        return None
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return None
    try:
        return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None


def _extract_from_ffprobe(rep: VideoReport, meta: dict) -> None:
    """Populate rep.duration_s / width / height / fps / codecs from ffprobe."""
    fmt = meta.get("format", {}) or {}
    try:
        rep.duration_s = float(fmt.get("duration", 0.0) or 0.0)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    try:
        rep.bitrate_bps = int(fmt.get("bit_rate", 0) or 0)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        pass

    for stream in meta.get("streams", []) or []:
        kind = stream.get("codec_type", "")
        if kind == "video" and not rep.video_codec:
            rep.video_codec = str(stream.get("codec_name", "")).lower()
            try: rep.width  = int(stream.get("width",  0) or 0)
            except (ValueError, TypeError): pass
            try: rep.height = int(stream.get("height", 0) or 0)
            except (ValueError, TypeError): pass
            # fps comes as fraction "30/1" or "30000/1001"
            fps_str = str(stream.get("r_frame_rate", "0/1"))
            if "/" in fps_str:
                num, den = fps_str.split("/", 1)
                try:
                    n = float(num); d = float(den)
                    if d > 0:
                        rep.fps = n / d
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        elif kind == "audio" and not rep.audio_codec:
            rep.audio_codec = str(stream.get("codec_name", "")).lower()
            rep.has_audio   = True


def _add_metadata_checks(rep: VideoReport, limits: dict) -> None:
    """Add CheckItems for the metadata we extracted."""
    # Duration
    if rep.duration_s <= 0:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Duration", CheckResult.WARN,
            "ffprobe không đọc được duration",
            "Video có thể bị corrupt",
        ))
    elif rep.duration_s < limits["min_duration_s"]:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Duration", CheckResult.FAIL,
            f"Quá ngắn ({rep.duration_s:.1f}s < {limits['min_duration_s']}s)",
            "TT yêu cầu video ≥ 3 s",
        ))
    elif rep.duration_s > limits["max_duration_s"]:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Duration", CheckResult.FAIL,
            f"Quá dài ({rep.duration_s:.0f}s > {limits['max_duration_s']}s)",
            "Cắt video xuống ≤ 10 phút",
        ))
    else:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Duration", CheckResult.PASS,
            f"{rep.duration_s:.1f}s", "",
        ))

    # Resolution
    if rep.height <= 0 or rep.width <= 0:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Resolution", CheckResult.WARN,
            "Không xác định được resolution", "",
        ))
    elif rep.height < limits["min_height"]:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Resolution", CheckResult.FAIL,
            f"{rep.width}×{rep.height} thấp hơn {limits['min_height']}p",
            "Re-encode lên ≥ 540p (1080×1920 tốt nhất)",
        ))
    else:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Resolution", CheckResult.PASS,
            f"{rep.width}×{rep.height}", "",
        ))

    # Aspect ratio (informational warn — TT accepts most)
    if rep.aspect_ratio > 0:
        ar = rep.aspect_ratio
        if 0.55 <= ar <= 0.58:    # ~9:16 (0.5625)
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Aspect ratio", CheckResult.PASS,
                f"9:16 vertical ({ar:.3f}) — discoverability max", "",
            ))
        elif 0.95 <= ar <= 1.05:  # square
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Aspect ratio", CheckResult.WARN,
                f"1:1 square ({ar:.3f}) — letterboxed trên feed",
                "Crop sang 9:16 để max reach",
            ))
        elif 1.7 <= ar <= 1.8:    # 16:9
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Aspect ratio", CheckResult.WARN,
                f"16:9 horizontal ({ar:.3f}) — TT crop / pillarbox",
                "Crop sang 9:16",
            ))
        else:
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Aspect ratio", CheckResult.WARN,
                f"Unusual {ar:.3f} — TT có thể crop lạ", "Use 9:16 / 1:1 / 16:9",
            ))

    # FPS
    if rep.fps <= 0:
        pass
    elif rep.fps < limits["min_fps"]:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Frame rate", CheckResult.FAIL,
            f"{rep.fps:.1f} fps < {limits['min_fps']} fps min",
            "Re-encode ≥ 23 fps",
        ))
    elif rep.fps > limits["max_fps"]:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Frame rate", CheckResult.WARN,
            f"{rep.fps:.1f} fps > {limits['max_fps']} fps",
            "Re-encode ≤ 60 fps",
        ))
    else:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Frame rate", CheckResult.PASS, f"{rep.fps:.1f} fps", "",
        ))

    # Video codec
    if rep.video_codec:
        if rep.video_codec in limits["preferred_video_codecs"]:
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Video codec", CheckResult.PASS, rep.video_codec, "",
            ))
        else:
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Video codec", CheckResult.WARN,
                f"Codec '{rep.video_codec}' không phải H.264/H.265/VP9 — TT có thể từ chối",
                "Re-encode H.264 (libx264) cho tương thích max",
            ))

    # Audio codec
    if not rep.has_audio:
        rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
            "Audio", CheckResult.WARN,
            "Video không có audio track",
            "TT thường có audio — clip silent dễ bị low engagement",
        ))
    elif rep.audio_codec:
        if rep.audio_codec in limits["preferred_audio_codecs"]:
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Audio codec", CheckResult.PASS, rep.audio_codec, "",
            ))
        else:
            rep.items.append(VideoCheckItem(
                "Audio codec", CheckResult.WARN,
                f"Codec '{rep.audio_codec}' không phải AAC/MP3",
                "Re-encode AAC để tương thích max",
            ))

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@

"""
Lightweight watermark detector (Sprint TT-5 / F4).

TikTok aggressively deboosts videos that contain another platform's
watermark (CapCut, Splash, InShot, Filmora, etc.). True per-pixel CV
detection requires OpenCV + ML models — heavyweight for a desktop bot.

This module uses CHEAP heuristics that catch ~80 % of cases without any
binary dependency:

  1. FILENAME signals — the most common: CapCut exports as
     `VID_<timestamp>_capcut.mp4`, Splash as `<id>_splash.mp4`, etc.
     The user often imports the file as-is from the editor.

  2. CONTAINER METADATA — many editors stamp the encoder field of the
     MOV/MP4 container. ffprobe exposes this in `format.tags.encoder` or
     stream metadata. We check that against a known-editor list.

  3. AUDIO METADATA — some editors stamp audio "title" or "comment".

For deeper detection, F4-future would wire OpenCV template matching on
the first/last seconds of video. Out of scope for this iteration.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional

# Known editor signatures — filename substrings and encoder strings.
_FILENAME_SIGNATURES: dict[str, str] = {
    "capcut":   "CapCut",
    "splash":   "Splash",
    "inshot":   "InShot",
    "filmora":  "Filmora",
    "kinemaster": "KineMaster",
    "vllo":     "VLLO",
    "vita":     "VITA",
    "videoshow": "VideoShow",
    "alight":   "Alight Motion",
    "cute_cut": "Cute Cut",
}

_ENCODER_SIGNATURES: dict[str, str] = {
    "capcut":     "CapCut",
    "lavf":       "FFmpeg/libavformat (likely OK — generic)",
    "x264":       "x264 (likely OK — generic)",
    "splash":     "Splash",
    "inshot":     "InShot",
    "filmora":    "Filmora",
    "kinemaster": "KineMaster",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WatermarkSignal:
    detected:    bool
    source:      str          # "filename" | "encoder_tag" | "title_tag" | "none"
    editor_name: str          # human-readable, e.g. "CapCut"
    confidence:  str          # "high" | "medium" | "low"
    message:     str
    fix_hint:    str = ""


def detect_watermark(file_path: str) -> WatermarkSignal:
    """Inspect *file_path* for known editor signatures.

    Returns WatermarkSignal — detected=True when high-confidence hit found.
    Always safe to call (no exceptions); returns "none" on any failure.
    """
    if not file_path or not os.path.exists(file_path):
        return WatermarkSignal(
            detected=False, source="none", editor_name="", confidence="low",
            message="File không tồn tại",
        )

    # 1. Filename check — strongest signal because users rarely rename
    lower = os.path.basename(file_path).lower()
    for sig, editor in _FILENAME_SIGNATURES.items():
        if sig in lower:
            return WatermarkSignal(
                detected=True, source="filename", editor_name=editor,
                confidence="high",
                message=f"Tên file gợi ý xuất từ {editor}: {os.path.basename(file_path)}",
                fix_hint=(
                    f"Re-export từ {editor} CHỌN tuỳ chọn 'Remove watermark' / "
                    "'Export without watermark'. Hoặc dùng tool xoá watermark."
                ),
            )

    # 2. ffprobe encoder tag check (only if ffprobe available — graceful skip)
    encoder = _ffprobe_encoder(file_path)
    if encoder:
        e_low = encoder.lower()
        for sig, editor in _ENCODER_SIGNATURES.items():
            if sig in e_low and "OK" not in editor:
                return WatermarkSignal(
                    detected=True, source="encoder_tag", editor_name=editor,
                    confidence="medium",
                    message=f"Metadata encoder '{encoder}' = {editor}",
                    fix_hint=f"Re-encode bằng ffmpeg để strip metadata",
                )

    return WatermarkSignal(
        detected=False, source="none", editor_name="", confidence="medium",
        message="Không phát hiện watermark qua heuristic",
    )


def _ffprobe_encoder(file_path: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Pull format.tags.encoder via ffprobe. Returns None on any failure."""
    try:
        from core.tiktok.video_validator import _ffprobe
    except Exception:
        return None
    meta = _ffprobe(file_path)
    if meta is None:
        return None
    fmt = meta.get("format", {}) or {}
    tags = fmt.get("tags", {}) or {}
    # Prioritise "encoder"; fall back to "handler_name" / "compatible_brands"
    return (
        tags.get("encoder")
        or tags.get("Encoder")
        or tags.get("ENCODER")
        or ""
    ).strip() or None
