"""Demucs adapter for audio source separation.

Wraps demucs CLI for stem separation (vocals, drums, bass, other).
Ported from NerfWarAI's audio.py demucs patterns.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cutclipshort.adapters.base import BaseAdapter
from cutclipshort.errors import AdapterError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

STEM_NAMES = ("vocals", "drums", "bass", "other")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StemPaths:
    """Paths to separated audio stems."""
    vocals: Path
    drums: Path
    bass: Path
    other: Path

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Path]:
        """Return stem paths as a name-to-path dictionary."""
        return {
            "vocals": self.vocals,
            "drums": self.drums,
            "bass": self.bass,
            "other": self.other,
        }


class DemucsAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Adapter for Demucs audio source separation."""

    def __init__(self, executable_path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(executable_path)

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        """Return adapter tool name."""
        return "demucs"

    def _find_executable(self) -> str:
        """Demucs can be called as python -m demucs or as CLI."""
        import shutil
        found = shutil.which("demucs")
        if found:
            return found
        # Try python module
        return "demucs"

    def check_available(self) -> bool:
        """Check if demucs is installed as library or CLI."""
        try:
            import demucs  # noqa: F401
            return True
        except ImportError:
            import shutil
            return shutil.which("demucs") is not None

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        """Return demucs version string or None."""
        try:
            import demucs
            return f"demucs {getattr(demucs, '__version__', 'unknown')}"
        except ImportError:
            return None

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return availability and CUDA status."""
        caps: dict[str, Any] = {"available": self.check_available()}
        if caps["available"]:
            try:
                import torch
                caps["cuda"] = torch.cuda.is_available()
            except ImportError:
                caps["cuda"] = False
        return caps

    def separate(
        self,
        audio_path: Path,
        output_dir: Path,
        *,
        model: str = "htdemucs",
        two_stems: str | None = None,
    ) -> StemPaths:
        """Separate audio into stems.

        Args:
            audio_path: Input audio file (WAV recommended).
            output_dir: Directory to write stems into.
            model: Demucs model name.
            two_stems: If set (e.g. "vocals"), only separate into
                       vocals and accompaniment.

        Returns:
            StemPaths with paths to each stem WAV file.
        """
        if not self.check_available():
            raise AdapterError(
                "Demucs not available",
                tool_name="demucs",
            )

        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        args = [
            "python", "-m", "demucs",
            "-n", model,
            "-o", str(output_dir),
        ]
        if two_stems:
            args += ["--two-stems", two_stems]
        args.append(str(audio_path))

        logger.info("Running demucs: model=%s, input=%s", model, audio_path.name)
        self._run_command(args, timeout=600)  # 10 min timeout

        # Find output directory (demucs creates model_name/input_stem/)
        stem_name = audio_path.stem
        track_dir = output_dir / model / stem_name

        if not track_dir.exists():
            # Try to find it
            for d in (output_dir / model).iterdir():
                if d.is_dir():
                    track_dir = d
                    break

        if not track_dir.exists():
            raise AdapterError(
                f"Demucs output directory not found: {track_dir}",
                tool_name="demucs",
            )

        stems = {}
        for name in STEM_NAMES:
            stem_path = track_dir / f"{name}.wav"
            if stem_path.exists():
                stems[name] = stem_path
            else:
                logger.warning("Stem not found: %s", stem_path)
                stems[name] = stem_path  # May not exist for two_stems mode

        return StemPaths(**stems)

    def available_models(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return list of common demucs models."""
        return ["htdemucs", "htdemucs_ft", "mdx_extra"]

"""Video downloader adapter — YouTube/TikTok/Drive → local file.

Supports:
  - YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, etc. via yt-dlp
  - Google Drive public links via gdown
  - Direct video URLs via urllib

Downloads to a local file, then feeds into the existing analysis pipeline.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# ── URL pattern detection ──────────────────────────────────────────

_YTDLP_DOMAINS = {
    "youtube.com", "youtu.be", "m.youtube.com",
    "tiktok.com", "vm.tiktok.com",
    "instagram.com",
    "twitter.com", "x.com",
    "facebook.com", "fb.watch",
    "vimeo.com",
    "dailymotion.com",
    "twitch.tv",
    "reddit.com",
    "bilibili.com",
}

_DRIVE_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"drive\.google\.com/(?:file/d/|open\?id=|uc\?id=)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)"
)

_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = {".mp4", ".mkv", ".avi", ".mov", ".webm", ".flv", ".ts"}


class DownloadError(Exception):
    """Download failed."""
    pass


class DriveNotPublicError(DownloadError):
    """Google Drive file is not shared publicly."""
    pass


class DownloaderNotInstalledError(DownloadError):
    """Required downloader library is not installed."""
    pass


# ── Progress callback type ─────────────────────────────────────────

ProgressCallback = Callable[[float, str, str], None]
# (percent 0-100, speed str, eta str)


# ── Source detection ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def detect_source(url: str) -> str:
    """Detect source type from URL.

    Returns: 'ytdlp', 'drive', 'direct', or 'unknown'
    """
    url = url.strip()
    if not url:
        return "unknown"

    # Google Drive
    if _DRIVE_PATTERN.search(url):
        return "drive"

    # yt-dlp supported sites
    try:
        from urllib.parse import urlparse
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        domain = parsed.hostname or ""
        # Strip www.
        domain = domain.removeprefix("www.")
        if domain in _YTDLP_DOMAINS:
            return "ytdlp"
        # Any other URL with video extension → direct
        if any(parsed.path.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in _VIDEO_EXTENSIONS):
            return "direct"
        # Try yt-dlp for any URL (it supports 1000+ sites)
        if parsed.scheme in ("http", "https") and "." in domain:
            return "ytdlp"
    except Exception:
        pass

    return "unknown"


def check_available() -> dict[str, bool]:
    """Check which download backends are installed."""
    result = {"ytdlp": False, "gdown": False}
    try:
        import yt_dlp  # noqa: F401
        result["ytdlp"] = True
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import gdown  # noqa: F401
        result["gdown"] = True
    except ImportError:
        pass
    return result


# ── Info extraction (no download) ──────────────────────────────────

def extract_info(url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Extract video metadata without downloading.

    Returns dict with: title, duration, thumbnail, source_type, url
    """
    source = detect_source(url)

    if source == "ytdlp":
        return _extract_info_ytdlp(url)
    elif source == "drive":
        return _extract_info_drive(url)
    elif source == "direct":
        return {"title": Path(url).stem, "duration": 0, "source_type": "direct", "url": url}
    else:
        raise DownloadError(
            "URL không được hỗ trợ.\n"
            "Hỗ trợ: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, Vimeo, Google Drive."
        )


def _extract_info_ytdlp(url: str) -> dict:
    """Extract info via yt-dlp without downloading."""
    try:
        import yt_dlp
    except ImportError:
        raise DownloaderNotInstalledError(
            "Chưa cài yt-dlp. Chạy: pip install yt-dlp"
        )

    opts = {
        "quiet": True,
        "no_warnings": True,
        "noplaylist": True,
        "skip_download": True,
    }

    try:
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
            info = ydl.extract_info(url, download=False)
            if info is None:
                raise DownloadError("Không lấy được thông tin video.")
            return {
                "title": info.get("title", "Video"),
                "duration": info.get("duration", 0) or 0,
                "thumbnail": info.get("thumbnail", ""),
                "uploader": info.get("uploader", ""),
                "resolution": f"{info.get('width', '?')}x{info.get('height', '?')}",
                "source_type": "ytdlp",
                "url": url,
            }
    except yt_dlp.utils.DownloadError as e:
        err = str(e).lower()
        if "private" in err or "sign in" in err:
            raise DownloadError("Video ở chế độ riêng tư, không tải được.")
        if "age" in err:
            raise DownloadError("Video bị giới hạn tuổi, không tải được.")
        raise DownloadError(f"Không tải được video: {e}")


def _extract_info_drive(url: str) -> dict:
    """Extract info from Google Drive link."""
    match = _DRIVE_PATTERN.search(url)
    if not match:
        raise DownloadError("Link Google Drive không hợp lệ.")

    file_id = match.group(1)
    # Try HEAD request to check if accessible
    check_url = f"https://drive.google.com/uc?id={file_id}&export=download"
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(check_url, method="HEAD")
        req.add_header("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            content_type = resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
            # Google returns HTML login page for private files
            if "text/html" in content_type:
                raise DriveNotPublicError(
                    "\u26a0 File Google Drive ch\u01b0a \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c chia s\u1ebb c\u00f4ng khai.\n"
                    "H\u00e3y b\u1eadt chia s\u1ebb c\u00f4ng khai (Anyone with the link) r\u1ed3i th\u1eed l\u1ea1i."
                )
            size = int(resp.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
    except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError):
        # Can't HEAD → might be large file with virus scan warning
        size = 0

    return {
        "title": f"Drive file {file_id[:8]}...",
        "duration": 0,
        "size_bytes": size,
        "source_type": "drive",
        "file_id": file_id,
        "url": url,
    }


# ── Download ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def download(
    url: str,
    output_dir: Path,
    progress_callback: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_flag: list | None = None,
) -> Path:
    """Download video from URL to output_dir. Returns local file path.

    Args:
        url: Video URL (YouTube, Drive, direct)
        output_dir: Directory to save file
        progress_callback: (percent, speed_str, eta_str)
        cancel_flag: [bool] — set [True] to cancel

    Returns:
        Path to downloaded video file

    Raises:
        DownloadError: on failure
        DriveNotPublicError: if Drive file not public
        DownloaderNotInstalledError: if yt-dlp/gdown not installed
    """
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source = detect_source(url)

    if source == "ytdlp":
        return _download_ytdlp(url, output_dir, progress_callback, cancel_flag)
    elif source == "drive":
        return _download_drive(url, output_dir, progress_callback)
    elif source == "direct":
        return _download_direct(url, output_dir, progress_callback)
    else:
        raise DownloadError("URL không được hỗ trợ.")


def _download_ytdlp(
    url: str, output_dir: Path,
    progress_callback: ProgressCallback | None,
    cancel_flag: list | None,
) -> Path:
    """Download via yt-dlp (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.)."""
    try:
        import yt_dlp
    except ImportError:
        raise DownloaderNotInstalledError(
            "Chưa cài yt-dlp.\nChạy: pip install yt-dlp"
        )

    downloaded_file = [None]

    def _progress_hook(d: dict) -> None:
        if cancel_flag and cancel_flag[0]:
            raise DownloadError("Đã hủy tải xuống.")

        if d["status"] == "downloading":
            total = d.get("total_bytes") or d.get("total_bytes_estimate") or 0
            downloaded = d.get("downloaded_bytes", 0)
            pct = (downloaded / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0
            speed = d.get("_speed_str", "")
            eta = d.get("_eta_str", "")
            if progress_callback:
                progress_callback(pct, speed, eta)

        elif d["status"] == "finished":
            downloaded_file[0] = d.get("filename", "")
            if progress_callback:
                progress_callback(100.0, "", "Xong!")

    opts = {
        "format": "bestvideo[height<=1080]+bestaudio/best[height<=1080]/best",
        "merge_output_format": "mp4",
        "outtmpl": str(output_dir / "%(title).80s.%(ext)s"),
        "noplaylist": True,
        "quiet": True,
        "no_warnings": True,
        "progress_hooks": [_progress_hook],
        # Retry on failure
        "retries": 3,
        "fragment_retries": 3,
    }

    try:
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
            ydl.download([url])
    except yt_dlp.utils.DownloadError as e:
        err = str(e).lower()
        if "private" in err or "sign in" in err:
            raise DownloadError("Video ở chế độ riêng tư.")
        if "age" in err:
            raise DownloadError("Video bị giới hạn tuổi.")
        raise DownloadError(f"Tải xuống thất bại: {e}")

    # Find the output file
    if downloaded_file[0] and Path(downloaded_file[0]).exists():
        result = Path(downloaded_file[0])
        # yt-dlp may have created .mp4 by merging
        mp4_path = result.with_suffix(".mp4")
        if mp4_path.exists():
            return mp4_path
        return result

    # Fallback: find newest file in output_dir
    files = sorted(output_dir.glob("*.*"), key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
    for f in files:
        if f.suffix.lower() in _VIDEO_EXTENSIONS:
            return f

    raise DownloadError("Tải xong nhưng không tìm thấy file video.")


def _download_drive(
    url: str, output_dir: Path,
    progress_callback: ProgressCallback | None,
) -> Path:
    """Download from Google Drive (public link only)."""
    try:
        import gdown
    except ImportError:
        raise DownloaderNotInstalledError(
            "Chưa cài gdown.\nChạy: pip install gdown"
        )

    match = _DRIVE_PATTERN.search(url)
    if not match:
        raise DownloadError("Link Google Drive không hợp lệ.")

    file_id = match.group(1)
    download_url = f"https://drive.google.com/uc?id={file_id}"
    output_path = str(output_dir / f"drive_{file_id[:12]}.mp4")

    if progress_callback:
        progress_callback(0, "", "Đang tải từ Drive...")

    try:
        result = gdown.download(
            download_url,
            output_path,
            quiet=True,
            fuzzy=True,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        err_str = str(e).lower()
        if "access denied" in err_str or "permission" in err_str or "cannot" in err_str:
            raise DriveNotPublicError(
                "\u26a0 File Google Drive ch\u01b0a \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c chia s\u1ebb c\u00f4ng khai.\n"
                "H\u00e3y b\u1eadt chia s\u1ebb c\u00f4ng khai (Anyone with the link) r\u1ed3i th\u1eed l\u1ea1i."
            )
        raise DownloadError(f"Tải từ Drive thất bại: {e}")

    if result is None or not Path(result).exists():
        raise DriveNotPublicError(
            "\u26a0 File Google Drive ch\u01b0a \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c chia s\u1ebb c\u00f4ng khai.\n"
            "H\u00e3y b\u1eadt chia s\u1ebb c\u00f4ng khai (Anyone with the link) r\u1ed3i th\u1eed l\u1ea1i."
        )

    if progress_callback:
        progress_callback(100.0, "", "Xong!")

    return Path(result)


def _download_direct(
    url: str, output_dir: Path,
    progress_callback: ProgressCallback | None,
) -> Path:
    """Download direct video URL via urllib."""
    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    filename = Path(parsed.path).name or "video.mp4"
    output_path = output_dir / filename

    if progress_callback:
        progress_callback(0, "", "Đang tải...")

    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url)
        req.add_header("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            total = int(resp.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            downloaded = 0
            with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
                while True:
                    chunk = resp.read(8192)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    f.write(chunk)
                    downloaded += len(chunk)
                    if total > 0 and progress_callback:
                        pct = downloaded / total * 100
                        speed = ""
                        progress_callback(pct, speed, "")
    except Exception as e:
        raise DownloadError(f"Tải xuống thất bại: {e}")

    if progress_callback:
        progress_callback(100.0, "", "Xong!")

    return output_path

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@

"""FFmpeg/FFprobe adapter.

Wraps all FFmpeg subprocess interactions. No other module should
construct FFmpeg commands directly.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cutclipshort.adapters.base import BaseAdapter
from cutclipshort.errors import AdapterError
from cutclipshort.types import SourceAsset

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FFmpegAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Adapter for FFmpeg video/audio encoding."""

    def __init__(self, executable_path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(executable_path)

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        """Return adapter tool name."""
        return "ffmpeg"

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        """Return FFmpeg version string or None if unavailable."""
        try:
            result = self._run_command([self.executable, "-version"])
            first_line = result.stdout.split("\n")[0]
            return first_line.strip()
        except AdapterError:
            return None

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return available encoders and decoders."""
        if self._capabilities_cache is not None:
            return self._capabilities_cache

        caps: dict[str, Any] = {
            "available": self.check_available(),
            "encoders": [],
            "decoders": [],
        }

        if caps["available"]:
            try:
                result = self._run_command(
                    [self.executable, "-encoders"],
                    check=False,
                )
                caps["encoders"] = [
                    parts[1]
                    for line in result.stdout.split("\n")
                    if line.strip().startswith("V")
                    and len(parts := line.strip().split()) >= 2
                ]
            except AdapterError:
                pass

        self._capabilities_cache = caps
        return caps

    def encode(
        self,
        input_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        *,
        video_filters: str = "",
        audio_filters: str = "",
        codec: str = "libx264",
        crf: str = "18",
        preset: str = "medium",
        pixel_format: str = "yuv420p",
        audio_codec: str = "aac",
        audio_bitrate: str = "192k",
        audio_sample_rate: int = 44100,
        audio_channels: int = 2,
        start_time: float | None = None,
        duration: float | None = None,
        max_bitrate: str = "",
        bufsize: str = "",
        target_fps: float = 0.0,
        extra_args: list[str] | None = None,
        timeout: float | None = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """Encode video with specified settings.

        Args:
            max_bitrate: VBV max bitrate (e.g. "10M"). Empty = no cap.
            bufsize: VBV buffer size (e.g. "20M"). Empty = 2x maxrate.
            target_fps: Output FPS. 0 = keep original.
        """
        args = [self.executable, "-y"]

        if start_time is not None:
            args += ["-ss", str(start_time)]
        args += ["-i", str(input_path)]
        if duration is not None:
            args += ["-t", str(duration)]

        if video_filters:
            args += ["-vf", video_filters]
        if audio_filters:
            args += ["-af", audio_filters]

        # FPS control
        if target_fps > 0:
            args += ["-r", str(target_fps)]

        # Video codec settings
        is_nvenc = "nvenc" in codec
        if is_nvenc:
            args += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset, "-cq", crf]
        elif codec == "libx265":
            args += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset, "-crf", crf, "-tag:v", "hvc1"]
        else:
            args += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset, "-crf", crf]

        # VBV bitrate capping
        if max_bitrate:
            actual_bufsize = bufsize or f"{int(float(max_bitrate.rstrip('MmKk')) * 2)}M"
            args += ["-maxrate", max_bitrate, "-bufsize", actual_bufsize]

        args += ["-pix_fmt", pixel_format]

        # Audio codec settings
        args += [
            "-c:a", audio_codec,
            "-b:a", audio_bitrate,
            "-ar", str(audio_sample_rate),
            "-ac", str(audio_channels),
        ]

        if extra_args:
            args += extra_args

        args.append(str(output_path))

        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            self._run_command(args, timeout=timeout)
        except AdapterError as e:
            raise AdapterError(
                f"Encode video thất bại: {input_path.name} → {output_path.name}. "
                f"Codec: {codec}, CRF: {crf}. Chi tiết: {e}",
                tool_name="ffmpeg",
                stderr=getattr(e, 'stderr', ''),
            ) from e
        return output_path

    def encode_2pass(
        self,
        input_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        *,
        target_bitrate: str,
        video_filters: str = "",
        audio_filters: str = "",
        codec: str = "libx264",
        preset: str = "medium",
        pixel_format: str = "yuv420p",
        audio_codec: str = "aac",
        audio_bitrate: str = "192k",
        audio_sample_rate: int = 44100,
        audio_channels: int = 2,
        start_time: float | None = None,
        duration: float | None = None,
        max_bitrate: str = "",
        target_fps: float = 0.0,
        extra_args: list[str] | None = None,
        timeout: float | None = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """2-pass ABR encoding for optimal quality within bitrate budget."""
        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        passlog = str(output_path.parent / f"{output_path.stem}_2pass")

        actual_maxrate = max_bitrate or target_bitrate

        # ── Pass 1 ──
        args1 = [self.executable, "-y"]
        if start_time is not None:
            args1 += ["-ss", str(start_time)]
        args1 += ["-i", str(input_path)]
        if duration is not None:
            args1 += ["-t", str(duration)]
        if video_filters:
            args1 += ["-vf", video_filters]
        if target_fps > 0:
            args1 += ["-r", str(target_fps)]

        is_nvenc = "nvenc" in codec
        if is_nvenc:
            args1 += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset,
                      "-b:v", target_bitrate, "-maxrate", actual_maxrate,
                      "-multipass", "fullres"]
        else:
            args1 += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset,
                      "-b:v", target_bitrate, "-maxrate", actual_maxrate,
                      "-pass", "1", "-passlogfile", passlog]

        args1 += ["-pix_fmt", pixel_format, "-an", "-f", "null"]
        # Windows: use NUL, Unix: /dev/null
        args1.append("NUL" if os.name == "nt" else "/dev/null")

        try:
            self._run_command(args1, timeout=timeout)
        except AdapterError as e:
            raise AdapterError(
                f"2-pass (pass 1) thất bại: {input_path.name}. Chi tiết: {e}",
                tool_name="ffmpeg",
                stderr=getattr(e, 'stderr', ''),
            ) from e

        # ── Pass 2 ──
        args2 = [self.executable, "-y"]
        if start_time is not None:
            args2 += ["-ss", str(start_time)]
        args2 += ["-i", str(input_path)]
        if duration is not None:
            args2 += ["-t", str(duration)]
        if video_filters:
            args2 += ["-vf", video_filters]
        if audio_filters:
            args2 += ["-af", audio_filters]
        if target_fps > 0:
            args2 += ["-r", str(target_fps)]

        if is_nvenc:
            args2 += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset,
                      "-b:v", target_bitrate, "-maxrate", actual_maxrate,
                      "-multipass", "fullres"]
        else:
            args2 += ["-c:v", codec, "-preset", preset,
                      "-b:v", target_bitrate, "-maxrate", actual_maxrate,
                      "-pass", "2", "-passlogfile", passlog]

        args2 += ["-pix_fmt", pixel_format]
        args2 += ["-c:a", audio_codec, "-b:a", audio_bitrate,
                  "-ar", str(audio_sample_rate), "-ac", str(audio_channels)]

        if extra_args:
            args2 += extra_args
        args2.append(str(output_path))

        try:
            self._run_command(args2, timeout=timeout)
        except AdapterError as e:
            raise AdapterError(
                f"2-pass (pass 2) thất bại: {input_path.name}. Chi tiết: {e}",
                tool_name="ffmpeg",
                stderr=getattr(e, 'stderr', ''),
            ) from e
        finally:
            for ext in (".log", "-0.log", "-0.log.mbtree"):
                p = Path(passlog + ext)
                if p.exists():
                    p.unlink(missing_ok=True)

        return output_path

    def extract_audio(
        self,
        input_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        *,
        sample_rate: int = 44100,
        channels: int = 2,
        start_time: float | None = None,
        duration: float | None = None,
    ) -> Path:
        """Extract audio from video to WAV."""
        args = [self.executable, "-y"]
        if start_time is not None:
            args += ["-ss", str(start_time)]
        args += ["-i", str(input_path)]
        if duration is not None:
            args += ["-t", str(duration)]
        args += [
            "-vn",
            "-acodec", "pcm_s16le",
            "-ar", str(sample_rate),
            "-ac", str(channels),
            str(output_path),
        ]

        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            self._run_command(args)
        except AdapterError as e:
            raise AdapterError(
                f"Trích xuất audio thất bại: {input_path.name}. "
                f"Video có thể không có track audio. Chi tiết: {e}",
                tool_name="ffmpeg",
                stderr=getattr(e, 'stderr', ''),
            ) from e
        return output_path

    def concat(
        self,
        file_list_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        *,
        codec_copy: bool = False,
    ) -> Path:
        """Concatenate files using concat demuxer."""
        args = [
            self.executable, "-y",
            "-f", "concat",
            "-safe", "0",
            "-i", str(file_list_path),
        ]
        if codec_copy:
            args += ["-c", "copy"]
        else:
            args += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-c:a", "aac"]
        args.append(str(output_path))

        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._run_command(args)
        return output_path

    def extract_thumbnail(
        self,
        input_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        time_sec: float = 0.0,
        width: int = 320,
        height: int = -1,
    ) -> Path:
        """Extract a single frame as JPEG thumbnail.

        Args:
            input_path: Source video.
            output_path: Where to write the .jpg file.
            time_sec: Timestamp to capture (seconds).
            width: Target width (height auto-scaled if -1).
            height: Target height (-1 = auto from width).
        """
        scale = f"scale={width}:{height}" if height > 0 else f"scale={width}:-1"
        args = [
            self.executable, "-y",
            "-ss", str(time_sec),
            "-i", str(input_path),
            "-vframes", "1",
            "-vf", scale,
            "-q:v", "3",
            str(output_path),
        ]

        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._run_command(args, timeout=15.0)
        return output_path

    def replace_audio(
        self,
        video_path: Path,
        audio_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
    ) -> Path:
        """Replace audio in video without re-encoding video."""
        args = [
            self.executable, "-y",
            "-i", str(video_path),
            "-i", str(audio_path),
            "-c:v", "copy",
            "-c:a", "aac",
            "-b:a", "192k",
            "-map", "0:v:0",
            "-map", "1:a:0",
            "-shortest",
            str(output_path),
        ]

        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._run_command(args)
        return output_path


class FFprobeAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Adapter for FFprobe media analysis."""

    def __init__(self, executable_path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(executable_path)

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        """Return adapter tool name."""
        return "ffprobe"

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        """Return FFprobe version string or None if unavailable."""
        try:
            result = self._run_command([self.executable, "-version"])
            first_line = result.stdout.split("\n")[0]
            return first_line.strip()
        except AdapterError:
            return None

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return availability status."""
        return {"available": self.check_available()}

    def probe(self, input_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Get full probe data as dict."""
        args = [
            self.executable,
            "-v", "quiet",
            "-print_format", "json",
            "-show_format",
            "-show_streams",
            str(input_path),
        ]
        result = self._run_command(args)
        try:
            return json.loads(result.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise AdapterError(
                f"Failed to parse ffprobe output for {input_path}",
                tool_name="ffprobe",
                details=str(e),
            )

    def get_media_info(self, input_path: Path, source_hash: str) -> SourceAsset:
        """Extract SourceAsset metadata from a video file."""
        data = self.probe(input_path)

        video_stream = None
        audio_stream = None
        for stream in data.get("streams", []):
            if stream.get("codec_type") == "video" and video_stream is None:
                video_stream = stream
            elif stream.get("codec_type") == "audio" and audio_stream is None:
                audio_stream = stream

        if video_stream is None:
            raise AdapterError(
                f"No video stream found in {input_path}",
                tool_name="ffprobe",
            )

        fmt = data.get("format", {})

        # Parse FPS from r_frame_rate (e.g. "30000/1001" or "29.97")
        fps_str = video_stream.get("r_frame_rate", "30/1")
        try:
            if "/" in fps_str:
                num, den = fps_str.split("/")
                fps = float(num) / float(den)
            else:
                fps = float(fps_str)
        except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
            logger.warning("Unparseable FPS '%s', defaulting to 30.0", fps_str)
            fps = 30.0

        def _safe_int(val, default: int = 0) -> int:
            """Safely convert string/int/None to int."""
            try:
                return int(float(str(val))) if val else default
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                return default

        return SourceAsset(
            original_path=str(input_path),
            source_hash=source_hash,
            file_name=input_path.name,
            file_size_bytes=_safe_int(fmt.get("size", 0)),
            duration_sec=float(fmt.get("duration", 0) or 0),
            width=_safe_int(video_stream.get("width", 0)),
            height=_safe_int(video_stream.get("height", 0)),
            fps=round(fps, 3),
            video_codec=video_stream.get("codec_name", "unknown"),
            pixel_format=video_stream.get("pix_fmt", "yuv420p"),
            bitrate_kbps=_safe_int(fmt.get("bit_rate", 0)) // 1000,
            audio_codec=audio_stream.get("codec_name", "none") if audio_stream else "none",
            audio_sample_rate=_safe_int(audio_stream.get("sample_rate", 0)) if audio_stream else 0,
            audio_channels=_safe_int(audio_stream.get("channels", 0)) if audio_stream else 0,
            audio_bitrate_kbps=_safe_int(audio_stream.get("bit_rate", 0)) // 1000 if audio_stream else 0,
        )

    def get_duration(self, input_path: Path) -> float:
        """Get video duration in seconds."""
        data = self.probe(input_path)
        return float(data.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0))

"""Hardware acceleration detection for FFmpeg.

Detects NVENC (NVIDIA), QSV (Intel), and VideoToolbox (macOS).
Falls back gracefully to software encoding.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cutclipshort.adapters.base import BaseAdapter
from cutclipshort.errors import AdapterError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FFmpegHWAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Hardware encoder detection and selection."""

    def __init__(self, ffmpeg_path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(ffmpeg_path)
        self._hw_cache: dict[str, bool] | None = None

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        """Return adapter tool name."""
        return "ffmpeg"

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        """Return None; version is provided by FFmpegAdapter."""
        return None  # Delegates to FFmpegAdapter

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return NVENC and QSV availability."""
        return {
            "nvenc": self.has_nvenc(),
            "qsv": self.has_qsv(),
        }

    def _test_encoder(self, encoder: str) -> bool:
        """Test if an encoder works by encoding a tiny black frame."""
        try:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                test_out = Path(tmp) / "test.mp4"
                # NVENC trên một số GPU/driver (đặc biệt RTX 50xx) từ chối
                # frame 64x64 dù encoder hoạt động bình thường với video thật.
                # Probe 256x256 thống nhất với platform_core.media để không
                # báo âm giả rồi lùi cả job về libx264.
                args = [
                    self.executable,
                    "-y",
                    "-f", "lavfi",
                    "-i", "color=black:s=256x256:d=0.1",
                    "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                    "-c:v", encoder,
                    "-frames:v", "1",
                    str(test_out),
                ]
                subprocess.run(
                    args,
                    capture_output=True,
                    timeout=10,
                    check=True,
                )
                return test_out.exists() and test_out.stat().st_size > 0
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, FileNotFoundError):
            return False

    def _detect_all(self) -> dict[str, bool]:
        """Detect all hardware encoders."""
        if self._hw_cache is not None:
            return self._hw_cache

        self._hw_cache = {
            "h264_nvenc": self._test_encoder("h264_nvenc"),
            "h264_qsv": self._test_encoder("h264_qsv"),
        }

        for name, available in self._hw_cache.items():
            if available:
                logger.info("Hardware encoder available: %s", name)
            else:
                logger.debug("Hardware encoder not available: %s", name)

        return self._hw_cache

    def has_nvenc(self) -> bool:
        """Check if NVIDIA NVENC is available."""
        return self._detect_all().get("h264_nvenc", False)

    def has_qsv(self) -> bool:
        """Check if Intel QSV is available."""
        return self._detect_all().get("h264_qsv", False)

    def best_encoder(self, prefer_hw: bool = True) -> str:
        """Return the best available H.264 encoder.

        Priority: h264_nvenc > h264_qsv > libx264
        """
        if prefer_hw:
            hw = self._detect_all()
            if hw.get("h264_nvenc"):
                return "h264_nvenc"
            if hw.get("h264_qsv"):
                return "h264_qsv"

        return "libx264"

    def encoder_preset(self, encoder: str) -> str:
        """Return appropriate preset for the encoder."""
        presets = {
            "h264_nvenc": "p5",
            "h264_qsv": "medium",
            "libx264": "medium",
        }
        return presets.get(encoder, "medium")

"""MPV adapter for video playback in GUI.

Wraps libmpv for frame-accurate video playback embedded in PySide6.
Falls back to QMediaPlayer if mpv is unavailable.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cutclipshort.adapters.base import BaseAdapter
from cutclipshort.errors import AdapterError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MPVAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Adapter for MPV video player."""

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        """Return adapter tool name."""
        return "mpv"

    def check_available(self) -> bool:
        """Check if python-mpv and libmpv are available."""
        try:
            import mpv  # noqa: F401
            return True
        except (ImportError, OSError):
            return False

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        """Return MPV version string or None."""
        try:
            import mpv
            player = mpv.MPV()
            version = player.mpv_version
            player.terminate()
            return version
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.debug("Failed to get MPV version: %s", exc)
            return None

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return availability status."""
        return {"available": self.check_available()}

    def create_player(self, wid: int | None = None) -> Any:
        """Create an MPV player instance.

        Args:
            wid: Window ID for embedding (from Qt widget.winId()).

        Returns:
            mpv.MPV instance.
        """
        if not self.check_available():
            raise AdapterError(
                "python-mpv not installed or libmpv not found",
                tool_name="mpv",
            )

        import mpv

        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "input_default_bindings": True,
            "input_vo_keyboard": True,
            "osc": True,
        }
        if wid is not None:
            kwargs["wid"] = str(wid)

        player = mpv.MPV(**kwargs)
        return player

"""PySceneDetect adapter for scene boundary detection.

Wraps scenedetect library's ContentDetector.
Ported from NerfWarAI's scene_detect.py.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cutclipshort.adapters.base import BaseAdapter
from cutclipshort.errors import AdapterError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SceneBoundary:
    """A detected scene boundary."""
    id: int
    start_time: float  # seconds
    end_time: float  # seconds


class SceneDetectAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Adapter for PySceneDetect."""

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        """Return adapter tool name."""
        return "scenedetect"

    def _find_executable(self) -> str:
        return "scenedetect"  # Python library

    def check_available(self) -> bool:
        """Check if scenedetect is installed."""
        try:
            import scenedetect  # noqa: F401
            return True
        except ImportError:
            return False

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        """Return scenedetect version string or None."""
        try:
            import scenedetect
            return f"scenedetect {scenedetect.__version__}"
        except (ImportError, AttributeError):
            return None

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return availability status."""
        return {"available": self.check_available()}

    def detect(
        self,
        video_path: Path,
        *,
        threshold: float = 27.0,
        min_scene_len_sec: float = 1.5,
    ) -> list[SceneBoundary]:
        """Detect scene boundaries in a video.

        Args:
            video_path: Path to video file.
            threshold: Content detection threshold (higher = fewer scenes).
            min_scene_len_sec: Minimum scene length in seconds.

        Returns:
            List of SceneBoundary objects.
        """
        if not self.check_available():
            raise AdapterError(
                "scenedetect not installed",
                tool_name="scenedetect",
            )

        from scenedetect import open_video, SceneManager
        from scenedetect.detectors import ContentDetector

        logger.info(
            "Detecting scenes: threshold=%.1f, min_len=%.1fs",
            threshold, min_scene_len_sec,
        )

        video = open_video(str(video_path))
        fps = video.frame_rate
        min_scene_len_frames = int(min_scene_len_sec * fps)

        manager = SceneManager()
        manager.add_detector(ContentDetector(
            threshold=threshold,
            min_scene_len=min_scene_len_frames,
        ))
        manager.detect_scenes(video)
        scene_list = manager.get_scene_list()

        boundaries = [
            SceneBoundary(
                id=i,
                start_time=scene[0].get_seconds(),
                end_time=scene[1].get_seconds(),
            )
            for i, scene in enumerate(scene_list)
        ]

        logger.info("Detected %d scenes", len(boundaries))
        return boundaries

"""Whisper adapter — bilingual Vietnamese/English speech-to-text.

Pipeline:
  1. Detect language via short audio sample (2-pass approach)
  2. Transcribe with language-specific optimized parameters
  3. Post-process: fix common errors per language
  4. Return word-level timestamps for caption sync

Supports:
  - faster-whisper (preferred: GPU, faster, lower memory)
  - openai-whisper (fallback: CPU-friendly)

Language strategy:
  - If language is forced (config), use it directly
  - If auto-detect, run a 30s detect pass first, then full transcribe
  - Vietnamese: initial_prompt with tonal patterns, post-process d→đ fixes
  - English: no special prompt needed, post-process capitalization only
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cutclipshort.adapters.base import BaseAdapter
from cutclipshort.errors import AdapterError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class TranscriptResult:
    """Result of a transcription."""
    language: str
    segments: list[dict[str, Any]]  # [{start, end, text, words}]
    duration_sec: float


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LANGUAGE-SPECIFIC CONFIGURATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Vietnamese prompt — primes Whisper to output correct tonal marks.
# Contains common Vietnamese words that Whisper frequently gets wrong,
# especially the đ/d confusion and tonal mark errors.
_PROMPT_VI = (
    "Đây là nội dung tiếng Việt có phụ đề. "
    "Các từ thường gặp: không, được, người, những, cũng, đã, đang, đến, để, "
    "rồi, thì, mà, là, của, này, đó, ấy, đi, về, lại, ra, vào, lên, xuống, "
    "anh, chị, em, bạn, tôi, mình, chúng tôi, họ, "
    "nhưng, nếu, vì, nên, hay, hoặc, với, từ, trong, ngoài, "
    "một, hai, ba, bốn, năm, sáu, bảy, tám, chín, mười, "
    "thật, rất, quá, lắm, nhiều, ít, "
    "biết, hiểu, nghĩ, nói, làm, có, muốn, cần, phải."
)

# English prompt — minimal, just sets the context
_PROMPT_EN = (
    "This is a video with English subtitles. "
    "Transcribe accurately with proper punctuation and capitalization."
)

_LANG_PARAMS = {
    "vi": {

        "temperature": 0.0,
        # condition_on_previous_text=False: ngan Whisper lap lai cau bia
        # (hallucination) suot video khi audio khong co thoai ro rang.
        "condition_on_previous_text": False,
        "vad_filter": True,
        "vad_parameters": {"min_silence_duration_ms": 250},
        # Vietnamese speech has shorter pauses between phrases
    },
    "en": {
        "initial_prompt": _PROMPT_EN,
        "beam_size": 5,
        "temperature": 0.0,
        "condition_on_previous_text": False,
        "vad_filter": True,
        "vad_parameters": {"min_silence_duration_ms": 500},
    },
}

# Default params for any other language
_LANG_PARAMS_DEFAULT = {
    "beam_size": 5,
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "condition_on_previous_text": False,
    "vad_filter": True,
}

class WhisperAdapter(BaseAdapter):
    """Bilingual Vietnamese/English Whisper speech-to-text adapter.

    Features:
    - 2-pass: detect language first, then transcribe with optimized params
    - Language-specific initial prompts for accuracy
    - Vietnamese post-processing (d→đ, abbreviations, punctuation)
    - English post-processing (capitalization, punctuation)
    - Hallucination filtering
    - Model caching (don't reload for same model_size)
    """

    def __init__(self, model_size: str = "base", compute_type: str = "auto") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._model_size = model_size
        self._compute_type = compute_type  # "auto", "int8", "float16", "float32"
        self._backend: str | None = None
        # Model cache to avoid reloading
        self._cached_model = None
        self._cached_model_size: str = ""
        self._cached_compute_type: str = ""

    @property
    def tool_name(self) -> str:
        return "whisper"

    def _find_executable(self) -> str:
        return "whisper"

    def check_available(self) -> bool:
        try:
            import faster_whisper  # noqa: F401
            self._backend = "faster_whisper"
            return True
        except ImportError:
            pass
        try:
            import whisper  # noqa: F401
            self._backend = "openai_whisper"
            return True
        except ImportError:
            pass
        return False

    def get_version(self) -> str | None:
        if self._backend == "faster_whisper":
            try:
                import faster_whisper
                return f"faster-whisper {faster_whisper.__version__}"
            except (ImportError, AttributeError):
                return "faster-whisper"
        elif self._backend == "openai_whisper":
            try:
                import whisper
                return f"openai-whisper {whisper.__version__}"
            except (ImportError, AttributeError):
                return "openai-whisper"
        return None

    def get_capabilities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        available = self.check_available()
        caps: dict[str, Any] = {"available": available, "backend": self._backend}
        if available:
            try:
                import torch
                caps["cuda"] = torch.cuda.is_available()
                if caps["cuda"]:
                    caps["cuda_device"] = torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
            except ImportError:
                caps["cuda"] = False
        return caps

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # MAIN TRANSCRIBE API
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    def transcribe(
        self,
        audio_path: Path,
        *,
        model_size: str | None = None,
        language: str | None = None,
        word_timestamps: bool = True,
        progress_callback: Any = None,
    ) -> TranscriptResult:
        """Transcribe audio to text with word-level timestamps.

        Args:
            audio_path: Path to audio/video file
            model_size: Whisper model (tiny/base/small/medium/large-v3)
            language: Force language ("vi"/"en") or None for auto-detect
            word_timestamps: Include per-word timing
            progress_callback: Optional progress function

        Returns:
            TranscriptResult with segments, language, duration
        """
        if not self.check_available():
            raise AdapterError(
                "No whisper backend. Install: pip install faster-whisper",
                tool_name="whisper",
            )

        model_size = model_size or self._model_size

        # Step 1: Detect language if not forced
        if language is None:
            language = self._detect_language(audio_path, model_size)
            logger.info("Auto-detected language: %s", language)

        # Step 2: Transcribe with language-optimized parameters
        logger.info("Transcribing: model=%s, lang=%s, backend=%s",
                     model_size, language, self._backend)

        if self._backend == "faster_whisper":
            result = self._transcribe_faster(
                audio_path, model_size, language, word_timestamps)
        else:
            result = self._transcribe_openai(
                audio_path, model_size, language, word_timestamps)

        # Step 3: Post-process per language
        result.segments = self._postprocess_segments(result.segments, result.language)

        logger.info("Transcription complete: %d segments, lang=%s",
                     len(result.segments), result.language)
        return result

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # LANGUAGE DETECTION (2-pass approach)
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    def _detect_language(self, audio_path: Path, model_size: str) -> str:
        """Detect language from first 30s of audio.

        Uses Whisper's built-in language detection which analyzes
        the first 30 seconds of audio mel spectrogram.
        """
        try:
            if self._backend == "faster_whisper":
                model = self._get_or_load_model_faster(model_size)

                # Try fast language detection (faster-whisper ≥0.10)
                lang = None
                prob = 0.0
                try:
                    if hasattr(model, 'detect_language_multi_segment'):
                        # Fast path: only analyzes mel spectrogram, no transcription
                        lang_results = model.detect_language_multi_segment(str(audio_path))
                        if lang_results:
                            lang = lang_results[0][0]
                            prob = lang_results[0][1]
                            logger.info("Fast language detection: %s (%.1f%%)", lang, prob * 100)
                except Exception:
                    pass  # Fall through to transcription-based detection

                if lang is None:
                    # Fallback: use transcribe with minimal processing
                    segments_gen, info = model.transcribe(
                        str(audio_path),
                        language=None,
                        word_timestamps=False,
                        vad_filter=False,
                    )
                    # Consume just first segment to get info
                    for _ in segments_gen:
                        break
                    lang = info.language
                    prob = info.language_probability
                logger.info("Language detection: %s (%.1f%%)", lang, prob * 100)
                # If confidence < 70%, fall back to Vietnamese (target audience)
                if prob < 0.7:
                    logger.warning("Low confidence (%.1f%%), defaulting to 'vi'", prob * 100)
                    return "vi"
                return lang
            else:
                import whisper
                model = self._get_or_load_model_openai(model_size)
                audio = whisper.load_audio(str(audio_path))
                audio = whisper.pad_or_trim(audio)
                mel = whisper.log_mel_spectrogram(audio).to(model.device)
                _, probs = model.detect_language(mel)
                lang = max(probs, key=probs.get)
                logger.info("Language detection: %s (%.1f%%)", lang, probs[lang] * 100)
                if probs[lang] < 0.7:
                    return "vi"
                return lang
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Language detection failed: %s, defaulting to 'vi'", e)
            return "vi"

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FASTER-WHISPER BACKEND
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    def _get_or_load_model_faster(self, model_size: str):
        """Load faster-whisper model with caching and tier-aware compute type."""
        # Resolve compute type from config (or auto-detect)
        device = "cuda" if self.get_capabilities().get("cuda") else "cpu"
        if self._compute_type == "auto":
            compute_type = "float16" if device == "cuda" else "int8"
        elif self._compute_type == "float16" and device == "cpu":
            # float16 not supported on CPU — fallback to int8
            compute_type = "int8"
            logger.info("float16 not available on CPU, using int8")
        else:
            compute_type = self._compute_type

        # Return cached model if same model+compute
        if (self._cached_model
                and self._cached_model_size == model_size
                and self._cached_compute_type == compute_type):
            return self._cached_model

        # Release old model before loading new one (prevent OOM)
        if self._cached_model is not None:
            logger.info("Releasing previous model: %s (%s)",
                        self._cached_model_size, self._cached_compute_type)
            del self._cached_model
            self._cached_model = None
            try:
                import torch
                if torch.cuda.is_available():
                    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
            except ImportError:
                pass

        from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

        # Check for bundled local model first (shipped with exe)
        model_path_or_name = self._find_local_model(model_size) or model_size
        if model_path_or_name != model_size:
            logger.info("Using bundled local model: %s", model_path_or_name)

        logger.info("Loading faster-whisper model=%s device=%s compute=%s",
                     model_path_or_name, device, compute_type)

        try:
            self._cached_model = WhisperModel(
                model_path_or_name, device=device, compute_type=compute_type,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            # OOM or model not found — try fallback
            from cutclipshort.core.quality_tiers import get_whisper_fallback
            fallback = get_whisper_fallback(model_size)
            if fallback:
                logger.warning(
                    "Failed to load %s (%s): %s — falling back to %s",
                    model_size, compute_type, e, fallback,
                )
                fallback_path = self._find_local_model(fallback) or fallback
                self._cached_model = WhisperModel(
                    fallback_path, device=device, compute_type=compute_type,
                )
                model_size = fallback
            else:
                raise

        self._cached_model_size = model_size
        self._cached_compute_type = compute_type
        return self._cached_model

    def _transcribe_faster(
        self, audio_path: Path, model_size: str,
        language: str, word_timestamps: bool,
    ) -> TranscriptResult:
        """Transcribe using faster-whisper with per-language optimization."""
        model = self._get_or_load_model_faster(model_size)

        # Get language-specific parameters
        params = _LANG_PARAMS.get(language, _LANG_PARAMS_DEFAULT).copy()
        params["language"] = language
        params["word_timestamps"] = word_timestamps

        # Anti-hallucination hardening (faster-whisper only). Suppresses the
        # model echoing its own initial_prompt or repeating phrases over
        # music/SFX/silence (e.g. nerf-gun action with no clear narration).
        params.setdefault("no_speech_threshold", 0.6)
        params.setdefault("compression_ratio_threshold", 2.4)
        params.setdefault("log_prob_threshold", -1.0)

        segments_gen, info = model.transcribe(str(audio_path), **params)

        segments = []
        for seg in segments_gen:
            seg_dict: dict[str, Any] = {
                "start": seg.start,
                "end": seg.end,
                "text": seg.text.strip(),
            }
            if word_timestamps and seg.words:
                seg_dict["words"] = [
                    {
                        "word": w.word.strip(),
                        "start": w.start,
                        "end": w.end,
                        "confidence": round(w.probability, 3),
                    }
                    for w in seg.words
                ]
            segments.append(seg_dict)

        return TranscriptResult(
            language=info.language,
            segments=segments,
            duration_sec=info.duration,
        )

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # OPENAI-WHISPER BACKEND
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    def _get_or_load_model_openai(self, model_size: str):
        """Load openai-whisper model with caching.

        Note: openai-whisper does NOT support compute_type parameter.
        It auto-selects fp16 on CUDA, fp32 on CPU.
        """
        if self._cached_model and self._cached_model_size == model_size:
            return self._cached_model

        # Release old model
        if self._cached_model is not None:
            del self._cached_model
            self._cached_model = None

        if self._compute_type not in ("auto", ""):
            logger.info("openai-whisper does not support compute_type='%s' — using auto detection",
                        self._compute_type)

        import whisper
        logger.info("Loading openai-whisper model=%s (compute_type=auto)", model_size)
        try:
            self._cached_model = whisper.load_model(model_size)
        except Exception as e:
            from cutclipshort.core.quality_tiers import get_whisper_fallback
            fallback = get_whisper_fallback(model_size)
            if fallback:
                logger.warning("Failed to load %s: %s — falling back to %s", model_size, e, fallback)
                self._cached_model = whisper.load_model(fallback)
                model_size = fallback
            else:
                raise
        self._cached_model_size = model_size
        return self._cached_model

    def _transcribe_openai(
        self, audio_path: Path, model_size: str,
        language: str, word_timestamps: bool,
    ) -> TranscriptResult:
        """Transcribe using openai-whisper with per-language optimization."""
        model = self._get_or_load_model_openai(model_size)

        params = _LANG_PARAMS.get(language, _LANG_PARAMS_DEFAULT).copy()
        # openai-whisper doesn't support vad_filter/vad_parameters
        params.pop("vad_filter", None)
        params.pop("vad_parameters", None)
        params["language"] = language
        params["word_timestamps"] = word_timestamps

        result = model.transcribe(str(audio_path), **params)

        segments = []
        for seg in result.get("segments", []):
            seg_dict: dict[str, Any] = {
                "start": seg["start"],
                "end": seg["end"],
                "text": seg["text"].strip(),
            }
            if "words" in seg:
                seg_dict["words"] = [
                    {
                        "word": w["word"].strip(),
                        "start": w["start"],
                        "end": w["end"],
                        "confidence": round(w.get("probability", 0.0), 3),
                    }
                    for w in seg["words"]
                ]
            segments.append(seg_dict)

        return TranscriptResult(
            language=result.get("language", language),
            segments=segments,
            duration_sec=0.0,
        )

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # POST-PROCESSING
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    def _postprocess_segments(
        self, segments: list[dict], language: str,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Apply language-specific post-processing to all segments."""
        result = []
        for seg in segments:
            text = seg["text"]

            # Filter hallucinations (text patterns + prompt-echo)
            if self._is_hallucination(text, language):
                logger.debug("Filtered hallucination: '%s'", text[:50])
                continue

            # Filter low-confidence segments. Whisper bia chu tren audio
            # nhac/SFX/im lang co confidence gan 0 (vd nerf-gun action).
            if self._is_low_confidence_segment(seg):
                logger.debug("Filtered low-confidence segment: '%s'", text[:50])
                continue

            # Apply language-specific fixes
            if language == "vi":
                text = self._fix_vietnamese(text)
            elif language == "en":
                text = self._fix_english(text)

            # Skip empty segments after processing
            text = text.strip()
            if not text:
                continue

            seg = dict(seg)  # Copy to avoid mutating original
            seg["text"] = text

            # Also fix word-level text (for subtitle sync accuracy)
            # IMPORTANT: Only apply d→đ and abbreviation fixes to words.
            # Do NOT apply capitalization or period-adding — those are
            # sentence-level fixes that break word-level display.
            if "words" in seg and language == "vi":
                fixed_words = []
                for w in seg["words"]:
                    w = dict(w)
                    w["word"] = self._fix_vietnamese_word(w.get("word", ""))
                    fixed_words.append(w)
                seg["words"] = fixed_words

            result.append(seg)

        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _is_hallucination(text: str, language: str) -> bool:
        """Detect Whisper hallucination patterns (expanded v2)."""
        text_lower = text.strip().lower()
        if not text_lower:
            return True

        # Repeated words (3+ times = hallucination)
        words = text_lower.split()
        if len(words) >= 3 and len(set(words)) == 1:
            return True

        # Mostly repeated (80%+ same word in 5+ word segment)
        if len(words) >= 5:
            most_common = max(set(words), key=words.count)
            if words.count(most_common) / len(words) >= 0.8:
                return True

        # Very short filler segments (1-2 chars only)
        if len(text_lower) <= 2 and text_lower in ("ừ", "uh", "hm", "à", "ờ", "ơ"):
            return True

        # Prompt-echo: Whisper nha lai chinh initial_prompt khi khong co thoai.
        # Vd: "Transcribe accurately with proper punctuation and capitalization."
        # hoac "This is a video with English subtitles."
        _PROMPT_ECHO_MARKERS = (
            "transcribe accurately",
            "proper punctuation",
            "punctuation and capitalization",
            "this is a video with english subtitles",
            "phien am chinh xac",
            "ban ghi chep tieng viet",
        )
        for marker in _PROMPT_ECHO_MARKERS:
            if marker in text_lower:
                return True

        # Known hallucination phrases
        if language == "vi":
            for h in _VI_HALLUCINATIONS:
                if h.lower() in text_lower:
                    return True
        elif language == "en":
            en_hallucinations = [
                "thank you for watching",
                "please subscribe",
                "like and subscribe",
            ]
            for h in en_hallucinations:
                if h in text_lower:
                    return True

        return False

    @staticmethod
    def _is_low_confidence_segment(seg: dict, threshold: float = 0.30) -> bool:
        """Detect hallucinated segments via near-zero word confidence.

        Real speech from large-v3 averages 0.6-0.95 per word. Hallucinations
        on music/SFX/silence average < 0.1. We drop a segment only when it has
        enough words (>=3) to judge reliably, so genuine short interjections
        ("Yes!", "Wow") are never removed.
        """
        words = seg.get("words") or []
        confs = [
            float(w.get("confidence", 0.0))
            for w in words
            if (w.get("word") or "").strip()
        ]
        if len(confs) < 3:
            return False  # Not enough data — keep (avoid dropping real short segs)
        avg_conf = sum(confs) / len(confs)
        return avg_conf < threshold

    @staticmethod
    def _fix_vietnamese(text: str) -> str:
        """Fix common Whisper errors in Vietnamese.

        Main fixes:
        1. d → đ correction (Whisper's #1 Vietnamese error)
        2. Abbreviation expansion
        3. Punctuation normalization
        4. Capitalization
        """
        if not text:
            return text

        # Pad with spaces for word-boundary matching
        padded = f" {text} "

        # ── Fix d → đ (word-boundary safe) ──
        for wrong, right in _VI_D_TO_Đ.items():
            # Match as whole word (case-insensitive for first char)
            padded = re.sub(
                rf'(?<=\s){re.escape(wrong)}(?=[\s.,!?])',
                right, padded, flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )

        # ── Fix abbreviations (whole-word only) ──
        for abbr, full in _VI_ABBREVIATIONS.items():
            padded = re.sub(
                rf'(?<=\s){re.escape(abbr)}(?=[\s.,!?])',
                full, padded, flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )

        text = padded.strip()

        # ── Capitalization ──
        if text:
            # Capitalize first character
            text = text[0].upper() + text[1:]
            # Capitalize after sentence-ending punctuation
            text = re.sub(
                r'([.!?]\s+)(\w)',
                lambda m: m.group(1) + m.group(2).upper(),
                text,
            )

        # ── Punctuation cleanup ──
        text = re.sub(r' +', ' ', text)           # Double spaces
        text = re.sub(r' ([.!?,])', r'\1', text)  # Space before punct
        text = text.strip()

        # Add period if missing at end
        if text and text[-1] not in ".!?…":
            text += "."

        return text

    @staticmethod
    def _fix_vietnamese_word(word: str) -> str:
        """Fix d→đ and abbreviations for a SINGLE WORD only.

        Unlike _fix_vietnamese(), this does NOT:
        - Add period at end (would produce "Rằng." "Họ." "Không.")
        - Capitalize first letter (would capitalize every word)
        - Normalize punctuation across sentence boundaries

        Only applies safe word-level corrections:
        1. d → đ mapping (if exact match)
        2. Abbreviation expansion (if exact match)
        """
        if not word:
            return word
        stripped = word.strip()
        if not stripped:
            return word

        # Check d→đ mapping (case-insensitive)
        lower = stripped.lower()
        if lower in _VI_D_TO_Đ:
            # Preserve original casing pattern
            replacement = _VI_D_TO_Đ[lower]
            if stripped[0].isupper():
                replacement = replacement[0].upper() + replacement[1:]
            return replacement

        # Check abbreviation mapping
        if lower in _VI_ABBREVIATIONS:
            return _VI_ABBREVIATIONS[lower]

        return word

    @staticmethod
    def _fix_english(text: str) -> str:
        """Fix common Whisper errors in English.

        Light-touch fixes (Whisper is generally good at English):
        1. Capitalization (first letter, after period)
        2. Punctuation
        3. Common contractions
        """
        if not text:
            return text

        # Capitalize first letter
        text = text[0].upper() + text[1:] if text else text

        # Capitalize after sentence-ending punctuation
        text = re.sub(
            r'([.!?]\s+)(\w)',
            lambda m: m.group(1) + m.group(2).upper(),
            text,
        )

        # Capitalize "I" as standalone word
        text = re.sub(r'\bi\b', 'I', text)

        # Punctuation cleanup
        text = re.sub(r' +', ' ', text)
        text = re.sub(r' ([.!?,])', r'\1', text)
        text = text.strip()

        if text and text[-1] not in ".!?…":
            text += "."

        return text

    def _find_local_model(self, model_size: str) -> str | None:
        """Find a bundled whisper model in the app's models/ directory.

        Search order (for requested model_size, then smaller fallbacks):
        1. <app_root>/models/faster-whisper-<size>/  (bundled with exe)
        2. <app_root>/models/whisper-<size>/
        3. Fallback to smaller models: medium → base → small → tiny
        4. None (will download from HuggingFace)

        A valid local model directory must have 'model.bin' with size > 1MB.
        """
        import sys
        from pathlib import Path

        if getattr(sys, 'frozen', False):
            app_root = Path(sys.executable).parent
        else:
            app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent

        # Fallback chain: try requested size first, then smaller models
        _FALLBACK_ORDER = {
            "large-v3": ["large-v3", "medium", "base", "small", "tiny"],
            "medium": ["medium", "base", "small", "tiny"],
            "small": ["small", "base", "tiny"],
            "base": ["base", "tiny"],
            "tiny": ["tiny"],
        }
        sizes_to_try = _FALLBACK_ORDER.get(model_size, [model_size, "base", "tiny"])

        for size in sizes_to_try:
            search_names = [
                f"faster-whisper-{size}",
                f"whisper-{size}",
                size,
            ]
            for name in search_names:
                model_dir = app_root / "models" / name
                model_bin = model_dir / "model.bin"
                if model_dir.is_dir() and model_bin.exists():
                    # Verify model.bin is not empty (symlink copy bug)
                    if model_bin.stat().st_size > 1_000_000:  # > 1MB
                        if size != model_size:
                            logger.info("Local model '%s' not found, using '%s' instead: %s",
                                        model_size, size, model_dir)
                        else:
                            logger.info("Found local model: %s", model_dir)
                        return str(model_dir)
                    else:
                        logger.warning("Model file too small (corrupt?): %s (%d bytes)",
                                       model_bin, model_bin.stat().st_size)

        logger.warning("No local model found for '%s' in %s/models/", model_size, app_root)
        return None

    def available_models(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["tiny", "base", "small", "medium", "large-v3"]
