function removeEdgeFromGraph(nodes:CanvasNode[],edges:CanvasEdge[],edgeId:string){
  const edge=edges.find(item=>item.id===edgeId);if(!edge)return {nodes,edges}
  const cleaned=nodes.map(node=>{if(node.id!==edge.target||!edge.targetHandle)return node
    const params={...((node.data.params??{}) as Record<string,unknown>)};const reference=`$${edge.source}.${edge.sourceHandle}`
    if(params[edge.targetHandle]===reference)delete params[edge.targetHandle]
    else if(Array.isArray(params[edge.targetHandle])){
      const values=(params[edge.targetHandle] as unknown[]).filter(value=>value!==reference)
      if(values.length)params[edge.targetHandle]=values;else delete params[edge.targetHandle]
    }
    return {...node,data:{...node.data,params}}
  })
  return {nodes:cleaned,edges:edges.filter(item=>item.id!==edgeId)}
}

function connectGraph(nodes:CanvasNode[],edges:CanvasEdge[],connection:Connection,
                      byName:Map<string,PaletteTool>){
  const sourceNode=nodes.find(node=>node.id===connection.source);const targetNode=nodes.find(node=>node.id===connection.target)
  const sourceTool=byName.get(String(sourceNode?.data.tool));const targetTool=byName.get(String(targetNode?.data.tool))
  if(!connectionAllowed(sourceTool,connection.sourceHandle,targetTool,connection.targetHandle)||
      connectionCreatesCycle(edges,connection.source!,connection.target!))return undefined
  const sourceHandle=connection.sourceHandle!;const targetHandle=connection.targetHandle!
  const output=sourceTool!.returns[sourceHandle];const input=targetTool!.params_schema[targetHandle]
  const variadic=Boolean(input.type.endsWith('[]')&&output===input.type.slice(0,-2))
  const sameInput=edges.filter(edge=>edge.target===connection.target&&edge.targetHandle===targetHandle)
  const retained=variadic?sameInput.filter(edge=>{
    const tool=byName.get(String(nodes.find(node=>node.id===edge.source)?.data.tool))
    return tool?.returns[edge.sourceHandle??'']===output&&!(edge.source===connection.source&&edge.sourceHandle===sourceHandle)
  }):[]
  const available=edges.filter(edge=>!(edge.target===connection.target&&edge.targetHandle===targetHandle)).concat(retained)
  const nextEdges=addEdge({...connection,id:`${connection.source}-${sourceHandle}-${connection.target}-${targetHandle}`},available) as CanvasEdge[]
  const references=[...retained.map(edge=>`$${edge.source}.${edge.sourceHandle}`),`$${connection.source}.${sourceHandle}`]
  const nextNodes=nodes.map(node=>node.id===connection.target?{...node,data:{...node.data,params:{...(node.data.params as object??{}),
    [targetHandle]:variadic?[...new Set(references)]:`$${connection.source}.${sourceHandle}`}}}:node)
  return {nodes:nextNodes,edges:nextEdges}
}

function uniqueNodeLabel(node:CanvasNode,nodes:CanvasNode[],byName:Map<string,PaletteTool>){
  const base=node.label?.trim()||customerToolLabel(byName.get(String(node.data.tool)))
  const peers=nodes.filter(item=>(item.label?.trim()||customerToolLabel(byName.get(String(item.data.tool))))===base)
  return peers.length>1?`${base} ${peers.findIndex(item=>item.id===node.id)+1}`:base
}

    cancelled:'Đã hủy',scheduled:'Đã lên lịch'} as Record<string,string>)[status]??status
}

  const insertToolOnEdge=useCallback((tool:PaletteTool,edgeId:string,position:{x:number;y:number})=>{
    if(readOnly)return
    const old=page.edges.find(edge=>edge.id===edgeId);if(!old||!old.sourceHandle||!old.targetHandle)return
    const sourceNode=page.nodes.find(node=>node.id===old.source);const targetNode=page.nodes.find(node=>node.id===old.target)
    const sourceTool=byName.get(String(sourceNode?.data.tool));const targetTool=byName.get(String(targetNode?.data.tool))
    const inputHandle=Object.keys(tool.params_schema).find(field=>connectionAllowed(sourceTool,old.sourceHandle!,tool,field))
    const candidateOutput=primaryOutputHandle(tool)
    const outputHandle=candidateOutput&&connectionAllowed(tool,candidateOutput,targetTool,old.targetHandle!)?candidateOutput:undefined
    if(!inputHandle||!outputHandle)return
    const node=nextNode(tool,page.nodes.length);node.position=position
    const inputRule=tool.params_schema[inputHandle];const sourceKind=sourceTool?.returns[old.sourceHandle]
    node.data.params={...((node.data.params??{}) as Record<string,unknown>),[inputHandle]:
      inputRule.type.endsWith('[]')&&sourceKind===inputRule.type.slice(0,-2)?[`$${old.source}.${old.sourceHandle}`]:`$${old.source}.${old.sourceHandle}`}
    const nodes=page.nodes.map(item=>{if(item.id!==old.target)return item
      const params={...((item.data.params??{}) as Record<string,unknown>)};const before=`$${old.source}.${old.sourceHandle}`;const after=`$${node.id}.${outputHandle}`
      if(params[old.targetHandle!]===before)params[old.targetHandle!]=after
      else if(Array.isArray(params[old.targetHandle!]))params[old.targetHandle!]=(params[old.targetHandle!] as unknown[]).map(value=>value===before?after:value)
      return {...item,data:{...item.data,params}}
    })
    const edges=page.edges.filter(edge=>edge.id!==old.id).concat([
      {id:`${old.source}-${old.sourceHandle}-${node.id}-${inputHandle}`,source:old.source,sourceHandle:old.sourceHandle,target:node.id,targetHandle:inputHandle},
      {id:`${node.id}-${outputHandle}-${old.target}-${old.targetHandle}`,source:node.id,sourceHandle:outputHandle,target:old.target,targetHandle:old.targetHandle},
    ])
    dispatch({type:'graph',nodes:[...nodes,node],edges});dispatch({type:'select',id:node.id});setSelected([node.id]);setEdgeInsert(null)
  },[readOnly,page,byName])

  const addConnectedTool=useCallback((tool:PaletteTool,sourceId:string,sourceHandle:string,position:{x:number;y:number})=>{

  const prepareScope=useCallback(async(scope:RunScope)=>{
    const activeRun=run&&!['done','error','cancelled'].includes(run.status)
    if(!workflow||readOnly||activeRun)return
    if(autosaveTimer.current)window.clearTimeout(autosaveTimer.current)
    setRun(undefined)
    setPreparedScope(scope);setRunScope(scope.mode==='frame'?`frame:${scope.frame_id}`:scope.mode)
    setDesktopPanel('run');setPhase('saving');setRunError('')
    let saved:Workflow
    try{
      saved=await saveWorkflow({...workflow,canvas:state.document},csrf)
      setPhase('saved')
    }catch(error){
      setPhase(error instanceof WorkflowConflictError?'conflict':'error')
      setRunError(error instanceof Error?error.message:'Không lưu được workflow.')
      return
    }
    try{
      const checked=await validateWorkflow(saved,csrf)
      setWorkflow(checked);setCosts(Object.fromEntries(checked.validation.step_costs.map((item:{step_id:string;maximum:number})=>[item.step_id,item.maximum])))
      const requested=scope.mode==='full'?page.nodes.map(node=>node.id):scope.mode==='frame'
        ?page.frames.find(frame=>frame.id===scope.frame_id)?.node_ids??[]
        :(scope.node_ids??[scope.node_id??'']).filter(Boolean)
      const relevantIds=new Set(scopeNodeIds(page.nodes,page.edges,requested))
      const relevantIssues=checked.validation.issues.filter((issue:{step_id:string;message:string})=>
        !issue.step_id||relevantIds.has(issue.step_id))
      setValidationIssues(relevantIssues)
      if(relevantIssues.length)return
      setRun(await createRun(checked,csrf,scope,useCache));void refreshRunHistory()
    }catch(error){
      if(error instanceof WorkflowConflictError)setPhase('conflict')
      setRunError(error instanceof Error?error.message:'Không chuẩn bị được bản chạy.')
    }
  },[workflow,readOnly,run,state.document,csrf,useCache,refreshRunHistory,page.nodes,page.edges,page.frames])

  const downstreamIds=useCallback((nodeId:string)=>{

    dispatch({type:'graph',nodes:[...page.nodes,...cloned.nodes],edges:[...page.edges,...cloned.edges]})

  },[readOnly,page])
  const disconnectInput=useCallback((edgeId:string)=>{
    if(readOnly)return
    const edge=page.edges.find(item=>item.id===edgeId);if(!edge)return
    const nodes=page.nodes.map(node=>{if(node.id!==edge.target||!edge.targetHandle)return node
      const params={...((node.data.params??{}) as Record<string,unknown>)}
      const reference=`$${edge.source}.${edge.sourceHandle}`
      if(params[edge.targetHandle]===reference)delete params[edge.targetHandle]
      else if(Array.isArray(params[edge.targetHandle])){
        const remaining=(params[edge.targetHandle] as unknown[]).filter(value=>value!==reference)
        if(remaining.length)params[edge.targetHandle]=remaining
        else delete params[edge.targetHandle]
      }
      return {...node,data:{...node.data,params}}
    })
    dispatch({type:'graph',nodes,edges:page.edges.filter(item=>item.id!==edgeId)})
  },[readOnly,page])
  const toggleErrorBranch=()=>{if(!selectedEdge||readOnly)return;const condition=selectedEdge.data?.condition==='error'?'success':'error';dispatch({type:'graph',nodes:page.nodes,edges:page.edges.map(edge=>edge.id===selectedEdge.id?{...edge,data:{...edge.data,condition}}:edge)})}
  const activateWorkflow=(next:Workflow)=>{setWorkflow(next);dispatch({type:'replace',document:next.canvas});setRun(undefined);setPreparedScope(undefined);setCosts({});setValidationIssues([]);setPhase('ready')}
  const cloneCurrent=async()=>{if(!workflow)return;try{activateWorkflow(await cloneWorkflow(workflow,csrf))}catch{setPhase('error')}}
  const downloadTemplate=async()=>{if(!workflow)return;try{const payload=await exportWorkflow(workflow);const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download=`workflow-${workflow.id}.json`;link.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url)}catch{setPhase('error')}}
  const importTemplate=async(event:React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>)=>{const file=event.target.files?.[0];if(!file)return;try{activateWorkflow(await importWorkflow(JSON.parse(await file.text()),csrf))}catch{setPhase('error')}finally{event.target.value=''}}
  const onSelectionChange = useCallback(({ nodes, edges }: { nodes: { id: string }[]; edges: { id: string }[] }) => {
    const next = nodes.map(node => node.id).sort()
    const nextEdges = edges.map(edge => edge.id).sort()
    if (nextEdges.length) dispatch({ type: 'select' })
    else if (next.length === 1) dispatch({ type: 'select', id: next[0] })
    setSelected(previous => previous.length === next.length && previous.every((id, index) => id === next[index])
      ? previous : next)
    setSelectedEdges(previous => previous.length === nextEdges.length && previous.every((id, index) => id === nextEdges[index])
      ? previous : nextEdges)
  }, [])

  const onKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const target=event.target as HTMLElement
    if(target.closest('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]'))return
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
      event.preventDefault(); setCommandOpen(true); return
    }
    if (event.key === 'Escape') { setCommandOpen(false);setShowLayers(false);setDesktopPanel(null);setContextMenu(null);setQuickCreate(null);setQuickConnect(null);
      setSelected([]);setSelectedEdges([]);dispatch({type:'select'});return }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'z') { event.preventDefault(); dispatch({ type: event.shiftKey ? 'redo' : 'undo' }); return }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'y') { event.preventDefault(); dispatch({ type: 'redo' }); return }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'd') { event.preventDefault(); duplicate(); return }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'c') {
      const ids=new Set(selected);copied.current={nodes:page.nodes.filter(node=>ids.has(node.id)).map(node=>structuredClone(node)),
        edges:page.edges.filter(edge=>ids.has(edge.source)&&ids.has(edge.target)).map(edge=>structuredClone(edge))};return
    }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'v') { event.preventDefault(); paste();return }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
      event.preventDefault();setSelected(page.nodes.map(node=>node.id));setSelectedEdges([]);dispatch({type:'select'});return
    }
    if(!event.ctrlKey&&!event.metaKey&&!event.altKey){
      const key=event.key.toLowerCase();const mode=({i:'image',v:'video',t:'text',a:'audio'} as Record<string,string>)[key]
      const tool=mode&&palette.find(item=>nodeModality(item)===mode&&item.primary)
        ||mode&&palette.find(item=>nodeModality(item)===mode)

        dispatch({type:'graph',nodes:page.nodes.map(node=>selected.includes(node.id)?{...node,position:{x:node.position.x+movement.x,y:node.position.y+movement.y}}:node),edges:page.edges});return
      }

          <button disabled={readOnly} onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'noteAdd',text:'Ghi chú mới'})}>+ Sticky note</button>
          <button disabled={readOnly} onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'commentAdd',text:'Bình luận mới'})}>+ Comment</button>
          {!!page.frames.length&&<ul>{page.frames.map(frame=><li key={frame.id}><input aria-label={`Đổi tên ${frame.name}`}
            value={frame.name} disabled={readOnly} onChange={event=>dispatch({type:'frameRename',id:frame.id,name:event.target.value})}/>
            <small>{frame.node_ids.length} node</small>{workflow&&<a aria-label={`Xuất ${frame.name}`}
              href={`/agent/api/workflows/${workflow.id}/frames/${frame.id}/export`}>↓</a>}<button aria-label={`Xóa ${frame.name}`} disabled={readOnly}
              onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'frameDelete',id:frame.id})}>×</button></li>)}</ul>}
          {!!page.notes.length&&<ul>{page.notes.map(note=><li key={note.id}><label>NOTE<input aria-label="Nội dung sticky note"
            value={note.text} disabled={readOnly} onChange={event=>dispatch({type:'annotationUpdate',kind:'notes',id:note.id,text:event.target.value})}/></label>
            <button aria-label="Xóa sticky note" disabled={readOnly} onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'annotationDelete',kind:'notes',id:note.id})}>×</button></li>)}</ul>}
          {!!page.comments.length&&<ul>{page.comments.map(comment=><li key={comment.id}><label>COMMENT<input aria-label="Nội dung comment"
            value={comment.text} disabled={readOnly} onChange={event=>dispatch({type:'annotationUpdate',kind:'comments',id:comment.id,text:event.target.value})}/></label>
            <button aria-label="Xóa comment" disabled={readOnly} onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'annotationDelete',kind:'comments',id:comment.id})}>×</button></li>)}</ul>}
        </section><h2>Công cụ</h2>
        <div className="workflow-settings"><p className="routing-note">AUTO ROUTING · {catalogMeta.models} model · {catalogMeta.routing||'managed'}</p><label>Mục tiêu workflow<textarea disabled={readOnly}
          value={state.document.goal} onChange={event => dispatch({ type: 'document', goal: event.target.value })} /></label>
          <label>Ngân sách tối đa<input type="number" min="5" disabled={readOnly}
            value={state.document.budget_max_credit} onChange={event => dispatch({ type: 'document', budget_max_credit: Number(event.target.value) })} /></label>
          <button disabled={readOnly || state.document.goal.trim().length < 10} onClick={async () => {
            try { setPhase('loading'); const planned = await planWorkflow(state.document.goal,
              state.document.budget_max_credit, csrf); setWorkflow(planned)
              dispatch({ type: 'replace', document: planned.canvas }); setRun(undefined); setCosts({}); setPhase('ready')
            } catch { setPhase('error') }
          }}>AI dựng Canvas</button><div className="template-actions"><button disabled={readOnly||!workflow} onClick={cloneCurrent}>Nhân workflow</button><button disabled={!workflow} onClick={downloadTemplate}>Xuất mẫu</button><label>Nhập mẫu<input type="file" accept="application/json,.json" onChange={importTemplate}/></label></div></div>
        {Object.entries(groups).map(([group, tools]) => <section key={group}><h3>{group}</h3>
        {tools?.map(tool => <button key={tool.name} draggable={!readOnly} disabled={readOnly}
          onDragStart={event => event.dataTransfer.setData('application/ltt-tool', tool.name)} onClick={() => addTool(tool)}
          aria-label={`Thêm ${customerToolLabel(tool)}`}><strong>{customerToolLabel(tool)}</strong><small>{tool.description}</small></button>)}</section>)}</aside>
      <main className="canvas-stage" data-testid="canvas-stage" data-edge-count={page.edges.length} data-display-edge-count={displayEdges.length} onDragOver={event => event.preventDefault()}
        onContextMenu={event=>{if((event.target as HTMLElement).closest('.react-flow__node,.canvas-context-menu'))return
          event.preventDefault();setQuickCreate(null);const screen={x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY}
          setContextMenu({kind:'pane',x:screen.x,y:screen.y,flow:reactFlow.screenToFlowPosition(screen)})}}
        onDrop={event => { const tool = byName.get(event.dataTransfer.getData('application/ltt-tool')); if (tool) addTool(tool, reactFlow.screenToFlowPosition({ x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY })) }}>
        <ReactFlow key={page.id} nodes={displayNodes as CanvasNode[]} edges={displayEdges} nodeTypes={nodeTypes} edgeTypes={edgeTypes}
          onNodesChange={(changes: NodeChange[]) => { const persisted = changes.filter(change => ['position', 'add', 'remove', 'replace'].includes(change.type));
            if (persisted.length) dispatch({ type: persisted.every(change => change.type === 'position') ? 'sync' : 'graph', nodes: applyNodeChanges(persisted, page.nodes) as CanvasNode[], edges: page.edges }) }}
          onEdgesChange={(changes: EdgeChange[]) => { const persisted = changes.filter(change => ['add', 'remove', 'replace'].includes(change.type));
            if (persisted.length) dispatch({ type: 'graph', nodes: page.nodes, edges: applyEdgeChanges(persisted, page.edges) as CanvasEdge[] }) }}
          onConnect={onConnect} onReconnect={onReconnectEdge} edgesReconnectable={!readOnly} onConnectEnd={(event,connectionState)=>{
            if(connectionState.isValid||connectionState.toNode||!connectionState.fromNode||connectionState.fromHandle?.type!=='source')return
            const point='changedTouches' in event&&event.changedTouches.length?event.changedTouches[0]:event as MouseEvent
            const screen={x:point.clientX,y:point.clientY};setContextMenu(null)
            setQuickCreate({sourceId:connectionState.fromNode.id,sourceHandle:connectionState.fromHandle.id??'',x:screen.x,y:screen.y,
              flow:reactFlow.screenToFlowPosition(screen)})
          }} onNodeClick={(event, node) => {const additive=event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey||event.shiftKey
            setContextMenu(null);setQuickCreate(null);setSelectedEdges([]);setDesktopPanel(null)
            setSelected(previous=>additive?(previous.includes(node.id)?previous.filter(id=>id!==node.id):[...previous,node.id]):[node.id])
            dispatch({ type: 'select', id: node.id }) }}
          onNodeContextMenu={(event,node)=>{event.preventDefault();setQuickCreate(null);setSelected([node.id]);dispatch({type:'select',id:node.id});
            setContextMenu({kind:'node',nodeId:node.id,x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY,flow:node.position})}}
          onPaneContextMenu={event=>{event.preventDefault();setQuickCreate(null);const screen={x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY};
            setContextMenu({kind:'pane',x:screen.x,y:screen.y,flow:reactFlow.screenToFlowPosition(screen)})}}
          onEdgeClick={(_event, edge) => { setSelected([]); setSelectedEdges([edge.id]); dispatch({ type: 'select' }) }}
          onNodeDragStart={() => { dragBefore.current = structuredClone(state.document) }}
          onNodeDragStop={() => { if (dragBefore.current) dispatch({ type: 'commit', before: dragBefore.current }); dragBefore.current = undefined }}
          onPaneClick={() => { setContextMenu(null);setQuickCreate(null);setSelected([]); setSelectedEdges([]); dispatch({ type: 'select' }) }} onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
          onMoveEnd={(_event, viewport) => dispatch({ type: 'viewport', viewport })}
          nodesDraggable={!readOnly} nodesConnectable={!readOnly} elementsSelectable
          multiSelectionKeyCode={['Control','Meta']} selectionOnDrag panOnDrag={[1,2]}
          defaultViewport={page.viewport} minZoom={0.1} maxZoom={2}
          fitView={!page.nodes.length} deleteKeyCode={null}>
          <FlowStatus />
          {showGrid&&<Background color={theme==='light'?'#d8dde5':'#242a31'} gap={20} />}{showMinimap&&<MiniMap pannable zoomable />}<Controls showInteractive={!readOnly} />
        </ReactFlow>
        {!page.nodes.length && <section className="canvas-empty first-run" aria-label="Bắt đầu workflow"><small>3 BƯỚC ĐẦU TIÊN</small><h2>Tạo kết quả đầu tiên</h2><ol><li>Chọn một mẫu</li><li>Nhập hoặc tải nội dung</li><li>Kiểm tra chi phí trước khi chạy</li></ol><div className="starter-flows">
          <button onClick={()=>applyStarterFlow('text-image')}><strong>Prompt thành hình ảnh</strong><span>Viết một lần, tạo ảnh từ nội dung đó</span></button>
          <button onClick={()=>applyStarterFlow('image-text')}><strong>Hiểu nội dung hình ảnh</strong><span>Tải hoặc tạo ảnh, rồi yêu cầu AI phân tích</span></button>
          <button onClick={()=>applyStarterFlow('image-video')}><strong>Ảnh thành video</strong><span>Dùng ảnh làm khung đầu cho video</span></button>
          <button className="blank-flow" onClick={()=>setDesktopPanel('tools')}>Bắt đầu với Canvas trống</button></div></section>}
        {!!validationIssues.length && <div className="validation-banner" role="alert"><strong>Workflow chưa hợp lệ</strong>
          <span>{validationIssues.slice(0, 3).map(issue => issue.message).join(' · ')}</span></div>}
        {showLayers&&<aside className="layers-drawer" aria-label="Danh sách lớp"><header><strong>Lớp · {page.name}</strong>
          <button aria-label="Đóng danh sách lớp" onClick={()=>setShowLayers(false)}>×</button></header>
          <ul>{page.frames.map(frame=><li key={frame.id}><span>FRAME</span>{frame.name}</li>)}
            {page.nodes.map(node=><li key={node.id}><button onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'select',id:node.id})}><span>KHỐI</span>{uniqueNodeLabel(node,page.nodes,byName)}</button></li>)}
            {page.notes.map(note=><li key={note.id}><span>NOTE</span>{note.text}</li>)}
            {page.comments.map(comment=><li key={comment.id}><span>COMMENT</span>{comment.text}</li>)}</ul></aside>}
      </main>
      <nav className="page-dock" aria-label="Chuyển page">{state.document.pages.map(item=><button
        key={item.id} aria-pressed={item.id===page.id} onClick={()=>dispatch({type:'pageSelect',id:item.id})}>{item.name}</button>)}</nav>
      {quickConnect&&<aside className="quick-connect-picker" aria-label="Chọn bước tiếp theo"><header><div><small>BƯỚC TIẾP THEO TỪ</small><strong>{(()=>{const source=page.nodes.find(node=>node.id===quickConnect.sourceId);const sourceTool=byName.get(String(source?.data.tool));return outputLabel(quickConnect.sourceHandle,String(sourceTool?.returns[quickConnect.sourceHandle]??''))})()}</strong></div><button aria-label="Đóng chọn bước tiếp theo" onClick={()=>setQuickConnect(null)}>×</button></header>
        {!!quickOptions.length&&<section><small>NỐI VỚI BLOCK ĐÃ CÓ</small>{quickOptions.map(option=><button key={`${option.targetId}-${option.targetHandle}`} onClick={()=>{onConnect({source:quickConnect.sourceId,sourceHandle:quickConnect.sourceHandle,target:option.targetId,targetHandle:option.targetHandle});setQuickConnect(null)}}>{option.label}</button>)}</section>}
        {!!quickNewOptions.length&&<section><small>TẠO BLOCK MỚI</small>{quickNewOptions.map(tool=>{const source=page.nodes.find(node=>node.id===quickConnect.sourceId);const sourceTool=byName.get(String(source?.data.tool));return <button key={tool.name} onClick={()=>{addConnectedTool(tool,quickConnect.sourceId,quickConnect.sourceHandle,{x:(source?.position.x??0)+420,y:source?.position.y??0});setQuickConnect(null)}}><strong>{destinationLabel(sourceTool,quickConnect.sourceHandle,tool)}</strong><span>{categoryLabels[tool.category??'advanced']}</span></button>})}</section>}
        {!quickOptions.length&&!quickNewOptions.length&&<p>Không có bước tương thích với nội dung này.</p>}</aside>}
      {quickCreate&&<aside className="quick-create-picker" aria-label="Tạo block đích tương thích" style={{left:Math.min(quickCreate.x,window.innerWidth-320),top:Math.min(quickCreate.y,window.innerHeight-420)}}>
        <header><div><small>BƯỚC TIẾP THEO</small><strong>Chọn kết quả muốn tạo</strong></div><button aria-label="Đóng tạo block nhanh" onClick={()=>setQuickCreate(null)}>×</button></header>
        {quickCreateOptions.length?<div>{quickCreateOptions.map(tool=>{const source=page.nodes.find(node=>node.id===quickCreate.sourceId);const sourceTool=byName.get(String(source?.data.tool));return <button key={tool.name} onClick={()=>addConnectedTool(tool,quickCreate.sourceId,quickCreate.sourceHandle,quickCreate.flow)}><strong>{destinationLabel(sourceTool,quickCreate.sourceHandle,tool)}</strong><small>{categoryLabels[tool.category??'advanced']}</small></button>})}</div>:<p>Không có bước tương thích với nội dung này.</p>}
      </aside>}
      {edgeInsert&&<aside className="quick-create-picker edge-insert-picker" aria-label="Chèn bước vào kết nối"
        style={{left:Math.min(edgeInsert.x,window.innerWidth-320),top:Math.min(edgeInsert.y,window.innerHeight-420)}}>
        <header><div><small>CHÈN BƯỚC</small><strong>Chọn hành động tương thích</strong></div><button aria-label="Đóng chèn bước" onClick={()=>setEdgeInsert(null)}>×</button></header>
        {insertOptions.length?<div>{insertOptions.map(tool=><button key={tool.name}
          onClick={()=>insertToolOnEdge(tool,edgeInsert.edgeId,edgeInsert.flow)}><strong>{customerToolLabel(tool)}</strong><small>{tool.description}</small></button>)}</div>:
          <p>Không có bước trung gian tương thích với kết nối này.</p>}
      </aside>}
      {contextMenu&&<aside className={`canvas-context-menu ${contextMenu.kind}`} aria-label={contextMenu.kind==='pane'?'Menu khoảng trống Canvas':'Menu thao tác node'}
        style={{left:Math.min(contextMenu.x,window.innerWidth-310),top:Math.min(contextMenu.y,window.innerHeight-520)}}>
        <header><strong>{contextMenu.kind==='pane'?'Thêm vào Canvas':'Thao tác node'}</strong><button aria-label="Đóng menu ngữ cảnh" onClick={()=>setContextMenu(null)}>×</button></header>
        {contextMenu.kind==='pane'?<><div className="context-tool-list">{customerPaletteTools(palette,catalogMode==='advanced').map(tool=><button key={tool.name} onClick={()=>{addTool(tool,contextMenu.flow);setContextMenu(null)}}><strong>{customerToolLabel(tool)}</strong><small>{categoryLabels[tool.category??'advanced']}</small></button>)}</div>
          <hr/><button onClick={()=>{dispatch({type:'pageView',connections:!showConnections});setContextMenu(null)}}>{showConnections?'Ẩn đường nối':'Hiện đường nối'}</button>
          <button onClick={()=>{dispatch({type:'layout'});setContextMenu(null)}}>Tự động sắp xếp node</button></>:
          <>{contextMenu.nodeId&&<><button disabled={readOnly||Boolean(run&&!terminalRun)} onClick={()=>{setRunScope('node');void prepareScope({mode:'node',node_id:contextMenu.nodeId});setContextMenu(null)}}>Báo giá & chạy block này</button>
            <button disabled={readOnly||Boolean(run&&!terminalRun)} onClick={()=>{setRunScope('selection');void prepareScope({mode:'selection',node_ids:downstreamIds(contextMenu.nodeId!)});setContextMenu(null)}}>Báo giá & chạy từ đây</button>
            <button disabled={readOnly} onClick={()=>{duplicateNode(contextMenu.nodeId!);setContextMenu(null)}}>Sao chép node</button>
            {state.document.pages.filter(item=>item.id!==page.id).map(item=><button key={item.id} disabled={readOnly}
              onClick={()=>{dispatch({type:'nodeMovePage',id:contextMenu.nodeId!,pageId:item.id});setContextMenu(null)}}>Chuyển sang {item.name}</button>)}
            <button className="danger" disabled={readOnly} onClick={()=>{dispatch({type:'delete',ids:[contextMenu.nodeId!]});setSelected([]);setContextMenu(null)}}>Xóa node</button></>}</>}
      </aside>}
      {selectedNode&&presentationMode==='legacy'&&<ContextComposer node={selectedNode} tool={byName.get(String(selectedNode.data.tool))} readOnly={readOnly} presentationMode={presentationMode}
        onClose={()=>{setSelected([]);dispatch({type:'select'})}} onAdvanced={()=>setDesktopPanel('inspector')}
        onRun={()=>void prepareScope({mode:'node',node_id:selectedNode.id})} cost={liveQuotes[selectedNode.id]??costs[selectedNode.id]}
        references={referenceOptions} connectedInputs={connectedInputs} onDisconnect={disconnectInput} onReference={reference=>onConnect({source:reference.source,sourceHandle:reference.sourceHandle,
          target:selectedNode.id,targetHandle:reference.targetHandle})}
        onChange={data=>dispatch({type:'update',id:selectedNode.id,data})}/>}
      {(desktopPanel==='inspector'||mobilePanel==='inspector')&&<Inspector className={desktopPanel==='inspector'?'is-open':''} node={selectedNode} tool={selectedNode ? byName.get(String(selectedNode.data.tool)) : undefined} run={run} csrfToken={csrf}
        runHistory={runHistory} onSelectRun={id=>void loadRun(id).then(setRun).catch(()=>setRunError('Không tải được run.'))}
        onReplay={source=>void runAgain(source,csrf).then(next=>{setRun(next);void refreshRunHistory()}).catch(error=>setRunError(error instanceof Error?error.message:'Không thể replay.'))}
        onRestore={source=>void restoreRunAsWorkflow(source,csrf).then(activateWorkflow).catch(error=>setRunError(error instanceof Error?error.message:'Không thể khôi phục workflow.'))}
        readOnly={readOnly} connections={connectionOptions}
        onConnect={(field, value) => { if (!selectedNode) return; const [source, sourceHandle] = value.split('|')
          onConnect({ source, sourceHandle, target: selectedNode.id, targetHandle: field }) }}
        onChange={data => selectedNode && dispatch({ type: 'update', id: selectedNode.id, data })} />}
    </div>
    {assistantOpen&&<aside className="assistant-drawer" aria-label="Workflow Assistant"><header><strong>Workflow Assistant</strong><button aria-label="Đóng Assistant" onClick={()=>setAssistantOpen(false)}>×</button></header>
      <div className="assistant-modes"><button aria-pressed={assistantMode==='analyze'} onClick={()=>setAssistantMode('analyze')}>Phân tích</button><button aria-pressed={assistantMode==='improve'} onClick={()=>setAssistantMode('improve')}>Đề xuất cải tiến</button></div>
      {!!selected.length&&<p className="assistant-context">Ngữ cảnh: {selected.map(id=>byName.get(String(page.nodes.find(node=>node.id===id)?.data.tool))?.label??id).join(', ')}</p>}
      <textarea aria-label="Yêu cầu Assistant" value={assistantPrompt} onChange={event=>setAssistantPrompt(event.target.value)} placeholder="Ví dụ: thêm nhánh tạo giọng đọc và ghép video…"/>
      <button disabled={!workflow||assistantBusy||(assistantMode==='improve'&&assistantPrompt.trim().length<3)} onClick={async()=>{if(!workflow)return;setAssistantBusy(true);setAssistantResult({});try{const context=selected.length?`${assistantPrompt}\n\nNgữ cảnh node đã chọn: ${selected.join(', ')}`:assistantPrompt;setAssistantResult(await previewAssistant(workflow,assistantMode,context,csrf))}catch(error){setAssistantResult({error:error instanceof Error?error.message:'Assistant lỗi'})}finally{setAssistantBusy(false)}}}>{assistantBusy?'Đang phân tích…':'Tạo bản xem trước'}</button>
      {assistantResult.analysis&&<section><h3>Phân tích</h3><p>{assistantResult.analysis.nodes} node · {assistantResult.analysis.roots} đầu vào · {assistantResult.analysis.valid?'Hợp lệ':'Cần sửa'}</p>{assistantResult.analysis.issues.map(issue=><small key={issue}>{issue}</small>)}</section>}
      {assistantResult.proposal&&<section className="assistant-diff"><h3>Bản diff</h3><p>{assistantResult.proposal.diff.before_nodes} → {assistantResult.proposal.diff.after_nodes} node · tối đa {assistantResult.proposal.diff.estimated_max_credit} credit</p><button onClick={async()=>{if(!workflow||!assistantResult.proposal)return;try{activateWorkflow(await applyAssistant(workflow,assistantResult.proposal.token,csrf));setAssistantOpen(false)}catch(error){setAssistantResult(current=>({...current,error:error instanceof Error?error.message:'Không áp dụng được'}))}}}>Áp dụng bản đã xem trước</button></section>}
      {assistantResult.error&&<p className="assistant-error" role="alert">{assistantResult.error}</p>}</aside>}
    {historyOpen&&<aside className="history-drawer" aria-label="Phiên bản và chia sẻ"><header><strong>Phiên bản & chia sẻ</strong><button aria-label="Đóng phiên bản" onClick={()=>setHistoryOpen(false)}>×</button></header>
      <section><h3>Snapshot</h3>{snapshots.map(item=><div key={item.revision}><span>v{item.revision} · {item.reason}</span><button disabled={!workflow||item.revision===workflow.revision} onClick={()=>workflow&&void restoreSnapshot(workflow,item.revision,csrf).then(next=>{activateWorkflow(next);return loadSnapshots(next)}).then(setSnapshots)}>Khôi phục</button></div>)}</section>
      <section><h3>Share riêng tư · 24 giờ</h3><select aria-label="Quyền share" value={sharePermission} onChange={event=>setSharePermission(event.target.value as 'view'|'clone')}><option value="view">Chỉ xem</option><option value="clone">Xem & clone</option></select><button onClick={()=>workflow&&void createShare(workflow,sharePermission,csrf).then(result=>setSharePath(`${location.origin}${result.path}`))}>Tạo link</button>{sharePath&&<input readOnly aria-label="Link share" value={sharePath}/>}</section>
    </aside>}
    {commandOpen&&<div className="command-backdrop" role="presentation" onMouseDown={event=>event.target===event.currentTarget&&setCommandOpen(false)}>
      <section className="command-palette" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Bảng lệnh Canvas">
        <header><strong>Bảng lệnh</strong><kbd>Esc</kbd></header><input autoFocus aria-label="Tìm lệnh" value={commandQuery}
          onChange={event=>setCommandQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Tìm thao tác…"/>
        <div>{[
          {name:'Tạo page mới',run:()=>dispatch({type:'pageAdd'})},
          {name:'Tạo sticky note',run:()=>dispatch({type:'noteAdd',text:'Ghi chú mới'})},
          {name:'Tạo comment',run:()=>dispatch({type:'commentAdd',text:'Bình luận mới'})},
          {name:'Tự động sắp xếp',run:()=>dispatch({type:'layout'})},
          {name:showGrid?'Ẩn lưới':'Hiện lưới',run:()=>dispatch({type:'pageView',grid:!showGrid})},
          {name:showConnections?'Ẩn đường nối':'Hiện đường nối',run:()=>dispatch({type:'pageView',connections:!showConnections})},
          {name:showMinimap?'Ẩn bản đồ':'Hiện bản đồ',run:()=>dispatch({type:'pageView',minimap:!showMinimap})},
        ].filter(item=>item.name.toLocaleLowerCase('vi').includes(commandQuery.toLocaleLowerCase('vi')))
          .map(item=><button key={item.name} onClick={()=>{item.run();setCommandOpen(false);setCommandQuery('')}}>{item.name}</button>)}</div>
      </section></div>}
  </section>
}

function FlowStatus(){
  const edges=useStore(state=>state.edges.length)
  const nodes=useStore(state=>state.nodes.length)
  return <span className="sr-only" data-testid="flow-store-status">{nodes} node · {edges} kết nối trong renderer</span>
}

type ReferenceOption={source:string;sourceHandle:string;targetHandle:string;label:string;detail:string}
type ConnectedInput={edgeId:string;label:string;detail:string}

function ContextComposer({node,tool,readOnly,presentationMode,onChange,onAdvanced,onClose,onRun,cost,references,connectedInputs,onReference,onDisconnect}:{node:CanvasNode;tool?:PaletteTool;readOnly:boolean;presentationMode:'creative'|'legacy';
  onChange:(data:Record<string,unknown>)=>void;onAdvanced:()=>void;onClose:()=>void;onRun:()=>void;cost?:number;
  references:ReferenceOption[];connectedInputs:ConnectedInput[];onReference:(reference:ReferenceOption)=>void;onDisconnect:(edgeId:string)=>void}) {
  if(!tool)return null
  const params=(node.data.params??{}) as Record<string,unknown>
  const fields=presentationMode==='creative'?primaryFields(tool,params).slice(0,4):primaryFields(tool,params)
  const setParam=(name:string,value:unknown)=>onChange({params:{...params,[name]:value}})
  return <section className="context-composer" aria-label={`Thiết lập ${customerToolLabel(tool)}`}>
    <header><div><small>Đang làm việc với</small><strong>{customerToolLabel(tool)}</strong></div><nav><button onClick={onAdvanced}>Nâng cao</button><button aria-label="Đóng thiết lập" onClick={onClose}>×</button></nav></header>

    {!!references.length&&<label className="composer-reference"><span>Tham chiếu đầu vào</span><select disabled={readOnly} value="" onChange={event=>{

      if(reference)onReference(reference)
    }}><option value="">@ Chọn node liên quan…</option>{references.map(reference=><option
      key={`${reference.source}-${reference.sourceHandle}-${reference.targetHandle}`}
      value={`${reference.source}|${reference.sourceHandle}|${reference.targetHandle}`}>@{reference.label} · {reference.detail}</option>)}</select></label>}

        placeholder={name==='url'&&tool.name==='video.social_import'?'Dán link TikTok, YouTube Shorts hoặc Reels…':undefined}
        onChange={event=>setParam(name,rule.type==='int'?Number.parseInt(event.target.value):rule.type==='number'?Number(event.target.value):event.target.value)} /></label>
    })}</div>
    <footer><span>{cost===undefined?'Chi phí do server xác nhận':`Tối đa ${cost} credit`}</span><button className="composer-run" disabled={readOnly} onClick={onRun}>✦ Kiểm tra chi phí</button></footer>
  </section>
}

import type { PaletteTool } from './editorState'
import type { AgentRun, AgentRunSummary, CanvasNode } from './workflowApi'
import { fieldLabel, primaryFields } from './nodePresentation'
import { customerToolLabel } from './presentationAdapter'

type InspectorProps = {
  node?: CanvasNode
  tool?: PaletteTool
  readOnly: boolean
  csrfToken: string
  run?: AgentRun
  runHistory?: AgentRunSummary[]
  onSelectRun?: (id: string) => void
  onReplay?: (run: AgentRun) => void
  onRestore?: (run: AgentRun) => void
  onChange: (data: Record<string, unknown>) => void
  connections?: Record<string, { value: string; label: string }[]>
  onConnect?: (field: string, value: string) => void
  className?: string
}

const contentFields = new Set(['prompt', 'topic', 'text', 'url', 'source_url'])

export function Inspector({node, tool, readOnly, run, runHistory, onSelectRun, onReplay,
  onRestore, onChange, className = ''}: InspectorProps) {
  const history = <details className="run-history-details"><summary>Lịch sử chạy</summary>
    <RunInspector run={run} history={runHistory} onSelect={onSelectRun} onReplay={onReplay} onRestore={onRestore}/>
  </details>
  if (!node || !tool) return <aside className={`canvas-inspector ${className}`} aria-label="Chi tiết block">
    <div className="node-inspector"><h2>Chi tiết</h2><p>Chọn một block để xem các tùy chọn tạo nội dung.</p></div>{history}
  </aside>

  const params = (node.data.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>
  const fields = primaryFields(tool, params).filter(([name]) => !contentFields.has(name)).slice(0, 6)
  const setParam = (name: string, value: unknown) => onChange({params: {...params, [name]: value}})
  return <aside className={`canvas-inspector ${className}`} aria-label="Chi tiết block">
    <div className="node-inspector"><small>TÙY CHỌN TẠO</small><h2>{customerToolLabel(tool)}</h2>
      <p>Chỉ những lựa chọn ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến kết quả được hiển thị tại đây.</p>
      {fields.map(([name, rule]) => {
        const value = params[name] ?? rule.default ?? ''
        const label = <span>{fieldLabel(name)}{rule.required ? ' *' : ''}</span>
        if (rule.values?.length) return <label key={name}>{label}<select disabled={readOnly}
          value={String(value)} onChange={event => setParam(name, event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">— chọn —</option>{(rule.options ?? rule.values.map(item => ({value: item, label: String(item)})))
            .map(option => <option key={String(option.value)} value={String(option.value)}>{option.label}</option>)}</select></label>
        if (rule.type === 'bool') return <label key={name} className="check-field"><input type="checkbox"
          disabled={readOnly} checked={Boolean(value)} onChange={event => setParam(name, event.target.checked)}/>{label}</label>
        return <label key={name}>{label}<input disabled={readOnly} value={String(value)}
          type={rule.type === 'int' || rule.type === 'number' ? 'number' : 'text'} min={rule.min} max={rule.max}
          onChange={event => setParam(name, rule.type === 'int' ? Number.parseInt(event.target.value) :
            rule.type === 'number' ? Number(event.target.value) : event.target.value)}/></label>
      })}
      {!fields.length && <p className="detail-empty">Block này không cần thêm tùy chọn. Nội dung và thao tác chạy nằm ngay trong block.</p>}
    </div>{history}
  </aside>
}

import type { AgentRun,AgentRunSummary } from './workflowApi'

const labels:Record<string,string>={awaiting_approval:'Chờ phê duyệt',running:'Đang chạy',done:'Hoàn tất',error:'Lỗi',cancelled:'Đã hủy',queued:'Đang chờ'}

export function RunInspector({run,history=[],onSelect,onReplay,onRestore}:{run?:AgentRun;history?:AgentRunSummary[];onSelect?:(id:string)=>void;onReplay?:(run:AgentRun)=>void;onRestore?:(run:AgentRun)=>void}){
  if(!run)return <section className="run-inspector" aria-label="Run inspector"><h2>Bản chạy</h2><p>Kiểm tra workflow và tạo bản chạy để xem checkpoint, chi phí và artifact.</p><RunHistory items={history} onSelect={onSelect}/></section>
  const steps=run.plan.steps||[]
  return <section className="run-inspector" aria-label="Run inspector">
    <header><h2>Bản chạy</h2><span className={`run-badge ${run.status}`}>{run.status==='running'&&run.scheduled_at&&new Date(run.scheduled_at)>new Date()?'Đã lên lịch':labels[run.status]||run.status}</span></header>
    {run.scheduled_at&&<p className="scheduled-time">Thời điểm chạy: <time dateTime={run.scheduled_at}>{new Date(run.scheduled_at).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}</time></p>}
    <dl><div><dt>Ước tính</dt><dd>{run.estimated} credit</dd></div><div><dt>Thực tế</dt><dd>{run.actual} credit</dd></div><div><dt>Phiên bản</dt><dd>v{run.version}</dd></div></dl>
    <ol className="run-steps">{steps.map(step=>{const state=run.checkpoint[step.id]||{};const status=String(state.status||'queued');return <li key={step.id}><span className={`run-dot ${status}`} aria-hidden="true"/><div><strong>{step.id}</strong><small>{labels[status]||status}{state.error||state.reason?` · ${String(state.error||state.reason)}`:''}</small></div></li>})}</ol>
    {!!run.artifacts?.length&&<div className="run-artifacts"><h3>ARTIFACTS</h3>{run.artifacts.map((item,index)=><a key={`${item.step_id}-${index}`} href={item.url}>{item.name}</a>)}</div>}
    {!!run.artifacts?.length&&<a className="run-bundle" href={`/agent/api/runs/${run.id}/bundle`}>Tải bundle run (.zip)</a>}
    {!!run.decisions.length&&<details><summary>Nhật ký quyết định ({run.decisions.length})</summary><ol>{run.decisions.slice(-8).map((item,index)=><li key={index}>{String(item.event||item.status||'decision')}</li>)}</ol></details>}
    {['done','error','cancelled'].includes(run.status)&&onReplay&&<button className="replay-run" onClick={()=>onReplay(run)}>Replay từ snapshot này</button>}
    {onRestore&&<button className="restore-workflow" onClick={()=>onRestore(run)}>Khôi phục thành workflow mới</button>}
    <RunHistory items={history} selected={run.id} onSelect={onSelect}/>
  </section>
}

function RunHistory({items,selected,onSelect}:{items:AgentRunSummary[];selected?:string;onSelect?:(id:string)=>void}){return items.length?<div className="run-history"><h3>LỊCH SỬ</h3>{items.map(item=><button key={item.id} className={item.id===selected?'selected':''} aria-pressed={item.id===selected} onClick={()=>onSelect?.(item.id)}><span className={`run-dot ${item.status}`} aria-hidden="true"/><strong>{item.id.slice(0,8)}</strong><small>{labels[item.status]||item.status} · {item.actual}/{item.estimated} credit</small></button>)}</div>:null}

        <strong>{configured?'Đã có nội dung':empty?.title??presentation?.emptyTitle??emptyMessage(tool).title}</strong>
        <span>{configured?'Sẵn sàng để thiết lập.':empty?.hint??presentation?.emptyHint??emptyMessage(tool).hint}</span>
        <div className="node-primary-actions nodrag">
          {accept&&<label className="node-upload">Tải lên<input type="file" accept={accept} disabled={typed.__readOnly}
            onChange={event=>{upload(event.target.files??undefined);event.target.value=''}}/></label>}
          {!['input','transform'].includes(nodeModality(tool))&&<button className="accent" disabled={typed.__readOnly}
            onClick={event=>{event.stopPropagation();(typed.__onGenerate??typed.__onOpen)?.()}}>Tạo AI</button>}
          {nodeModality(tool)==='transform'&&<button disabled={typed.__readOnly}
            onClick={event=>{event.stopPropagation();typed.__onOpen?.()}}>Chọn đầu vào</button>}
        </div></div>}
      {!!previewUrls.length&&media&&<div className="node-preview-actions nodrag">
        {accept&&<label className="node-upload">Thay tệp<input type="file" accept={accept} disabled={typed.__readOnly}
          onChange={event=>{upload(event.target.files??undefined);event.target.value=''}}/></label>}
        <button className="accent" disabled={typed.__readOnly}
          onClick={event=>{event.stopPropagation();(typed.__onGenerate??typed.__onOpen)?.()}}>Tạo lại</button>
      </div>}
    </div>
    {selected&&<section className="node-customer-composer nodrag" aria-label={`Thiết lập ${customerToolLabel(tool)}`}>
      {contentField&&modality!=='text'&&<label><span>{fieldLabel(contentField[0])}</span>
        {contentField[1].type==='string'&&['url','source_url'].includes(contentField[0])?<input
          value={contentFromConnection?'':contentValue} disabled={typed.__readOnly||contentFromConnection}
          placeholder={tool?.name==='video.social_import'?'Dán link TikTok, YouTube Shorts hoặc Reels…':'Dán liên kết nội dung…'}
          onChange={event=>typed.__onParamChange?.(contentField[0],event.target.value)}/>:
        <textarea value={contentFromConnection?'':contentValue} disabled={typed.__readOnly||contentFromConnection}
          placeholder={contentFromConnection?'Dùng nội dung từ block đã kết nối':'Mô tả kết quả bạn muốn tạo…'}
          onChange={event=>typed.__onParamChange?.(contentField[0],event.target.value)}/>}</label>}
      {!!typed.__connectedInputs?.length&&<div className="node-input-chips" aria-label="Đầu vào đã kết nối">
        {typed.__connectedInputs.map(input=><span key={input.edgeId}><b>@{input.label}</b><small>{input.detail}</small>
          <button disabled={typed.__readOnly} aria-label={`Tháo kết nối ${input.label}`} onClick={()=>typed.__onDisconnect?.(input.edgeId)}>×</button></span>)}</div>}
      {!!typed.__references?.length&&<label className="node-reference"><span>Thêm nội dung từ block khác</span><select
        disabled={typed.__readOnly} value="" onChange={event=>{const reference=typed.__references?.find(item=>
          `${item.source}|${item.sourceHandle}|${item.targetHandle}`===event.target.value);if(reference)typed.__onReference?.(reference)}}>
        <option value="">@ Chọn nội dung liên quan…</option>{typed.__references.map(reference=><option
          key={`${reference.source}-${reference.sourceHandle}-${reference.targetHandle}`}
          value={`${reference.source}|${reference.sourceHandle}|${reference.targetHandle}`}>@{reference.label} · {reference.detail}</option>)}</select></label>}
    </section>}
    <footer><span>{typed.__cost===undefined?'Chi phí do server xác nhận':`Tối đa ${typed.__cost} credit`}</span>
      <nav className="node-footer-actions nodrag"><button onClick={event=>{event.stopPropagation();typed.__onOpen?.()}}>Chi tiết</button>
        <button className="node-run" disabled={typed.__readOnly||typed.__status==='running'}
          onClick={event=>{event.stopPropagation();typed.__onRun?.()}}>{typed.__cost===undefined?'Báo giá':`${typed.__cost} credit · Chạy`}</button></nav></footer>
    {tool&&Object.entries(tool.params_schema).filter(([name])=>typed.__inputFields?.includes(name)).map(([name],index)=><Handle
      key={name} id={name} type="target" position={Position.Left} className="typed-port input-port"
      style={{top:58+index*28}} aria-label={`Đầu vào ${fieldLabel(name)}`}/>)}
    {tool&&output&&<Handle id={output} type="source" position={Position.Right} className="typed-port output-port primary-output"
      style={{top:'50%'}} aria-label={`Kết nối ${outputLabel(output,String(tool.returns[output]))}`}
      onClick={event=>{event.stopPropagation();typed.__onQuickConnect?.(output)}}><b>+</b></Handle>}
  </article>
}

export function FrameNode({ data }: NodeProps) {
  const typed = data as { name?: string; count?: number }
  return <section className="canvas-frame-node" aria-label={`Frame ${typed.name ?? ''}`}>
    <header><strong>{typed.name ?? 'Frame'}</strong><span>{typed.count ?? 0} node</span></header>
  </section>
}

export function AnnotationNode({ data }: NodeProps) {
  const typed = data as { kind?: 'note' | 'comment'; text?: string }
  return <article className={`canvas-annotation-node ${typed.kind ?? 'note'}`}
    aria-label={`${typed.kind === 'comment' ? 'Comment' : 'Sticky note'} ${typed.text ?? ''}`}>
    <small>{typed.kind === 'comment' ? 'COMMENT' : 'NOTE'}</small>
    <p>{typed.text}</p>
  </article>
}

import type { CanvasDocument, CanvasEdge, CanvasNode, CanvasPage } from './workflowApi'

export type EditorState = {
  document: CanvasDocument
  selectedId?: string
  past: CanvasDocument[]
  future: CanvasDocument[]
}

export type EditorAction =
  | { type: 'replace'; document: CanvasDocument }
  | { type: 'graph'; nodes: CanvasNode[]; edges: CanvasEdge[] }
  | { type: 'sync'; nodes: CanvasNode[]; edges: CanvasEdge[] }
  | { type: 'commit'; before: CanvasDocument }
  | { type: 'select'; id?: string }
  | { type: 'update'; id: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { type: 'toolReplace'; id: string; tool: PaletteTool; tools: PaletteTool[];
      data?: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { type: 'nodeLabel'; id: string; label: string }
  | { type: 'viewport'; viewport: CanvasPage['viewport'] }
  | { type: 'pageView'; grid?: boolean; connections?: boolean; minimap?: boolean }
  | { type: 'document'; goal?: string; budget_max_credit?: number }
  | { type: 'pageAdd' }
  | { type: 'pageSelect'; id: string }
  | { type: 'pageRename'; id: string; name: string }
  | { type: 'pageDelete'; id: string }
  | { type: 'frameAdd'; nodeIds: string[] }
  | { type: 'frameRename'; id: string; name: string }
  | { type: 'frameDelete'; id: string }
  | { type: 'noteAdd'; text: string }
  | { type: 'commentAdd'; text: string }
  | { type: 'annotationUpdate'; kind: 'notes' | 'comments'; id: string; text: string }
  | { type: 'annotationDelete'; kind: 'notes' | 'comments'; id: string }
  | { type: 'delete'; ids: string[] }
  | { type: 'nodeMovePage'; id: string; pageId: string }
  | { type: 'deleteEdges'; ids: string[] }
  | { type: 'undo' | 'redo' | 'layout' }

const clone = (document: CanvasDocument): CanvasDocument => structuredClone(document)

export const emptyPage = (id = 'page-1', name = 'Page 1'): CanvasPage => ({
  id, name, nodes: [], edges: [], viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
  frames: [], notes: [], comments: [],
  view: { grid: true, connections: true, minimap: true },
})

export const emptyDocument = (): CanvasDocument => ({ version: 2, goal: '',
  budget_max_credit: 50, active_page_id: 'page-1', pages: [emptyPage()] })

export function activePage(document: CanvasDocument): CanvasPage {
  return document.pages.find(page => page.id === document.active_page_id) ?? document.pages[0]
}

function updateActive(document: CanvasDocument, update: (page: CanvasPage) => CanvasPage): CanvasDocument {
  return { ...document, pages: document.pages.map(page =>
    page.id === document.active_page_id ? update(page) : page) }
}

function changed(state: EditorState, document: CanvasDocument): EditorState {
  return { ...state, document, past: [...state.past.slice(-49), clone(state.document)], future: [] }
}

function clearEdgeReferences(nodes:CanvasNode[],removed:CanvasEdge[]){
  const byTarget=new Map<string,CanvasEdge[]>()
  for(const edge of removed){const list=byTarget.get(edge.target)??[];list.push(edge);byTarget.set(edge.target,list)}
  return nodes.map(node=>{
    const affected=byTarget.get(node.id);if(!affected?.length)return node
    const params={...((node.data.params??{}) as Record<string,unknown>)}
    for(const edge of affected){if(!edge.targetHandle)continue
      const reference=`$${edge.source}.${edge.sourceHandle}`;const current=params[edge.targetHandle]
      if(current===reference)delete params[edge.targetHandle]
      else if(Array.isArray(current)){
        const remaining=current.filter(value=>value!==reference)
        if(remaining.length)params[edge.targetHandle]=remaining
        else delete params[edge.targetHandle]
      }
    }
    return {...node,data:{...node.data,params}}
  })
}

export function editorReducer(state: EditorState, action: EditorAction): EditorState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'replace': return { document: clone(action.document), past: [], future: [] }
    case 'select': return { ...state, selectedId: action.id }
    case 'graph': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page =>
      ({ ...page, nodes: action.nodes, edges: action.edges })))
    case 'sync': return { ...state, document: updateActive(state.document, page =>
      ({ ...page, nodes: action.nodes, edges: action.edges })) }
    case 'commit': return { ...state, past: [...state.past.slice(-49), clone(action.before)], future: [] }
    case 'update': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      nodes: page.nodes.map(node => node.id === action.id
        ? { ...node, data: { ...node.data, ...action.data } } : node) })))
    case 'toolReplace': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page =>
      replaceNodeTool(page, action.id, action.tool, action.tools, action.data)))
    case 'nodeLabel': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      nodes: page.nodes.map(node => node.id === action.id
        ? { ...node, label: action.label.trim().slice(0, 80) || undefined } : node) })))
    case 'viewport': return { ...state, document: updateActive(state.document, page =>
      ({ ...page, viewport: action.viewport })) }
    case 'pageView': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      view: { grid: action.grid ?? page.view?.grid ?? true,
        connections: action.connections ?? page.view?.connections ?? true,
        minimap: action.minimap ?? page.view?.minimap ?? true } })))
    case 'document': return changed(state, { ...state.document,
      goal: action.goal ?? state.document.goal,
      budget_max_credit: action.budget_max_credit ?? state.document.budget_max_credit })
    case 'pageAdd': {
      const id = `page-${Date.now().toString(36)}`
      return changed({ ...state, selectedId: undefined }, { ...state.document,
        active_page_id: id, pages: [...state.document.pages,
          emptyPage(id, `Page ${state.document.pages.length + 1}`)] })
    }
    case 'pageSelect': return action.id === state.document.active_page_id ? state
      : { ...state, selectedId: undefined, document: { ...state.document, active_page_id: action.id } }
    case 'pageRename': return changed(state, { ...state.document,
      pages: state.document.pages.map(page => page.id === action.id
        ? { ...page, name: action.name.slice(0, 80) || page.name } : page) })
    case 'pageDelete': {
      if (state.document.pages.length === 1) return state
      const pages = state.document.pages.filter(page => page.id !== action.id)
      return changed({ ...state, selectedId: undefined }, { ...state.document, pages,
        active_page_id: action.id === state.document.active_page_id
          ? pages[0].id : state.document.active_page_id })
    }
    case 'frameAdd': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      frames: [...page.frames, { id: `frame-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
        name: `Frame ${page.frames.length + 1}`, node_ids: action.nodeIds }] })))
    case 'frameRename': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      frames: page.frames.map(frame => frame.id === action.id
        ? { ...frame, name: action.name.slice(0, 80) || frame.name } : frame) })))
    case 'frameDelete': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      frames: page.frames.filter(frame => frame.id !== action.id) })))
    case 'noteAdd': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      notes: [...page.notes, { id: `note-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, text: action.text,
        x: 380 + (page.notes.length % 3) * 220, y: 100 + Math.floor(page.notes.length / 3) * 170 }] })))
    case 'commentAdd': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      comments: [...page.comments, { id: `comment-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, text: action.text,
        x: 420 + (page.comments.length % 3) * 220, y: 320 + Math.floor(page.comments.length / 3) * 120 }] })))
    case 'annotationUpdate': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      [action.kind]: page[action.kind].map(item => item.id === action.id
        ? { ...item, text: action.text.slice(0, 1000) } : item) })))
    case 'annotationDelete': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      [action.kind]: page[action.kind].filter(item => item.id !== action.id) })))
    case 'delete': {
      const ids = new Set(action.ids)
      return changed({ ...state, selectedId: ids.has(state.selectedId ?? '') ? undefined : state.selectedId },
        updateActive(state.document, page => {const removed=page.edges.filter(edge=>ids.has(edge.source)||ids.has(edge.target));return { ...page,
          nodes: clearEdgeReferences(page.nodes.filter(node => !ids.has(node.id)),removed),
          edges: page.edges.filter(edge => !ids.has(edge.source) && !ids.has(edge.target)),
          frames: page.frames.map(frame => ({ ...frame,
            node_ids: frame.node_ids.filter(id => !ids.has(id)) })) }}))
    }
    case 'nodeMovePage': {
      if (action.pageId === state.document.active_page_id ||
          !state.document.pages.some(page => page.id === action.pageId)) return state
      const source = activePage(state.document)
      const node = source.nodes.find(item => item.id === action.id)
      if (!node) return state
      const document = { ...state.document, pages: state.document.pages.map(page => {
        if (page.id === source.id) {const removed=page.edges.filter(edge=>edge.source===action.id||edge.target===action.id);return { ...page,
          nodes: clearEdgeReferences(page.nodes.filter(item => item.id !== action.id),removed),
          edges: page.edges.filter(edge => edge.source !== action.id && edge.target !== action.id),
          frames: page.frames.map(frame => ({ ...frame,
            node_ids: frame.node_ids.filter(id => id !== action.id) })) }}
        if (page.id === action.pageId) return { ...page, nodes: [...page.nodes, {
          ...node, position: { x: 90 + (page.nodes.length % 3) * 430,
            y: 90 + Math.floor(page.nodes.length / 3) * 430 } }] }
        return page
      }) }
      return changed({ ...state, selectedId: undefined }, document)
    }
    case 'deleteEdges': {
      const ids = new Set(action.ids)
      return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => {const removed=page.edges.filter(edge=>ids.has(edge.id));return { ...page,
        nodes:clearEdgeReferences(page.nodes,removed),edges: page.edges.filter(edge => !ids.has(edge.id)) }}))
    }
    case 'layout': return changed(state, updateActive(state.document, page => ({ ...page,
      nodes: page.nodes.map((node, index) => ({ ...node,
        position: { x: 90 + (index % 4) * 430, y: 90 + Math.floor(index / 4) * 430 } })) })))
    case 'undo': {
      const previous = state.past.at(-1)
      if (!previous) return state
      return { ...state, document: clone(previous), past: state.past.slice(0, -1),
        future: [clone(state.document), ...state.future].slice(0, 50) }
    }
    case 'redo': {
      const next = state.future[0]
      if (!next) return state
      return { ...state, document: clone(next), past: [...state.past, clone(state.document)].slice(-50),
        future: state.future.slice(1) }
    }
  }
}

export function replaceNodeTool(page: CanvasPage, nodeId: string, nextTool: PaletteTool,
                                tools: PaletteTool[], data: Record<string, unknown> = {}): CanvasPage {
  const current = page.nodes.find(node => node.id === nodeId)
  if (!current) return page
  const byName = new Map(tools.map(tool => [tool.name, tool]))
  const defaults = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(nextTool.params_schema)
    .filter(([, rule]) => rule.default !== undefined)
    .map(([name, rule]) => [name, structuredClone(rule.default)]))
  const { asset_name: _name, asset_names: _names, asset_size: _size,
    asset_sizes: _sizes, asset_url: _url, asset_urls: _urls, ...stable } = current.data
  const nodes = new Map(page.nodes.map(node => [node.id, node]))
  nodes.set(nodeId, { ...current, data: { ...stable, tool: nextTool.name,
    params: defaults, ...data } })
  const occupied = new Set(page.edges.filter(edge => edge.source !== nodeId && edge.target !== nodeId)
    .map(edge => `${edge.target}|${edge.targetHandle}`))
  const edges: CanvasEdge[] = []

  const clearTargetParam = (edge: CanvasEdge) => {
    if (!edge.targetHandle) return
    const target = nodes.get(edge.target); if (!target) return
    const params = { ...((target.data.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>) }
    const reference = `$${edge.source}.${edge.sourceHandle}`
    if (params[edge.targetHandle] === reference) delete params[edge.targetHandle]
    else if (Array.isArray(params[edge.targetHandle])) {
      const remaining = (params[edge.targetHandle] as unknown[]).filter(value => value !== reference)
      if (remaining.length) params[edge.targetHandle] = remaining
      else delete params[edge.targetHandle]
    }
    nodes.set(target.id, { ...target, data: { ...target.data, params } })
  }

  for (const edge of page.edges) {
    if (edge.target === nodeId) continue
    if (edge.source !== nodeId) { edges.push(edge); continue }
    const target = nodes.get(edge.target)
    const targetTool = byName.get(String(target?.data.tool))
    const candidates = Object.keys(nextTool.returns).flatMap(sourceHandle =>
      Object.keys(targetTool?.params_schema ?? {}).filter(targetHandle => {
        const rule = targetTool?.params_schema[targetHandle]
        const variadic = Boolean(rule?.type.endsWith('[]') &&
          nextTool.returns[sourceHandle] === rule.type.slice(0, -2))
        return (!occupied.has(`${edge.target}|${targetHandle}`) || variadic) &&
          connectionAllowed(nextTool, sourceHandle, targetTool, targetHandle)
      })
        .map(targetHandle => ({ sourceHandle, targetHandle })))
    const exact = candidates.find(item => nextTool.returns[item.sourceHandle] ===
      inputPort(targetTool!.params_schema[item.targetHandle].type))
    const replacement = candidates.find(item => item.sourceHandle === edge.sourceHandle && item.targetHandle === edge.targetHandle &&
      nextTool.returns[item.sourceHandle] === inputPort(targetTool!.params_schema[item.targetHandle].type))
      ?? exact
      ?? candidates.find(item => item.targetHandle === edge.targetHandle)
      ?? candidates.find(item => item.sourceHandle === edge.sourceHandle)
      ?? candidates[0]
    clearTargetParam(edge)
    if (!replacement || !target) continue
    const rule = targetTool?.params_schema[replacement.targetHandle]
    const reference = `$${nodeId}.${replacement.sourceHandle}`
    const currentParams = (nodes.get(target.id)?.data.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>
    const variadic = Boolean(rule?.type.endsWith('[]') &&
      nextTool.returns[replacement.sourceHandle] === rule.type.slice(0, -2))
    const previous = currentParams[replacement.targetHandle]
    const value = variadic
      ? [...new Set([...(Array.isArray(previous) ? previous : []), reference])]
      : reference
    occupied.add(`${edge.target}|${replacement.targetHandle}`)
    const params = { ...currentParams, [replacement.targetHandle]: value }
    nodes.set(target.id, { ...nodes.get(target.id)!, data: { ...nodes.get(target.id)!.data, params } })
    edges.push({ ...edge,
      id: `${nodeId}-${replacement.sourceHandle}-${edge.target}-${replacement.targetHandle}`,
      sourceHandle: replacement.sourceHandle, targetHandle: replacement.targetHandle })
  }
  return { ...page, nodes: page.nodes.map(node => nodes.get(node.id)!), edges }
}

export type PaletteTool = {
  name: string
  label?: string
  category?: 'content'|'input'|'transform'|'specialized'|'advanced'
  primary?: boolean
  customer_visible?: boolean
  description: string
  app_slug: string
  app_name: string
  requires: string[]
  params_schema: Record<string, { type: string; required?: boolean; default?: unknown;
    values?: unknown[]; options?: { value: unknown; label: string }[]; min?: number; max?: number;
    depends_on?: string }>
  schema_variants?: Record<string, Record<string, PaletteTool['params_schema']>>
  returns: Record<string, string>
  verifiable: string[]
}

const inputPort = (type: string) => ['string', 'text'].includes(type) ? 'text'
  : ['int', 'number', 'bool'].includes(type) ? 'json' : type

export function connectionAllowed(source: PaletteTool | undefined, sourceHandle: string | null,
                                  target: PaletteTool | undefined, targetHandle: string | null) {
  if (!source || !target || !sourceHandle || !targetHandle) return false
  if (target.name.startsWith('asset.')) return false
  if (targetHandle === 'refs' || targetHandle.startsWith('_')) return false
  const output = source.returns[sourceHandle]
  const input = target.params_schema[targetHandle]
  if (targetHandle === 'prompt' && output === 'text' && target.params_schema.source_text) return false
  const expected = input && inputPort(input.type)
  return Boolean(output && expected && (output === expected ||
    (expected.endsWith('[]') && output === expected.slice(0, -2))))
}

export function connectionCreatesCycle(edges:CanvasEdge[],sourceId:string,targetId:string){
  if(sourceId===targetId)return true
  const reachable=new Set([targetId]);let changed=true
  while(changed){changed=false;for(const edge of edges)if(reachable.has(edge.source)&&!reachable.has(edge.target)){
    reachable.add(edge.target);changed=true
  }}
  return reachable.has(sourceId)
}

export function scopeNodeIds(nodes:CanvasNode[],edges:CanvasEdge[],targets:string[]){
  const available=new Set(nodes.map(node=>node.id))
  const included=new Set(targets.filter(id=>available.has(id)))
  let expanded=true
  while(expanded){
    expanded=false
    for(const edge of edges)if(included.has(edge.target)&&available.has(edge.source)&&!included.has(edge.source)){
      included.add(edge.source);expanded=true
    }
  }
  return [...included]
}

export function cloneGraphSelection(nodes:CanvasNode[],edges:CanvasEdge[],suffix=Date.now().toString()){
  const selected=new Set(nodes.map(node=>node.id))
  const ids=new Map(nodes.map((node,index)=>[node.id,`${node.id}-copy-${suffix}-${index}`]))
  const remap=(value:unknown):unknown=>{
    if(typeof value==='string'&&value.startsWith('$')){
      const dot=value.indexOf('.')
      const source=dot>1?value.slice(1,dot):'';const replacement=ids.get(source)
      return replacement?`$${replacement}${value.slice(dot)}`:value
    }
    if(Array.isArray(value))return value.map(remap)
    if(value&&typeof value==='object')return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key,item])=>[key,remap(item)]))
    return value
  }
  const clonedNodes=nodes.map(node=>{
    const clone=structuredClone(node);clone.id=ids.get(node.id)!
    clone.position={x:node.position.x+32,y:node.position.y+32}
    clone.data=remap(clone.data) as CanvasNode['data']
    return clone
  })
  const clonedEdges=edges.filter(edge=>selected.has(edge.source)&&selected.has(edge.target)).map(edge=>({
    ...structuredClone(edge),id:`${ids.get(edge.source)}-${edge.sourceHandle}-${ids.get(edge.target)}-${edge.targetHandle}`,
    source:ids.get(edge.source)!,target:ids.get(edge.target)!,
  }))
  return {nodes:clonedNodes,edges:clonedEdges,nodeIds:clonedNodes.map(node=>node.id)}
}

export function nextNode(tool: PaletteTool, count: number): CanvasNode {
  const params = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(tool.params_schema)
    .filter(([, rule]) => rule.default !== undefined)
    .map(([name, rule]) => [name, structuredClone(rule.default)]))
  return { id: `n${Date.now().toString(36)}-${count}`, type: 'tool',
    position: { x: 90 + (count % 3) * 430, y: 90 + Math.floor(count / 3) * 430 },
    data: { tool: tool.name, params, fanout: 1, max_retry: 0,
      on_fail: 'retry_same', verify: null } }
}

import type { PaletteTool } from './editorState'

export type NodeModality = 'text'|'image'|'video'|'audio'|'batch'|'transform'|'input'|'tool'

export const fieldLabels: Record<string,string> = {
  prompt:'Mô tả', topic:'Chủ đề', model:'Model', aspect_ratio:'Tỷ lệ',
  resolution:'Độ phân giải', duration:'Thời lượng', count:'Số lượng',
  voice:'Giọng đọc', language:'Ngôn ngữ', url:'Liên kết', source_url:'Liên kết',
  target_height:'Độ phân giải đích', preset:'Chất lượng', scale:'Mức phóng đại',
  interval:'Khoảng cách khung hình', fps:'Khung hình/giây', layout:'Bố cục',
  direction:'Hướng ghép', generate_audio:'Tạo âm thanh', preserve_audio:'Giữ âm thanh',
  preserve_fps:'Giữ tốc độ khung hình', images:'Ảnh đầu vào', videos:'Video đầu vào',
  image_key:'Ảnh đầu vào', video_key:'Video đầu vào', audio_key:'Âm thanh đầu vào',
  image_keys:'Bộ ảnh đầu vào', video_keys:'Bộ video đầu vào', source_text:'Văn bản tham chiếu',
  text:'Nội dung',
  confirm_rights:'Tôi xác nhận có quyền sử dụng video',
}

export function nodeModality(tool?: PaletteTool): NodeModality {
  const name=tool?.name??''
  if(name==='asset.images')return 'batch'
  if(name.includes('batch'))return 'batch'
  if(tool?.category==='transform'||/upscale|extract|merge/.test(name))return 'transform'
  if(name==='asset.image')return 'image'
  if(name==='asset.video')return 'video'
  if(name==='asset.audio')return 'audio'
  if(name.startsWith('asset.')||name.includes('social_import'))return 'input'
  if(name.startsWith('text.'))return 'text'
  if(name.startsWith('image.'))return 'image'
  if(name.startsWith('video.'))return 'video'
  if(name.startsWith('audio.'))return 'audio'
  return 'tool'
}

export function nodeTitle(tool?:PaletteTool){
  if(tool?.name==='asset.image')return 'Hình ảnh'
  if(tool?.name==='asset.images')return 'Bộ ảnh'
  if(tool?.name==='asset.video')return 'Video'
  if(tool?.name==='asset.audio')return 'Âm thanh'
  return tool?.label||tool?.name||'Công cụ không tồn tại'
}

export function mediaKind(tool?:PaletteTool):'image'|'video'|'audio'|undefined {
  const name=tool?.name??''
  if(name.startsWith('image.')||name==='asset.image'||name==='asset.images')return 'image'
  if(name.startsWith('video.')||name==='asset.video'||name.includes('video'))return 'video'
  if(name.startsWith('audio.')||name==='asset.audio')return 'audio'
  return undefined
}

export function fieldLabel(name:string){
  return fieldLabels[name]??name.replace(/_+/g,' ').replace(/^./,letter=>letter.toLocaleUpperCase('vi'))
}

export function outputLabel(name:string,kind:string){
  if(kind==='image'||kind==='image[]')return kind.endsWith('[]')?'Bộ ảnh':'Hình ảnh'
  if(kind==='video'||kind==='video[]')return kind.endsWith('[]')?'Bộ video':'Video'
  if(kind==='audio')return 'Âm thanh'
  if(kind==='text')return 'Nội dung'
  if(kind==='json')return 'Dữ liệu'
  return fieldLabel(name)
}

const priorities=['prompt','topic','text','url','source_url','model','aspect_ratio','resolution',
  'duration','count','voice','language','target_height','preset','scale','interval','fps',
  'layout','direction','generate_audio','preserve_audio','preserve_fps']

export function primaryFields(tool:PaletteTool,params:Record<string,unknown>){
  if(tool.name.startsWith('asset.'))return []
  const schema=Object.entries(tool.schema_variants??{}).reduce((current,[field,variants])=>
    variants[String(params[field])]??current,tool.params_schema)
  return Object.entries(schema).filter(([name,rule])=>
    !['image','video','audio','image[]','video[]'].includes(rule.type)&&
    (priorities.includes(name)||rule.required||rule.type==='model_ref'||rule.values?.length))
    .sort(([a],[b])=>(priorities.indexOf(a)<0?999:priorities.indexOf(a))-(priorities.indexOf(b)<0?999:priorities.indexOf(b)))
    .slice(0,6)
}

export function emptyMessage(tool?:PaletteTool){
  if(tool?.name==='video.social_import')return {title:'Thêm Social Video',
    hint:'Dán liên kết TikTok, YouTube Shorts hoặc Reels mà bạn có quyền sử dụng.'}
  const mode=nodeModality(tool)
  if(mode==='image')return {title:'Thêm một hình ảnh',hint:'Kéo thả, tải lên hoặc tạo bằng AI.'}
  if(mode==='video')return {title:'Thêm một video',hint:'Tải video hoặc tạo từ mô tả và nội dung đã nối.'}
  if(mode==='audio')return {title:'Thêm âm thanh',hint:'Tải file hoặc tạo giọng nói, nhạc và hiệu ứng.'}
  if(mode==='text')return {title:'Thêm nội dung',hint:'Viết yêu cầu hoặc tạo nội dung bằng AI.'}
  if(mode==='batch')return {title:'Thêm bộ ảnh',hint:'Tải nhiều ảnh hoặc tạo một batch có kiểm soát.'}
  if(mode==='transform')return {title:'Kết nối nội dung đầu vào',hint:'Nối output tương thích rồi chạy công cụ xử lý.'}
  if(mode==='input')return {title:'Thêm nội dung đầu vào',hint:'Tải file hoặc nhập liên kết nguồn.'}
  return {title:'Thiết lập công cụ',hint:'Mở thiết lập để hoàn thành node.'}
}

export function hasMeaningfulInput(tool:PaletteTool|undefined,params:Record<string,unknown>){
  if(!tool)return false
  return Object.entries(params).some(([name,value])=>{
    if(['model','aspect_ratio','resolution','duration','count','fanout'].includes(name))return false
    return Array.isArray(value)?value.length>0:value!==''&&value!==undefined&&value!==null&&value!==false
  })
}
