import type { PaletteTool } from './editorState'

export const CANVAS_PRESENTATION_VERSION = 'creative-v1' as const
export type CanvasPresentationMode = 'creative'|'legacy'
export type CreativeModality = 'text'|'image'|'video'|'audio'
export type PresentationTier = 'core'|'secondary'|'internal'

export type BlockPresentation = {
  modality: CreativeModality
  label: string
  icon: string
  tier: PresentationTier
  emptyTitle: string
  emptyHint: string
}

const modalityCopy:Record<CreativeModality,Omit<BlockPresentation,'modality'|'tier'>>={
  text:{label:'Văn bản',icon:'≡',emptyTitle:'Thêm văn bản',emptyHint:'Viết trực tiếp hoặc tạo bằng AI.'},
  image:{label:'Hình ảnh',icon:'▧',emptyTitle:'Thêm hình ảnh',emptyHint:'Kéo thả, tải lên hoặc tạo bằng AI.'},
  video:{label:'Video',icon:'▶',emptyTitle:'Thêm video',emptyHint:'Tải video hoặc tạo từ nội dung đã nối.'},
  audio:{label:'Âm thanh',icon:'♪',emptyTitle:'Thêm âm thanh',emptyHint:'Tải file hoặc tạo giọng nói bằng AI.'},
}

const coreTools:Record<CreativeModality,string>={
  text:'text.generate',image:'image.generate',video:'video.generate',audio:'audio.generate',
}

const explicitModalities:Record<string,CreativeModality>={
  'asset.image':'image','asset.images':'image','asset.video':'video','asset.audio':'audio',
  'text.generate':'text','text.script':'text','text.prompt_package':'text','story.storyboard':'text',
  'image.generate':'image','image.batch_generate':'image','image.thumbnail':'image','image.upscale':'image',
  'video.generate':'video','video.short_clips':'video','video.subtitle':'video','video.upscale':'video',
  'video.extract_frames':'image','video.social_import':'video','media.merge_image':'image',
  'media.merge_video':'video','audio.generate':'audio',
}

const actionLabels:Record<string,string>={
  'text.script':'Viết kịch bản','text.prompt_package':'Tạo gói prompt',
  'story.storyboard':'Tạo storyboard','image.batch_generate':'Tạo bộ ảnh',
  'image.thumbnail':'Tạo thumbnail','image.upscale':'Nâng cấp ảnh',
  'video.upscale':'Nâng cấp video','video.extract_frames':'Tách khung hình',
  'video.subtitle':'Tạo phụ đề','video.short_clips':'Tạo clip ngắn',
  'video.social_import':'Nhập video từ liên kết','media.merge_image':'Ghép ảnh',
  'media.merge_video':'Ghép video',
}

export function creativeModality(tool?:PaletteTool):CreativeModality|undefined{
  if(!tool)return undefined
  return explicitModalities[tool.name]
    ??(tool.name.startsWith('text.')?'text':tool.name.startsWith('image.')?'image':
      tool.name.startsWith('video.')?'video':tool.name.startsWith('audio.')?'audio':undefined)
}

export function blockPresentation(tool?:PaletteTool):BlockPresentation|undefined{
  const modality=creativeModality(tool)
  if(!tool||!modality)return undefined
  const tier:PresentationTier=tool.name.startsWith('asset.')?'internal':
    coreTools[modality]===tool.name?'core':'secondary'
  return {...modalityCopy[modality],modality,tier,
    label:tier==='core'||tier==='internal'?modalityCopy[modality].label:
      actionLabels[tool.name]??tool.label??modalityCopy[modality].label}
}

export function canonicalCreativeTools(palette:PaletteTool[]):PaletteTool[]{
  const visible=palette.filter(tool=>tool.customer_visible!==false)
  return (Object.keys(coreTools) as CreativeModality[]).flatMap(modality=>{
    const exact=visible.find(tool=>tool.name===coreTools[modality])
    const fallback=visible.find(tool=>creativeModality(tool)===modality&&!tool.name.startsWith('asset.'))
    return exact?[exact]:fallback?[fallback]:[]
  })
}

export function customerPaletteTools(palette:PaletteTool[],advanced=false):PaletteTool[]{
  if(!advanced)return canonicalCreativeTools(palette)
  return palette.filter(tool=>tool.customer_visible!==false&&
    blockPresentation(tool)?.tier!=='internal')
}

export function customerToolLabel(tool?:PaletteTool):string{
  return blockPresentation(tool)?.label??tool?.label??'Công cụ'
}

export function primaryOutputHandle(tool?:PaletteTool):string|undefined{
  if(!tool)return undefined
  const modality=creativeModality(tool)
  const wanted=modality==='text'?['text','script','prompt_package','storyboard']:
    modality==='image'?['image','image_key','image_keys','frames']:
    modality==='video'?['video','video_key','video_keys']:
    modality==='audio'?['audio','audio_key']:[]
  return wanted.find(name=>name in tool.returns)??Object.keys(tool.returns)[0]
}

function sourceKind(tool:PaletteTool|undefined,handle:string):CreativeModality|undefined{
  const kind=tool?.returns[handle]
  if(kind==='text')return 'text'
  if(kind==='image'||kind==='image[]')return 'image'
  if(kind==='video'||kind==='video[]')return 'video'
  if(kind==='audio'||kind==='audio[]')return 'audio'
  return creativeModality(tool)
}

export function connectionIntent(source:PaletteTool|undefined,sourceHandle:string,
                                 target:PaletteTool|undefined):string{
  const from=sourceKind(source,sourceHandle);const to=creativeModality(target)
  if(!from||!to)return `Nối tới ${customerToolLabel(target)}`
  if(to==='text')return from==='text'?'Viết tiếp hoặc biên tập':
    from==='image'?'Phân tích hình ảnh':from==='video'?'Phân tích video':'Phân tích âm thanh'
  if(to==='image')return from==='image'?'Chỉnh sửa hoặc biến thể ảnh':
    from==='video'?'Tách hoặc tạo ảnh từ video':'Tạo hình ảnh'
  if(to==='video')return from==='video'?'Chỉnh sửa hoặc xử lý video':
    from==='image'?'Tạo video từ hình ảnh':'Tạo video'
  return from==='audio'?'Xử lý âm thanh':'Tạo âm thanh'
}

export function destinationLabel(source:PaletteTool|undefined,sourceHandle:string,
                                 target:PaletteTool|undefined,targetLabel?:string):string{
  const label=(targetLabel||customerToolLabel(target)).trim()
  return `${connectionIntent(source,sourceHandle,target)} · ${label}`
}

export class WorkflowConflictError extends Error {}

async function decode(response: Response) {
  if (response.ok) return response.json()
  if (response.status === 409) throw new WorkflowConflictError('Workflow was updated elsewhere')
  let message = `Request failed (${response.status})`
  try { message = (await response.json()).detail ?? message } catch { /* non-JSON error */ }
  throw new Error(message)
}

async function request(path: string, init?: RequestInit) {
  return decode(await fetch(path, { credentials: 'same-origin', ...init }))
}

export function normalizeCanvas(canvas: CanvasDocument | LegacyCanvasDocument): CanvasDocument {
  if (canvas.version === 2) return canvas
  return { version: 2, goal: canvas.goal, budget_max_credit: canvas.budget_max_credit,
    active_page_id: 'page-1', pages: [{ id: 'page-1', name: 'Page 1',
      nodes: canvas.nodes, edges: canvas.edges, viewport: canvas.viewport,
      frames: [], notes: [], comments: [], view: { grid: true, connections: true, minimap: true } }] }
}

function normalizeWorkflow(workflow: Workflow): Workflow {
  return { ...workflow, canvas: normalizeCanvas(workflow.canvas as CanvasDocument | LegacyCanvasDocument) }
}

export type AssistantResult = { analysis?: { nodes: number; valid: boolean; issues: string[];
  roots: number; patterns_considered: number }; proposal?: { token: string; canvas: CanvasDocument;
  diff: { before_nodes: number; after_nodes: number; estimated_max_credit: number } }; error?: string }

export async function previewAssistant(workflow: Workflow, mode: 'analyze'|'improve', prompt: string,
                                       csrfToken: string): Promise<AssistantResult> {
  const response = await fetch(`/agent/api/workflows/${workflow.id}/assistant/preview`, { method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken,
      'If-Match': `"${workflow.revision}"` }, body: JSON.stringify({ mode, prompt }) })
  if (!response.ok || !response.body) return decode(response)
  const result: AssistantResult = {}; const reader = response.body.getReader(); const decoder = new TextDecoder()
  let buffer = ''
  while (true) { const { value, done } = await reader.read(); buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: !done })
    const packets = buffer.split('\n\n'); buffer = packets.pop() ?? ''
    for (const packet of packets) { const event = packet.match(/^event: (.+)$/m)?.[1]
      const data = packet.match(/^data: (.+)$/m)?.[1]; if (!event || !data) continue
      const parsed = JSON.parse(data)
      if (event === 'analysis') result.analysis = parsed
      if (event === 'proposal') result.proposal = { ...parsed, canvas: normalizeCanvas(parsed.canvas) }
      if (event === 'error') result.error = parsed.detail }
    if (done) break }
  return result
}

export function createAutosave<T>(
  save: (value: T) => Promise<void>,
  delayMs = 800,
) {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let latest: T | undefined
  const flush = async () => {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer)
    timer = undefined
    if (latest === undefined) return
    const value = latest
    latest = undefined
    await save(value)
  }
  return {
    schedule(value: T) {
      latest = value
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer)
      timer = setTimeout(() => { void flush() }, delayMs)
    },
    flush,
    cancel() {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer)
      timer = undefined
      latest = undefined
    },
  }
}

    app_slug:'upscale',app_name:'Upscale',requires:['gpu'],verifiable:[],params_schema:{image_key:{type:'image',required:true}},returns:{image:'image'} },
  { name: 'media.merge_video', label:'Ghép video',category:'transform',primary:false,description:'Ghép nhiều video',
    app_slug:'mediatools',app_name:'Media',requires:[],verifiable:[],params_schema:{videos:{type:'video[]',required:true},transition:{type:'enum',default:'cut',values:['cut']}},returns:{video_key:'video'} },
  { name: 'text.script', label:'Viết kịch bản',category:'specialized',primary:false,description:'Viết kịch bản',
    app_slug:'kichban',app_name:'Kịch bản',requires:['api'],verifiable:[],params_schema:{topic:{type:'text',required:true}},returns:{script:'text'} }
] }
const workflow = { id: 'w1', name: 'Workflow mới', status: 'draft', revision: 1, estimated: 0,
  canvas: { version: 1, goal: '', budget_max_credit: 50, nodes: [], edges: [],
    viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 } } }
const validatedWorkflow={...workflow,revision:3,validation:{issues:[],step_costs:[],estimated_max_credit:7}}
const awaitingRun={id:'r1',version:1,status:'awaiting_approval',plan:{steps:[{id:'n1'},{id:'n2'}]},
  checkpoint:{},estimated:7,actual:0,quote_hash:'quote-test',decisions:[]}

beforeEach(() => {
  document.body.innerHTML = '<div id="agent-canvas-root" data-csrf-token="test-csrf"></div>'
  vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation(async (input, init) => {
    const url = String(input)
    if (url.endsWith('/palette')) return new Response(JSON.stringify(palette), { status: 200 })
    if (url.endsWith('/preferences')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({theme:'dark',catalog_mode:'simple',presentation_version:'creative-v1',revision:init?.method?1:0}), { status: 200 })
    if (url.endsWith('/assets')) {const file=init?.body instanceof FormData?init.body.get('file') as File:null
      const name=file?.name||'owned.png';return new Response(JSON.stringify({key:`agent-assets/u/${name}`,kind:'image',
        name,size:123,content_type:'image/png',url:`/agent/api/assets/${name}`}),{status:200})}
    if (url.endsWith('/agent/api/runs') && !init?.method) return new Response(JSON.stringify({items:[]}),{status:200})
    if (url.endsWith('/validate')) return new Response(JSON.stringify(validatedWorkflow),{status:200})
    if (url.endsWith('/workflows/w1/runs')&&init?.method==='POST') return new Response(JSON.stringify(awaitingRun),{status:201})
    if (url.endsWith('/runs/r1/approve')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({...awaitingRun,version:2,status:'running'}),{status:200})
    if (url.endsWith('/runs/r1/cancel')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({...awaitingRun,version:3,status:'cancelled'}),{status:200})
    if (url.endsWith('/runs/r1/again')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({...awaitingRun,version:4}),{status:201})
    if (url.endsWith('/workflows') && !init?.method) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ items: [] }), { status: 200 })
    if (url.includes('/workflows/w1')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ...workflow, revision: 2 }), { status: 200 })
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(workflow), { status: 201 })
  })
})

describe('CanvasShell', () => {
  it('loads dynamic palette and adds/configures a tool node', async () => {
    render(<CanvasShell />)
    const palettePanel = await screen.findByLabelText('Palette công cụ')
    expect(palettePanel).not.toHaveClass('is-open')
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Mở công cụ'}))
    expect(palettePanel).toHaveClass('is-open')
    expect(screen.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Tìm công cụ'})).toBeInTheDocument()
    const add = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Thêm Văn bản' })
    fireEvent.click(add)
    const node=await screen.findByLabelText('Khối Văn bản')
    expect(node).toBeInTheDocument()
    const inline=within(node).getByRole('textbox',{name:'Nội dung trực tiếp trong node'})
    fireEvent.change(inline,{target:{value:'Viết ngay trong node'}})
    expect(inline).toHaveValue('Viết ngay trong node')
    const title=within(node).getByRole('textbox',{name:'Tên hiển thị node'})
    fireEvent.change(title,{target:{value:'Lời dẫn mở đầu'}})
    expect(title).toHaveValue('Lời dẫn mở đầu')
    fireEvent.click(node)
    expect(screen.getByRole('region',{name:'Thiết lập Văn bản'})).toBeInTheDocument()
    fireEvent.change(inline, { target: { value: 'Chủ đề mới' } })
    expect(inline).toHaveValue('Chủ đề mới')
    fireEvent.keyDown(window,{key:'Escape'})
    expect(screen.queryByRole('region',{name:'Thiết lập Văn bản'})).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('queues offline edits, retries after reconnect and keeps mobile read-only',async()=>{
    render(<CanvasShell />)

    fireEvent(window,new Event('offline'))

    const putCount=()=>vi.mocked(globalThis.fetch).mock.calls.filter(([url,init])=>
      String(url).includes('/workflows/w1')&&init?.method==='PUT').length
    const before=putCount()
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Nội dung trực tiếp trong node'}),{target:{value:'Sửa khi mất mạng'}})
    await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,900))
    expect(putCount()).toBe(before)
    Object.defineProperty(navigator,'onLine',{configurable:true,value:true})
    fireEvent(window,new Event('online'))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(putCount()).toBeGreaterThan(before),{timeout:1900})
    Object.defineProperty(window,'innerWidth',{configurable:true,value:390})
    fireEvent(window,new Event('resize'))
    expect(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Chạy'})).toBeDisabled()

  it('keeps multiple scalar sources connected to one collection input',async()=>{
    render(<CanvasShell />)
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button',{name:'Mở công cụ'}))
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Thêm Video'}))

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Hiện công cụ nâng cao'}))

    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByLabelText('Khối Ghép video'))
    let picker=screen.getByRole('combobox',{name:'Thêm nội dung từ block khác'}) as HTMLSelectElement
    const first=[...picker.options].find(option=>option.value)!
    fireEvent.change(picker,{target:{value:first.value}})
    picker=screen.getByRole('combobox',{name:'Thêm nội dung từ block khác'}) as HTMLSelectElement
    const second=[...picker.options].find(option=>option.value&&option.value!==first.value)!
    fireEvent.change(picker,{target:{value:second.value}})

    expect(screen.queryByRole('button',{name:'Tháo kết nối Video 1'})).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/3 node · 1 kết nối/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

    decisions:[],artifacts:[]}

    created_at:'2026-08-03',finished_at:'2026-08-03'}]} onSelect={onSelect} onReplay={onReplay} onRestore={onRestore}/>)

  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:/run-old/}))
  expect(onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith('run-old')
})

import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { Inspector } from '../src/Inspector'
import type { PaletteTool } from '../src/editorState'
import type { CanvasNode } from '../src/workflowApi'

const tool: PaletteTool = { name: 'video.generate', description: 'Video', app_slug: 'video',
  app_name: 'Video', requires: ['api'], returns: { video_key: 'video' }, verifiable: [],
  params_schema: { model: { type: 'model_ref', values: ['mini', 'full'] },
    resolution: { type: 'enum', depends_on: 'model', values: [] } },
  schema_variants: { model: {
    mini: { model: { type: 'model_ref', values: ['mini', 'full'] },
      resolution: { type: 'enum', values: ['480p', '720p'] } },
    full: { model: { type: 'model_ref', values: ['mini', 'full'] },
      resolution: { type: 'enum', values: ['480p', '720p', '4k'] } },
  } } }

afterEach(cleanup)

function Harness({ connect = vi.fn() }: { connect?: (field: string, value: string) => void }) {
  const [node, setNode] = useState<CanvasNode>({ id: 'n1', type: 'tool', position: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    data: { tool: 'video.generate', params: { model: 'mini' }, fanout: 1 } })
  return <Inspector node={node} tool={tool} readOnly={false} csrfToken="test-csrf"
    connections={{ resolution: [{ value: 'n0|size', label: 'n0 · size' }] }} onConnect={connect}
    onChange={data => setNode(current => ({ ...current, data: { ...current.data, ...data } }))} />
}

describe('schema inspector', () => {
  it('switches customer-facing dependent options when the model changes', () => {
    render(<Harness />)
    expect(screen.queryByRole('option', { name: '4k' })).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Model' }), { target: { value: 'full' } })
    expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: '4k' })).toBeInTheDocument()
  })

  it('hides developer schema and connections from the customer details panel', () => {
    render(<Harness />)
    expect(screen.getByRole('complementary',{name:'Chi tiết block'})).toHaveTextContent('Video')
    expect(screen.getByRole('combobox',{name:'Độ phân giải'})).toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('video.generate')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Fan-out')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
    expect(screen.queryByText('Nối dữ liệu từ')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { activePage, cloneGraphSelection, connectionAllowed, connectionCreatesCycle, editorReducer, emptyDocument, replaceNodeTool, scopeNodeIds, type EditorState, type PaletteTool } from '../src/editorState'

const tool = (name: string, input: string, output: string): PaletteTool => ({ name,
  description: '', app_slug: 'x', app_name: 'X', requires: [], verifiable: [],
  params_schema: { input: { type: input } }, returns: { output } })

describe('editor reducer', () => {
  it('rejects self-links and links that would close a graph cycle',()=>{
    const edges=[{id:'a-b',source:'a',target:'b'},{id:'b-c',source:'b',target:'c'}]
    expect(connectionCreatesCycle(edges,'c','a')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionCreatesCycle(edges,'b','b')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionCreatesCycle(edges,'a','c')).toBe(false)
  })
  it('undoes, redoes and deletes nodes with their edges', () => {
    const document = emptyDocument()
    activePage(document).nodes = [
      { id: 'a', type: 'tool', position: { x: 0, y: 0 }, data: {} },
      { id: 'b', type: 'tool', position: { x: 1, y: 1 }, data: {params:{input:'$a.output'}} },
    ]
    activePage(document).edges = [{ id: 'a-b', source: 'a',sourceHandle:'output', target: 'b',targetHandle:'input' }]
    let state: EditorState = { document, past: [], future: [] }
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'delete', ids: ['a'] })
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes).toHaveLength(1); expect(activePage(state.document).edges).toHaveLength(0)
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[0].data.params).toEqual({})
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'undo' }); expect(activePage(state.document).nodes).toHaveLength(2)
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'redo' }); expect(activePage(state.document).nodes).toHaveLength(1)
  })

  it('auto-layout changes positions only', () => {
    const document = emptyDocument()
    activePage(document).nodes = [{ id: 'a', type: 'tool', position: { x: 99, y: 99 }, data: { tool: 'x' } }]
    const state = editorReducer({ document, past: [], future: [] }, { type: 'layout' })
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[0].data).toEqual({ tool: 'x' })
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[0].position).toEqual({ x: 90, y: 90 })
  })

  it('stores a display label outside executable node data',()=>{
    const document=emptyDocument()
    activePage(document).nodes=[{id:'a',type:'tool',position:{x:0,y:0},data:{tool:'text.generate'}}]
    const state=editorReducer({document,past:[],future:[]},{type:'nodeLabel',id:'a',label:'Lời dẫn mở đầu'})
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[0].label).toBe('Lời dẫn mở đầu')
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[0].data).toEqual({tool:'text.generate'})
  })

  it('disconnects selected edges without deleting their nodes and can undo', () => {
    const document = emptyDocument()
    activePage(document).nodes = [
      { id: 'a', type: 'tool', position: { x: 0, y: 0 }, data: {} },
      { id: 'b', type: 'tool', position: { x: 1, y: 1 }, data: {params:{input:'$a.output'}} },
    ]
    activePage(document).edges = [{ id: 'a-b', source: 'a',sourceHandle:'output', target: 'b',targetHandle:'input' }]
    let state: EditorState = { document, past: [], future: [] }
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'deleteEdges', ids: ['a-b'] })
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(activePage(state.document).edges).toHaveLength(0)
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[1].data.params).toEqual({})
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'undo' })
    expect(activePage(state.document).edges).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[1].data.params).toEqual({input:'$a.output'})
  })

  it('keeps 100 nodes and 150 edges editable within the local budget', () => {
    const document = emptyDocument()
    activePage(document).nodes = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index) => ({ id: `n${index}`,
      type: 'tool' as const, position: { x: index, y: index }, data: { tool: 'text.script' } }))
    activePage(document).edges = Array.from({ length: 150 }, (_, index) => ({ id: `e${index}`,
      source: `n${index % 99}`, target: `n${(index % 99) + 1}` }))
    const start = performance.now()
    let state: EditorState = { document, past: [], future: [] }
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'layout' })
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'delete', ids: ['n50'] })
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'undo' })
    expect(performance.now() - start).toBeLessThan(250)
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes).toHaveLength(100)
    expect(activePage(state.document).edges).toHaveLength(150)
  })

  it('creates, renames, switches and deletes pages without leaking graph state', () => {
    const document = emptyDocument()
    activePage(document).nodes = [{ id: 'a', type: 'tool', position: { x: 0, y: 0 }, data: {} }]
    let state: EditorState = { document, past: [], future: [] }
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'pageAdd' })
    expect(state.document.pages).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes).toHaveLength(0)
    const second = state.document.active_page_id
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'pageRename', id: second, name: 'Biến thể' })
    expect(activePage(state.document).name).toBe('Biến thể')
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'frameAdd', nodeIds: [] })
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'noteAdd', text: 'Ghi chú' })
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'commentAdd', text: 'Bình luận' })
    expect(activePage(state.document).frames).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(activePage(state.document).notes).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(activePage(state.document).comments).toHaveLength(1)
    const frame = activePage(state.document).frames[0]
    const note = activePage(state.document).notes[0]
    const comment = activePage(state.document).comments[0]
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'frameRename', id: frame.id, name: 'Cảnh mở đầu' })
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'annotationUpdate', kind: 'notes', id: note.id, text: 'Duyệt màu' })
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'annotationDelete', kind: 'comments', id: comment.id })
    expect(activePage(state.document).frames[0].name).toBe('Cảnh mở đầu')
    expect(activePage(state.document).notes[0].text).toBe('Duyệt màu')
    expect(activePage(state.document).comments).toHaveLength(0)
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'frameDelete', id: frame.id })
    expect(activePage(state.document).frames).toHaveLength(0)
    state = editorReducer(state, { type: 'pageDelete', id: second })
    expect(state.document.pages).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes[0].id).toBe('a')
  })

  it('moves a node to another page and removes invalid cross-page edges',()=>{
    const document=emptyDocument();const first=activePage(document)
    first.nodes=[{id:'a',type:'tool',position:{x:0,y:0},data:{}},{id:'b',type:'tool',position:{x:1,y:1},data:{}}]
    first.edges=[{id:'a-b',source:'a',target:'b'}]
    let state:EditorState={document,past:[],future:[]};state=editorReducer(state,{type:'pageAdd'})
    const target=state.document.active_page_id;state=editorReducer(state,{type:'pageSelect',id:'page-1'})
    state=editorReducer(state,{type:'nodeMovePage',id:'a',pageId:target})
    expect(activePage(state.document).nodes.map(node=>node.id)).toEqual(['b'])
    expect(activePage(state.document).edges).toHaveLength(0)
    expect(state.document.pages.find(page=>page.id===target)?.nodes[0].id).toBe('a')
  })

  it('duplicates a graph selection with internal edges and remapped references',()=>{
    const nodes=[
      {id:'source',type:'tool' as const,position:{x:10,y:20},data:{tool:'text.generate',params:{prompt:'gốc'}}},
      {id:'target',type:'tool' as const,position:{x:50,y:60},data:{tool:'image.generate',params:{prompt:'$source.text',refs:['$source.text']}}},
    ]
    const edges=[{id:'source-target',source:'source',sourceHandle:'text',target:'target',targetHandle:'prompt'}]
    const cloned=cloneGraphSelection(nodes,edges,'fixed')
    expect(cloned.nodeIds).toEqual(['source-copy-fixed-0','target-copy-fixed-1'])
    expect(cloned.nodes[1].data.params).toEqual({prompt:'$source-copy-fixed-0.text',refs:['$source-copy-fixed-0.text']})
    expect(cloned.edges).toEqual([{id:'source-copy-fixed-0-text-target-copy-fixed-1-prompt',
      source:'source-copy-fixed-0',sourceHandle:'text',target:'target-copy-fixed-1',targetHandle:'prompt'}])
    expect(cloned.nodes[0].position).toEqual({x:42,y:52})
  })

  it('switches an Image node from generated collection to owned upload without leaving a broken graph',()=>{
    const generated={...tool('image.generate','text','image[]'),params_schema:{prompt:{type:'text',required:true}},
      returns:{image_keys:'image[]'}}
    const uploaded={...tool('asset.image','string','image'),params_schema:{image_key:{type:'string',required:true}},
      returns:{image_key:'image'}}
    const text={...tool('text.generate','text','text'),params_schema:{prompt:{type:'string',required:true},
      image_key:{type:'image'},image_keys:{type:'image[]'}},returns:{text:'text'}}
    const page=activePage(emptyDocument())
    page.nodes=[
      {id:'source',type:'tool',position:{x:0,y:0},data:{tool:'text.generate',params:{prompt:'nguồn'}}},
      {id:'image',type:'tool',label:'Ảnh sản phẩm',position:{x:1,y:0},data:{tool:'image.generate',params:{prompt:'$source.text'}}},
      {id:'analysis',type:'tool',position:{x:2,y:0},data:{tool:'text.generate',params:{prompt:'phân tích',image_keys:'$image.image_keys'}}},
    ]
    page.edges=[
      {id:'source-image',source:'source',sourceHandle:'text',target:'image',targetHandle:'prompt'},
      {id:'image-analysis',source:'image',sourceHandle:'image_keys',target:'analysis',targetHandle:'image_keys'},
    ]
    const replaced=replaceNodeTool(page,'image',uploaded,[generated,uploaded,text],{
      params:{image_key:'agent-assets/u/owned.png'},asset_name:'owned.png',asset_url:'/preview/owned.png'})
    expect(replaced.nodes.find(node=>node.id==='image')).toMatchObject({label:'Ảnh sản phẩm',data:{
      tool:'asset.image',params:{image_key:'agent-assets/u/owned.png'},asset_name:'owned.png'}})
    expect(replaced.edges).toEqual([{id:'image-image_key-analysis-image_key',source:'image',
      sourceHandle:'image_key',target:'analysis',targetHandle:'image_key'}])
    expect(replaced.nodes.find(node=>node.id==='analysis')?.data.params).toMatchObject({
      prompt:'phân tích',image_key:'$image.image_key'})
    expect((replaced.nodes.find(node=>node.id==='analysis')?.data.params as Record<string,unknown>).image_keys).toBeUndefined()
  })
})

describe('typed connection guard', () => {
  it('accepts matching ports and rejects mismatches', () => {
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('a', 'text', 'video'), 'output', tool('b', 'video', 'text'), 'input')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('a', 'text', 'video'), 'output', tool('b', 'image', 'text'), 'input')).toBe(false)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('a', 'text', 'text'), 'output', tool('b', 'enum', 'text'), 'input')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('connects image and image collections to matching multimodal text inputs', () => {
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('image-source', 'text', 'image'), 'output',
      tool('text-vision', 'image', 'text'), 'input')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('batch-source', 'text', 'image[]'), 'output',
      tool('text-vision', 'image[]', 'text'), 'input')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('batch-source', 'text', 'image[]'), 'output',
      tool('text-vision', 'image', 'text'), 'input')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('allows repeated scalar media outputs to feed collection merge inputs',()=>{
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('video-source','text','video'),'output',
      tool('merge-video','video[]','video'),'input')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('image-source','text','image'),'output',
      tool('merge-image','image[]','image'),'input')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('audio-source','text','audio'),'output',
      tool('merge-video','video[]','video'),'input')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('keeps uploaded asset nodes as graph sources, never connection targets', () => {
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('text.generate', 'text', 'text'), 'output',
      tool('asset.image', 'string', 'image'), 'input')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('keeps text context separate from the instruction prompt', () => {
    const source = tool('source-text', 'text', 'text')
    const target = {
      ...tool('text.generate', 'string', 'text'),
      params_schema: { prompt: { type: 'string' }, source_text: { type: 'text' } },
    }
    expect(connectionAllowed(source, 'output', target, 'prompt')).toBe(false)
    expect(connectionAllowed(source, 'output', target, 'source_text')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(source, 'output', tool('image.generate', 'string', 'image'), 'input')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('allows typed image and video references to drive a Video node',()=>{
    const videoTarget={...tool('video.generate','text','video'),params_schema:{
      prompt:{type:'text',required:true},image_key:{type:'image'},image_keys:{type:'image[]'},video_key:{type:'video'}},
      returns:{video_key:'video'}}
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('asset.image','string','image'),'output',videoTarget,'image_key')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('image.batch_generate','text','image[]'),'output',videoTarget,'image_keys')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('asset.video','string','video'),'output',videoTarget,'video_key')).toBe(true)
    expect(connectionAllowed(tool('raw.json','text','json'),'output',{
      ...videoTarget,params_schema:{...videoTarget.params_schema,refs:{type:'json'}}},'refs')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('limits a node run to that node and all transitive prerequisites',()=>{
    const nodes=['a','b','c','unrelated'].map((id,index)=>({id,type:'tool' as const,position:{x:index,y:0},data:{}}))
    const edges=[{id:'a-b',source:'a',target:'b'},{id:'b-c',source:'b',target:'c'}]
    expect(new Set(scopeNodeIds(nodes,edges,['c']))).toEqual(new Set(['a','b','c']))
    expect(scopeNodeIds(nodes,edges,['missing'])).toEqual([])
  })
})

import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest'
import type {PaletteTool} from '../src/editorState'
import {blockPresentation,CANVAS_PRESENTATION_VERSION,canonicalCreativeTools,
  connectionIntent,customerPaletteTools,customerToolLabel,destinationLabel,
  primaryOutputHandle} from '../src/presentationAdapter'

const make=(name:string,returns:Record<string,string>={text:'text'}):PaletteTool=>({name,
  label:name,description:'internal description',app_slug:'x',app_name:'X',requires:[],verifiable:[],
  primary:false,category:name.startsWith('asset.')?'input':'advanced',params_schema:{},returns})

const publicNames=['text.generate','text.script','text.prompt_package','story.storyboard',
  'image.generate','image.batch_generate','image.thumbnail','image.upscale','video.generate',
  'video.short_clips','video.subtitle','video.upscale','video.extract_frames','video.social_import',
  'media.merge_image','media.merge_video','audio.generate','asset.image','asset.images','asset.video','asset.audio']

describe('creative presentation adapter',()=>{
  it('covers every public ToolSpec without changing the document/runtime contract',()=>{
    expect(CANVAS_PRESENTATION_VERSION).toBe('creative-v1')
    for(const name of publicNames)expect(blockPresentation(make(name)),name).toBeDefined()
    expect(blockPresentation(make('asset.image'))?.tier).toBe('internal')
    expect(customerToolLabel(make('text.generate'))).toBe('Văn bản')
    expect(customerToolLabel(make('video.subtitle'))).toBe('Tạo phụ đề')
  })

  it('shows exactly four canonical blocks and hides asset implementations',()=>{
    const palette=[make('asset.image',{image_key:'image'}),make('video.generate',{video_key:'video'}),
      make('audio.generate',{audio_key:'audio'}),make('image.generate',{image_keys:'image[]'}),
      make('text.generate'),make('image.upscale',{image_key:'image'})]
    expect(canonicalCreativeTools(palette).map(tool=>tool.name)).toEqual([
      'text.generate','image.generate','video.generate','audio.generate'])
    expect(customerPaletteTools(palette).map(tool=>tool.name)).toEqual([
      'text.generate','image.generate','video.generate','audio.generate'])
    expect(customerPaletteTools(palette,true).map(tool=>tool.name)).not.toContain('asset.image')
    expect(primaryOutputHandle(palette[3])).toBe('image_keys')
  })

  it('keeps soft-retired tools resolvable but removes them from customer menus',()=>{
    const retired={...make('text.script'),customer_visible:false}
    const palette=[retired,make('text.generate'),make('image.generate',{image_keys:'image[]'})]
    expect(palette.find(tool=>tool.name==='text.script')).toBe(retired)
    expect(customerPaletteTools(palette,true).map(tool=>tool.name)).not.toContain('text.script')
  })

  it('uses human intent and a unique destination label instead of field names',()=>{
    const text=make('text.generate',{text:'text'});const image=make('image.generate',{image_keys:'image[]'})
    expect(connectionIntent(text,'text',image)).toBe('Tạo hình ảnh')
    expect(connectionIntent(image,'image_keys',text)).toBe('Phân tích hình ảnh')
    expect(destinationLabel(text,'text',image,'Ảnh sản phẩm')).toBe('Tạo hình ảnh · Ảnh sản phẩm')
    expect(destinationLabel(text,'text',image,'Ảnh sản phẩm')).not.toContain('prompt')
  })
})

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { approveRun, cloneWorkflow, createAutosave, createRun, exportWorkflow, importWorkflow,
  loadRun, loadRunHistory, restoreRunAsWorkflow, saveWorkflow, WorkflowConflictError,
  type AgentRun, type Workflow } from '../src/workflowApi'

const workflow = { id: 'w1', name: 'A', revision: 3, status: 'draft', estimated: 0,
  canvas: { version: 2, goal: 'g', budget_max_credit: 10, active_page_id: 'page-1',
    pages: [{ id: 'page-1', name: 'Page 1', nodes: [], edges: [],
      viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 }, frames: [], notes: [], comments: [] }] } } satisfies Workflow

afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.useRealTimers() })

describe('workflow API', () => {
  it('uses CSRF and If-Match without sending client price', async () => {
    const fetchMock = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      new Response(JSON.stringify(workflow), { status: 200,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }))
    await saveWorkflow(workflow, 'csrf-test')
    const init = fetchMock.mock.calls[0][1]!
    expect(new Headers(init.headers).get('If-Match')).toBe('"3"')
    expect(new Headers(init.headers).get('X-CSRF-Token')).toBe('csrf-test')
    expect(init.body).not.toContain('estimated')
  })

  it('surfaces revision conflicts', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(new Response('{}', { status: 409 }))
    await expect(saveWorkflow(workflow, 'csrf-test')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(WorkflowConflictError)
  })

  it('binds run creation to workflow revision and approval to quote hash', async () => {
    const run = { id: 'r1', version: 1, status: 'awaiting_approval', plan: { steps: [] },
      checkpoint: {}, estimated: 5, actual: 0, quote_hash: 'abc', decisions: [], artifacts: [] } satisfies AgentRun
    const fetchMock = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation(async () => new Response(
      JSON.stringify(run), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }))
    await createRun(workflow, 'csrf-test', { mode: 'selection', node_ids: ['n1'] })
    expect(new Headers(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][1]?.headers).get('If-Match')).toBe('"3"')
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][1]?.body).toBe(JSON.stringify({ scope: { mode: 'selection', node_ids: ['n1'] }, use_cache: true }))
    await approveRun(run, 'csrf-test')
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[1][1]?.body).toBe(JSON.stringify({ version: 1, quote_hash: 'abc' }))
    await approveRun(run, 'csrf-test', '2026-08-04T02:00:00.000Z')
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[2][1]?.body).toContain('2026-08-04T02:00:00.000Z')
  })

  it('loads owner run history/detail and reuses workflow template contracts', async () => {
    const fetchMock = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation(async input => {
      const url = String(input)
      const body = url.endsWith('/runs') ? { items: [{ id: 'r1' }] }
        : url.endsWith('/runs/r1') ? { id: 'r1' }
        : url.endsWith('/export') ? { schema: 'ltt.agent.workflow' } : workflow
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })
    })
    await expect(loadRunHistory()).resolves.toEqual([{ id: 'r1' }])
    await expect(loadRun('r1')).resolves.toMatchObject({ id: 'r1' })
    await cloneWorkflow(workflow, 'csrf-test')
    await exportWorkflow(workflow)
    await importWorkflow({ schema: 'ltt.agent.workflow' }, 'csrf-test')
    await restoreRunAsWorkflow({id:'r1'} as AgentRun,'csrf-test')
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.map(call => String(call[0]))).toEqual([
      '/agent/api/runs', '/agent/api/runs/r1', '/agent/api/workflows/w1/clone',
      '/agent/api/workflows/w1/export', '/agent/api/workflows/import',
      '/agent/api/runs/r1/restore-workflow'])
    expect(new Headers(fetchMock.mock.calls[2][1]?.headers).get('X-CSRF-Token')).toBe('csrf-test')
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[4][1]?.body).toBe(JSON.stringify({ schema: 'ltt.agent.workflow' }))
    expect(new Headers(fetchMock.mock.calls[5][1]?.headers).get('X-CSRF-Token')).toBe('csrf-test')
  })

  it('debounces autosave and persists only latest value', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const save = vi.fn(async (_value: number) => {})
    const autosave = createAutosave(save, 500)
    autosave.schedule(1); autosave.schedule(2)
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(500)
    expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(2)
  })
})

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { readdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path'

const source = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..')
const output = resolve(source, '../../server/static/autosub-studio')
const ignoredDirs = new Set(['node_modules', '.pytest_cache'])
const ignoredFiles = new Set(['tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo', 'tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo',
  'vite.config.d.ts', 'vite.config.js'])
const inputs = []
async function walk(dir) {
  for (const item of await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (item.isDirectory() && ignoredDirs.has(item.name)) continue
    const full = resolve(dir, item.name)
    if (item.isDirectory()) await walk(full)
    else if (!ignoredFiles.has(item.name)) inputs.push(full)
  }
}
await walk(source)
const hash = createHash('sha256')
for (const full of inputs.sort()) {
  hash.update(relative(source, full).replaceAll('\\', '/')); hash.update('\0')
  hash.update(await readFile(full)); hash.update('\0')
}
await writeFile(resolve(output, 'build-meta.json'), JSON.stringify({
  schema: 1, source_sha256: hash.digest('hex'), node: process.versions.node, sourcemap: false,
}, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8')

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { StudioCue, StudioTrack } from './studioApi'
import { Waveform } from './Waveform'

type Props = { tracks: StudioTrack[]; duration: number; currentTime: number; sourceUrl: string;
  selectedCueId: string; onSelect: (id:string) => void; onSeek:(time:number)=>void;
  onCueChange:(trackId:string,cueId:string,patch:Partial<StudioCue>)=>void }

export function EditorTimeline(props: Props) {
  const {tracks,duration,currentTime,sourceUrl,selectedCueId,onSelect,onSeek,onCueChange}=props
  const safeDuration=Math.max(duration, ...tracks.flatMap(t=>t.cues.map(c=>c.end)), 1)
  const [drag,setDrag]=useState<{track:string;cue:string;mode:'move'|'start'|'end';x:number;start:number;end:number}|null>(null)
  const ticks=useMemo(()=>Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>safeDuration*i/5),[safeDuration])
  const move=(event:React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>)=>{
    if(!drag)return; const rect=event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const delta=(event.clientX-drag.x)/Math.max(1,rect.width)*safeDuration
    if(drag.mode==='move'){const length=drag.end-drag.start; const start=Math.max(0,Math.min(safeDuration-length,drag.start+delta)); onCueChange(drag.track,drag.cue,{start,end:start+length})}
    if(drag.mode==='start')onCueChange(drag.track,drag.cue,{start:Math.max(0,Math.min(drag.end-.05,drag.start+delta))})
    if(drag.mode==='end')onCueChange(drag.track,drag.cue,{end:Math.max(drag.start+.05,Math.min(safeDuration,drag.end+delta))})
  }
  return <div className="timeline-editor" onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={()=>setDrag(null)} onPointerCancel={()=>setDrag(null)}>
    <Waveform src={sourceUrl} duration={safeDuration} currentTime={currentTime} onSeek={onSeek}/>
    <div className="timeline-ruler">{ticks.map(t=><button key={t} onClick={()=>onSeek(t)}>{formatShort(t)}</button>)}</div>
    <div className="timeline-lanes" onPointerDown={event=>{if(event.target===event.currentTarget){const rect=event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();onSeek((event.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width*safeDuration)}}}>
      <i className="playhead" style={{left:`${currentTime/safeDuration*100}%`}}/>
      {tracks.map(track=><div className={`timeline-lane ${track.visible?'':'muted'}`} key={track.id}>
        <span className="lane-label" title={track.name}>{track.kind==='translation'?'TR':'CC'}</span>
        <div className="lane-content">{track.cues.map(cue=><button type="button" key={cue.id}
          className={`cue-block ${selectedCueId===cue.id?'selected':''}`} style={{left:`${cue.start/safeDuration*100}%`,width:`${Math.max(.5,(cue.end-cue.start)/safeDuration*100)}%`}}
          aria-pressed={selectedCueId===cue.id} aria-label={`${cue.text||'Cue trống'}, ${formatShort(cue.start)} đến ${formatShort(cue.end)}`}
          onClick={()=>{onSelect(cue.id);onSeek(cue.start)}} onPointerDown={event=>{event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);setDrag({track:track.id,cue:cue.id,mode:'move',x:event.clientX,start:cue.start,end:cue.end})}}>
          <i className="cue-handle start" onPointerDown={event=>{event.stopPropagation();setDrag({track:track.id,cue:cue.id,mode:'start',x:event.clientX,start:cue.start,end:cue.end})}}/>
          <span>{cue.text||'(trống)'}</span><i className="cue-handle end" onPointerDown={event=>{event.stopPropagation();setDrag({track:track.id,cue:cue.id,mode:'end',x:event.clientX,start:cue.start,end:cue.end})}}/>
        </button>)}</div>
      </div>)}</div>
  </div>
}

function formatShort(seconds:number){const m=Math.floor(seconds/60);const s=Math.floor(seconds%60);return `${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`}

export function friendlyStudioError(error: unknown) {
  const message = String((error as Error)?.message || error)
  return message === 'Failed to fetch'
    ? 'Mất kết nối — thay đổi chưa được lưu.'
    : message
}

export function StudioShell({ csrfToken }: { csrfToken: string }) {

  const [renderJob,setRenderJob]=useState<StudioJob|null>(null)

  const [targetLanguage,setTargetLanguage]=useState('en')

  useEffect(() => { loadOrCreateProject(csrfToken).then(row => {

    setState('ready'); setMessage(row.source_expired
      ? 'Video nguồn đã hết hạn — hãy tải lại để tiếp tục.' : 'Sẵn sàng')
    void loadStudioJobs(row.id).then(items=>{setJobHistory(items)
      setRenderJob(items.find(job=>job.type==='autosubvideo.render')||null)
      setAuxJob(items.find(job=>job.type!=='autosubvideo.render'&&['queued','running'].includes(job.status))||null)
    }).catch(()=>setMessage('Không tải được lịch sử job'))
  }).catch(error => { setState('error'); setMessage(friendlyStudioError(error)) }) }, [csrfToken])
  useEffect(()=>{loadStyles().then(setPresets).catch(()=>setMessage('Không tải được preset'))},[])
  useEffect(()=>{loadCapabilities().then(setCapabilities).catch(()=>setCapabilities(null))},[])
  useEffect(()=>{if(!auxJob||!['queued','running'].includes(auxJob.status))return
    const timer=window.setInterval(()=>{void loadStudioJob(auxJob.id).then(async job=>{setAuxJob(job);upsertJob(setJobHistory,job)

  const autosave = useMemo(() => createAutosave<StudioProject>(async (draft) => {

      const revision = projectRef.current?.revision ?? draft.revision
      const saved = await saveProject({...draft, revision}, csrfToken)
      const current = projectRef.current
      const merged = current?.id === saved.id ? {...current, revision:saved.revision} : saved
      projectRef.current = merged; setProject(merged); setState('saved'); setMessage('Đã lưu')
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ProjectConflictError) { setState('conflict'); setMessage(error.message) }
      else { setState('error'); setMessage(friendlyStudioError(error)) }
    }

    } catch (error) { setState('error'); setMessage(friendlyStudioError(error)); setUpload(0) }
  }
  const onTranscript = async (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0]; if (!file || !projectRef.current) return
    setMessage('Đang nhập transcript…')
    try { const saved = await importTranscript(projectRef.current, csrfToken, file)
      projectRef.current = saved; setProject(saved); setSelectedTrackId(saved.payload.tracks[0]?.id||'')
      setState('saved'); setMessage('Đã nhập transcript')
    } catch (error) { setState('error'); setMessage(friendlyStudioError(error)) }
  }
  const transcribe = async () => {
    if (!projectRef.current) return; setMessage('Đang tạo job WhisperX…')
    try { const response = await startTranscription(projectRef.current, csrfToken)
      const job={id:response.job_id,type:'autosubvideo.transcribe',status:response.status,
        progress:0,message:'đang xếp hàng',error:'',result:{}}
      setAuxJob(job);upsertJob(setJobHistory,job)
      setMessage(`WhisperX đang chạy · job ${response.job_id.slice(0,8)} · 0 credit`)
    } catch (error) { setState('error'); setMessage(friendlyStudioError(error)) }
  }
  const runAux=async(operation:'diarize'|'translate')=>{if(!projectRef.current)return
    setMessage(operation==='diarize'?'Đang tạo job Pyannote…':'Đang tạo job Gemini…')
    try{const trackId=selectedTrackId||projectRef.current.payload.tracks[0]?.id||''
      const response=operation==='diarize'?await startDiarization(projectRef.current,csrfToken):
      await startTranslation(projectRef.current,csrfToken,trackId,targetLanguage)
      const job={id:response.job_id,type:`autosubvideo.${operation}`,status:response.status,
        progress:0,message:'đang xếp hàng',error:'',result:{}}
      setAuxJob(job);upsertJob(setJobHistory,job);setMessage(`${operation} đang xếp hàng · 0 credit`)
    }catch(error){setState('error');setMessage(friendlyStudioError(error))}}

  if (!project) return <div className={`studio-state ${state}`}>{message}</div>
  const source=project.payload.source; const sourceUrl=source.key?`/autosubvideo/v/${source.key}`:''
  const selectedTrack=project.payload.tracks.find(track=>track.id===selectedTrackId)||project.payload.tracks[0]
  const selectedCue=selectedTrack?.cues.find(cue=>cue.id===selectedCueId)
  const cues=project.payload.tracks.reduce((total,track)=>total+track.cues.length,0)
  const filtered=selectedTrack?.cues.filter(cue=>cue.text.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))||[]

  const cueChange=(trackId:string,cueId:string,patch:Partial<StudioCue>)=>mutate(d=>{const cue=findCue(d,trackId,cueId);if(cue)Object.assign(cue,patch)})
  const addTrack=()=>mutate(d=>{const index=d.payload.tracks.length+1;const track:StudioTrack={id:`track-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,kind:'custom',language:'vi',name:`Phụ đề ${index}`,visible:true,z_index:Math.max(-1,...d.payload.tracks.map(t=>t.z_index))+1,style_id:'default',cues:[]};d.payload.tracks.push(track);setSelectedTrackId(track.id);d.payload.active_step='transcript'})
  const addCue=()=>{if(!selectedTrack)return;const start=Math.min(currentTime,Math.max(0,source.duration_s-.1));const end=Math.max(start+.05,Math.min(source.duration_s||start+2,start+2));const id=`cue-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;mutate(d=>{const track=d.payload.tracks.find(t=>t.id===selectedTrack.id);track?.cues.push({id,start,end,text:'Phụ đề mới',speaker:'',words:[]});track?.cues.sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start)});setSelectedCueId(id)}
  const removeCue=()=>{if(!selectedTrack||!selectedCue)return;mutate(d=>{const track=d.payload.tracks.find(t=>t.id===selectedTrack.id);if(track)track.cues=track.cues.filter(c=>c.id!==selectedCue.id)});setSelectedCueId('')}
  const splitCue=()=>{if(!selectedTrack||!selectedCue)return;const at=currentTime>selectedCue.start+.05&&currentTime<selectedCue.end-.05?currentTime:(selectedCue.start+selectedCue.end)/2;const id=`cue-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;mutate(d=>{const track=d.payload.tracks.find(t=>t.id===selectedTrack.id);const cue=track?.cues.find(c=>c.id===selectedCue.id);if(!track||!cue)return;const words=cue.text.trim().split(/\s+/);const cut=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(words.length/2));const second={...cue,id,start:at,text:words.slice(cut).join(' ')||cue.text,words:[]};cue.end=at;cue.text=words.slice(0,cut).join(' ');cue.words=[];track.cues.push(second);track.cues.sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start)});setSelectedCueId(id)}
  const mergeNext=()=>{if(!selectedTrack||!selectedCue)return;const index=selectedTrack.cues.findIndex(c=>c.id===selectedCue.id);const next=selectedTrack.cues[index+1];if(!next)return;mutate(d=>{const track=d.payload.tracks.find(t=>t.id===selectedTrack.id);const cue=track?.cues.find(c=>c.id===selectedCue.id);if(!track||!cue)return;cue.end=next.end;cue.text=`${cue.text} ${next.text}`.trim();cue.words=[];track.cues=track.cues.filter(c=>c.id!==next.id)})}
  const seek=(time:number)=>{setCurrentTime(time);if(videoRef.current)videoRef.current.currentTime=time}

  return <main className="studio-shell" data-save-state={state}>
    <header className="studio-topbar"><div className="studio-brand"><span className="studio-mark">LTT</span><strong>AUTO SUB VIDEO</strong></div>
      <ol className="studio-steps">{steps.map(([id,n,label])=><li key={id} className={project.payload.active_step===id?'active':''}><button type="button" aria-current={project.payload.active_step===id?'step':undefined} onClick={()=>mutate(d=>{d.payload.active_step=id})}><span>{n}</span>{label}</button></li>)}</ol>
      <div className="history-tools"><button aria-label="Hoàn tác" disabled={!history.canUndo} onClick={()=>history.undo(projectRef.current)}>↶</button><button aria-label="Làm lại" disabled={!history.canRedo} onClick={()=>history.redo(projectRef.current)}>↷</button><span className={`studio-save ${state}`} role="status" aria-live="polite">{message}</span></div></header>
    <section className="studio-grid">

        <section className="transcript-panel"><h2>TRANSCRIPT</h2><div className="quick-actions"><label className="subtle-button">Nhập SRT/VTT/ASS<input type="file" accept=".srt,.vtt,.ass,.ssa,.json" onChange={onTranscript}/></label><button type="button" onClick={transcribe} disabled={!source.key}>WhisperX · 0 credit</button></div>
          <div className="track-tools"><select aria-label="Track phụ đề" value={selectedTrack?.id||''} onChange={e=>{setSelectedTrackId(e.target.value);setSelectedCueId('')}}>{project.payload.tracks.map(track=><option key={track.id} value={track.id}>{track.name} · {track.language}</option>)}</select><button onClick={addTrack} aria-label="Thêm track">＋ Track</button>{selectedTrack&&<button aria-label="Ẩn hiện track" onClick={()=>mutate(d=>{const track=d.payload.tracks.find(t=>t.id===selectedTrack.id);if(track)track.visible=!track.visible})}>{selectedTrack.visible?'◉':'○'}</button>}</div>
          <div className="capability-list" aria-label="Trạng thái công cụ AI"><Capability name="WhisperX" ready={capabilities?.whisperx} detail="Transcript và word timing"/><Capability name="Pyannote" ready={capabilities?.diarization} detail="Phân vai ẩn danh"/><Capability name="Gemini" ready={capabilities?.translation} detail="Dịch transcript theo cue"/></div>
          <div className="ai-actions"><button onClick={()=>void runAux('diarize')} disabled={!capabilities?.diarization||!selectedTrack?.cues.length||!!auxJob&&['queued','running'].includes(auxJob.status)} title={!capabilities?.diarization?'Pyannote chưa được cấu hình':''}>Phân vai · 0 credit</button><div><select aria-label="Ngôn ngữ dịch" value={targetLanguage} onChange={e=>setTargetLanguage(e.target.value)}><option value="en">English</option><option value="vi">Tiếng Việt</option><option value="zh">中文</option><option value="ja">日本語</option><option value="ko">한국어</option><option value="fr">Français</option><option value="de">Deutsch</option><option value="es">Español</option></select><button onClick={()=>void runAux('translate')} disabled={!capabilities?.translation||!selectedTrack?.cues.length||!!auxJob&&['queued','running'].includes(auxJob.status)} title={!capabilities?.translation?'Gemini chưa được cấu hình':''}>Dịch Gemini · 0 credit</button></div>{auxJob&&<div className="aux-progress"><progress aria-label="Tiến độ công cụ AI" value={auxJob.progress} max="100"/><span>{auxJob.message||studioJobStatusLabel(auxJob.status)}</span>{['queued','running'].includes(auxJob.status)&&<button onClick={()=>void cancelStudioJob(auxJob.id,csrfToken).then(()=>setAuxJob({...auxJob,status:'cancelled'}))}>Hủy</button>}</div>}</div>
          <input className="cue-search" aria-label="Tìm transcript" placeholder="Tìm transcript…" value={query} onChange={e=>setQuery(e.target.value)}/>
          <div className="cue-list">{filtered.map(cue=><button type="button" key={cue.id} className={cue.id===selectedCueId?'active':''} onClick={()=>{setSelectedCueId(cue.id);seek(cue.start)}}><time>{formatTime(cue.start)}</time><span>{cue.speaker&&<b>{project.payload.speakers[cue.speaker]||cue.speaker}</b>}{cue.text||'(trống)'}</span></button>)}</div><p className="count-line">{project.payload.tracks.length} track · {cues} cue</p></section>

        <JobHistory jobs={jobHistory} onSelect={job=>job.type==='autosubvideo.render'?setRenderJob(job):setAuxJob(job)}/>
      </aside>

      </section>
      <aside className="studio-right">{project.payload.active_step==='render'?<RenderPanel project={project} csrf={csrfToken} job={renderJob} onJob={job=>{setRenderJob(job);upsertJob(setJobHistory,job)}} onMessage={setMessage} onChange={fn=>mutate(fn)}/>:<StyleInspector tab={styleTab} setTab={setStyleTab}

function Capability({name,ready,detail}:{name:string;ready:boolean|undefined;detail:string}){const state=ready===undefined?'Đang kiểm tra':ready?'Sẵn sàng':'Chưa cấu hình';return <div className={`capability ${ready===undefined?'checking':ready?'ready':'unavailable'}`}><span aria-hidden="true"/><div><strong>{name}</strong><small>{detail}</small></div><b>{state}</b></div>}
function formatTime(seconds:number){const safe=Number.isFinite(seconds)?Math.max(0,seconds):0;const h=Math.floor(safe/3600),m=Math.floor((safe%3600)/60),s=Math.floor(safe%60);return [h,m,s].map(value=>String(value).padStart(2,'0')).join(':')}

export function SubtitlePreview({cue,currentTime,rawStyle}:{cue:StudioCue;currentTime:number;rawStyle:Partial<StudioStyle>}) {
  const style=normalizeStyle(rawStyle); const words=cue.text.split(/\s+/); const progress=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(currentTime-cue.start)/Math.max(.05,cue.end-cue.start)));const active=Math.min(words.length-1,Math.floor(progress*words.length))
  const vertical=style.alignment>=7?{top:`${style.margin_v}px`}:style.alignment>=4?{top:'50%',transform:'translateY(-50%)'}:{bottom:`${style.margin_v}px`}
  const css:CSSProperties={...vertical,fontFamily:style.font_family,fontSize:`clamp(14px,${style.font_size/22}vw,${style.font_size}px)`,fontWeight:style.bold?800:400,fontStyle:style.italic?'italic':'normal',color:style.font_color,WebkitTextStroke:`${style.outline_width}px ${style.outline_color}`,textShadow:`${style.shadow_offset}px ${style.shadow_offset}px ${Math.max(1,style.shadow_offset)}px ${style.shadow_color}`,background:style.bg_box?hexAlpha(style.bg_color,style.bg_opacity):undefined,padding:style.bg_box?`${style.bg_padding}px`:undefined}
  return <div key={cue.id} className={`subtitle-overlay animation-${style.animation}`} style={{...css,'--animation-ms':`${style.animation_ms}ms`} as CSSProperties}>{words.map((word,index)=>{const marked=style.highlight_mode==='all_text'||(style.highlight_mode==='word'&&index===active)||(style.highlight_mode==='keyword'&&style.keyword_highlights.some(k=>k.toLowerCase()===word.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu,'').toLowerCase()));return <span key={`${index}-${word}`} className={marked?'highlighted':''} style={marked?{color:style.highlight_mode==='keyword'?style.keyword_highlight_color:style.highlight_color}:undefined}>{word}{' '}</span>})}</div>
}

function hexAlpha(hex:string,opacity:number){const alpha=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,opacity))*255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0');return `${hex}${alpha}`}

import { useMemo } from 'react'
import type { StudioCue, StudioTrack } from './studioApi'

export type TranscriptIssue={cueId:string;severity:'error'|'warning';code:string;message:string}

export function auditTranscript(track:StudioTrack|undefined,maxCharsPerLine=42,maxLines=2){
  if(!track)return {score:0,issues:[] as TranscriptIssue[]}
  const issues:TranscriptIssue[]=[];const sorted=[...track.cues].sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start)
  sorted.forEach((cue,index)=>{
    const duration=Math.max(.01,cue.end-cue.start);const chars=cue.text.trim().length
    if(!chars)issues.push({cueId:cue.id,severity:'error',code:'empty',message:'Cue không có nội dung'})
    if(index>0&&cue.start<sorted[index-1].end)issues.push({cueId:cue.id,severity:'error',code:'overlap',message:'Chồng thời gian với cue trước'})
    if(duration<.5)issues.push({cueId:cue.id,severity:'warning',code:'short',message:'Thời lượng dưới 0,5 giây'})
    if(chars/duration>20)issues.push({cueId:cue.id,severity:'warning',code:'speed',message:`Tốc độ đọc ${Math.round(chars/duration)} ký tự/giây`})
    if(chars>maxCharsPerLine*maxLines)issues.push({cueId:cue.id,severity:'warning',code:'length',message:`Dài hơn giới hạn ${maxCharsPerLine*maxLines} ký tự`})
  })
  const score=Math.max(0,100-issues.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+(item.severity==='error'?15:5),0))
  return {score,issues}
}

export function TranscriptQuality({track,speakers,maxCharsPerLine,maxLines,onCue,onSpeaker}:{
  track:StudioTrack|undefined;speakers:Record<string,string>;maxCharsPerLine:number;maxLines:number;
  onCue:(cue:StudioCue)=>void;onSpeaker:(id:string,name:string)=>void}){
  const report=useMemo(()=>auditTranscript(track,maxCharsPerLine,maxLines),[track,maxCharsPerLine,maxLines])
  const speakerIds=useMemo(()=>[...new Set((track?.cues||[]).map(cue=>cue.speaker).filter(Boolean))].sort(),[track])
  const cueById=new Map((track?.cues||[]).map(cue=>[cue.id,cue]))
  return <section className="transcript-quality" aria-label="Kiểm tra chất lượng transcript">
    <div className="quality-head"><h2>TRANSCRIPT QA</h2><strong className={report.score>=90?'good':report.score>=70?'warn':'bad'}>{report.score}/100</strong></div>
    {track?.cues.length?<>{report.issues.length?<div className="quality-issues">{report.issues.slice(0,8).map((issue,index)=>{const cue=cueById.get(issue.cueId);return <button type="button" key={`${issue.cueId}-${issue.code}-${index}`} className={issue.severity} onClick={()=>cue&&onCue(cue)}><span>{issue.severity==='error'?'Lỗi':'Cảnh báo'}</span>{issue.message}</button>})}{report.issues.length>8&&<small>Và {report.issues.length-8} vấn đề khác</small>}</div>:<p className="quality-pass">Không phát hiện lỗi timing/nội dung/tốc độ đọc.</p>}
      <div className="speaker-workflow"><h3>NGƯỜI NÓI</h3>{speakerIds.length?speakerIds.map(id=><label key={id}><span>{id}</span><input aria-label={`Tên hiển thị cho ${id}`} value={speakers[id]||''} placeholder={id} onChange={event=>onSpeaker(id,event.target.value)}/></label>):<small>Chưa có speaker. Dùng Phân vai hoặc nhập speaker trong cue.</small>}</div></>:<p className="quality-empty">Nhập hoặc tạo transcript để chạy QA.</p>}
  </section>
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

export function Waveform({ src, duration, currentTime, onSeek }: {
  src: string; duration: number; currentTime: number; onSeek: (seconds: number) => void
}) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
  const [samples, setSamples] = useState<number[]>([])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!src) { setSamples([]); return }
    const controller = new AbortController(); let context: AudioContext | undefined
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(src, { signal: controller.signal })
        if (!response.ok) return
        context = new AudioContext()
        const buffer = await context.decodeAudioData(await response.arrayBuffer())
        const channel = buffer.getChannelData(0); const bins = 360
        const block = Math.max(1, Math.floor(channel.length / bins)); const next:number[] = []
        for (let i=0; i<bins; i += 1) {
          let peak = 0; const start = i * block; const end = Math.min(channel.length, start + block)
          for (let j=start; j<end; j += 1) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(channel[j]))
          next.push(peak)
        }
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setSamples(next)
      } catch { /* Some browser codecs cannot be decoded by WebAudio; cue lane remains usable. */ }
      finally { void context?.close() }
    })()
    return () => controller.abort()
  }, [src])

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current; if (!canvas) return
    const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1; const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * scale)); canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height * scale))
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d'); if (!context) return
    context.scale(scale, scale); context.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height)
    context.fillStyle = '#11151a'; context.fillRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height)
    const values = samples.length ? samples : Array.from({length:180}, (_, index) => .12 + ((index * 17) % 13) / 65)
    const step = rect.width / values.length; context.fillStyle = samples.length ? '#8f353b' : '#333941'
    values.forEach((value, index) => { const height = Math.max(2, value * rect.height * .9)
      context.fillRect(index * step, (rect.height - height) / 2, Math.max(1, step - .5), height) })
    const x = duration > 0 ? Math.min(rect.width, currentTime / duration * rect.width) : 0
    context.fillStyle = '#ef2b2d'; context.fillRect(x, 0, 1.5, rect.height)
  }, [samples, currentTime, duration])

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="waveform" aria-label="Dạng sóng âm thanh"
    onPointerDown={event => { if (!duration) return; const rect=event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
      onSeek(Math.max(0, Math.min(duration, (event.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width*duration))) }}/>
}

export class ProjectConflictError extends Error {}

async function decode(response: Response) {
  if (response.ok) return response.json()
  if (response.status === 409) throw new ProjectConflictError('Project đã đổi ở phiên khác')
  let message = `Yêu cầu lỗi (${response.status})`
  try {
    const body = await response.json()
    message = typeof body.detail === 'string' ? body.detail : message
  } catch { /* non-json */ }
  throw new Error(message)
}

export async function loadOrCreateProject(csrf: string): Promise<StudioProject> {
  const listing = await decode(await fetch('/autosubvideo/api/projects', {
    credentials: 'same-origin',
  }))
  const active = listing.items.find((item: { status: string }) => item.status === 'active')
  if (active) return loadProject(active.id)
  return decode(await fetch('/autosubvideo/api/projects', { method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-CSRF-Token': csrf }, body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Dự án chưa đặt tên' }) }))
}

export async function loadProject(id:string):Promise<StudioProject>{
  return decode(await fetch(`/autosubvideo/api/projects/${id}`,{credentials:'same-origin'}))
}

export async function saveProject(project: StudioProject, csrf: string,
                                  signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<StudioProject> {
  return decode(await fetch(`/autosubvideo/api/projects/${project.id}`, { method: 'PUT',
    credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-CSRF-Token': csrf, 'If-Match': `"${project.revision}"` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ name: project.name, payload: project.payload }), signal }))
}

export async function attachSource(project: StudioProject, csrf: string, file: File,
                                   metadata: { duration: number; width: number; height: number },
                                   onProgress: (value: number) => void): Promise<StudioProject> {
  const ticket = await decode(await fetch('/autosubvideo/api/uploads', {
    method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',
      'X-CSRF-Token':csrf}, body:JSON.stringify({filename:file.name,
      content_type:file.type||'video/mp4',expected_size:file.size}),
  }))
  const form = new FormData()
  form.append('revision', String(project.revision)); form.append('csrf_token', csrf)
  form.append('filename', file.name); form.append('duration_s', String(metadata.duration))
  form.append('width', String(metadata.width)); form.append('height', String(metadata.height))
  if (ticket.mode === 'direct') {
    const response = await fetch(ticket.url, { method: 'PUT', headers: ticket.headers, body: file })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Upload R2 lỗi (${response.status})`)
    form.append('upload_id', ticket.upload_id); onProgress(90)
  } else {
    form.append('video', file); onProgress(30)
  }
  return decode(await fetch(`/autosubvideo/api/projects/${project.id}/source`, {
    method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf }, body: form,
  }))
}

export async function importTranscript(project: StudioProject, csrf: string, file: File) {
  const form = new FormData(); form.append('transcript', file)
  form.append('revision', String(project.revision)); form.append('language', 'vi')
  form.append('track_name', file.name); form.append('csrf_token', csrf)
  return decode(await fetch(`/autosubvideo/api/projects/${project.id}/import`, {
    method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf }, body: form,
  })) as Promise<StudioProject>
}

export function createAutosave<T>(save: (value: T, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>,
                                  delayMs = 700) {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let controller: AbortController | undefined
  let latest: T | undefined
  let running = false
  let cancelled = false
  const flush = async () => {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined
    if (running || latest === undefined || cancelled) return
    running = true
    try {
      while (latest !== undefined && !cancelled) {
        const value = latest; latest = undefined
        controller = new AbortController()
        await save(value, controller.signal)
      }
    } finally { running = false }
  }
  return { schedule(value: T) { if (cancelled) return; latest = value; if (timer) clearTimeout(timer)
      timer = setTimeout(() => { void flush() }, delayMs) }, flush,
    cancel() { cancelled = true; if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); controller?.abort(); latest = undefined } }
}

export function readVideoMetadata(file: File): Promise<{ duration: number; width: number; height: number }> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const video = document.createElement('video'); const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    video.preload = 'metadata'; video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url); resolve({ duration: video.duration || 0,
        width: video.videoWidth || 0, height: video.videoHeight || 0 }) }
    video.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(new Error('Không đọc được video')) }
    video.src = url
  })
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { StudioProject } from './studioApi'

const LIMIT = 80

export function useProjectHistory(initial: StudioProject | null,
                                  apply: (value: StudioProject) => void) {
  const past = useRef<StudioProject[]>([])
  const future = useRef<StudioProject[]>([])
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0)
  const initialId = useRef('')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initial && initial.id !== initialId.current) {
      initialId.current = initial.id; past.current = []; future.current = []
      setVersion(value => value + 1)
    }
  }, [initial])

  const record = useCallback((before: StudioProject) => {
    past.current.push(structuredClone(before))
    if (past.current.length > LIMIT) past.current.shift()
    future.current = []; setVersion(value => value + 1)
  }, [])

  const undo = useCallback((current: StudioProject | null) => {
    const previous = past.current.pop(); if (!previous || !current) return
    future.current.push(structuredClone(current)); apply(previous)
    setVersion(value => value + 1)
  }, [apply])

  const redo = useCallback((current: StudioProject | null) => {
    const next = future.current.pop(); if (!next || !current) return
    past.current.push(structuredClone(current)); apply(next)
    setVersion(value => value + 1)
  }, [apply])

  return { record, undo, redo, canUndo: version >= 0 && past.current.length > 0,
    canRedo: version >= 0 && future.current.length > 0 }
}

    const url=String(input)

      diarization:false,translation:false,credit:{transcribe:0,diarize:0,translate:0}}),{status:200})
    if(url.endsWith('/api/projects'))return new Response(JSON.stringify({items:[{id:'p-render',status:'active'}]}),{status:200})

      project_revision:2}}),{status:200})
    if(url.endsWith('/render')&&init?.method==='POST')return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      job_id:'render-job',status:'queued',quote:{credit:1}}),{status:202})
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(project),{status:200})
  })

it('polls a WhisperX job and reloads the project when transcription completes', async () => {
  const empty = { id:'p-asr', name:'ASR lifecycle', revision:2, status:'active', payload:{
    schema_version:1, active_step:'transcript', source:{key:'autosubvideo/u/source.mp4',
      filename:'source.mp4',duration_s:10,width:1280,height:720}, tracks:[], speakers:{},
    style:normalizeStyle({preset:'default'}), output:{resolution:'source',format:'mp4',quality:'standard',
      track_ids:[],export_srt:true,export_vtt:true,export_json:true,export_ass:true,bundle_zip:true}}} as StudioProject
  const complete = structuredClone(empty)
  complete.revision=3;complete.payload.tracks=[{id:'track-source',kind:'source',language:'vi',
    name:'Bản chép lời',visible:true,z_index:0,style_id:'default',cues:[{id:'cue-1',
      start:0,end:2,text:'Xin chào LTT',speaker:'',words:[]}]}]
  let projectLoads=0
  vi.spyOn(globalThis,'fetch').mockImplementation(async (input,init)=>{
    const url=String(input)
    if(url.endsWith('/api/styles'))return new Response(JSON.stringify({items:[]}),{status:200})
    if(url.endsWith('/api/capabilities'))return new Response(JSON.stringify({whisperx:true,
      diarization:false,translation:false,credit:{transcribe:0,diarize:0,translate:0}}),{status:200})
    if(url.endsWith('/api/projects'))return new Response(JSON.stringify({items:[{id:'p-asr',status:'active'}]}),{status:200})
    if(url.includes('/api/jobs?'))return new Response(JSON.stringify({items:[]}),{status:200})
    if(url.endsWith('/transcribe')&&init?.method==='POST')return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      job_id:'asr-job-12345678',status:'queued',credit:0}),{status:202})
    if(url.endsWith('/api/jobs/asr-job-12345678'))return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      id:'asr-job-12345678',type:'autosubvideo.transcribe',status:'done',progress:100,
      message:'chép lời hoàn tất',error:'',result:{}}),{status:200})
    if(url.endsWith('/api/projects/p-asr')){projectLoads+=1;return new Response(JSON.stringify(
      projectLoads===1?empty:complete),{status:200})}
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(empty),{status:200})
  })
  render(<StudioShell csrfToken="csrf"/>)
  fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button',{name:/WhisperX/}))
  await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('status'))
    .toHaveTextContent('AI auxiliary hoàn tất · 0 credit'), {timeout:3000})
  expect(screen.getByText('1 track · 1 cue')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getAllByText('Xin chào LTT').length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
})

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { attachSource, createAutosave, DEFAULT_STYLE, loadOrCreateProject, ProjectConflictError, saveProject,
  type StudioProject } from '../src/studioApi'

const payload = { schema_version: 1 as const, active_step: 'upload' as const,
  source: { key:'', filename:'', duration_s:0, width:0, height:0 }, tracks: [],
  speakers: {}, style: DEFAULT_STYLE, output: { resolution:'source' as const,
    format:'mp4' as const,quality:'standard' as const,track_ids:[],export_srt:true,
    export_vtt:true,export_json:true,export_ass:true,bundle_zip:true } }
const project: StudioProject = { id:'p1', name:'P', revision:1, status:'active', payload }

afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks())

describe('project API', () => {
  it('loads the newest active project', async () => {
    const fetch = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch')
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify({ items:[{ id:'p1', status:'active' }] }), { status:200 }))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify(project), { status:200 }))
    expect((await loadOrCreateProject('csrf')).id).toBe('p1')
    expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })
  it('creates when no active project exists', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch')
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify({ items:[] }), { status:200 }))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify(project), { status:201 }))
    expect((await loadOrCreateProject('csrf')).revision).toBe(1)
  })
  it('sends revision and maps conflict', async () => {
    const fetch = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      new Response(JSON.stringify({ detail:'stale' }), { status:409 }))
    await expect(saveProject(project, 'csrf')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ProjectConflictError)
    const headers = fetch.mock.calls[0][1]?.headers as Record<string,string>
    expect(headers['If-Match']).toBe('"1"')
  })
})

it('stages a Studio source through the project upload contract', async () => {
  const file=new File([new Uint8Array([0,0,0,0])],'source.mp4',{type:'video/mp4'})
  const fetch=vi.spyOn(globalThis,'fetch')
    .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify({mode:'direct',upload_id:'up-1',
      url:'https://upload.test/source',headers:{'Content-Type':'video/mp4'}}),{status:200}))
    .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response('',{status:200}))
    .mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify({...project,revision:2}),{status:200}))
  const saved=await attachSource(project,'csrf',file,{duration:4,width:1280,height:720},()=>{})
  expect(saved.revision).toBe(2)
  const ticket=fetch.mock.calls[0]
  expect(String(ticket[0])).toBe('/autosubvideo/api/uploads')
  expect(JSON.parse(String(ticket[1]?.body))).toMatchObject({expected_size:4,
    filename:'source.mp4',content_type:'video/mp4'})
  const attached=fetch.mock.calls[2][1]?.body as FormData
  expect(attached.get('upload_id')).toBe('up-1')
  expect(attached.get('video_key')).toBeNull()
})

it('autosave coalesces edits and flushes the latest value', async () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers(); const saved: number[] = []
  const autosave = createAutosave<number>(async value => { saved.push(value) }, 50)
  autosave.schedule(1); autosave.schedule(2); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(51)
  expect(saved).toEqual([2]); autosave.cancel(); vi.useRealTimers()
})

it('autosave serializes an edit arriving while a save is running', async () => {
  let release: (()=>void)|undefined; const saved:number[]=[]
  const autosave=createAutosave<number>(async value=>{saved.push(value)
    if(value===1)await new Promise<void>(resolve=>{release=resolve})},0)
  autosave.schedule(1); await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,5))
  autosave.schedule(2); release?.(); await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,5))
  expect(saved).toEqual([1,2]); autosave.cancel()
})
