"""Upload staging lifecycle dùng chung cho app file/media.

File mới luôn vào ``staging/``. Paid input chỉ promote sau khi job giữ credit.
Editor có project bền vững được attach source vào project với TTL riêng; đây
không phải paid input và không được đi vòng qua ``promote(job)``. Session hết
hạn/failure có sweeper idempotent để browser bỏ dở không thành rác vĩnh viễn.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import PurePath
import io
import logging
import re
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select

from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
from platform_core.models import (JOB_CANCELLED, JOB_DONE, JOB_ERROR, Job,
                                  UPLOAD_ATTACHED, UPLOAD_DELETED, UPLOAD_PENDING,
                                  UPLOAD_PROMOTED, UPLOAD_READY, UploadSession)


DEFAULT_TTL_S = 60 * 60
PROMOTED_RETENTION_DAYS = 30
DRAFT_RETENTION_DAYS = 30
MAX_ACTIVE_SESSIONS = 20
MAX_ACTIVE_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_CREATED_PER_MINUTE = 12
_SLUG = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$")
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class UploadSessionError(ValueError):
    pass


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
    return value if value.tzinfo is not None else value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def _matches_type(content_type: str, allowed: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    return any(content_type == item or
               (item.endswith("/*") and content_type.startswith(item[:-1]))
               for item in allowed)


def create(db, *, user_id: str, app_slug: str, filename: str,
           content_type: str, expected_size: int, max_size: int,
           allowed_types: tuple[str, ...], ttl_s: int = DEFAULT_TTL_S,
           now: datetime | None = None) -> UploadSession:
    current = now or _now()
    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(str(app_slug or "")):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Ứng dụng upload không hợp lệ."))
    name = PurePath(str(filename or "").replace("\\", "/")).name[:255]
    if not name:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Tên file không hợp lệ."))
    ct = str(content_type or "application/octet-stream").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower()
    if not _matches_type(ct, allowed_types):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Loại file không được hỗ trợ."))
    try:
        size = int(expected_size)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Kích thước file không hợp lệ.")) from exc
    if size <= 0 or size > int(max_size):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Kích thước file vượt giới hạn."))

    active = (UPLOAD_PENDING, UPLOAD_READY)
    active_count, active_bytes = db.execute(select(
        func.count(UploadSession.id),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(UploadSession.expected_size), 0),
    ).where(
        UploadSession.user_id == user_id,
        UploadSession.status.in_(active),
        UploadSession.expires_at > current,
    )).one()
    recent = db.execute(select(func.count(UploadSession.id)).where(
        UploadSession.user_id == user_id,
        UploadSession.created_at >= current - timedelta(minutes=1),
    )).scalar_one()
    if int(active_count or 0) >= MAX_ACTIVE_SESSIONS or \
            int(active_bytes or 0) + size > MAX_ACTIVE_BYTES:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Đã đạt giới hạn upload đang chờ."))
    if int(recent or 0) >= MAX_CREATED_PER_MINUTE:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Tạo quá nhiều lượt upload. Vui lòng thử lại sau."))

    session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    ext = PurePath(name).suffix.lower()[:12]
    session = UploadSession(
        id=session_id,
        user_id=user_id, app_slug=app_slug, filename=name, content_type=ct,
        expected_size=size, expires_at=current + timedelta(seconds=max(60, int(ttl_s))),
        staging_key=f"staging/{user_id}/{app_slug}/{session_id}/payload{ext}",
    )
    db.add(session); db.flush()
    return session


def owned(db, *, session_id: str = "", staging_key: str = "",
          user_id: str, app_slug: str) -> UploadSession | None:
    stmt = select(UploadSession).where(
        UploadSession.user_id == user_id, UploadSession.app_slug == app_slug)
    if session_id:
        stmt = stmt.where(UploadSession.id == session_id)
    elif staging_key:
        stmt = stmt.where(UploadSession.staging_key == staging_key)
    else:
        return None
    return db.execute(stmt).scalar_one_or_none()


def upload_target(storage, session: UploadSession):
    return storage.try_put_url(
        session.staging_key,
        ttl_s=max(60, int((_utc(session.expires_at) - _now()).total_seconds())),
        content_type=session.content_type,
    )


def _signature_ok(content_type: str, head: bytes) -> bool:
    ct = content_type.lower()
    if ct in {"application/octet-stream"}:
        return bool(head)
    if ct in {"image/jpeg", "image/jpg"}:
        return head.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff")
    if ct == "image/png":
        return head.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
    if ct == "image/webp":
        return head.startswith(b"RIFF") and head[8:12] == b"WEBP"
    if ct in {"video/mp4", "video/quicktime", "video/x-m4v"}:
        return len(head) >= 12 and head[4:8] == b"ftyp"
    if ct in {"video/webm", "video/x-matroska"}:
        return head.startswith(b"\x1aE\xdf\xa3")
    if ct == "video/x-msvideo":
        return head.startswith(b"RIFF") and head[8:12] == b"AVI "
    if ct in {"audio/wav", "audio/x-wav"}:
        return head.startswith(b"RIFF") and head[8:12] == b"WAVE"
    if ct in {"audio/mpeg", "audio/mp3"}:
        return head.startswith(b"ID3") or (len(head) >= 2 and head[0] == 0xFF)
    if ct in {"audio/mp4", "audio/x-m4a"}:
        return len(head) >= 12 and head[4:8] == b"ftyp"
    return False


def confirm(db, storage, session: UploadSession,
            *, now: datetime | None = None) -> UploadSession:
    current = now or _now()
    if session.status == UPLOAD_READY:
        return session
    if session.status != UPLOAD_PENDING or _utc(session.expires_at) <= current:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Vé upload đã hết hạn hoặc đã được dùng."))
    if not storage.exists(session.staging_key):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("File chưa upload xong."))
    actual = int(storage.size(session.staging_key))
    if actual != int(session.expected_size):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Kích thước file thực tế không khớp khai báo."))
    stream = storage.open(session.staging_key)
    try:
        head = stream.read(32)
    finally:
        stream.close()
    if not _signature_ok(session.content_type, head):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Nội dung file không khớp định dạng khai báo."))
    session.actual_size = actual
    session.status = UPLOAD_READY
    session.updated_at = current
    db.flush()
    return session


def stage_bytes(db, storage, *, user_id: str, app_slug: str, filename: str,
                content_type: str, data: bytes, max_size: int,
                allowed_types: tuple[str, ...],
                ttl_s: int = DEFAULT_TTL_S) -> UploadSession:
    """Stage multipart nhỏ bằng cùng contract với direct upload."""
    session = create(
        db, user_id=user_id, app_slug=app_slug, filename=filename,
        content_type=content_type, expected_size=len(data), max_size=max_size,
        allowed_types=allowed_types, ttl_s=ttl_s,
    )
    storage.put(session.staging_key, io.BytesIO(data), content_type=session.content_type)
    return confirm(db, storage, session)


def _la_job_thu(job: Job) -> bool:
    """Job này có phải job chế độ thử (khoá `ltt_tk_`) hay không.

    Cửa "phải giữ credit mới được lưu file" tồn tại để không ai biến input của
    job thành kho lưu trữ miễn phí. Một job chế độ thử **không bao giờ** giữ
    credit — đó chính là lời hứa của khoá thử — nên với nó cửa đó không phải một
    hàng rào mà là một bức tường: mọi tool nhận file trở thành không thử được,
    và đúng cái mà chế độ thử sinh ra để cho phép lại là cái nó chặn.

    Trần chống lạm dụng của chế độ thử nằm ở chỗ khác và vẫn nguyên: giới hạn
    kích thước, giới hạn nhịp gọi, và hạn lưu trữ của upload đã promote.
    """
    from platform_core.public_api import sandbox

    return sandbox.is_test(sandbox.mode_of_job(job))


def promote(db, storage, session: UploadSession, *, job: Job,
            final_key: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    from platform_core import credit, job_events
    current = now or _now()
    if session.user_id != job.user_id or session.app_slug != job.app_slug:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Upload không thuộc job này."))
    if session.status == UPLOAD_PROMOTED:
        if session.job_id != job.id or session.final_key != final_key:
            raise UploadSessionError(_t("Upload đã được dùng cho job khác."))
        return session.final_key
    confirm(db, storage, session, now=current)
    if credit.so_da_giu(db, job.id) <= 0 and not _la_job_thu(job):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Chưa giữ credit nên không thể lưu file."))
    try:
        stored = storage.promote(
            session.staging_key, final_key, content_type=session.content_type)
        if stored.size != session.actual_size:
            raise UploadSessionError(_t("Promote file không toàn vẹn."))
        session.status = UPLOAD_PROMOTED
        session.final_key = stored.key
        session.job_id = job.id
        session.expires_at = current + timedelta(days=PROMOTED_RETENTION_DAYS)
        session.updated_at = current
        job_events.append(
            db, job, "input_promoted", visibility=job_events.INTERNAL,
            details={"upload_id": session.id, "bytes": session.actual_size,
                     "content_type": session.content_type},
            event_key=f"input-promoted:{session.id}",
        )
        db.flush()
    except Exception:
        # Object storage không tham gia transaction CSDL. Nếu validation/flush
        # sau lệnh move lỗi, trả file về staging để retry/sweeper còn nhìn thấy.
        compensate(storage, [(session.staging_key, final_key,
                              session.content_type)])
        raise
    return stored.key


def attach_to_project(db, storage, session: UploadSession, *, project_id: str,
                      final_key: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    """Attach a validated source to an owner-scoped editor project.

    This transition is deliberately separate from ``promote``: a draft source
    is needed before a paid Job exists, while paid inputs must still prove a
    credit hold. The caller owns the AppProject ownership/revision check and
    must compensate the object move if its database commit fails.
    """
    current = now or _now()
    pid = str(project_id or "").strip()
    prefix = f"{session.app_slug}/{session.user_id}/"
    if not pid or not str(final_key).startswith(prefix):
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Đích project upload không hợp lệ."))
    if session.status == UPLOAD_ATTACHED:
        if session.project_id != pid or session.final_key != final_key:
            raise UploadSessionError(_t("Upload đã gắn vào project khác."))
        session.expires_at = current + timedelta(days=DRAFT_RETENTION_DAYS)
        session.updated_at = current
        db.flush()
        return session.final_key
    if session.status == UPLOAD_PROMOTED:
        raise UploadSessionError(_t("Upload đã được dùng cho job."))
    confirm(db, storage, session, now=current)
    try:
        stored = storage.promote(
            session.staging_key, final_key, content_type=session.content_type)
        if stored.size != session.actual_size:
            raise UploadSessionError(_t("Attach file không toàn vẹn."))
        session.status = UPLOAD_ATTACHED
        session.final_key = stored.key
        session.project_id = pid
        session.expires_at = current + timedelta(days=DRAFT_RETENTION_DAYS)
        session.updated_at = current
        db.flush()
    except Exception:
        compensate(storage, [(session.staging_key, final_key,
                              session.content_type)])
        raise
    return stored.key


def project_attachment(db, *, user_id: str, app_slug: str,
                       project_id: str, final_key: str) -> UploadSession | None:
    return db.execute(select(UploadSession).where(
        UploadSession.user_id == user_id,
        UploadSession.app_slug == app_slug,
        UploadSession.project_id == project_id,
        UploadSession.final_key == final_key,
    )).scalar_one_or_none()


def touch_project_attachment(db, session: UploadSession,
                             *, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    if session.status != UPLOAD_ATTACHED:
        return False
    current = now or _now()
    session.expires_at = current + timedelta(days=DRAFT_RETENTION_DAYS)
    session.updated_at = current
    db.flush()
    return True


def compensate(storage, promotions: list[tuple[str, str, str]]) -> int:
    """Đảo các move chưa commit, theo thứ tự ngược; best-effort và idempotent.

    Route gọi hàm này sau ``db.rollback()`` nếu commit chứa job/hold/session lỗi.
    Nhờ key đích xác định trước, file không thành orphan vô danh ngoài CSDL.
    """
    restored = 0
    for staging_key, final_key, content_type in reversed(promotions):
        try:
            if storage.exists(final_key) and not storage.exists(staging_key):
                storage.promote(final_key, staging_key, content_type=content_type)
                restored += 1
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - keep reverting the remaining files
            log.exception("khong the tra artifact ve staging: %s", final_key)
    return restored


def _stored_key(session: UploadSession) -> str:
    return (session.final_key if session.status in (UPLOAD_ATTACHED, UPLOAD_PROMOTED)
            else session.staging_key)


def sweep(db, storage, *, now: datetime | None = None,
          dry_run: bool = True, limit: int = 500) -> dict:
    current = now or _now()
    rows = list(db.execute(select(UploadSession).where(
        UploadSession.status.in_((UPLOAD_PENDING, UPLOAD_READY, UPLOAD_ATTACHED,
                                  UPLOAD_PROMOTED)),
        UploadSession.expires_at <= current,
    ).order_by(UploadSession.expires_at).limit(max(1, min(int(limit), 5000)))).scalars())
    due = []; skipped_active = 0; errors = 0; deleted = 0
    for session in rows:
        if session.job_id:
            job = db.get(Job, session.job_id)
            if job is not None and job.status not in (JOB_DONE, JOB_ERROR, JOB_CANCELLED):
                skipped_active += 1
                continue
        key = _stored_key(session)
        due.append({"upload_id": session.id, "status": session.status,
                    "bytes": session.actual_size or session.expected_size})
        if dry_run:
            continue
        try:
            storage.delete(key)
            session.status = UPLOAD_DELETED
            session.updated_at = current
            deleted += 1
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - report keeps sweeper progressing
            log.exception("cleanup upload session %s that bai", session.id)
            errors += 1
    if not dry_run:
        db.flush()
    return {"due": len(due), "deleted": deleted, "errors": errors,
            "skipped_active": skipped_active, "items": due}


def cleanup_failed_job(db, storage, job: Job) -> int:
    """Xóa input promoted của job terminal lỗi/hủy; gọi lại không đổi kết quả."""
    if job.status not in (JOB_ERROR, JOB_CANCELLED):
        return 0
    rows = list(db.execute(select(UploadSession).where(
        UploadSession.job_id == job.id,
        UploadSession.status == UPLOAD_PROMOTED,
    )).scalars())
    removed = 0
    for session in rows:
        storage.delete(session.final_key)
        session.status = UPLOAD_DELETED
        session.updated_at = _now()
        removed += 1
    if removed:
        from platform_core import job_events
        job_events.append(
            db, job, "input_cleaned", visibility=job_events.INTERNAL,
            details={"uploads": removed}, event_key="failed-input-cleanup",
        )
    db.flush()
    return removed


def reconcile(db, storage, *, limit: int = 1000) -> dict:
    rows = list(db.execute(select(UploadSession).where(
        UploadSession.status.in_((UPLOAD_PENDING, UPLOAD_READY, UPLOAD_ATTACHED,
                                  UPLOAD_PROMOTED)),
    ).limit(max(1, min(int(limit), 5000)))).scalars())
    missing = []
    for session in rows:
        key = _stored_key(session)
        if not storage.exists(key):
            missing.append({"upload_id": session.id, "status": session.status,
                            "job_id": session.job_id})
    return {"checked": len(rows), "missing": len(missing), "items": missing}

"""
users.py — nghiệp vụ người dùng và phiên đăng nhập phía máy chủ.

Tách khỏi route: route lo HTTP (form, cookie, redirect), file này lo quy tắc
(băm mật khẩu, chuẩn hoá email, tạo/thu hồi phiên). Nhờ vậy test được logic mà
không cần dựng cả một request giả.

Băm mật khẩu **tái dùng** `platform_core/password_hashing.py` — đúng hàm PBKDF2
đang chạy production. Không phát minh cách băm thứ hai: hai cách băm trong một
hệ thống là hai chỗ có thể sai, và tài khoản tạo bằng cách này phải đăng nhập
được bằng đường kia trong suốt giai đoạn chạy song song.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session as DbSession

from platform_core.models import Session as SessionRow
from platform_core.models import User
from platform_core.password_hashing import hash_password, verify_password

# Phiên sống 8 giờ không hoạt động — khớp với SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS cũ của
# cookie Starlette, nên hành vi hết hạn không đổi dưới mắt người dùng.
SESSION_TTL = timedelta(hours=8)


class UserError(Exception):
    """Lỗi nghiệp vụ người dùng, thông điệp an toàn để hiện cho người dùng."""


def chuan_hoa_email(email: str) -> str:
    """Chuẩn hoá để LƯU và HIỂN THỊ. Chỉ bỏ khoảng trắng và hạ chữ thường."""
    return (email or "").strip().lower()


# Nhà cung cấp coi dấu chấm và hậu tố `+…` là CÙNG một hộp thư.
_MIEN_ALIAS = {"gmail.com", "googlemail.com"}


def chuan_hoa_email_chong_trung(email: str) -> str:
    """Chuẩn hoá để KIỂM TRÙNG — khác `chuan_hoa_email`.

    Gmail giao `a@gmail.com`, `a+1@gmail.com`, `a.b@gmail.com` về **cùng một hộp
    thư**. Trước đây hệ thống coi chúng là ba email khác nhau, nên một hộp Gmail
    tạo được vô hạn tài khoản, mỗi cái 20 credit dùng thử. Xác thực email không
    cản được: chính người đó nhận hết thư xác thực.

    Hàm này CHỈ dùng cho cột `email_chuan` (chống trùng). Email gốc vẫn giữ
    nguyên để hiển thị và gửi thư — người dùng nhập `a.b@gmail.com` thì phải
    thấy đúng chuỗi đó, không phải chuỗi ta tự sửa.

    Cố ý chỉ áp cho Gmail: mỗi nhà cung cấp một luật, đoán bừa cho miền khác sẽ
    gộp nhầm hai người thành một.
    """
    e = chuan_hoa_email(email)
    if "@" not in e:
        return e
    ten, mien = e.rsplit("@", 1)
    if mien == "googlemail.com":
        mien = "gmail.com"
    if mien in _MIEN_ALIAS:
        ten = ten.split("+", 1)[0].replace(".", "")
    return f"{ten}@{mien}"


# ── Tạo và xác thực người dùng ────────────────────────────────────────────────

def tao_nguoi_dung(
    db: DbSession, *, email: str, password: str, display_name: str = "",
    role: str = "user", is_verified: bool = False, registration_ip: str = "",
) -> User:
    """Tạo một người dùng. Ném `UserError` nếu email đã tồn tại.

    KHÔNG commit — nơi gọi quyết định thời điểm chốt giao dịch, vì việc tạo user
    thường đi cùng những thao tác khác (cấp credit dùng thử) phải cùng thành
    hoặc cùng bại.
    """
    email = chuan_hoa_email(email)
    if not email or "@" not in email:
        raise UserError("Email không hợp lệ.")
    if not password:
        raise UserError("Mật khẩu không được rỗng.")

    # Kiem trung theo email_chuan, KHONG theo email goc: gmail giao
    # a@ / a+1@ / a.b@ ve cung mot hop thu (xem chuan_hoa_email_chong_trung).
    chuan = chuan_hoa_email_chong_trung(email)
    trung = db.execute(
        select(User).where(User.email_chuan == chuan)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if trung is not None:
        raise UserError("Email này đã được đăng ký.")

    user = User(
        email=email,
        email_chuan=chuan,
        display_name=display_name.strip() or email.split("@")[0],
        password_hash=hash_password(password),
        role=role,
        is_verified=is_verified,
        registration_ip=(registration_ip or "")[:45],
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.flush()      # gán id ngay, nhưng chưa commit
    return user


def tim_theo_email(db: DbSession, email: str) -> Optional[User]:
    return db.execute(
        select(User).where(User.email == chuan_hoa_email(email))
    ).scalar_one_or_none()


def xac_thuc(db: DbSession, *, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:
    """Trả về User nếu email+mật khẩu đúng và tài khoản còn hoạt động.

    Trả `None` cho **mọi** trường hợp sai — không phân biệt "email không tồn
    tại" với "sai mật khẩu". Phân biệt hai cái đó là tiết lộ email nào đã đăng
    ký, tức là làm lộ danh sách khách hàng cho kẻ dò.

    Vẫn băm-và-so ngay cả khi email không tồn tại, để thời gian phản hồi không
    tiết lộ tài khoản nào có thật (timing oracle).
    """
    user = tim_theo_email(db, email)
    if user is None:
        # So với một hash giả để tiêu tốn thời gian tương đương.
        verify_password(password, _HASH_GIA)
        return None
    if not verify_password(password, user.password_hash):
        return None
    if not user.is_active:
        return None
    return user


# Một hash PBKDF2 thật của một chuỗi ngẫu nhiên, tính một lần lúc nạp module.
# Dùng để so khi email không tồn tại — không bao giờ khớp, chỉ để tốn thời gian.
_HASH_GIA = hash_password(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))


def doi_mat_khau(db: DbSession, user: User, mat_khau_moi: str) -> None:
    """Đổi mật khẩu và **thu hồi mọi phiên** của user đó.

    Thu hồi phiên là điểm mấu chốt: đổi mật khẩu mà các phiên cũ vẫn sống thì
    một kẻ đã chiếm phiên vẫn vào được sau khi nạn nhân đã đổi mật khẩu.
    """
    if not mat_khau_moi:
        raise UserError("Mật khẩu không được rỗng.")
    user.password_hash = hash_password(mat_khau_moi)
    thu_hoi_moi_phien(db, user.id)
    db.flush()


# ── Phiên đăng nhập phía máy chủ ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def _bay_gio() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _aware(dt: datetime) -> datetime:
    """Bảo đảm datetime có múi giờ (coi naive là UTC).

    PostgreSQL với `DateTime(timezone=True)` trả về datetime có múi giờ, nhưng
    SQLite không giữ tzinfo nên đọc ra là naive. So một cái naive với một cái
    aware ném TypeError. Chuẩn hoá tại điểm so sánh để code chạy đúng trên cả
    hai backend — production là Postgres, test là SQLite.
    """
    return dt if dt.tzinfo is not None else dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def _bam_sid(sid: str) -> str:
    """Băm token phiên để LƯU (không lưu token thô).

    `id` của bảng `sessions` vừa là token vừa là KHOÁ CHÍNH. sqladmin phơi khoá
    chính ra checkbox/URL của từng dòng, nên nếu id = token thô thì admin xem
    trang Phiên là lấy được token sống → mạo danh không cần mật khẩu (P0-5).
    Giải pháp: cookie mang token THÔ, còn DB chỉ lưu SHA-256 của nó; tra cứu thì
    băm token trong cookie rồi so với hash. Dump CSDL cũng không lộ token dùng
    được (băm một chiều).
    """
    return hashlib.sha256(sid.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def tao_phien(db: DbSession, user: User, *, user_agent: str = "", ip: str = "",
              ttl: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:
    """Tạo một phiên, trả về session_id (token THÔ) để đặt vào cookie.

    Token là 32 byte ngẫu nhiên mã hoá urlsafe — không đoán được, không mang
    thông tin gì về user. CSDL chỉ lưu HASH của token (xem `_bam_sid`), không
    lưu token thô.

    `ttl` để rút ngắn tuổi thọ cho những phiên **không phải** cookie trình duyệt
    — cụ thể là vé SSO của ứng dụng Nexus, thứ đi qua thanh địa chỉ nên phải chết
    nhanh (xem `platform_core.nexus.sso`). Bỏ trống → `SESSION_TTL` như cũ.
    """
    sid = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    db.add(SessionRow(
        id=_bam_sid(sid), user_id=user.id,
        expires_at=_bay_gio() + (ttl or SESSION_TTL),
        user_agent=(user_agent or "")[:255], ip=(ip or "")[:45],
    ))
    user.last_login_at = _bay_gio()
    db.flush()
    return sid


def lay_user_tu_phien(db: DbSession, sid: Optional[str]) -> Optional[User]:
    """Đổi session_id (token thô trong cookie) lấy User, hoặc None nếu phiên
    sai/hết hạn/user bị khoá. Băm token trước khi tra vì DB chỉ lưu hash.

    Phiên hết hạn thì xoá luôn tại chỗ — dọn rác dần thay vì để bảng phình mãi.
    """
    if not sid:
        return None
    row = db.get(SessionRow, _bam_sid(sid))
    if row is None:
        return None
    if _aware(row.expires_at) <= _bay_gio():
        db.delete(row)
        db.flush()
        return None
    user = db.get(User, row.user_id)
    if user is None or not user.is_active:
        return None
    return user


def thu_hoi_phien(db: DbSession, sid: str) -> None:
    """Đăng xuất một phiên. Băm token trước khi tra (DB lưu hash)."""
    row = db.get(SessionRow, _bam_sid(sid))
    if row is not None:
        db.delete(row)
        db.flush()


def thu_hoi_moi_phien(db: DbSession, user_id: str) -> int:
    """Đăng xuất khỏi mọi thiết bị. Trả về số phiên đã xoá."""
    rows = db.execute(
        select(SessionRow).where(SessionRow.user_id == user_id)
    ).scalars().all()
    for r in rows:
        db.delete(r)
    db.flush()
    return len(rows)


def don_phien_het_han(db: DbSession) -> int:
    """Xoá mọi phiên đã hết hạn. Dành cho tác vụ dọn dẹp định kỳ."""
    rows = db.execute(
        select(SessionRow).where(SessionRow.expires_at <= _bay_gio())
    ).scalars().all()
    for r in rows:
        db.delete(r)
    db.flush()
    return len(rows)

"""
TikTok Capability Check — verify app audit status + per-account permissions
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Queries TikTok's /v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/ for each connected account
to determine:
  - Granted scopes (user.info.basic, video.upload, video.publish)
  - Privacy levels available (SELF_ONLY only = Sandbox/unaudited;
    + PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE = FULL APPROVAL)
  - Max video duration allowed
  - Creator-level toggles (duet, comment, stitch)

Usage:
    .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts\\_check_tiktok_capabilities.py
    .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts\\_check_tiktok_capabilities.py --account klcloset96

Prints one line per capability, pass/fail.

Exit codes:
    0 — at least one account is FULL APPROVAL (PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE available)
    1 — no PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE on any account (Sandbox)
    2 — config / token errors
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

# Force UTF-8 on Windows cmd (cp1252 chokes on Unicode box-drawing)
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
except (AttributeError, OSError):
    pass


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="TikTok capability check")
    parser.add_argument("--account", default=None,
                        help="Filter to one account by display_name or open_id prefix")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", "-v", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Load config + token store
    from core.tiktok.token_store import get_default_store
    from core.tiktok.creator_info import query_creator_info
    from core.tiktok.client import TikTokError

    store = get_default_store()
    accounts = store.all_accounts()
    if not accounts:
        print("[FATAL] No TikTok accounts connected.")
        print("        Run bot → tab 'TikTok Accounts' → Continue with TikTok.")
        return 2

    if args.account:
        filt = args.account.lower()
        accounts = [a for a in accounts
                    if filt in a.display_name.lower() or a.open_id.startswith(args.account)]
        if not accounts:
            print(f"[FATAL] No account matches '{args.account}'")
            return 2

    print("=" * 70)
    print("  TIKTOK CAPABILITY CHECK")
    print("=" * 70)

    any_public = False
    summary = []

    for i, acc in enumerate(accounts, 1):
        # Skip accounts with stale tokens
        if not acc.is_token_valid():
            print(f"\n[{i}] Account: @{acc.display_name}  (open_id={acc.open_id[:16]}...)")
            print(f"    ⚠  Access token expired — refresh via bot GUI first.")
            summary.append((acc.display_name, "TOKEN_EXPIRED", []))
            continue

        print(f"\n[{i}] Account: @{acc.display_name}  ({acc.open_id[:16]}...)")
        print(f"    Scopes granted on token: {','.join(acc.scopes)}")

        try:
            info = query_creator_info(
                access_token=acc.access_token,
                timeout_s=15,
                on_log=(lambda m, l: print(f"    · {m}")) if args.verbose else None,
            )
        except TikTokError as exc:
            print(f"    ❌ TikTok API error: {exc}")
            summary.append((acc.display_name, "API_ERROR", []))
            continue
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"    ❌ Unexpected error: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            summary.append((acc.display_name, "ERROR", []))
            continue

        # Display privacy options
        opts = info.privacy_level_options
        has_public = "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE" in opts
        if has_public:
            any_public = True
            print(f"    Direct Post: ✅  APPROVED for PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE")
        else:
            print(f"    Direct Post: ⚠  ONLY SELF_ONLY (Sandbox/unaudited)")

        print(f"    Privacy options available: {len(opts)}")
        for o in opts:
            marker = "[PUBLIC]" if o == "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE" else "[OK]    "
            print(f"      {marker} {o}")

        print(f"    Max video duration: {info.max_video_post_duration_sec}s")
        print(f"    Creator settings: "
              f"duet={'disabled' if info.duet_disabled else 'allowed'}, "
              f"comment={'disabled' if info.comment_disabled else 'allowed'}, "
              f"stitch={'disabled' if info.stitch_disabled else 'allowed'}")

        if args.verbose and (info.creator_nickname or info.creator_avatar_url):
            print(f"    Creator nickname: {info.creator_nickname}")
            print(f"    Avatar URL: {info.creator_avatar_url[:80]}")

        summary.append((acc.display_name, "PUBLIC" if has_public else "SELF_ONLY", opts))

    # Final verdict
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    if any_public:
        print("  STATUS: ✅ FULL APPROVAL — app moved to Production")
        print("  Ready for Direct Post PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE.")
    else:
        print("  STATUS: ⚠  No PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE on any account (Sandbox mode).")
        print("  Possible causes:")
        print("    - Client key/secret in config is Sandbox (not Production)")
        print("    - Account connected before audit Live — re-OAuth needed")
        print("    - App still in Sandbox tab on TikTok Developer Portal")
    print("=" * 70)

    return 0 if any_public else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""
TikTok permission audit — comprehensive probe of what the bot CAN do right now.

Differentiates 3 layers of permissions:
  A. SCOPES GRANTED — what's in the access_token (from OAuth flow)
  B. CREATOR INFO  — what TikTok reports for the connected account
  C. AUDIT TIER    — what the publish API actually allows (the real gate)

Critical insight: Layer C can REJECT operations that Layers A and B suggest
should work. TikTok enforces audit-tier rules at the publish endpoint that
are not visible via /creator_info/query/.

This script probes all three layers and produces a GAP REPORT showing what's
nominally granted vs what's actually enforced.

Usage:
    .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts\\_check_tiktok_permissions.py
    .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts\\_check_tiktok_permissions.py --account klcloset96
    .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts\\_check_tiktok_permissions.py --json

Exit codes:
    0 — Full PUBLIC posting capability confirmed
    1 — Limited capabilities (draft only, or SELF_ONLY restriction)
    2 — Severe restriction or errors
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

# Force UTF-8 stdout on Windows cmd
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
except (AttributeError, OSError):
    pass


# ─── Color helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class _C:
    OK    = "\033[92m"
    WARN  = "\033[93m"
    FAIL  = "\033[91m"
    DIM   = "\033[90m"
    BOLD  = "\033[1m"
    END   = "\033[0m"


def section(title: str):
    print(f"\n{_C.BOLD}━━━ {title} ━━━{_C.END}")


def ok(label: str, detail: str = ""):
    print(f"  {_C.OK}✓{_C.END} {label}{(': ' + detail) if detail else ''}")


def fail(label: str, detail: str = ""):
    print(f"  {_C.FAIL}✗ {label}{_C.END}{(': ' + detail) if detail else ''}")


def warn(label: str, detail: str = ""):
    print(f"  {_C.WARN}⚠ {label}{_C.END}{(': ' + detail) if detail else ''}")


def info(label: str, detail: str = ""):
    print(f"  {_C.DIM}·{_C.END} {label}{(': ' + detail) if detail else ''}")


# ─── Probe functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def probe_init_direct(access_token: str, privacy: str, on_log=None):
    """
    Try direct-post init endpoint with given privacy.
    Returns (success: bool, error_code: str|None, error_msg: str|None, response: dict|None).
    Does NOT actually upload — just checks if init is accepted.
    """
    from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError

    client = TikTokClient(access_token=access_token,
                         on_log=on_log or (lambda m, l: None),
                         timeout=15)

    # Minimal init payload — small dummy video size to test init accept/reject
    # We use 5 MB which is the MIN chunk size, well within all limits.
    DUMMY_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    payload = {
        "post_info": {
            "title":           "permission_probe — DO NOT UPLOAD",
            "description":     "Probe-only test of init endpoint",
            "privacy_level":   privacy,
            "disable_duet":    False,
            "disable_comment": False,
            "disable_stitch":  False,
        },
        "source_info": {
            "source":            "FILE_UPLOAD",
            "video_size":        DUMMY_SIZE,
            "chunk_size":        DUMMY_SIZE,
            "total_chunk_count": 1,
        },
    }

    try:
        data = client.post("/v2/post/publish/video/init/", payload)
        return True, None, None, data
    except TikTokError as exc:
        return False, getattr(exc, "error_code", None), str(exc), None
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, type(exc).__name__, str(exc), None


def probe_init_draft(access_token: str, on_log=None):
    """Try draft (inbox) init endpoint."""
    from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError

    client = TikTokClient(access_token=access_token,
                         on_log=on_log or (lambda m, l: None),
                         timeout=15)

    DUMMY_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    payload = {
        "source_info": {
            "source":            "FILE_UPLOAD",
            "video_size":        DUMMY_SIZE,
            "chunk_size":        DUMMY_SIZE,
            "total_chunk_count": 1,
        },
    }

    try:
        data = client.post("/v2/post/publish/inbox/video/init/", payload)
        return True, None, None, data
    except TikTokError as exc:
        return False, getattr(exc, "error_code", None), str(exc), None
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, type(exc).__name__, str(exc), None


# ─── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--account", default=None,
                        help="Filter to one account by display_name or open_id prefix")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON report")
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", "-v", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    from core.tiktok.token_store import get_default_store
    from core.tiktok.creator_info import query_creator_info

    store = get_default_store()
    accounts = store.all_accounts()
    if not accounts:
        print(f"{_C.FAIL}[FATAL] No TikTok accounts connected.{_C.END}")
        return 2

    if args.account:
        filt = args.account.lower()
        accounts = [a for a in accounts
                    if filt in a.display_name.lower() or a.open_id.startswith(args.account)]
        if not accounts:
            print(f"{_C.FAIL}[FATAL] No account matches '{args.account}'{_C.END}")
            return 2

    # Probe each account
    report = {"accounts": []}
    overall_status = 0  # 0=full, 1=limited, 2=broken

    for acc in accounts:
        print()
        print("=" * 76)
        print(f"  ACCOUNT: @{acc.display_name}  (open_id={acc.open_id[:16]}...)")
        print("=" * 76)

        if not acc.is_token_valid():
            fail("token", "expired — re-OAuth needed")
            overall_status = max(overall_status, 2)
            continue

        acc_report = {
            "display_name": acc.display_name,
            "open_id_prefix": acc.open_id[:16],
            "layer_a_scopes": {},
            "layer_b_creator_info": {},
            "layer_c_audit_enforcement": {},
            "gaps": [],
        }

        # ── LAYER A: Scopes granted on the access token ────────────────
        section("LAYER A — Scopes granted on access_token (from OAuth)")
        scopes_set = set(acc.scopes)
        for s in ["user.info.basic", "video.upload", "video.publish",
                  "comment.create", "comment.list"]:
            granted = s in scopes_set
            if granted:
                ok(f"scope.{s}", "granted")
            else:
                if s in ("comment.create", "comment.list"):
                    warn(f"scope.{s}", "NOT granted (auto-comment will be skipped)")
                else:
                    fail(f"scope.{s}", "NOT granted")
            acc_report["layer_a_scopes"][s] = granted

        # ── LAYER B: TikTok's view (creator_info endpoint) ──────────────
        section("LAYER B — Creator info (TikTok server view)")
        try:
            info_obj = query_creator_info(access_token=acc.access_token, timeout_s=15)
            ok("creator_info.query", "OK")
            info(f"username", info_obj.creator_username or acc.display_name)
            info(f"privacy_options", ", ".join(info_obj.privacy_level_options))
            info(f"max_duration_sec", str(info_obj.max_video_post_duration_sec))
            info(f"creator_toggles",
                 f"duet={'off' if info_obj.duet_disabled else 'on'}, "
                 f"comment={'off' if info_obj.comment_disabled else 'on'}, "
                 f"stitch={'off' if info_obj.stitch_disabled else 'on'}")
            acc_report["layer_b_creator_info"] = {
                "privacy_options": info_obj.privacy_level_options,
                "max_duration":    info_obj.max_video_post_duration_sec,
                "duet_disabled":   info_obj.duet_disabled,
                "comment_disabled": info_obj.comment_disabled,
                "stitch_disabled": info_obj.stitch_disabled,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            fail("creator_info.query", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            overall_status = max(overall_status, 2)
            report["accounts"].append(acc_report)
            continue

        # ── LAYER C: Audit enforcement (real publish API behavior) ──────
        section("LAYER C — Audit enforcement (publish API behavior)")

        def _log(m, l):
            if args.verbose:
                info(f"[client {l}]", m)

        # C.1 — Probe direct post with PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE
        ok_pub, err_code, err_msg, resp = probe_init_direct(
            acc.access_token, "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE", on_log=_log,
        )
        if ok_pub:
            ok("direct_post.PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE", "init accepted ✅ FULL APPROVAL")
            acc_report["layer_c_audit_enforcement"]["direct_public"] = "ALLOWED"
            # Try to abort/cancel — we don't actually want to upload
            if resp and isinstance(resp, dict):
                pid = resp.get("publish_id") or resp.get("data", {}).get("publish_id")
                if pid and args.verbose:
                    info("aborted_probe_publish_id", str(pid))
        else:
            fail(f"direct_post.PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE", f"BLOCKED — error: {err_code}")
            info("error_detail", (err_msg or "")[:200])
            acc_report["layer_c_audit_enforcement"]["direct_public"] = f"BLOCKED ({err_code})"

        # C.2 — Probe direct post with SELF_ONLY
        ok_self, err_code2, err_msg2, _ = probe_init_direct(
            acc.access_token, "SELF_ONLY", on_log=_log,
        )
        if ok_self:
            ok("direct_post.SELF_ONLY", "init accepted")
            acc_report["layer_c_audit_enforcement"]["direct_self_only"] = "ALLOWED"
        else:
            fail("direct_post.SELF_ONLY", f"BLOCKED — error: {err_code2}")
            acc_report["layer_c_audit_enforcement"]["direct_self_only"] = f"BLOCKED ({err_code2})"

        # C.3 — Probe draft (inbox) init
        ok_draft, err_code3, err_msg3, _ = probe_init_draft(acc.access_token, on_log=_log)
        if ok_draft:
            ok("draft_upload.inbox", "init accepted ✅")
            acc_report["layer_c_audit_enforcement"]["draft_inbox"] = "ALLOWED"
        else:
            fail("draft_upload.inbox", f"BLOCKED — error: {err_code3}")
            acc_report["layer_c_audit_enforcement"]["draft_inbox"] = f"BLOCKED ({err_code3})"

        # ── GAP ANALYSIS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        section("GAP ANALYSIS — granted vs enforced")
        gaps = []

        # Gap 1: video.publish scope granted but direct PUBLIC blocked
        has_publish_scope = "video.publish" in scopes_set
        public_in_options = "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE" in info_obj.privacy_level_options
        if has_publish_scope and public_in_options and not ok_pub:
            gap = (
                "video.publish scope granted + PUBLIC in privacy_options, "
                f"BUT init rejected ({err_code}). "
                "Likely cause: app audit tier doesn't include direct PUBLIC posting yet."
            )
            gaps.append(gap)
            warn("AUDIT_GAP_PUBLIC", gap)
            overall_status = max(overall_status, 1)

        # Gap 2: comment.create scope missing
        if "comment.create" not in scopes_set:
            gap = "comment.create scope missing — auto-comment will be skipped"
            gaps.append(gap)
            warn("SCOPE_GAP_COMMENT", gap)

        # Gap 3: draft blocked too (severe)
        if not ok_draft:
            gap = f"draft init blocked ({err_code3}) — basic upload pipeline broken"
            gaps.append(gap)
            fail("CRITICAL", gap)
            overall_status = max(overall_status, 2)

        if not gaps:
            ok("No gaps — full PUBLIC capability confirmed")

        acc_report["gaps"] = gaps
        report["accounts"].append(acc_report)

    # ── Overall verdict ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print()
    print("=" * 76)
    print(f"  {_C.BOLD}OVERALL VERDICT{_C.END}")
    print("=" * 76)
    if overall_status == 0:
        print(f"  {_C.OK}✓ FULL PUBLIC CAPABILITY{_C.END}")
        print(f"    Bot can direct-post videos as PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE on all accounts.")
    elif overall_status == 1:
        print(f"  {_C.WARN}⚠ LIMITED CAPABILITY{_C.END}")
        print(f"    Bot can upload to TikTok Inbox as draft (user publishes manually).")
        print(f"    Direct PUBLIC posting is BLOCKED — pending TikTok audit approval.")
        print()
        print(f"    {_C.BOLD}Next steps:{_C.END}")
        print(f"      1. Wait for audit decision (TikTok usually 5-10 business days)")
        print(f"      2. Re-run this script after notification email")
        print(f"      3. Until then, use --mode draft and publish manually from TikTok app")
    else:
        print(f"  {_C.FAIL}✗ BROKEN OR SEVERELY LIMITED{_C.END}")
        print(f"    Investigate errors above.")

    if args.json:
        print()
        print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

    return overall_status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""
Test driver chạy thủ công — đăng video thật lên FB Page + TikTok Draft.

Mục đích: kiểm tra end-to-end pipeline mà không cần GUI. Capture log đầy đủ
ra file, in stdout, và trả về exit code.

Cách dùng:
    python scripts/_manual_test_run.py                # chạy cả FB + TT
    python scripts/_manual_test_run.py --tiktok-only  # chỉ TT
    python scripts/_manual_test_run.py --fb-only      # chỉ FB

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import os

import threading

from pathlib import Path

# ── Setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
os.chdir(ROOT)
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

LOG_PATH = ROOT / "data" / "manual_test_run.log"
LOG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Buộc UTF-8 cho mọi stream để khỏi crash unicode trên Windows CMD
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

_log_lines: list[str] = []


def _emit(prefix: str, msg: str, level: str = "info"):
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    line = f"[{ts}] [{prefix:<8}] [{level:<7}] {msg}"
    _log_lines.append(line)
    print(line)


def _flush_log():
    LOG_PATH.write_text("\n".join(_log_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


# Wire python logging to capture engine internals too
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s — %(message)s",
)


# ── Test parameters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DOWNLOADS = Path(r"C:\Users\KENLY\Downloads")

FB_VIDEO = DOWNLOADS / "Tạo_Video_Chim_Ruồi_Quay_Chậm.mp4"
FB_PAGE  = "KL Closet"
FB_TITLE = "[TEST] Chim ruồi quay chậm"

    "Bot upload test — video chim ruồi siêu thực, slow motion 8s.\n"
    "Đây là post test tự động từ LTTStudio VideoBot.\n"
    "#test #slowmotion #bot"

# ── Config loader ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_config() -> dict:
    cfg_path = ROOT / "data" / "config.json"
    with cfg_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


# ── FB test ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def run_fb_test(config: dict) -> bool:
    _emit("FB", f"Bắt đầu test Facebook upload → page='{FB_PAGE}'")
    if not FB_VIDEO.exists():
        _emit("FB", f"❌ FILE KHÔNG TỒN TẠI: {FB_VIDEO}", "error")
        return False

    from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
    from server.services.ui_constants import PRIVACY_OPTIONS

    stop_event = threading.Event()
    result_status = {"value": None, "link": ""}

    def _on_log(msg, level="info"):
        _emit("FB-eng", str(msg), str(level))

    def _on_status(msg):
        _emit("FB-eng", f"status: {msg}", "info")

    def _on_result(task, status, link):
        result_status["value"] = status
        result_status["link"]  = link or ""
        _emit("FB", f"on_result: status={status}  link={link}", "info")

    def _on_done():
        _emit("FB", "on_done fired", "info")

    def _on_error(msg):
        _emit("FB", f"on_error: {msg}", "error")

    engine = UploadEngine(
        config     = config,
        stop_event = stop_event,
        on_log     = _on_log,
        on_status  = _on_status,
        on_result  = _on_result,
        on_done    = _on_done,
        on_error   = _on_error,
    )

    task = {
        "video_path":  str(FB_VIDEO),
        "page":        FB_PAGE,
        "title":       FB_TITLE,
        "description": FB_DESC,
        "thumbnail":   "",
        "privacy":     PRIVACY_OPTIONS["Công khai"],  # Page posts đều public
        "schedule":    "",
    }

    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        engine.run(task)
    except Exception as exc:
        _emit("FB", f"engine.run raised: {exc}\n{traceback.format_exc()}", "error")
        return False
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    _emit("FB", f"Hoàn tất sau {elapsed:.1f}s", "info")
    return result_status["value"] == "success"


# ── TT test ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def run_tt_test(config: dict) -> bool:
    _emit("TT", f"Bắt đầu test TikTok Draft upload → account='{TT_OPEN_ID_DISPLAY}'")
    if not TT_VIDEO.exists():
        _emit("TT", f"❌ FILE KHÔNG TỒN TẠI: {TT_VIDEO}", "error")
        return False

    from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher
    from core.tiktok.token_store import get_default_store as get_tt

    # Lookup open_id từ display_name
    store = get_tt()
    open_id = None
    for a in store.all_accounts():
        if a.display_name == TT_OPEN_ID_DISPLAY:
            open_id = a.open_id
            break
    if not open_id:
        _emit("TT", f"❌ Không tìm thấy TT account '{TT_OPEN_ID_DISPLAY}'", "error")
        return False
    _emit("TT", f"Resolved open_id={open_id[:16]}…", "info")

    stop_event = threading.Event()

    def _on_log(msg, level="info"):
        _emit("TT-pub", str(msg), str(level))

    def _on_status(msg):
        _emit("TT-pub", f"status: {msg}", "info")

    task = {
        "video_path":       str(TT_VIDEO),
        "account":          open_id,
        "title":            TT_TITLE,
        "description":      TT_DESC,
        "post_type":        "tiktok_draft",
        "privacy_level":    "",
        # user_confirmed_at: dùng UTC ISO (advisory check trong compliance_guard)
        "user_confirmed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
    }

    publisher = TikTokPublisher(
        config     = config,
        stop_event = stop_event,
        on_log     = _on_log,
        on_status  = _on_status,
    )

    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        result = publisher.publish(task)
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        _emit(
            "TT",
            f"✅ result: publish_id={result.external_post_id}  "
            f"status={result.status}  ({elapsed:.1f}s)",
            "success",
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        _emit("TT", f"❌ publish() raised: {exc}", "error")
        _emit("TT", traceback.format_exc(), "debug")
        return False

    _emit("MAIN", f"Kết quả: {results}")

        sys.exit(130)

"""
End-to-end test: upload PUBLIC video to TikTok + auto-comment.

Tests bot's TikTokPublisher with realistic task dict:
  - Auto-generated title with timestamp
  - Auto-generated description + hashtags
  - PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE direct post
  - Auto-comment after publish

Designed to verify:
  ✓ Compliance guard passes
  ✓ Direct uploader handles init → upload → status poll → publish
  ✓ Audit log captures success
  ✓ Auto-comment posts after publish_id is obtained
  ✓ Final video URL is reachable

Output: comprehensive PASS/FAIL matrix + TikTok video URL.

Usage:
    .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts\\_test_tiktok_public_upload.py \\
        --video "C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Downloads\\clip_02 (4).mp4" \\
        --account klcloset96

Exit codes:
    0 — all checks PASS, video URL captured
    1 — at least one check FAIL
    2 — fatal setup error (no account, no video, etc.)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
import traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
os.chdir(ROOT)

# Force UTF-8 stdout on Windows cmd
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
except (AttributeError, OSError):
    pass


# ─── Test conditions matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestMatrix:
    """Tracks PASS/FAIL for each test condition."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.conditions = []   # list of (name, status, detail)

    def pass_(self, name: str, detail: str = ""):
        self.conditions.append((name, "PASS", detail))
        print(f"  \033[92m✓\033[0m {name}  {detail}")

    def fail(self, name: str, detail: str = ""):
        self.conditions.append((name, "FAIL", detail))
        print(f"  \033[91m✗ {name}\033[0m")
        if detail:
            print(f"     \033[91m{detail}\033[0m")

    def warn(self, name: str, detail: str = ""):
        self.conditions.append((name, "WARN", detail))
        print(f"  \033[93m⚠ {name}\033[0m  {detail}")

    def info(self, msg: str):
        print(f"  \033[90m· {msg}\033[0m")

    def summary(self) -> int:
        passed = sum(1 for c in self.conditions if c[1] == "PASS")
        failed = sum(1 for c in self.conditions if c[1] == "FAIL")
        warns  = sum(1 for c in self.conditions if c[1] == "WARN")
        total  = len(self.conditions)
        print()
        print("=" * 76)
        print(f"  TEST MATRIX SUMMARY — {passed} pass / {failed} fail / {warns} warn / {total} total")
        print("=" * 76)
        print(f"  {'Condition':<60} {'Status':<8}")
        print(f"  {'-' * 60} {'-' * 8}")
        for name, status, detail in self.conditions:
            color = {"PASS": "\033[92m", "FAIL": "\033[91m", "WARN": "\033[93m"}.get(status, "")
            print(f"  {name[:60]:<60} {color}{status}\033[0m")
        return 0 if failed == 0 else 1


# ─── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--video", required=True, help="Path to .mp4")
    parser.add_argument("--account", required=True, help="TikTok account display_name or open_id prefix")
    parser.add_argument("--title-prefix", default="Bot test direct public",
                        help="Title prefix (timestamp appended)")
    parser.add_argument("--comment", default="",
                        help="Auto-comment text (default: auto-generate)")
    parser.add_argument("--privacy", default="PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE",
                        choices=["PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE", "MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS",
                                 "FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR", "SELF_ONLY"],
                        help="Target privacy level (direct post only)")
    parser.add_argument("--mode", default="direct", choices=["direct", "draft"],
                        help="Publish mode: 'direct' = direct post, 'draft' = TikTok Inbox draft")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    m = TestMatrix()

    print("=" * 76)
    print("  TikTok PUBLIC Upload — End-to-End Test")
    print("=" * 76)

    # ── PRE-FLIGHT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 1] Pre-flight checks")

    # P1.1 — Video file exists + size sane
    vp = args.video
    if not os.path.isfile(vp):
        m.fail("video.exists", f"Not found: {vp}")
        return m.summary()
    size = os.path.getsize(vp)
    m.pass_("video.exists", f"{os.path.basename(vp)} ({size:,} bytes / {size/1024/1024:.1f} MB)")

    if size > 500 * 1024 * 1024:
        m.fail("video.size", f"Exceeds 500 MB TikTok limit: {size:,}")
        return m.summary()
    if size < 1024:
        m.fail("video.size", "Too small (< 1 KB)")
        return m.summary()
    m.pass_("video.size", "Within TikTok limit (< 500 MB)")

    # P1.2 — MP4 magic bytes
    with open(vp, "rb") as f:
        head = f.read(12)
    is_mp4 = b"ftyp" in head
    if is_mp4:
        m.pass_("video.format", f"MP4 magic detected ({head[:12].hex()})")
    else:
        m.warn("video.format", f"No MP4 ftyp in header; TikTok may reject ({head.hex()})")

    # P1.3 — Config valid + audit flags correct
    try:
        with open("data/config.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            cfg = json.load(f)
    except Exception as exc:
        m.fail("config.load", str(exc))
        return m.summary()

    required = {
        "tiktok_audit_approved":      True,
        "tiktok_enable_direct_post":  True,
        "tiktok_publish_mode":        "direct_public",
        "tiktok_privacy_level":       "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE",
    }
    for k, want in required.items():
        got = cfg.get(k)
        if got == want:
            m.pass_(f"config.{k}", f"= {got!r}")
        else:
            m.fail(f"config.{k}", f"want {want!r} got {got!r}")

    # P1.4 — Token store + account
    from core.tiktok.token_store import get_default_store
    store = get_default_store()
    accounts = store.all_accounts()
    if not accounts:
        m.fail("account.connected", "No TikTok accounts in token store")
        return m.summary()

    filt = args.account.lower()
    matched = [a for a in accounts
               if filt in a.display_name.lower() or a.open_id.startswith(args.account)]
    if not matched:
        m.fail("account.match", f"No account matches '{args.account}'")
        return m.summary()
    account = matched[0]
    m.pass_("account.match", f"@{account.display_name} (open_id={account.open_id[:16]}…)")

    if not account.is_token_valid():
        m.fail("account.token_valid", "Access token expired")
        return m.summary()
    m.pass_("account.token_valid", "Token healthy")

    # P1.5 — Scopes
    needed_scopes = {"user.info.basic", "video.upload", "video.publish"}
    have = set(account.scopes)
    if needed_scopes.issubset(have):
        m.pass_("account.scopes", f"All 3 scopes granted")
    else:
        missing = needed_scopes - have
        m.fail("account.scopes", f"Missing: {missing}")
        return m.summary()

    # P1.6 — Capability check via TikTok API
    print("\n[PHASE 2] TikTok server capability check")
    from core.tiktok.creator_info import query_creator_info
    try:
        info = query_creator_info(access_token=account.access_token, timeout_s=15)
    except Exception as exc:
        m.fail("capability.query", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        return m.summary()

    if "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE" in info.privacy_level_options:
        m.pass_("capability.public", f"PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE unlocked")
    else:
        m.fail("capability.public", f"Only: {info.privacy_level_options}")
        return m.summary()

    m.info(f"max_duration={info.max_video_post_duration_sec}s, "
           f"duet={'off' if info.duet_disabled else 'on'}, "
           f"comment={'off' if info.comment_disabled else 'on'}")

    # ── BUILD TASK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 3] Build publish task")

    ts_local = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    title = f"{args.title_prefix} {ts_local}"
    description = (
        f"Bot upload test — direct PUBLIC post.\n"
        f"Timestamp: {ts_local}.\n"
        f"#test #bot #lttstudio"
    )

    if args.comment:
        comment_text = args.comment
    else:
        comment_text = (
            f"Bot auto-comment test @ {ts_local} — confirm comment API works. 🤖"
        )

    post_type = "tiktok_direct" if args.mode == "direct" else "tiktok_draft"

    task = {
        "video_path":        vp,
        "title":             title,
        "description":       description,
        "account":           account.open_id,    # publisher resolves by open_id
        "post_type":         post_type,
        "privacy_level":     args.privacy,
        "comment":           comment_text,
        # TikTok audit requires user confirmation timestamp (advisory)
        "user_confirmed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
    }

    m.pass_("task.title", f"'{title}'")
    m.pass_("task.post_type", post_type)
    m.pass_("task.privacy", args.privacy)
    m.pass_("task.comment", f"'{comment_text[:60]}…'")

    # ── EXECUTE PUBLISH ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 4] Execute publish (this takes 30-90s for ~60 MB video)")

    from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher

    log_buffer = []
    def _on_log(msg, lvl="info"):
        line = f"[{lvl}] {msg}"
        log_buffer.append(line)
        print(f"    {line}")

    status_buffer = []
    def _on_status(msg):
        status_buffer.append(msg)
        print(f"    [status] {msg}")

    stop_event = threading.Event()

    publisher = TikTokPublisher(
        config     = cfg,
        stop_event = stop_event,
        on_log     = _on_log,
        on_status  = _on_status,
    )

    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    publish_result = None
    publish_err    = None
    try:
        publish_result = publisher.publish(task)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t_start
        m.pass_("publish.execute", f"completed in {elapsed:.1f}s")
    except Exception as exc:
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t_start
        publish_err = exc
        m.fail("publish.execute",
               f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]} (after {elapsed:.1f}s)")
        print()
        print("=== Stack trace ===")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ── VERIFY RESULT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 5] Verify publish result")

    if publish_result is None:
        m.fail("publish.result", "No result object (exception above)")
        return m.summary()

    # 'success' = direct post done; 'draft' = sent to inbox awaiting manual publish
    if publish_result.status in ("success", "draft"):
        m.pass_("publish.status", f"= '{publish_result.status}'")
    else:
        m.fail("publish.status", f"got '{publish_result.status}'")

    publish_id = publish_result.external_post_id
    if publish_id:
        m.pass_("publish.publish_id", f"= {publish_id}")
    else:
        m.fail("publish.publish_id", "missing")

    # PublishResult has `external_post_url` (not `external_url`)
    video_url = getattr(publish_result, "external_post_url", "") or ""
    if video_url:
        m.pass_("publish.url", video_url)
    else:
        # Draft mode never returns a URL — video is in user's TikTok Inbox
        if publish_result.status == "draft":
            m.info("draft mode: no URL yet — user must open TikTok app and publish manually")
        else:
            m.warn("publish.url", "No direct URL returned by TikTok")

    # ── COMMENT VERIFICATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 6] Verify auto-comment was attempted")
    comment_attempted = any("Comment" in l or "comment" in l for l in log_buffer)
    if comment_attempted:
        # Look for success/failure markers
        comment_ok = any("comment đã đăng" in l.lower() or "comment success" in l.lower()
                         or "[tiktok comment]" in l.lower()
                         for l in log_buffer)
        if comment_ok:
            m.pass_("comment.posted", "auto-comment logged as posted")
        else:
            comment_skip = any("bỏ qua comment" in l.lower() or "skip comment" in l.lower()
                              for l in log_buffer)
            if comment_skip:
                m.warn("comment.posted", "skipped (logged)")
            else:
                m.warn("comment.posted", "attempt logged but no explicit success marker")
    else:
        m.warn("comment.posted", "no comment-related log lines found")

    # ── AUDIT LOG ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 7] Verify audit log")
    audit_path = ROOT / "data" / "audit_log.jsonl"
    if audit_path.exists():
        with audit_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
        recent_events = []
        for line in lines[-100:]:
            try:
                e = json.loads(line)
                if e.get("event", "").startswith("tiktok_publish") or e.get("evt", "").startswith("tiktok_publish"):
                    recent_events.append(e)
            except Exception:
                pass
        attempt_seen = any("publish_attempt" in str(e) for e in recent_events)
        success_seen = any("publish_success" in str(e) for e in recent_events)
        if attempt_seen:
            m.pass_("audit.attempt", "tiktok_publish_attempt logged")
        else:
            m.warn("audit.attempt", "not found in last 100 entries")
        if success_seen:
            m.pass_("audit.success", "tiktok_publish_success logged")
        else:
            m.warn("audit.success", "not found")
    else:
        m.warn("audit.log_file", f"not present: {audit_path}")

    # ── FINAL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n[PHASE 8] Summary + verification URL")
    if video_url:
        print(f"\n  🎬 VIDEO URL: {video_url}")
        print(f"\n  Verify steps:")
        print(f"    1. Open URL in browser → should load TikTok video page")
        print(f"    2. Open URL in incognito → should still load (PUBLIC)")
        print(f"    3. TikTok app → @{account.display_name} → top video")
    elif publish_id:
        print(f"\n  📋 PUBLISH_ID: {publish_id}")
        print(f"     (Video URL not directly returned. Check @{account.display_name} on TikTok app)")

    return m.summary()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n[CTRL+C] Interrupted by user")
        sys.exit(130)

"""
Verify demo video — extract frames tại 14 timestamp quan trọng + show.

Usage:
    python scripts/_verify_demo_video.py "C:\\path\\to\\your_demo.mp4"

Hoặc gọi từ Claude với file path. Script extract 14 PNG vào folder
data/_verify_frames/ rồi báo lại — Claude đọc từng frame để verify.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
os.chdir(ROOT)

# 14 cảnh BẮT BUỘC + timestamp (theo timing-reference)
SCENES = [
    ("01_opening",        "00:00:05", "Opening slide"),
    ("02_privacy_url",    "00:00:25", "Privacy URL trên browser"),
    ("02_terms_url",      "00:00:32", "Terms URL trên browser"),
    ("03_bot_overview",   "00:00:42", "9 tabs bot"),
    ("04a_continue_btn",  "00:00:52", "Nút 'Continue with TikTok' + logo"),
    ("04b_disclosure",    "00:00:58", "Pre-OAuth Disclosure Modal ⭐"),
    ("04c_tt_authorize",  "00:01:12", "TT authorize page (URL bar tiktok.com)"),
    ("04d_account_in_list", "00:01:28", "Account klcloset96 hiện trong list"),
    ("05_audit_dashboard", "00:01:38", "Audit Dashboard 11 ✅"),
    ("06_form_filled",     "00:02:00", "Manual TT form đã fill"),
    ("07a_dialog_open",    "00:02:18", "Consent dialog mở ra ⭐"),
    ("07b_privacy_dropdown", "00:02:25", "Privacy DROPDOWN (mở ra)"),
    ("07c_toggles_ai_branded", "00:02:32", "3 toggles + AI + Branded ⭐"),
    ("08_upload_success",  "00:02:55", "Upload thành công + video trên TT"),
    ("09_disconnect",      "00:03:08", "Disconnect/revoke flow"),
]


def have_ffmpeg() -> bool:
    """Check ffmpeg trên PATH."""
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            ["ffmpeg", "-version"], capture_output=True, timeout=5,
        )
        return True
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return False


def extract_frames(video_path: Path, out_dir: Path) -> list[tuple[str, Path, str]]:
    """Extract 14 frames tại các timestamp định nghĩa.

    Returns: list of (scene_id, frame_path, description)
    """
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    results: list[tuple[str, Path, str]] = []

    for scene_id, ts, desc in SCENES:
        frame_file = out_dir / f"{scene_id}.png"
        # ffmpeg -ss <timestamp> -i <input> -frames:v 1 <output>
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error",
            "-ss", ts, "-i", str(video_path),
            "-frames:v", "1",
            # Resize xuống 1280x720 để tiết kiệm chỗ + Claude đọc nhanh
            "-vf", "scale=1280:720",
            str(frame_file),
        ]
        try:
            subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, timeout=20, capture_output=True)
            results.append((scene_id, frame_file, desc))
            print(f"  ✅ {scene_id:<25}  @ {ts}  → {frame_file.name}")
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"  ❌ {scene_id}  @ {ts}  → FAIL: {e.stderr.decode()[:200]}")
            results.append((scene_id, None, desc))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            print(f"  ⏰ {scene_id}  @ {ts}  → TIMEOUT")
            results.append((scene_id, None, desc))
    return results


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python scripts/_verify_demo_video.py <path_to_demo.mp4>")
        sys.exit(2)

    video_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
    if not video_path.exists():
        print(f"❌ File không tồn tại: {video_path}")
        sys.exit(2)

    if not have_ffmpeg():
        print("❌ Thiếu ffmpeg trên PATH. Cài: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html")
        sys.exit(2)

    out_dir = ROOT / "data" / "_verify_frames"
    print(f"📹 Video: {video_path}")
    print(f"📁 Output: {out_dir}")
    print(f"🎬 Extract 14 frames…")
    print()

    results = extract_frames(video_path, out_dir)
    ok = sum(1 for _, p, _ in results if p is not None)
    print()
    print(f"📊 Extracted {ok}/{len(SCENES)} frames")
    print(f"📁 Đường dẫn folder: {out_dir}")
    print()
    print("Claude có thể đọc từng frame để verify nội dung.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Generate opening + closing slide PNG (1920x1080) cho demo recording.
Chạy 1 lần: python scripts/demo_assets/_gen_slides.py
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

OUT_DIR = os.path.dirname(__file__)
W, H = 1920, 1080

# Tìm font Windows
def _load(name: str, size: int):
    for path in [
        rf"C:\Windows\Fonts\{name}.ttf",
        rf"C:\Windows\Fonts\{name}bd.ttf",
        rf"C:\Windows\Fonts\consola.ttf",
        rf"C:\Windows\Fonts\Arial.ttf",
    ]:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            try:
                return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return ImageFont.load_default()


def _center_text(draw, text, y, font, color="#E6EAF2"):
    """Draw centered text at vertical y."""
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2, y), text, font=font, fill=color)


def make_opening():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#0d1117")
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    # Accent bar trên
    d.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 8)], fill="#9C27B0")
    # Logo + brand
    _center_text(d, "🎬",  340, _load("seguiemj", 96), "#4A90D9")
    _center_text(d, "LTTStudio VideoBot",        470, _load("consola", 72), "#E6EAF2")
    _center_text(d, "TikTok Content Posting API Integration",  570, _load("consola", 32), "#9C27B0")
    # Subtitle
    _center_text(d, "Demo for App Audit Review",  680, _load("consola", 28), "#A0AEC0")
    _center_text(d, "May 2026",                   730, _load("consola", 22), "#6B7280")
    # Footer
    _center_text(d, "Built on TikTok Content Posting API v2 + Login Kit",
                 980, _load("consola", 18), "#4a5568")
    img.save(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "opening_slide.png"), optimize=True)
    print(f"✅ opening_slide.png")


def make_closing():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#0d1117")
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    # Accent bar dưới
    d.rectangle([(0, H - 8), (W, H)], fill="#9C27B0")
    # Body
    _center_text(d, "Thank you for reviewing",  380, _load("consola", 56), "#E6EAF2")
    _center_text(d, "",                          440, _load("consola", 16))
    _center_text(d, "LTTStudio VideoBot",        540, _load("consola", 48), "#9C27B0")
    _center_text(d, "https://lttstudios.com",     640, _load("consola", 28), "#4A90D9")
    _center_text(d, "Support: support@lttstudios.com",
                 720, _load("consola", 22), "#A0AEC0")
    img.save(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "closing_slide.png"), optimize=True)
    print(f"✅ closing_slide.png")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    make_opening()
    make_closing()
    print(f"\nĐã lưu tại: {OUT_DIR}")
