#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ltt_cai_dat_cli.py - plug LTT Studios into Codex, Claude Code and Claude Desktop.

    python ltt_cai_dat_cli.py --key ltt_sk_...

One file, no dependencies, works on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Why this exists: the thing that stops a developer is almost never the protocol,
it is filling in a config file correctly. Two base URLs that differ by four
characters, a model name that must match exactly, one environment variable that
has to be set at user level rather than in a shell. Each of those fails quietly
with an unhelpful symptom, and each of them is mechanical.

SAFETY, because these are your files and not ours:

  * every write is ADDITIVE - your existing `model`, your other providers and
    your other settings are left exactly as they were;
  * every file we touch is BACKED UP first, next to the original;
  * we never write your key into a config file. Config files get shared,
    committed and screenshotted. The key goes into an environment variable and
    the config only names that variable.

Run with --kiem-tra (--check) to verify a setup without changing anything.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

MAC_DINH_BASE = "https://app.lttstudios.com"
MODEL = "ltt_llm"
BIEN_KHOA = "LTT_API_KEY"


def _goc(base: str) -> str:
    return (base or MAC_DINH_BASE).rstrip("/")


def _sao_luu(p: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    """Back up before touching. Once per run, never overwriting an older backup."""
    if not p.exists():
        return
    bak = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".ltt-bak")
    if not bak.exists():
        shutil.copy2(p, bak)
        print(f"    sao luu: {bak}")


# ── Codex ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def codex(base: str, goc_codex: pathlib.Path) -> list:
    """Two files, and the split is not optional.

    Codex 0.145+ refuses `[profiles.X]` inside config.toml outright:
    "cannot be used while config.toml contains legacy `[profiles.ltt]` config".
    The provider block stays in config.toml; the profile moves to its own file.
    """
    ra = []
    goc_codex.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    cfg = goc_codex / "config.toml"
    cu = cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if cfg.exists() else ""
    if "[model_providers.ltt]" in cu:
        ra.append(f"  = da co [model_providers.ltt] trong {cfg}, giu nguyen")
    else:
        _sao_luu(cfg)
        khoi = (
            "\n# --- LTT Studios (them tu dong; khong doi gi o tren) ---\n"
            "[model_providers.ltt]\n"
            'name = "LTT Studios"\n'
            f'base_url = "{_goc(base)}/api/v1"   # co /v1: Codex ghep them /responses\n'
            f'env_key = "{BIEN_KHOA}"\n'
            'wire_api = "responses"\n'
            "stream_idle_timeout_ms = 600000\n")
        cfg.write_text(cu.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + khoi if cu else khoi.lstrip("\n"),
                       encoding="utf-8")
        ra.append(f"  + them [model_providers.ltt] vao {cfg}")

    pro = goc_codex / "ltt.config.toml"
    if pro.exists():
        ra.append(f"  = da co {pro}, giu nguyen")
    else:
        pro.write_text(
            f'model = "{MODEL}"\n'
            'model_provider = "ltt"\n'
            "# Left at its default the model spends most of max_tokens thinking\n"
            "# before it answers.\n"
            'model_reasoning_effort = "low"\n'
            'model_reasoning_summary = "none"\n'
            "model_context_window = 65536\n", encoding="utf-8")
        ra.append(f"  + tao {pro}")
    return ra


# ── Claude Code CLI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def claude_code(base: str, goc_claude: pathlib.Path) -> list:
    """`~/.claude/settings.json`, merged rather than replaced.

    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL is the one everybody forgets: Claude Code uses
    a second, smaller model for background work. Leave it unset and those calls
    ask for a Claude model this API does not serve, and fail quietly while the
    main session looks fine.
    """
    goc_claude.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = goc_claude / "settings.json"
    goc_json = {}
    if p.exists():
        try:
            goc_json = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") or "{}")
        except ValueError:
            return [f"  ! {p} khong phai JSON hop le - BO QUA, khong dam sua"]
        _sao_luu(p)
    env = dict(goc_json.get("env") or {})
    env.update({
        "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": f"{_goc(base)}/api",     # KHONG /v1: client tu ghep
        "ANTHROPIC_MODEL": MODEL,
        "ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL": MODEL,
    })
    # Khoa KHONG vao day. `settings.json` bi chia se va commit thuong xuyen.
    env.setdefault("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN", f"${BIEN_KHOA}")
    goc_json["env"] = env
    p.write_text(json.dumps(goc_json, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                 encoding="utf-8")
    return [f"  + cap nhat khoi `env` trong {p}"]


# ── Claude Desktop: khong tu dong duoc ──────────────────────────────────────

def claude_desktop(base: str) -> list:
    """Claude Desktop does NOT read ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. It has its own form, and
    there is no supported file to write, so this prints steps instead of lying
    about having configured it."""
    return [
        "  i Claude Desktop phai lam bang tay (no khong doc bien moi truong):",
        "      Help -> Troubleshooting -> Enable Developer Mode",
        "      Developer -> Configure Third-Party Inference...",
        "      Inference provider  : Gateway",
        f"      Gateway base URL    : {_goc(base)}/api",
        "      Gateway API key     : khoa cua ban",
        "      Gateway auth scheme : Bearer",
        f"      inferenceModels     : {MODEL}",
        "      -> Apply locally",
        "    (inferenceModels BAT BUOC: bo chon model tu dong cua Desktop chi giu",
        "     nhung id trong giong Claude, nen model nay khong tu hien ra.)",
    ]


# ── Kiem tra that, khong tin cau hinh ───────────────────────────────────────

def kiem_tra(base: str, key: str) -> int:
    """Ask the server, do not trust the files we just wrote."""
    url = f"{_goc(base)}/api/v1/models"
    # 🔴 PHAI GUI User-Agent RIENG. Cloudflare chan User-Agent mac dinh cua
    #    urllib (`Python-urllib/3.x`) bang 403 truoc khi request toi may chu ta.
    #    Do that 24/08: cung mot khoa, cung mot URL —
    #        urllib mac dinh   -> 403
    #        bat ky UA nao khac -> 200
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
        "User-Agent": "ltt-cai-dat-cli/1.0",
    })
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
            goi = json.loads(r.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        than = e.read()[:200].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        print(f"  ! {url} tra HTTP {e.code}")
        if e.code == 401:
            print("    -> khoa sai, hoac ban dan nham chuoi")
        elif e.code == 403:
            print("    -> khoa dung nhung chua duoc phep goi tool nay")
        else:
            print(f"    -> {than}")
        return 1
    except Exception as e:                                  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"  ! khong noi duoc toi {url}: {type(e).__name__}")
        return 1

    ten = [m.get("name") for m in (goi.get("items") or [])]
    if MODEL not in ten:
        print(f"  ! may chu khong liet ke `{MODEL}` (thay: {ten or 'khong co gi'})")
        return 1
    print(f"  OK may chu nhan khoa, va co `{MODEL}`")
    return 0


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Cam LTT Studios vao Codex / Claude Code / Claude Desktop.")
    ap.add_argument("--key", default=os.environ.get(BIEN_KHOA, ""),
                    help=f"khoa ltt_sk_... (mac dinh: bien {BIEN_KHOA})")
    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default=MAC_DINH_BASE)
    ap.add_argument("--kiem-tra", "--check", action="store_true", dest="chi_kiem",
                    help="chi kiem tra, KHONG sua file nao")
    ap.add_argument("--home", default=str(pathlib.Path.home()),
                    help="thu muc home (dung de thu)")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    if not a.key:
        print(f"Thieu khoa. Dat bien {BIEN_KHOA} hoac dung --key.")
        print("Lay khoa o: " + _goc(a.base_url) + "/developers/keys")
        return 2

    home = pathlib.Path(a.home)
    print(f"May chu : {_goc(a.base_url)}")
    print(f"Model   : {MODEL}")
    print("")

    if a.chi_kiem:
        print("Kiem tra (khong sua gi):")
        return kiem_tra(a.base_url, a.key)

    print("Codex:")
    for d in codex(a.base_url, home / ".codex"):
        print(d)
    print("Claude Code (CLI):")
    for d in claude_code(a.base_url, home / ".claude"):
        print(d)
    print("Claude Desktop:")
    for d in claude_desktop(a.base_url):
        print(d)

    print("")
    print("Kiem tra voi may chu:")
    rc = kiem_tra(a.base_url, a.key)

    print("")
    print("CON MOT VIEC BAN PHAI TU LAM - dat khoa o CAP NGUOI DUNG:")
    if os.name == "nt":
        print(f'    setx {BIEN_KHOA} "<khoa cua ban>"')
    else:
        print(f'    echo \'export {BIEN_KHOA}="<khoa cua ban>"\' >> ~/.profile')
    print("  Roi MO LAI terminal / VS Code. Dat trong mot cua so terminal thoi la")
    print("  khong du: tien ich VS Code va Claude Desktop la tien trinh khac va")
    print("  khong thay bien do.")
    print("")
    print("Xong thi chay:  codex --profile ltt")
    return rc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Minimal Python client for the LTT Studios Public API.

No third-party dependencies: a customer integrating one API should not have to
adopt our HTTP library. Standard library only.

The one rule this client exists to enforce, because getting it wrong costs the
customer money:

    a chargeable POST is retried **only** with the same Idempotency-Key.

Everything else — GET retries, waiting for a job, downloading an artifact,
verifying a webhook signature — is convenience.

    from ltt_public_api import LttClient

    client = LttClient(base_url="https://app.lttstudios.com", api_key="ltt_sk_…")
    quote = client.quote("image.thumbnail", {"topic": "bánh mì", "count": 2})
    job = client.create_job(quote, {"topic": "bánh mì", "count": 2})
    job = client.wait_for_job(job["id"])
    for artifact in job.get("outputs", []):
        print(client.artifact_url(artifact["id"]))
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

__all__ = ["LttClient", "LttApiError", "verify_webhook"]

USER_AGENT = "ltt-public-api-python/1.0"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30.0

# A GET is safe to repeat, so transient failures are retried. A chargeable POST
# is not repeated unless the caller's Idempotency-Key makes it safe — see
# `create_job`.
RETRY_STATUSES = frozenset({429, 500, 502, 503, 504})
MAX_RETRIES = 3


class LttApiError(RuntimeError):
    """One problem+json response, kept whole so callers can branch on `code`."""

    def __init__(self, status: int, payload: dict):
        self.status = int(status)
        self.payload = dict(payload or {})
        self.code = str(self.payload.get("code") or "")
        self.request_id = str(self.payload.get("request_id") or "")
        detail = self.payload.get("detail") or self.payload.get("title") or ""
        super().__init__(f"{self.status} {self.code}: {detail}")

    @property
    def retry_after(self) -> int:
        try:
            return int(self.payload.get("retry_after") or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return 0


@dataclass
class LttClient:
    base_url: str
    api_key: str
    timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT
    max_retries: int = MAX_RETRIES
    # Injectable so tests can drive the client against an in-process app; a real
    # integration never sets it.
    transport: object = field(default=None, repr=False)

    # ── HTTP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _url(self, path: str) -> str:
        return self.base_url.rstrip("/") + "/api/v1" + path

    def _request(self, method: str, path: str, *, body=None,
                 headers: dict | None = None, retry: bool = False):
        payload = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
        request_headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }
        if payload is not None:
            request_headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        request_headers.update(headers or {})

        attempt = 0
        while True:
            attempt += 1
            try:
                status, response_headers, raw = self._send(
                    method, self._url(path), payload, request_headers)
            except OSError:
                if retry and attempt <= self.max_retries:
                    time.sleep(min(8.0, 0.5 * 2 ** (attempt - 1)))
                    continue
                raise
            if status in RETRY_STATUSES and retry and attempt <= self.max_retries:
                # `retry_after` from the server beats a guess from the client.
                wait = 0
                try:
                    wait = int(json.loads(raw or b"{}").get("retry_after") or 0)
                except (ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError):
                    wait = 0
                time.sleep(max(wait, min(8.0, 0.5 * 2 ** (attempt - 1))))
                continue
            return status, response_headers, raw

    def _send(self, method: str, url: str, payload, headers):
        if self.transport is not None:
            return self.transport(method, url, payload, headers)
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers=headers,
                                         method=method)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
                return response.status, dict(response.headers), response.read()
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            body = exc.read()
            exc.close()
            return int(exc.code), dict(exc.headers or {}), body

    def _json(self, method: str, path: str, *, body=None, headers=None,
              retry: bool = False) -> dict:
        status, response_headers, raw = self._request(
            method, path, body=body, headers=headers, retry=retry)
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(raw or b"{}")
        except ValueError:
            parsed = {}
        if status >= 400:
            raise LttApiError(status, parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {})
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            parsed.setdefault("_headers", response_headers)
        return parsed

    # ── Reads (safe to retry) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    # @covers GET /me
    def me(self) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", "/me", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /capabilities
    def capabilities(self) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", "/capabilities", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /tools
    def tools(self, *, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", f"/tools?limit={int(limit)}&offset={int(offset)}",
                          retry=True)

    # @covers GET /models
    def models(self, *, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0) -> dict:
        """Model aliases this key may use. Aliases, never provider model ids —
        the platform publishes names it controls, so a provider swap does not
        become your migration."""
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode({"limit": int(limit),
                                        "offset": int(offset)})
        return self._json("GET", f"/models?{query}", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /models/{model_name}
    def model(self, name: str) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", f"/models/{urllib.parse.quote(name)}",
                          retry=True)

    # @covers GET /health
    def health(self) -> dict:
        """Liveness of the API surface. No credential required, so this is the
        one call worth making before blaming your key."""
        return self._json("GET", "/health", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /tools/{tool_name}
    def tool(self, name: str) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", f"/tools/{urllib.parse.quote(name)}", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /jobs/{job_id}
    def job(self, job_id: str) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", f"/jobs/{urllib.parse.quote(job_id)}", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /jobs
    def jobs(self, *, status: str = "", limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0) -> dict:
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {"status": status, "limit": limit, "offset": offset})
        return self._json("GET", f"/jobs?{query}", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /credits/balance
    def balance(self) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", "/credits/balance", retry=True)

    # @covers GET /usage
    def usage(self, **params) -> dict:
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode({k: v for k, v in params.items() if v})
        return self._json("GET", f"/usage?{query}" if query else "/usage",
                          retry=True)

    # @covers GET /artifacts/{artifact_id}
    def artifact_url(self, artifact_id: str) -> str:
        return self._json(
            "GET", f"/artifacts/{urllib.parse.quote(artifact_id)}",
            retry=True)["url"]

    # @covers GET /artifacts/{artifact_id}/content
    def download_artifact(self, artifact_id: str) -> bytes:
        _status, _headers, raw = self._request(
            "GET", f"/artifacts/{urllib.parse.quote(artifact_id)}/content",
            retry=True)
        return raw

    # ── Writes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    # @covers POST /quotes
    def quote(self, tool: str, tool_input: dict) -> dict:
        """Price a call. Cheap, chargeable-free, and safe to repeat."""
        return self._json("POST", "/quotes",
                          body={"tool": tool, "input": tool_input}, retry=True)

    # @covers POST /jobs
    def create_job(self, quote: dict, tool_input: dict, *,
                   idempotency_key: str = "") -> dict:
        """Run a quoted call.

        The key is generated once, here, and reused for every retry of *this*
        call. That is the difference between a timeout costing nothing and a
        timeout costing the customer a second job: the server returns the first
        job for a repeated key, and a *new* key would create a second one.
        """
        key = idempotency_key or uuid.uuid4().hex
        return self._json(
            "POST", "/jobs",
            body={"tool": quote["tool"], "quote": quote["quote"],
                  "input": tool_input},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": key},
            # Safe precisely because the key is fixed for the whole loop.
            retry=True)

    # @covers POST /chat/completions
    def chat(self, messages: list, *, model: str = "ltt_llm",
             max_tokens: int = 1024, temperature: float | None = None,
             tools: list | None = None, reasoning_effort: str = "",
             idempotency_key: str = "") -> dict:
        """A chat completion, answered in this request. Chargeable.

        Unlike :meth:`create_job` there is no quote: the price depends on the
        tokens the model produces, which do not exist until it has run. Credit is
        held at a ceiling before the model starts and settled from the measured
        usage, so the number in ``x_ltt.credit_charged`` is the real bill and is
        usually well below the hold.

        That missing quote is why the Idempotency-Key matters more here than
        anywhere else on the surface: it is the only thing standing between a
        network timeout and paying twice for the same generation. Generate it
        once, here, and reuse it for every retry of *this* call.

        A call that cannot finish inside the server's synchronous budget is
        refused with 400 rather than cut off mid-answer; send that work to
        :meth:`create_job` instead.
        """
        body: dict = {"model": model, "messages": messages,
                      "max_tokens": max_tokens}
        if temperature is not None:
            body["temperature"] = temperature
        if tools:
            body["tools"] = tools
        if reasoning_effort:
            body["reasoning_effort"] = reasoning_effort
        return self._json(
            "POST", "/chat/completions", body=body,
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": idempotency_key or uuid.uuid4().hex},
            # Safe precisely because the key is fixed for the whole loop.
            retry=True)

    # @covers-not POST /messages — an SSE stream in the Anthropic Messages shape,
    #   served for Claude Code and Claude Desktop rather than for this SDK. Those
    #   clients speak the protocol natively; wrapping it here would mean
    #   re-implementing their parsers badly. Point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the /api
    #   parent of that route instead.
    # @covers-not POST /responses — the same, in the OpenAI Responses shape, for
    #   the Codex CLI and its VS Code extension. Set base_url to this route's
    #   parent and wire_api = "responses".
    #
    #   Neither takes an Idempotency-Key (Q107): no CLI sends one, so the money is
    #   protected by settling from the tokens actually produced instead. A stream
    #   you abandon halfway bills for what it generated, not for the ceiling.

    # @covers POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel
    def cancel_job(self, job_id: str) -> dict:
        return self._json("POST", f"/jobs/{urllib.parse.quote(job_id)}/cancel")

    def wait_for_job(self, job_id: str, *, timeout: float = 600.0,
                     poll_interval: float = 2.0) -> dict:
        """Poll until the job reaches a terminal state, or raise TimeoutError."""
        deadline = time.monotonic() + float(timeout)
        while True:
            job = self.job(job_id)
            if job.get("status") in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
                return job
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError(f"job {job_id} did not finish in {timeout}s")
            time.sleep(poll_interval)

    # ── Uploads ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    # @covers POST /uploads
    # @covers POST /uploads/{upload_id}/content
    # @covers POST /uploads/{upload_id}/confirm
    def upload(self, tool: str, field_name: str, filename: str,
               content_type: str, data: bytes) -> str:
        """Create a ticket, send the bytes, confirm. Returns the upload id."""
        ticket = self._json("POST", "/uploads", body={
            "tool": tool, "field": field_name, "filename": filename,
            "content_type": content_type, "size": len(data)})
        target = ticket.get("upload") or {}
        if str(target.get("method", "")).upper() == "PUT":
            self._put_bytes(target["url"], data,
                            dict(target.get("headers") or {}))
        else:
            self._post_multipart(target.get("url") or
                                 f"/uploads/{ticket['id']}/content",
                                 filename, content_type, data)
        self._json("POST", f"/uploads/{ticket['id']}/confirm")
        return ticket["id"]

    def _put_bytes(self, url: str, data: bytes, headers: dict) -> None:
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method="PUT",
                                         headers=headers or {})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout):
            return

    def _post_multipart(self, path: str, filename: str, content_type: str,
                        data: bytes) -> None:
        boundary = uuid.uuid4().hex
        body = b"".join([
            f"--{boundary}\r\n".encode(),
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="{filename}"\r\n'.encode(),
            f"Content-Type: {content_type}\r\n\r\n".encode(),
            data, f"\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n".encode(),
        ])
        url = path if path.startswith("http") else self.base_url.rstrip("/") + path
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
                   "Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}",
                   "User-Agent": USER_AGENT}
        if self.transport is not None:
            self.transport("POST", url, body, headers)
            return
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers,
                                         method="POST")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout):
            return

    # ── Webhooks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    # @covers POST /webhooks
    def create_webhook(self, url: str, events=()) -> dict:
        return self._json("POST", "/webhooks",
                          body={"url": url, "events": list(events)})

    # @covers GET /webhooks
    def webhooks(self) -> dict:
        return self._json("GET", "/webhooks", retry=True)

    # @covers DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id}
    def delete_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> dict:
        return self._json("DELETE", f"/webhooks/{urllib.parse.quote(webhook_id)}")

    # @covers GET /webhooks/deliveries
    def webhook_deliveries(self, *, subscription_id: str = "",
                           status: str = "", limit: int = 20,
                           offset: int = 0) -> dict:
        """What we tried to send you, and how it went.

        The first thing to read when a callback did not arrive: it separates
        "we never sent it" from "we sent it and your endpoint refused".
        """
        params = {"limit": int(limit), "offset": int(offset)}
        if subscription_id:
            params["subscription_id"] = subscription_id
        if status:
            params["status"] = status
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
        return self._json("GET", f"/webhooks/deliveries?{query}", retry=True)


def verify_webhook(secret: str, *, timestamp, event_id: str, body: bytes,
                   signature: str, tolerance_s: int = 300) -> bool:
    """Check a delivery came from LTT and is not a replay.

    Run this before trusting anything in the payload. The timestamp check is
    what stops an old, valid delivery being replayed at you later.
    """
    try:
        sent_at = int(timestamp)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    if abs(int(time.time()) - sent_at) > int(tolerance_s):
        return False
    payload = b".".join([str(sent_at).encode("ascii"),
                         str(event_id).encode("ascii"), body])
    expected = hmac.new(str(secret).encode("utf-8"), payload,
                        hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(f"v1={expected}", str(signature or ""))


# The one route no client method wraps, and why that is deliberate:
# @covers-not GET /openapi.json — machine-readable spec, not a call your code
# makes. Fetch it with any HTTP client, or download the versioned copy from the
# developer portal; wrapping it would imply the SDK parses it, which it does not.

/**
 * Minimal TypeScript client for the LTT Studios Public API.
 *
 * Uses `fetch` and nothing else, so it runs in Node 18+, Deno, Bun and the
 * browser without a build step or a dependency.
 *
 * The rule this client exists to enforce, because getting it wrong costs the
 * customer money:
 *
 *     a chargeable POST is retried **only** with the same Idempotency-Key.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const client = new LttClient({ baseUrl: "https://app.lttstudios.com", apiKey });
 * const quote = await client.quote("image.thumbnail", { topic: "bánh mì", count: 2 });
 * const job = await client.waitForJob((await client.createJob(quote, { topic: "bánh mì", count: 2 })).id);
 * ```
 */

export interface LttClientOptions {
  baseUrl: string;
  apiKey: string;
  /** Retries for safe (idempotent) requests. Default 3. */
  maxRetries?: number;
  /** Injected in tests; production uses global fetch. */
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface Problem {
  type?: string;
  title?: string;
  status?: number;
  code?: string;
  detail?: unknown;
  instance?: string;
  request_id?: string;
  retry_after?: number;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface Quote {
  quote: string;
  tool: string;
  credit: number;
  expires_in: number;
  balance: number;
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  role: "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";
  content: string | Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface ChatCompletion {
  object: "chat.completion";
  model: string;
  choices: Array<{
    index: number;
    message: { role: string; content: string; tool_calls?: unknown[] };
    finish_reason: string;
  }>;
  usage: { prompt_tokens: number; completion_tokens: number; total_tokens: number };
  /** Everything OpenAI has no field for. The money lives here, not in `usage`:
   *  adding our own keys to `usage` would break clients that parse it strictly. */
  x_ltt: {
    /** What was ACTUALLY billed, not what was held. Usually well below it. */
    credit_charged: number;
    credit_held: number;
    usage_measured: boolean;
    cached_prompt_tokens: number;
    duration_seconds: number;
    test_mode: boolean;
  };
}

export interface ChatOptions {
  model?: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
  temperature?: number;
  tools?: unknown[];
  reasoningEffort?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
}

export type JobStatus = "queued" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "cancelled";

export interface Job {
  id: string;
  tool: string | null;
  status: JobStatus;
  progress: number;
  created_at: string | null;
  started_at: string | null;
  finished_at: string | null;
  credit: { held: number; charged: number };
  outputs?: Array<{ id: string; field: string; index: number }>;
  result?: Record<string, unknown>;
  error?: { message: string };
}

/** One problem+json response, kept whole so callers can branch on `code`. */
export class LttApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly code: string;
  readonly requestId: string;
  readonly payload: Problem;

  constructor(status: number, payload: Problem) {
    const detail = typeof payload.detail === "string" ? payload.detail : payload.title;
    super(`${status} ${payload.code ?? ""}: ${detail ?? ""}`);
    this.name = "LttApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.code = payload.code ?? "";
    this.requestId = payload.request_id ?? "";
    this.payload = payload;
  }

  get retryAfter(): number {
    return Number(this.payload.retry_after ?? 0) || 0;
  }
}

const RETRY_STATUSES = new Set([429, 500, 502, 503, 504]);
const USER_AGENT = "ltt-public-api-ts/1.0";

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export class LttClient {
  private readonly baseUrl: string;
  private readonly apiKey: string;
  private readonly maxRetries: number;
  private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch;

  constructor(options: LttClientOptions) {
    this.baseUrl = options.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    this.apiKey = options.apiKey;
    this.maxRetries = options.maxRetries ?? 3;
    this.fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  }

  private url(path: string): string {
    return `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1${path}`;
  }

  private async request<T>(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    options: { body?: unknown; headers?: Record<string, string>; retry?: boolean } = {},
  ): Promise<T> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}`,
      Accept: "application/json",
      "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
      ...(options.headers ?? {}),
    };
    let body: string | undefined;
    if (options.body !== undefined) {
      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
      body = JSON.stringify(options.body);
    }

    for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt += 1) {
      const response = await this.fetchImpl(this.url(path), { method, headers, body });
      const text = await response.text();
      let parsed: unknown = {};
      try {
        parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
      } catch {
        parsed = {};
      }
      if (response.ok) {
        return parsed as T;
      }
      const problem = parsed as Problem;
      const retryable = options.retry === true && RETRY_STATUSES.has(response.status);
      if (retryable && attempt <= this.maxRetries) {
        // The server's own retry_after beats a guess from the client.
        const backoff = Math.min(8000, 500 * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
        await sleep(Math.max(Number(problem.retry_after ?? 0) * 1000, backoff));
        continue;
      }
      throw new LttApiError(response.status, problem);
    }
  }

  // ── Reads (safe to retry) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // @covers GET /me
  me() {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>("GET", "/me", { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /capabilities
  capabilities() {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>("GET", "/capabilities", { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /tools
  tools(limit = 20, offset = 0) {
    return this.request<{ items: unknown[] }>(
      "GET", `/tools?limit=${limit}&offset=${offset}`, { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /tools/{tool_name}
  tool(name: string) {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>(
      "GET", `/tools/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { retry: true });
  }

  /**
   * Model aliases this key may use.
   *
   * Aliases, never provider model ids: the platform publishes names it
   * controls, so a provider swap does not become your migration.
   */
  // @covers GET /models
  models(limit = 20, offset = 0) {
    return this.request<{ items: unknown[] }>(
      "GET", `/models?limit=${limit}&offset=${offset}`, { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /models/{model_name}
  model(name: string) {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>(
      "GET", `/models/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { retry: true });
  }

  /** Liveness of the API surface. Needs no credential, so it is the one call
   * worth making before blaming your key. */
  // @covers GET /health
  health() {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>("GET", "/health",
      { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /jobs/{job_id}
  job(jobId: string) {
    return this.request<Job>("GET", `/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`, { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /jobs
  jobs(status = "", limit = 20, offset = 0) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams({ status, limit: String(limit),
                                        offset: String(offset) });
    return this.request<{ items: Job[] }>("GET", `/jobs?${query}`,
      { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /credits/balance
  balance() {
    return this.request<{ balance: number }>("GET", "/credits/balance", { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /usage
  usage() {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>("GET", "/usage", { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers GET /artifacts/{artifact_id}
  async artifactUrl(artifactId: string): Promise<string> {
    const body = await this.request<{ url: string }>(
      "GET", `/artifacts/${encodeURIComponent(artifactId)}`, { retry: true });
    return body.url;
  }

  /**
   * The bytes of one output.
   *
   * Goes through `/content` rather than the signed URL so it works from a
   * server with no outbound access to object storage — and so a caller does
   * not have to handle a URL that expires while they are reading it.
   */
  // @covers GET /artifacts/{artifact_id}/content
  async downloadArtifact(artifactId: string): Promise<ArrayBuffer> {
    const response = await fetch(
      this.url(`/artifacts/${encodeURIComponent(artifactId)}/content`),
      { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` } });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new LttApiError(response.status, await response.json()
        .catch(() => ({})) as Problem);
    }
    return response.arrayBuffer();
  }

  // ── Writes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // @covers POST /quotes
  quote(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>) {
    return this.request<Quote>("POST", "/quotes", { body: { tool, input }, retry: true });
  }

  /**
   * Run a quoted call.
   *
   * The idempotency key is generated once and reused for every retry of *this*
   * call. A fresh key on retry is what turns one timeout into two charges.
   */
  // @covers POST /jobs
  createJob(quote: Quote, input: Record<string, unknown>, idempotencyKey?: string) {
    const key = idempotencyKey ?? crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "");
    return this.request<Job>("POST", "/jobs", {
      body: { tool: quote.tool, quote: quote.quote, input },
      headers: { "Idempotency-Key": key },
      retry: true,
    });
  }

  /**
   * A chat completion, answered in this request. Chargeable.
   *
   * Unlike `createJob` there is no quote: the price depends on the tokens the
   * model produces, which do not exist until it has run. Credit is held at a
   * ceiling before the model starts and settled from the measured usage, so
   * `x_ltt.credit_charged` is the real bill and is usually well below the hold.
   *
   * That missing quote is why the Idempotency-Key matters more here than
   * anywhere else on the surface: it is the only thing standing between a
   * network timeout and paying twice for the same generation. It is generated
   * once, here, and reused for every retry of *this* call.
   *
   * A call that cannot finish inside the server's synchronous budget is refused
   * with 400 rather than cut off mid-answer; send that work to `createJob`.
   */
  // @covers POST /chat/completions
  chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options: ChatOptions = {}) {
    const key = options.idempotencyKey ?? crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "");
    const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
      model: options.model ?? "ltt_llm",
      messages,
      max_tokens: options.maxTokens ?? 1024,
    };
    if (options.temperature !== undefined) body.temperature = options.temperature;
    if (options.tools?.length) body.tools = options.tools;
    if (options.reasoningEffort) body.reasoning_effort = options.reasoningEffort;
    return this.request<ChatCompletion>("POST", "/chat/completions", {
      body,
      headers: { "Idempotency-Key": key },
      // Safe precisely because the key is fixed for the whole loop.
      retry: true,
    });
  }

  // @covers-not POST /messages — an SSE stream in the Anthropic Messages shape,
  //   served for Claude Code and Claude Desktop rather than for this SDK. Those
  //   clients speak the protocol natively; wrapping it here would mean
  //   re-implementing their parsers badly. Point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the /api
  //   parent of that route instead.
  // @covers-not POST /responses — the same, in the OpenAI Responses shape, for
  //   the Codex CLI and its VS Code extension. Set base_url to this route's
  //   parent and wire_api = "responses".
  //
  //   Neither takes an Idempotency-Key (Q107): no CLI sends one, so the money is
  //   protected by settling from the tokens actually produced instead. A stream
  //   you abandon halfway bills for what it generated, not for the ceiling.

  // @covers POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel
  cancelJob(jobId: string) {
    return this.request<Job>("POST", `/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/cancel`);
  }

  async waitForJob(jobId: string, timeoutMs = 600_000, pollMs = 2000): Promise<Job> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
      const job = await this.job(jobId);
      if (job.status === "succeeded" || job.status === "failed" || job.status === "cancelled") {
        return job;
      }
      if (Date.now() >= deadline) {
        throw new Error(`job ${jobId} did not finish in ${timeoutMs}ms`);
      }
      await sleep(pollMs);
    }
  }

  // @covers POST /webhooks
  createWebhook(url: string, events: string[] = []) {
    return this.request<{ id: string; secret: string }>(
      "POST", "/webhooks", { body: { url, events } });
  }

  // @covers GET /webhooks
  webhooks() {
    return this.request<{ items: unknown[] }>("GET", "/webhooks",
      { retry: true });
  }

  // @covers DELETE /webhooks/{webhook_id}
  deleteWebhook(webhookId: string) {
    return this.request<Record<string, unknown>>(
      "DELETE", `/webhooks/${encodeURIComponent(webhookId)}`);
  }

  /**
   * What we tried to send you, and how it went.
   *
   * The first thing to read when a callback did not arrive: it separates "we
   * never sent it" from "we sent it and your endpoint refused".
   */
  // @covers GET /webhooks/deliveries
  webhookDeliveries(subscriptionId = "", status = "", limit = 20, offset = 0) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit),
                                        offset: String(offset) });
    if (subscriptionId) query.set("subscription_id", subscriptionId);
    if (status) query.set("status", status);
    return this.request<{ items: unknown[] }>(
      "GET", `/webhooks/deliveries?${query}`, { retry: true });
  }

  /**
   * Put a file where a tool can read it: ticket, bytes, confirm.
   *
   * Three calls because the platform stages an upload before anything is paid
   * for, and promotes it only after the job holds credit (Q85). The direct PUT
   * is used when the storage backend offers one, so gigabytes never travel
   * through the API process.
   */
  // @covers POST /uploads
  // @covers POST /uploads/{upload_id}/content
  // @covers POST /uploads/{upload_id}/confirm
  async upload(tool: string, field: string, filename: string,
               contentType: string, data: Blob | ArrayBuffer): Promise<string> {
    const blob = data instanceof Blob ? data : new Blob([data]);
    const ticket = await this.request<{
      id: string;
      upload?: { method: string; url: string; headers?: Record<string, string> };
    }>("POST", "/uploads", {
      body: { tool, field, filename, content_type: contentType,
              size: blob.size },
    });

    const target = ticket.upload;
    if (target && target.method.toUpperCase() === "PUT") {
      const put = await fetch(target.url, {
        method: "PUT", body: blob,
        headers: { "Content-Type": contentType, ...(target.headers ?? {}) },
      });
      if (!put.ok) throw new Error(`upload failed: HTTP ${put.status}`);
    } else {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("file", blob, filename);
      const post = await fetch(
        this.url(`/uploads/${encodeURIComponent(ticket.id)}/content`),
        { method: "POST", body: form,
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` } });
      if (!post.ok) throw new Error(`upload failed: HTTP ${post.status}`);
    }

    await this.request<Record<string, unknown>>(
      "POST", `/uploads/${encodeURIComponent(ticket.id)}/confirm`);
    return ticket.id;
  }
}

/**
 * Check a webhook delivery came from LTT and is not a replay.
 *
 * Run this before trusting the payload. `crypto.subtle` keeps it dependency
 * free; the comparison is constant time.
 */
export async function verifyWebhook(options: {
  secret: string;
  timestamp: string | number;
  eventId: string;
  body: string;
  signature: string;
  toleranceSeconds?: number;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const sentAt = Number(options.timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(sentAt)) return false;
  const tolerance = options.toleranceSeconds ?? 300;
  if (Math.abs(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - sentAt) > tolerance) return false;

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw", encoder.encode(options.secret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]);
  const payload = encoder.encode(`${sentAt}.${options.eventId}.${options.body}`);
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, payload);
  const expected = "v1=" + Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest))
    .map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

  const given = options.signature ?? "";
  if (expected.length !== given.length) return false;
  let mismatch = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < expected.length; index += 1) {
    mismatch |= expected.charCodeAt(index) ^ given.charCodeAt(index);
  }
  return mismatch === 0;
}

"""
access_middleware.py — chặn quyền app ở tầng route (H1.4).

Vì sao là middleware chứ không phải dependency gắn từng route: chặn phải phủ
**mọi** đường vào một app, kể cả khi người dùng gõ thẳng URL, và phải làm được
mà **không sửa từng app** (giữ hợp đồng: nền tảng không biết trước app nào tồn
tại). Một middleware đọc registry rồi ánh xạ path → app làm đúng điều đó cho cả
app mount động lẫn các route đặc cách của socialbot.

Thứ tự middleware: lớp này phải chạy **sau** SessionMiddleware để đọc được
`request.session`. Trong Starlette, middleware thêm TRƯỚC là lớp trong (chạy
sau) — nên `create_app` add lớp này trước khi add SessionMiddleware.

Fail-open có chủ ý: khi chưa có CSDL, không tra được user, hay bất kỳ lỗi nào,
middleware **cho qua**. Ở giai đoạn này mặc định quyền là "mở" (Q25) nên cho
qua = đúng mặc định; và admin-env (đường lui khi DB hỏng) không bao giờ bị lớp
này chặn. Chốt chặn tiền thật vẫn là credit, không phải lớp này.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import Response

from platform_core.i18n import _ as _t
from server.templating import templates


class AccessControlMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        chan = self._kiem_tra(request)
        if chan is not None:
            return chan
        return await call_next(request)

    def _kiem_tra(self, request: Request):
        # Chỉ quan tâm request thuộc về một app. Mọi thứ khác cho qua ngay.
        try:
            loaded = getattr(request.app.state, "loaded_apps", None) or []
            from platform_core.app_access import app_cho_path
            slug = app_cho_path(request.url.path, loaded)
        except Exception:
            return None
        if slug is None:
            return None
        item = next((entry for entry in loaded if entry.manifest.slug == slug), None)
        surface = getattr(getattr(item, "manifest", None), "surface", "customer")

        # admin-env (đường lui) là admin → không bao giờ bị chặn ở đây.
        try:
            session = request.session
        except Exception:
            return None
        if session.get("user"):
            return None
        sid = session.get("sid")
        if not sid:
            return None      # ẩn danh → require_login của route lo phần đăng nhập

        # Tra user CSDL. Bất kỳ trục trặc nào → fail-open.
        try:
            from platform_core.app_access import HIDDEN, LOCKED, muc_quyen
            from platform_core.db import get_session
            from platform_core.users import lay_user_tu_phien
            gen = get_session()
            db = next(gen)
            try:
                user = lay_user_tu_phien(db, sid)
                if user is None:
                    return None
                if surface == "admin":
                    if user.role == "admin":
                        return None
                    return self._trang_loi(
                        request, 404, _t("Không tìm thấy trang bạn yêu cầu."))
                level = muc_quyen(db, user, slug)
                db.commit()
            finally:
                try:
                    next(gen)
                except StopIteration:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            return None

        if level == HIDDEN:
            # Ẩn nghĩa là "không tồn tại với người này" → 404, không 403.
            # 403 xác nhận app có thật; 404 thì không tiết lộ gì.
            return self._trang_loi(request, 404,
                                   "Không tìm thấy trang bạn yêu cầu.")
        if level == LOCKED:
            return self._trang_loi(request, 403,
                                   "Công cụ này chưa mở cho tài khoản của bạn.")
        return None

    def _trang_loi(self, request: Request, code: int, message: str) -> Response:
        return templates.TemplateResponse(
            request, "error.html",
            {"code": code, "message": message,
             "correlation_id": getattr(request.state, "correlation_id", "")},
            status_code=code,
        )

@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_END@@@

def _is_admin(request: Request) -> bool:
    """True nếu phiên hiện tại là admin (admin-env HOẶC user CSDL role=admin).

    Uỷ quyền cho `server.deps.is_operator` thay vì tự kiểm lại. Trước
    2026-08-06 đây là bản sao thứ hai của cùng một luật; hai bản của một luật
    quyền là hai chỗ có thể trôi dạt, và lúc đó "admin" nghĩa là hai thứ khác
    nhau tuỳ đường vào.
    """
    from server.deps import is_operator

    return is_operator(request)


def _email_admin(request: Request) -> str:
    """Email của admin đang thao tác. Rỗng nếu không xác định được."""
    from server.deps import user_hien_tai
    u = user_hien_tai(request)
    if u is not None:
        return u.email
    # Hoi thang scope thay vi bat ngoai le — cung ly do da ghi o
    # server/routes/ngon_ngu.py: bat rong roi `return ""` se giau ca loi phien
    # that, ma trieu chung chi la "nhat ky khong biet ai lam".
    if "session" not in request.scope:
        return ""
    return str(request.session.get("user") or "")


def ghi_nhat_ky(db, request: Request, hanh_dong: str, doi_tuong: str = "",
                chi_tiet: str = "") -> None:
    """Ghi một dòng nhật ký thao tác quản trị (F-06). KHÔNG commit.

class AdminAuth(AuthenticationBackend):
    """Cổng đăng nhập của sqladmin — tái dùng phiên nền tảng, không form riêng."""

    async def login(self, request: Request) -> bool:
        # Không dùng form đăng nhập của sqladmin; đăng nhập ở /login của nền tảng.
        return False

    async def logout(self, request: Request) -> bool:
        return True

    async def authenticate(self, request: Request):
        if _is_admin(request):
            return True
        # Chưa phải admin → đá về trang đăng nhập nền tảng.
        return RedirectResponse("/login", status_code=303)

def _admin_shell(title: str, active: str, body: str) -> str:
    nav = ""
    mobile_nav = ""
    for href, ic, label, key in _ADM_NAV:
        if href == "__grp__":
            nav += f'<div class="grp">{escape(label)}</div>'
        else:
            cls = "on" if key == active else ""
            current = ' aria-current="page"' if key == active else ""
            nav += (f'<a class="{cls}" href="{href}"{current}><span class="ic">{ic}</span> '
                    f'{escape(label)}</a>')
            mobile_nav += (f'<a class="{cls}" href="{href}"{current}>'
                           f'{escape(label)}</a>')
    return (f'<!doctype html><html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8">'
            f'<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">'
            f'<link rel="icon" href="/static/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">'
            f'<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/ltt.css?v={_asset_ver()}">'
            f'<title>{escape(title)} — Quản trị</title></head><body>'
            f'<a class="skip-link" href="#admin-content">Bỏ qua điều hướng</a>'
            f'<div class="adm"><aside class="adm-side" aria-label="Điều hướng quản trị">'
            f'<div class="adm-brand"><div class="mark">LTT</div>'
            f'<div><b>LTT AI Studio</b><small>quản trị</small></div></div>'
            f'<nav class="adm-nav" aria-label="Các khu vực quản trị">{nav}</nav>'
            f'<div class="adm-sidefoot"><span class="status-live"></span>Hệ thống vận hành</div></aside>'
            f'<main class="adm-main" id="admin-content">'
            f'<header class="adm-mobilebar"><a class="adm-mobilebrand" href="/admin/">'
            f'<span class="mark">LTT</span><span>Quản trị</span></a>'
            f'<details class="adm-mobilemenu"><summary aria-label="Mở điều hướng">Menu</summary>'
            f'<nav aria-label="Điều hướng mobile">{mobile_nav}</nav></details></header>'
            f'{body}</main></div></body></html>')

    if not key.enabled:
        return '<span class="badge b-grey"><span class="dot"></span>đã tắt</span>'
    cls, lbl = _STATUS.get(key.status, ("b-grey", key.status))
    return f'<span class="badge {cls}"><span class="dot"></span>{escape(lbl)}</span>'


def _health_bar(h: int) -> str:
    col = "var(--ok)" if h >= 80 else "var(--warn)" if h >= 50 else "var(--err)"
    w = max(0, min(100, int(h)))
    return (f'<span class="health"><span style="width:{w}%;background:{col}"></span></span> '
            f'<span class="tnum muted" style="font-size:11px">{h}</span>')


class ChiTietNguoiDungView(BaseView):
    """Trang gom mọi thứ về MỘT người dùng (F-04, audit 2026-08-07).

    Trước đây muốn biết một người đang thế nào phải mở 4 trang và tự nối chúng
    bằng một UUID copy tay: số dư ở Sổ credit, job ở trang Job, đơn ở trang Đơn
    hàng, phiên ở trang Phiên. Trang này trả lời câu đó ở một chỗ.
    """

    name = "Chi tiết người dùng"
    icon = "fa-solid fa-id-card"

    @expose("/nguoi-dung", methods=["GET"])
    async def chi_tiet(self, request: Request):
        from platform_core import credit
        from platform_core.models import CreditEntry, Job, PaymentOrder
        from platform_core.models import Session as PhienDb

        khoa = (request.query_params.get("q") or "").strip()
        body_tim = f"""<div class="ui-card" style="max-width:620px">
<form method="get"><div class="field"><label>Email hoặc User ID</label>
<input class="inp" name="q" value="{escape(khoa)}" placeholder="nhanvien@congty.com" autofocus></div>
<button class="btn" type="submit">Xem</button></form></div>"""

        if not khoa:
            return HTMLResponse(_admin_shell(
                "Chi tiết người dùng", "chitiet",
                f'<div class="adm-content"><div class="pagehead"><div>'
                f'<h1>Chi tiết người dùng</h1><p>Gõ email (hoặc User ID) để xem '
                f'số dư, việc đã chạy, đơn nạp và phiên đang mở ở một chỗ.</p>'
                f'</div></div>{body_tim}</div>'))

        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            u = credit.tim_theo_email(db, khoa) or db.get(User, khoa)
            if u is None:
                return HTMLResponse(_admin_shell(
                    "Chi tiết người dùng", "chitiet",
                    f'<div class="adm-content"><div class="pagehead"><div>'
                    f'<h1>Chi tiết người dùng</h1></div></div>{body_tim}'
                    f'<div class="alert alert-warn" style="max-width:620px">'
                    f'Không tìm thấy tài khoản <code>{escape(khoa)}</code>.</div></div>'),
                    status_code=404)

            so_du = credit.so_du(db, u.id)
            jobs = db.query(Job).filter(Job.user_id == u.id)                     .order_by(Job.created_at.desc()).limit(20).all()
            dons = db.query(PaymentOrder).filter(PaymentOrder.user_id == u.id)                     .order_by(PaymentOrder.created_at.desc()).limit(10).all()
            phien = db.query(PhienDb).filter(PhienDb.user_id == u.id).count()
            but = db.query(CreditEntry).filter(CreditEntry.user_id == u.id)                    .order_by(CreditEntry.created_at.desc()).limit(15).all()

            def _bang(tieu_de, dong_html, rong="Chưa có."):
                return (f'<div class="ui-card"><p class="eyebrow">{tieu_de}</p>'
                        f'{dong_html or f"<p class=dim>{rong}</p>"}</div>')

            job_html = "".join(
                f'<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">'
                f'{escape(j.app_slug or "")} · {escape(j.job_type or "")}</span>'
                f'<span><span class="mono" style="font-size:12px">{escape(j.status)}</span>'
                f'</span></div>' for j in jobs)
            don_html = "".join(
                f'<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">#{d.order_code} · '
                f'{d.price_vnd:,}đ</span><span>{escape(d.status)}</span></div>'
                for d in dons)
            but_html = "".join(
                f'<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">{escape(b.kind)} · '
                f'{escape((b.note or "")[:60])}</span>'
                f'<strong>{b.delta:+d}</strong></div>' for b in but)

            body = f"""<div class="adm-content">
<div class="pagehead"><div><h1>{escape(u.email)}</h1>
<p><span class="mono">{escape(u.id)}</span></p></div>
<div class="actions"><a class="btn" href="/admin/grant-credit">Cấp credit</a></div></div>
{body_tim}
<div class="ui-card"><p class="eyebrow">Tổng quan</p>
<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">Số dư</span><strong class="tnum">{so_du:,} credit</strong></div>
<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">Vai trò</span><span>{escape(u.role or "user")}</span></div>
<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">Đang hoạt động</span><span>{"có" if u.is_active else "KHÔNG"}</span></div>
<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">Đã xác thực email</span><span>{"có" if u.is_verified else "chưa"}</span></div>
<div class="billing-line"><span class="dim">Phiên đang mở</span><span>{phien}</span></div>
</div>
{_bang("15 bút toán credit gần nhất", but_html)}
{_bang("20 việc gần nhất", job_html, "Chưa chạy việc nào.")}
{_bang("10 đơn nạp gần nhất", don_html, "Chưa có đơn nạp nào.")}
</div>"""
            return HTMLResponse(_admin_shell(f"Chi tiết {u.email}", "chitiet", body))
        finally:
            try:
                next(gen)
            except StopIteration:
                pass


class ApiKeysConsole(BaseView):
    """Console APIKEYS custom dark (UX-1) — bề mặt chính quản khoá API."""

    name = "APIKEYS"
    icon = "fa-solid fa-key"

    @expose("/apikeys", methods=["GET"])
    async def console(self, request: Request):
        from platform_core import api_keys, api_pool, providers
        from server.auth.csrf import issue_csrf_token
        _co_refresh = {p.id for p in providers.list_all() if p.list_models_path}

        cat = request.query_params.get("cat", "all")
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            keys = api_keys.liet_ke(db)
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
        token = issue_csrf_token(request)

        cnt = {"all": len(keys)}
        for c in ("model_control", "chat", "image", "video"):
            cnt[c] = sum(1 for k in keys if c in (k.categories or []))
        shown = keys if cat == "all" else [k for k in keys if cat in (k.categories or [])]

        def tab(c, label):
            on = "on" if cat == c else ""
            return (f'<a class="{on}" href="/admin/apikeys?cat={c}">{label} '
                    f'<span class="n">{cnt.get(c, 0)}</span></a>')
        tabs = (tab("all", "Tất cả") + tab("model_control", "🧭 Điều khiển model")
                + tab("chat", "💬 Chat") + tab("image", "🖼️ Ảnh")
                + tab("video", "🎬 Video"))

        def act_form(k, op, label):
            return (f'<form method="post" action="/admin/api-key-action" style="display:inline">'
                    f'<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{escape(token)}">'
                    f'<input type="hidden" name="id" value="{escape(k.id)}">'
                    f'<input type="hidden" name="op" value="{op}">'
                    f'<button class="btn ghost sm">{label}</button></form>')

        rows = ""
        for k in shown:
            toggle = act_form(k, "enable", "Bật") if not k.enabled else act_form(k, "disable", "Tắt")
            refresh = act_form(k, "refresh", "Làm mới") if k.provider in _co_refresh else ""
            _rpm = api_pool.rpm(k)
            cap = f'/{k.rpm_limit}' if k.rpm_limit else ''
            rows += (
                f'<tr><td><span class="prov">{_prov_dot(k.provider)}{escape(k.provider)}</span></td>'
                f'<td>{escape(k.name or "")}</td>'
                f'<td class="mono muted">{escape(k.key_preview or "")}</td>'
                f'<td>{_cat_chips(k.categories)}</td>'
                f'<td>{_status_badge(k)}</td>'
                f'<td>{_health_bar(k.health_score)}</td>'
                f'<td class="tnum">{k.priority}</td>'
                f'<td class="tnum muted" style="font-size:12px">{_rpm}{cap}/min<br>{k.total_tokens} tok</td>'
                f'<td><div class="rowactions">'
                f'<a class="btn ghost sm" href="/admin/api-key-test?id={escape(k.id)}">Test</a>'
                f'<a class="btn ghost sm" href="/admin/api-key-sua?id={escape(k.id)}">Sửa</a>'
                f'{refresh}{toggle}{act_form(k, "reset", "Reset")}</div></td></tr>')
        if not shown:
            rows = ('<tr><td colspan="9" class="muted" style="padding:26px;text-align:center">'
                    'Chưa có key nào ở mục này. Bấm “＋ Thêm key”.</td></tr>')

        active_cnt = sum(1 for k in keys if k.enabled and k.status == "active")
        body = (
            f'<div class="adm-top"><span class="eyebrow">Nguồn API của nền tảng</span>'
            f'<span class="pill"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--ok);width:7px;'
            f'height:7px;border-radius:50%"></span> {active_cnt}/{len(keys)} key hoạt động</span></div>'
            f'<div class="adm-content"><div class="pagehead"><div><h1>APIKEYS</h1>'
            f'<p>Kho khoá API tập trung — app xin khoá theo provider &amp; loại. '
            f'Credential luôn mã hoá; chỉ hiện 4 số cuối.</p></div>'
            f'<div class="actions"><a class="btn ghost" href="/admin/api-models">🧩 Models</a>'
            f'<a class="btn" href="/admin/api-key-them">＋ Thêm key</a></div></div>'
            f'<div class="tabs">{tabs}</div>'
            f'<div class="tablewrap"><table class="ui-table"><thead><tr>'
            f'<th>Provider</th><th>Tên</th><th>Preview</th><th>Loại</th><th>Trạng thái</th>'
            f'<th>Health</th><th>Ưu tiên</th><th>Tải</th><th style="text-align:right">Thao tác</th>'
            f'</tr></thead><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table></div></div>')
        return HTMLResponse(_admin_shell("APIKEYS", "apikeys", body))


class UserAdmin(ModelView, model=User):
    name = "Người dùng"
    name_plural = "Người dùng"
    icon = "fa-solid fa-user"
    # F-04 (audit 2026-08-07): SO DU phai co o day. Truoc day danh sach nguoi
    # dung khong hien so du — con so van hanh quan trong nhat ve mot nguoi lai
    # khong nam o cho quan ly nguoi, phai sang trang So credit loc bang UUID.
    column_list = [User.email, "so_du_credit", User.display_name, User.role,
                   User.is_active, User.is_verified, User.created_at,
                   User.last_login_at]
    column_labels = {"so_du_credit": "Số dư"}

    async def on_model_change(self, data, model, is_created, request) -> None:
        """F-06: doi vai tro / vo hieu hoa tai khoan phai de lai dau vet.

        Truoc day chi co credit la truy duoc (`cap_tay(by=)`). Doi `role` hay
        `is_active` thi khong ai biet ai lam, luc nao — va do la hai thao tac co
        hau qua lon nhat trong trang nay.
        """
        from platform_core.db import get_session
        cu_gia = {k: getattr(model, k, None)
                  for k in ("role", "is_active", "is_verified", "display_name")}
        thay = {k: (cu_gia[k], data.get(k)) for k in cu_gia
                if k in data and data.get(k) != cu_gia[k]}
        if not thay:
            return
        gen = get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            ghi_nhat_ky(db, request, "sua_nguoi_dung",
                        doi_tuong=getattr(model, "email", "") or str(model),
                        chi_tiet="; ".join(f"{k}: {a!r} -> {b!r}"
                                           for k, (a, b) in sorted(thay.items())))
            db.commit()
        finally:
            try:
                next(gen)
            except StopIteration:
                pass
    column_searchable_list = [User.email, User.display_name]
    column_sortable_list = [User.email, User.created_at, User.last_login_at]
    column_default_sort = [(User.created_at, True)]
    # KHÔNG cho sửa email hay password_hash qua form (email là danh tính; mật
    # khẩu chỉ đổi qua luồng đổi-mật-khẩu đã băm đúng cách).
    form_columns = [User.display_name, User.role, User.is_active, User.is_verified]
    can_create = False   # user tạo qua đăng ký; tạo admin-trong-DB làm ở bước sau
    can_delete = False   # giữ dấu vết + sổ credit gắn user_id

class GrantCreditView(BaseView):
    """Cấp/điều chỉnh credit tay — ghi MỘT bút toán `grant` (append-only)."""

    name = "Cấp credit"
    icon = "fa-solid fa-hand-holding-dollar"

    @expose("/grant-credit", methods=["GET", "POST"])
    async def grant(self, request: Request):
        from server.auth.csrf import issue_csrf_token, verify_csrf_token

        msg_html = ""
        user_id = ""
        status = 200
        if request.method == "POST":
            form = await request.form()
            # CSRF: mutation ghi sổ credit PHẢI có token hợp lệ. Trước đây chỉ dựa
            # SameSite=Lax; thêm synchronizer token cho đồng nhất với route nền
            # tảng (W1.3) — chống bị lừa POST cấp credit.
            if not verify_csrf_token(request, (form.get("csrf_token") or "")):
                msg_html = ('<p style="color:#b91c1c;">Phiên hết hạn hoặc CSRF '
                            'không hợp lệ — tải lại trang rồi thử lại.</p>')
                status = 400
            else:
                # `user_id` la ten o cu (UUID). Giu de script/test cu khong gay;
                # `cap_hang_loat` nhan ca email lan UUID nen mot duong xu ly la du.
                nguoi_raw = ((form.get("nguoi") or form.get("user_id") or "").strip())
                amount_raw = (form.get("amount") or "").strip()
                note = (form.get("note") or "").strip()
                user_id = nguoi_raw
                try:
                    amount = int(amount_raw)
                    if amount == 0:
                        raise ValueError("Số credit phải khác 0.")
                    # Tách theo xuống dòng, dấu phẩy và chấm phẩy — admin dán từ
                    # bảng tính hoặc từ chat, không ai gõ đúng một định dạng.
                    tach = nguoi_raw.replace(",", "\n").replace(";", "\n")
                    ds = [x for x in tach.splitlines() if x.strip()]
                    from platform_core.credit import cap_hang_loat, so_du
                    gen = get_session()
                    db = next(gen)
                    try:
                        kq = cap_hang_loat(db, ds, amount, by="admin", note=note)
                        if not kq.thanh_cong:
                            # D4: mot email sai thi KHONG AI duoc cap. Rollback cho
                            # chac, du cap_hang_loat chua ghi gi khi co email sai.
                            db.rollback()
                            ds_sai = ", ".join(escape(x) for x in kq.khong_thay)
                            msg_html = (
                                f'<p style="color:#b91c1c;">Không tìm thấy tài khoản: '
                                f'<b>{ds_sai}</b>.<br>'
                                f'<b>Chưa cấp cho ai cả</b> — sửa lại rồi gửi lần nữa.</p>')
                            status = 400
                        else:
                            db.commit()
                            dong = "".join(
                                f"<li><code>{escape(e)}</code> — số dư mới "
                                f"<b>{so_du(db, uid)}</b></li>"
                                for e, uid in kq.da_cap)
                            canh = ""
                            if kq.trung:
                                canh = (f'<p style="color:#92400e;">Bỏ qua '
                                        f'{len(kq.trung)} email lặp — mỗi người chỉ '
                                        f'cấp một lần.</p>')
                            ghi_nhat_ky(
                                db, request, "cap_credit",
                                doi_tuong=", ".join(e for e, _ in kq.da_cap)[:255],
                                chi_tiet=f"{amount:+d} credit cho {len(kq.da_cap)} "
                                         f"tai khoan; ghi chu: {note}")
                            db.commit()
                            msg_html = (
                                f'<p style="color:#1a7f37;">Đã cấp <b>{amount:+d}</b> '
                                f'credit cho <b>{len(kq.da_cap)}</b> tài khoản.</p>'
                                f'{canh}<ul>{dong}</ul>')
                            user_id = ""
                    finally:
                        try:
                            next(gen)
                        except StopIteration:
                            pass
                except Exception as e:
                    msg_html = f'<p style="color:#b91c1c;">Lỗi: {escape(str(e))}</p>'
                    status = 400

        csrf_token = issue_csrf_token(request)
        body = f"""<div class="adm-content" style="max-width:600px">
<div class="pagehead"><div><h1>Cấp / điều chỉnh credit</h1>
<p>Ghi một bút toán <code>grant</code> cho mỗi người (số âm để trừ). Sổ credit append-only. Cấp được cho nhiều người một lượt.</p></div></div>
{msg_html}
<div class="ui-card"><form method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{escape(csrf_token)}">
  <div class="field"><label>Email tài khoản — mỗi dòng một người</label>
    <textarea class="inp" name="nguoi" rows="6" required
      placeholder="nhanvien1@congty.com&#10;nhanvien2@congty.com">{escape(user_id)}</textarea>
    <small>Dán được cả danh sách. Ngăn bằng xuống dòng, dấu phẩy hoặc chấm phẩy.
    <b>Một email sai thì không ai được cấp</b> — để bạn không phải đối soát tay.</small></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Số credit (dương = cộng, âm = trừ)</label>
    <input class="inp tnum" name="amount" type="number" required placeholder="100"></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Ghi chú</label>
    <input class="inp" name="note" placeholder="khuyến mãi / bồi thường"></div>
  <button class="btn" type="submit">Cấp credit</button>
</form></div></div>"""
        return HTMLResponse(_admin_shell("Cấp credit", "grant", body), status_code=status)


class NhatKyAdminView(ModelView, model=NhatKyAdmin):
    """Nhật ký thao tác quản trị — CHỈ XEM (F-06).

    Khoá create/edit/delete cùng lý do với sổ credit: một nhật ký sửa được thì
