"""
manual_publish.py — the web equivalent of the desktop Manual FB / Manual
TikTok tabs (gui/operation_tab.py).

Two things had to change from the desktop design, both forced by the move to
a remote server:

  1. **The video arrives as an upload, not a local path.** The desktop used
     `filedialog.askopenfilename` and passed a path straight into the
     engine. Here the browser streams the file to `temp_video_dir` first and
     the job is given that server-side path.

  2. **Publishing runs as a background job, not inline.** The desktop kept
     the Tk main loop responsive with a worker thread and callbacks. An HTTP
     request cannot wait out a multi-minute upload+publish, so a job id is
     returned immediately and the page polls for status.

Validation, limits and error wording are ported from
`gui/operation_tab.py::_validate` / `_validate_tiktok` so the web rejects
exactly what the desktop rejected, with the same messages.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import threading
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from server.services import ui_constants as UI


# ── Validation (ported verbatim from operation_tab) ───────────────────────────

def validate_facebook(*, account: str, page: str, video_path: str, title: str,
                      description: str, thumbnail: str, schedule: str) -> str | None:
    """Returns the first error message, or None. Order matches the desktop."""
    if not account.strip():
        return "Vui lòng chọn tài khoản (vào tab 🔐 Tài khoản FB để kết nối)"
    if not page.strip() or "Chưa có page" in page:
        return "Vui lòng chọn Page đăng (vào tab 🔐 Tài khoản FB để tick chọn page)"

    err = _validate_video(video_path, UI.VIDEO_EXTS_FB, UI.FB_MAX_VIDEO_BYTES,
                          "Facebook Graph API giới hạn 10 GB.")
    if err:
        return err

    if not title.strip():
        return "Vui lòng nhập tiêu đề video"
    if len(title) > UI.FB_TITLE_LIMIT:
        return (f"Tiêu đề quá dài ({len(title)} ký tự).\n"
                f"Giới hạn: {UI.FB_TITLE_LIMIT} ký tự.")
    if len(description) > UI.FB_DESC_LIMIT:
        return (f"Mô tả quá dài ({len(description)} ký tự).\n"
                f"Giới hạn: {UI.FB_DESC_LIMIT} ký tự.")

    if thumbnail.strip():
        if not os.path.exists(thumbnail):
            return f"File thumbnail không tồn tại:\n{thumbnail}"
        if os.path.isdir(thumbnail):
            return f"Thumbnail là thư mục, không phải ảnh:\n{thumbnail}"
        ext = os.path.splitext(thumbnail)[1].lower()
        if ext not in UI.IMAGE_EXTS:
            return (f"Thumbnail không phải ảnh hợp lệ ({ext}).\n"
                    f"Hỗ trợ: {', '.join(sorted(UI.IMAGE_EXTS))}")

    if schedule.strip():
        from datetime import datetime
        try:
            when = datetime.strptime(schedule.strip(), "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")
        except ValueError:
            return "Định dạng lịch sai — cần: DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM"
        if when < datetime.now():
            return (f"Lịch đăng đang ở quá khứ:\n{schedule}\n\n"
                    "Để đăng ngay, để trống ô lịch.\n"
                    "Để lên lịch, chọn thời gian tương lai.")
    return None


def validate_tiktok(*, account: str, video_path: str, title: str,
                    description: str) -> str | None:
    if not account.strip() or "Chưa kết nối" in account:
        return ("Chưa có tài khoản TikTok.\n"
                "Vào tab 🎵 Tài khoản TikTok → Kết nối tài khoản trước.")

    err = _validate_video(video_path, UI.VIDEO_EXTS_TT, UI.TT_MAX_VIDEO_BYTES,
                          "TikTok giới hạn 4 GB.")
    if err:
        return err

    # Duration is best-effort: only checked when ffprobe exists, exactly as
    # the desktop did — a missing ffprobe must not block a publish.
    try:
        from core.tiktok.video_validator import is_ffprobe_available, validate_video
        if is_ffprobe_available():
            report = validate_video(video_path)
            dur = getattr(report, "duration_s", 0) or 0
            if dur > UI.TT_MAX_DURATION_S:
                return (f"Video dài {dur:.0f}s, vượt giới hạn TikTok mặc định "
                        f"({UI.TT_MAX_DURATION_S}s = 10 phút).\n"
                        "Nếu app của bạn đã được TikTok unlock 30 phút, "
                        "có thể bỏ qua check này.")
    except Exception:
        pass

    if not title.strip():
        return "Vui lòng nhập tiêu đề (phần 📝 Nội dung phía trên)."
    if len(title) > UI.TT_CAPTION_LIMIT:
        return (f"Tiêu đề quá dài ({len(title)} ký tự).\n"
                f"TikTok giới hạn {UI.TT_CAPTION_LIMIT} ký tự.")
    total = len(title) + len(description)
    if total > UI.TT_CAPTION_LIMIT:
        return (f"Tiêu đề + mô tả tổng cộng {total} ký tự, vượt giới hạn "
                f"caption TikTok ({UI.TT_CAPTION_LIMIT}).")
    return None


def _validate_video(path: str, exts: tuple, max_bytes: int, limit_note: str) -> str | None:
    if not path.strip():
        return "Vui lòng chọn file video"
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return f"File video không tồn tại:\n{path}"
    if os.path.isdir(path):
        return (f"Đường dẫn là thư mục, không phải file video:\n{path}\n\n"
                f"Hãy chọn file {' / '.join(exts[:3])}")
    try:
        size = os.path.getsize(path)
    except OSError as exc:
        return f"Không đọc được file video:\n{exc}"
    if size == 0:
        return f"File video rỗng (0 byte):\n{path}"
    if size > max_bytes:
        return f"File video quá lớn ({size / 1024 ** 3:.1f} GB).\n{limit_note}"
    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()
    if ext not in exts:
        return (f"File không có đuôi video hợp lệ ({ext}).\n"
                f"Hỗ trợ: {', '.join(sorted(exts))}")
    return None


# ── Background publish jobs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class PublishJob:
    id: str
    platform: str
    state: str = "queued"          # queued | running | done | error
    status: str = ""
    result_link: str = ""
    error: str = ""
    log: list = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {"id": self.id, "platform": self.platform, "state": self.state,
                "status": self.status, "result_link": self.result_link,
                "error": self.error, "log": self.log[-60:]}


class PublishRegistry:
    """Process-wide job table. One orchestrator per process (ADR-005), so a
    plain dict under a lock is sufficient and avoids adding infrastructure."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._jobs: dict = {}

    def create(self, platform: str) -> PublishJob:
        job = PublishJob(id=uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], platform=platform)
        with self._lock:
            self._jobs[job.id] = job
            # Keep the table bounded; manual publishing is low volume.
            if len(self._jobs) > 50:
                for stale in list(self._jobs)[:-50]:
                    self._jobs.pop(stale, None)
        return job

    def get(self, job_id: str) -> PublishJob | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._jobs.get(job_id)

    def latest(self, platform: str) -> PublishJob | None:
        with self._lock:
            jobs = [j for j in self._jobs.values() if j.platform == platform]
        return jobs[-1] if jobs else None


_registry = PublishRegistry()


def registry() -> PublishRegistry:
    return _registry


def _record(job: PublishJob, message: str, level: str = "info") -> None:
    job.log.append({"level": level, "message": str(message)[:400]})


def start_facebook_publish(config: dict, task: dict) -> PublishJob:
    """Hand the task to the same UploadEngine the desktop used."""
    job = _registry.create("facebook")
    stop_event = threading.Event()

    def run() -> None:
        job.state = "running"
        try:
            from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
            engine = UploadEngine(
                config, stop_event,
                on_log=lambda m, l="info": _record(job, m, l),
                on_status=lambda m: setattr(job, "status", str(m)[:200]),
                on_result=lambda t, status, link: _finish(job, status, link),
                on_done=lambda: None,
                on_error=lambda m: None,   # on_result already carries it
            )
            engine.run(task)
        except Exception as exc:
            job.state, job.error = "error", str(exc)
            _record(job, f"Lỗi: {exc}", "error")
        finally:
            if job.state == "running":
                job.state = "done"

    threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True, name=f"ManualFB-{job.id}").start()
    return job


def _finish(job: PublishJob, status: str, link: str) -> None:
    if status == "success":
        job.state, job.result_link = "done", link
        _record(job, f"✅ Đăng thành công: {link}", "success")
    else:
        job.state, job.error = "error", link
        _record(job, f"❌ {link}", "error")


def start_tiktok_publish(config: dict, task: dict) -> PublishJob:
    """Hand the task to TikTokPublisher. The compliance guard inside it runs
    server-side, so a tampered form cannot bypass the checks."""
    job = _registry.create("tiktok")
    stop_event = threading.Event()

    def run() -> None:
        job.state = "running"
        try:
            from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher
            pub = TikTokPublisher(
                config, stop_event,
                on_log=lambda m, l="info": _record(job, m, l),
                on_status=lambda m: setattr(job, "status", str(m)[:200]),
            )
            result = pub.publish(task)
            pid = getattr(result, "external_post_id", "") or "—"
            st = getattr(result, "status", "") or "ok"
            job.state = "done"
            job.status = f"✅ Đăng thành công! publish_id={pid} ({st})"
            _record(job, job.status, "success")
        except Exception as exc:
            job.state = "error"
            job.error = _friendly_tiktok_error(exc)
            _record(job, f"❌ {job.error}", "error")

    threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True, name=f"ManualTT-{job.id}").start()
    return job


def _friendly_tiktok_error(exc: Exception) -> str:
    """Same mapping as gui/operation_tab.py::_friendly_tiktok_error."""
    try:
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        if isinstance(exc, TikTokComplianceError):
            return f"{exc.message}\n(Mã: {exc.error_code})"
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from core.tiktok.error_codes import get_friendly_message
        code = getattr(exc, "error_code", "")
        if code:
            return get_friendly_message(code, fallback=str(exc))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return str(exc)

def safe_upload_name(filename: str) -> str:
    """Keep the extension (validation depends on it) but never trust the
    client-supplied path or name."""
    base = os.path.basename(filename or "upload")
    ext = os.path.splitext(base)[1].lower()[:10]
    stem = "".join(c for c in os.path.splitext(base)[0] if c.isalnum() or c in "-_")[:60]
    return f"{stem or 'upload'}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}{ext}"

"""
monitor_service.py — data for the Monitor page (web port of gui/monitor_tab.py).

Two defects in the desktop tab are FIXED here rather than reproduced (both
found by the parity analysis):

  1. `monitor_tab.py:388` calls `get_fb_default_store()`, but that name is
     only bound inside a different method's local import. At that line it
     raises NameError, which the surrounding bare `except` swallows — so

     Here the fallback is fully populated.

@dataclass
class TokenRow:
    name: str
    days: int
    status: str
    pages_selected: int = 0
    pages_total: int = 0

    @property
    def token_text(self) -> str:
        return "∞" if self.days == -1 else f"{self.days} ngày"

    @property
    def colour(self) -> str:
        return {
            "ok": UI.COLORS["green"], "permanent": UI.COLORS["green"],
            "warning": UI.COLORS["amber"], "expired": UI.COLORS["red"],
        }.get(self.status, UI.COLORS["muted2"])


@dataclass
class MetricRow:
    page: str
    uploads_done: int
    avg_wait_s: float
    total_upload_s: float

    @property
    def avg_upload_s(self) -> float:
        return self.total_upload_s / self.uploads_done if self.uploads_done else 0.0


@dataclass

    tokens: list = field(default_factory=list)
    token_error: str = ""
    metrics: list = field(default_factory=list)
    antispam_summary: str = "—"
    antispam_colour: str = ""

def collect_token_health(config: dict) -> tuple[list, str]:
    """Token expiry per account, joined with its selected-page count.

    The join is the part the desktop got wrong (see module docstring).
    """
    try:
        from core.token_store import get_default_store

        store = get_default_store()
        if getattr(store, "is_unreadable", False):
            # Bail out before importing the refresher: nothing downstream can
            # do anything useful with a store that will not decrypt.
            return [], store.load_error or "Không đọc được kho token."

        from core.token_refresher import TokenRefresher

        # name -> (selected, total). This is the join the desktop lost to a
        # swallowed NameError.
        page_counts = {
            acc.name: (len(acc.get_selected_pages()), len(acc.get_pages_list()))
            for acc in store.all_accounts()
        }

        rows = []
        for entry in TokenRefresher(config, store).health_summary():
            sel, total = page_counts.get(entry.get("name", ""), (0, 0))
            rows.append(TokenRow(
                name=str(entry.get("name", ""))[:40],
                days=int(entry.get("days", 0)),
                status=str(entry.get("status", "")),
                pages_selected=sel, pages_total=total,
            ))
        return rows, ""
    except Exception as exc:
        return [], f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"


def collect_metrics() -> list:
    """Per-page upload metrics for this process (core.rate_limiter)."""
    try:
        from core.rate_limiter import get_global_page_metrics
        snapshot = get_global_page_metrics() or {}
    except Exception:
        return []
    rows = [
        MetricRow(
            page=str(page)[:40],
            uploads_done=int(m.get("uploads_done", 0)),
            avg_wait_s=float(m.get("avg_wait_s", 0.0)),
            total_upload_s=float(m.get("total_upload_s", 0.0)),
        )
        for page, m in snapshot.items()
    ]
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r.page)


def reset_metrics() -> None:
    from core.rate_limiter import reset_global_metrics
    reset_global_metrics()

def collect_antispam(config: dict) -> tuple[str, str, list]:
    """(summary, colour, detail lines) — mirrors _render_antispam."""
    failure = ""
    format_oneline = None
    try:
        from core.anti_spam_analytics import collect_snapshot, format_oneline
        snap = collect_snapshot(config)
    except Exception as exc:
        # Keep rendering from the fallback instead of bailing out — that is
        # exactly where the desktop raised its second AttributeError.
        snap = _EmptySnapshot()
        failure = f"⚠ Không thu thập được số liệu chống spam: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

    if failure:
        summary = failure
    else:
        try:
            summary = format_oneline(snap)
        except Exception as exc:
            summary = f"⚠ Không định dạng được số liệu: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            failure = summary

    def n(attr, default=0):
        return getattr(snap, attr, default)

    if failure:
        colour = UI.COLORS["amber"]
    elif (n("n_critical_tokens") or n("targets_with_abuse")
            or n("n_pages_dead") or n("n_pages_throttled")):
        colour = UI.COLORS["red"]
    elif (n("n_warn_tokens") or n("open_breakers")
          or n("targets_with_rate") or n("n_bot_flat_targets")):
        colour = UI.COLORS["amber"]
    else:
        colour = UI.COLORS["green"]

    details: list = []
    if n("total_attempts_7d"):
        details.append(
            f"📊 7d: {n('total_successes_7d')}/{n('total_attempts_7d')} thành công "
            f"({n('success_rate_7d', 0.0) * 100:.0f}%)")
    breakers = n("open_breakers") or []
    if breakers:
        joined = ", ".join(f"{k} ({s / 60:.0f}p)" for k, s in breakers[:3])
        details.append(f"⏸ Breaker OPEN: {joined}")
    if n("targets_with_abuse"):
        details.append("🚨 Abuse signal: " + ", ".join(n("targets_with_abuse")[:3]))
    if n("targets_with_rate"):
        details.append("🟠 Rate-limited: " + ", ".join(n("targets_with_rate")[:3]))
    details.extend(list(n("token_messages") or [])[:2])
    details.extend(list(n("page_health_warnings") or [])[:3])
    details.extend(list(n("time_intel_warnings") or [])[:2])
    recs = n("recommendations") or []
    if recs:
        details.append(f"💡 {len(recs)} đề xuất tinh chỉnh — xem log")
        for r in recs[:2]:
            details.append(
                f"   • {getattr(r, 'metric', '?')}: {getattr(r, 'current_value', 0):g}"
                f"→{getattr(r, 'suggested', 0):g} "
                f"({getattr(r, 'direction', '')}, {getattr(r, 'confidence', '')})")
    if n("total_content_records"):
        details.append(f"📚 Content history: {n('total_content_records')} bản ghi")

    return summary, colour, details


def collect_logs(limit: int = 80) -> list:
    """Newest-first, same as the desktop panel. Secrets are already redacted
    by utils.logger before they reach the buffer."""
    try:
        from utils.logger import get_recent_logs
        entries = get_recent_logs(limit) or []
    except Exception:
        return []
    out = []
    for e in reversed(entries):
        level = str(e.get("level", "info"))
        message = str(e.get("formatted") or e.get("msg") or "")
        # Colour first: the prefix would push "[W3]" off the start of the
        # string and the per-worker colour would silently fall back to the
        # level colour.
        colour = UI.log_colour(level, message)
        # Worker lines are coloured per worker, so severity has to be spelled
        # out or an error hides among routine lines.
        if UI.is_worker_line(message):
            message = UI.severity_prefix(level) + message
        out.append({"level": level, "message": message, "colour": colour})
    return out


def collect(config: dict) -> MonitorData:
    tokens, token_error = collect_token_health(config)
    summary, colour, details = collect_antispam(config)
    return MonitorData(
        tokens=tokens, token_error=token_error,
        metrics=collect_metrics(),
        antispam_summary=summary, antispam_colour=colour,
        antispam_details=details,
        logs=collect_logs(),
    )

"""
oauth_service.py — provider OAuth on the web (W5).

The desktop flow could not work on a server: it opened a browser on the
machine running the bot and bound `localhost:8765` / `localhost:8766` to
catch the redirect (`core/auth_manager.py`, `core/tiktok/auth_manager.py`).
On a VPS there is no browser, and the operator's browser cannot reach the
server's localhost.

Here the provider redirects straight back to this app, so the callback is an
ordinary authenticated request. The Graph / TikTok work itself is NOT
reimplemented — it lives in `AuthManager.complete_oauth()` and
`TikTokAuthManager.complete_oauth()`, which the desktop transport also calls.
This module only owns what the web needs and the desktop got for free from a
closure variable:

  * a **server-side** store for `state` and the PKCE `code_verifier`, since
    they must survive the round trip between two separate HTTP requests;
  * **binding each flow to the browser session** that started it, via a
    nonce kept in the signed session cookie. Without it, anyone who learned
    a `state` value could complete a flow into this operator's token store;
  * **single-use** consumption and a TTL, so a leaked or replayed callback
    URL is worthless.

This also lets the TikTok relay go away entirely: the relay existed only
because there was no public callback endpoint to register.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import secrets
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

CALLBACK_PATHS = {
    "facebook": "/oauth/facebook/callback",
    "tiktok":   "/oauth/tiktok/callback",
}

FLOW_TTL_S = 600         # a login that takes >10 minutes has been abandoned
MAX_PENDING = 20         # bound the store; an operator has one browser
SESSION_NONCE_KEY = "oauth_nonce"


class OAuthError(Exception):
    """Anything that should be shown to the operator rather than logged."""


@dataclass
class PendingFlow:
    provider: str
    state: str
    redirect_uri: str
    session_nonce: str
    code_verifier: str = ""      # TikTok (PKCE) only
    created_at: float = 0.0

    def is_expired(self, now: float) -> bool:
        return (now - self.created_at) > FLOW_TTL_S


class FlowStore:
    """In-memory, single-use, TTL-bounded pending-flow store.

    In-process is correct under ADR-005 (one orchestrator process). If the app
    is ever run with multiple workers this must move to shared storage, or a
    callback will land on a worker that never saw the flow.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._flows: dict[str, PendingFlow] = {}

    def put(self, flow: PendingFlow) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._prune(time.time())
            if len(self._flows) >= MAX_PENDING:
                # Drop the oldest rather than refusing — a fresh, deliberate
                # login attempt should never be blocked by stale entries.
                oldest = min(self._flows.values(), key=lambda f: f.created_at)
                self._flows.pop(oldest.state, None)
            self._flows[flow.state] = flow

    def take(self, state: str) -> PendingFlow | None:
        """Pop the flow for `state`. Single-use: a replayed callback finds
        nothing."""
        with self._lock:
            now = time.time()
            self._prune(now)
            flow = self._flows.pop(state, None)
            if flow is None or flow.is_expired(now):
                return None
            return flow

    def _prune(self, now: float) -> None:
        for state in [s for s, f in self._flows.items() if f.is_expired(now)]:
            self._flows.pop(state, None)

    # Test/diagnostic helpers.
    def pending_count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            self._prune(time.time())
            return len(self._flows)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._flows.clear()


_store = FlowStore()


def store() -> FlowStore:
    return _store


# ── session binding ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def session_nonce(session: dict) -> str:
    """Stable per-session nonce, minted on first use.

    Kept in the signed session cookie, so a callback can prove it arrived in
    the same browser session that started the flow.
    """
    nonce = str(session.get(SESSION_NONCE_KEY, "") or "")
    if not nonce:
        nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        session[SESSION_NONCE_KEY] = nonce
    return nonce


def callback_url(base_url: str, provider: str) -> str:
    """Absolute callback URL, which must match the provider registration
    byte-for-byte or the token exchange is rejected."""
    if provider not in CALLBACK_PATHS:
        raise OAuthError(f"Provider không hỗ trợ: {provider}")
    return base_url.rstrip("/") + CALLBACK_PATHS[provider]


# The redirect URI is read from the SAME config keys the bot already uses —
# `meta_redirect_uri` / `tiktok_redirect_uri`, the values registered at the
# Meta and TikTok developer portals. No new key is introduced: the operator
# repoints the existing ones from the old static bridge pages
# (https://lttstudios.com/auth/fb-callback.html,
#  https://lttstudios.com/legal/callback.html) to this app's own routes.
REDIRECT_CONFIG_KEY = {
    "facebook": "meta_redirect_uri",
    "tiktok":   "tiktok_redirect_uri",
}

_PORTAL = {
    "facebook": "Meta → App → Facebook Login → Valid OAuth Redirect URIs",
    "tiktok":   "TikTok Developer Portal → App → Login Kit → Redirect URI",
}


def resolve_redirect_uri(config: dict, provider: str, request_base: str) -> str:
    """The redirect URI to send, validated against what this app can serve.

    Deliberately strict. A redirect_uri mismatch surfaces at the provider as
    an opaque error long after the operator has left this app, so it is far
    cheaper to refuse up front and say exactly which value to change where.
    """
    key = REDIRECT_CONFIG_KEY[provider]
    configured = str(config.get(key, "") or "").strip()
    expected = callback_url(request_base, provider)

    if not configured:
        raise OAuthError(
            f"Chưa đặt `{key}`. Vào Cài đặt và điền:\n    {expected}\n"
            f"rồi khai báo đúng URL đó ở {_PORTAL[provider]}."
        )
    if not configured.startswith("https://"):
        raise OAuthError(
            f"`{key}` phải là HTTPS — {'Facebook' if provider == 'facebook' else 'TikTok'} "
            f"từ chối HTTP. Giá trị hiện tại: {configured}"
        )
    if not configured.rstrip("/").endswith(CALLBACK_PATHS[provider]):
        raise OAuthError(
            f"`{key}` đang trỏ tới {configured}\n"
            f"— đó là trang callback tĩnh của bản desktop cũ, không còn dùng.\n"
            f"Ứng dụng web nhận callback tại:\n    {expected}\n"
            f"Hãy sửa `{key}` thành URL đó, VÀ khai báo đúng nó ở "
            f"{_PORTAL[provider]}."
        )
    return configured


# ── Facebook ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def facebook_start(config: dict, request_base: str, session: dict) -> str:
    from core.auth_manager import AuthManager

    manager = AuthManager(config)
    if not manager.is_configured():
        raise OAuthError(
            "Chưa cấu hình Meta App ID / App Secret. Vào Cài đặt → "
            "'Meta App (Facebook Login)' để nhập trước khi kết nối."
        )

    redirect_uri = resolve_redirect_uri(config, "facebook", request_base)
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    _store.put(PendingFlow(
        provider="facebook", state=state, redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
        session_nonce=session_nonce(session), created_at=time.time(),
    ))
    return manager.build_authorize_url(redirect_uri, state)


def facebook_finish(config: dict, state: str, code: str, session: dict):
    from core.auth_manager import AuthManager

    flow = _consume(state, session, "facebook")
    manager = AuthManager(config)
    return manager.complete_oauth(code, flow.redirect_uri)


# ── TikTok ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def tiktok_start(config: dict, request_base: str, session: dict) -> str:
    from core.tiktok.auth_manager import TikTokAuthManager

    manager = TikTokAuthManager(config)
    if not manager.is_configured():
        raise OAuthError(
            "Chưa cấu hình TikTok Client Key / Client Secret. Vào Cài đặt → "
            "'TikTok App' để nhập trước khi kết nối."
        )

    redirect_uri = resolve_redirect_uri(config, "tiktok", request_base)
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    code_verifier, code_challenge = manager.generate_pkce_pair()
    # The verifier must never leave the server: it is what proves this app
    # (not whoever intercepted the code) is redeeming the authorization code.
    _store.put(PendingFlow(
        provider="tiktok", state=state, redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
        session_nonce=session_nonce(session), code_verifier=code_verifier,
        created_at=time.time(),
    ))
    return manager.build_authorize_url(redirect_uri, state, code_challenge)


def tiktok_finish(config: dict, state: str, code: str, session: dict):
    from core.tiktok.auth_manager import TikTokAuthManager

    flow = _consume(state, session, "tiktok")
    manager = TikTokAuthManager(config)
    return manager.complete_oauth(code, flow.code_verifier, flow.redirect_uri)


def tiktok_scopes(config: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Scopes to show on the disclosure screen — the exact list that will be
    requested, read from config rather than restated here."""
    from core.tiktok.auth_manager import TikTokAuthManager

    raw = TikTokAuthManager(config).scopes
    return [s.strip() for s in str(raw).split(",") if s.strip()]


# ── shared ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _consume(state: str, session: dict, provider: str) -> PendingFlow:
    if not state:
        raise OAuthError("Thiếu tham số state — không thể xác thực callback.")

    flow = _store.take(state)
    if flow is None:
        raise OAuthError(
            "Phiên kết nối không còn hợp lệ (đã hết 10 phút, đã dùng rồi, "
            "hoặc máy chủ vừa khởi động lại). Hãy bấm kết nối lại."
        )
    if flow.provider != provider:
        raise OAuthError("Callback không khớp nền tảng đã yêu cầu.")

    expected = str(session.get(SESSION_NONCE_KEY, "") or "")
    if not expected or not secrets.compare_digest(expected, flow.session_nonce):
        raise OAuthError(
            "Callback đến từ một phiên trình duyệt khác — đã từ chối. "
            "Hãy đăng nhập lại rồi bấm kết nối từ đầu."
        )
    return flow


def provider_error_message(params: dict) -> str:
    """Human-readable text for a provider-side denial, if any."""
    for key in ("error_description", "error_message", "error_reason", "error"):
        value = str(params.get(key, "") or "").strip()
        if value:
            return value
    return ""

"""
settings_schema.py — presentation schema for the web Settings page.

Mirrors the 11 cards of the desktop `gui/settings_tab.py`, but declares the
fields as data instead of hand-built widgets. Rendering is generic, so the
page stays a fraction of the desktop tab's 1,600 lines while covering the
same keys.

Values and defaults come from `core.config_defaults.DEFAULTS` — this module
only describes how to *show* them. Adding a config key there and listing it
here is all that is needed for it to appear in the UI.

Secret fields are marked `secret=True`: their current value is never sent to
the browser, and an empty submission means "keep what is stored" rather than
"clear it".
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field as dc_field

from core.config_defaults import DEFAULTS
from core.config_help import FIELD_HELP

# Field kinds the template knows how to render.
TEXT, PASSWORD, NUMBER, BOOL, SELECT, TEXTAREA, JSONLIST = (
    "text", "password", "number", "bool", "select", "textarea", "jsonlist"
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Field:
    key:     str
    label:   str
    kind:    str = TEXT
    hint:    str = ""
    options: tuple = ()
    secret:  bool = False

    @property
    def default(self):
        return DEFAULTS.get(self.key, "")

    @property
    def help_text(self) -> str:
        """Explicit hint wins; otherwise fall back to the desktop tooltip for
        this key (core.config_help), so the web shows the same guidance the
        desktop showed rather than a reworded version."""
        return self.hint or FIELD_HELP.get(self.key, "")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Group:
    id:     str
    title:  str
    colour: str
    note:   str = ""
    fields: tuple = dc_field(default_factory=tuple)

def all_field_keys() -> set:
    return {f.key for g in GROUPS for f in g.fields}


def field_by_key(key: str):
    for g in GROUPS:
        for f in g.fields:
            if f.key == key:
                return f
    return None


def secret_keys() -> set:
    return {f.key for g in GROUPS for f in g.fields if f.secret}


def coverage_report() -> dict:
    """Which DEFAULTS keys are not yet exposed in the UI.

    Used by a test so a config key added to core.config_defaults cannot be
    silently unreachable from the web UI.
    """
    shown = all_field_keys()
    return {
        "shown": sorted(shown),
        "missing": sorted(set(DEFAULTS) - shown),
        "unknown": sorted(shown - set(DEFAULTS)),
    }

"""
settings_service.py — read/validate/save data/config.json from the web UI.

Safety properties this enforces, all learned from real incidents in this
project:

  * Secret values are never sent to the browser. An empty submission for a
    secret field means "keep the stored value", so a round-trip through the
    form cannot silently blank an App Secret.
  * The file is written atomically (utils.atomic_io), so a crash mid-save
    cannot truncate a working config.
  * A timestamped backup is kept before every write, because a bad column
    mapping silently stops the bot (docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md B3).
  * The new config is validated *before* it replaces the old one. Invalid
    input is rejected with per-field errors and nothing is written.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
from datetime import datetime

from core.config_defaults import DEFAULTS
from core.config_validator import ConfigValidationError, validate_config
from platform_core.runtime_paths import resolve_runtime_paths
from server.services.settings_schema import BOOL, JSONLIST, NUMBER, GROUPS
from utils.atomic_io import atomic_write_json

SECRET_PLACEHOLDER = ""      # secrets render as empty; empty means "unchanged"
MAX_BACKUPS = 20


def config_path(env: dict | None = None) -> str:
    return resolve_runtime_paths(env).config_path


def load_config(env: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    path = config_path(env)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return dict(DEFAULTS)
    # utf-8-sig, not utf-8: an operator who edits this file in Notepad on
    # Windows gets a UTF-8 BOM, and json.load() raises on it. That failure
    # surfaced as an opaque 503 from /health/ready with the service running
    # normally — expensive to diagnose, trivial to tolerate.
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def view_model(config: dict) -> dict:
    """Values shaped for the template. Secrets are replaced by a flag, never
    by their value — so a token cannot leak into rendered HTML."""
    out: dict = {}
    for group in GROUPS:
        for f in group.fields:
            raw = config.get(f.key, f.default)
            if f.secret:
                out[f.key] = {"value": SECRET_PLACEHOLDER, "is_set": bool(str(raw or "").strip())}
            elif f.kind == JSONLIST:
                out[f.key] = {"value": json.dumps(raw if raw is not None else [],
                                                  ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}
            elif f.kind == BOOL:
                out[f.key] = {"value": _as_bool(raw)}
            else:
                out[f.key] = {"value": "" if raw is None else str(raw)}
    return out


def _as_bool(v) -> bool:
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return v
    return str(v).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes", "on")


def apply_form(config: dict, form: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """Merge submitted form values into *config*.

    Returns (new_config, field_errors). A non-empty field_errors means
    nothing should be saved.
    """
    new = dict(config)
    errors: dict = {}

    for group in GROUPS:
        for f in group.fields:
            submitted = form.get(f.key)

            if f.kind == BOOL:
                # Unchecked checkboxes are simply absent from the form body.
                new[f.key] = f.key in form
                continue

            if submitted is None:
                continue                      # field not on this submission

            raw = str(submitted).strip()

            if f.secret:
                if raw == "":
                    continue                  # keep existing secret
                new[f.key] = raw
                continue

            if f.kind == NUMBER:
                if raw == "":
                    new[f.key] = 0
                    continue
                try:
                    new[f.key] = int(raw) if "." not in raw else float(raw)
                except ValueError:
                    errors[f.key] = f"'{raw}' không phải số hợp lệ"
                continue

            if f.kind == JSONLIST:
                if raw == "":
                    new[f.key] = []
                    continue
                try:
                    new[f.key] = json.loads(raw)
                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                    errors[f.key] = f"JSON không hợp lệ: {exc.msg} (dòng {exc.lineno})"
                continue

            new[f.key] = raw

    return new, errors


def _backup(path: str) -> str | None:
    """Timestamped copy of the current config, pruned to MAX_BACKUPS."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    folder = os.path.dirname(path) or "."
    stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    dest = os.path.join(folder, f"config.backup_{stamp}.json")
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)

    backups = sorted(
        (f for f in os.listdir(folder) if f.startswith("config.backup_")),
        reverse=True,
    )
    for stale in backups[MAX_BACKUPS:]:
        try:
            os.remove(os.path.join(folder, stale))
        except OSError:
            pass
    return dest


def save_config(new_config: dict, env: dict | None = None) -> tuple[bool, list, list]:
    """Validate then atomically write. Returns (saved, errors, warnings).

    On validation failure nothing is written — the running config survives.
    """
    try:
        warnings = validate_config(new_config)
    except ConfigValidationError as exc:
        return False, list(exc.errors), list(exc.warnings)

    path = config_path(env)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    _backup(path)
    atomic_write_json(path, new_config)
    return True, [], list(warnings)


def list_backups(env: dict | None = None) -> list:
    folder = os.path.dirname(config_path(env)) or "."
    if not os.path.isdir(folder):
        return []
    return sorted(
        (f for f in os.listdir(folder) if f.startswith("config.backup_")),
        reverse=True,
    )

"""
sheet_service.py — Sheet Runner data access for the web UI.

Reproduces the behaviour of `gui/sheet_runner_tab.py`'s selectors, worker
CRUD and queue preview, but as plain functions with no widget dependency.
Everything goes through the shared `core/` code and the shared
`data/workers.json`, so the web and any other client see one list
(ADR-003).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from core.worker_store import load_workers, save_workers
from server.services import ui_constants as UI


class SheetServiceError(RuntimeError):
    """Something the operator needs to read and act on."""


# ── Selectors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def list_sheet_options(config: dict) -> list:
    """Sheet dropdown, mirroring _reload_sheets().

    Falls back to a synthetic "Default" entry built from the legacy
    top-level `sheet_id` when `sheets` is empty, exactly as the desktop did.
    """
    sheets = config.get("sheets") or []
    options = [
        {"id": str(s.get("id", "")).strip(),
         "alias": str(s.get("alias", "") or "Sheet").strip(),
         "label": f"{s.get('alias') or 'Sheet'}  ({str(s.get('id',''))[:10]}…)"}
        for s in sheets if str(s.get("id", "")).strip()
    ]
    if not options:
        legacy = str(config.get("sheet_id", "") or "").strip()
        if legacy:
            options = [{"id": legacy, "alias": "Default",
                        "label": f"Default  ({legacy[:10]}…)"}]
    return options


def list_tabs(config: dict, sheet_id: str) -> list:
    """Tab dropdown — hits the Google Sheets API."""
    from utils.sheet_client import SheetClient
    try:
        client = SheetClient(config, sheet_id_override=sheet_id)
        client.connect()
        return client.get_all_tabs()
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SheetServiceError(f"Lỗi kết nối: {exc}") from exc


def list_page_options(platform: str) -> list:
    """Page / TikTok-account dropdown.

    facebook -> TokenStore.all_page_options(), label "Page  ← Account"
    tiktok   -> TikTokTokenStore accounts, label = display_name or open_id

    An unreadable token store yields [] plus a readable reason, so the page
    can say "kho token không đọc được" instead of silently showing nothing.
    """
    if platform == "tiktok":
        try:
            from core.tiktok.token_store import get_default_store
            store = get_default_store()
            if getattr(store, "is_unreadable", False):
                return []
            return [{"label": a.display_name or a.open_id,
                     "page_id": "", "account_id": a.open_id,
                     "account_name": a.display_name or a.open_id}
                    for a in store.all_accounts()]
        except Exception:
            return []

    try:
        from core.token_store import get_default_store
        store = get_default_store()
        if getattr(store, "is_unreadable", False):
            return []
        store.reload()          # desktop forces a re-read here too
        return [{"label": o["label"], "page_id": o["page_id"],
                 "account_id": o["account_id"], "account_name": o["account_name"],
                 "page_name": o["page_name"]}
                for o in store.all_page_options()]
    except Exception:
        return []


def _resolve_page(platform: str, label: str) -> dict:
    """Reverse-map a dropdown label to ids, mirroring _resolve_page_label()."""
    label = (label or "").strip()
    for opt in list_page_options(platform):
        if opt["label"] == label:
            if platform == "tiktok":
                return {"page": label, "page_id": "",
                        "account_id": opt.get("account_id", ""),
                        "account_name": opt.get("account_name", label)}
            return {"page": opt.get("page_name", label),
                    "page_id": opt.get("page_id", ""),
                    "account_id": opt.get("account_id", ""),
                    "account_name": opt.get("account_name", "")}
    # Free-typed / stale label: keep it, with no ids. The desktop did the same.
    if platform == "tiktok":
        return {"page": label, "page_id": "", "account_id": "",
                "account_name": label}
    return {"page": label, "page_id": "", "account_id": "", "account_name": ""}


# ── Worker CRUD (shared data/workers.json) ────────────────────────────────────

def stored_workers(platform: str) -> list:
    try:
        return load_workers(platform=platform)
    except Exception:
        return []


def add_worker(platform: str, *, sheet_id: str, tab: str, page_label: str) -> None:
    """Same validation order and messages as _add_worker()."""
    sheet_id = (sheet_id or "").strip()
    tab = (tab or "").strip()

    if not sheet_id:
        raise SheetServiceError("Chưa chọn Sheet (dropdown đầu).")
    if not tab or tab.startswith("⏳"):
        raise SheetServiceError("Chọn Tab Sheet trước (nhấn 🔄 để tải)")

    workers = stored_workers(platform)
    if len(workers) >= UI.MAX_WORKERS:
        raise SheetServiceError(f"Tối đa {UI.MAX_WORKERS} workers")

    resolved = _resolve_page(platform, page_label)
    new_id = resolved["page_id"] or resolved["page"]
    for w in workers:
        existing_id = w.get("page_id") or w.get("page", "")
        if w.get("sheet_id", "") == sheet_id and w.get("tab") == tab \
                and existing_id == new_id:
            raise SheetServiceError(
                f"({sheet_id[:10]}…, '{tab}', '{resolved['page']}') đã được thêm")

    workers.append({
        "sheet_id": sheet_id,
        "tab": tab,
        "page": resolved["page"],
        "page_id": resolved["page_id"],
        "account_id": resolved["account_id"],
    })
    save_workers(workers, platform=platform)


def remove_worker(platform: str, index: int) -> None:
    workers = stored_workers(platform)
    if 0 <= index < len(workers):
        workers.pop(index)
        save_workers(workers, platform=platform)


# ── Queue preview ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def queue_preview(config: dict, platform: str, limit: int = 20) -> dict:
    """Mirrors _refresh_queue_preview(): first worker's sheet+tab, skip DONE /
    SKIPPED, cap at 20 rows, report the real spreadsheet row number."""
    workers = stored_workers(platform)
    if not workers:
        raise SheetServiceError(
            "Chưa có worker — thêm ít nhất 1 Tab Sheet + Page")

    w0 = workers[0]
    tab = w0.get("tab", "")
    sheet_id = w0.get("sheet_id", "") or str(config.get("sheet_id", ""))
    if not tab or not sheet_id:
        raise SheetServiceError("Worker đầu tiên thiếu sheet_id hoặc tab")

    from utils.sheet_client import SheetClient
    try:
        client = SheetClient(config, sheet_id_override=sheet_id)
        client.connect()
        client.switch_tab(tab)
        data_rows = client.get_all_rows()          # header already excluded
        status_idx = client.get_column_index("col_status")
        title_idx = client.get_column_index("col_title")
        sched_idx = client.get_column_index("col_schedule_time")
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SheetServiceError(str(exc)[:200]) from exc

    def cell(row, idx, limit_chars):
        # `idx is not None` — column A is index 0 and must not read as missing.
        if idx is None or idx >= len(row):
            return "—"
        return str(row[idx])[:limit_chars]

    rows = []
    for i, row in enumerate(data_rows, start=2):
        if not any(row):
            continue
        status = (str(row[status_idx]).strip().upper()
                  if status_idx is not None and status_idx < len(row) else "")
        if status in ("DONE", "SKIPPED"):
            continue
        rows.append({
            "seq": len(rows) + 1,
            "row_idx": i,
            "title": cell(row, title_idx, 35),
            "schedule": cell(row, sched_idx, 16),
            "status": status or "PENDING",
            "colour": {"RUNNING": UI.COLORS["blue"],
                       "ERROR": UI.COLORS["red"]}.get(status, UI.COLORS["muted"]),
        })
        if len(rows) >= limit:
            break

    return {"tab": tab, "rows": rows, "count": len(rows)}

def log_colour(level: str, message: str = "") -> str:
    """Colour for a log line, reproducing gui/result_tabs.py::_pick_tag.

    A line starting with "[W<n>]" gets a per-worker colour cycling every 6
    workers; otherwise the level decides.
    """
    import re
    m = re.match(r"\[W(\d+)\]", message or "")
    if m:
        idx = (int(m.group(1)) - 1) % len(WORKER_LOG_COLORS)
        return WORKER_LOG_COLORS[idx]
    return LOG_COLORS.get((level or "").lower(), LOG_LEVEL_DEFAULT_COLOR)


def is_worker_line(message: str) -> bool:
    import re
    return bool(re.match(r"\[W(\d+)\]", message or ""))


def severity_prefix(level: str) -> str:
    """Severity marker for a worker log line (gui/result_tabs.py::
    _severity_prefix).

    A `[W3] Lỗi ...` line is coloured by worker, not by level, so without this
    marker an error inside a worker line is indistinguishable from routine
    chatter. The desktop added it for exactly that reason; it must not be lost
    on the web, where the log is the only window into a running job.
    """
    lvl = (level or "").lower()
    if lvl == "error":
        return "✖ "
    if lvl in ("warning", "warn"):
        return "⚠ "
    return ""


def worker_state_view(state: str, current_job: str = "", last_msg: str = "",
                      jobs_done: int = 0, jobs_error: int = 0) -> tuple:
    """(text, colour) for a worker row — mirrors _on_worker_update."""
    colour = WORKER_STATE_COLORS.get(state, WORKER_STATE_DEFAULT_COLOR)
    if state == "running":
        text = f"▶ {current_job[:14]}" if current_job else (last_msg[:16] or state)
    elif state == "stopped":
        text = f"⏹ {jobs_done}✓ {jobs_error}✗"
    elif state == "error":
        text = f"❌ {last_msg[:14]}"
    elif state in WORKER_STATE_TEXT:
        text = WORKER_STATE_TEXT[state]
    else:
        text = last_msg[:16] or state
    return text, colour

"""
worker_control.py — start/stop/inspect the publishing worker from the web
dashboard (P6).

Architecture (ADR-004): the dashboard is a *control plane*. Starting a run
here hands work to P1's `WorkerApplication`, which owns its own daemon
threads. Closing the browser, logging out, or losing the HTTP connection
does not stop the run — only an explicit stop, or the process exiting,
does.

Single-orchestrator invariant (ADR-005): exactly one `WorkerApplication`
per process, held here as module state. Cross-process safety comes from
`WorkerApplication`'s own SessionLock, which is what stops a second runner
and this server from driving the same account simultaneously.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from core.worker_app import WorkerApplication, WorkerOwnershipError

# Bounded so a long-running worker cannot grow this without limit.
_LOG_CAPACITY = 300


class WorkerBusyError(RuntimeError):
    """A run is already in progress in this process."""


class NoWorkersConfiguredError(RuntimeError):
    """Nothing to run — the worker list is empty."""


@dataclass
class WorkerSnapshot:
    running:   bool = False
    platform:  str = ""
    workers:   list = field(default_factory=list)   # list[dict] view models
    log:       list = field(default_factory=list)   # newest last
    last_error: str = ""


class WorkerController:
    """Process-wide worker lifecycle owner. Thread-safe."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._app: WorkerApplication | None = None
        self._platform = ""
        self._log: list = []
        self._last_error = ""

    # ── logging adapter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_log(self, message: str, level: str) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._log.append({"level": level, "message": str(message)[:400]})
            if len(self._log) > _LOG_CAPACITY:
                del self._log[: len(self._log) - _LOG_CAPACITY]

    # ── lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def start(self, workers: list, config: dict, platform: str = "") -> None:
        """Begin a run. Raises WorkerBusyError / NoWorkersConfiguredError /
        WorkerOwnershipError — all of which the caller should surface to the
        operator rather than swallow."""
        if not workers:
            raise NoWorkersConfiguredError(
                "Chưa có worker nào được cấu hình. Thêm worker ở tab Sheet "
                "ở trang Sheet FB / Sheet TikTok (danh sách được lưu và dùng chung)."
            )

        with self._lock:
            if self._app is not None and self._app.is_running:
                raise WorkerBusyError(
                    "Đang có một phiên chạy. Dừng phiên hiện tại trước khi bắt đầu phiên mới."
                )
            self._log = []
            self._last_error = ""
            self._platform = platform
            app = WorkerApplication(
                workers=workers, config=config, platform_filter=platform,
                on_log=self._on_log,
            )
            self._app = app

        # start() outside the lock: it acquires SessionLocks and spawns
        # threads, and a stop callback firing immediately would otherwise
        # contend for a lock this thread still holds.
        try:
            app.start()
        except WorkerOwnershipError as exc:
            with self._lock:
                self._app = None
                self._last_error = str(exc)
            raise

    def stop(self) -> None:
        app = self._app
        if app is not None:
            app.stop()

    def snapshot(self) -> WorkerSnapshot:
        with self._lock:
            app = self._app
            log = list(self._log)
            last_error = self._last_error
            platform = self._platform

        if app is None:
            return WorkerSnapshot(running=False, platform=platform,
                                  log=log, last_error=last_error)

        statuses = []
        for s in app.worker_statuses():
            statuses.append({
                "tab":         getattr(s, "tab", ""),
                "page":        getattr(s, "page", ""),
                "state":       getattr(s, "state", ""),
                "current_job": getattr(s, "current_job", ""),
                "jobs_done":   getattr(s, "jobs_done", 0),
                "jobs_error":  getattr(s, "jobs_error", 0),
                "last_msg":    getattr(s, "last_msg", ""),
            })

        return WorkerSnapshot(
            running=app.is_running, platform=platform, workers=statuses,
            log=log, last_error=last_error,
        )


_controller: WorkerController | None = None
_controller_lock = threading.Lock()


def get_controller() -> WorkerController:
    """Process-wide singleton — enforces the one-orchestrator invariant."""
    global _controller
    if _controller is None:
        with _controller_lock:
            if _controller is None:
                _controller = WorkerController()
    return _controller


def reset_controller_for_tests() -> None:
    """Drop the singleton. Tests only — module state would otherwise leak
    a running worker between test cases."""
    global _controller
    with _controller_lock:
        _controller = None

"""
Server-specific settings (P3) — session secret and admin credentials.

Layered on top of core.settings (environment profile + runtime paths),
not a replacement for it. Never stores or logs a secret value; only reads
them from the environment.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass

from core.settings import Environment, resolve_environment


class MissingServerSecretError(RuntimeError):
    """A required server secret (session key / admin credentials) is unset."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ServerSettings:
    environment:          Environment
    session_secret:       str
    admin_username:       str
    admin_password_hash:  str
    secure_cookies:       bool   # False only allowed in development, for plain-HTTP local testing


def load_server_settings(env: dict | None = None) -> ServerSettings:
    e = os.environ if env is None else env
    environment = resolve_environment(env)

    session_secret = (e.get("LTT_SESSION_SECRET") or "").strip()
    admin_username = (e.get("LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME") or "").strip()
    admin_password_hash = (e.get("LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH") or "").strip()

    if environment == Environment.DEVELOPMENT:
        # Convenience only: an ephemeral secret so `uvicorn server.app:app
        # --reload` works out of the box locally. Every process restart
        # invalidates all sessions — acceptable for development, and
        # explicitly refused below for the other two profiles so a real
        # deployment can never silently fall back to this.
        session_secret = session_secret or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        admin_username = admin_username or "admin"
        # No default password hash is fabricated — an unset admin hash in
        # development still means "nobody can log in" rather than a known
        # default credential shipping in the codebase.
    else:
        # Q29: admin-env chi la BREAK-GLASS, khong con bat buoc. Admin chinh la
        # user role=admin trong CSDL (H3-admin, tools/create_admin.py). O
        # production LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH thuong RONG => admin-env vo hieu;
        # dat lai qua env khi can cuu ho. Chi SESSION_SECRET la bat buoc o day.
        missing = [
            name for name, value in (
                ("LTT_SESSION_SECRET", session_secret),
            ) if not value
        ]
        if missing:
            raise MissingServerSecretError(
                f"Missing required server secret(s) for environment "
                f"'{environment.value}': {', '.join(missing)}. Set them as "
                "environment variables (see docs/_luutru/PROJECT_MEMORY.md for "
                "names/storage location — never commit the values)."
            )

    secure_cookies = environment != Environment.DEVELOPMENT

    return ServerSettings(
        environment=environment,
        session_secret=session_secret,
        admin_username=admin_username,
        admin_password_hash=admin_password_hash,
        secure_cookies=secure_cookies,
    )

/* Developer playground — talks to /api/v1 exactly the way a customer does.
 *
 * The single design decision worth explaining: this page calls the public API
 * from the browser with a key the developer pastes in, rather than proxying
 * through a portal endpoint that borrows their session.
 *
 * A proxy would have to reconstruct the caller's identity server-side and would
 * become a second way to reach the chargeable path — the one thing the platform
 * rules forbid, and the one place a policy bug costs real money. Pasting a key
 * means the playground *is* the API: same auth, same scopes, same rate limits,
 * same credit ledger, same idempotency. If it works here it works from a
 * server, and if it is refused here it would have been refused there.
 *
 * The key lives in a variable for the lifetime of the tab. It is never written
 * to localStorage, never sent anywhere except the Authorization header of
 * requests to this same origin, and the field is cleared on submit-to-nowhere.
 */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.getElementById("playground");
  if (!root) return;

  var catalog = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("pg-catalog").textContent);
  var state = { tool: null, uploads: {} };

  var els = {
    tool: document.getElementById("pg-tool"),
    key: document.getElementById("pg-key"),
    form: document.getElementById("pg-form"),
    raw: document.getElementById("pg-raw"),
    rawWrap: document.getElementById("pg-raw-wrap"),
    rawToggle: document.getElementById("pg-raw-toggle"),
    quote: document.getElementById("pg-quote"),
    run: document.getElementById("pg-run"),
    out: document.getElementById("pg-out"),
    cost: document.getElementById("pg-cost"),
  };

  function show(message, kind) {
    els.out.textContent = message;
    els.out.className = "pg-out " + (kind || "");
  }

  function append(message) {
    els.out.textContent += "\n" + message;
  }

  function toolByName(name) {
    for (var i = 0; i < catalog.length; i += 1) {
      if (catalog[i].name === name) return catalog[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* Build the form from the published JSON Schema — the same document the
     server validates against, so the form cannot offer a field the API
     rejects or miss one it requires. */
  function renderForm(tool) {
    els.form.innerHTML = "";
    state.uploads = {};
    var required = tool.input_schema.required || [];
    var props = tool.input_schema.properties || {};
    Object.keys(props).forEach(function (name) {
      var spec = props[name];
      var row = document.createElement("p");
      var label = document.createElement("label");
      label.setAttribute("for", "pg-f-" + name);
      label.textContent = name + (required.indexOf(name) >= 0 ? " *" : "");
      row.appendChild(label);
      row.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));

      var field;
      if (spec.enum) {
        field = document.createElement("select");
        if (required.indexOf(name) < 0) {
          field.appendChild(new Option("—", ""));
        }
        spec.enum.forEach(function (value) {
          field.appendChild(new Option(String(value), String(value)));
        });
      } else if (isMedia(spec)) {
        field = document.createElement("input");
        field.type = "file";
        field.dataset.media = "1";
      } else {
        field = document.createElement("input");
        field.type = spec.type === "integer" ? "number" : "text";
        if (spec.minimum !== undefined) field.min = spec.minimum;
        if (spec.maximum !== undefined) field.max = spec.maximum;
        if (spec.maxLength !== undefined) field.maxLength = spec.maxLength;
      }
      field.id = "pg-f-" + name;
      field.name = name;
      if (spec.default !== undefined && field.tagName !== "SELECT") {
        field.value = spec.default;
      } else if (spec.default !== undefined) {
        field.value = String(spec.default);
      } else if (spec.examples && spec.examples.length && !isMedia(spec)) {
        field.value = String(spec.examples[0]);
      }
      row.appendChild(field);

      if (spec.description) {
        var hint = document.createElement("small");
        hint.className = "muted";
        hint.textContent = " " + spec.description;
        row.appendChild(hint);
      }
      els.form.appendChild(row);
    });
    syncRaw();
  }

  function isMedia(spec) {
    return spec.type === "string" &&
      /Upload or artifact id|upload/i.test(spec.description || "");
  }

  function collect() {
    var payload = {};
    var props = (state.tool.input_schema.properties) || {};
    Object.keys(props).forEach(function (name) {
      var field = document.getElementById("pg-f-" + name);
      if (!field) return;
      if (field.dataset && field.dataset.media) {
        if (state.uploads[name]) payload[name] = state.uploads[name];
        return;
      }
      var value = field.value;
      if (value === "" || value === null) return;
      payload[name] = props[name].type === "integer" ? Number(value) : value;
    });
    return payload;
  }

  function syncRaw() {
    if (els.rawWrap.hidden) return;
    els.raw.value = JSON.stringify(collect(), null, 2);
  }

  function currentInput() {
    if (!els.rawWrap.hidden && els.raw.value.trim()) {
      return JSON.parse(els.raw.value);
    }
    return collect();
  }

  function headers(extra) {
    var base = {
      "Authorization": "Bearer " + els.key.value.trim(),
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    };
    Object.keys(extra || {}).forEach(function (k) { base[k] = extra[k]; });
    return base;
  }

  function traceOf(response) {
    /* Only headers a caller is meant to act on. Nothing else is echoed. */
    var safe = ["X-Correlation-ID", "X-LTT-API-Version", "Retry-After",
                "Idempotency-Replayed", "Location"];
    var seen = [];
    safe.forEach(function (name) {
      var value = response.headers.get(name);
      if (value) seen.push(name + ": " + value);
    });
    return seen.join("\n");
  }

  function call(method, path, body, extra) {
    return fetch("/api/v1" + path, {
      method: method,
      headers: headers(extra),
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
    }).then(function (response) {
      return response.json().catch(function () { return {}; })
        .then(function (data) {
          return { ok: response.ok, status: response.status, data: data,
                   trace: traceOf(response) };
        });
    });
  }

  function requireKey() {
    if (!els.key.value.trim()) {
      show(root.dataset.needKey, "err");
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  /* Media inputs go through the real upload flow: ticket, bytes, confirm. */
  function uploadPending() {
    var fields = els.form.querySelectorAll("input[data-media]");
    var chain = Promise.resolve();
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(fields, function (field) {
      if (!field.files || !field.files[0] || state.uploads[field.name]) return;
      var file = field.files[0];
      chain = chain.then(function () {
        return call("POST", "/uploads", {
          tool: state.tool.name, field: field.name,
          filename: file.name, content_type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
          size: file.size,
        }).then(function (result) {
          if (!result.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result.data));
          var id = result.data.id;
          return fetch("/api/v1/uploads/" + id + "/content", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer " + els.key.value.trim(),
                       "Content-Type": file.type || "application/octet-stream" },
            body: file,
          }).then(function () {
            return call("POST", "/uploads/" + id + "/confirm", {});
          }).then(function (confirmed) {
            if (!confirmed.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(confirmed.data));
            state.uploads[field.name] = id;
            append("upload " + field.name + " → " + id);
          });
        });
      });
    });
    return chain;
  }

  function doQuote() {
    if (!requireKey()) return Promise.resolve(null);
    show(root.dataset.working);
    return uploadPending().then(function () {
      return call("POST", "/quotes",
                  { tool: state.tool.name, input: currentInput() });
    }).then(function (result) {
      show(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), result.ok ? "" : "err");
      if (result.trace) append("\n" + result.trace);
      els.cost.textContent = result.ok
        ? root.dataset.costs.replace("{n}", result.data.credit)
        : "";
      return result.ok ? result.data : null;
    }).catch(function (error) {
      show(String(error), "err");
      return null;
    });
  }

  function poll(id, tries) {
    return call("GET", "/jobs/" + id).then(function (result) {
      var status = result.data.status;
      append("… " + status);
      if (status === "queued" || status === "running") {
        if (tries <= 0) return result;
        return new Promise(function (resolve) {
          setTimeout(function () { resolve(poll(id, tries - 1)); }, 2000);
        });
      }
      return result;
    });
  }

  function doRun() {
    if (!requireKey()) return;
    doQuote().then(function (quote) {
      if (!quote) return;
      /* One key per logical call, generated here so a developer cannot forget
         it — and reused if they press Run twice with the same input, which is
         precisely the double-charge this header exists to prevent. */
      var key = state.idempotencyKey || (state.idempotencyKey = uuid());
      append("\nIdempotency-Key: " + key);
      return call("POST", "/jobs",
                  { tool: state.tool.name, quote: quote.quote,
                    input: currentInput() },
                  { "Idempotency-Key": key }).then(function (result) {
        append("\n" + JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2));
        if (result.trace) append("\n" + result.trace);
        if (!result.ok) return;
        return poll(result.data.id, 30).then(function (final) {
          append("\n" + JSON.stringify(final.data, null, 2));
          var outputs = (final.data || {}).outputs || [];
          outputs.forEach(function (artifact) {
            append("artifact " + artifact.id);
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function uuid() {
    if (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID) {
      return window.crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    return "pg-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2);
  }

  els.tool.addEventListener("change", function () {
    state.tool = toolByName(els.tool.value);
    state.idempotencyKey = null;
    els.cost.textContent = "";
    if (state.tool) renderForm(state.tool);
  });
  els.form.addEventListener("input", function () {
    /* Any change is a different call, so the previous key must not be reused:
       reusing it would replay the first answer instead of running the new
       input, and the API would be right to refuse. */
    state.idempotencyKey = null;
    syncRaw();
  });
  els.rawToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
    els.rawWrap.hidden = !els.rawWrap.hidden;
    syncRaw();
  });
  els.quote.addEventListener("click", doQuote);
  els.run.addEventListener("click", doRun);

  state.tool = toolByName(els.tool.value);
  if (state.tool) renderForm(state.tool);
})();

"""Optional Sentry boundary with deny-by-default PII/secret scrubbing."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import os

_DENY = {"authorization", "cookie", "set-cookie", "password", "password_hash",
         "token", "secret", "api_key", "credential", "email", "goal", "prompt",
         "params", "plan", "checkpoint", "request", "body"}
_EMAIL = re.compile(r"(?i)\b[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+\b")


def scrub_event(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): "[Filtered]" if str(key).lower().replace("-", "_") in _DENY
                else scrub_event(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [scrub_event(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return tuple(scrub_event(item) for item in value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return _EMAIL.sub("[Filtered email]", value)[:2000]
    return value


def before_send(event, _hint):
    return scrub_event(event)


def init_sentry(env: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """Enable Sentry only when a DSN exists; never enable default PII collection."""
    source = os.environ if env is None else env
    dsn = str(source.get("LTT_SENTRY_DSN", "")).strip()
    if not dsn:
        return False
    import sentry_sdk
    try:
        sample_rate = float(source.get("LTT_SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE", "0.05"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        sample_rate = 0.05
    sentry_sdk.init(dsn=dsn, before_send=before_send, send_default_pii=False,
                    traces_sample_rate=max(0.0, min(1.0, sample_rate)))
    return True

<script>
/* Đóng dropdown khi bấm ra ngoài/Escape và trả focus về nút mở. */
(function(){
  function closeMenu(d, restoreFocus){
    d.removeAttribute('open');
    if(restoreFocus){var s=d.querySelector(':scope > summary');if(s)s.focus();}
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    document.querySelectorAll('header.hdr details.menu[open]').forEach(function(d){
      if(!d.contains(e.target))closeMenu(d,false);
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key!=='Escape')return;
    var opened=document.querySelector('header.hdr details.menu[open]');
    if(opened){e.preventDefault();closeMenu(opened,true);}
  });
})();
</script>

  <script>(function(){
    var notice=document.getElementById('job-network-state'),delay=2000,maxDelay=30000;
    var timer=0,reloading=false,stopped=false;
    function schedule(wait){clearTimeout(timer);if(!stopped)timer=setTimeout(poll,wait)}
    async function poll(){
      var current=document.getElementById('job-progress');
      if(!current||current.dataset.running!=='true')return;
      try{
        var response=await fetch(current.dataset.pollUrl,{headers:{Accept:'text/html'}});
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error('progress '+response.status);
        var template=document.createElement('template');template.innerHTML=(await response.text()).trim();
        var next=template.content.firstElementChild;if(!next)throw new Error('empty progress');
        current.replaceWith(next);notice.hidden=true;delay=2000;
        if(!reloading&&response.headers.get('X-LTT-Job-Terminal')==='1'){
          reloading=true;location.reload();return;
        }
        if(next.dataset.running==='true')schedule(delay);
      }catch(_error){notice.hidden=false;delay=Math.min(delay*2,maxDelay);schedule(delay)}
    }
    window.addEventListener('online',function(){notice.hidden=true;delay=2000;schedule(0)});
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(!document.hidden){delay=2000;schedule(0)}});
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload',function(){stopped=true;clearTimeout(timer)});
    schedule(delay);
  })();</script>
{% endblock %}

    (function () {
      var sid = {{ session_id | tojson }};
      var url = {{ app.route_prefix | tojson }} + "/phien/" + sid + "/ket-noi";
      var cho = document.getElementById("cho");
      var ok = document.getElementById("san-sang");
      var dong = document.getElementById("da-dong");
      var timer = null;
      function tick() {
        fetch(url, { headers: { "Accept": "application/json" } })
          .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
          .then(function (d) {
            if (d.san_sang) {
              document.getElementById("kn-server").textContent = d.server;
              document.getElementById("kn-id").textContent = d.engine_id;
              document.getElementById("kn-pw").textContent = d.mat_khau;
              cho.style.display = "none"; dong.style.display = "none";
              ok.style.display = "";
              if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
            } else if (d.da_dong) {
              cho.style.display = "none"; ok.style.display = "none";
              dong.style.display = "";
              if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
            }
          })
          .catch(function () { /* mang chop: cu thu lai o nhip sau */ });
      }
      tick();
      timer = setInterval(tick, 2000);
    })();
  </script>

  1. Khung app ở hero là **HTML/CSS**, không phải ảnh chụp. Màn hình app thật có

     nơi nhưng tốn thêm một cú 302 cho người đang đọc bản tiếng Anh (đo thật).

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ _("Console") }} — {{ may.ten or may.id[:8] }}{% endblock %}
{% block topbar_title %}<strong>{{ app.icon }} {{ _("Console") }} — {{ may.ten or may.id[:8] }}</strong>{% endblock %}
{% block content %}

  <p style="margin:0 0 12px;">
    <a href="{{ app.route_prefix }}/{{ may.id }}">&larr; {{ _("Về trang máy") }}</a>
  </p>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="card-accent" style="background:{{ app.accent }};"></div>
    <p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 8px;">
      {{ _("Console dùng khi bạn không vào được bằng RDP — ví dụ vừa đổi tường lửa hoặc cấu hình mạng trong máy. Nó chậm hơn RDP, đừng dùng để làm việc hằng ngày.") }}
    </p>
    <div id="tt" class="muted" style="margin:0 0 8px;">{{ _("Đang kết nối…") }}</div>
    {# `tabindex` để khung nhận được phím; thiếu nó thì chuột chạy mà bàn phím
       không, và triệu chứng là "gõ không lên chữ" — rất khó đoán ra. #}
    <div id="khung" tabindex="0"
         style="width:100%; height:70vh; background:#000; border-radius:6px;
                overflow:hidden; outline:none;"></div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <button class="btn" id="nut-ctrlaltdel" type="button">Ctrl + Alt + Del</button>
      <button class="btn" id="nut-noi-lai" type="button" style="display:none;">
        {{ _("Kết nối lại") }}</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  {# Vé chỉ sống {{ han_ve_giay }} giây và dùng ĐÚNG MỘT LẦN. Nó nằm trong biến
     JS chứ không nằm trên thanh địa chỉ: URL đi vào lịch sử trình duyệt, vào
     ảnh chụp màn hình, và vào log của mọi proxy trên đường. #}
  <script type="module">
    import RFB from "{{ url_for('static', path='vps/novnc/core/rfb.js') }}";

    const khung = document.getElementById("khung");
    const tt = document.getElementById("tt");
    const nutNoiLai = document.getElementById("nut-noi-lai");
    const ve = {{ ve | tojson }};
    const duong = (location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss://" : "ws://")
      + location.host + "{{ app.route_prefix }}/{{ may.id }}/console/ws?ve="
      + encodeURIComponent(ve);

    let rfb = null;

    function bao(chu, loi) {
      tt.textContent = chu;
      tt.className = loi ? "alert alert-err" : "muted";
    }

    function noi() {
      nutNoiLai.style.display = "none";
      bao({{ _("Đang kết nối…") | tojson }}, false);
      // Mật khẩu VNC là vé của Proxmox. Nó chỉ mở được ĐÚNG cổng của phiên
      // này, trên một máy chủ mà khách không biết địa chỉ.
      rfb = new RFB(khung, duong, {
        wsProtocols: ["binary"],
        credentials: { password: {{ vnc_mat_khau | tojson }} },
      });
      rfb.scaleViewport = true;
      // Đừng đổi độ phân giải máy của khách chỉ vì cửa sổ trình duyệt to hay nhỏ.
      rfb.resizeSession = false;
      rfb.addEventListener("connect", () => {
        bao({{ _("Đã kết nối. Bấm vào khung rồi gõ như trên máy thật.") | tojson }}, false);
        khung.focus();
      });
      rfb.addEventListener("disconnect", (e) => {
        // Vé đã tiêu, nên KHÔNG tự nối lại: lần sau phải xin vé mới, tức tải
        // lại trang. Tự nối lại bằng vé cũ chỉ tạo một vòng lặp thất bại im lặng.
        bao(e.detail.clean
          ? {{ _("Đã ngắt kết nối.") | tojson }}
          : {{ _("Mất kết nối. Tải lại trang để mở console mới.") | tojson }}, !e.detail.clean);
        nutNoiLai.style.display = "";
      });
      rfb.addEventListener("securityfailure", () => {
        bao({{ _("Máy chủ từ chối phiên console. Tải lại trang để lấy vé mới.") | tojson }}, true);
      });
    }

    document.getElementById("nut-ctrlaltdel")
      .addEventListener("click", () => rfb && rfb.sendCtrlAltDel());
    nutNoiLai.addEventListener("click", () => location.reload());
    noi();
  </script>

{% endblock %}

    // also re-run the health checks on every tick.
    async function refresh() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/workers/status', {credentials: 'same-origin'});
        if (!r.ok) return;
        const d = await r.json();
        document.getElementById('run-state').textContent =
          d.running ? '🟢 Đang chạy' : '⚪ Đang dừng';
        document.getElementById('log').textContent =
          d.log.map(l => '[' + l.level + '] ' + l.message).join('\n');
      } catch (e) { /* transient network error — next tick retries */ }
    }
    setInterval(refresh, 4000);
  </script>
