class TestReelsUploaderConstruction(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_init_stores_page(self):
        u = _make_reels_uploader()
        self.assertEqual(u.page.id, "1234567890")

    def test_init_stores_config(self):
        cfg = {"graph_api_version": "v20.0"}
        u = _make_reels_uploader(config=cfg)
        self.assertEqual(u.config, cfg)

    def test_init_creates_graph_client(self):
        u = _make_reels_uploader()
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        self.assertIsInstance(u._client, GraphClient)

    def test_on_status_defaults_to_noop(self):
        from core.reels_uploader import ReelsUploader
        from core.token_store import AccountInfo, PageInfo
        from utils.logger import BotLogger

        page = MagicMock(spec=PageInfo)
        page.id = "1"; page.name = "P"; page.access_token = "T"
        account = MagicMock(spec=AccountInfo)
        logger = BotLogger(callback=lambda m, l: None)

        # Should not raise even without on_status/on_progress
        u = ReelsUploader(
            account=account, page=page,
            config={}, stop_event=_make_stop(), logger=logger,
        )
        u.on_status("hello")   # noop, no exception
        u.on_progress(0, 100)  # noop, no exception


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  _start_session()
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestStartSession(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.u = _make_reels_uploader()

    def test_returns_upload_url_and_video_id(self):
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={
            "upload_url": "https://rupload.facebook.com/xyz",
            "video_id": "9876543210",
        })
        url, vid = self.u._start_session({"title": "My Reel", "video_path": "x.mp4"})
        self.assertEqual(url, "https://rupload.facebook.com/xyz")
        self.assertEqual(vid, "9876543210")

    def test_raises_if_upload_url_missing(self):
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={"video_id": "123"})
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            self.u._start_session({"title": "", "video_path": "x.mp4"})

    def test_calls_correct_endpoint(self):
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={
            "upload_url": "https://rupload.fb.com/abc",
            "video_id": "111",
        })
        self.u._start_session({"title": "T", "video_path": "v.mp4"})
        endpoint = self.u._client.post.call_args[0][0]
        self.assertIn("video_reels", endpoint)
        self.assertIn(self.u.page.id, endpoint)

    def test_sends_upload_phase_start(self):
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={
            "upload_url": "https://rupload.fb.com/xyz",
            "video_id": "222",
        })
        self.u._start_session({"title": "T", "video_path": "v.mp4"})
        data = self.u._client.post.call_args[1].get("data") or \
               self.u._client.post.call_args[0][1] if len(self.u._client.post.call_args[0]) > 1 \
               else self.u._client.post.call_args[1].get("data", {})
        # Check via call_args
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        data_sent = kwargs.get("data", {})
        self.assertEqual(data_sent.get("upload_phase"), "start")

    def test_uses_page_access_token(self):
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={
            "upload_url": "https://rupload.fb.com/xyz",
            "video_id": "333",
        })
        self.u._start_session({"title": "T", "video_path": "v.mp4"})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("token"), self.u.page.access_token)

    def test_uses_filename_as_clip_title_when_title_empty(self):
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={
            "upload_url": "https://rupload.fb.com/x",
            "video_id": "444",
        })
        self.u._start_session({"title": "", "video_path": "/tmp/my_video.mp4"})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        data = kwargs.get("data", {})
        self.assertEqual(data.get("clip_title"), "my_video")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  _binary_upload()

class TestBinaryUpload(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.u = _make_reels_uploader()
        self.video_path = _make_video_file(1024)

    def tearDown(self):
        try:
            os.unlink(self.video_path)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _mock_put(self, status_code=200):
        resp = MagicMock()
        resp.status_code = status_code
        resp.text = ""
        session = MagicMock()
        session.put = MagicMock(return_value=resp)
        return session

    def test_put_called_with_correct_url(self):
        import requests
        session = self._mock_put()
        with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
            self.u._binary_upload(self.video_path, 1024, "https://upload.fb.com/x")
        session.put.assert_called()
        url_used = session.put.call_args[0][0]
        self.assertEqual(url_used, "https://upload.fb.com/x")

    def test_put_headers_contain_authorization(self):
        session = self._mock_put()
        with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
            self.u._binary_upload(self.video_path, 1024, "https://upload.fb.com/x")
        headers = session.put.call_args[1].get("headers", {})
        self.assertIn("Authorization", headers)
        self.assertIn("PAGE_TOKEN", headers["Authorization"])

    def test_put_headers_contain_file_size(self):
        session = self._mock_put()
        with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
            self.u._binary_upload(self.video_path, 1024, "https://upload.fb.com/x")
        headers = session.put.call_args[1].get("headers", {})
        self.assertEqual(headers.get("file_size"), "1024")

    def test_put_headers_first_chunk_offset_zero(self):
        session = self._mock_put()
        with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
            self.u._binary_upload(self.video_path, 1024, "https://upload.fb.com/x")
        # First call (only one chunk for 1024-byte file)
        headers = session.put.call_args_list[0][1].get("headers", {})
        self.assertEqual(headers.get("offset"), "0")

    def test_put_headers_content_type_octet_stream(self):
        session = self._mock_put()
        with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
            self.u._binary_upload(self.video_path, 1024, "https://upload.fb.com/x")
        headers = session.put.call_args[1].get("headers", {})
        self.assertEqual(headers.get("Content-Type"), "application/octet-stream")

    def test_raises_on_http_error(self):
        session = self._mock_put(status_code=500)
        with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                self.u._binary_upload(self.video_path, 1024, "https://upload.fb.com/x")

    def test_multiple_chunks_for_large_file(self):
        """File larger than _CHUNK_SIZE should produce multiple PUT calls."""
        from core.reels_uploader import _CHUNK_SIZE
        large_path = _make_video_file(_CHUNK_SIZE + 1)
        try:
            session = self._mock_put()
            with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
                self.u._binary_upload(large_path, _CHUNK_SIZE + 1, "https://upload.fb.com/x")
            self.assertEqual(session.put.call_count, 2)
        finally:
            os.unlink(large_path)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  _finish_session()
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestFinishSession(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.u = _make_reels_uploader()
        self.u._client.post = MagicMock(return_value={"success": True})

    def test_sends_finish_phase(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID123", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("data", {}).get("upload_phase"), "finish")

    def test_sends_video_id(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID456", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("data", {}).get("video_id"), "VID456")

    def test_published_state_when_no_schedule(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("data", {}).get("video_state"), "PUBLISHED")

    def test_scheduled_state_for_future_schedule(self):
        future = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
                               time.localtime(time.time() + 3600))
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": future})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        data = kwargs.get("data", {})
        self.assertEqual(data.get("video_state"), "SCHEDULED")
        self.assertIn("scheduled_publish_time", data)

    def test_published_state_for_past_schedule(self):
        past = "2020-01-01 00:00:00"
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": past})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("data", {}).get("video_state"), "PUBLISHED")

    def test_description_included_when_provided(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {
            "description": "My Reel description",
            "keywords": "",
            "schedule": "",
        })
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertIn("My Reel description", kwargs.get("data", {}).get("description", ""))

    def test_keywords_appended_to_description(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {
            "description": "Desc",
            "keywords": "tag1 tag2",
            "schedule": "",
        })
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        desc = kwargs.get("data", {}).get("description", "")
        self.assertIn("tag1", desc)

    def test_no_description_field_when_empty(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertNotIn("description", kwargs.get("data", {}))

    def test_uses_page_access_token(self):
        self.u._finish_session("VID", {"description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
        kwargs = self.u._client.post.call_args[1]
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("token"), self.u.page.access_token)

class TestReelsUploaderUpload(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_uploader_with_mocked_phases(self):
        u = _make_reels_uploader()
        u._start_session = MagicMock(return_value=("https://rupload.fb.com/xyz", "VID999"))
        u._binary_upload = MagicMock()
        u._finish_session = MagicMock()
        return u

    def test_upload_returns_tuple(self):
        u = self._make_uploader_with_mocked_phases()
        video = _make_video_file(512)
        try:
            result = u.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T",
                               "description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
            self.assertIsInstance(result, tuple)
            self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_upload_video_url_contains_page_and_video_id(self):
        u = self._make_uploader_with_mocked_phases()
        video = _make_video_file(512)
        try:
            url, vid = u.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T",
                                  "description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
            self.assertIn("1234567890", url)   # page.id
            self.assertIn("VID999", url)       # video_id from start_session
            self.assertEqual(vid, "VID999")
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_upload_raises_file_not_found(self):
        u = self._make_uploader_with_mocked_phases()
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
            u.upload({"video_path": "/nonexistent/path/video.mp4",
                      "title": "", "description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})

    def test_upload_raises_value_error_for_empty_file(self):
        u = self._make_uploader_with_mocked_phases()
        empty = _make_video_file(0)
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                u.upload({"video_path": empty, "title": "",
                           "description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
        finally:
            os.unlink(empty)

    def test_upload_calls_all_three_phases(self):
        u = self._make_uploader_with_mocked_phases()
        video = _make_video_file(512)
        try:
            u.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T",
                      "description": "", "keywords": "", "schedule": ""})
            u._start_session.assert_called_once()
            u._binary_upload.assert_called_once()
            u._finish_session.assert_called_once()
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_upload_passes_task_to_finish_session(self):
        u = self._make_uploader_with_mocked_phases()
        video = _make_video_file(256)
        task = {"video_path": video, "title": "T", "description": "D",
                "keywords": "kw", "schedule": ""}
        try:
            u.upload(task)
            finish_args = u._finish_session.call_args[0]
            # finish_session(video_id, task)
            self.assertEqual(finish_args[0], "VID999")
            self.assertEqual(finish_args[1], task)
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

def _make_engine():
    from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
    config = {
        "graph_api_version": "v21.0",
        "temp_video_dir": "temp_videos",
        "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
        "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
        "fb_comment_enabled": True,
    }
    return UploadEngine(
        config=config,
        stop_event=_make_stop(),
        on_log=lambda m, l: None,
        on_status=lambda m: None,
        on_result=lambda task, status, link: None,
        on_done=lambda: None,
        on_error=lambda m: None,
    )


def _make_account_page():
    from core.token_store import AccountInfo, PageInfo
    account = MagicMock(spec=AccountInfo)
    account.is_token_valid.return_value = True

    page = MagicMock(spec=PageInfo)
    page.id = "1234567890"
    page.name = "TestPage"
    page.access_token = "TOKEN"
    return account, page


class TestUploadEngineRouting(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_reels_post_type_uses_reels_uploader(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.reels_uploader.ReelsUploader") as MockReels, \
             patch("core.graph_uploader.GraphUploader"):
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/X", "X")
            MockReels.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"post_type": "reels", "comment": ""}
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            MockReels.assert_called_once()

    def test_feed_post_type_uses_graph_uploader(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.graph_uploader.GraphUploader") as MockGraph, \
             patch("core.reels_uploader.ReelsUploader"):
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/Y", "Y")
            MockGraph.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"post_type": "feed", "comment": ""}
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            MockGraph.assert_called_once()

    def test_empty_post_type_defaults_to_graph_uploader(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.graph_uploader.GraphUploader") as MockGraph, \
             patch("core.reels_uploader.ReelsUploader"):
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/Z", "Z")
            MockGraph.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"comment": ""}   # no post_type key
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            MockGraph.assert_called_once()

    def test_reels_does_not_post_comment(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.reels_uploader.ReelsUploader") as MockReels:
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/R", "R")
            MockReels.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"post_type": "reels", "comment": "Hello World"}
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            # post_comment should NOT be called on a ReelsUploader
            mock_instance.post_comment.assert_not_called()

    def test_feed_posts_comment_when_provided(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.graph_uploader.GraphUploader") as MockGraph:
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/F", "F")
            MockGraph.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"post_type": "feed", "comment": "Test comment"}
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            mock_instance.post_comment.assert_called_once_with("F", "Test comment")

    def test_feed_does_not_post_empty_comment(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.graph_uploader.GraphUploader") as MockGraph:
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/G", "G")
            MockGraph.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"post_type": "feed", "comment": ""}
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            mock_instance.post_comment.assert_not_called()

    def test_run_api_returns_tuple(self):
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.graph_uploader.GraphUploader") as MockGraph:
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/H", "H")
            MockGraph.return_value = mock_instance

            result = engine._run_api({"post_type": "feed", "comment": ""}, account, page)
            self.assertIsInstance(result, tuple)
            self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
            self.assertEqual(result[0], "https://fb.com/v/H")
            self.assertEqual(result[1], "H")

    def test_reels_uppercase_normalized(self):
        """'REELS' should still route to ReelsUploader."""
        engine = _make_engine()
        account, page = _make_account_page()

        with patch("core.reels_uploader.ReelsUploader") as MockReels:
            mock_instance = MagicMock()
            mock_instance.upload.return_value = ("https://fb.com/v/RL", "RL")
            MockReels.return_value = mock_instance

            task = {"post_type": "REELS", "comment": ""}
            engine._run_api(task, account, page)

            MockReels.assert_called_once()

# 8.  get_next_pending_row() — post_type field

class TestSheetClientPostType(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_client(self, header, col_post_type_name="post_type"):
        from utils.sheet_client import SheetClient
        cfg = {
            "sheet_id": "SID",
            "sheet_tab": "Tab1",
            "col_status": "status",
            "col_video_drive": "video",
            "col_post_type": col_post_type_name,
            "col_schedule_time": "schedule_time",
        }
        client = SheetClient(cfg)
        client._header_map = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(header)}
        client._current_tab = "Tab1"
        client._refresh_header_map = MagicMock()
        client._get_tz = MagicMock(
            return_value=__import__("zoneinfo").ZoneInfo("UTC")
        )
        return client

    @staticmethod
    def _due():
        from datetime import datetime, timezone
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

    def test_post_type_defaults_to_feed_when_col_absent(self):
        """If col_post_type column doesn't exist in header, default = 'feed'."""
        client = self._make_client(
            ["status", "video", "schedule_time"]
        )   # no post_type column
        rows = [["", "https://drive.google.com/X", self._due()]]
        client._retry = MagicMock(return_value={"values": rows})

        task = client.get_next_pending_row()
        self.assertIsNotNone(task)
        self.assertEqual(task.get("post_type"), "feed")

    def test_post_type_read_from_column(self):
        """When col_post_type column exists and has 'reels', task should have 'reels'."""
        client = self._make_client(
            ["status", "video", "post_type", "schedule_time"]
        )
        rows = [["", "https://drive.google.com/X", "reels", self._due()]]
        client._retry = MagicMock(return_value={"values": rows})

        task = client.get_next_pending_row()
        self.assertIsNotNone(task)
        self.assertEqual(task.get("post_type"), "reels")

    def test_post_type_feed_from_column(self):
        """When col_post_type column has 'feed', task should have 'feed'."""
        client = self._make_client(
            ["status", "video", "post_type", "schedule_time"]
        )
        rows = [["", "https://drive.google.com/X", "feed", self._due()]]
        client._retry = MagicMock(return_value={"values": rows})

        task = client.get_next_pending_row()
        self.assertIsNotNone(task)
        self.assertEqual(task.get("post_type"), "feed")

    def test_empty_post_type_column_defaults_to_feed(self):
        """When col_post_type column exists but cell is blank, default = 'feed'."""
        client = self._make_client(
            ["status", "video", "post_type", "schedule_time"]
        )
        rows = [["", "https://drive.google.com/X", "", self._due()]]
        client._retry = MagicMock(return_value={"values": rows})

        task = client.get_next_pending_row()
        self.assertIsNotNone(task)
        self.assertEqual(task.get("post_type"), "feed")

    def test_post_type_in_returned_task_dict(self):
        """post_type is always present in the returned task dict."""
        client = self._make_client(["status", "video", "schedule_time"])
        rows = [["", "https://drive.google.com/X", self._due()]]
        client._retry = MagicMock(return_value={"values": rows})

        task = client.get_next_pending_row()
        self.assertIn("post_type", task)

    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _read(relative: str) -> str:
    return (ROOT / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_my_apps_dung_toan_bo_lich_su_khong_chi_nam_job_gan_nhat(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    url = f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'home-ia.db').as_posix()}"
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL", url)

    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    from platform_core.models import Job
    from platform_core.users import tao_nguoi_dung
    from server.routes.dashboard import _workspace_data

    dbmod.reset_engine()
    dbmod.Base.metadata.create_all(dbmod.get_engine())
    gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        user = tao_nguoi_dung(
            db, email="home-ia@example.com", password="matkhau-tot-12",
            is_verified=True,
        )
        old = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        db.add(Job(
            user_id=user.id, app_slug="taoanh", job_type="taoanh.generate",
            created_at=old,
        ))
        for offset in range(1, 6):
            db.add(Job(
                user_id=user.id, app_slug="thumbnail",
                job_type="thumbnail.generate",
                created_at=old + timedelta(days=offset),
            ))
        db.commit()
        visible = [
            SimpleNamespace(manifest=SimpleNamespace(
                slug="taoanh", display_name="Tạo ảnh", icon="A")),
            SimpleNamespace(manifest=SimpleNamespace(
                slug="thumbnail", display_name="Thumbnail", icon="T")),
        ]

        result = _workspace_data(visible, user)

        assert len(result["recent"]) == 5
        assert {job.app_slug for job in result["recent"]} == {"thumbnail"}
        assert result["used_slugs"] == {"taoanh", "thumbnail"}
    finally:
        try:
            next(gen)
        except StopIteration:
            pass
        dbmod.reset_engine()


def test_global_navigation_khong_con_link_gia():
    home = _read("server/templates/home.html")

    assert "> Agent Canvas</a>" in home
    assert 'href="/agent/canvas"><span aria-hidden="true">▱</span> Templates' not in home
    # H24: chu gio di qua catalog dich nen khong chot mat chu tho nua. Van chot
    # DIEU test nay sinh ra de chot: ba muc chua phat hanh phai bi vo hieu hoa
    # va co giai thich, chu khong phai link song dan toi trang trong.
    assert "_('Thư viện mẫu toàn nền tảng chưa được phát hành')" in home
    assert "_('Kho tài nguyên cá nhân chưa được phát hành')" in home
    assert home.count('class="market-deferred" disabled aria-disabled="true"') == 3

"""H15.S4 TV-FEAT-001 — asset lịch sử owner-scoped và validation."""

import asyncio
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from starlette.datastructures import Headers, UploadFile


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class _Storage:
    def __init__(self):
        self.files = {}

    def put(self, key, stream, content_type="application/octet-stream"):
        self.files[key] = (stream.read(), content_type)

    def exists(self, key):
        return key in self.files

    def size(self, key):
        return len(self.files[key][0])

    def open(self, key):
        return io.BytesIO(self.files[key][0])

    def delete(self, key):
        self.files.pop(key, None)


def _upload(name: str, content_type: str,
            data: bytes = b"\x00\x00\x00\x18ftypisommedia") -> UploadFile:
    return UploadFile(io.BytesIO(data), filename=name,
                      headers=Headers({"content-type": content_type}))


def test_upload_ref_luu_metadata_va_chuan_hoa_role(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from apps.taovideo.routes import _luu_refs
    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    import platform_core.storage as storage_module
    from tests.conftest import bao_dam_user
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL",
                       f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'stage-ref.db').as_posix()}")
    dbmod.reset_engine(); dbmod.Base.metadata.create_all(dbmod.get_engine())
    gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
    bao_dam_user(db, "u1"); db.commit(); db.close()
    storage = _Storage()
    monkeypatch.setattr(storage_module, "get_storage", lambda: storage)
    try:
        refs = asyncio.run(_luu_refs(
            "u1", [_upload(r"C:\fake\clip.mp4", "video/mp4")],
            ["first_frame"], ["hero"],
        ))

        assert len(refs) == 1

        assert refs[0]["role"] == "reference_video"
        assert refs[0]["name"] == "clip.mp4"
        assert refs[0]["content_type"] == "video/mp4"
        assert refs[0]["size"] == 17
        assert refs[0]["storage_key"].startswith("staging/u1/taovideo/")
        assert refs[0]["upload_id"]
    finally:
        dbmod.reset_engine()


def test_upload_ref_tu_choi_mime_va_qua_bon_file(monkeypatch):

def test_saved_asset_chi_resolve_tu_lich_su_dung_owner(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'assets.db').as_posix()}")
    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    import platform_core.storage as storage_module
    from apps.taovideo.routes import _saved_refs_for_user
    from platform_core.models import Job
    from platform_core.users import tao_nguoi_dung

    dbmod.reset_engine(); dbmod.Base.metadata.create_all(dbmod.get_engine())
    gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
    storage = _Storage()
    try:
        mine = tao_nguoi_dung(db, email="asset-mine@example.com",
                              password="matkhau-tot-12", is_verified=True)
        other = tao_nguoi_dung(db, email="asset-other@example.com",
                               password="matkhau-tot-12", is_verified=True)
        mine_key = f"taovideo/{mine.id}/refs/mine"
        other_key = f"taovideo/{other.id}/refs/other"
        storage.files[mine_key] = (b"mine", "image/png")
        storage.files[other_key] = (b"other", "image/png")
        db.add_all([
            Job(user_id=mine.id, app_slug="taovideo", job_type="taovideo.generate",
                params={"refs": [{"storage_key": mine_key, "kind": "image",
                                  "role": "first_frame", "handle": "hero"}]}),
            Job(user_id=other.id, app_slug="taovideo", job_type="taovideo.generate",
                params={"refs": [{"storage_key": other_key, "kind": "image"}]}),
        ])
        db.commit(); monkeypatch.setattr(storage_module, "get_storage", lambda: storage)

        assert _saved_refs_for_user(mine.id, [mine_key])[0]["role"] == "first_frame"
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="không hợp lệ"):
            _saved_refs_for_user(mine.id, [other_key])
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass
        dbmod.reset_engine()

"""Regression cho benchmark/capability gate UP-FEAT-001."""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "benchmark_upscale_ai_detail", ROOT / "tools" / "benchmark_upscale_ai_detail.py")
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
BENCH = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(BENCH)


def test_degradation_matrix_is_deterministic_and_distinct():
    array = np.tile(np.arange(64, dtype=np.uint8), (64, 1))
    source = Image.fromarray(np.stack((array, array, array), axis=2), "RGB")
    bicubic = np.asarray(BENCH._degrade(source, "bicubic", 1))
    blur = np.asarray(BENCH._degrade(source, "blur", 1))
    noise_a = np.asarray(BENCH._degrade(source, "noise", 20260803))
    noise_b = np.asarray(BENCH._degrade(source, "noise", 20260803))
    assert bicubic.shape == (16, 16, 3)
    assert not np.array_equal(bicubic, blur)
    assert not np.array_equal(bicubic, noise_a)
    assert np.array_equal(noise_a, noise_b)


def test_wdn_presence_does_not_fake_adjustable_denoise_feature():
    gates = BENCH._feature_gates([
        "realesr-general-x4v3", "realesr-general-wdn-x4v3", "realesrgan-x4plus"])
    assert gates["ai_detail"]["status"] == "DEFER"
    assert gates["denoise"]["status"] == "DEFER"
    assert "no adjustable -dn/DNI control" in gates["denoise"]["reason"]
    assert gates["deblur"]["status"] == "DEFER"


def test_benchmark_inventory_requires_complete_model_pair(tmp_path):
    models = tmp_path / "models"
    models.mkdir()
    (models / "realesr-general-x4v3.param").write_text("p", encoding="ascii")
    assert BENCH._installed_models(tmp_path) == []
    (models / "realesr-general-x4v3.bin").write_bytes(b"b")
    assert BENCH._installed_models(tmp_path) == ["realesr-general-x4v3"]

"""
test_11_upgrades.py — P0 through P4 quality fixes verification

P0 (Critical K-8 bugs):
  - upload_task forwards post_type to engine
  - upload_task forwards schedule to engine
  - upload_task forwards comment to engine
  - SheetRunner does NOT call _post_comment_safe separately after upload

P1 (Quality fixes):
  - notify_batch_done called when all workers stop (ConcurrentRunner)
  - TelegramNotifier uses single sender thread (queue-based)
  - TelegramNotifier queue drops silently when full (no RuntimeError)
  - uploaded_at respects configured timezone (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh != UTC)
  - duration_s uses metrics delta when rate-limiter data is available

P2 (Robustness):
  - Retry state persisted to JSON after scheduling
  - Retry state loaded on SheetRunner init
  - Stale retry state (>1h old) discarded on load
  - _get_retry_delay() has jitter (not exactly base value)
  - jitter stays within ±10% of base
  - Reset metrics clears global registry
  - _pick_tag() cycles W7→worker_1, W8→worker_2 …
  - _severity_prefix() returns red icon for error worker log

P3 (Reliability):
  - ReelsUploader binary upload retries on HTTP 500 (max 3 times)
  - ReelsUploader succeeds on 3rd attempt after 2 failures
  - ConcurrentRunner restarts worker after crash (up to max_restarts)
  - ConcurrentRunner permanent error after max_restarts exceeded
  - _escape_md2() escapes MarkdownV2 special characters
  - notify_job_error uses MarkdownV2 (not legacy Markdown)

P4 (K-7 Video Insights):
  - get_video_insights() returns expected keys
  - InsightsFetcher._parse_dt() parses various datetime formats
  - InsightsFetcher._find_pending_rows() skips rows with insights_at set
  - InsightsFetcher._find_pending_rows() skips rows uploaded < 24h ago
  - InsightsFetcher._find_pending_rows() skips rows without fb_video_id

class TestP0UploadTaskForwarding(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify SheetRunner._tick() forwards post_type, schedule, comment."""

    def _make_runner(self):
        from core.sheet_runner import SheetRunner
        config = {
            "job_delay_seconds": 0,
            "delete_video_after_upload": False,
            "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
            "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
            "max_retries": 3,
            "timezone": "UTC",
        }
        r = SheetRunner(config=config, page_name="P", sheet_tab="T",
                        stop_event=threading.Event())
        r._sheet = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.get_next_pending_row.return_value = {
            "row_idx":     10,
            "video_url":   "https://drive.google.com/file/d/X/view",
            "title":       "My Video",
            "description": "Desc",
            "keywords":    "kw",
            "thumbnail_url": "",
            "comment":     "Hello!",
            "target_page": "",
            "schedule":    "2027-01-01 12:00:00",
            "post_type":   "reels",
        }
        r._sheet.mark_done = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.mark_running = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.mark_error = MagicMock()
        # Temp video
        self._tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        self._tmp.write(b"v" * 100)
        self._tmp.close()
        r._downloader = MagicMock()
        r._downloader.download.return_value = self._tmp.name
        return r

    def tearDown(self):
        try:
            os.unlink(self._tmp.name)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _run_tick_capture_upload_task(self):
        """Run _tick(), capture what upload_task was passed to UploadEngine."""
        captured = {}
        r = self._make_runner()

        from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
        orig_init = UploadEngine.__init__
        orig_run_sync = UploadEngine.run_sync

        def mock_run_sync(self_engine, task):
            captured["task"] = dict(task)
            return ("https://fb.com/v/1", "1")

        with patch.object(UploadEngine, "run_sync", mock_run_sync):
            r._tick()

        return captured.get("task", {})

    def test_post_type_forwarded(self):
        task = self._run_tick_capture_upload_task()
        self.assertEqual(task.get("post_type"), "reels")

    def test_schedule_forwarded(self):
        task = self._run_tick_capture_upload_task()
        self.assertEqual(task.get("schedule"), "2027-01-01 12:00:00")

    def test_comment_forwarded(self):
        """Verify sheet_runner forwards 'comment' field through the pipeline.

        Updated contract (after FacebookCommenter introduction):
        - sheet_runner builds upload_task with comment="Hello!"
        - FacebookPublisher receives it intact
        - FacebookPublisher.publish() handles comment via FacebookCommenter
          and clears it BEFORE calling UploadEngine (to avoid double-comment).

        So we now capture at the FacebookPublisher.publish() level instead
        of UploadEngine.run_sync().
        """
        captured = {}
        r = self._make_runner()

        # Patch FacebookPublisher.publish to capture the task it receives
        from core.facebook.publisher_service import FacebookPublisher
        from core.publisher import PublishResult

        def mock_publish(self_pub, task):
            captured["task"] = dict(task)
            return PublishResult(
                success=True, external_post_id="1",
                external_post_url="https://fb.com/v/1", status="published",
            )

        with patch.object(FacebookPublisher, "publish", mock_publish):
            r._tick()

        self.assertEqual(captured["task"].get("comment"), "Hello!")

    def test_default_post_type_is_feed_when_missing(self):
        r = self._make_runner()
        row = r._sheet.get_next_pending_row.return_value
        del row["post_type"]   # row has no post_type
        r._sheet.get_next_pending_row.return_value = row

        captured = {}
        from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine

        def mock_run_sync(self_engine, task):
            captured["task"] = dict(task)
            return ("https://fb.com/v/X", "X")

        with patch.object(UploadEngine, "run_sync", mock_run_sync):
            r._tick()

        self.assertEqual(captured.get("task", {}).get("post_type"), "feed")

    def test_no_separate_post_comment_safe_for_reels(self):
        """_post_comment_safe must NOT be called; engine handles comment."""
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._post_comment_safe = MagicMock()

        from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
        with patch.object(UploadEngine, "run_sync",
                          return_value=("https://fb.com/v/R", "R")):
            r._tick()

        r._post_comment_safe.assert_not_called()

        with patch("utils.notifier.get_notifier") as mock_get:
            mock_notifier = MagicMock()
            mock_notifier.notify_batch_done = mock_notify
            mock_get.return_value = mock_notifier

            runner.start()
            time.sleep(0.5)  # let thread finish

        self.assertTrue(len(notified) >= 0)  # may or may not fire (daemon timing)
        # The important check: the callback is registered
        # We verify by checking _make_on_stopped logic
        cb = runner._make_on_stopped(0)
        # Manually trigger
        runner._stopped_count = len(runner._runners) - 1  # one short
        with patch("utils.notifier.get_notifier") as mock_get2:
            mock_notifier2 = MagicMock()
            mock_get2.return_value = mock_notifier2
            runner._on_all_stopped = MagicMock()
            cb()
        mock_notifier2.notify_batch_done.assert_called_once()


class TestP1TelegramQueue(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_sender_thread_started(self):
        from utils.notifier import TelegramNotifier
        n = TelegramNotifier({"telegram_bot_token": "1:X", "telegram_chat_id": "123"})
        self.assertTrue(n._sender_thread.is_alive())

    def test_queue_is_bounded(self):
        from utils.notifier import TelegramNotifier
        import queue
        n = TelegramNotifier({"telegram_bot_token": "1:X", "telegram_chat_id": "123"})
        self.assertIsInstance(n._queue, queue.Queue)
        self.assertEqual(n._queue.maxsize, 50)

    def test_full_queue_does_not_raise(self):
        """When queue is full, _send_async silently drops the message."""
        from utils.notifier import TelegramNotifier
        n = TelegramNotifier({"telegram_bot_token": "1:X", "telegram_chat_id": "123"})
        # Fill the queue manually
        for _ in range(50):
            try:
                n._queue.put_nowait("x")
            except Exception:
                break
        # Should not raise
        try:
            n._send_async("overflow message")
        except Exception as e:
            self.fail(f"_send_async raised {e} when queue is full")

    def test_disabled_notifier_does_not_enqueue(self):
        from utils.notifier import TelegramNotifier
        n = TelegramNotifier({})  # no token → disabled
        n._send_async("should not enqueue")
        self.assertEqual(n._queue.qsize(), 0)


class TestP1TimezoneUploadedAt(unittest.TestCase):
    """uploaded_at should use configured timezone, not always UTC."""

    def _run_tick_capture_uploaded_at(self, timezone_str):
        from core.sheet_runner import SheetRunner
        config = {
            "job_delay_seconds": 0,
            "delete_video_after_upload": False,
            "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
            "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
            "max_retries": 0,
            "timezone": timezone_str,
        }
        r = SheetRunner(config=config, page_name="P", sheet_tab="T",
                        stop_event=threading.Event())
        r._sheet = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.get_next_pending_row.return_value = {
            "row_idx": 5, "video_url": "https://drive.google.com/X",
            "title": "", "description": "", "keywords": "",
            "thumbnail_url": "", "comment": "", "target_page": "",
            "schedule": "", "post_type": "feed",
        }
        r._sheet.mark_done = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.mark_running = MagicMock()

        tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        tmp.write(b"v" * 10)
        tmp.close()
        r._downloader = MagicMock()
        r._downloader.download.return_value = tmp.name

        from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
        with patch.object(UploadEngine, "run_sync",
                          return_value=("https://fb.com/v/1", "1")):
            r._tick()

        os.unlink(tmp.name)

        call_args = r._sheet.mark_done.call_args
        if call_args is None:
            return None
        kwargs = call_args[1]
        return kwargs.get("uploaded_at", "")

    def test_utc_timezone(self):
        ts = self._run_tick_capture_uploaded_at("UTC")
        self.assertIsNotNone(ts)
        self.assertRegex(ts, r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}")

    def test_hcm_timezone_offset_from_utc(self):
        """Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh is UTC+7 — timestamp should differ from UTC by ~7h."""
        from datetime import datetime, timezone as tz_mod
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

        ts_utc = self._run_tick_capture_uploaded_at("UTC")
        ts_hcm = self._run_tick_capture_uploaded_at("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")

        if ts_utc is None or ts_hcm is None:
            self.skipTest("mark_done not called")

        fmt = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
        dt_utc = datetime.strptime(ts_utc, fmt).replace(tzinfo=tz_mod.utc)
        dt_hcm = datetime.strptime(ts_hcm, fmt)
        # HCM time string represents local time, which is UTC+7
        # So hcm_string hour should be utc_hour + 7 (mod 24)
        diff_h = (dt_hcm.hour - dt_utc.hour) % 24
        self.assertIn(diff_h, (6, 7, 8))  # ±1h for test timing edge cases


class TestP1DurationMetrics(unittest.TestCase):
    """duration_s should use rate-limiter metrics delta when available."""

    def test_duration_uses_metrics_delta_when_available(self):
        """When _delta_upload > 0, it's used instead of wall time."""
        from core.sheet_runner import SheetRunner
        from core.rate_limiter import _GLOBAL_METRICS, _GLOBAL_LOCK, reset_global_metrics
        import core.rate_limiter as rl_module

        reset_global_metrics()

        config = {
            "job_delay_seconds": 0,
            "delete_video_after_upload": False,
            "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
            "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
            "max_retries": 0,
            "timezone": "UTC",
        }
        r = SheetRunner(config=config, page_name="P", sheet_tab="T",
                        stop_event=threading.Event())
        r._sheet = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.get_next_pending_row.return_value = {
            "row_idx": 7, "video_url": "https://drive.google.com/X",
            "title": "", "description": "", "keywords": "",
            "thumbnail_url": "", "comment": "", "target_page": "TestPage",
            "schedule": "", "post_type": "feed",
        }
        r._sheet.mark_done = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.mark_running = MagicMock()

        tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        tmp.write(b"v" * 10)
        tmp.close()
        r._downloader = MagicMock()
        r._downloader.download.return_value = tmp.name

        # Simulate rate-limiter writing 42.5s of upload time into global metrics
        def fake_run_sync(self_engine, task):
            with _GLOBAL_LOCK:
                _GLOBAL_METRICS["TestPage"] = {
                    "uploads_done": 1,
                    "total_upload_s": 42.5,
                    "avg_wait_s": 0.0,
                    "total_wait_s": 0.0,
                }
            return ("https://fb.com/v/Z", "Z")

        from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
        with patch.object(UploadEngine, "run_sync", fake_run_sync):
            r._tick()

        os.unlink(tmp.name)
        reset_global_metrics()

        call_args = r._sheet.mark_done.call_args
        if call_args is None:
            self.skipTest("mark_done not called")
        duration_s = call_args[1].get("duration_s", -1)
        # Should be ~42.5 (from metrics delta), not wall time (which would be <1s)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(duration_s, 42.5, delta=5.0)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# P2 — Robustness: retry state persistence + jitter + dual-tag + reset
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TestP2RetryStatePersistence(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()

    def tearDown(self):
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(self._tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def _make_runner(self, tab="TestTab"):
        from core.sheet_runner import SheetRunner
        config = {
            "job_delay_seconds": 0,
            "delete_video_after_upload": False,
            "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
            "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
            "max_retries": 3,
        }
        r = SheetRunner(config=config, page_name="P", sheet_tab=tab,
                        stop_event=threading.Event())
        # Override retry state path to use temp dir
        r._retry_state_path = os.path.join(self._tmp_dir, f"retry_{tab}.json")
        r._sheet = MagicMock()
        return r

    def test_save_creates_json_file(self):
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._retry_attempt = {5: 1}
        r._retry_ready   = {5: time.time() + 300}
        r._save_retry_state()
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(r._retry_state_path))

    def test_loaded_attempt_matches_saved(self):
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._retry_attempt = {10: 2, 15: 1}
        r._retry_ready   = {10: time.time() + 600, 15: time.time() + 300}
        r._save_retry_state()

        r2 = self._make_runner()
        r2._retry_state_path = r._retry_state_path
        r2._load_retry_state()
        self.assertEqual(r2._retry_attempt.get(10), 2)
        self.assertEqual(r2._retry_attempt.get(15), 1)

    def test_stale_ready_entries_discarded(self):
        """Entries with ready_time < now - 3600 are dropped on load."""
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._retry_attempt = {20: 1}
        r._retry_ready   = {20: time.time() - 7200}  # 2h ago → stale
        r._save_retry_state()

        r2 = self._make_runner()
        r2._retry_state_path = r._retry_state_path
        r2._load_retry_state()
        self.assertNotIn(20, r2._retry_ready)

    def test_fresh_entries_preserved_on_load(self):
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._retry_attempt = {30: 2}
        r._retry_ready   = {30: time.time() + 900}  # future → fresh
        r._save_retry_state()

        r2 = self._make_runner()
        r2._retry_state_path = r._retry_state_path
        r2._load_retry_state()
        self.assertIn(30, r2._retry_ready)

    def test_save_called_after_retry_schedule(self):
        """After _tick() schedules a retry, the JSON file must exist."""
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._sheet.get_next_pending_row.return_value = {
            "row_idx": 10, "video_url": "https://drive.google.com/X",
            "title": "", "description": "", "keywords": "",
            "thumbnail_url": "", "comment": "", "target_page": "",
            "schedule": "", "post_type": "feed",
        }
        r._sheet.mark_retry = MagicMock()
        r._sheet.mark_running = MagicMock()

        tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        tmp.write(b"v" * 10)
        tmp.close()
        r._downloader = MagicMock()
        r._downloader.download.return_value = tmp.name

        from core.upload_engine import UploadEngine
        with patch.object(UploadEngine, "run_sync",
                          side_effect=ConnectionError("network error")):
            r._tick()

        os.unlink(tmp.name)
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(r._retry_state_path))


class TestP2RetryJitter(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_runner(self):
        from core.sheet_runner import SheetRunner
        return SheetRunner(
            config={"max_retries": 3, "job_delay_seconds": 0,
                    "delete_video_after_upload": False,
                    "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
                    "min_interval_per_page_s": 0},
            page_name="P", sheet_tab="T", stop_event=threading.Event(),
        )

    def test_delay_is_not_exactly_base_value(self):
        """With jitter, no two successive delays should be identical (probabilistic)."""
        r = self._make_runner()
        delays = [r._get_retry_delay(1) for _ in range(20)]
        unique = set(round(d, 4) for d in delays)
        # With random jitter, very unlikely all 20 are identical
        self.assertGreater(len(unique), 1)

    def test_delay_within_10_percent_of_base(self):
        r = self._make_runner()
        base_delay_1 = 300.0
        for _ in range(30):
            d = r._get_retry_delay(1)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(d, base_delay_1 * 0.9 - 1)  # -1 for float rounding
            self.assertLessEqual(d,    base_delay_1 * 1.1 + 1)

    def test_delay_minimum_is_10s(self):
        """Even with full negative jitter, delay stays >= 10s."""
        r = self._make_runner()
        r._retry_delays = [10]   # base 10s
        for _ in range(30):
            d = r._get_retry_delay(1)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(d, 10.0)


class TestP2DualTagWorkerLog(unittest.TestCase):
    """Worker log lines must still show severity.

    A `[W3] Lỗi ...` line is coloured by worker, not by level, so without an
    explicit marker an error is indistinguishable from routine chatter. This
    was gui/result_tabs.py::_severity_prefix; on the web it is
    ui_constants.severity_prefix, applied in monitor_service.collect_logs.
    """

    def _colour(self, message, level="info"):
        from server.services.ui_constants import log_colour
        return log_colour(level, message)

    def _worker_colour(self, n):
        from server.services.ui_constants import WORKER_LOG_COLORS
        return WORKER_LOG_COLORS[(n - 1) % len(WORKER_LOG_COLORS)]

    def test_colour_cycles_for_w7(self):
        # W7 wraps back to the first colour.
        self.assertEqual(self._colour("[W7] some message"), self._worker_colour(1))

    def test_colour_cycles_for_w12(self):
        # (12-1)%6 = 5 → the 6th colour.
        self.assertEqual(self._colour("[W12] msg"), self._worker_colour(6))

    def test_severity_prefix_error(self):
        from server.services.ui_constants import severity_prefix
        self.assertIn("✖", severity_prefix("error"))

    def test_severity_prefix_warning(self):
        from server.services.ui_constants import severity_prefix
        self.assertIn("⚠", severity_prefix("warning"))
        self.assertIn("⚠", severity_prefix("warn"))

    def test_severity_prefix_empty_for_info(self):
        from server.services.ui_constants import severity_prefix
        self.assertEqual(severity_prefix("info"), "")

    def test_severity_prefix_empty_for_success(self):
        from server.services.ui_constants import severity_prefix
        self.assertEqual(severity_prefix("success"), "")

    def test_worker_error_line_gets_the_marker_and_keeps_its_colour(self):
        """The regression that matters: prefixing must not push "[W3]" off the
        start of the string, or the per-worker colour is silently lost."""
        import sys
        import types

        from server.services import monitor_service

        fake = types.ModuleType("fake")
        fake.get_recent_logs = lambda n: [
            {"level": "error", "formatted": "[W3] Lỗi upload"}]
        real = sys.modules.get("utils.logger")
        sys.modules["utils.logger"] = fake
        try:
            row = monitor_service.collect_logs()[0]
        finally:
            if real is not None:
                sys.modules["utils.logger"] = real
            else:
                del sys.modules["utils.logger"]

        self.assertTrue(row["message"].startswith("✖ "))
        self.assertEqual(row["colour"], self._worker_colour(3))

    def test_non_worker_line_gets_no_marker(self):
        import sys
        import types

        from server.services import monitor_service

        fake = types.ModuleType("fake")
        fake.get_recent_logs = lambda n: [
            {"level": "error", "formatted": "Lỗi kết nối sheet"}]
        real = sys.modules.get("utils.logger")
        sys.modules["utils.logger"] = fake
        try:
            row = monitor_service.collect_logs()[0]
        finally:
            if real is not None:
                sys.modules["utils.logger"] = real
            else:
                del sys.modules["utils.logger"]

        self.assertEqual(row["message"], "Lỗi kết nối sheet")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# P3 — Reliability: chunk retry, auto-restart, MarkdownV2
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TestP3ReelsBinaryUploadRetry(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_uploader(self):
        from core.reels_uploader import ReelsUploader
        from core.token_store import AccountInfo, PageInfo
        from utils.logger import BotLogger

        page = MagicMock(spec=PageInfo)
        page.id = "111"; page.name = "P"; page.access_token = "T"
        account = MagicMock(spec=AccountInfo)
        logger = BotLogger(callback=lambda m, l: None)

        return ReelsUploader(
            account=account, page=page, config={},
            stop_event=threading.Event(), logger=logger,
        )

    def _make_video(self, size=512):
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        f.write(b"X" * size)
        f.close()
        return f.name

    def test_retries_on_http_500_then_succeeds(self):
        """Should retry and succeed on the 3rd attempt."""
        u = self._make_uploader()
        video = self._make_video()
        try:
            call_count = [0]

            def mock_put(*args, **kwargs):
                call_count[0] += 1
                resp = MagicMock()
                resp.status_code = 500 if call_count[0] < 3 else 200
                resp.text = "server error"
                return resp

            session = MagicMock()
            session.put = mock_put
            session.headers = {}

            with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
                u._binary_upload(video, 512, "https://upload.fb.com/x")

            self.assertEqual(call_count[0], 3)
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_raises_after_all_retries_fail(self):
        """After 3 failures, RuntimeError must be raised."""
        u = self._make_uploader()
        video = self._make_video()
        try:
            resp = MagicMock()
            resp.status_code = 503
            resp.text = "service unavailable"

            session = MagicMock()
            session.put = MagicMock(return_value=resp)
            session.headers = {}

            with patch("requests.Session", return_value=session):
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                    u._binary_upload(video, 512, "https://upload.fb.com/x")

            self.assertEqual(session.put.call_count, 3)
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)


class TestP3WorkerAutoRestart(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_worker_restarts_once_on_crash(self):
        from core.concurrent_runner import ConcurrentRunner

        crash_count = [0]
        run_calls   = [0]
        done_event  = threading.Event()

        def flaky_run():
            run_calls[0] += 1
            if crash_count[0] < 1:
                crash_count[0] += 1
                raise RuntimeError("transient crash")
            # Second call: return normally — signal that we're done
            done_event.set()

        config = {
            "job_delay_seconds": 0,
            "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
            "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
            "worker_max_restarts": 1,
        }
        runner = ConcurrentRunner(
            workers=[{"tab": "T1", "page": "P1"}],
            config=config,
        )
        runner._runners[0].run = flaky_run

        # Patch time.sleep to make restart-delay instant; use Event to wait
        with patch("core.concurrent_runner.time.sleep"):
            runner.start()
            done_event.wait(timeout=3.0)

        self.assertGreaterEqual(run_calls[0], 2)   # ran at least twice (crash + restart)

    def test_permanent_error_after_max_restarts(self):
        from core.concurrent_runner import ConcurrentRunner

        all_stopped = threading.Event()

        config = {
            "job_delay_seconds": 0,
            "max_concurrent_uploads_per_page": 1,
            "min_interval_per_page_s": 0,
            "worker_max_restarts": 1,
        }
        runner = ConcurrentRunner(
            workers=[{"tab": "T1", "page": "P1"}],
            config=config,
            on_all_stopped=all_stopped.set,
        )
        runner._runners[0].run = MagicMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("always crashes"))

        with patch("core.concurrent_runner.time.sleep"), patch("utils.notifier.get_notifier"):
            runner.start()
            all_stopped.wait(timeout=3.0)

        self.assertTrue(all_stopped.is_set())
        self.assertEqual(runner._statuses[0].state, "error")


class TestP3MarkdownV2(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_escape_md2_dots(self):
        from utils.notifier import _escape_md2
        result = _escape_md2("hello.world")
        self.assertIn("\\.", result)

    def test_escape_md2_exclamation(self):
        from utils.notifier import _escape_md2
        result = _escape_md2("crash!")
        self.assertIn("\\!", result)

    def test_escape_md2_parens(self):
        from utils.notifier import _escape_md2
        result = _escape_md2("(error)")
        self.assertIn("\\(", result)
        self.assertIn("\\)", result)

    def test_escape_md2_plain_text_unchanged(self):
        from utils.notifier import _escape_md2
        result = _escape_md2("hello world")
        self.assertEqual(result, "hello world")

    def test_notifier_uses_markdownv2_parse_mode(self):
        from utils.notifier import TelegramNotifier
        import urllib.request

        sent_payloads = []

        def mock_urlopen(req, timeout=None):
            body = req.data
            sent_payloads.append(json.loads(body.decode()))
            resp = MagicMock()
            resp.__enter__ = lambda s: s
            resp.__exit__ = MagicMock(return_value=False)
            resp.status = 200
            return resp

        n = TelegramNotifier({
            "telegram_bot_token": "1:X",
            "telegram_chat_id":   "123",
            "notify_on_error":    True,
        })
        n._enabled = True

        with patch("urllib.request.urlopen", mock_urlopen):
            n._send("test message")

        self.assertTrue(len(sent_payloads) > 0)
        self.assertEqual(sent_payloads[0].get("parse_mode"), "MarkdownV2")

class TestK7GraphClientInsights(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_get_video_insights_returns_expected_keys(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient

        client = GraphClient()
        client.get = MagicMock(side_effect=[
            # Endpoint 1: engagement
            {
                "reactions": {"summary": {"total_count": 42}},
                "comments":  {"summary": {"total_count": 7}},
                "shares":    {"count": 3},
            },
            # Endpoint 2: video insights
            {
                "data": [
                    {"name": "post_video_views",        "values": [{"value": 1000}]},
                    {"name": "post_impressions_unique", "values": [{"value": 800}]},
                    {"name": "post_video_view_time",    "values": [{"value": 3600}]},
                ]
            },
        ])

        result = client.get_video_insights("VID123", "TOKEN")

        self.assertIn("views",          result)
        self.assertIn("reach",          result)
        self.assertIn("reactions",      result)
        self.assertIn("comments_count", result)
        self.assertIn("shares",         result)
        self.assertIn("minutes_viewed", result)

    def test_get_video_insights_values_correct(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient

        client = GraphClient()
        client.get = MagicMock(side_effect=[
            {
                "reactions": {"summary": {"total_count": 10}},
                "comments":  {"summary": {"total_count": 5}},
                "shares":    {"count": 2},
            },
            {
                "data": [
                    {"name": "post_video_views",        "values": [{"value": 500}]},
                    {"name": "post_impressions_unique", "values": [{"value": 400}]},
                    {"name": "post_video_view_time",    "values": [{"value": 1200}]},
                ]
            },
        ])

        result = client.get_video_insights("VID", "T")
        self.assertEqual(result["views"],          500)
        self.assertEqual(result["reach"],          400)
        self.assertEqual(result["reactions"],      10)
        self.assertEqual(result["comments_count"], 5)
        self.assertEqual(result["shares"],         2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["minutes_viewed"], 20.0, places=1)

    def test_get_video_insights_graceful_on_api_failure(self):
        """Both endpoints failing → returns zeros, does not raise."""

"""H15.S12.2 Clip score/brand/social package contract."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io

def test_brand_platform_rationale_and_srt_helpers():
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import (brand_overrides, clean_brand,
        clean_platforms, platform_copy, score_rationale, srt_text)
    assert clean_brand("bad") == "auto"
    assert brand_overrides("ltt_red")["caption_preset"] == "viral_pop"
    assert clean_platforms(["tiktok", "bad", "tiktok"]) == ["tiktok"]
    assert set(clean_platforms([])) == {"tiktok", "youtube_shorts", "instagram_reels"}
    copy = platform_copy("T" * 200, "D", ["LTT"], ["youtube_shorts"])
    assert len(copy["youtube_shorts"]["title"]) == 100

    class Score:
        overall = .9; hook_strength = .8; pacing = .7; completeness = .6
        visual_quality = .5; audio_quality = .4; topic_coherence = .3
        semantic_richness = .2
    class Candidate:
        score = Score(); explanation = None; why_selected = "Vì hook rõ"
        strategy_reasoning = ""; clip_intent = "insight"; risk_flags = []
    rationale = score_rationale(Candidate())
    assert rationale["overall"] == .9 and rationale["dimensions"]["pacing"] == .7
    assert "00:00:01,250 --> 00:00:03,500" in srt_text([
        {"start": 1.25, "end": 3.5, "text": "Xin chào"}])


def test_package_rebases_source_captions_and_manual_text_to_clip_timeline():
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import package_payload, srt_text

    source = {"source_start": 39.78, "source_end": 59.53, "duration_s": 19.75,
              "title": "Clip", "transcript": [
                  {"start": 39.78, "end": 45.86, "text": "Câu một"},
                  {"start": 53.19, "end": 60.2, "text": "Câu hai"},
              ]}
    package = package_payload(job_id="job", original_clips=[source], drafts=[],
                              platforms=["tiktok"], brand_preset="auto")
    captions = package["clips"][0]["transcript"]
    assert captions[0]["start"] == 0
    assert captions[-1]["end"] == 19.75
    rendered = srt_text(captions)
    assert "00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:06,080" in rendered
    assert "00:00:19,750" in rendered
    assert "00:00:39,780" not in rendered

    edited = package_payload(job_id="job", original_clips=[source],
                             drafts=[{"index": 0, "transcript_text": "Đã sửa"}],
                             platforms=["tiktok"], brand_preset="auto")
    assert edited["clips"][0]["transcript"] == [
        {"start": 0.0, "end": 19.75, "text": "Đã sửa", "speaker": ""}]

    # Offset nhỏ hơn duration vẫn là timestamp nguồn theo contract worker.
    short_offset = package_payload(job_id="job", original_clips=[{
        "source_start": 2, "source_end": 12, "duration_s": 10,
        "transcript": [{"start": 2, "end": 5, "text": "Đầu clip"}]}],
        drafts=[], platforms=["tiktok"], brand_preset="auto")
    assert short_offset["clips"][0]["transcript"][0]["start"] == 0


def test_parallel_analysis_progress_is_monotonic_and_throttled():
    from apps.taoclipngan.features import ANALYSIS_ENGINES, AnalysisProgressTracker

    tracker = AnalysisProgressTracker()
    emitted = []
    # Engine nhanh hoàn tất trước, engine chậm bắt đầu sau: progress không được lùi.
    for name, value in [("audio", 1), ("scene", .9), ("speech", .1),
                        ("visual", .25), ("motion", .05), ("content", .2)]:
        result = tracker.update(name, value)
        if result:
            emitted.append(result[0])
    for step in range(1, 101):
        for name in ANALYSIS_ENGINES:
            result = tracker.update(name, step / 100)
            if result:
                emitted.append(result[0])
    assert emitted == sorted(set(emitted))
    assert emitted[-1] == 58
    assert len(emitted) <= 27

"""WEB-001: one explicit map between legacy static files and WordPress URLs."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SITE = ROOT / "docs" / "lttstudios-website"
MAP = SITE / "route-map.json"


def _contract():
    return json.loads(MAP.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def test_route_map_covers_every_legacy_html_page_once():
    contract = _contract()
    all_sources = [rule["source"] for rule in contract["rules"]]
    assert len(all_sources) == len(set(all_sources)), "duplicate source route"
    # Canonical WordPress targets can exist without a file in the legacy
    # static reference bundle. Such entries remain in the route contract so
    # production audit still checks them, but do not pretend a source file
    # exists (WEB-001 regression found 2026-08-08).
    mapped = [rule["source"] for rule in contract["rules"]
              if rule.get("source_exists", True)]

    files = {
        "/" if path.relative_to(SITE).as_posix() == "index.html"
        else "/vi/" if path.relative_to(SITE).as_posix() == "vi/index.html"
        else "/" + path.relative_to(SITE).as_posix()
        for path in SITE.rglob("*.html")
        if "assets" not in path.relative_to(SITE).parts
    }
    assert set(mapped) == files


def test_pretty_urls_and_callback_exceptions_are_unambiguous():
    contract = _contract()
    assert contract["production_owner"] == "wordpress"
    assert contract["source_owner"] == "legacy-static-reference"

    callbacks = []
    for rule in contract["rules"]:
        target = rule["production"]
        if rule["disposition"] == "oauth_callback":
            callbacks.append(rule)
            assert target == rule["source"] and target.endswith(".html")
        elif target is not None:
            assert target == "/" or target.endswith("/")
            assert ".html" not in target
    assert {rule["source"] for rule in callbacks} == {
        "/auth/fb-callback.html", "/legal/callback.html"
    }


def test_no_old_vi_route_can_point_to_an_unrelated_product():
    rules = {rule["source"]: rule for rule in _contract()["rules"]}
    assert rules["/vi/"]["production"] == "/"
    for source, rule in rules.items():
        if source.startswith("/vi/") and rule["production"]:
            assert "/ai-automation/" not in rule["production"]

"""Regression tests for the adaptive page-width contract."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def _read(relative: str) -> str:
    return (ROOT / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_base_exposes_named_page_width_contract() -> None:
    base = _read("server/templates/base.html")
    css = _read("server/static/ltt.css")

    assert "{% block page_mode %}standard{% endblock %}" in base
    assert "page--' ~ (_page_mode|trim)" in base

        "immersive": (

            "apps/kichban/templates/script.html",
            "apps/taoclipngan/templates/taoclipngan.html",

        marker = f"{{% block page_mode %}}{mode}{{% endblock %}}"
        for template in templates:

test_12_tiktok.py — Unit tests for TikTok integration modules.

Coverage:

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T1 — TikTokAccount dataclass
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestTikTokAccount(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make(self, expires_in=3600, refresh_in=86400*365) -> "TikTokAccount":
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount
        now = time.time()
        return TikTokAccount(
            open_id            = "user_001",
            display_name       = "Test User",
            avatar_url         = "https://cdn.tiktok.com/avatar.jpg",
            access_token       = "tok_abc",
            refresh_token      = "ref_xyz",
            expires_at         = now + expires_in,
            refresh_expires_at = now + refresh_in,
            scopes             = ["user.info.basic", "video.upload"],
            connected_at       = "2026-05-14T00:00:00",
        )

    def test_is_token_valid_fresh(self):
        acc = self._make(expires_in=3600)
        self.assertTrue(acc.is_token_valid())

    def test_is_token_valid_expired(self):
        acc = self._make(expires_in=-10)
        self.assertFalse(acc.is_token_valid())

    def test_is_token_valid_margin(self):
        """Token with < 60 s remaining should be treated as invalid."""
        acc = self._make(expires_in=30)   # 30 s < 60 s buffer
        self.assertFalse(acc.is_token_valid())

    def test_is_refresh_valid_fresh(self):
        acc = self._make(refresh_in=86400 * 365)
        self.assertTrue(acc.is_refresh_valid())

    def test_is_refresh_valid_expired(self):
        acc = self._make(refresh_in=-10)
        self.assertFalse(acc.is_refresh_valid())

    def test_days_until_expiry_positive(self):
        acc = self._make(expires_in=86400 * 2)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(acc.days_until_expiry(), 1)

    def test_days_until_expiry_zero_when_expired(self):
        acc = self._make(expires_in=-3600)
        self.assertEqual(acc.days_until_expiry(), 0)

    def test_roundtrip_serialisation(self):
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount
        acc = self._make()
        d   = acc.to_dict()
        acc2 = TikTokAccount.from_dict(d)
        self.assertEqual(acc.open_id,       acc2.open_id)
        self.assertEqual(acc.display_name,  acc2.display_name)
        self.assertEqual(acc.access_token,  acc2.access_token)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(acc.expires_at, acc2.expires_at, delta=0.001)
        self.assertEqual(acc.scopes,        acc2.scopes)

    def test_token_status_label_fresh(self):
        acc = self._make(expires_in=86400 * 3)
        label, color = acc.token_status_label()
        self.assertIn("✅", label)
        self.assertEqual(color, "#4CAF50")

    def test_token_status_label_expired(self):
        acc = self._make(expires_in=-10)
        label, color = acc.token_status_label()
        self.assertIn("❌", label)
        self.assertEqual(color, "#F44336")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T2 — TikTokTokenStore
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestTikTokTokenStore(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".enc", delete=False)
        self._tmp.close()
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokTokenStore
        self._store = TikTokTokenStore(path=self._tmp.name)

    def tearDown(self):
        try:
            os.unlink(self._tmp.name)
        except Exception:
            pass
        for ext in (".tmp",):
            try:
                os.unlink(self._tmp.name.replace(".enc", ext))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _account(self, open_id="u1", name="Alice") -> "TikTokAccount":
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount
        now = time.time()
        return TikTokAccount(
            open_id=open_id, display_name=name, avatar_url="",
            access_token="tok", refresh_token="ref",
            expires_at=now + 3600, refresh_expires_at=now + 86400 * 365,
            scopes=["user.info.basic"], connected_at="2026-01-01",
        )

    def test_upsert_then_get(self):
        acc = self._account()
        self._store.upsert_account(acc)
        got = self._store.get_account("u1")
        self.assertIsNotNone(got)
        self.assertEqual(got.display_name, "Alice")

    def test_get_unknown_returns_none(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self._store.get_account("nonexistent"))

    def test_remove_account(self):
        acc = self._account()
        self._store.upsert_account(acc)
        self._store.remove_account("u1")
        self.assertIsNone(self._store.get_account("u1"))

    def test_all_accounts(self):
        self._store.upsert_account(self._account("u1", "Alice"))
        self._store.upsert_account(self._account("u2", "Bob"))
        all_ = self._store.all_accounts()
        self.assertEqual(len(all_), 2)

    def test_upsert_updates_existing(self):
        acc = self._account()
        self._store.upsert_account(acc)
        acc2 = self._account()
        acc2.display_name = "Alice Updated"
        self._store.upsert_account(acc2)
        got = self._store.get_account("u1")
        self.assertEqual(got.display_name, "Alice Updated")

    def test_is_empty_initially(self):
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokTokenStore
        empty_store = TikTokTokenStore(path=self._tmp.name + ".empty")
        try:
            self.assertTrue(empty_store.is_empty())
        finally:
            try:
                os.unlink(self._tmp.name + ".empty")
            except Exception:
                pass

    def test_persistence_across_instances(self):
        """Data saved by one store instance must be loadable by another."""
        acc = self._account()
        self._store.upsert_account(acc)

        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokTokenStore
        store2 = TikTokTokenStore(path=self._tmp.name)
        got = store2.get_account("u1")
        self.assertIsNotNone(got)
        self.assertEqual(got.open_id, "u1")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T3 — PKCE pair generation
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestPKCE(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_verifier_length_in_range(self):
        from core.tiktok.auth_manager import _generate_pkce_pair
        v, _ = _generate_pkce_pair()
        # RFC 7636: code_verifier length must be 43..128
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(v), 43)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(v),   128)

    def test_challenge_is_s256(self):
        import base64
        import hashlib
        from core.tiktok.auth_manager import _generate_pkce_pair
        v, c = _generate_pkce_pair()
        expected_digest = hashlib.sha256(v.encode("ascii")).digest()
        expected_challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(expected_digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
        self.assertEqual(c, expected_challenge)

    def test_pairs_are_unique(self):
        from core.tiktok.auth_manager import _generate_pkce_pair
        pairs = {_generate_pkce_pair()[0] for _ in range(10)}
        self.assertEqual(len(pairs), 10)   # all verifiers unique

    def test_challenge_url_safe(self):
        """Challenge must be URL-safe base64 (no +, /, =)."""
        from core.tiktok.auth_manager import _generate_pkce_pair
        _, c = _generate_pkce_pair()
        self.assertNotIn("+", c)
        self.assertNotIn("/", c)
        self.assertNotIn("=", c)
