class TestTikTokError(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make(self, code="", status=200) -> "TikTokError":
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokError
        return TikTokError("test", error_code=code, http_status=status)

    def test_auth_error_by_code(self):
        err = self._make(code="access_token_invalid")
        self.assertTrue(err.is_auth_error())

    def test_auth_error_by_http_401(self):
        err = self._make(status=401)
        self.assertTrue(err.is_auth_error())

    def test_rate_limit_by_code(self):
        err = self._make(code="rate_limit_exceeded")
        self.assertTrue(err.is_rate_limit())

    def test_rate_limit_by_http_429(self):
        err = self._make(status=429)
        self.assertTrue(err.is_rate_limit())

    def test_server_error_500(self):
        err = self._make(status=500)
        self.assertTrue(err.is_server_error())

    def test_server_error_503(self):
        err = self._make(status=503)
        self.assertTrue(err.is_server_error())

    def test_normal_error_not_auth_or_rate(self):
        err = self._make(code="some_other_error", status=400)
        self.assertFalse(err.is_auth_error())
        self.assertFalse(err.is_rate_limit())
        self.assertFalse(err.is_server_error())


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T5 — TikTokClient._parse()
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestTikTokClientParse(unittest.TestCase):

    def _resp(self, body: dict, status: int = 200) -> MagicMock:
        r = MagicMock()
        r.json.return_value = body
        r.ok = (200 <= status < 300)
        r.status_code = status
        r.text = str(body)
        return r

    def test_ok_response_returns_data(self):
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient
        resp = self._resp({
            "data": {"publish_id": "abc"},
            "error": {"code": "ok", "message": ""}
        })
        result = TikTokClient._parse(resp)
        self.assertEqual(result["publish_id"], "abc")

    def test_error_code_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError
        resp = self._resp({
            "data": {},
            "error": {"code": "access_token_invalid", "message": "bad token"}
        })
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokError) as ctx:
            TikTokClient._parse(resp)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "access_token_invalid")

    def test_non_json_non_ok_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient, TikTokError
        r = MagicMock()
        r.json.side_effect = ValueError("not json")
        r.ok = False
        r.status_code = 503
        r.text = "Service Unavailable"
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokError) as ctx:
            TikTokClient._parse(r)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.http_status, 503)

    def test_success_code_string_variants(self):
        """'success' and '' are also valid ok codes."""
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient
        for ok_code in ("ok", "success", "OK"):
            resp = self._resp({"data": {"x": 1}, "error": {"code": ok_code}})
            result = TikTokClient._parse(resp)
            self.assertEqual(result.get("x"), 1)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T6 — poll_until_done()
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestPollUntilDone(unittest.TestCase):

    def _client(self, statuses: list[str]) -> MagicMock:
        """Mock TikTokClient.post that returns statuses in sequence."""
        client = MagicMock()
        responses = [
            {"process_info": {"status": s, "uploaded_bytes": 0, "fail_reason": ""}}
            for s in statuses
        ]
        client.post.side_effect = responses
        return client

    def test_immediate_success(self):
        from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done
        client = self._client(["PROCESS_SUCCESS"])
        result = poll_until_done(client, "pub_1", poll_interval_s=0)
        self.assertEqual(result, "PROCESS_SUCCESS")

    def test_success_after_two_polls(self):
        from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done
        client = self._client([
            "PROCESSING_UPLOAD",
            "PROCESSING_INTERCUT_AND_UPLOAD",
            "PROCESS_SUCCESS",
        ])
        with patch("core.tiktok.status_poller.time.sleep"):
            result = poll_until_done(client, "pub_2", poll_interval_s=0.001)
        self.assertEqual(result, "PROCESS_SUCCESS")
        self.assertEqual(client.post.call_count, 3)

    def test_process_failed_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done, TikTokError
        client = self._client(["PROCESS_FAILED"])
        client.post.side_effect = [
            {"process_info": {"status": "PROCESS_FAILED", "fail_reason": "bad video", "uploaded_bytes": 0}}
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokError) as ctx:
            poll_until_done(client, "pub_3", poll_interval_s=0)
        self.assertIn("bad video", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_stop_event_raises_interrupted(self):
        from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done
        stop = threading.Event()
        stop.set()
        client = MagicMock()
        with self.assertRaises(InterruptedError):
            poll_until_done(client, "pub_4", stop_event=stop)

    def test_inbox_status_treated_as_success(self):
        from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done
        client = self._client(["SEND_TO_USER_INBOX"])
        result = poll_until_done(client, "pub_5", poll_interval_s=0)
        self.assertEqual(result, "SEND_TO_USER_INBOX")

    def test_timeout_raises_tiktok_error(self):
        from core.tiktok.status_poller import poll_until_done, TikTokError
        client = MagicMock()
        client.post.return_value = {
            "process_info": {"status": "PROCESSING_UPLOAD", "uploaded_bytes": 0, "fail_reason": ""}
        }
        with patch("core.tiktok.status_poller.time.sleep"):
            with self.assertRaises(TikTokError) as ctx:
                poll_until_done(client, "pub_6", poll_interval_s=0, timeout_s=0.001)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "timeout")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T7 — TikTokDraftUploader
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestTikTokDraftUploader(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_video(self, size=1024) -> str:
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        f.write(b"X" * size)
        f.close()
        return f.name

    def _make_client(self, publish_id="pub_draft_1"):
        client = MagicMock()
        client.post.side_effect = [
            # Phase 1: init response
            {"publish_id": publish_id, "upload_url": "https://upload.tiktok.com/x"},
            # Phase 3: status poll response
            {"process_info": {"status": "SEND_TO_USER_INBOX", "uploaded_bytes": 1024, "fail_reason": ""}},
        ]
        client.put_binary.return_value = 200
        return client

    def _make_uploader(self, client):
        from core.tiktok.uploader_draft import TikTokDraftUploader
        return TikTokDraftUploader(
            client=client, config={},
            stop_event=threading.Event(),
        )

    def test_upload_returns_publish_id(self):
        video = self._make_video()
        client = self._make_client("pub_42")
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        try:
            publish_id, post_url = uploader.upload({
                "video_path":  video,
                "title":       "Test",
                "description": "Draft test",
            })
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)
        self.assertEqual(publish_id, "pub_42")
        self.assertEqual(post_url, "")   # draft has no public URL

    def test_upload_calls_init_endpoint(self):
        video = self._make_video()
        client = self._make_client()
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        try:
            uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)
        first_call_path = client.post.call_args_list[0][0][0]
        self.assertIn("inbox", first_call_path)

    def test_upload_calls_put_binary(self):
        video = self._make_video(1024)
        client = self._make_client()
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        try:
            uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)
        client.put_binary.assert_called_once()

    def test_missing_video_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.uploader_draft import TikTokDraftUploader
        client = MagicMock()
        uploader = TikTokDraftUploader(client=client, config={})
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
            uploader.upload({"video_path": "/nonexistent/video.mp4"})

    def test_init_failure_raises_tiktok_error(self):
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokError
        from core.tiktok.uploader_draft import TikTokDraftUploader
        video = self._make_video()
        client = MagicMock()
        client.post.side_effect = TikTokError("API down", error_code="server_error", http_status=500)
        uploader = TikTokDraftUploader(client=client, config={})
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(TikTokError):
                uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_stop_event_during_upload(self):
        from core.tiktok.uploader_draft import TikTokDraftUploader
        video = self._make_video(1024)
        stop = threading.Event()
        stop.set()   # already stopped

        client = MagicMock()
        uploader = TikTokDraftUploader(client=client, config={}, stop_event=stop)
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(InterruptedError):
                uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# T8 — TikTokDirectUploader
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestTikTokDirectUploader(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_video(self, size=512) -> str:
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
        f.write(b"Y" * size)
        f.close()
        return f.name

    def _make_client(self, publish_id="pub_direct_1"):
        client = MagicMock()
        client.post.side_effect = [
            {"publish_id": publish_id, "upload_url": "https://upload.tiktok.com/d"},
            {"process_info": {"status": "PROCESS_SUCCESS", "uploaded_bytes": 512, "fail_reason": ""}},
        ]
        client.put_binary.return_value = 200
        return client

    def _make_uploader(self, client, config=None):
        from core.tiktok.uploader_direct import TikTokDirectUploader
        return TikTokDirectUploader(
            client=client,
            config=config or {},
            stop_event=threading.Event(),
        )

    def test_upload_returns_publish_id(self):
        video = self._make_video()
        client = self._make_client("pub_d_99")
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        try:
            publish_id, url = uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)
        self.assertEqual(publish_id, "pub_d_99")
        self.assertEqual(url, "")   # no public URL from API

    def test_upload_calls_direct_endpoint(self):
        video = self._make_video()
        client = self._make_client()
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        try:
            uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)
        first_path = client.post.call_args_list[0][0][0]
        self.assertNotIn("inbox", first_path)
        self.assertIn("publish", first_path)

    def test_privacy_default_self_only(self):
        """Default privacy_level must be SELF_ONLY (safe for unaudited apps)."""
        video = self._make_video()
        client = self._make_client()
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        captured = {}

        original_post = client.post.side_effect

        def capture_post(path, payload):
            if not captured:
                captured["payload"] = payload
            return next(iter([
                {"publish_id": "pub_x", "upload_url": "https://x"},
                {"process_info": {"status": "PROCESS_SUCCESS", "uploaded_bytes": 0, "fail_reason": ""}},
            ]))

        # We need sequential side_effect, so re-build:
        responses = [
            {"publish_id": "pub_x", "upload_url": "https://upload.tiktok.com/x"},
            {"process_info": {"status": "PROCESS_SUCCESS", "uploaded_bytes": 0, "fail_reason": ""}},
        ]
        idx = [0]
        def seq_post(path, payload):
            if "publish" in path and idx[0] == 0:
                captured["payload"] = payload
            r = responses[idx[0]]
            idx[0] += 1
            return r
        client.post.side_effect = seq_post

        try:
            uploader.upload({"video_path": video, "title": "T"})
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

        post_info = captured.get("payload", {}).get("post_info", {})
        self.assertEqual(post_info.get("privacy_level"), "SELF_ONLY")

    def test_keywords_appended_as_hashtags(self):
        """Keywords should appear as #tag in the description."""
        video = self._make_video()
        client = self._make_client()
        captured = {}

        responses = [
            {"publish_id": "pub_h", "upload_url": "https://upload.tiktok.com/h"},
            {"process_info": {"status": "PROCESS_SUCCESS", "uploaded_bytes": 0, "fail_reason": ""}},
        ]
        idx = [0]
        def seq_post(path, payload):
            if idx[0] == 0:
                captured["payload"] = payload
            r = responses[idx[0]]
            idx[0] += 1
            return r
        client.post.side_effect = seq_post

        uploader = self._make_uploader(client)
        try:
            uploader.upload({
                "video_path":  video,
                "title":       "Test",
                "description": "Hello world",
                "keywords":    "python, coding, tutorial",
            })
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

        desc = captured.get("payload", {}).get("post_info", {}).get("description", "")
        self.assertIn("#python", desc)
        self.assertIn("#coding", desc)

    def test_privacy_mismatch_raises_runtime_error(self):
        """privacy_level_option_mismatch → clear RuntimeError."""
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokError
        video = self._make_video()
        client = MagicMock()
        client.post.side_effect = TikTokError(
            "not allowed",
            error_code="privacy_level_option_mismatch",
            http_status=400,
        )
        uploader = self._make_uploader(client, config={})
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
                uploader.upload({
                    "video_path":    video,
                    "title":         "T",
                    "privacy_level": "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE",
                })
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)
        self.assertIn("SELF_ONLY", str(ctx.exception))

class TestTikTokPublisher(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_account(self, open_id="u1") -> "TikTokAccount":
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount
        now = time.time()
        return TikTokAccount(
            open_id=open_id, display_name="User", avatar_url="",
            access_token="tok", refresh_token="ref",
            expires_at=now + 3600, refresh_expires_at=now + 86400 * 365,
            scopes=["video.upload"], connected_at="2026-01-01",
        )

    def _make_publisher(self, accounts=None) -> "TikTokPublisher":
        from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher
        pub = TikTokPublisher(
            config={}, stop_event=threading.Event(),
        )
        store = MagicMock()
        store.all_accounts.return_value = accounts or [self._make_account()]
        store.get_account.side_effect = lambda oid: next(
            (a for a in (accounts or [self._make_account()]) if a.open_id == oid), None
        )
        pub._token_store = store
        return pub

    def test_no_accounts_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher
        pub = TikTokPublisher(config={}, stop_event=threading.Event())
        pub._token_store = MagicMock()
        pub._token_store.all_accounts.return_value = []
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
            pub.publish({"video_path": "/tmp/x.mp4", "title": "T"})
        self.assertIn("Chưa kết nối", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_unknown_open_id_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher
        pub = TikTokPublisher(config={}, stop_event=threading.Event())
        pub._token_store = MagicMock()
        pub._token_store.get_account.return_value = None
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            pub.publish({"video_path": "/tmp/x.mp4", "account": "bad_id"})

    def test_dispatch_draft(self):
        """post_type=tiktok_draft → calls TikTokDraftUploader.upload()"""
        pub = self._make_publisher()
        with patch("core.tiktok.publisher_service.TikTokClient") as MockClient, \
             patch("core.tiktok.uploader_draft.TikTokDraftUploader.upload",
                   return_value=("pub_draft_X", "")) as mock_upload, \
             patch("core.tiktok.compliance_guard.TikTokComplianceGuard.check",
                   return_value=[]):
            result = pub.publish({
                "video_path": "/tmp/v.mp4",
                "post_type":  "tiktok_draft",
                "title":      "T",
            })
        mock_upload.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(result.status, "draft")
        self.assertEqual(result.external_post_id, "pub_draft_X")

    def test_dispatch_direct(self):
        """post_type=tiktok_direct → calls TikTokDirectUploader.upload()"""
        pub = self._make_publisher()
        with patch("core.tiktok.publisher_service.TikTokClient") as MockClient, \
             patch("core.tiktok.uploader_direct.TikTokDirectUploader.upload",
                   return_value=("pub_direct_Y", "")) as mock_upload, \
             patch("core.tiktok.compliance_guard.TikTokComplianceGuard.check",
                   return_value=[]):
            result = pub.publish({
                "video_path": "/tmp/v.mp4",
                "post_type":  "tiktok_direct",
                "title":      "T",
            })
        mock_upload.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(result.status, "published")

    def test_publish_result_success_true(self):
        pub = self._make_publisher()
        with patch("core.tiktok.publisher_service.TikTokClient"), \
             patch("core.tiktok.uploader_draft.TikTokDraftUploader.upload",
                   return_value=("p_id", "")), \
             patch("core.tiktok.compliance_guard.TikTokComplianceGuard.check",
                   return_value=[]):
            result = pub.publish({"video_path": "/x.mp4", "post_type": "tiktok_draft"})
        self.assertTrue(result.success)

    def test_expired_token_triggers_refresh(self):
        """Expired token → _ensure_token_fresh() → refresh_access_token()"""
        from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount
        from core.tiktok.publisher_service import TikTokPublisher

        expired = TikTokAccount(
            open_id="u_exp", display_name="Exp", avatar_url="",
            access_token="old_tok", refresh_token="ref_ok",
            expires_at=time.time() - 100,      # expired
            refresh_expires_at=time.time() + 86400 * 365,
            scopes=["video.upload"], connected_at="2026-01-01",
        )

        pub = TikTokPublisher(config={}, stop_event=threading.Event())
        pub._token_store = MagicMock()
        pub._token_store.all_accounts.return_value = [expired]
        pub._token_store.get_account.return_value = None

        refreshed = MagicMock()
        refreshed.is_token_valid.return_value = True
        refreshed.access_token = "new_tok"

        with patch("core.tiktok.auth_manager.TikTokAuthManager") as MockAuth:
            mock_mgr = MagicMock()
            mock_mgr.refresh_access_token.return_value = refreshed
            MockAuth.return_value = mock_mgr

            with patch("core.tiktok.publisher_service.TikTokClient") as MockClient, \
                 patch("core.tiktok.uploader_draft.TikTokDraftUploader.upload",
                       return_value=("p", "")), \
                 patch("core.tiktok.compliance_guard.TikTokComplianceGuard.check",
                       return_value=[]):
                pub.publish({"video_path": "/x.mp4", "post_type": "tiktok_draft"})

        mock_mgr.refresh_access_token.assert_called_once()

class TestTikTokConfigKeys(unittest.TestCase):

    REQUIRED_TIKTOK_KEYS = [
        "tiktok_client_key",
        "tiktok_client_secret",
        "tiktok_scopes",
        "tiktok_privacy_level",
        "tiktok_poll_interval_s",
        "tiktok_upload_timeout_s",
        "tiktok_request_timeout_s",
        "col_platform",
        "col_tiktok_link",
        "col_tiktok_id",
    ]

    def _load_config(self):
        import json
        cfg_path = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data", "config.json")
        if not os.path.exists(cfg_path):
            self.skipTest("data/config.json not found")
        with open(cfg_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)

    def test_all_tiktok_keys_present(self):
        config = self._load_config()
        missing = [k for k in self.REQUIRED_TIKTOK_KEYS if k not in config]
        self.assertEqual(missing, [], f"Thiếu keys trong config.json: {missing}")

    def test_tiktok_privacy_default_self_only(self):
        from core.config_defaults import DEFAULTS
        self.assertEqual(DEFAULTS.get("tiktok_privacy_level"), "SELF_ONLY")

    def test_tiktok_disable_flags_are_bool(self):
        config = self._load_config()
        for key in ("tiktok_disable_duet", "tiktok_disable_comment", "tiktok_disable_stitch"):
            self.assertIsInstance(config.get(key), bool, f"{key} must be bool")

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import subprocess
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from apps.mediatools.jobs import _safe_remote_url, _social_host, handle
from platform_core.storage import LocalStorage, set_storage


class Ctx:
    job_id = "job-1"
    def progress(self, *_args):
        pass


@pytest.fixture()
def storage(tmp_path):
    value = LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "files")); set_storage(value)
    yield value
    set_storage(None)


def _png(color: str) -> io.BytesIO:
    result = io.BytesIO(); Image.new("RGB", (24, 16), color).save(result, "PNG"); result.seek(0)
    return result


def _mp4(path: Path, color: str) -> None:
    from platform_core.media import ffmpeg_bin
    result = subprocess.run([ffmpeg_bin(), "-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i",
                             f"color=c={color}:s=160x96:d=0.7:r=12",
                             "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo",
                             "-shortest", "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                             "-c:a", "aac", str(path)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")


def test_asset_passthrough_chot_owner(storage):
    storage.put("agent-assets/u1/a.png", _png("red"), "image/png")
    result = handle({"owner_id": "u1", "image_key": "agent-assets/u1/a.png"}, Ctx())
    assert result["image_key"] == "agent-assets/u1/a.png"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="không thuộc"):
        handle({"owner_id": "u2", "image_key": "agent-assets/u1/a.png"}, Ctx())


def test_asset_image_collection_preserves_order_owner_and_uniqueness(storage):
    storage.put("agent-assets/u1/a.png", _png("red"), "image/png")
    storage.put("agent-assets/u1/b.png", _png("blue"), "image/png")
    result = handle({"owner_id": "u1", "image_keys": [
        "agent-assets/u1/b.png", "agent-assets/u1/a.png"]}, Ctx())
    assert result["image_keys"] == ["agent-assets/u1/b.png", "agent-assets/u1/a.png"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="trùng"):
        handle({"owner_id": "u1", "image_keys": [
            "agent-assets/u1/a.png", "agent-assets/u1/a.png"]}, Ctx())


def test_merge_image_tao_artifact_that(storage):
    storage.put("agent-assets/u1/a.png", _png("red"), "image/png")
    storage.put("agent-assets/u1/b.png", _png("blue"), "image/png")
    result = handle({"owner_id": "u1", "images": ["agent-assets/u1/a.png",
                    "agent-assets/u1/b.png"], "layout": "horizontal"}, Ctx())
    assert storage.exists(result["image_key"])
    with storage.open(result["image_key"]) as stream:
        image = Image.open(stream)
        assert image.size == (48, 16)


def test_merge_video_va_extract_frames_tao_artifact_that(storage, tmp_path):
    from platform_core.media import duration_seconds
    first = tmp_path / "first.mp4"; second = tmp_path / "second.mp4"
    _mp4(first, "red"); _mp4(second, "blue")
    with first.open("rb") as stream:
        storage.put("agent-assets/u1/first.mp4", stream, "video/mp4")
    with second.open("rb") as stream:
        storage.put("agent-assets/u1/second.mp4", stream, "video/mp4")
    merged = handle({"owner_id": "u1", "videos": ["agent-assets/u1/first.mp4",
                     "agent-assets/u1/second.mp4"], "transition": "cut"}, Ctx())
    assert merged["source_count"] == 2 and storage.exists(merged["video_key"])
    exported = tmp_path / "merged.mp4"
    with storage.open(merged["video_key"]) as source, exported.open("wb") as target:
        target.write(source.read())
    assert duration_seconds(str(exported)) >= 1.2
    frames = handle({"owner_id": "u1", "video_key": merged["video_key"],
                     "interval_sec": 0.25, "max_frames": 3}, Ctx())
    assert frames["count"] == 3
    assert all(storage.exists(key) for key in frames["image_keys"])


def test_social_import_chan_ssrf(monkeypatch):

def _build_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    db_path = (tmp_path / "ommi.db").as_posix()
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{db_path}")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "data"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_ENV", "development")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SESSION_SECRET", "ommi-test-session-secret")
    monkeypatch.delenv("TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY", raising=False)
    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    import platform_core.models  # noqa: F401
    import platform_core.storage as storage_mod
    dbmod.reset_engine(); dbmod.Base.metadata.create_all(dbmod.get_engine())
    storage_mod.set_storage(storage_mod.LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "files")))
    from platform_core.credit import cap_tay
    from platform_core.users import tao_nguoi_dung
    gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        for email in ("ommi-a@example.com", "ommi-b@example.com"):
            user = tao_nguoi_dung(db, email=email, password="Strong-pass-123",
                                  is_verified=True)
            db.flush(); cap_tay(db, user.id, 200, by="pytest", note="PROMPT AI OMMI")
        db.commit()
    finally:
        try: next(gen)
        except StopIteration: pass
    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"job_delay_seconds": 1, "max_retries": 1,
                               "sheet_id": "test"}), encoding="utf-8")
    from server.app import create_app
    return create_app(env={"LTT_ENV": "development", "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "ommi-test-session-secret", "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": ""}), dbmod, storage_mod


def _login(app, email):
    client = TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver", follow_redirects=True)
    page = client.get("/login")
    token = re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', page.text).group(1)
    assert client.post("/login", data={"username": email, "password": "Strong-pass-123",
        "csrf_token": token, "next": "/prompt-ai-ommi"}).status_code == 200
    studio = client.get("/prompt-ai-ommi")
    assert studio.status_code == 200 and "Prompt AI" in studio.text
    csrf = re.search(r'data-csrf-token="([^"]+)"', studio.text).group(1)
    return client, csrf


def test_project_revision_preferences_credit_and_ownership(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    app, dbmod, storage_mod = _build_app(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    owner, csrf = _login(app, "ommi-a@example.com")
    try:
        made = owner.post("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects", headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
                          json={"name": "Campaign"})
        assert made.status_code == 201
        project = made.json(); project_id = project["id"]
        payload = project["payload"]
        payload["brief"]["story"] = "Một câu chuyện quảng cáo đủ dài để chạy AI Director an toàn."
        saved = owner.put(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={"revision": project["revision"],
                                                  "payload": payload})
        assert saved.status_code == 200 and saved.json()["revision"] == project["revision"] + 1
        selected = saved.json()["payload"]
        selected["brief"].update({
            "style_id": "builtin-style-01",
            "meta_prompt_id": "builtin-meta-01",
            "snippet_ids": ["builtin-snippet-01"],
        })
        selected_saved = owner.put(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
            json={"revision": saved.json()["revision"], "payload": selected})
        assert selected_saved.status_code == 200
        checked = owner.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}/preview",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={"payload": selected_saved.json()["payload"]})
        assert checked.status_code == 200 and checked.json()["valid"] is True
        assert checked.json()["selections"] == {
            "style": "Hành động điện ảnh",
            "meta": "Video liên tục có timecode",
            "snippets": ["Khóa nhất quán nhân vật"],
        }
        stale = owner.put(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={"revision": 0, "payload": payload})
        assert stale.status_code == 409
        preference = owner.put("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/preferences",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={"theme": "dark", "revision": 0})
        assert preference.status_code == 200 and preference.json()["theme"] == "dark"
        assert owner.get("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/preferences").json()["theme"] == "dark"
        quote = owner.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}/quote",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={"operation": "director"})
        assert quote.status_code == 200 and quote.json()["credit"] > 0
        job = owner.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}/generate",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={"operation": "director"})
        assert job.status_code == 201 and job.json()["status"] == "queued"
        gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
        try:
            from platform_core.models import JOB_DONE, Job
            row = db.get(Job, job.json()["id"])
            row.status = JOB_DONE
            row.result = {"operation": "director", "prompt_package": {"scenes": [{
                "id": "scene_catalog", "title": "Mở đầu", "prompt": "Catalog prompt",
            }]}}
            db.commit()
        finally:
            try: next(gen)
            except StopIteration: pass
        missing_revision = owner.post(
            f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}/apply/{job.json()['id']}",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json={})
        assert missing_revision.status_code == 409
        applied = owner.post(
            f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}/apply/{job.json()['id']}",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf},
            json={"revision": selected_saved.json()["revision"]})
        assert applied.status_code == 200
        assert applied.json()["payload"]["scenes"][0]["id"] == "scene_catalog"
        package = owner.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}/export/json")
        assert package.status_code == 200 and package.json()["format"] == "ltt-prompt-ai-ommi"
        imported = owner.post("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/import",
            headers={"X-CSRF-Token": csrf}, json=package.json())
        assert imported.status_code == 201
        other, _ = _login(app, "ommi-b@example.com")
        try:
            assert other.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/projects/{project_id}").status_code == 404
        finally:
            other.close()
    finally:
        owner.close(); dbmod.reset_engine(); storage_mod._storage = None

"""Bounded 100-node Canvas/Plan release contract."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from time import perf_counter

from platform_core.agent import workflows
from platform_core.agent.validator import MAX_STEPS, validate_plan


def _canvas(count: int) -> dict:
    nodes = [{
        "id": f"n{index}",
        "type": "tool",
        "position": {"x": (index % 10) * 280, "y": (index // 10) * 190},
        "data": {"tool": "text.script", "params": {"topic": f"Muc {index}"},
                 "fanout": 1, "max_retry": 0, "on_fail": "retry_same",
                 "verify": None},
    } for index in range(count)]
    edges = [{"id": f"e{index}", "source": f"n{index - 1}",
              "target": f"n{index}"} for index in range(1, count)]
    return {"version": 2, "goal": "scale", "budget_max_credit": 1000,
            "active_page_id": "page-1", "pages": [{"id": "page-1",
            "name": "Scale", "nodes": nodes, "edges": edges,
            "viewport": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "zoom": 1}, "frames": [],
            "notes": [], "comments": [], "view": {"grid": True,
            "connections": True, "minimap": True}}]}


def test_canvas_100_nodes_round_trips_within_bounded_document_limit():
    canvas = _canvas(100)
    encoded = json.dumps(canvas, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    assert 64 * 1024 < workflows.MAX_CANVAS_BYTES == 512 * 1024
    assert len(encoded) < workflows.MAX_CANVAS_BYTES
    started = perf_counter()
    plan = workflows.canvas_to_plan(canvas)
    assert len(plan["steps"]) == MAX_STEPS == 100
    assert perf_counter() - started < 0.5


def test_plan_step_limit_rejects_101_before_provider_or_credit_access():
    plan = workflows.canvas_to_plan(_canvas(100))
    plan["steps"].append(dict(plan["steps"][-1], id="n100", after=["n99"]))
    result = validate_plan(plan)
    assert result.valid is False
    assert result.issues[0].code == "steps"
    assert "100" in result.issues[0].message


def test_canvas_document_limit_stays_bounded():
    canvas = _canvas(100)
    canvas["pages"][0]["notes"] = [{"id": "oversize", "text": "x" *
                                      workflows.MAX_CANVAS_BYTES,
                                      "x": 0, "y": 0}]
    try:
        workflows.canvas_to_plan(canvas)
    except workflows.WorkflowError as exc:
        assert "512 KiB" in str(exc)
    else:  # pragma: no cover - explicit release guard
        raise AssertionError("Oversized Canvas was accepted")

def _png(color=(30, 90, 180)) -> bytes:
    output = io.BytesIO()
    Image.new("RGB", (32, 24), color).save(output, "PNG")
    return output.getvalue()

def test_video_context_uses_files_api_and_returns_owned_file_part(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from apps.kichban import jobs
    from platform_core.storage import LocalStorage, set_storage

    storage = LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "store"))
    set_storage(storage)
    key = "agent-assets/u1/clip.mp4"
    storage.put(key, io.BytesIO(b"video-bytes"), "video/mp4")
    calls = []

    class Response:
        def __init__(self, status=200, data=None, headers=None):
            self.status_code = status
            self._data = data or {}
            self.headers = headers or {}
        def json(self):
            return self._data

    def post(url, **kwargs):
        calls.append(("post", url))
        if url.endswith("/upload/v1beta/files"):
            return Response(headers={"x-goog-upload-url": "https://upload.test/file"})
        return Response(data={"file": {"name": "files/abc", "uri": "gemini://abc",
                                        "state": "ACTIVE"}})

    fake_httpx = SimpleNamespace(post=post, get=lambda *_a, **_k: Response(),
                                 delete=lambda url, **_k: calls.append(("delete", url)),
                                 HTTPError=Exception)
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "httpx", fake_httpx)

def test_video_context_deletes_remote_file_when_processing_fails(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from apps.kichban import jobs
    from platform_core.storage import LocalStorage, set_storage

    storage = LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "store"))
    set_storage(storage)
    key = "agent-assets/u1/clip.mp4"
    storage.put(key, io.BytesIO(b"video-bytes"), "video/mp4")
    deleted = []

    class Response:
        status_code = 200
        headers = {"x-goog-upload-url": "https://upload.test/file"}
        def __init__(self, data=None):
            self._data = data or {}
        def json(self):
            return self._data

    def post(url, **_kwargs):
        if url.endswith("/upload/v1beta/files"):
            return Response()
        return Response({"file": {"name": "files/failed", "uri": "gemini://failed",
                                   "state": "PROCESSING"}})

    fake_httpx = SimpleNamespace(
        post=post,
        get=lambda *_a, **_k: Response({"state": "FAILED"}),
        delete=lambda url, **_k: deleted.append(url),
        HTTPError=Exception,
    )
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "httpx", fake_httpx)
    monkeypatch.setattr(jobs.time, "sleep", lambda _seconds: None)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(jobs.GeminiError, match="không xử lý được"):
            jobs._upload_video_part({"video_key": key}, "u1", "test-key")
        assert deleted == ["https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/files/failed"]
    finally:
        set_storage(None)

def test_video_tool_exposes_typed_media_inputs_and_prices_video_reference():
    spec = next(tool for tool in MANIFEST.tools if tool.name == "video.generate")
    assert spec.params_schema["image_key"]["type"] == "image"
    assert spec.params_schema["image_keys"]["type"] == "image[]"

    assert spec.params_schema["audio_key"]["type"] == "audio"

    assert _cost({**base, "video_key": "$source.video_key"}) > 0
    assert _cost({**base, "video_key": "$source.video_key"}) != _cost(base)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="không còn"):
        _reference_specs({"image_key": "agent-assets/u1/missing.png"}, "u1", storage)

"""Canvas Image nodes accept owned scalar and collection image references."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io

import pytest
from PIL import Image


def _png(color: str = "red") -> bytes:
    output = io.BytesIO()
    Image.new("RGB", (64, 64), color).save(output, "PNG")
    return output.getvalue()

def storage(tmp_path):

    current = LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "storage"))
    set_storage(current)

def test_image_tools_expose_typed_scalar_and_collection_inputs():
    from apps.taoanh.manifest import MANIFEST
    for name in ("image.generate", "image.batch_generate"):
        spec = next(tool for tool in MANIFEST.tools if tool.name == name)
        assert spec.params_schema["image_key"]["type"] == "image"
        assert spec.params_schema["image_keys"]["type"] == "image[]"


def test_canvas_references_preserve_order_dedupe_and_verify_owner(storage):
    from apps.taoanh.jobs import _load_canvas_references
    first = "agent-assets/u1/first.png"
    second = "taoanh/u1/job/second.png"
    storage.put(first, io.BytesIO(_png("red")), "image/png")
    storage.put(second, io.BytesIO(_png("blue")), "image/png")
    refs = _load_canvas_references({
        "image_key": first, "image_keys": [second, first],
    }, "u1", storage)
    assert [ref["data"] for ref in refs] == [_png("red"), _png("blue")]
    assert all(ref["mime"] == "image/png" and ref["role"] == "reference" for ref in refs)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="không thuộc"):
        _load_canvas_references({"image_key": first}, "u2", storage)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="không còn tồn tại"):
        _load_canvas_references({"image_key": "agent-assets/u1/missing.png"}, "u1", storage)


def test_worker_sends_canvas_references_to_gemini(storage, monkeypatch):
    from apps.taoanh import jobs
    first = "agent-assets/u1/first.png"
    second = "agent-assets/u1/second.png"
    storage.put(first, io.BytesIO(_png("red")), "image/png")
    storage.put(second, io.BytesIO(_png("blue")), "image/png")
    monkeypatch.setattr(jobs, "_lay_key", lambda _model: ("test-key", None))
    seen = {}

    def fake_call(prompt, aspect, key, model, references):
        seen.update(prompt=prompt, references=references)
        return _png("green")

    monkeypatch.setattr(jobs, "_goi_gemini", fake_call)
    result = jobs.handle({
        "owner_id": "u1", "prompt": "combine wardrobe, model and location",
        "image_key": first, "image_keys": [second], "count": 1,
    })
    assert len(seen["references"]) == 2
    assert "Input image roles in order: reference, reference" in seen["prompt"]
    assert storage.exists(result["image_keys"][0])

"""Kho tài nguyên PROMPT AI OMMI — bất biến sở hữu.

Vì sao file này tồn tại trước cả endpoint: module nguồn (`D:\\BOT GEMINI`) khai
ba tầng sở hữu nhưng `scoping.py` lọc mọi truy vấn theo một `master_user_id`
dùng chung, nên trên thực tế mọi khách hàng nhìn chung một kho. Đây là lỗi
loại P0 và nó **không lộ ra khi thử một mình** — chỉ lộ khi có người thứ hai.

Nên bất biến sở hữu phải được chốt từ lúc dựng bảng, không phải sau khi viết
xong API. Hai test dưới đây là khuôn: mọi endpoint kho tài nguyên thêm về sau
phải dùng `assert_cross_user_404` chứ không tự nghĩ cách kiểm riêng.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from platform_core.db import Base
from platform_core.registry import load_app_tables

# Bảng chỉ chứa quan hệ giữa hai bản ghi đã có chủ; chủ sở hữu suy ra từ bảng
# cha, thêm cột owner_id vào đây là dữ liệu trùng lặp có thể lệch nhau.
_JOIN_TABLES = {"ommi_resource_tag", "ommi_collection_item"}


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def _load_tables():
    load_app_tables()


def _ommi_tables():
    return {name: table for name, table in Base.metadata.tables.items()
            if name.startswith("ommi_")}


def test_every_ommi_data_table_carries_an_owner():
    """Bảng dữ liệu thiếu `owner_id` thì không có cách nào lọc theo người dùng —
    lập trình viên sau sẽ viết truy vấn không điều kiện và không ai thấy sai."""
    missing = [name for name, table in _ommi_tables().items()
               if name not in _JOIN_TABLES and "owner_id" not in table.c]
    assert missing == [], f"bảng thiếu owner_id: {missing}"


def test_owner_column_is_indexed():
    """Mọi truy vấn kho đều lọc theo owner_id. Không index thì kho lớn phải quét
    toàn bảng, và người dùng đông lên là chậm cho tất cả cùng lúc."""
    unindexed = []
    for name, table in _ommi_tables().items():
        if name in _JOIN_TABLES or "owner_id" not in table.c:
            continue
        column = table.c["owner_id"]
        covered = column.index or any(
            index.columns.keys()[:1] == ["owner_id"] for index in table.indexes)
        if not covered:
            unindexed.append(name)
    assert unindexed == [], f"owner_id chưa được index: {unindexed}"


def test_catalog_tables_allow_a_null_owner():
    """Mẫu catalog do admin publish có `owner_id` NULL. Bảng khai NOT NULL thì
    không publish mẫu được, và người ta sẽ lách bằng cách gán bừa cho một tài
    khoản admin — đúng cái namespace dùng chung mà ta đang tránh."""
    catalog = ("ommi_meta_prompt", "ommi_prompt_snippet", "ommi_style",
               "ommi_resource")
    wrong = [name for name in catalog
             if not _ommi_tables()[name].c["owner_id"].nullable]
    assert wrong == [], f"bảng catalog không cho owner_id NULL: {wrong}"


def assert_cross_user_404(client_b, token_b, paths):
    """Khuôn dùng lại: user B chạm tài nguyên của user A phải nhận 404.

    404 chứ không phải 403 — 403 xác nhận bản ghi có tồn tại, tức vẫn rò rỉ
    thông tin cho người đi dò ID.
    """
    for method, path in paths:
        response = client_b.request(method, path,
                                    headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_b})
        assert response.status_code == 404, (
            f"{method} {path} trả {response.status_code}, phải là 404")

def test_missing_and_forbidden_are_indistinguishable(db):
    """Hai trường hợp phải ném CÙNG một lỗi. Nếu 'của người khác' báo khác

    with pytest.raises(svc.ResourceNotFound) as forbidden:

"""Kho tài nguyên OMMI — tầng HTTP với hai người dùng thật.

Test service (`test_136`) chứng minh hàm lọc đúng. File này chứng minh **route**
cũng lọc đúng: một handler quên truyền `owner_id`, hoặc lấy nó từ body thay vì
từ phiên, thì service vẫn đúng mà API vẫn rò rỉ.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture()
def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL",
                       f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'ommi-api.db').as_posix()}")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "data"))
    monkeypatch.delenv("LTT_STORAGE", raising=False)
    import platform_core.storage as storage_mod
    storage_mod.set_storage(storage_mod.LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "files")))

    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    import platform_core.models  # noqa: F401
    from platform_core.registry import load_app_tables
    load_app_tables()
    dbmod.reset_engine()
    dbmod.Base.metadata.create_all(dbmod.get_engine())

    db = next(dbmod.get_session())
    from platform_core.users import tao_nguoi_dung
    ids = {}
    for email in ("ommi-a@example.com", "ommi-b@example.com"):
        ids[email] = tao_nguoi_dung(db, email=email, password="Strong-pass-123",
                                    is_verified=True).id
    db.commit(); db.close(); dbmod.reset_engine()

    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"job_delay_seconds": 1, "max_retries": 1,
                               "sheet_id": "test"}), encoding="utf-8")
    from server.app import create_app
    app = create_app(env={"LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
                          "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
                          "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "ommi-resource-api-test",
                          "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "", "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": ""})

    def login(email):
        client = TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver",
                            follow_redirects=True)
        page = client.get("/login")
        token = re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', page.text).group(1)
        assert client.post("/login", data={
            "username": email, "password": "Strong-pass-123",
            "csrf_token": token, "next": "/prompt-ai-ommi"}).status_code == 200
        studio = client.get("/prompt-ai-ommi")
        csrf = re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', studio.text).group(1)
        return client, csrf

    a, token_a = login("ommi-a@example.com")
    b, token_b = login("ommi-b@example.com")
    # ID thật của A cần cho phép thử "gài owner_id của nạn nhân vào body" —
    # gài một ID bịa thì handler nào cũng 404 và test không chứng minh được gì.
    yield a, token_a, b, token_b, ids["ommi-a@example.com"]
    a.close(); b.close(); dbmod.reset_engine(); storage_mod._storage = None


def _create(client, token, name="Nhân vật chính", kind="character"):
    response = client.post("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources",
                           headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
                           json={"kind": kind, "name": name})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


def test_owner_creates_reads_and_updates(api):
    a, token_a, *_rest = api
    made = _create(a, token_a)
    assert made["kind"] == "character" and made["is_catalog"] is False

    got = a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{made['id']}")
    assert got.status_code == 200
    assert got.json()["name"] == "Nhân vật chính"

    updated = a.put(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{made['id']}",
                    headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_a},
                    json={"name": "Đã đổi tên", "tags": ["hero", "chinh"]})
    assert updated.status_code == 200
    assert a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{made['id']}").json()["tags"] == [
        "chinh", "hero"]


def test_every_resource_endpoint_returns_404_for_another_user(api):
    """Khuôn bắt buộc: thêm endpoint kho tài nguyên nào cũng phải có mặt ở đây."""
    a, token_a, b, token_b, id_a = api
    made = _create(a, token_a)
    rid = made["id"]

    checks = [
        ("GET", f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}", None),
        ("GET", f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/usage", None),
        ("PUT", f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}", {"name": "Cướp"}),
        ("POST", f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/archive", {"archived": True}),
        ("POST", f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/clone", {}),
    ]
    # Mỗi endpoint thử hai lần: body sạch, và body có gài `owner_id` của nạn
    # nhân. Lần thứ hai mới là kiểu tấn công thật — chỉ thử body sạch thì một
    # handler tin `owner_id` do client gửi vẫn qua được test.
    victim = id_a
    for method, path, body in checks:
        for payload in (body, {**(body or {}), "owner_id": victim}):
            response = b.request(method, path,
                                 headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_b}, json=payload)
            assert response.status_code == 404, (
                f"{method} {path} với body {payload!r} trả "
                f"{response.status_code}, phải 404")

    # Và bản ghi không hề bị đổi.
    assert a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}").json()["name"] == \
        "Nhân vật chính"


def test_listing_is_scoped_to_the_caller(api):
    a, token_a, b, token_b, _id_a = api
    _create(a, token_a, "Của A")
    _create(b, token_b, "Của B")

    seen_a = a.get("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources").json()
    seen_b = b.get("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources").json()
    assert [i["name"] for i in seen_a["items"]] == ["Của A"]
    assert [i["name"] for i in seen_b["items"]] == ["Của B"]
    assert seen_a["counts"]["character"] == 1


def test_owner_id_in_the_body_is_ignored(api):
    """Nếu handler tin `owner_id` do client gửi thì bất kỳ ai cũng đọc được kho
    người khác chỉ bằng cách thêm một trường vào JSON."""
    a, token_a, b, token_b, _id_a = api
    _create(a, token_a, "Của A")
    made_b = b.post("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources",
                    headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_b},
                    json={"kind": "character", "name": "Giả mạo",
                          "owner_id": "user-a"})
    assert made_b.status_code == 201
    # Vẫn thuộc về B, và B vẫn chỉ thấy đúng một bản ghi của mình.
    assert [i["name"] for i in b.get(
        "/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources").json()["items"]] == ["Giả mạo"]

def _resource(client, token, name="Nhân vật"):
    response = client.post("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources",
                           headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
                           json={"kind": "character", "name": name})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["id"]


def _upload(client, token, rid, data=PNG, content_type="image/png"):
    return client.post(
        f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/images",
        data={"csrf_token": token, "label": "goc"},
        files={"file": ("a.png", io.BytesIO(data), content_type)})


def test_upload_attaches_an_image_and_sets_the_cover(api):
    a, token_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    response = _upload(a, token_a, rid)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    variant = response.json()

    detail = a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}").json()
    assert [v["id"] for v in detail["variants"]] == [variant["id"]]
    assert detail["cover_variant_id"] == variant["id"]
    assert variant["bytes_size"] == len(PNG)

    assert _upload(b, token_b, rid).status_code == 404
    assert a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}").json()["variants"] == []

def test_ticket_falls_back_to_local_when_direct_upload_is_off(api):
    a, token_a, id_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    body = a.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/images/ticket",
                  headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_a},
                  json={"content_type": "image/png"}).json()
    assert body["mode"] == "local"
    # Khoá luôn nằm trong thư mục của chính người gọi.
    assert body["key"].startswith(f"ommi/{id_a}/{rid}/")
    # Khoá phải NGẮN: Windows chặn ở 260 ký tự và LocalStorage còn thêm hậu tố
    # `.part<pid>` khi ghi. Khoá dài đã thật sự làm upload vỡ trên fixture.
    assert len(body["key"]) < 120, f"khoá quá dài: {len(body['key'])}"


def test_confirm_rejects_a_key_outside_the_callers_own_folder(api):
    """Client tự chọn `key`. Chỉ kiểm 'file có tồn tại' là chưa đủ — phải kiểm
    khoá thuộc đúng thư mục người gọi, nếu không gửi khoá của người khác là gắn
    được ảnh của họ vào tài nguyên của mình."""
    a, token_a, _id_a, b, token_b, id_b, storage_mod = api
    rid_a = _resource(a, token_a)
    rid_b = _resource(b, token_b)

    # B tải ảnh thật của mình lên, rồi A thử xác nhận khoá đó.
    assert _upload(b, token_b, rid_b).status_code == 201
    stolen = b.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid_b}"
                   ).json()["variants"][0]["storage_key"]
    assert storage_mod.get_storage().exists(stolen)

    response = a.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid_a}/images/confirm",
                      headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_a}, json={"key": stolen})
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid_a}").json()["variants"] == []

    """Bản đầu trả `download_token` của storage và ảnh 404 trên browser: token
    nằm trong RAM của TỪNG tiến trình, mà web và worker là hai tiến trình khác

    assert "token" not in body, "token của storage không dùng được xuyên tiến trình"
    served = a.get(body["url"])
    assert served.status_code == 200, served.text
    assert served.content == PNG

                              is_verified=True)
        ids[email] = user.id
        credit.cap_tay(db, user.id, 500, by="test")
    db.commit(); db.close(); dbmod.reset_engine()

    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"job_delay_seconds": 1, "max_retries": 1,
                               "sheet_id": "test"}), encoding="utf-8")
    from server.app import create_app
    app = create_app(env={"LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
                          "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
                          "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "ommi-generate-test",
                          "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "", "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": ""})

    def login(email):
        client = TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver",
                            follow_redirects=True)
        page = client.get("/login")
        token = re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', page.text).group(1)
        assert client.post("/login", data={
            "username": email, "password": "Strong-pass-123",
            "csrf_token": token, "next": "/prompt-ai-ommi"}).status_code == 200
        studio = client.get("/prompt-ai-ommi")
        csrf = re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', studio.text).group(1)
        return client, csrf

    a, token_a = login("gen-a@example.com")
    b, token_b = login("gen-b@example.com")
    yield (a, token_a, ids["gen-a@example.com"],
           b, token_b, ids["gen-b@example.com"])
    a.close(); b.close(); dbmod.reset_engine(); storage_mod._storage = None


def _resource(client, token, name="Nhân vật", prompt="mot nhan vat hoat hinh"):
    made = client.post("/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources",
                       headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token},
                       json={"kind": "character", "name": name,
                             "prompt_text": prompt})
    assert made.status_code == 201, made.text
    return made.json()["id"]


def _upload(client, token, rid):
    return client.post(
        f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/images",
        data={"csrf_token": token, "label": "goc"},
        files={"file": ("a.png", io.BytesIO(PNG), "image/png")}).json()


def _gen(client, token, rid, **body):
    return client.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/images/generate",
                       headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token}, json=body)


def test_quote_does_not_submit_anything(api):
    a, token_a, id_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    quoted = _gen(a, token_a, rid, count=2)
    assert quoted.status_code == 200
    body = quoted.json()
    assert body["confirmed"] is False and body["credit"] > 0
    assert body["count"] == 2

    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import Job
    db = next(get_session())
    try:
        assert db.query(Job).filter(Job.user_id == id_a).count() == 0
    finally:
        db.close()


def test_confirmed_run_submits_a_taoanh_job_priced_by_that_app(api):
    a, token_a, id_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    quoted = _gen(a, token_a, rid, count=3).json()
    started = _gen(a, token_a, rid, count=3, confirmed=True)
    assert started.status_code == 200, started.text
    assert started.json()["credit"] == quoted["credit"], (
        "giá báo và giá trừ phải cùng một công thức")

    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import Job
    db = next(get_session())
    try:
        job = db.query(Job).filter(Job.user_id == id_a).one()
        # Điều phối thuộc OMMI, lời gọi provider thuộc Tạo ảnh.
        assert job.job_type == "taoanh.generate"
        assert job.app_slug == "prompt_ai_ommi"
        assert job.params["count"] == 3
        assert job.params["owner_id"] == id_a
    finally:
        db.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["cua-nguoi-khac", "cua-tai-nguyen-khac"])
def test_reference_ids_outside_this_resource_never_reach_the_provider(api, case):
    """Ảnh tham chiếu đi THẲNG vào tham số job, tức vào provider.

    Hai nguồn ID lạ đều phải rơi ra: ảnh của người dùng khác, và ảnh của chính
    mình nhưng thuộc tài nguyên khác. Trường hợp thứ hai mới là cái dễ lọt —
    nó không vi phạm quyền sở hữu nên một bộ lọc chỉ nhìn `owner_id` sẽ cho qua.
    """
    a, token_a, _id_a, b, token_b, _id_b = api
    rid_a = _resource(a, token_a)
    if case == "cua-nguoi-khac":
        other = _upload(b, token_b, _resource(b, token_b))
    else:
        other = _upload(a, token_a, _resource(a, token_a, name="Tài nguyên khác"))

    started = _gen(a, token_a, rid_a, confirmed=True,
                   reference_variant_ids=[other["id"]])
    assert started.status_code == 200

    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import Job
    db = next(get_session())
    try:
        job = db.query(Job).filter(Job.params["prompt"].isnot(None)).all()[-1]
        assert "image_keys" not in job.params, (
            f"ID {case} không được lọt vào tham số job")
    finally:
        db.close()


def test_own_reference_images_are_passed_through(api):
    a, token_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    mine = _upload(a, token_a, rid)
    started = _gen(a, token_a, rid, confirmed=True,
                   reference_variant_ids=[mine["id"]])

    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import Job
    db = next(get_session())
    try:
        job = db.query(Job).one()
        assert job.params["image_keys"] == [mine["storage_key"]]
    finally:
        db.close()

def test_too_short_a_prompt_is_rejected(api):

    assert _gen(a, token_a, rid, prompt="ngan").status_code == 422


def _finish_job(job_id, keys):
    from platform_core.db import get_session
    from platform_core.models import JOB_DONE, Job
    db = next(get_session())
    try:
        job = db.get(Job, job_id)
        job.status = JOB_DONE
        job.result = {"image_keys": keys}
        db.commit()
    finally:
        db.close()


def test_attaching_a_finished_job_adds_variants(api):
    a, token_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    job_id = _gen(a, token_a, rid, count=2, confirmed=True).json()["id"]
    _finish_job(job_id, ["taoanh/x/1.png", "taoanh/x/2.png"])

    attached = a.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/images/from-job",
                      headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_a}, json={"job_id": job_id})
    assert attached.status_code == 201, attached.text
    assert len(attached.json()["variants"]) == 2
    detail = a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}").json()
    assert len(detail["variants"]) == 2
    assert detail["cover_variant_id"] == attached.json()["variants"][0]["id"]


def test_cannot_attach_someone_elses_job(api):
    a, token_a, _id_a, b, token_b, _id_b = api
    rid_a = _resource(a, token_a)
    rid_b = _resource(b, token_b)
    job_id = _gen(b, token_b, rid_b, confirmed=True).json()["id"]
    _finish_job(job_id, ["taoanh/x/1.png"])

    stolen = a.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid_a}/images/from-job",
                    headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_a}, json={"job_id": job_id})
    assert stolen.status_code == 404
    assert a.get(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid_a}"
                 ).json()["variants"] == []


def test_cannot_attach_a_job_that_has_not_finished(api):
    a, token_a, *_ = api
    rid = _resource(a, token_a)
    job_id = _gen(a, token_a, rid, confirmed=True).json()["id"]
    response = a.post(f"/prompt-ai-ommi/api/resources/{rid}/images/from-job",
                      headers={"X-CSRF-Token": token_a}, json={"job_id": job_id})
    assert response.status_code == 409

test_13_compliance.py — Unit tests for TikTokComplianceGuard.

Coverage:
  C1:  TikTokComplianceError — str format, is_permanent default, fields
  C2:  ComplianceWarning — fields
  C3:  _check_account() — None account raises ERR_NO_ACCOUNT
  C4:  _check_token() — expired+no-refresh raises ERR_TOKEN_EXPIRED_NO_REFRESH
  C5:  _check_token() — expired+refresh-valid → no error (refresh upstream)
  C6:  _check_scopes() — missing video.upload raises ERR_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE
  C7:  _check_scopes() — direct post missing video.publish raises ERR_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE
  C8:  _check_video() — empty path raises ERR_NO_VIDEO_PATH
  C9:  _check_video() — nonexistent file raises ERR_VIDEO_NOT_FOUND
  C10: _check_video() — zero-byte file raises ERR_VIDEO_EMPTY
  C11: _check_video() — >4 GB file raises ERR_VIDEO_TOO_LARGE
  C12: _check_caption() — caption >2200 chars raises ERR_CAPTION_TOO_LONG
  C13: _check_caption() — title >150 chars raises ERR_TITLE_TOO_LONG
  C14: _check_caption() — no caption AND no title → WARN_NO_CAPTION warning
  C15: _check_privacy() — unknown value raises ERR_INVALID_PRIVACY
  C16: _check_privacy() — all supported aliases resolve correctly
  C17: _check_audit_gate() — direct_post_disabled → ERR_DIRECT_POST_DISABLED
  C18: _check_audit_gate() — public direct without audit → ERR_AUDIT_NOT_APPROVED
  C19: _check_audit_gate() — draft post always passes regardless of privacy
  C20: _check_audit_gate() — direct+SELF_ONLY passes without audit
  C21: _check_audit_gate() — direct+public+audit_approved=true passes
  C22: _check_publish_mode() — mode mismatch → WARN_MODE_MISMATCH
  C23: _check_user_confirmation() — missing confirmed_at → WARN_NO_USER_CONFIRMATION
  C24: _check_ai_disclosure() — is_ai_generated=true → WARN_AI_CONTENT_FLAGGED
  C25: check() — fully valid task returns empty warning list
  C26: check() — multiple non-blocking warnings accumulate correctly
  C27: SheetRunner._is_retryable_error() — compliance codes [ERR_*] are not retried
  C28: TikTokComplianceError is_permanent=False is retryable via _is_retryable_error logic

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _make_account(
    scopes=None,
    expires_in=3600,
    refresh_in=86400 * 365,
) -> "TikTokAccount":
    from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokAccount
    now = time.time()
    return TikTokAccount(
        open_id            = "u_test",
        display_name       = "Test User",
        avatar_url         = "",
        access_token       = "tok_test",
        refresh_token      = "ref_test",
        expires_at         = now + expires_in,
        refresh_expires_at = now + refresh_in,
        scopes             = scopes if scopes is not None else ["video.upload"],
        connected_at       = "2026-01-01T00:00:00",
    )


def _make_guard(config: dict = None) -> "TikTokComplianceGuard":
    from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceGuard
    return TikTokComplianceGuard(config or {})


def _draft_config() -> dict:
    """Config that allows only draft uploads (safe/unaudited defaults).

    Sprint TT-5 toggles are opted-OUT here so the legacy test surface stays
    stable. Production DEFAULTS turn them on; tests asserting empty-warning
    happy paths should not be perturbed by added soft checks.
    """
    return {
        "tiktok_publish_mode":        "draft_upload",
        "tiktok_audit_approved":      "false",
        "tiktok_enable_direct_post":  "false",
        "tiktok_require_user_confirm": "false",
        "tiktok_privacy_level":       "SELF_ONLY",
        # Disable F1-F6 in this legacy-tests config; they have dedicated tests
        # in test_29_tiktok_preflight.py.
        "anti_spam_video_validate":       False,
        "anti_spam_scope_verify":         False,
        "anti_spam_watermark_check":      False,
        "anti_spam_audio_rights_check":   False,
        "anti_spam_content_policy":       False,
    }


def _direct_config(audit_approved=False) -> dict:
    """Config for direct posting (enable_direct_post=true)."""
    return {
        "tiktok_publish_mode":        "direct_private",
        "tiktok_audit_approved":      "true" if audit_approved else "false",
        "tiktok_enable_direct_post":  "true",
        "tiktok_require_user_confirm": "false",
        "tiktok_privacy_level":       "SELF_ONLY",
    }


def _make_video(size: int = 1024) -> str:
    """Create a temp video file and return its path."""
    f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
    f.write(b"Z" * size)
    f.close()
    return f.name

class TestComplianceErrorType(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_str_format_contains_error_code(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        err = TikTokComplianceError("ERR_FOO", "something went wrong")
        self.assertEqual(str(err), "[ERR_FOO] something went wrong")

    def test_is_permanent_defaults_true(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        err = TikTokComplianceError("ERR_X", "msg")
        self.assertTrue(err.is_permanent)

    def test_is_permanent_can_be_false(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        err = TikTokComplianceError("ERR_Y", "msg", is_permanent=False)
        self.assertFalse(err.is_permanent)

    def test_is_exception_subclass(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        err = TikTokComplianceError("ERR_Z", "msg")
        self.assertIsInstance(err, Exception)

    def test_args_contains_message(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        err = TikTokComplianceError("ERR_Q", "human message")
        # Exception.args[0] is the message (set by __post_init__)
        self.assertIn("human message", str(err))

class TestCheckAccount(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_none_account_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_account(None)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_NO_ACCOUNT")
        self.assertTrue(ctx.exception.is_permanent)

    def test_valid_account_passes(self):
        guard  = _make_guard()
        acc    = _make_account()
        # Should not raise
        guard._check_account(acc)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# C4 & C5 — _check_token
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestCheckToken(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_expired_no_refresh_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(expires_in=-100, refresh_in=-100)   # both expired
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_token(acc)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_TOKEN_EXPIRED_NO_REFRESH")

    def test_expired_but_refresh_valid_does_not_raise(self):
        """Refresh is valid → upstream will refresh; guard should not block."""
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(expires_in=-100, refresh_in=86400 * 365)
        # Should not raise — publisher will refresh before posting
        guard._check_token(acc)

    def test_fresh_token_passes(self):
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(expires_in=3600)
        guard._check_token(acc)

class TestCheckScopes(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_missing_video_upload_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(scopes=[])   # no scopes at all
        warnings: list = []
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_scopes({"post_type": "tiktok_draft"}, acc, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE")
        self.assertIn("video.upload", ctx.exception.message)

    def test_draft_only_needs_video_upload(self):
        """Draft posts only need video.upload, not video.publish."""
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(scopes=["video.upload"])
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_scopes({"post_type": "tiktok_draft"}, acc, warnings)
        # No error — test passes if no exception is raised

    def test_direct_post_needs_video_publish(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(scopes=["video.upload"])  # missing video.publish
        warnings: list = []
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_scopes({"post_type": "tiktok_direct"}, acc, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE")
        self.assertIn("video.publish", ctx.exception.message)

    def test_direct_post_with_both_scopes_passes(self):
        guard = _make_guard()
        acc   = _make_account(scopes=["video.upload", "video.publish"])
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_scopes({"post_type": "tiktok_direct"}, acc, warnings)

class TestCheckVideo(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_empty_path_raises_no_video_path(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_video({"video_path": ""})
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_NO_VIDEO_PATH")

    def test_nonexistent_path_raises_video_not_found(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_video({"video_path": "/nonexistent/video.mp4"})
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_VIDEO_NOT_FOUND")

    def test_empty_file_raises_video_empty(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        video = _make_video(size=0)
        try:
            guard = _make_guard()
            with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
                guard._check_video({"video_path": video})
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_VIDEO_EMPTY")
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_valid_video_passes(self):
        video = _make_video(size=1024)
        try:
            guard = _make_guard()
            guard._check_video({"video_path": video})  # must not raise
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_video_too_large_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        video = _make_video(size=1)
        try:
            with patch("os.path.getsize", return_value=4 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 + 1):
                guard = _make_guard()
                with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
                    guard._check_video({"video_path": video})
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_VIDEO_TOO_LARGE")
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

    def test_exact_4gb_passes(self):
        """4 GB exactly is still within the limit."""
        video = _make_video(size=1)
        try:
            with patch("os.path.getsize", return_value=4 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024):
                guard = _make_guard()
                guard._check_video({"video_path": video})  # must not raise
        finally:
            os.unlink(video)

class TestCheckCaption(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_caption_too_long_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_caption({"description": "A" * 2201}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_CAPTION_TOO_LONG")

    def test_caption_exactly_limit_passes(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_caption({"description": "B" * 2200, "title": "T"}, warnings)

    def test_title_too_long_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_caption({"description": "", "title": "T" * 151}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_TITLE_TOO_LONG")

    def test_title_exactly_limit_passes(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_caption({"title": "T" * 150, "description": ""}, warnings)

    def test_no_caption_no_title_yields_warning(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_caption({"description": "", "title": ""}, warnings)
        codes = [w.code for w in warnings]
        self.assertIn("WARN_NO_CAPTION", codes)

    def test_caption_only_no_warning(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_caption({"description": "Hello", "title": ""}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(warnings, [])

    def test_title_only_no_warning(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        guard._check_caption({"description": "", "title": "A"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(warnings, [])

class TestCheckPrivacy(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_invalid_value_raises(self):
        from core.tiktok.compliance_guard import TikTokComplianceError
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        with self.assertRaises(TikTokComplianceError) as ctx:
            guard._check_privacy({"privacy_level": "EVERYONE"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.error_code, "ERR_INVALID_PRIVACY")

    def test_valid_self_only(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        result = guard._check_privacy({"privacy_level": "SELF_ONLY"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(result, "SELF_ONLY")

    def test_alias_public_resolves(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        result = guard._check_privacy({"privacy_level": "public"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(result, "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE")

    def test_alias_private_resolves(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        result = guard._check_privacy({"privacy_level": "private"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(result, "SELF_ONLY")

    def test_alias_followers_resolves(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        result = guard._check_privacy({"privacy_level": "followers"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(result, "FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR")

    def test_alias_friends_resolves(self):
        guard    = _make_guard()
        warnings: list = []
        result = guard._check_privacy({"privacy_level": "friends"}, warnings)
        self.assertEqual(result, "MUTUAL_FRIEND_FRIENDS")

    def test_fallback_to_config_when_not_in_task(self):
