class TestFBCommenterValidation(unittest.TestCase):
    """FC01-FC04, FC12-FC14: input validation + boundaries."""

    def _make_client(self, post_result=None):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        if post_result is not None:
            client.post.return_value = post_result
        return client

    def test_FC01_empty_returns_skipped(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_client()
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_123", "")
        self.assertTrue(result.success)
        self.assertTrue(result.skipped)
        client.post.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC02_whitespace_returns_skipped(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_client()
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_123", "  \n\t  ")
        self.assertTrue(result.skipped)
        client.post.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC03_too_long_returns_failed(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_client()
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        long_text = "x" * 9000     # > 8000
        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_123", long_text)

        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "comment_too_long")
        client.post.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC04_missing_video_id_returns_failed(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_client()
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("", "Nice video!")
        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "missing_video_id")
        client.post.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC12_none_client_raises(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter, FacebookCommentError
        with self.assertRaises(FacebookCommentError):
            FacebookCommenter(None, "PAGE_TOKEN")

    def test_FC13_empty_token_raises(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter, FacebookCommentError
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        with self.assertRaises(FacebookCommentError):
            FacebookCommenter(client, "")

    def test_FC14_response_without_id_still_success(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_client(post_result={})    # no id returned
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_123", "Hello")
        self.assertTrue(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.comment_id, "")


class TestFBCommenterAPICall(unittest.TestCase):
    """FC05-FC06, FC16: API call shape and response parsing."""

    def test_FC05_calls_correct_endpoint_with_message_body(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter

        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        client.post.return_value = {"id": "PAGE_111_2222"}

        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")
        commenter.post_comment("vid_999", "Awesome!")

        client.post.assert_called_once()
        args, kwargs = client.post.call_args

        # First positional arg should be "<video_id>/comments"
        endpoint = args[0] if args else kwargs.get("path")
        self.assertEqual(endpoint, "vid_999/comments")

        # Data dict should contain message
        data = kwargs.get("data")
        self.assertEqual(data, {"message": "Awesome!"})

    def test_FC06_success_returns_comment_id(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter

        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        client.post.return_value = {"id": "PAGE_111_2222"}

        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")
        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_999", "Awesome!")

        self.assertTrue(result.success)
        self.assertFalse(result.skipped)
        self.assertEqual(result.comment_id, "PAGE_111_2222")

    def test_FC16_passes_token_as_kwarg(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter

        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        client.post.return_value = {"id": "x"}

        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "MY_PAGE_TOKEN_XYZ")
        commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Hi")

        kwargs = client.post.call_args.kwargs
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get("token"), "MY_PAGE_TOKEN_XYZ")


class TestFBCommenterErrorHandling(unittest.TestCase):
    """FC07-FC11, FC15: Graph error mapping + cancellation never raise."""

    def _make_raising_client(self, code: int, msg: str = "test"):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient, GraphError
        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        err = GraphError(msg, code=code)
        client.post.side_effect = err
        return client

    def test_FC07_token_invalid_returns_failed(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_raising_client(190, "OAuth expired")
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Hi")
        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "190")

    def test_FC08_permission_denied_returns_failed(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_raising_client(200, "Permission required")
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Hi")
        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "200")

    def test_FC09_rate_limit_returns_failed(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_raising_client(32, "Rate limit")
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Hi")
        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "32")

    def test_FC10_stop_event_returns_user_cancelled(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter

        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        stop = threading.Event()
        stop.set()

        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN", stop_event=stop)
        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Hi")

        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "user_cancelled")
        client.post.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC11_unexpected_exception_no_raise(self):
        from core.graph_client import GraphClient
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter

        client = MagicMock(spec=GraphClient)
        client.post.side_effect = ConnectionError("Network down")

        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")
        # Must NOT raise
        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Hi")
        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "unexpected_error")

    def test_FC15_spam_368_returns_failed(self):
        from core.facebook.commenter import FacebookCommenter
        client = self._make_raising_client(368, "Spam detected")
        commenter = FacebookCommenter(client, "PAGE_TOKEN")

        result = commenter.post_comment("vid_1", "Buy now! www.example.com")
        self.assertFalse(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.error_code, "368")

class TestFBPublisherStage7(unittest.TestCase):
    """FC20-FC28: FacebookPublisher correctly invokes FacebookCommenter."""

    def _make_publisher(self, comment_enabled=True):
        # comment_enabled defaults True here so the Stage-7 comment path is
        # exercised. Production config defaults fb_comment_enabled=False (the
        # pages_manage_engagement permission is not in the App Review scope).
        from core.facebook.publisher_service import FacebookPublisher
        return FacebookPublisher(
            config     = {"graph_api_version": "v21.0",
                          "fb_comment_enabled": comment_enabled},
            stop_event = threading.Event(),
            on_log     = lambda m, l: None,
            on_status  = lambda m: None,
        )

    def test_FC29_comment_disabled_skips_commenter(self):
        """fb_comment_enabled=False → feed+comment must NOT invoke commenter."""
        publisher = self._make_publisher(comment_enabled=False)
        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            task = {
                "page":       "MyPage",
                "video_path": "v.mp4",
                "post_type":  "feed",
                "comment":    "Great!",
            }
            result = publisher.publish(task)
            MockCommenter.assert_not_called()
            self.assertTrue(result.success)          # publish still succeeds

    def _patch_engine(self, video_url="https://fb.com/x/videos/V99", video_id="V99"):
        return patch(
            "core.facebook.publisher_service.UploadEngine.run_sync",
            return_value=(video_url, video_id),
        )

    def _patch_token_store(self):
        """Patch get_default_store to return a fake account+page."""
        store = MagicMock()
        account = MagicMock()
        account.is_token_valid.return_value = True
        page = MagicMock()
        page.access_token = "PAGE_TOKEN_XYZ"
        page.name = "MyPage"
        page.id = "111"
        store.find_page_by_name.return_value = (account, page)
        return patch(
            "core.token_store.get_default_store",
            return_value=store,
        )

    def test_FC20_feed_with_comment_invokes_commenter(self):
        publisher = self._make_publisher()

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            from core.facebook.commenter import CommentResult
            instance = MockCommenter.return_value
            instance.post_comment.return_value = CommentResult(
                success=True, comment_id="cm_42", text="Great!",
            )

            task = {
                "page":       "MyPage",
                "video_path": "v.mp4",
                "post_type":  "feed",
                "comment":    "Great!",
            }
            publisher.publish(task)
            instance.post_comment.assert_called_once_with("V99", "Great!")

    def test_FC21_reels_with_comment_SKIPS_commenter(self):
        publisher = self._make_publisher()

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            task = {
                "page":       "MyPage",
                "video_path": "v.mp4",
                "post_type":  "reels",
                "comment":    "Great!",
            }
            publisher.publish(task)
            MockCommenter.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC22_empty_comment_skips_commenter(self):
        publisher = self._make_publisher()

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            task = {
                "page":       "MyPage",
                "video_path": "v.mp4",
                "post_type":  "feed",
                "comment":    "",
            }
            publisher.publish(task)
            MockCommenter.assert_not_called()

    def test_FC23_success_writes_facebook_comment_posted(self):
        publisher = self._make_publisher()
        events: list[dict] = []

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter, \
             patch("utils.audit_logger.append_event",
                   side_effect=lambda ev, **kw: events.append({"event": ev, **kw})):
            from core.facebook.commenter import CommentResult
            MockCommenter.return_value.post_comment.return_value = CommentResult(
                success=True, comment_id="cm_42", text="Yay",
            )
            task = {"page": "MyPage", "video_path": "v.mp4",
                    "post_type": "feed", "comment": "Yay"}
            publisher.publish(task)

        names = [e["event"] for e in events]
        self.assertIn("facebook_comment_posted", names)
        posted = [e for e in events if e["event"] == "facebook_comment_posted"][0]
        self.assertEqual(posted.get("publish_id"), "V99")

    def test_FC24_empty_comment_does_not_write_audit(self):
        """Empty comment: no commenter, no audit event."""
        publisher = self._make_publisher()
        events: list[dict] = []

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("utils.audit_logger.append_event",
                   side_effect=lambda ev, **kw: events.append({"event": ev, **kw})):
            task = {"page": "MyPage", "video_path": "v.mp4",
                    "post_type": "feed", "comment": ""}
            publisher.publish(task)

        names = [e["event"] for e in events]
        self.assertNotIn("facebook_comment_posted", names)
        self.assertNotIn("facebook_comment_skipped", names)
        self.assertNotIn("facebook_comment_failed", names)

    def test_FC25_api_error_writes_facebook_comment_failed(self):
        publisher = self._make_publisher()
        events: list[dict] = []

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter, \
             patch("utils.audit_logger.append_event",
                   side_effect=lambda ev, **kw: events.append({"event": ev, **kw})):
            from core.facebook.commenter import CommentResult
            MockCommenter.return_value.post_comment.return_value = CommentResult(
                success=False, error_code="200",
                message="Permission denied", text="Hi",
            )
            task = {"page": "MyPage", "video_path": "v.mp4",
                    "post_type": "feed", "comment": "Hi"}
            publisher.publish(task)

        names = [e["event"] for e in events]
        self.assertIn("facebook_comment_failed", names)
        failed = [e for e in events if e["event"] == "facebook_comment_failed"][0]
        self.assertEqual(failed.get("error_code"), "200")

    def test_FC26_comment_failure_preserves_publish_success(self):
        """Critical: comment errors must NEVER break a successful publish."""
        publisher = self._make_publisher()

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            from core.facebook.commenter import CommentResult
            MockCommenter.return_value.post_comment.return_value = CommentResult(
                success=False, error_code="32",
                message="rate limit", text="Hi",
            )
            task = {"page": "MyPage", "video_path": "v.mp4",
                    "post_type": "feed", "comment": "Hi"}
            result = publisher.publish(task)

        self.assertTrue(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.external_post_id, "V99")
        self.assertEqual(result.status, "published")

    def test_FC27_commenter_exception_does_not_break_publish(self):
        publisher = self._make_publisher()

        with self._patch_engine(), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            MockCommenter.side_effect = RuntimeError("boom")
            task = {"page": "MyPage", "video_path": "v.mp4",
                    "post_type": "feed", "comment": "Hi"}
            result = publisher.publish(task)

        self.assertTrue(result.success)
        self.assertEqual(result.external_post_id, "V99")

    def test_FC28_engine_receives_empty_comment_to_avoid_double_post(self):
        """FB publisher must clear task['comment'] before calling engine —
        otherwise engine ALSO calls post_comment internally → duplicate.
        """
        publisher = self._make_publisher()

        captured = {}

        def fake_run_sync(self_engine, task_arg):
            captured["task"] = task_arg
            return ("https://fb.com/x/videos/V1", "V1")

        with patch("core.upload_engine.UploadEngine.run_sync", fake_run_sync), \
             self._patch_token_store(), \
             patch("core.facebook.commenter.FacebookCommenter") as MockCommenter:
            from core.facebook.commenter import CommentResult
            MockCommenter.return_value.post_comment.return_value = CommentResult(
                success=True, comment_id="cm", text="Yay",
            )
            task = {"page": "MyPage", "video_path": "v.mp4",
                    "post_type": "feed", "comment": "Yay"}
            publisher.publish(task)

        # The task passed to engine must have comment cleared
        self.assertEqual(captured["task"].get("comment"), "")
        # But the original task is untouched
        self.assertEqual(task["comment"], "Yay")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

def test_option_matrix_covers_customer_visible_compatibility_surface():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "upscale_option_matrix", ROOT / "tools" / "upscale_option_matrix.py")
    assert spec and spec.loader
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    cases = module._cases()
    core = {(item["preset"], item["height"], item["codec"])
            for item in cases if not item["flags"]}

    assert core == {(preset, height, codec)
                    for preset in ("fast", "quality")
                    for height in (1080, 1440, 2160)
                    for codec in ("h264", "hevc")}
    flags = {flag for item in cases for flag in item["flags"]}
    assert {"--no-preserve-fps", "--no-preserve-audio", "--preview",
            "--stabilize", "--smooth-motion"} <= flags

        "model": "seedance-2.0-mini", "resolution": "480p",

def test_submit_lai_cung_quote_khong_tao_job_hay_giu_credit_lan_hai(db):
    from apps.taovideo import quotes
    from platform_core import credit
    from platform_core.models import JOB_DONE, Job

    bao_dam_user(db, "u1")
    credit.nap(db, "u1", 500); db.commit()
    _token, quote = quotes.issue("u1", _params(), 2, False)
    base = {**_params(), "prompt": "a test video", "owner_id": "u1", "refs": []}

    first = quotes.submit_batch(
        db, user_id="u1", quote=quote, base_params=base, fixed_seed=100)
    db.commit()
    first_ids = [job.id for job in first]
    after_first = credit.so_du(db, "u1")
    for job in first:
        job.status = JOB_DONE
    db.commit()

    replay = quotes.submit_batch(
        db, user_id="u1", quote=quote, base_params=base, fixed_seed=100)
    db.commit()

    assert [job.id for job in replay] == first_ids
    assert db.query(Job).filter_by(app_slug="taovideo").count() == 2
    assert credit.so_du(db, "u1") == after_first
    assert replay[0].params["seed"] == 100
    assert replay[1].params["seed"] == 101

def test_chi_promote_sau_hold_va_gan_job_owner(env):
    from platform_core import credit, upload_sessions
    from platform_core.job_submit import submit_with_credit
    from platform_core.models import Job
    db, storage = env
    session = _session(db)
    storage.put(session.staging_key, io.BytesIO(MP4), content_type="video/mp4")
    no_hold = Job(user_id="u1", app_slug="demo", job_type="demo.reverse",
                  params={"text": "x"})
    db.add(no_hold); db.flush()
    with pytest.raises(upload_sessions.UploadSessionError, match="credit"):
        upload_sessions.promote(
            db, storage, session, job=no_hold, final_key=f"demo/u1/{no_hold.id}/source.mp4")
    db.rollback()

    session = _session(db)
    storage.put(session.staging_key, io.BytesIO(MP4), content_type="video/mp4")
    credit.nap(db, "u1", 10)
    job = submit_with_credit(db, user_id="u1", app_slug="demo",
                             job_type="demo.reverse", params={"text": "x"})
    final = f"demo/u1/{job.id}/source.mp4"
    key = upload_sessions.promote(db, storage, session, job=job, final_key=final)
    db.commit()

    assert key == final and storage.exists(final)
    assert not storage.exists(session.staging_key)
    assert session.status == "promoted" and session.job_id == job.id


def test_attach_project_owner_scoped_ttl_va_sweep(env):
    from platform_core import upload_sessions
    db, storage = env
    start = datetime(2026, 8, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    session = _session(db, now=start)
    storage.put(session.staging_key, io.BytesIO(MP4), content_type="video/mp4")
    final = "demo/u1/drafts/project-1/source.mp4"

    key = upload_sessions.attach_to_project(
        db, storage, session, project_id="project-1", final_key=final, now=start)
    db.commit()

    assert key == final and session.status == "attached"
    assert session.project_id == "project-1" and storage.exists(final)
    assert upload_sessions.project_attachment(
        db, user_id="u1", app_slug="demo", project_id="project-1",
        final_key=final) is session
    assert upload_sessions.project_attachment(
        db, user_id="other", app_slug="demo", project_id="project-1",
        final_key=final) is None

    assert upload_sessions.touch_project_attachment(
        db, session, now=start + timedelta(days=29)) is True
    report = upload_sessions.sweep(
        db, storage, now=start + timedelta(days=31), dry_run=False)
    assert report["due"] == 0 and storage.exists(final)
    report = upload_sessions.sweep(
        db, storage, now=start + timedelta(days=60), dry_run=False)
    assert report["deleted"] == 1 and not storage.exists(final)

def test_sweeper_dry_run_delete_idempotent_va_reconcile(env):
    from platform_core import upload_sessions
    db, storage = env
    start = datetime(2026, 8, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    session = _session(db, now=start)
    storage.put(session.staging_key, io.BytesIO(MP4), content_type="video/mp4")
    db.commit()
    later = start + timedelta(hours=2)

    dry = upload_sessions.sweep(db, storage, now=later, dry_run=True)
    assert dry["due"] == 1 and dry["deleted"] == 0
    assert storage.exists(session.staging_key)

    done = upload_sessions.sweep(db, storage, now=later, dry_run=False)
    db.commit()
    again = upload_sessions.sweep(db, storage, now=later, dry_run=False)
    assert done["deleted"] == 1 and again["deleted"] == 0
    assert upload_sessions.reconcile(db, storage)["missing"] == 0


def test_compensate_tra_file_ve_staging_sau_db_rollback(env):

"""R2 route integration — media chỉ bền vững sau hold, retry không thu lại."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
import re

from PIL import Image


MP4 = b"\x00\x00\x00\x18ftypisom" + b"x" * 52


def _png() -> bytes:
    stream = io.BytesIO()
    Image.new("RGB", (64, 64), (180, 20, 20)).save(stream, format="PNG")
    return stream.getvalue()


def _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, credit_amount=100):
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    from platform_core.credit import cap_tay
    from platform_core.storage import LocalStorage, set_storage
    from platform_core.users import tao_nguoi_dung

    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL",
                       f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'routes.db').as_posix()}")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "data"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_ENV", "development")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SESSION_SECRET", "upload-route-contract")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
    monkeypatch.delenv("TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY", raising=False)
    dbmod.reset_engine(); dbmod.Base.metadata.create_all(dbmod.get_engine())
    storage = LocalStorage(str(tmp_path / "storage")); set_storage(storage)
    gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
    user = tao_nguoi_dung(db, email="upload-route@example.com",
                          password="Browser-pass-123", is_verified=True)
    db.flush()
    if credit_amount:
        cap_tay(db, user.id, credit_amount, by="fixture", note="R2 route")
    db.commit(); user_id = user.id; db.close()

    from server.app import create_app
    client = TestClient(create_app(), base_url="https://testserver",
                        follow_redirects=False)
    login = client.get("/login")
    csrf = re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', login.text).group(1)
    assert client.post("/login", data={
        "username": "upload-route@example.com", "password": "Browser-pass-123",
        "csrf_token": csrf,
    }).status_code == 303
    return client, dbmod, storage, user_id, set_storage


def _csrf(client, path: str) -> str:
    page = client.get(path)
    assert page.status_code == 200
    return re.search(r'name="csrf_token" value="([^"]+)"', page.text).group(1)


def _rows(dbmod, app_slug: str):
    from platform_core.models import Job, UploadSession
    from sqlalchemy import select
    gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
    try:
        jobs = list(db.execute(select(Job).where(Job.app_slug == app_slug)).scalars())
        sessions = list(db.execute(select(UploadSession).where(
            UploadSession.app_slug == app_slug)).scalars())
        return jobs, sessions
    finally:
        db.close()


def test_upscale_promote_va_retry_cung_ve_khong_giu_credit_lan_hai(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from platform_core.credit import so_du
    client, dbmod, storage, user_id, reset_storage = _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    try:
        csrf = _csrf(client, "/upscalevideo")
        first = client.post("/upscalevideo/queue", data={
            "csrf_token": csrf, "duration_s": "1", "preset": "fast",
            "target_height": "1080", "codec": "h264", "ajax": "1",
        }, files={"video": ("sample.mp4", MP4, "video/mp4")})
        assert first.status_code == 200
        jobs, sessions = _rows(dbmod, "upscalevideo")
        assert len(jobs) == len(sessions) == 1 and sessions[0].status == "promoted"
        assert storage.exists(sessions[0].final_key)
        assert not storage.exists(sessions[0].staging_key)
        gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
        balance = so_du(db, user_id); db.close()

        replay = client.post("/upscalevideo/queue", data={
            "csrf_token": csrf, "video_key": sessions[0].staging_key,
            "duration_s": "1", "preset": "fast", "target_height": "1080",
            "codec": "h264", "ajax": "1",
        })
        assert replay.status_code == 200
        jobs, _sessions = _rows(dbmod, "upscalevideo")
        gen = dbmod.get_session(); db = next(gen)
        assert len(jobs) == 1 and so_du(db, user_id) == balance
        db.close()
    finally:
        client.close(); dbmod.reset_engine(); reset_storage(None)

"""R3: benchmark ASR không được bịa WER khi chưa có ground truth."""
from __future__ import annotations

from tools.autosub_asr_benchmark import _result_metrics, _words


def _sample_result() -> dict:
    return {
        "engine": "whisperx",
        "alignment_status": "aligned",
        "language": "vi",
        "segments": [{
            "start": 0.0,
            "end": 1.0,
            "text": "xin chao",
            "words": [
                {"start": 0.0, "end": 0.4, "text": "xin"},
                {"start": 0.5, "end": 1.0, "text": "chao"},
            ],
        }],
    }


def test_smoke_without_ground_truth_keeps_wer_unknown():
    metrics = _result_metrics(_sample_result(), reference=[], duration=2, elapsed=1)
    assert metrics["segments"] == 1
    assert metrics["aligned_words"] == 2
    assert metrics["word_timing_monotonic"] is True
    assert metrics["word_error_rate"] is None


def test_ground_truth_still_produces_real_wer():
    exact = _result_metrics(
        _sample_result(), reference=_words("xin chao"), duration=2, elapsed=1)
    different = _result_metrics(
        _sample_result(), reference=_words("xin tam biet"), duration=2, elapsed=1)
    assert exact["word_error_rate"] == 0.0
    assert different["word_error_rate"] > 0

"""Q88: app APIs always receive JSON errors, while browser pages stay HTML."""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


def test_nested_app_api_error_is_json_but_page_error_is_html(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATABASE_URL", f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'api.db').as_posix()}")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "data"))
    import platform_core.db as dbmod
    dbmod.reset_engine()
    from server.app import create_app
    app = create_app(env={"LTT_ENV":"local-server-test",
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET":"api-error-contract", "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME":"",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH":"", "LTT_CONFIG_PATH":str(tmp_path / "config.json")})
    router = APIRouter()

    @router.get("/sample/api/fail")
    def api_fail():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="actionable")

    @router.get("/sample/page/fail")
    def page_fail():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="page")

    app.include_router(router)
    try:
        with TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver") as client:
            api = client.get("/sample/api/fail")
            page = client.get("/sample/page/fail")
        assert api.status_code == 422 and api.json()["detail"] == "actionable"
        assert api.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
        assert api.headers["cache-control"] == "no-store"
        assert page.status_code == 422 and page.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/html")
    finally:
        # create_app uses the process-wide DB engine. Leaving this engine bound
        # to pytest's soon-to-be-removed tmp_path poisons later page tests in a
        # full-suite run even though this file passes in isolation.
        dbmod.reset_engine()


def test_json_error_detail_drops_request_input_and_exception_context():
    from server.app import _json_error_detail
    detail = [{"type":"value_error", "msg":"invalid", "input":{"secret":"x"},
               "ctx":{"error":ValueError("boom")}, "loc":("body", "field")}]
    assert _json_error_detail(detail) == [{"type":"value_error", "msg":"invalid",
                                           "loc":["body", "field"]}]

"""Hồ sơ hệ thống phải đầy đủ, tái tạo được và không đọc dữ liệu runtime."""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PROFILE = ROOT / "ho_so_he_thong.txt"


def test_profile_is_current_and_utf8_without_bom():
    raw = PROFILE.read_bytes()
    assert raw and not raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf")
    raw.decode("utf-8")
    done = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "tools/build_system_profile.py", "--check"],
        cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr


def test_profile_covers_every_app_job_tool_migration_and_frontend():
    from platform_core.registry import discover
    from tools.system_profile.builder import migrations

    text = PROFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for loaded in discover():
        assert f"[{loaded.slug}] {loaded.manifest.display_name}" in text
        for job_type in loaded.manifest.job_types:
            assert job_type in text
        for tool in loaded.manifest.tools:
            assert tool.name in text
    for migration in migrations():
        assert migration["revision"] in text
    for package in (ROOT / "frontend").glob("*/package.json"):
        assert package.parent.name in text
    assert "GET    /favicon.ico" in text
    assert "server/app.py:" in text


def test_profile_embeds_every_selected_source_once_without_size_limit():

        (ROOT / "tools/system_profile_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        "alembic", "apps", "codex_sidecar", "core", "cutclipshort", "deploy",
        "frontend", "platform_core", "scripts", "server", "setup", "tests",
        "tools", "utils",

    assert required_roots.issubset(config["source_roots"])
    required_entrypoints = {
        "codex_sidecar_main.py", "job_worker.py", "worker_main.py",
        "requirements-whisperx.txt",
    }
    assert required_entrypoints.issubset(config["root_sources"])

    marker = "@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_BEGIN@@@ "
    text = PROFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    embedded = [line[len(marker):] for line in text.splitlines()
                if line.startswith(marker)]
    expected = [path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for path in source_files()]
    assert embedded == expected
    assert len(embedded) == len(set(embedded))
    assert any(path.startswith("apps/") for path in embedded)
    assert any(path.startswith("platform_core/") for path in embedded)
    assert any(path.startswith("frontend/") for path in embedded)


def test_profile_source_blocks_have_original_byte_hashes():
    import hashlib

    from tools.system_profile import source_files

    marker = "@@@LTT_PROFILE_FILE_BEGIN@@@ "
    lines = PROFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    metadata = {
        line[len(marker):]: lines[index + 1]
        for index, line in enumerate(lines[:-1])
        if line.startswith(marker)
    }
    for path in source_files():
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert metadata[relative].startswith(f"SHA256={digest} ")

"""Q92 — Public API kernel: mounting, kill switches, error contract, inventory.

These tests hold four properties that are cheap to break later:

1. the surface is **off** unless an operator turns it on, and turning it on does
   not move any existing route;
2. every failure on ``/api/v1`` is problem+json with a request id — including
   the ones no handler was written for;
3. the read-only switch stops writes without touching reads or the UI;
4. no route exists on ``/api/v1`` that is not in the declared inventory.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from platform_core.public_api.config import (DEFAULT_MAX_BODY_BYTES,
                                             MAX_MAX_BODY_BYTES,

from platform_core.public_api.errors import (ApiError, ApiProblem,
                                             GENERIC_INTERNAL_DETAIL,
                                             PROBLEM_CONTENT_TYPE,
                                             problem_for_status, scrub_detail)
from platform_core.public_api.pagination import (MAX_PAGE_LIMIT, Page, PageRequest)
from server.api.inventory import API_V1_PREFIX, declared_paths, documented_paths

BASE_ENV = {
    "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
    "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "public-api-kernel-secret",
    "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "",
    "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": "",
}


def _app(**overrides):
    from server.app import create_app

    return create_app(env={**BASE_ENV, **overrides})


def _app_with_api(**overrides):
    """Build the platform app and hand back the mounted public sub-app.

    Tests that need a throwaway endpoint must add it to the sub-application:
    a route on the parent would not be part of the public surface at all, so it
    would prove nothing about the guards this surface applies.
    """
    app = _app(LTT_PUBLIC_API="1", **overrides)
    for route in app.routes:
        if getattr(route, "name", "") == "public_api":
            return app, route.app
    raise AssertionError("public API sub-application was not mounted")

    with TestClient(_app(LTT_PUBLIC_API="1")) as client:
        yield client

    assert not {"health", "me", "capabilities"} & set(body["capabilities"])
    body = capabilities.text.lower()
    for leak in ("gemini", "seedance", "postgres", "r2", "c:\\", "/data/", "secret"):
        assert leak not in body

def test_app_nested_api_keeps_the_q88_contract():
    """The Q88 shape must not change just because a new surface exists."""
    from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

    app = _app(LTT_PUBLIC_API="1")
    router = APIRouter()

    @router.get("/sample/api/fail")
    def sample_fail():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="actionable")

    app.include_router(router)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = client.get("/sample/api/fail")
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
    assert "problem" not in response.headers["content-type"]
    assert response.json()["detail"] == "actionable"

def test_principal_resolution_is_deny_all_with_no_resolver_installed():
    """Fail-closed default. Prompt 04 installs the database-backed resolver."""
    from server.api import deps

    class _Request:
        headers = {"authorization": "Bearer whatever"}

    previous = deps.current_resolver()
    deps.set_principal_resolver(None)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(ApiError) as raised:
            deps.resolve_principal(_Request(), None)
        assert raised.value.status == 401
    finally:
        deps.set_principal_resolver(previous)


def test_principal_never_reads_the_browser_session():
    """A logged-in browser must not be able to spend credit through the API."""
    from server.api import deps

    captured = {}

    class _Session(dict):
        def __getitem__(self, key):  # pragma: no cover - must not be called
            captured["read"] = key
            return super().__getitem__(key)

    class _Request:
        headers = {}
        session = _Session({"sid": "browser-session"})

    previous = deps.current_resolver()
    deps.set_principal_resolver(lambda request, db: None)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(ApiError):
            deps.resolve_principal(_Request(), None)
    finally:
        deps.set_principal_resolver(previous)
    assert captured == {}
    assert deps.bearer_token(_Request()) == ""


def test_bearer_token_parsing_is_case_insensitive_and_trims():
    from server.api import deps

    class _Request:
        headers = {"authorization": "bearer   abc.def  "}

    assert deps.bearer_token(_Request()) == "abc.def"


# ── Trusted proxy / client IP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_forwarding_headers_are_only_believed_from_a_trusted_peer():
    from server.api.context import client_ip

    class _Client:
        def __init__(self, host):
            self.host = host

    class _Request:
        def __init__(self, host, headers):
            self.client = _Client(host)
            self.headers = headers

    trusted = ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
    spoofed = _Request("203.0.113.9", {"cf-connecting-ip": "1.2.3.4",
                                       "x-forwarded-for": "5.6.7.8"})
    assert client_ip(spoofed, trusted) == "203.0.113.9"

    tunnelled = _Request("127.0.0.1", {"cf-connecting-ip": "1.2.3.4"})
    assert client_ip(tunnelled, trusted) == "1.2.3.4"

    no_header = _Request("127.0.0.1", {})
    assert client_ip(no_header, trusted) == "127.0.0.1"

    assert client_ip(tunnelled, ()) == "127.0.0.1"


# ── Pagination primitives ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_pagination_has_a_hard_ceiling_and_rejects_nonsense():
    assert PageRequest.parse().limit == 20
    assert PageRequest.parse(limit=100000).limit == MAX_PAGE_LIMIT
    assert PageRequest.parse(limit="5", offset="10") == PageRequest(limit=5, offset=10)
    for bad in ({"limit": "-1"}, {"limit": "0"}, {"limit": "abc"},
                {"offset": "-3"}, {"offset": 10_000_000}):
        with pytest.raises(ApiError):
            PageRequest.parse(**bad)


def test_page_uses_one_extra_row_to_report_has_more():
    request = PageRequest(limit=2, offset=4)
    assert request.fetch_limit == 3
    full = Page.of([1, 2, 3], request).to_dict()
    assert full["items"] == [1, 2]
    assert full["page"] == {"limit": 2, "offset": 4, "has_more": True, "next_offset": 6}
    last = Page.of([1], request).to_dict()
    assert last["items"] == [1] and last["page"]["has_more"] is False
    assert "next_offset" not in last["page"]

"""Q92 / Prompt 03 — developer API key domain.

The properties held here are the ones whose absence is expensive later: a key
that survives revocation, a plaintext that lingers in the database, one customer
reading another's keys, or an auth path that tells an attacker which key ids
exist.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from platform_core.public_api import keys as devkeys
from platform_core.public_api.scopes import (DEFAULT_SCOPES, SCOPE_JOBS_CREATE,
                                             ScopeError, normalize_scopes)
from platform_core.public_api.tables import (DEVKEY_ACTIVE, DEVKEY_DISABLED,
                                             DEVKEY_EXPIRED, DEVKEY_REVOKED,
                                             DeveloperApiKey, KEY_PREFIX)

PEPPER = "test-pepper-" + "a" * 40
OTHER_PEPPER = "rotated-pepper-" + "b" * 40
ENV = {devkeys.PEPPER_ENV: PEPPER}


@pytest.fixture()
def db(tmp_path):
    import platform_core.models  # noqa: F401 - registers every table
    from platform_core.db import Base

    engine = sa.create_engine(f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'keys.db').as_posix()}",
                              future=True)
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    session = sessionmaker(bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False)()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()
        engine.dispose()


def _user(db, email: str = "dev@example.com"):
    from platform_core.users import tao_nguoi_dung

    user = tao_nguoi_dung(db, email=email, password="a-good-password-12")
    db.commit()
    return user


def _issue(db, user, **kwargs):
    key, token = devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, env=ENV, **kwargs)
    db.commit()
    return key, token


# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_issuing_without_a_pepper_fails_closed(db):
    user = _user(db)
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, env={})
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, env={devkeys.PEPPER_ENV: "too-short"})


def test_pepper_is_never_written_to_the_row(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, _token = _issue(db, user)
    assert PEPPER not in "".join(str(value) for value in [
        key.verifier_digest, key.key_id, key.name])


# ── Token format and entropy ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_token_shape_is_recognisable_and_high_entropy(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, token = _issue(db, user, name="ci")
    assert token.startswith(f"{KEY_PREFIX}_")
    parsed = devkeys.parse_token(token)
    assert parsed is not None
    key_id, secret = parsed
    assert key_id == key.key_id
    assert len(key_id) == devkeys.KEY_ID_LENGTH
    # 43 urlsafe-base64 characters carry >= 256 bits.
    assert len(secret) == devkeys.SECRET_LENGTH


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [
    "", "not-a-token", "ltt_sk_short_secret", "ltt_pk_" + "a" * 32 + "_" + "b" * 43,
    "ltt_sk_" + "z" * 32 + "_" + "b" * 43,          # key_id not hex
    "ltt_sk_" + "a" * 31 + "_" + "b" * 43,          # key_id too short
    "ltt_sk_" + "a" * 32 + "_" + "b" * 42,          # secret too short
    "ltt_sk_" + "a" * 32 + "_" + "b" * 43 + "_x",   # extra segment
])
def test_malformed_tokens_are_rejected_by_shape(bad):
    assert devkeys.parse_token(bad) is None


def test_a_secret_containing_an_underscore_still_parses(db, monkeypatch):
    """Regression: the secret is urlsafe base64, so "_" is part of its alphabet.

    A naive ``split("_")`` shredded roughly a third of all issued tokens — they
    verified in one test run and failed in the next, which is the worst possible
    failure mode for a credential.
    """
    user = _user(db)
    tricky = "a_b-c" + "d" * (devkeys.SECRET_LENGTH - 5)
    monkeypatch.setattr(devkeys, "_new_secret", lambda: tricky)
    _key, token = _issue(db, user)
    assert devkeys.parse_token(token) == (token.split("_", 3)[2], tricky)
    assert devkeys.verify(db, token, env=ENV) is not None


def test_two_keys_never_share_material(db):
    user = _user(db)
    first, first_token = _issue(db, user)
    second, second_token = _issue(db, user)
    assert first.key_id != second.key_id
    assert first.verifier_digest != second.verifier_digest
    assert first_token != second_token


def test_key_id_collision_is_retried_not_crashed(db, monkeypatch):
    user = _user(db)
    taken, _token = _issue(db, user)
    generated = iter([taken.key_id, "f" * 32])
    monkeypatch.setattr(devkeys, "_new_key_id", lambda: next(generated))
    key, token = _issue(db, user)
    assert key.key_id == "f" * 32
    assert devkeys.verify(db, token, env=ENV) is not None


# ── One-time reveal / no plaintext at rest ────────────────────────────────────

def test_plaintext_exists_only_in_the_issue_return_value(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, token = _issue(db, user)
    _key_id, secret = devkeys.parse_token(token)

    row = db.execute(sa.text("SELECT * FROM developer_api_keys")).mappings().one()
    serialized = " ".join(str(value) for value in row.values())
    assert secret not in serialized
    assert token not in serialized
    # The digest is present, and it is not the secret.
    assert key.verifier_digest in serialized
    assert repr(key).find(secret) == -1


def test_a_reloaded_key_cannot_reproduce_its_token(db):
    user = _user(db)
    _key, token = _issue(db, user)
    db.expire_all()
    reloaded = db.execute(sa.select(DeveloperApiKey)).scalar_one()
    assert not hasattr(reloaded, "secret")
    assert token.split("_")[-1] not in reloaded.verifier_digest

    user = _user(db)
    key, token = _issue(db, user)
    resolved = devkeys.verify(db, token, env=ENV)
    assert resolved is not None and resolved.id == key.id


def test_wrong_secret_for_a_real_key_id_is_refused(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, _token = _issue(db, user)
    forged = devkeys.format_token(key.key_id, "c" * devkeys.SECRET_LENGTH)
    assert devkeys.verify(db, forged, env=ENV) is None


def test_unknown_key_id_and_malformed_token_answer_the_same_way(db):
    user = _user(db)
    _issue(db, user)
    unknown = devkeys.format_token("d" * 32, "e" * devkeys.SECRET_LENGTH)
    assert devkeys.verify(db, unknown, env=ENV) is None
    assert devkeys.verify(db, "garbage", env=ENV) is None
    assert devkeys.verify(db, "", env=ENV) is None


def test_verification_hashes_even_for_unknown_keys(db, monkeypatch):
    """No early return that would make "key exists" measurable."""
    user = _user(db)
    _issue(db, user)
    calls = []
    original = devkeys.digest_secret
    monkeypatch.setattr(devkeys, "digest_secret",
                        lambda secret, pepper: calls.append(1) or original(secret, pepper))

    devkeys.verify(db, devkeys.format_token("d" * 32, "e" * devkeys.SECRET_LENGTH),
                   env=ENV)
    assert calls, "unknown key id must still perform a digest"
    calls.clear()
    devkeys.verify(db, "totally-malformed", env=ENV)
    assert calls, "malformed token must still perform a digest"


def test_revoked_disabled_and_expired_keys_stop_working(db):
    user = _user(db)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    revoked_key, revoked_token = _issue(db, user)
    devkeys.revoke(db, revoked_key)
    db.commit()
    assert devkeys.verify(db, revoked_token, env=ENV) is None
    assert revoked_key.status() == DEVKEY_REVOKED

    disabled_key, disabled_token = _issue(db, user)
    devkeys.set_enabled(db, disabled_key, False)
    db.commit()
    assert devkeys.verify(db, disabled_token, env=ENV) is None
    assert disabled_key.status() == DEVKEY_DISABLED

    expiring_key, expiring_token = _issue(db, user,
                                          expires_at=now + timedelta(minutes=5))
    assert devkeys.verify(db, expiring_token, env=ENV) is not None
    later = now + timedelta(minutes=10)
    assert devkeys.verify(db, expiring_token, env=ENV, now=later) is None
    assert expiring_key.status(now=later) == DEVKEY_EXPIRED
    assert expiring_key.status(now=now) == DEVKEY_ACTIVE


def test_revocation_cannot_be_undone(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, _token = _issue(db, user)
    assert devkeys.revoke(db, key) is True
    assert devkeys.revoke(db, key) is False
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.set_enabled(db, key, True)
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.rotate(db, key, env=ENV)


def test_rotation_invalidates_the_previous_secret(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, old_token = _issue(db, user, name="ci", scopes=[SCOPE_JOBS_CREATE])
    new_token = devkeys.rotate(db, key, env=ENV)
    db.commit()
    assert new_token != old_token
    assert devkeys.verify(db, old_token, env=ENV) is None
    rotated = devkeys.verify(db, new_token, env=ENV)
    assert rotated is not None and rotated.id == key.id
    # Policy and identity survive the rotation; only the secret material moves.
    assert rotated.name == "ci" and rotated.scopes == [SCOPE_JOBS_CREATE]
    assert rotated.rotated_at is not None


# ── Pepper rotation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_a_key_issued_under_an_old_pepper_still_verifies(db):
    user = _user(db)
    old_env = {devkeys.PEPPER_ENV: PEPPER, devkeys.PEPPER_VERSION_ENV: "1"}
    key, token = devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, env=old_env)
    db.commit()
    assert key.pepper_version == 1

    rotated_env = {
        devkeys.PEPPER_ENV: OTHER_PEPPER,
        devkeys.PEPPER_VERSION_ENV: "2",
        f"{devkeys.RETIRED_PEPPER_PREFIX}1": PEPPER,
    }
    assert devkeys.verify(db, token, env=rotated_env) is not None

    # New keys are issued under the new pepper.
    fresh_key, fresh_token = devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, env=rotated_env)
    db.commit()
    assert fresh_key.pepper_version == 2
    assert devkeys.verify(db, fresh_token, env=rotated_env) is not None


def test_a_missing_old_pepper_fails_closed_rather_than_open(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, token = devkeys.issue(
        db, user_id=user.id,
        env={devkeys.PEPPER_ENV: PEPPER, devkeys.PEPPER_VERSION_ENV: "1"})
    db.commit()
    assert key.pepper_version == 1
    lost = {devkeys.PEPPER_ENV: OTHER_PEPPER, devkeys.PEPPER_VERSION_ENV: "2"}
    assert devkeys.verify(db, token, env=lost) is None


# ── Ownership ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_one_customer_cannot_reach_another_customers_key(db):
    alice = _user(db, "alice@example.com")
    bob = _user(db, "bob@example.com")
    alice_key, alice_token = _issue(db, alice)
    _bob_key, _bob_token = _issue(db, bob)

    assert devkeys.get_owned(db, user_id=bob.id, key_id=alice_key.key_id) is None
    assert devkeys.get_owned(db, user_id=alice.id, key_id=alice_key.key_id) is not None
    assert [key.id for key in devkeys.list_for_user(db, bob.id)] != [alice_key.id]
    assert alice_key.id not in [key.id for key in devkeys.list_for_user(db, bob.id)]
    # Alice's token still resolves to Alice, never to Bob.
    resolved = devkeys.verify(db, alice_token, env=ENV)
    assert resolved is not None and resolved.user_id == alice.id


def test_a_key_must_belong_to_someone(db):
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id="", env=ENV)


# ── Limits and policy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_scopes_are_validated_and_defaulted(db):

    with pytest.raises(ScopeError):

    with pytest.raises(ScopeError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, scopes=["make:coffee"], env=ENV)

    assert key.allowed_tools == ["a.b", "c.d"]
    other, _token2 = _issue(db, user)
    assert other.allowed_tools == []


def test_expiry_must_be_sane(db):
    user = _user(db)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, expires_at=now - timedelta(days=1), env=ENV)
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, expires_at=now + timedelta(days=400), env=ENV)


def test_a_user_cannot_hoard_unlimited_keys(db):
    user = _user(db)
    for _ in range(devkeys.MAX_KEYS_PER_USER):
        _issue(db, user)
    with pytest.raises(devkeys.DeveloperKeyError):
        devkeys.issue(db, user_id=user.id, env=ENV)
    # Revoking one frees a slot.
    devkeys.revoke(db, devkeys.list_for_user(db, user.id)[0])
    db.commit()
    _issue(db, user)


# ── last_used bucketing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_last_used_is_bucketed_instead_of_written_per_request(db):
    user = _user(db)
    key, _token = _issue(db, user)
    start = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    assert devkeys.touch_last_used(db, key, now=start) is True
    assert devkeys.touch_last_used(db, key, now=start + timedelta(seconds=30)) is False
    assert devkeys.touch_last_used(db, key, now=start + timedelta(minutes=2)) is False
    later = start + devkeys.LAST_USED_BUCKET + timedelta(seconds=1)
    assert devkeys.touch_last_used(db, key, now=later) is True
    assert key.last_used_at is not None


# ── Boundary with the provider credential domain ──────────────────────────────

def test_the_developer_key_domain_never_touches_provider_credentials():
    """Two credential domains, opposite requirements — they must not converge."""
    source = (devkeys.__file__, )
    from pathlib import Path

    text = Path(source[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "lay_credential" not in text
    assert "secretbox" not in text
    assert "from platform_core.api_keys" not in text
    assert "from platform_core import api_keys" not in text


def test_provider_api_keys_still_work_unchanged(db):
    """The provider table keeps its encrypt/decrypt behaviour."""
    from platform_core import api_keys as provider_keys

    import platform_core.secretbox as secretbox
    secretbox_key = "unit-test-token-encryption-key-0123456789"
    import os
    previous = os.environ.get("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY")
    os.environ["LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY"] = secretbox_key
    try:
        secretbox.reset_cache() if hasattr(secretbox, "reset_cache") else None
        key = provider_keys.tao_key(db, provider="gemini", credential="secret-value",
                                    categories=["image"])
        db.commit()
        assert provider_keys.lay_credential(db, key) == "secret-value"
        assert key.credential_enc != "secret-value"
    finally:
        if previous is None:
            os.environ.pop("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", None)
        else:
            os.environ["LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY"] = previous


# ── PostgreSQL-only guarantees ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# SQLite enforces UNIQUE too, but the platform runs on PostgreSQL and the claim
# being made is about *that* engine, under concurrent inserts. Set
# LTT_TEST_DATABASE_URL to a throwaway database to run these (the file's other
# tests stay engine-agnostic so a laptop without PostgreSQL is still green).

import os as _os

# Qua `pg_scratch`, vì fixture dưới đây gọi `drop_all()` — xem file đó vì sao
# một biến môi trường gõ nhầm là chuyện nghiêm trọng trên máy chủ.
from tests.pg_scratch import scratch_url

PG_URL = scratch_url()
postgres_only = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not PG_URL, reason="Set LTT_TEST_DATABASE_URL to a scratch PostgreSQL database.")


@pytest.fixture()
def pg_sessionmaker():
    import platform_core.models  # noqa: F401
    from platform_core.db import Base

    engine = sa.create_engine(PG_URL, future=True)
    Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    maker = sessionmaker(bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False)
    try:
        yield maker
    finally:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)
        engine.dispose()


@postgres_only
def test_key_id_is_unique_at_the_database_level(pg_sessionmaker):
    """The uniqueness of key_id is part of authentication, not just tidiness."""
    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

    session = pg_sessionmaker()
    user = _user(session, "pg-owner@example.com")
    key, _token = devkeys.issue(session, user_id=user.id, env=ENV)
    session.commit()

    clone = DeveloperApiKey(
        id="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", user_id=user.id,
        key_id=key.key_id, verifier_digest="0" * 64, pepper_version=1,
        scopes=[], allowed_tools=[], created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    session.add(clone)
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        session.commit()
    session.rollback()
    session.close()


@postgres_only
def test_a_user_with_keys_cannot_be_deleted(pg_sessionmaker):
    """RESTRICT: a key is evidence about who spent what; deactivate, don't delete."""
    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
    from platform_core.models import User

    session = pg_sessionmaker()
    user = _user(session, "pg-restrict@example.com")
    devkeys.issue(session, user_id=user.id, env=ENV)
    session.commit()

    session.execute(sa.delete(User).where(User.id == user.id))
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        session.commit()
    session.rollback()
    session.close()


# ── Verification cost (DoS guard) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_verification_is_cheap_enough_to_run_on_every_request(db):
    """A KDF-priced verifier here would be an anonymous CPU amplifier."""
    import time

    user = _user(db)
    _key, token = _issue(db, user)
    devkeys.verify(db, token, env=ENV)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(50):
        devkeys.verify(db, token, env=ENV)
    per_call_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000 / 50
    # Generous ceiling: the digest itself is microseconds, the rest is one
    # indexed lookup. This fails loudly if someone swaps in bcrypt/argon2.
    assert per_call_ms < 10, f"verify() takes {per_call_ms:.2f} ms per call"

"""
Tests for production-safety dimensions added to RateLimiter:
  - min_inter_page_interval_s
  - jitter_s
  - active_hours_start / active_hours_end
  - max_posts_per_page_per_day
  - daily_count() accessor + day-key purging

Each test asserts the new feature is OPT-IN: defaults (0/empty) preserve the
legacy behaviour exercised by test_05/test_06.

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
import unittest
from datetime import datetime
from unittest.mock import patch
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from core.rate_limiter import (
    QuotaExceededError,
    RateLimiter,
    reset_global_metrics,
)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. Backwards compatibility — defaults preserve legacy behaviour
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestBackwardsCompat(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_legacy_signature_still_works(self):
        # The 2-arg construction used by test_05 / test_06 must still work
        lim = RateLimiter(max_concurrent=2, min_interval_s=0.0)
        lim.acquire("P1")
        lim.release("P1")
        # No exception → legacy path intact

    def test_no_new_dimensions_no_block(self):
        # With all new dims at 0/empty, acquire+release of any page must NOT
        # wait beyond the original per-page interval.
        lim = RateLimiter(max_concurrent=1, min_interval_s=0.0)
        start = time.time()
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        lim.acquire("B"); lim.release("B")
        self.assertLess(time.time() - start, 1.0,
                        "two distinct-page acquires must be near-instant by default")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. Inter-page interval
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestInterPageInterval(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_inter_page_interval_blocks_other_pages(self):
        """After releasing Page A, Page B's acquire must wait for the global gap."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            max_concurrent=1,
            min_interval_s=0.0,            # no per-page wait
            min_inter_page_interval_s=0.4,  # 400 ms global gap
        )
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        t0 = time.time()
        lim.acquire("B"); lim.release("B")
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        self.assertGreaterEqual(elapsed, 0.35,
                                f"B should wait ~0.4 s, got {elapsed:.3f}s")
        self.assertLess(elapsed, 1.5)

    def test_zero_inter_page_means_no_block(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, min_inter_page_interval_s=0.0)
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        t0 = time.time()
        lim.acquire("B"); lim.release("B")
        self.assertLess(time.time() - t0, 0.3)

    def test_wait_until_ready_includes_inter_page(self):
        """wait_until_ready must reflect inter-page wait, even for never-posted page."""
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, min_inter_page_interval_s=10.0)
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        # Page B has never been touched, but inter-page gate still applies
        remaining = lim.wait_until_ready("B")
        self.assertGreater(remaining, 9.0)
        self.assertLessEqual(remaining, 10.0)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. Jitter
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestJitter(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_jitter_adds_extra_wait(self):
        """With jitter, the actual wait must be at least the base interval and
        at most (base + jitter) — broken into a deterministic check via patch."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            max_concurrent=1,
            min_interval_s=0.2,
            jitter_s=0.3,
        )
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        # Force the random.uniform return to a known value
        with patch("core.rate_limiter.random.uniform", return_value=0.25):
            t0 = time.time()
            lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
            elapsed = time.time() - t0
        # Expected wait: 0.2 (interval) + 0.25 (jitter) = 0.45
        self.assertGreaterEqual(elapsed, 0.4)
        self.assertLess(elapsed, 1.2)

    def test_zero_jitter_is_legacy_behaviour(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.1, jitter_s=0.0)
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        t0 = time.time()
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        self.assertLess(time.time() - t0, 0.4)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. Active hours window
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestActiveHours(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_inside_window_passes_through(self):
        # If current hour is anywhere in 0-23 and we set window 0-24-effective,
        # the gate must be open. We pick start==end which the implementation
        # treats as "disabled" — so any time is fine.
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, active_hours_start=0, active_hours_end=0)
        lim.acquire("X"); lim.release("X")  # no block

    def test_window_check_with_mock_clock(self):
        """Mock datetime so we control the 'current hour' and verify the window logic."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            min_interval_s=0.0,
            active_hours_start=8,
            active_hours_end=23,
        )
        # Patch datetime to return 14:00 → inside 8-23 window → must pass instantly
        fake_now = datetime(2026, 5, 15, 14, 0, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"))
        with patch("core.rate_limiter.datetime") as mock_dt:
            mock_dt.now.return_value = fake_now
            mock_dt.side_effect = lambda *a, **kw: datetime(*a, **kw)
            t0 = time.time()
            lim.acquire("X"); lim.release("X")
            self.assertLess(time.time() - t0, 0.5,
                            "Should pass instantly inside window")

    def test_window_crossing_midnight_logic(self):
        """A 22-6 window means active hours wrap midnight."""
        lim = RateLimiter(active_hours_start=22, active_hours_end=6)
        # Hour 23 → inside window
        self.assertTrue(
            (lim.active_hours_start <= 23) or (23 < lim.active_hours_end),
            "23h should be inside a 22-6 window"
        )
        # Hour 10 → outside
        self.assertFalse(
            (lim.active_hours_start <= 10 < lim.active_hours_end),
            "10h should be outside a 22-6 window (start<end branch)"
        )


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. Daily quota
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestDailyQuota(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_quota_disabled_by_default(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0)
        for _ in range(10):
            lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")
        # No exception → 0 cap means unlimited

    def test_quota_raises_when_exhausted(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, max_posts_per_page_per_day=2)
        lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")
        lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")
        self.assertEqual(lim.daily_count("P"), 2)
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceededError):
            lim.acquire("P")

    def test_quota_is_per_page(self):
        """Quota for one page must not affect another page."""
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, max_posts_per_page_per_day=1)
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceededError):
            lim.acquire("A")
        # Page B unaffected
        lim.acquire("B"); lim.release("B")

    def test_daily_count_starts_at_zero(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, max_posts_per_page_per_day=5)
        self.assertEqual(lim.daily_count("brand-new"), 0)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. Day-key purging — old day counts get dropped on new-day release
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestDayKeyPurge(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_old_day_keys_purged_on_release(self):
        """Insert a 'yesterday' count manually, release once today → purge."""
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, max_posts_per_page_per_day=10)
        # Inject a stale count for yesterday
        lim._daily_counts[("P", "2026-01-01")] = 42
        # Today's release should purge the stale entry
        lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")
        self.assertNotIn(("P", "2026-01-01"), lim._daily_counts)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. Stop event still honoured with new dimensions
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestStopEventStillWorks(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_stop_event_breaks_inter_page_wait(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(
            max_concurrent=1,
            min_interval_s=0.0,
            min_inter_page_interval_s=10.0,    # would block for 10 s
        )
        lim.acquire("A"); lim.release("A")

        stop = threading.Event()
        result = {}

        def _worker():
            try:
                lim.acquire("B", stop_event=stop)
            except InterruptedError as e:
                result["caught"] = str(e)

        t = threading.Thread(target=_worker, daemon=True)
        t.start()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        stop.set()
        t.join(timeout=2)
        self.assertFalse(t.is_alive(), "Worker should have exited via InterruptedError")
        self.assertIn("caught", result)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8. Per-account daily quota (Week 2-4 feature)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TestPerAccountQuota(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        reset_global_metrics()

    def test_account_quota_disabled_by_default(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0)
        # No account quota set → 10 acquires across multiple pages on same
        # account should pass
        for i in range(10):
            lim.acquire(f"P{i}", account_id="acc_X")
            lim.release(f"P{i}", account_id="acc_X")

    def test_account_quota_raises_across_multiple_pages(self):
        """An account managing 3 pages, cap=4. After 4 posts (any mix of pages),
        the 5th must raise — regardless of which page it's on."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            min_interval_s=0.0,
            max_posts_per_account_per_day=4,
        )
        # Page 1, 2 posts
        lim.acquire("P1", account_id="acc_A"); lim.release("P1", account_id="acc_A")
        lim.acquire("P1", account_id="acc_A"); lim.release("P1", account_id="acc_A")
        # Page 2, 2 posts → total 4 for acc_A
        lim.acquire("P2", account_id="acc_A"); lim.release("P2", account_id="acc_A")
        lim.acquire("P2", account_id="acc_A"); lim.release("P2", account_id="acc_A")

        self.assertEqual(lim.account_daily_count("acc_A"), 4)

        # 5th attempt on ANY page of acc_A → reject
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceededError) as ctx:
            lim.acquire("P3", account_id="acc_A")
        self.assertIn("acc_A", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_account_quota_isolated_per_account(self):
        """acc_A hitting quota must NOT block acc_B."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            min_interval_s=0.0,
            max_posts_per_account_per_day=1,
        )
        lim.acquire("P", account_id="acc_A")
        lim.release("P", account_id="acc_A")
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceededError):
            lim.acquire("P", account_id="acc_A")
        # Different account, same page → fine
        lim.acquire("P", account_id="acc_B")
        lim.release("P", account_id="acc_B")

    def test_account_id_missing_skips_account_check(self):
        """When acquire() is called without account_id (legacy call sites),
        the account-cap check must be skipped — back-compat with old code."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            min_interval_s=0.0,
            max_posts_per_account_per_day=1,
        )
        # No account_id → cap is bypassed
        lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")
        lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")
        lim.acquire("P"); lim.release("P")

    def test_account_quota_combines_with_page_quota(self):
        """Both quotas active: page cap=2, account cap=5. After 2 posts on
        page A (page-capped), shifting to page B still allowed (account=2/5)."""
        lim = RateLimiter(
            min_interval_s=0.0,
            max_posts_per_page_per_day=2,
            max_posts_per_account_per_day=5,
        )
        lim.acquire("A", account_id="u"); lim.release("A", account_id="u")
        lim.acquire("A", account_id="u"); lim.release("A", account_id="u")
        with self.assertRaises(QuotaExceededError) as ctx:
            lim.acquire("A", account_id="u")
        self.assertIn("page 'A'", str(ctx.exception))   # page-cap hit, not account
        # Page B still under page-cap; account total 2/5 → fine
        lim.acquire("B", account_id="u"); lim.release("B", account_id="u")
        self.assertEqual(lim.account_daily_count("u"), 3)

    def test_account_count_zero_when_no_id(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0)
        self.assertEqual(lim.account_daily_count(""), 0)
        self.assertEqual(lim.account_daily_count("unseen"), 0)

    def test_purge_drops_old_account_keys(self):
        lim = RateLimiter(min_interval_s=0.0, max_posts_per_account_per_day=10)
        lim._account_daily_counts[("acc_X", "2025-12-31")] = 999
        lim.acquire("P", account_id="acc_X")
        lim.release("P", account_id="acc_X")
        self.assertNotIn(("acc_X", "2025-12-31"), lim._account_daily_counts)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
