# TT-1.1 — TikTok adaptive backoff codes
# =============================================================================

class TestTikTokAdaptiveBackoff(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_tt_permanent_codes(self):
        for code in (
            "access_token_invalid",
            "scope_not_authorized",
            "invalid_param",
            "privacy_level_option_mismatch",
            "video_pull_failed",
        ):
            with self.subTest(code=code):
                p = get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(code, jitter=False)
                self.assertEqual(p.severity, "permanent")
                self.assertTrue(is_tiktok_permanent(code))

    def test_tt_rate_limit_codes(self):
        for code in ("rate_limit_exceeded", "daily_publish_cap_exceeded"):
            with self.subTest(code=code):
                p = get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(code, jitter=False)
                self.assertEqual(p.severity, "rate")
                self.assertTrue(p.retryable)
                self.assertGreaterEqual(p.cooldown_s, 3600)

    def test_tt_abuse_codes_flag_and_long_cooldown(self):
        for code in ("spam_risk_text", "spam_risk_user_banned_from_posting",
                     "spam_risk_too_many_posts"):
            with self.subTest(code=code):
                self.assertTrue(is_tiktok_abuse_signal(code))
                p = get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(code, jitter=False)
                self.assertGreaterEqual(p.cooldown_s, 6 * 3600)

    def test_tt_unknown_code_default(self):
        p = get_backoff_for_tiktok_error("never_seen_code", jitter=False)
        self.assertTrue(p.retryable)
        self.assertEqual(p.severity, "transient")

    def test_tt_jitter_perturbs_cooldown(self):
        base = get_backoff_for_tiktok_error("rate_limit_exceeded",
                                            jitter=False).cooldown_s
        seen = {get_backoff_for_tiktok_error(
            "rate_limit_exceeded", jitter=True
        ).cooldown_s for _ in range(20)}
        diffs = [v for v in seen if abs(v - base) > 0.1]
        self.assertGreater(len(diffs), 0)


# =============================================================================
# TT-1.2 — Account warm-up
# =============================================================================

class TestTikTokAccountWarmup(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        _clear_tt_warmup_cache()
        # Custom audit log per-test so we don't depend on shared state
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".jsonl",
                                        mode="w", encoding="utf-8")
        f.close()
        self.log_path = f.name

    def tearDown(self):
        _clear_tt_warmup_cache()
        try: os.unlink(self.log_path)
        except OSError: pass

    def _write_audit(self, records):
        with open(self.log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for r in records:
                f.write(json.dumps(r) + "\n")

    def test_curve_progression(self):
        self.assertEqual(recommended_cap_for_age(0),    1)
        self.assertEqual(recommended_cap_for_age(5),    2)
        self.assertEqual(recommended_cap_for_age(20),   4)
        self.assertEqual(recommended_cap_for_age(100),  0)  # mature

    def test_no_history_treated_as_brand_new(self):
        self._write_audit([])
        advice = get_warmup_advice("u_no_history",
                                    audit_log_path=self.log_path)
        self.assertEqual(advice.age_days, 0)
        self.assertEqual(advice.recommended_max_per_day, 1)

    def test_first_seen_age(self):
        ten_days_ago = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=10)).isoformat()
        self._write_audit([
            {"event": "tiktok_publish_attempt", "open_id": "u_ten",
             "timestamp": ten_days_ago},
        ])
        advice = get_warmup_advice("u_ten", audit_log_path=self.log_path)
        # 10 days → falls in <=14 bracket → 3 posts/day
        self.assertGreaterEqual(advice.age_days, 9)
        self.assertLessEqual(advice.age_days, 11)
        self.assertEqual(advice.recommended_max_per_day, 3)

    def test_other_open_ids_ignored(self):
        old = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=200)).isoformat()
        self._write_audit([
            {"event": "tiktok_publish_attempt", "open_id": "u_OTHER",
             "timestamp": old},
        ])
        advice = get_warmup_advice("u_mine", audit_log_path=self.log_path)
        # u_mine has no history → brand-new
        self.assertEqual(advice.age_days, 0)

    def test_effective_daily_cap_combines(self):
        adv = TikTokWarmupAdvice(open_id="u", age_days=5,
                                  recommended_max_per_day=2, note="")
        self.assertEqual(effective_daily_cap(adv, user_cap=10), 2)
        self.assertEqual(effective_daily_cap(adv, user_cap=1),  1)

# TT-1.3 — Network identity in TikTokClient

class TestTikTokClientIdentity(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_no_identity_when_disabled(self):
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient
        c = TikTokClient(access_token="t", account_id="acc_X", config={})
        self.assertEqual(c._identity_ua, "")
        self.assertEqual(c._identity_proxy, "")

    def test_identity_applied_when_enabled(self):
        from core.network_identity import reset_default_provider
        reset_default_provider()
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient
        c = TikTokClient(
            access_token="t", account_id="acc_X",
            config={"network_identity_enabled": True},
        )
        self.assertIn("Mozilla/5.0", c._identity_ua)

    def test_apply_identity_merges_headers_and_proxies(self):
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient
        c = TikTokClient(access_token="t")
        c._identity_ua    = "TestUA/1.0"
        c._identity_proxy = "http://proxy:8080"
        headers, kw = {}, {}
        c._apply_identity(headers, kw)
        self.assertEqual(headers["User-Agent"], "TestUA/1.0")
        self.assertEqual(kw["proxies"]["https"], "http://proxy:8080")


# =============================================================================
# TT-1.4 — TikTokClientPool
# =============================================================================

class TestTikTokClientPool(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_empty_pool(self):
        p = TikTokClientPool()
        self.assertIsNone(p.next_healthy())

    def test_round_robin(self):
        p = TikTokClientPool([
            TikTokClientRecord(client_key="K1", client_secret="s1"),
            TikTokClientRecord(client_key="K2", client_secret="s2"),
        ])
        keys = {p.next_healthy().client_key for _ in range(6)}
        self.assertEqual(keys, {"K1", "K2"})

    def test_disabled_skipped(self):
        p = TikTokClientPool([
            TikTokClientRecord(client_key="K1", client_secret="s1"),
            TikTokClientRecord(client_key="K2", client_secret="s2"),
        ])
        p.mark_disabled("K1")
        for _ in range(4):
            self.assertEqual(p.next_healthy().client_key, "K2")

    def test_legacy_config_fallback(self):
        p = TikTokClientPool.from_config({
            "tiktok_client_key": "legacy_K",
            "tiktok_client_secret": "legacy_s",
        })
        self.assertEqual(p.healthy_count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(p.next_healthy().client_key, "legacy_K")

    def test_pool_config_used(self):
        p = TikTokClientPool.from_config({
            "tiktok_client_pool": [
                {"client_key": "P1", "client_secret": "ps1"},
                {"client_key": "P2", "client_secret": "ps2", "disabled": True},
            ],
        })
        self.assertEqual(p.healthy_count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(p.next_healthy().client_key, "P1")

    def test_auth_manager_uses_pool(self):
        from core.tiktok.auth_manager import TikTokAuthManager
        am = TikTokAuthManager(config={
            "tiktok_client_pool": [
                {"client_key": "POOL_K", "client_secret": "POOL_S",
                 "redirect_uri": "https://x"},
            ],
        })
        self.assertEqual(am.client_key, "POOL_K")
        self.assertEqual(am.redirect_uri, "https://x")

# TT-1.6 — Comment delay
# =============================================================================

class TestTikTokCommentDelay(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_commenter(self, min_s, max_s):
        from core.tiktok.commenter import TikTokCommenter
        from core.tiktok.client import TikTokClient
        client = MagicMock(spec=TikTokClient)
        return TikTokCommenter(
            client=client, stop_event=threading.Event(),
            comment_delay_min_s=min_s, comment_delay_max_s=max_s,
        )

    def test_delay_zero_when_disabled(self):
        c = self._make_commenter(0, 0)
        self.assertEqual(c._compute_comment_delay(), 0.0)

    def test_delay_within_range(self):
        c = self._make_commenter(30, 60)
        for _ in range(20):
            d = c._compute_comment_delay()
            self.assertGreaterEqual(d, 30.0)
            self.assertLessEqual(d, 60.0)

    def test_sleep_interruptible(self):
        c = self._make_commenter(0, 0)
        result = {"slept": 0.0}
        def worker():
            t0 = time.time()
            c._sleep_interruptible(5.0)
            result["slept"] = time.time() - t0
        t = threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True)
        t.start()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        c._stop.set()
        t.join(timeout=3)
        self.assertLess(result["slept"], 2.5)

class TestTikTokAuditChecklist(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_empty_config_fails_multiple_checks(self):
        report = run_checklist({})
        self.assertGreater(report.fail_count, 0)
        self.assertFalse(report.ready_to_submit)

    def test_full_config_passes_credentials_and_urls(self):
        """TT-AUDIT-8 fix: run_checklist now does live HEAD + GET on URLs.
        Mock both to make test deterministic + offline-safe."""
        from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
        config = {
            "tiktok_client_key":          "abc",
            "tiktok_client_secret":       "secret",
            "tiktok_redirect_uri":        "https://lttstudios.com/legal/callback.html",
            "app_privacy_policy_url":     "https://lttstudios.com/legal/privacy.html",
            "app_terms_url":              "https://lttstudios.com/legal/terms.html",
            "tiktok_scopes":              "user.info.basic,video.upload,video.publish",
            "tiktok_audit_approved":      False,
            "tiktok_enable_direct_post":  False,
            "tiktok_require_user_confirm": True,
            "tiktok_privacy_level":       "SELF_ONLY",
        }
        # Fake live response: privacy policy mentions all required keywords
        fake_text = "tiktok open_id access token video scope policy lttstudio"
        fake_resp = MagicMock(status_code=200, text=fake_text)
        from core.tiktok import audit_checklist as ac
        with patch.object(ac, "_head_url", return_value=(True, "HTTP 200")), \
             patch.object(ac.requests, "get", return_value=fake_resp):
            report = run_checklist(config)
        # Credentials + URIs + scopes + audit flags must pass
        passes = {i.name for i in report.items if i.result is CheckResult.PASS}
        self.assertIn("Client Credentials", passes)
        self.assertIn("Redirect URI",       passes)
        self.assertIn("Privacy + Terms URLs", passes)
        self.assertIn("Scopes",             passes)
        self.assertIn("Audit flags",        passes)

    def test_inconsistent_direct_post_fails(self):
        report = run_checklist({
            "tiktok_client_key": "k", "tiktok_client_secret": "s",
            "tiktok_redirect_uri": "https://x.tld/cb",
            "app_privacy_policy_url": "https://x.tld/p",
            "app_terms_url":          "https://x.tld/t",
            "tiktok_scopes": "user.info.basic,video.upload,video.publish",
            "tiktok_enable_direct_post": True,
            "tiktok_audit_approved":     False,
        })
        fails = {i.name for i in report.items if i.result is CheckResult.FAIL}
        self.assertIn("Audit flags", fails)

    def test_summary_helpful(self):
        report = run_checklist({})
        self.assertTrue(report.summary())

# F1 — Video validator

class TestVideoValidator(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_missing_file_fails(self):
        rep = validate_video("/nope.mp4")
        self.assertEqual(rep.fail_count, 1)
        self.assertFalse(rep.ready_to_upload)

    def test_empty_file_fails(self):
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".mp4")
        f.close()  # 0 bytes
        try:
            rep = validate_video(f.name)
            self.assertEqual(rep.fail_count, 1)
        finally:
            os.unlink(f.name)

    def test_normal_file_size_passes(self):
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".mp4")
        f.write(b"x" * 1000)
        f.close()
        try:
            rep = validate_video(f.name)
            # At minimum, "File size" check should pass
            file_size_items = [i for i in rep.items if i.name == "File size"]
            self.assertEqual(len(file_size_items), 1)
            self.assertEqual(file_size_items[0].result, _VR.PASS)
        finally:
            os.unlink(f.name)

    def test_oversize_file_fails(self):
        # Mock os.path.getsize to return > 4 GB without actually creating the file
        f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".mp4")
        f.write(b"x")
        f.close()
        try:
            with patch("os.path.getsize", return_value=5 * 1024 ** 3):
                rep = validate_video(f.name)
            file_size_items = [i for i in rep.items if i.name == "File size"]
            self.assertEqual(file_size_items[0].result, _VR.FAIL)
        finally:
            os.unlink(f.name)

    def test_ffprobe_availability_is_bool(self):
        self.assertIsInstance(is_ffprobe_available(), bool)


# =============================================================================
# F2 — Scope verification
# =============================================================================

class TestScopeVerify(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_required_scopes_known_op(self):
        self.assertIn("video.upload",  required_scopes("draft_upload"))
        self.assertIn("video.publish", required_scopes("direct_upload"))
        # user.info.basic is NOT required (granted by default at OAuth time)
        self.assertNotIn("user.info.basic", required_scopes("draft_upload"))

    def test_required_scopes_unknown_op_is_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(required_scopes("nope"), set())

    def test_check_ok_when_all_granted(self):
        result = check_scopes("draft_upload", ["video.upload"])
        self.assertTrue(result.ok)
        self.assertEqual(result.missing_scopes, [])

    def test_check_fails_when_missing(self):
        result = check_scopes("direct_upload", ["video.upload"])
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("video.publish", result.missing_scopes)

    def test_check_handles_string_input(self):
        # granted_scopes can be any iterable of strings
        result = check_scopes("draft_upload", ("video.upload",))
        self.assertTrue(result.ok)

    def test_check_case_insensitive(self):
        result = check_scopes("draft_upload", ["Video.Upload"])
        self.assertTrue(result.ok)

    def test_comment_post_scopes(self):
        result = check_scopes("comment_post", ["video.upload"])
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("comment.create", result.missing_scopes)

class TestWatermarkDetector(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_named(self, name: str) -> str:
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        path = os.path.join(d, name)
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(b"x" * 100)
        return path

    def test_capcut_filename_detected(self):
        path = self._make_named("VID_20260516_capcut_export.mp4")
        try:
            sig = detect_watermark(path)
            self.assertTrue(sig.detected)
            self.assertEqual(sig.editor_name, "CapCut")
            self.assertEqual(sig.confidence, "high")
        finally:
            os.unlink(path); os.rmdir(os.path.dirname(path))

    def test_clean_filename_no_signal(self):
        path = self._make_named("my_clean_video.mp4")
        try:
            sig = detect_watermark(path)
            self.assertFalse(sig.detected)
        finally:
            os.unlink(path); os.rmdir(os.path.dirname(path))

    def test_missing_file_no_signal(self):
        sig = detect_watermark("/nope.mp4")
        self.assertFalse(sig.detected)

    def test_inshot_detected(self):
        path = self._make_named("output_inshot.mp4")
        try:
            sig = detect_watermark(path)
            self.assertTrue(sig.detected)
            self.assertEqual(sig.editor_name, "InShot")
        finally:
            os.unlink(path); os.rmdir(os.path.dirname(path))

class TestAudioRights(unittest.TestCase):

    def _make_named(self, name: str) -> str:
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        path = os.path.join(d, name)
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(b"x" * 100)
        return path

    def test_official_music_video_high_risk(self):
        path = self._make_named("Justin_Bieber_Ghost_official_music_video.mp4")
        try:
            sig = check_audio_rights(path)
            self.assertEqual(sig.risk_level, "high")
            self.assertIn("filename_pattern", sig.detected_tags)
        finally:
            os.unlink(path); os.rmdir(os.path.dirname(path))

    def test_feat_filename_high_risk(self):
        path = self._make_named("Track feat. Artist.mp4")
        try:
            sig = check_audio_rights(path)
            self.assertEqual(sig.risk_level, "high")
        finally:
            os.unlink(path); os.rmdir(os.path.dirname(path))

    def test_clean_filename(self):
        path = self._make_named("my_morning_routine_2026.mp4")
        try:
            sig = check_audio_rights(path)
            # Without ffprobe, risk is "none" or "low"
            self.assertIn(sig.risk_level, ("none", "low"))
        finally:
            os.unlink(path); os.rmdir(os.path.dirname(path))

    def test_missing_file(self):
        sig = check_audio_rights("/nope.mp4")
        self.assertEqual(sig.risk_level, "none")
        self.assertFalse(sig.has_audio)

class TestContentValidator(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_empty_caption_warns(self):
        rep = validate_content("")
        warns = [i for i in rep.items if i.result is _CR.WARN]
        self.assertTrue(any("Length" in i.name for i in warns))
        self.assertTrue(rep.ready_to_upload)   # warn doesn't block

    def test_normal_caption_passes(self):
        rep = validate_content("Helpful morning routine #productivity #morning")
        self.assertTrue(rep.ready_to_upload)
        self.assertEqual(rep.hashtag_count, 2)

    def test_too_long_caption_fails(self):
        long_text = "x" * 2300
        rep = validate_content(long_text)
        self.assertFalse(rep.ready_to_upload)

    def test_too_many_hashtags_fails(self):
        caption = "post " + " ".join(f"#tag{i}" for i in range(35))
        rep = validate_content(caption)
        self.assertFalse(rep.ready_to_upload)

    def test_banned_hashtag_flagged(self):
        rep = validate_content("Check this out #fyp #foryou")
        self.assertFalse(rep.ready_to_upload)

    def test_url_in_caption_warns(self):
        rep = validate_content("Check https://example.com #news")
        warns = [i for i in rep.items if "URL" in i.name and i.result is _CR.WARN]
        self.assertEqual(len(warns), 1)
        self.assertTrue(rep.ready_to_upload)   # warn only

    def test_emoji_only_warns(self):
        rep = validate_content("🌟🔥💖")
        warns = [i for i in rep.items if "Text content" in i.name and i.result is _CR.WARN]
        self.assertEqual(len(warns), 1)

    def test_all_caps_warns(self):
        rep = validate_content("WATCH THIS AMAZING VIDEO NOW")
        warns = [i for i in rep.items if "Text content" in i.name and i.result is _CR.WARN]
        self.assertEqual(len(warns), 1)

    def test_extra_banned_extends_list(self):
        rep = validate_content("Check #customban", extra_banned={"customban"})
        self.assertFalse(rep.ready_to_upload)

class TestCreatorInfo(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_c1_dataclass_defaults_safe(self):
        from core.tiktok.creator_info import CreatorInfo
        info = CreatorInfo()
        # Default state: không có public option
        self.assertEqual(info.privacy_level_options, [])
        # Safe default privacy → fallback SELF_ONLY
        self.assertEqual(info.safe_default_privacy(), "SELF_ONLY")

    def test_c2_has_public_option_only_when_listed(self):
        from core.tiktok.creator_info import CreatorInfo
        only_self = CreatorInfo(privacy_level_options=["SELF_ONLY"])
        self.assertFalse(only_self.has_public_option)

        full = CreatorInfo(privacy_level_options=["SELF_ONLY", "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE"])
        self.assertTrue(full.has_public_option)

    def test_c3_label_translation(self):
        """i18n: label_for_privacy returns localized label per current language."""
        from core.i18n import init as i18n_init, set_language
        from core.tiktok.creator_info import label_for_privacy, PRIVACY_LABELS_VI

        # Load translations before testing
        i18n_init({"app_language": "en"})

        self.assertIn("SELF_ONLY", PRIVACY_LABELS_VI)

        # Test English default
        set_language("en")
        self.assertIn("Only me", label_for_privacy("SELF_ONLY"))

        # Switch to Vietnamese
        set_language("vi")
        self.assertIn("Chỉ mình tôi", label_for_privacy("SELF_ONLY"))

        # Unknown enum → fallback raw enum (regardless of language)
        set_language("en")
        self.assertEqual(label_for_privacy("UNKNOWN"), "UNKNOWN")

    def test_c4_query_creator_info_parses_response(self):
        """Mock TikTokClient.post → CreatorInfo parsed đúng."""
        from core.tiktok import creator_info as mod
        fake_resp = {
            "creator_username":             "klcloset96",
            "creator_nickname":             "KL Closet",
            "creator_avatar_url":           "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
            "privacy_level_options":        ["SELF_ONLY", "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE"],
            "comment_disabled":             False,
            "duet_disabled":                True,
            "stitch_disabled":              False,
            "max_video_post_duration_sec":  300,
        }
        with patch.object(mod, "TikTokClient") as MockClient:
            inst = MockClient.return_value
            inst.post.return_value = fake_resp
            info = mod.query_creator_info("fake_token")
        self.assertEqual(info.creator_username, "klcloset96")
        self.assertTrue(info.has_public_option)
        self.assertTrue(info.duet_disabled)
        self.assertEqual(info.max_video_post_duration_sec, 300)

    def test_c5_empty_privacy_falls_back_self_only(self):
        """API trả về privacy_level_options=[] → fallback SELF_ONLY (audit-safe)."""
        from core.tiktok import creator_info as mod
        with patch.object(mod, "TikTokClient") as MockClient:
            inst = MockClient.return_value
            inst.post.return_value = {"privacy_level_options": []}
            info = mod.query_creator_info("fake_token")
        self.assertEqual(info.privacy_level_options, ["SELF_ONLY"])

class TestAuditChecklistEnhancements(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        from core.tiktok import audit_checklist
        self.mod = audit_checklist

    def test_f1_head_url_helper_exists(self):
        self.assertTrue(callable(self.mod._head_url))

    def test_f2_head_url_handles_success(self):
        """HTTP 200 → reachable=True."""
        with patch.object(self.mod, "requests") as mock_req:
            mock_resp = MagicMock(status_code=200)
            mock_req.head.return_value = mock_resp
            ok, msg = self.mod._head_url("https://example.com")
            self.assertTrue(ok)
            self.assertIn("200", msg)

    def test_f3_head_url_handles_404(self):
        with patch.object(self.mod, "requests") as mock_req:
            mock_resp = MagicMock(status_code=404)
            mock_req.head.return_value = mock_resp
            ok, msg = self.mod._head_url("https://example.com/missing")
            self.assertFalse(ok)
            self.assertIn("404", msg)

    def test_f4_head_url_fallback_to_get_on_405(self):
        """Vài CDN reject HEAD → must fall back to GET stream."""
        with patch.object(self.mod, "requests") as mock_req:
            mock_head = MagicMock(status_code=405)
            mock_get  = MagicMock(status_code=200)
            mock_req.head.return_value = mock_head
            mock_req.get.return_value  = mock_get
            ok, _ = self.mod._head_url("https://cdn.example.com/x")
            self.assertTrue(ok)
            self.assertTrue(mock_req.get.called)

    def test_f5_check_privacy_terms_urls_does_head(self):
        """Reachability check phải thực thi qua _head_url."""
        config = {
            "app_privacy_policy_url": "https://example.com/privacy",
            "app_terms_url":          "https://example.com/terms",
        }
        with patch.object(self.mod, "_head_url", return_value=(True, "HTTP 200")) as mock_head:
            item = self.mod.check_privacy_terms_urls(config)
            self.assertEqual(item.result, self.mod.CheckResult.PASS)
            # Cả 2 URL đều được check
            self.assertEqual(mock_head.call_count, 2)

    def test_f6_check_privacy_terms_urls_fails_on_404(self):
        config = {
            "app_privacy_policy_url": "https://example.com/privacy",
            "app_terms_url":          "https://example.com/terms",
        }
        with patch.object(self.mod, "_head_url", return_value=(False, "HTTP 404")):
            item = self.mod.check_privacy_terms_urls(config)
            self.assertEqual(item.result, self.mod.CheckResult.FAIL)

    def test_f7_check_login_button_branding_warns_when_missing(self):
        """Logo file thiếu → WARN (graceful, không FAIL)."""
        # Backup nếu file tồn tại
        path = os.path.join("data", "assets", "tiktok_logo.png")
        existed = os.path.exists(path)
        try:
            if existed:
                os.rename(path, path + ".bak")
            item = self.mod.check_login_button_branding({})
            self.assertEqual(item.result, self.mod.CheckResult.WARN)
        finally:
            if existed:
                os.rename(path + ".bak", path)

    def test_f8_check_privacy_mentions_tiktok_exists(self):
        self.assertTrue(callable(self.mod.check_privacy_policy_mentions_tiktok))

    def test_f9_check_privacy_mentions_tiktok_fails_on_missing_keyword(self):
        config = {"app_privacy_policy_url": "https://example.com/privacy"}
        fake_resp = MagicMock(status_code=200, text="generic privacy policy without keywords")
        with patch.object(self.mod, "requests") as mock_req:
            mock_req.get.return_value = fake_resp
            item = self.mod.check_privacy_policy_mentions_tiktok(config)
            self.assertEqual(item.result, self.mod.CheckResult.FAIL)

    def test_f10_run_checklist_includes_new_checks(self):
        """All check functions are registered in _ALL_CHECKS."""
        names = {c.__name__ for c in self.mod._ALL_CHECKS}
        self.assertIn("check_privacy_policy_mentions_tiktok", names)
        self.assertIn("check_login_button_branding", names)

class TestMainWindowAuditWiring(unittest.TestCase):
    """The audit screen must be reachable from the navigation, not merely exist."""

    def test_g1_audit_page_is_routed_and_built(self):
        from server.routes import monitor as monitor_routes
        from server.templating import BUILT_PAGES
        paths = {r.path for r in monitor_routes.router.routes}
        self.assertIn("/audit", paths)
        self.assertTrue(BUILT_PAGES.get("audit"))

    def test_g2_navigation_links_every_page(self):
        """Moi trang phai vao duoc tu dieu huong.

        Truoc day sidebar viet cung nen test grep base.html. Gio sidebar sinh
        tu apps/*/manifest.py, nen kiem tra o dung nguon: moi app dang bat phai
        khai it nhat mot muc nav, va base.html phai render tu nav_apps().

        Khop "nav_apps(" (khong phai "nav_apps()"): bat bien la sidebar sinh tu
        registry, khong phai so tham so cua ham. H1.4 them tham so `request` de
        loc app theo quyen (nav_apps(request)) — mot thay doi hop le lam
        assertion khoa cung "()" hong ma bat bien van dung.
        """
        from platform_core.registry import discover

        # UX Pha 2: dieu huong chuyen tu sidebar (base.html) sang HEADER ngang
        # (_header.html), sinh tu registry qua nav_groups(); base.html include
        # _header.html. Bat bien VAN la: nav sinh tu registry, khong hardcode.
        base_src = _read(os.path.join("server", "templates", "base.html"))
        self.assertIn("_header.html", base_src,
                      "base.html khong con include header dieu huong")
        header_src = _read(os.path.join("server", "templates", "_header.html"))
        self.assertIn("nav_groups(", header_src,
                      "_header.html khong con sinh nav tu registry")

        for item in discover():
            if not item.manifest.enabled or item.error:
                continue
            entries = item.manifest.nav_entries()
            self.assertTrue(entries,
                            f"{item.slug} khong co muc nav nao -> khong vao duoc")
            for e in entries:
                self.assertTrue(e.path.startswith("/"),
                                f"{item.slug}: nav path phai tuyet doi: {e.path}")

"""
test_32_system_user_token.py — Business Manager System User token import.

Covers AuthManager.import_system_user_token() (paste-token path, Giai đoạn 3):

  SU01: valid token, never-expiring     → AccountInfo(is_system_user=True, expiry="")
  SU02: 60-day token via debug_token    → token_expires_at set to ISO of expires_at
  SU03: empty token                     → ValueError
  SU04: token valid but no pages        → RuntimeError (no assets assigned)
  SU05: get_user_info raises GraphError → RuntimeError (invalid/revoked)
  SU06: pages carry per-page token      → stored on PageInfo
  SU07: AccountInfo round-trips is_system_user through to_dict/from_dict
  SU08: TokenRefresher skips system-user accounts (no exchange attempt)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from datetime import datetime

BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
if BASE_DIR not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, BASE_DIR)

from core.auth_manager import AuthManager
from core.graph_client import GraphError
from core.token_store import AccountInfo, TokenStore


class _Base(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.store = TokenStore(path=os.path.join(self._tmp.name, "tokens.enc"))
        config = {
            "meta_app_id": "APPID",
            "meta_app_secret": "APPSECRET",
            "graph_api_version": "v21.0",
        }
        self.mgr = AuthManager(config, self.store)

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def _stub(self, *, user=None, pages=None, debug=None):
        self.mgr._client.get_user_info = lambda token: (
            user or {"id": "SU999", "name": "Lttstudio Bot"}
        )
        self.mgr._client.get_pages = lambda token: (pages if pages is not None else [])
        self.mgr._client.get = lambda path, params=None, token=None: (
            debug or {"data": {"expires_at": 0}}
        )


class TestImportSystemUserToken(_Base):

    def test_SU01_valid_never_expiring(self):
        self._stub(pages=[{"id": "111", "name": "Page A",
                           "access_token": "pt_a", "category": "Media"}])
        acc = self.mgr.import_system_user_token("VALIDTOKEN")
        self.assertTrue(acc.is_system_user)
        self.assertEqual(acc.token_expires_at, "")       # permanent
        self.assertEqual(acc.fb_user_id, "SU999")
        self.assertTrue(acc.name.endswith("(BM)"))
        self.assertEqual(acc.user_token, "VALIDTOKEN")
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.store.get_account("SU999"))

    def test_SU02_sixty_day_sets_expiry(self):
        future = int(datetime(2099, 1, 1).timestamp())
        self._stub(
            pages=[{"id": "111", "name": "Page A", "access_token": "pt_a"}],
            debug={"data": {"expires_at": future}},
        )
        acc = self.mgr.import_system_user_token("SHORTTOKEN")
        self.assertNotEqual(acc.token_expires_at, "")
        self.assertTrue(acc.token_expires_at.startswith("2099"))

    def test_SU03_empty_token(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.mgr.import_system_user_token("   ")

    def test_SU04_no_pages(self):
        self._stub(pages=[])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
            self.mgr.import_system_user_token("VALIDTOKEN")
        self.assertIn("Page", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_SU05_invalid_token(self):
        def _boom(token):
            raise GraphError("Invalid OAuth access token", code=190)
        self.mgr._client.get_user_info = _boom
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            self.mgr.import_system_user_token("BADTOKEN")

    def test_SU06_page_tokens_stored(self):
        self._stub(pages=[
            {"id": "111", "name": "Page A", "access_token": "pt_a"},
            {"id": "222", "name": "Page B", "access_token": "pt_b"},
        ])
        acc = self.mgr.import_system_user_token("VALIDTOKEN")
        pages = acc.get_pages_list()
        self.assertEqual({p.id for p in pages}, {"111", "222"})
        self.assertEqual({p.access_token for p in pages}, {"pt_a", "pt_b"})
        self.assertTrue(all(p.selected for p in pages))

    def test_SU09_reimport_preserves_selection(self):
        # W1 — re-import must keep the user's tick/untick choices.
        self._stub(pages=[
            {"id": "111", "name": "A", "access_token": "pt_a"},
            {"id": "222", "name": "B", "access_token": "pt_b"},
        ])
        self.mgr.import_system_user_token("TOKEN")
        self.store.update_page_selection("SU999", "222", False)   # user unticks B
        acc = self.mgr.import_system_user_token("TOKEN")          # re-import
        sel = {p.id: p.selected for p in acc.get_pages_list()}
        self.assertFalse(sel["222"])                             # stayed unticked
        self.assertTrue(sel["111"])

    def test_SU10_skips_pages_without_token(self):
        # W2 — a page assigned without full control returns no access_token.
        self._stub(pages=[
            {"id": "111", "name": "A", "access_token": "pt_a"},
            {"id": "222", "name": "NoPerm", "access_token": ""},
        ])
        acc = self.mgr.import_system_user_token("TOKEN")
        self.assertEqual({p.id for p in acc.get_pages_list()}, {"111"})

    def test_SU12_all_pages_without_token_raises(self):
        self._stub(pages=[{"id": "111", "name": "A", "access_token": ""}])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
            self.mgr.import_system_user_token("TOKEN")
        self.assertIn("KHÔNG page", str(ctx.exception))


class TestSystemUserPlumbing(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_SU11_token_sanitization(self):
        # W3 — clean pasted tokens (quotes / prefix / wrapped newlines).
        san = AuthManager._sanitize_token
        self.assertEqual(san('  "EAAB123"  '), "EAAB123")
        self.assertEqual(san("access_token=EAAB123"), "EAAB123")
        self.assertEqual(san("EAAB\n123\n"), "EAAB123")
        self.assertEqual(san("Bearer EAAB123"), "EAAB123")
        self.assertEqual(san("'EAAB123'"), "EAAB123")

    def test_SU07_account_roundtrip_flag(self):
        acc = AccountInfo(
            fb_user_id="X", name="N", user_token="T",
            token_expires_at="", is_system_user=True,
        )
        restored = AccountInfo.from_dict(acc.to_dict())
        self.assertTrue(restored.is_system_user)

    def test_SU08_refresher_skips_system_user(self):
        from core.token_refresher import TokenRefresher

        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        store = TokenStore(path=os.path.join(tmp.name, "tokens.enc"))
        store.save_account(AccountInfo(
            fb_user_id="SU1", name="Bot (BM)", user_token="T",
            token_expires_at=datetime(2000, 1, 1).isoformat(),   # past → would be 'expired'
            is_system_user=True,
        ))

        expired_called = []
        refresher = TokenRefresher(
            config={"meta_app_id": "A", "meta_app_secret": "B"},
            token_store=store,
            on_expired=lambda name: expired_called.append(name),
        )
        refresher._check_one(store.get_account("SU1"), "A", "B", object())
        self.assertEqual(expired_called, [])   # skipped, not reported expired


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Tests for the source-boundary secret scanner.

from pathlib import Path

from tools.scan_source_secrets import (
    _is_excluded_file,
    _looks_like_generic_secret,
    _looks_like_placeholder,
    _scan_line,
)


def test_placeholder_detection():
    assert _looks_like_placeholder("[REDACTED]")
    assert _looks_like_placeholder("fake_access_token")
    assert _looks_like_placeholder("legacy-secret")


def test_help_text_is_not_generic_secret():
    assert not _looks_like_generic_secret(
        "Client Secret TikTok. Never share this value with anyone."
    )


def test_short_synthetic_fixture_is_not_generic_secret():
    assert not _looks_like_generic_secret("fake_token_123")


def test_machine_generated_value_is_generic_secret():
    candidate = "".join(("Ab9_", "xY7-", "Qp2!", "Lm8#", "Rt5$"))
    assert _looks_like_generic_secret(candidate)


def test_private_key_rule_reports_metadata():
    marker = "-----BEGIN " + "PRIVATE KEY-----"
    findings = _scan_line(Path("example.txt"), 7, marker)
    assert [(item.line, item.rule) for item in findings] == [
        (7, "private_key_block")
    ]


def test_known_provider_token_rule_reports_without_value():
    candidate = "AIza" + ("A1b2_" * 7)
    findings = _scan_line(Path("example.txt"), 3, candidate)
    assert any(item.rule == "google_api_key" for item in findings)
    assert all(not hasattr(item, "value") for item in findings)


def test_session_secret_hardcode_bi_bat():
    """W1.7: khoá phiên hardcode trong source bị bắt (trước đây lọt vì tên khoá
    không nằm trong danh sách keyword và giá trị là base64url, không phải 32-hex)."""
    line = 'session_secret = "' + ("a1B2c3D4e5F6" * 3) + '"'
    findings = _scan_line(Path("cfg.py"), 5, line)
    assert any(item.rule == "generic_secret_assignment" for item in findings)


def test_token_encryption_key_hardcode_bi_bat():
    """W1.7: khoá mã hoá token hardcode trong source bị bắt."""
    line = 'token_encryption_key = "' + ("Zx9Yw8Vu7Ts6" * 3) + '"'
    findings = _scan_line(Path("cfg.py"), 5, line)
    assert any(item.rule == "generic_secret_assignment" for item in findings)

"""
P1 — headless core boundary tests.

Verifies:
  - worker_main.py never imports customtkinter or gui.*
  - worker_main's CLI wiring (config load, default worker, start/stop
    callback plumbing) runs end-to-end in-process without network access
  - WorkerApplication start/stop/status lifecycle is idempotent
  - a crashing runner still releases the ownership lock exactly once
    (crash safety net)
  - the whole-run ownership lock rejects a second runner targeting the same
    account before it can race a real job
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading

import pytest

import worker_main
from core.session_lock import SessionLock
from core.worker_app import WorkerApplication, WorkerOwnershipError


# ─── No-GUI import boundary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_worker_main_does_not_import_gui_or_customtkinter():
    script = (
        "import sys\n"
        "import worker_main\n"
        "bad = [m for m in sys.modules if m == 'customtkinter' or m.startswith('gui.') or m == 'gui']\n"
        "assert not bad, bad\n"
        "print('OK')\n"
    )
    proj_root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", script],
        cwd=proj_root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
    assert "OK" in result.stdout


# ─── worker_main CLI wiring, end-to-end, no network ──────────────────────────

def _isolated_worker_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch, workers=None):
    """Point core.worker_store at a temp file so these tests never read or
    write the developer's real data/workers.json. Returns the path."""
    from core.worker_store import save_workers

    store = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.worker_store.default_path", lambda env=None: store)
    if workers:
        save_workers(workers, platform="facebook", path=store)
    return store


def test_worker_main_end_to_end_with_stored_workers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Worker list now comes from the shared store the desktop app writes.

    Behavior change (PA-5, docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md D3): this used to build a
    worker by guessing from the legacy top-level `sheet_tab`/`sheet_id`
    config keys. The audit proved that guess targeted a tab whose columns
    did not match the configured mapping, producing a run that connected
    and then failed mid-flight. Guessing was removed deliberately.
    """
    cfg_path = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps({"sheet_id": "abc123"}), encoding="utf-8")
    _isolated_worker_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch, [
        {"tab": "MyTab", "page": "MyPage", "sheet_id": "abc123"},
    ])

    captured = {}

    class _FakeApp:
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            captured.update(kwargs)

        def start(self):
            # Simulate a worker that finishes immediately.
            captured["on_all_stopped"]()

        def stop(self):
            captured["stopped_called"] = True

    monkeypatch.setattr(worker_main, "WorkerApplication", _FakeApp)

    rc = worker_main.main(["--config", str(cfg_path)])

    assert rc == 0
    assert [w["tab"] for w in captured["workers"]] == ["MyTab"]
    assert captured["config"]["sheet_id"] == "abc123"


def test_worker_main_reports_ownership_conflict_as_exit_code(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    cfg_path = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps({"sheet_id": "S"}), encoding="utf-8")
    _isolated_worker_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch, [{"tab": "T", "sheet_id": "S"}])

    class _FakeApp:
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            pass

        def start(self):
            raise WorkerOwnershipError("already owned")

    monkeypatch.setattr(worker_main, "WorkerApplication", _FakeApp)

    rc = worker_main.main(["--config", str(cfg_path)])
    assert rc == 2


# ─── WorkerApplication lifecycle (SheetRunner stubbed — no network) ──────────

class _StubSheetRunner:
    """Drop-in for core.sheet_runner.SheetRunner: honors stop_event, never
    touches Google Sheets / Graph API."""

    def __init__(self, *, stop_event=None, **_kwargs):
        self.stop_event = stop_event or threading.Event()

    def run(self):
        self.stop_event.wait()


class _CrashingSheetRunner(_StubSheetRunner):
    def run(self):
        raise RuntimeError("simulated crash before any job ran")


@pytest.fixture
def _stub_single_runner(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.worker_app.SheetRunner", _StubSheetRunner)


@pytest.fixture
def _crashing_single_runner(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.worker_app.SheetRunner", _CrashingSheetRunner)


def _unique_target(name: str) -> dict:
    return {"tab": name, "page": "", "sheet_id": "", "account_id": name}


def test_worker_application_start_stop_lifecycle(_stub_single_runner):
    app = WorkerApplication(
        workers=[_unique_target("__test_lifecycle_worker__")],
        config={"anti_spam_session_lock_enabled": False},
    )
    assert not app.is_running

    app.start()
    assert app.is_running

    # start() while running is a no-op, not a second runner.
    app.start()
    assert app.is_running

    app.stop()
    assert app.wait_stopped(timeout=5)
    assert not app.is_running


def test_worker_application_releases_lock_on_crash(_crashing_single_runner):
    target = "__test_crash_release__"
    stopped = threading.Event()
    app = WorkerApplication(
        workers=[_unique_target(target)],
        config={"anti_spam_session_lock_enabled": True},
        on_all_stopped=stopped.set,
    )
    try:
        app.start()
        assert stopped.wait(timeout=5), "crash should still fire on_all_stopped exactly once"
        assert app.wait_stopped(timeout=5)

        # Lock must be released — a second app targeting the same account
        # must be able to start cleanly right after the crash.
        app2 = WorkerApplication(
            workers=[_unique_target(target)],
            config={"anti_spam_session_lock_enabled": True},
        )
        app2.start()  # must not raise WorkerOwnershipError
        app2.wait_stopped(timeout=5)
    finally:
        lock_path = SessionLock(account_id=target, platform="facebook")._path
        try:
            os.remove(lock_path)
        except OSError:
            pass


def test_worker_application_ownership_lock_blocks_second_runner(_stub_single_runner):
    target = "__test_ownership_conflict__"
    lock = SessionLock(account_id=target, platform="facebook")
    try:
        lock.acquire()
        # Simulate "another process" by making is_us False. This also makes
        # our own lock.release() below unable to recognize the file as ours
        # (by design — that's the scenario under test), so cleanup happens
        # via os.remove in the finally block instead.
        _rewrite_owner_as_foreign_pid(lock)

        app = WorkerApplication(
            workers=[_unique_target(target)],
            config={"anti_spam_session_lock_enabled": True},
        )
        with pytest.raises(WorkerOwnershipError):
            app.start()
        assert not app.is_running
    finally:
        lock.release()
        try:
            os.remove(lock._path)
        except OSError:
            pass


def _rewrite_owner_as_foreign_pid(lock: SessionLock) -> None:
    """Rewrite the lock file so it looks owned by a different (live-looking)
    process, without needing to actually spawn one."""
    with open(lock._path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    data["pid"] = data["pid"] + 1  # different pid → is_us becomes False
    with open(lock._path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f)

def test_default_paths_resolve_from_non_project_cwd(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def test_env_vars_override_path_defaults(tmp_path):
    fake_env = {
        "LTT_DATA_DIR": str(tmp_path / "d"),
        "LTT_SECRETS_DIR": str(tmp_path / "s"),
        "LTT_LOGS_DIR": str(tmp_path / "l"),
        "LTT_TEMP_VIDEO_DIR": str(tmp_path / "t"),
    }
    paths = resolve_runtime_paths(env=fake_env)
    assert paths.data_dir == str(tmp_path / "d")
    assert paths.secrets_dir == str(tmp_path / "s")
    # config_path derives from data_dir when not explicitly overridden
    assert paths.config_path == os.path.join(str(tmp_path / "d"), "config.json")

    paths = resolve_runtime_paths(env=fake_env)
    assert paths.config_path == "/elsewhere/cfg.json"

def test_load_settings_invalid_config_raises_config_validation_error_no_secret_leak(tmp_path):
    cfg_path = tmp_path / "config.json"
    secret_value = "sk_live_should_never_appear_in_any_error_message_ABC123"
    cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps({
        "job_delay_seconds": -5,           # fails numeric sanity rule
        "meta_app_secret": secret_value,   # must never be echoed back
    }), encoding="utf-8")

    with pytest.raises(ConfigValidationError) as exc_info:
        load_settings(env={"LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg_path)}, strict=False)

    message = str(exc_info.value)
    assert secret_value not in message
    assert "job_delay_seconds" in message  # key names are fine to report


# ─── schema version ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _write_config(tmp_path, extra: dict) -> str:
    cfg_path = tmp_path / "config.json"
    base = {
        "job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3,

    with open(example_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)

        k for k in data
        if any(term in k.lower() for term in ("secret", "token", "password"))

                f"{key} in config.example.json looks like a real value, not a placeholder"
            )

"""
P2 — token-encryption migration (ADR-013) tests.

The FB/TikTok token stores derive their Fernet key from the machine
identity, which means encrypted token files cannot move between machines
(dev -> VPS) without re-authorizing every account. ADR-013 adds an
operator-provisioned external key override (LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY /
LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE) that is independent of machine identity,
while leaving the default (unset) behavior byte-for-byte identical to
before — verified here.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib

import core.token_store as fb_token_store
import core.tiktok.token_store as tt_token_store


def _clear_env(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.delenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE", raising=False)


def test_default_key_derivation_unchanged_without_env_override(monkeypatch):
    """No env vars set -> identical machine-bound key as before this change."""
    _clear_env(monkeypatch)
    key1 = fb_token_store._derive_key()
    key2 = fb_token_store._derive_key()
    assert key1 == key2
    # Matches the original formula directly (machine id + salt -> sha256 -> b64).
    import base64, hashlib
    expected = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(
        hashlib.sha256(
            fb_token_store._get_machine_id().encode("utf-8") + fb_token_store._SALT
        ).digest()
    )
    assert key1 == expected


def test_external_key_env_var_overrides_machine_binding(monkeypatch):
    _clear_env(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", "operator-provisioned-secret-123")
    key_with_override = fb_token_store._derive_key()

    _clear_env(monkeypatch)
    key_without_override = fb_token_store._derive_key()

    assert key_with_override != key_without_override


def test_external_key_is_deterministic_across_process_boundaries(monkeypatch):
    """Same external key -> same derived Fernet key every time (this is what
    makes tokens portable across a VPS reinstall)."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", "same-secret-value")
    key1 = fb_token_store._derive_key()
    key2 = fb_token_store._derive_key()
    assert key1 == key2


def test_external_key_file_is_read_when_env_var_absent(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    _clear_env(monkeypatch)
    key_file = tmp_path / "token.key"
    key_file.write_text("secret-from-file\n", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE", str(key_file))

    key = fb_token_store._derive_key()

    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", "secret-from-file")
    monkeypatch.delenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE", raising=False)
    key_from_var = fb_token_store._derive_key()

    assert key == key_from_var  # trailing newline is stripped consistently


def test_fb_and_tiktok_keys_differ_even_with_shared_external_secret(monkeypatch):
    """Per-store salt still applies on top of an external key, so FB and
    TikTok token files are never encrypted with the identical key."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", "shared-operator-secret")
    fb_key = fb_token_store._derive_key()
    tt_key = tt_token_store._derive_key()
    assert fb_key != tt_key


def test_token_store_roundtrip_survives_simulated_machine_change(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """The whole point of ADR-013: encrypt with one 'machine' (env A), then
    decrypt with a different simulated machine (env B) — succeeds only
    because the external key doesn't depend on machine identity."""
    _clear_env(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY", "portable-key-for-vps-migration")

    path = str(tmp_path / "tokens.enc")
    store_a = fb_token_store.TokenStore(path=path)
    account = fb_token_store.AccountInfo(
        fb_user_id="u1", name="Test User", user_token="tok123",
        token_expires_at="",
    )
    store_a.save_account(account)

    # Simulate moving the encrypted file to a different machine by faking a
    # different machine id — the external key must make this irrelevant.
    monkeypatch.setattr(fb_token_store, "_get_machine_id", lambda: "a-totally-different-machine")
    store_b = fb_token_store.TokenStore(path=path)

    loaded = store_b.get_account("u1")
    assert loaded is not None
    assert loaded.user_token == "tok123"

"""
P3 — web platform foundation tests.

Verifies:
  - server.app never imports customtkinter or gui.*
  - /health/live and /health/ready behave correctly

ADMIN_PASSWORD = "correct horse battery staple"


def _test_env(tmp_path, **overrides) -> dict:
    cfg_path = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps({
        "job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3,
        "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5, "tiktok_upload_timeout_s": 60,
        "tiktok_request_timeout_s": 10, "sheet_id": "abc",
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    env = {
        "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
        "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg_path),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    }
    env.update(overrides)
    return env


def _client(tmp_path, **overrides) -> TestClient:
    env = _test_env(tmp_path, **overrides)
    app = create_app(env=env)
    # base_url must be https:// — the session cookie is marked Secure
    # (secure_cookies=True for local-server-test/production), and httpx's
    # cookie jar correctly refuses to resend a Secure cookie over plain
    # http, which the default "http://testserver" base_url would be. This
    # mirrors real deployment: the browser always talks HTTPS to Caddy,
    # even though Caddy->uvicorn is a plain-HTTP loopback hop.
    return TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver", follow_redirects=False)

# ─── login / logout flow ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _get_csrf_token(client: TestClient) -> str:
    resp = client.get("/login")
    # crude extraction — good enough for a test, avoids adding an HTML parser dep
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = resp.text.index(marker) + len(marker)
    end = resp.text.index('"', start)
    return resp.text[start:end]


def test_login_wrong_password_returns_401(tmp_path):
    client = _client(tmp_path)
    token = _get_csrf_token(client)
    resp = client.post("/login", data={
        "username": "admin", "password": "wrong-password", "csrf_token": token,
    })
    assert resp.status_code == 401


def test_login_success_then_dashboard_then_logout(tmp_path):
    client = _client(tmp_path)
    token = _get_csrf_token(client)
    resp = client.post("/login", data={
        "username": "admin", "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD, "csrf_token": token,
    })
    assert resp.status_code == 303
    assert resp.headers["location"] == "/"

    dash = client.get("/")
    assert dash.status_code == 200
    assert "admin" in dash.text

    # Logout can CSRF (W1.4): lay token tu form logout trong base.html.
    _m = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    _s = dash.text.index(_m) + len(_m)
    logout_tok = dash.text[_s:dash.text.index('"', _s)]
    logout_resp = client.post("/logout", data={"csrf_token": logout_tok})
    assert logout_resp.status_code == 303
    assert logout_resp.headers["location"] == "/login"

    dash_after = client.get("/")
    # H6: trang chu cong khai -> 200; phien da thu hoi nen khong con vo authed.
    assert dash_after.status_code == 200
    assert "Đăng xuất" not in dash_after.text


# ─── rate limiting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_login_rate_limited_after_repeated_failures(tmp_path):
    client = _client(tmp_path)
    for _ in range(5):
        token = _get_csrf_token(client)
        resp = client.post("/login", data={
            "username": "admin", "password": "wrong", "csrf_token": token,
        })
        assert resp.status_code == 401

    token = _get_csrf_token(client)
    resp = client.post("/login", data={
        "username": "admin", "password": "wrong", "csrf_token": token,
    })
    assert resp.status_code == 429


def test_rate_limiter_unit_allows_then_blocks_then_resets():
    limiter = RateLimiter(max_attempts=2, window_seconds=60.0)
    assert limiter.allow("k") is True
    assert limiter.allow("k") is True
    assert limiter.allow("k") is False
    limiter.reset("k")
    assert limiter.allow("k") is True

"""
PA-1 — token store must distinguish "no accounts" from "unreadable file".

Regression guard for docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md finding D2: an undecryptable
token file used to be silently collapsed into "0 accounts", making a real
credential outage look identical to a fresh install. The live audit hit
exactly this — 27KB of real Facebook tokens reported as "no accounts
connected".
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json

import pytest
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

from core.tiktok.token_store import TikTokTokenStore
from core.token_store import AccountInfo, TokenStore


def _foreign_key() -> bytes:
    """A valid Fernet key that is NOT this machine's derived key —
    simulates a token file encrypted on a different host."""
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(b"some-other-machine").digest())


# ─── state 1: file absent -> quiet "no accounts" ──────────────────────────────

def test_absent_file_is_not_an_error(tmp_path):
    store = TokenStore(path=str(tmp_path / "nope.enc"))
    assert store.count() == 0
    assert store.is_unreadable is False
    assert store.load_error is None


def test_empty_file_is_not_an_error(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    p.write_bytes(b"")
    store = TokenStore(path=str(p))
    assert store.count() == 0
    assert store.is_unreadable is False


# ─── state 2: file present but unreadable -> loud ─────────────────────────────

def test_foreign_key_encrypted_file_reports_unreadable(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    payload = json.dumps([{
        "fb_user_id": "u1", "name": "N", "user_token": "t",
        "token_expires_at": "", "pages": [],
    }]).encode("utf-8")
    p.write_bytes(Fernet(_foreign_key()).encrypt(payload))

    store = TokenStore(path=str(p))

    assert store.count() == 0
    assert store.is_unreadable is True
    assert store.load_error
    # The message must tell the operator what to actually do.
    assert "kết nối lại" in store.load_error.lower()
    assert "LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY" in store.load_error


def test_corrupt_garbage_file_reports_unreadable(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    p.write_bytes(b"this is not fernet and not json either")
    store = TokenStore(path=str(p))
    assert store.count() == 0
    assert store.is_unreadable is True


def test_unreadable_message_never_contains_token_material(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    # Assembled at runtime so this fixture does not trip the repo's own
    # source secret scanner (same convention as test_33_secret_scanner).
    secret = "EAA" + "syntheticFixtureTokenValue" + "1234567890"
    payload = json.dumps([{
        "fb_user_id": "u1", "name": "N", "user_token": secret,
        "token_expires_at": "", "pages": [],
    }]).encode("utf-8")
    p.write_bytes(Fernet(_foreign_key()).encrypt(payload))

    store = TokenStore(path=str(p))
    assert secret not in (store.load_error or "")


# ─── state 3: readable -> loads, no error ─────────────────────────────────────

def test_readable_store_roundtrip_has_no_error(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    store = TokenStore(path=str(p))

    ))

    reopened = TokenStore(path=str(p))
    assert reopened.count() == 1
    assert reopened.is_unreadable is False
    assert reopened.load_error is None

"""
PA-3 — preflight column validation tests.

Guards docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md finding B3: a one-word column-name mismatch
(`schedule_time_fb_dai` vs `schedule_time`) took a live run down mid-flight,
and a second mismatch (`error_message_dai`) silently disabled error
write-back with no symptom at all.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from core.preflight import Severity, check_columns

# Header set taken from a real tab observed during the audit.
REAL_HEADERS = [
    "binh_luan_video", "dang_ky_kenh", "diem", "dsp_chinh", "error_message",
    "fb_video_id", "link_kenh_youtube", "make_status", "mo_ta",
    "schedule_time", "status", "status_clip_short", "status_fb",
    "ten_video_upload", "tieu_de", "tieu_de_seo", "time_tiktok",
    "titok_status", "tu_khoa_chinh", "upload_duration_s", "uploaded_at",
    "video_goc", "video_short", "video_url_fb",
]


def _config(**overrides) -> dict:
    base = {
        "col_schedule_time": "schedule_time",
        "col_status":        "status_fb",
        "col_video_drive":   "video_goc",
        "col_error":         "error_message",
        "col_fb_link":       "video_url_fb",
        "col_title":         "tieu_de_seo",
    }
    base.update(overrides)
    return base


def test_fully_matching_config_has_no_findings():
    result = check_columns(_config(), REAL_HEADERS, tab="T")
    assert result.findings == []
    assert result.ok is True
    assert "✅" in result.format()


def test_missing_mandatory_column_is_an_error_and_blocks_run():
    result = check_columns(
        _config(col_schedule_time="schedule_time_fb_dai"), REAL_HEADERS, tab="T",
    )
    assert result.ok is False
    assert len(result.errors) == 1
    assert result.errors[0].config_key == "col_schedule_time"


def test_the_real_audit_case_suggests_the_correct_header():
    """The exact mismatch that broke the live run must be auto-diagnosed."""
    result = check_columns(
        _config(col_schedule_time="schedule_time_fb_dai"), REAL_HEADERS, tab="T",
    )
    assert result.errors[0].suggestion == "schedule_time"


def test_missing_error_column_is_a_warning_that_does_not_block():
    result = check_columns(
        _config(col_error="error_message_dai"), REAL_HEADERS, tab="T",
    )
    assert result.ok is True                      # run still possible
    assert len(result.warnings) == 1
    w = result.warnings[0]
    assert w.config_key == "col_error"
    assert w.suggestion == "error_message"
    # The consequence must be spelled out — silent loss is the whole bug.
    assert "KHÔNG được ghi" in w.consequence


def test_unset_column_is_reported_not_skipped():
    result = check_columns(_config(col_schedule_time=""), REAL_HEADERS, tab="T")
    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.errors[0].configured == "(chưa đặt)"


def test_unrelated_name_gets_no_misleading_suggestion():
    result = check_columns(
        _config(col_schedule_time="zzz_completely_unrelated_xyz"), REAL_HEADERS, tab="T",
    )
    assert result.errors[0].suggestion == ""


def test_severity_split_is_correct():
    result = check_columns(
        _config(col_schedule_time="nope_missing", col_error="also_missing"),
        REAL_HEADERS, tab="T",
    )
    assert {f.severity for f in result.errors} == {Severity.ERROR}
    assert {f.severity for f in result.warnings} == {Severity.WARNING}


def test_headers_are_whitespace_normalised():
    result = check_columns(_config(), ["  schedule_time  ", "status_fb",
                                      "video_goc", "error_message",
                                      "video_url_fb", "tieu_de_seo"], tab="T")
    assert result.ok is True


def test_empty_sheet_reports_every_column_missing():
    result = check_columns(_config(), [], tab="Empty")
    assert result.ok is False
    assert len(result.errors) == 2      # both mandatory columns
    assert len(result.warnings) == 4    # all important columns

"""
PA-4 / PA-5 — worker-list persistence and the doctor health report.

Guards docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md finding D3 (worker list existed only in GUI

# ─── worker_store ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    save_workers([{"tab": "T1", "page": "P1", "sheet_id": "S1"}], path=p)
    got = load_workers(path=p)
    assert len(got) == 1
    assert got[0]["tab"] == "T1"
    assert got[0]["page"] == "P1"


def test_missing_file_is_empty_not_an_error(tmp_path):
    assert load_workers(path=str(tmp_path / "nope.json")) == []


def test_platforms_do_not_overwrite_each_other(tmp_path):
    """The desktop app has a Sheet-FB tab and a Sheet-TikTok tab; saving
    one must not wipe the other's list."""
    p = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    save_workers([{"tab": "FB-Tab"}], platform="facebook", path=p)
    save_workers([{"tab": "TT-Tab"}], platform="tiktok", path=p)

    assert [w["tab"] for w in load_workers(platform="facebook", path=p)] == ["FB-Tab"]
    assert [w["tab"] for w in load_workers(platform="tiktok", path=p)] == ["TT-Tab"]
    assert len(load_workers(path=p)) == 2      # platform=None -> everything


def test_empty_platform_is_stored_as_facebook(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    save_workers([{"tab": "T"}], platform="", path=p)
    assert len(load_workers(platform="facebook", path=p)) == 1


def test_resave_replaces_only_that_platform(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    save_workers([{"tab": "A"}, {"tab": "B"}], platform="facebook", path=p)
    save_workers([{"tab": "C"}], platform="facebook", path=p)
    assert [w["tab"] for w in load_workers(platform="facebook", path=p)] == ["C"]


def test_display_only_fields_are_not_persisted(tmp_path):
    """account_name is a cached label; persisting it would let stale
    display data outlive the account it described."""
    p = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    save_workers([{"tab": "T", "account_name": "Stale Cached Name"}], path=p)
    assert "account_name" not in load_workers(path=p)[0]


def test_rows_without_tab_are_dropped(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "workers.json")
    save_workers([{"tab": "Good"}, {"tab": ""}], path=p)
    assert [w["tab"] for w in load_workers(path=p)] == ["Good"]


def test_newer_schema_version_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "workers.json"
    p.write_text(json.dumps({
        "_schema_version": WORKERS_SCHEMA_VERSION + 1, "workers": [{"tab": "T"}],
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(WorkerStoreError):
        load_workers(path=str(p))


def test_corrupt_file_raises_rather_than_silently_empty(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "workers.json"
    p.write_text("{not json", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(WorkerStoreError):
        load_workers(path=str(p))


def test_wrong_toplevel_shape_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "workers.json"
    p.write_text(json.dumps([{"tab": "T"}]), encoding="utf-8")  # array, not object
    with pytest.raises(WorkerStoreError):
        load_workers(path=str(p))

# ─── doctor ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_doctor_reports_blocker_for_unreadable_tokens(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import base64
    import hashlib

    from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

    from tools import doctor

    foreign = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(b"other-machine").digest())
    tok = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    tok.write_bytes(Fernet(foreign).encrypt(b'[{"fb_user_id":"u1"}]'))

    import core.token_store as ts
    monkeypatch.setattr(ts, "TOKEN_FILE", str(tok))

    report = doctor.Report()
    doctor.check_tokens(report)

    fb = [s for s in report.sections if "Facebook" in s["check"]][0]
    assert fb["status"] == doctor.BLOCK
    assert fb["fix"]                       # must be actionable
    assert report.has_blocker is True


def test_doctor_output_contains_no_token_material(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import base64
    import hashlib

    from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

    from tools import doctor

    # Assembled at runtime so this fixture does not trip the repo's own
    # source secret scanner (same convention as test_33_secret_scanner).
    secret = "EAA" + "syntheticFixtureMustNotLeak" + "123456"
    foreign = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(b"other-machine").digest())
    tok = tmp_path / "tokens.enc"
    tok.write_bytes(Fernet(foreign).encrypt(
        json.dumps([{"fb_user_id": "u1", "user_token": secret}]).encode()
    ))

    import core.token_store as ts
    monkeypatch.setattr(ts, "TOKEN_FILE", str(tok))

    report = doctor.Report()
    doctor.check_tokens(report)
    assert secret not in report.to_text()


def test_doctor_exit_code_zero_when_healthy(monkeypatch):
    from tools import doctor

    report = doctor.Report()
    report.add("Everything", doctor.OK, "fine")
    assert report.has_blocker is False


def test_doctor_warning_alone_does_not_block(monkeypatch):
    from tools import doctor

    report = doctor.Report()
    report.add("Something", doctor.WARN, "not ideal")
    assert report.has_blocker is False
    assert "cảnh báo" in report.to_text()

def test_controller_rejects_second_concurrent_run(monkeypatch):
    class _StubRunner:
        def __init__(self, *, stop_event=None, **kw):
            self.stop_event = stop_event or threading.Event()

        def run(self):
            self.stop_event.wait()

    monkeypatch.setattr("core.worker_app.SheetRunner", _StubRunner)

    controller = WorkerController()
    workers = [{"tab": "T", "account_id": "__test_ctl_busy__"}]
    controller.start(workers, {"anti_spam_session_lock_enabled": False}, "facebook")
    try:
        assert controller.snapshot().running is True
        with pytest.raises(WorkerBusyError):
            controller.start(workers, {"anti_spam_session_lock_enabled": False}, "facebook")
    finally:
        controller.stop()

    assert snap.workers == []

# ─── web routes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _client(tmp_path) -> TestClient:
    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({
        "job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3,
        "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5, "tiktok_upload_timeout_s": 60,
        "tiktok_request_timeout_s": 10, "sheet_id": "abc",
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    app = create_app(env={
        "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
        "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    })
    return TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver", follow_redirects=False)


def _login(client: TestClient) -> None:
    resp = client.get("/login")
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = resp.text.index(marker) + len(marker)
    token = resp.text[start:resp.text.index('"', start)]
    client.post("/login", data={
        "username": "admin", "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD, "csrf_token": token,
    })


def _csrf_from(html: str) -> str:
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = html.index(marker) + len(marker)
    return html[start:html.index('"', start)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/facebook", "/tiktok", "/workers", "/api/workers/status"])
def test_new_routes_require_login(tmp_path, path):
    resp = _client(tmp_path).get(path)
    assert resp.status_code == 303
    assert resp.headers["location"].startswith("/login")

def test_start_then_status_api_then_stop(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """The end-to-end control-plane loop: web starts the worker, the JSON
    status endpoint reflects it, web stops it."""
    class _StubRunner:
        def __init__(self, *, stop_event=None, **kw):
            self.stop_event = stop_event or threading.Event()

        def run(self):
            self.stop_event.wait()

    monkeypatch.setattr("core.worker_app.SheetRunner", _StubRunner)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "server.routes.workers._stored_workers",
        lambda p: [{"tab": "T1", "page": "P1", "account_id": "__test_web_loop__"}],
    )

    client = _client(tmp_path)
    _login(client)

    page = client.get("/workers")

    assert stopped.status_code == 303

    from server.services.worker_control import get_controller
    assert get_controller().snapshot() is not None

"""
SessionLock must resolve its directory through the P2 runtime-path
boundary, not a CWD-relative constant.

Found during the P6 real-server smoke test: the lock directory was a
module-level `os.path.join("data", "session_locks")`. A server started
with LTT_DATA_DIR pointing at an external data directory therefore wrote
locks somewhere different from the desktop app, which would silently
break the desktop/server mutual exclusion that AGENTS.md requires —
exactly the failure that lets two runners publish the same job twice.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os

from core.session_lock import SessionLock


def test_lock_dir_follows_ltt_data_dir(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "custom_data"))
    lock = SessionLock(account_id="acct1", platform="facebook")
    assert str(tmp_path / "custom_data") in lock.lock_dir
    assert lock.lock_dir.endswith("session_locks")


def test_lock_dir_is_independent_of_cwd(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """The original bug: a CWD-relative default silently moved the lock
    directory when a process ran from elsewhere."""
    monkeypatch.delenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    lock = SessionLock(account_id="acct2", platform="facebook")

    assert os.path.isabs(lock.lock_dir)
    assert str(tmp_path) not in lock.lock_dir


def test_explicit_lock_dir_still_wins(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "ignored"))
    explicit = str(tmp_path / "explicit")
    lock = SessionLock(account_id="acct3", lock_dir=explicit)
    assert lock.lock_dir == explicit


def test_two_locks_in_same_data_dir_see_each_other(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Mutual exclusion only works if both processes agree on the path."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path / "shared"))

    first = SessionLock(account_id="shared_acct", platform="facebook")
    first.acquire()
    try:
        second = SessionLock(account_id="shared_acct", platform="facebook")
        owner = second.current_owner()
        assert owner is not None
        assert owner.account_id == "shared_acct"
    finally:
        first.release()


def test_runtime_paths_are_gitignored():
    """Locks and the worker list are machine-specific runtime state."""
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    with open(os.path.join(root, ".gitignore"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        ignored = f.read()
    assert "data/session_locks/" in ignored
    assert "data/workers.json" in ignored

"""
Web hardening checks found while auditing the dashboard's features before
putting it on a public domain (app.lttstudios.com).

Two real gaps this guards:
  1. FastAPI's /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json were reachable without
     authentication — free reconnaissance of every route and parameter.
  2. No security response headers at all (clickjacking, MIME sniffing,

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

ADMIN_PASSWORD = "correct horse battery staple"


def _client(tmp_path, environment: str = "local-server-test") -> TestClient:
    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({
        "job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3,
        "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5, "tiktok_upload_timeout_s": 60,
        "tiktok_request_timeout_s": 10, "sheet_id": "abc",
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    env = {
        "LTT_ENV": environment,
        "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    }
    return TestClient(create_app(env=env), base_url="https://testserver",
                      follow_redirects=False)

def test_loi_chua_bat_tra_500_co_style_va_no_store(tmp_path):
    """Route raise Exception (không phải HTTPException) phải trả 500 CÓ style,

    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"

        "job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3, "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5,

        "sheet_id": "abc",
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    app = create_app(env={
        "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test", "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    })

    @app.get("/_noi_gian_test")
    def _boom():
        raise RuntimeError("no vo co chu dich de test handler 500")

# ─── security headers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_security_headers_present_on_pages(tmp_path):
    resp = _client(tmp_path).get("/login")
    assert resp.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] == "nosniff"
    assert resp.headers["X-Frame-Options"] == "DENY"
    assert resp.headers["Referrer-Policy"] == "same-origin"
    csp = resp.headers["Content-Security-Policy"]
    assert "frame-ancestors 'none'" in csp
    assert "default-src 'self'" in csp
    assert "form-action 'self'" in csp
    # App video cần media-src (blob: đọc metadata client + R2 phát video presigned).
    assert "media-src 'self' blob:" in csp
    assert "r2.cloudflarestorage.com" in csp
    # connect-src cho upload thẳng browser→R2 (presigned PUT).
    assert "connect-src 'self' https://*.r2.cloudflarestorage.com" in csp
    assert "https://cloudflareinsights.com" in csp
    assert "https://static.cloudflareinsights.com" in csp
    # img-src cho ảnh output phục vụ qua R2 presigned (app chat AI, ảnh…).
    assert "img-src 'self' data: https://*.r2.cloudflarestorage.com" in csp


def test_dynamic_responses_are_not_cacheable(tmp_path):
    """Response ĐỘNG (ngoài /static/) phải `no-store` để CDN/proxy không cache.

    Khoá lỗi thật ở H5: ảnh output per-user phục vụ ở URL `.png` bị Cloudflare
    cache theo đuôi file rồi trả cho người KHÔNG đăng nhập (bỏ qua auth ở origin).
    """
    c = _client(tmp_path)
    assert c.get("/login").headers.get("Cache-Control") == "no-store"
    assert c.get("/health/ready").headers.get("Cache-Control") == "no-store"
    # /static/ là asset công khai — KHÔNG bị ép no-store (được phép cache).
    st = c.get("/static/htmx.min.js")
    if st.status_code == 200:
        assert st.headers.get("Cache-Control") != "no-store"
