"""
P9 — deployment script sanity checks.

Guards a real bug found while building the package: Windows PowerShell 5.1
reads a .ps1 file using the system ANSI codepage unless it has a UTF-8
BOM. An em-dash in a message string therefore turned into mojibake and
broke the parser with "The string is missing the terminator" — a
deployment script that fails to parse on the target server is worse than
no script, because it fails halfway through an install.

Keeping deploy scripts pure ASCII sidesteps codepage issues entirely.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os

import pytest

DEPLOY_DIR = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "deploy", "windows",
)

EXPECTED_SCRIPTS = (
    "install.ps1", "update.ps1", "rollback.ps1",
    "backup.ps1", "restore.ps1", "set-service-env.ps1",
    # Q28 lich backup + bootstrap: truoc day khong nam trong bo guard ASCII/BOM
    # (audit 2026-07-31 W0/W1). Them vao de regression khong lot luoi.
    "5-lich-backup.ps1", "bootstrap-server2016.ps1",
)


def _scripts() -> list:
    return [f for f in sorted(os.listdir(DEPLOY_DIR)) if f.endswith(".ps1")]


def _read(name: str) -> str:
    with open(os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, name), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()


def test_restore_actually_restores_the_database():
    """W0.4/P0-4: backup dung pg_dump (-Fc) nen restore PHAI pg_restore file
    .dump; neu chi Expand-Archive thi 'khoi phuc' mat toan bo CSDL (user/credit/
    job). Chot bang cach doi restore.ps1 co pg_restore + doc LTT_DATABASE_URL."""
    text = _read("restore.ps1")
    assert "pg_restore" in text, "restore.ps1 khong pg_restore -> backup khong cuu duoc DB"
    assert "LTT_DATABASE_URL" in text


def test_update_runs_migrations_before_start():
    """W0.6/P0-6: ban phat hanh doi schema ma update.ps1 khong 'alembic upgrade
    head' -> service boot tren schema cu, loi runtime/hong du lieu."""
    text = _read("update.ps1")
    assert "alembic upgrade head" in text
    # Migration phai chay TRUOC khi Start-Service.
    assert text.index("alembic upgrade head") < text.index("Start-Service $ServiceName")

def test_backup_never_puts_secrets_in_the_database_archive():
    """H35.9: app.env va pg_dump khong duoc nam chung mot zip.

    Do that ngay 2026-08-17 tren may chu: ltt_data_20260817_023001.zip chua ca
    `app.env` lan `lttplatform.dump`. Nghia la MOT ban zip bi lay cap la du de
    doc token da ma hoa (co LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY) va - sau khi Public API
    len - tan cong khoa API cua khach ngoai tuyen (co LTT_API_KEY_PEPPER).

    Chot bang cau truc chu khong bang cau chu: ban secrets phai la mot archive
    RIENG, va app.env khong duoc copy vao thu muc staging cua ban du lieu.
    """
    text = _read("backup.ps1")

    assert "ltt_secrets_$Stamp.zip" in text, "phai co archive secrets rieng"
    assert "SecretsDir" in text, "phai cho phep chon noi cat ban secrets"

    # app.env chi duoc copy vao staging RIENG cua secrets, khong vao $staging.

            continue
        assert "$secretStaging" in line, (
            f"app.env bi copy vao staging cua ban du lieu: {line.strip()}"
        )

    """W1.5: ban backup off-drive CHUA secrets (app.env + dump) -> thu muc phai
    bi siet ACL (icacls SID) de Users/Everyone khong doc duoc."""
    text = _read("5-lich-backup.ps1")
    assert "icacls" in text
    assert "/inheritance:r" in text
    assert "S-1-5-18" in text and "S-1-5-32-544" in text   # SID, locale-safe


def test_all_expected_scripts_exist():
    present = set(_scripts())
    missing = [s for s in EXPECTED_SCRIPTS if s not in present]
    assert missing == [], f"missing deployment scripts: {missing}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", EXPECTED_SCRIPTS)
def test_scripts_are_pure_ascii(name):
    """Non-ASCII in a .ps1 breaks Windows PowerShell 5.1 parsing when the
    file has no BOM."""
    path = os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, name)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        raw = f.read()

    non_ascii = [(i, b) for i, b in enumerate(raw) if b > 127]
    assert non_ascii == [], (
        f"{name} contains non-ASCII bytes at offsets "
        f"{[i for i, _ in non_ascii[:5]]} — PowerShell 5.1 will misparse it"
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", EXPECTED_SCRIPTS)
def test_scripts_have_no_bom(name):
    """A BOM would also work, but mixing conventions invites confusion —
    ASCII-only is the rule here."""
    with open(os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, name), "rb") as f:
        assert not f.read(3).startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", EXPECTED_SCRIPTS)
def test_scripts_set_error_action_stop(name):
    """Without this, a failed step keeps going and can leave a half-
    installed server that looks successful."""
    with open(os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, name), encoding="ascii") as f:
        assert "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'" in f.read()


def test_caddyfile_example_exists_and_binds_loopback():
    path = os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, "Caddyfile.example")
    assert os.path.exists(path)
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()
    assert "app.lttstudios.com" in content
    # The app must never be proxied from a public bind address.
    #
    # Asserted on the loopback prefix, not on a specific port number: the port
    # is a deployment detail that legitimately changes (it moved 8000 -> 8100
    # when this host turned out to already run another service on 8000), while
    # "never proxy a publicly-bound address" is the actual invariant. Pinning
    # the number made a routine port change look like a security regression.
    assert "reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:" in content
    for public_bind in ("reverse_proxy 0.0.0.0:", "reverse_proxy :"):
        assert public_bind not in content, public_bind


def test_no_secret_values_in_deploy_scripts():
    """Scripts may reference secret NAMES, never values."""
    for name in _scripts() + ["Caddyfile.example"]:
        path = os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, name)
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            content = f.read()
        for var in ("LTT_SESSION_SECRET", "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH",
                    "LTT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY"):
            for line in content.splitlines():
                if var not in line or "=" not in line:
                    continue
                tail = line.split(var, 1)[1].lstrip()
                if not tail.startswith("="):
                    continue
                # Strip PowerShell array/string punctuation so only the
                # assigned value remains:  'LTT_X=',  ->  ''
                assigned = tail[1:].strip().strip("'\"").rstrip(",").strip("'\"")
                assert assigned == "", (
                    f"{name}: {var} must ship empty, got {assigned!r}"
                )

"""
Two bugs found during the first real deployment to a Windows Server 2022
VM. Both only appear on a real target, which is why the earlier local
"clean-install rehearsal" missed them.

  1. tools/doctor.py crashed with UnicodeEncodeError on a fresh Windows
     console (legacy cp1252 codepage) because the report contains
     Vietnamese text and status icons. The diagnostic tool died exactly
     when it was needed to diagnose.

  2. install.ps1 created the data directory but never put a config.json
     in it, so the service started and reported /health/ready = 503
     forever with no obvious cause.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
import sys

DEPLOY_DIR = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "deploy", "windows",
)


def _project_root() -> str:
    return os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


# ─── Bug 1: doctor must survive a legacy console codepage ─────────────────────

def test_doctor_declares_utf8_hardening():
    with open(os.path.join(_project_root(), "tools", "doctor.py"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        src = f.read()
    assert "_force_utf8_output" in src
    assert 'errors="replace"' in src


def test_doctor_runs_under_legacy_codepage_without_crashing():
    """Reproduces the real failure: force a legacy ANSI codepage for the
    child process and confirm doctor still produces output and a clean
    exit code instead of a UnicodeEncodeError traceback."""
    env = dict(os.environ)
    # cp1252 is what the Windows Server console used when this crashed.
    env["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "cp1252"
    env.pop("PYTHONUTF8", None)
    env["LTT_CONFIG_PATH"] = os.path.join(_project_root(), "does_not_exist.json")

    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, os.path.join("tools", "doctor.py")],
        cwd=_project_root(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, env=env,
        # The child now emits UTF-8 (that is the fix); decode it as such.
        # Without this the *parent* would fail on cp1252, masking the result.
        encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
    )

    combined = (result.stdout or "") + (result.stderr or "")
    assert "UnicodeEncodeError" not in combined, combined[-800:]
    assert "Traceback" not in combined, combined[-800:]
    # Exit code 1 is expected (missing config is a blocker) — the point is
    # that it reported rather than crashed.
    assert result.returncode in (0, 1)
    assert result.stdout.strip(), "doctor produced no output"


def test_doctor_json_mode_also_survives_legacy_codepage():
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "cp1252"
    env.pop("PYTHONUTF8", None)

    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, os.path.join("tools", "doctor.py"), "--json"],
        cwd=_project_root(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, env=env,
        # The child now emits UTF-8 (that is the fix); decode it as such.
        # Without this the *parent* would fail on cp1252, masking the result.
        encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
    )
    assert "UnicodeEncodeError" not in (result.stdout + result.stderr)

# ─── Bug 3: an empty data dir must not abort update.ps1 ───────────────────────

def test_backup_treats_empty_data_dir_as_skip_not_error():
    """update.ps1 backs up before touching anything. backup.ps1 used to
    `throw 'Nothing to back up.'` on a fresh install, which aborted the
    entire update — found on the first real deployment."""
    with open(os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, "backup.ps1"), encoding="ascii") as f:
        src = f.read()

    assert "throw 'Nothing to back up.'" not in src, (
        "an empty data directory is a legitimate fresh-install state, "
        "not a failure that should abort the caller"
    )
    assert "[SKIP]" in src

    # Truoc H35.9 duong nay la `exit 0`. Khong con nua, va co chu y: ban sao
    # secrets duoc ghi SAU khoi nay, nen thoat som se lam mot may moi cai
    # co app.env nhung KHONG co ban sao nao cua no. Chot bang cau truc:
    # nhanh rong phai la mot `else`, khong duoc thoat khoi script.
    empty_branch = src[src.index("[SKIP]"):]
    assert "exit" not in empty_branch.split("}", 1)[0], (
        "nhanh 'khong co du lieu' khong duoc exit: ban sao secrets nam sau no"
    )
    assert src.index("[SKIP]") < src.index("ltt_secrets_$Stamp"), (
        "khoi secrets phai chay sau nhanh skip, khong bi no cat mat"
    )


def test_update_still_backs_up_before_changing_anything():
    """The skip above must not weaken the real safety property: a populated
    data directory is still backed up before the release is replaced."""
    with open(os.path.join(DEPLOY_DIR, "update.ps1"), encoding="ascii") as f:
        src = f.read()
    backup_at = src.index("backup.ps1")
    extract_at = src.index("Expand-Archive")
    assert backup_at < extract_at, "backup must run before the release is replaced"

"""
Web Settings page — GUI parity phase 1.

The properties that matter most here are not cosmetic:

  * a secret must never be rendered into HTML;
  * submitting the form with a secret field left blank must NOT wipe the
    stored secret (a round-trip through the UI would otherwise silently
    destroy an App Secret);
  * invalid input must leave the on-disk config untouched — a bad column
    mapping silently stops the bot (docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md B3), so a
    half-applied save is worse than a rejected one.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from core.config_defaults import DEFAULTS
from server.app import create_app
from platform_core.password_hashing import hash_password
from server.services.settings_schema import (
    GROUPS,
    all_field_keys,
    coverage_report,
    secret_keys,
)
from server.services.settings_service import apply_form, save_config, view_model

ADMIN_PASSWORD = "correct horse battery staple"
FAKE_SECRET = "s3cr3t" + "AppSecretValue" + "998877"


# ─── schema coverage ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_every_default_key_is_reachable_from_the_ui():
    """A config key nobody can edit is a key that silently rots."""
    missing = coverage_report()["missing"]
    assert missing == [], f"these config keys have no UI field: {missing}"


def test_schema_has_no_invented_keys_outside_the_real_config():
    """Guards against typo'd field keys that would write junk into config."""
    unknown = set(coverage_report()["unknown"])
    # These two are real keys used by core/ but absent from DEFAULTS.
    allowed = {"fb_comment_enabled", "tiktok_redirect_uri"}
    assert unknown <= allowed, f"unexpected keys: {unknown - allowed}"


def test_group_ids_and_field_keys_are_unique():
    ids = [g.id for g in GROUPS]
    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids))
    keys = [f.key for g in GROUPS for f in g.fields]
    assert len(keys) == len(set(keys)), "a field key appears twice"


# ─── secrets never leave the server ────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_view_model_never_exposes_a_secret_value():
    cfg = dict(DEFAULTS)
    for k in secret_keys():
        cfg[k] = FAKE_SECRET

    vm = view_model(cfg)
    blob = json.dumps(vm, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
    assert FAKE_SECRET not in blob

    for k in secret_keys():
        assert vm[k]["value"] == ""
        assert vm[k]["is_set"] is True


def test_view_model_marks_unset_secrets():
    cfg = dict(DEFAULTS)
    for k in secret_keys():
        cfg[k] = ""
    vm = view_model(cfg)
    for k in secret_keys():
        assert vm[k]["is_set"] is False


# ─── form merge semantics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_blank_secret_submission_keeps_the_stored_value():
    """The dangerous case: user edits an unrelated field and saves."""
    cfg = dict(DEFAULTS)
    cfg["meta_app_secret"] = FAKE_SECRET

    new, errors = apply_form(cfg, {"meta_app_secret": "", "sheet_id": "abc"})

    assert errors == {}
    assert new["meta_app_secret"] == FAKE_SECRET      # preserved
    assert new["sheet_id"] == "abc"


def test_non_blank_secret_submission_replaces_it():
    cfg = dict(DEFAULTS)
    cfg["meta_app_secret"] = FAKE_SECRET
    new, _ = apply_form(cfg, {"meta_app_secret": "brand-new-value"})
    assert new["meta_app_secret"] == "brand-new-value"

# ─── saving never corrupts a working config ────────────────────────────────────

def test_invalid_config_is_not_written(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    cfg_file = tmp_path / "config.json"
    good = {"job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3, "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5,
            "tiktok_upload_timeout_s": 60, "tiktok_request_timeout_s": 10}
    cfg_file.write_text(json.dumps(good), encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_CONFIG_PATH", str(cfg_file))

    bad = dict(good)
    bad["job_delay_seconds"] = -99          # violates the validator

    saved, errors, _ = save_config(bad)

    assert saved is False
    assert errors
    assert json.loads(cfg_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == good   # untouched


def test_valid_save_writes_and_makes_a_backup(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    cfg_file = tmp_path / "config.json"
    good = {"job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3, "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5,
            "tiktok_upload_timeout_s": 60, "tiktok_request_timeout_s": 10}
    cfg_file.write_text(json.dumps(good), encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_CONFIG_PATH", str(cfg_file))

    updated = dict(good, sheet_id="new-sheet")
    saved, errors, _ = save_config(updated)

    assert saved is True, errors
    assert json.loads(cfg_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sheet_id"] == "new-sheet"
    backups = list(tmp_path.glob("config.backup_*.json"))
    assert len(backups) == 1
    assert json.loads(backups[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == good


# ─── the page itself ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _client(tmp_path) -> TestClient:
    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({
        "job_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 3, "tiktok_poll_interval_s": 5,
        "tiktok_upload_timeout_s": 60, "tiktok_request_timeout_s": 10,
        "sheet_id": "abc", "meta_app_secret": FAKE_SECRET,
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    app = create_app(env={
        "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
        "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    })
    return TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver", follow_redirects=False)


def _login(c: TestClient) -> None:
    r = c.get("/login")
    m = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    s = r.text.index(m) + len(m)
    c.post("/login", data={"username": "admin", "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD,
                           "csrf_token": r.text[s:r.text.index('"', s)]})


def _csrf(html: str) -> str:
    m = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    s = html.index(m) + len(m)
    return html[s:html.index('"', s)]


def test_settings_requires_login(tmp_path):
    r = _client(tmp_path).get("/settings")
    assert r.status_code == 303
    assert r.headers["location"].startswith("/login")


def test_settings_page_renders_all_groups(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_CONFIG_PATH", str(tmp_path / "config.json"))
    c = _client(tmp_path)
    _login(c)
    r = c.get("/settings")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    for g in GROUPS:
        assert g.title in r.text, f"group missing from page: {g.title}"


def test_rendered_page_contains_no_secret_value(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_CONFIG_PATH", str(tmp_path / "config.json"))
    c = _client(tmp_path)
    _login(c)
    r = c.get("/settings")
    assert FAKE_SECRET not in r.text


def test_save_requires_csrf(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_CONFIG_PATH", str(tmp_path / "config.json"))
    c = _client(tmp_path)
    _login(c)
    r = c.post("/settings", data={"csrf_token": "forged", "sheet_id": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 400


def test_save_roundtrip_updates_config(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    cfg_file = tmp_path / "config.json"
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_CONFIG_PATH", str(cfg_file))
    c = _client(tmp_path)
    _login(c)

    page = c.get("/settings")
    r = c.post("/settings", data={
        "csrf_token": _csrf(page.text),
        "sheet_id": "sheet-from-web",
        "job_delay_seconds": "45",
        "meta_app_secret": "",          # blank => keep
    })
    assert r.status_code == 200
    on_disk = json.loads(cfg_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert on_disk["sheet_id"] == "sheet-from-web"
    assert on_disk["job_delay_seconds"] == 45
    assert on_disk["meta_app_secret"] == FAKE_SECRET      # not wiped

The property that matters: an OAuth-client JSON must be REJECTED. Accepting
one produces a config that looks valid and then hangs forever, because
`utils/sheet_client.py` falls back to `InstalledAppFlow.run_local_server()`

INSTALLED_CLIENT = {
    "installed": {
        "client_id": "123.apps.googleusercontent.com",
        "client_secret": "placeholder",
        "redirect_uris": ["http://localhost"],
    }
}

WEB_CLIENT = {"web": {"client_id": "x", "client_secret": "y"}}


def _raw(obj) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(obj).encode("utf-8")


# ─── validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_service_account_is_accepted():
    r = validate_service_account(_raw(SERVICE_ACCOUNT))
    assert r["ok"] is True
    assert r["client_email"] == "bot@demo-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"


def test_installed_oauth_client_is_rejected_with_the_reason():
    r = validate_service_account(_raw(INSTALLED_CLIENT))
    assert r["ok"] is False
    assert "SERVICE ACCOUNT" in r["error"]
    assert "trình duyệt" in r["error"]      # explains WHY, not just "invalid"


def test_web_oauth_client_is_rejected():
    assert validate_service_account(_raw(WEB_CLIENT))["ok"] is False


def test_empty_file_is_rejected():
    assert validate_service_account(b"")["ok"] is False
    assert validate_service_account(b"   ")["ok"] is False


def test_malformed_json_is_rejected_with_line_number():
    r = validate_service_account(b"{not json")
    assert r["ok"] is False
    assert "JSON" in r["error"]


def test_non_utf8_is_rejected():
    r = validate_service_account(b"\xff\xfe\x00binary")
    assert r["ok"] is False


def test_json_array_is_rejected():
    assert validate_service_account(b'[{"type":"service_account"}]')["ok"] is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize("missing", ["client_email", "private_key", "token_uri"])
def test_incomplete_service_account_is_rejected(missing):
    data = dict(SERVICE_ACCOUNT)
    data[missing] = ""
    r = validate_service_account(_raw(data))
    assert r["ok"] is False
    assert missing in r["error"]


# ─── storage ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_store_writes_file_and_reports_email(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SECRETS_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    ok, msg, info = store_credentials(_raw(SERVICE_ACCOUNT))

    assert ok is True
    assert info["client_email"] in msg
    # The share step is the one operators forget; it must be in the message.
    assert "Share" in msg or "chia sẻ" in msg.lower()

    written = tmp_path / "google_service_account.json"
    assert written.exists()
    assert json.loads(written.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["type"] == "service_account"


def test_store_refuses_oauth_client_and_writes_nothing(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SECRETS_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    ok, msg, _ = store_credentials(_raw(INSTALLED_CLIENT))
    assert ok is False
    assert list(tmp_path.glob("*.json")) == []


def test_describe_absent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SECRETS_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    assert describe_stored()["exists"] is False


def test_describe_stored_never_returns_the_private_key(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SECRETS_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    store_credentials(_raw(SERVICE_ACCOUNT))

    info = describe_stored()
    blob = json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False)

    assert info["valid"] is True
    assert "PRIVATE KEY" not in blob
    assert "private_key" not in info
    # client_email IS shown on purpose — the operator must share the Sheet
    # with it or every read 403s.
    assert info["client_email"].endswith(".iam.gserviceaccount.com")


def test_describe_flags_a_wrong_type_already_on_disk(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("LTT_SECRETS_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    (tmp_path / "google_service_account.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(INSTALLED_CLIENT), encoding="utf-8")
    info = describe_stored()
    assert info["exists"] is True
    assert info["valid"] is False

"""
W3 — manual publish validation and job plumbing.

The validation rules are ported from `gui/operation_tab.py::_validate` /
`_validate_tiktok`. These tests pin the *ported* behaviour so the web
rejects what the desktop rejected, with the same wording — and pin the two
places where the web must differ (uploaded file instead of a local path,
background job instead of a blocking call).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os

import pytest

from server.services import ui_constants as UI
from server.services.manual_publish import (
    PublishRegistry,
    safe_upload_name,
    temp_video_dir,
    validate_facebook,
    validate_tiktok,
)


def _video(tmp_path, name="clip.mp4", size=2048):
    p = tmp_path / name
    p.write_bytes(b"\x00" * size)
    return str(p)


def _fb(**over):
    base = {
        "account": "My Account", "page": "My Page", "video_path": "",
        "title": "Tiêu đề hợp lệ", "description": "", "thumbnail": "",
        "schedule": "",
    }
    base.update(over)
    return base


def _tt(**over):
    base = {"account": "TikTok User", "video_path": "",
            "title": "Tiêu đề hợp lệ", "description": ""}
    base.update(over)
    return base


# ─── Facebook validation, in the desktop's order ──────────────────────────────

def test_fb_requires_account():
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(account=""))
    assert "chọn tài khoản" in err


def test_fb_requires_page():
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(page=""))
    assert "chọn Page đăng" in err


def test_fb_rejects_the_no_page_placeholder():
    """The desktop's page dropdown falls back to a literal placeholder
    string; publishing with it selected must fail."""
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(page="(Chưa có page — vào tab Tài khoản FB)"))
    assert "chọn Page đăng" in err


def test_fb_requires_video(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=""))
    assert "chọn file video" in err


def test_fb_rejects_missing_file():
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=r"C:\nope\missing.mp4"))
    assert "không tồn tại" in err


def test_fb_rejects_directory(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=str(tmp_path)))
    assert "thư mục" in err


def test_fb_rejects_empty_file(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path, size=0)))
    assert "rỗng" in err


def test_fb_rejects_bad_extension(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path, "clip.txt")))
    assert "đuôi video hợp lệ" in err


def test_fb_accepts_every_documented_extension(tmp_path):
    for ext in UI.VIDEO_EXTS_FB:
        err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path, f"c{ext}")))
        assert err is None, f"{ext} should be accepted, got: {err}"


def test_fb_requires_title(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path), title="  "))
    assert "nhập tiêu đề" in err


def test_fb_title_limit_is_100(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path), title="x" * 101))
    assert "Tiêu đề quá dài" in err and "100" in err


def test_fb_description_limit_is_5000(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path),
                                  description="x" * 5001))
    assert "Mô tả quá dài" in err and "5000" in err


def test_fb_rejects_past_schedule(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path),
                                  schedule="01/01/2020 08:00"))
    assert "quá khứ" in err


def test_fb_rejects_malformed_schedule(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path),
                                  schedule="2020-01-01 08:00"))
    assert "DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM" in err


def test_fb_accepts_future_schedule(tmp_path):
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path),
                                  schedule="01/01/2099 08:00"))
    assert err is None


def test_fb_rejects_bad_thumbnail(tmp_path):
    thumb = tmp_path / "not_an_image.txt"
    thumb.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
    err = validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path),
                                  thumbnail=str(thumb)))
    assert "không phải ảnh hợp lệ" in err


def test_fb_happy_path(tmp_path):
    assert validate_facebook(**_fb(video_path=_video(tmp_path))) is None


# ─── TikTok validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_tt_requires_account():
    err = validate_tiktok(**_tt(account="(Chưa kết nối TikTok)"))
    assert "Chưa có tài khoản TikTok" in err


def test_tt_rejects_formats_facebook_allows(tmp_path):
    """The desktop's file picker offered .avi/.mkv on the TikTok tab and then
    rejected them. The web must reject them too — but ideally never offer
    them (the template's accept= list is narrower)."""
    for ext in (".avi", ".mkv", ".wmv", ".flv", ".m4v"):
        err = validate_tiktok(**_tt(video_path=_video(tmp_path, f"c{ext}")))
        assert err is not None and "định dạng" in err.lower() or "đuôi" in err.lower()


def test_tt_accepts_its_three_formats(tmp_path):
    for ext in UI.VIDEO_EXTS_TT:
        err = validate_tiktok(**_tt(video_path=_video(tmp_path, f"c{ext}")))
        assert err is None, f"{ext} should be accepted, got: {err}"


def test_tt_caption_limit_is_2200(tmp_path):
    err = validate_tiktok(**_tt(video_path=_video(tmp_path), title="x" * 2201))
    assert "2200" in err


def test_tt_title_plus_description_share_the_2200_budget(tmp_path):
    """This is the rule the desktop's character counter got wrong — it showed
    Facebook's 100/5000 on the TikTok tab."""
    err = validate_tiktok(**_tt(video_path=_video(tmp_path),
                                title="x" * 1500, description="y" * 800))
    assert err is not None
    assert "tổng cộng" in err


def test_tt_happy_path(tmp_path):
    assert validate_tiktok(**_tt(video_path=_video(tmp_path))) is None

    assert r.get(job.id) is job
    assert r.latest("facebook") is job
    assert r.latest("tiktok") is None

    r = PublishRegistry()
    for _ in range(70):
        r.create("facebook")
    assert len(r._jobs) <= 50

    job = r.create("tiktok")
    json.dumps(job.to_dict())

"""W4 — Monitor + TT Audit web pages.

Beyond route/render coverage, this file pins the two desktop defects the web
port fixes, so a future refactor cannot silently reintroduce them:

  * `monitor_tab.py:388` — a swallowed NameError made the Pages column
    always render 0.
  * the `_Empty` snapshot fallback omitted 5 attributes the renderer reads.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
import json
import sys

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from server.app import create_app
from platform_core.password_hashing import hash_password
from server.services import audit_service, monitor_service
from server.services import ui_constants as UI

ADMIN_PASSWORD = "correct horse battery staple"


def _fake_module(**attrs):
    """A stand-in module object for monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, ...).

    A plain object is used rather than type(): functions stored on a class
    become descriptors, which changes their call signature.
    """
    mod = type(sys)("fake")
    for name, value in attrs.items():
        setattr(mod, name, value)
    return mod


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path) -> TestClient:
    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"sheet_id": "abc"}), encoding="utf-8")
    app = create_app(env={
        "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
        "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    })
    return TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver", follow_redirects=False)


@pytest.fixture
def client_logged_in(client) -> TestClient:
    r = client.get("/login")
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = r.text.index(marker) + len(marker)
    client.post("/login", data={
        "username": "admin", "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD,
        "csrf_token": r.text[start:r.text.index('"', start)],
    })
    return client


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- unit: tokens

class _FakeAccount:
    def __init__(self, name, pages, selected):
        self.name = name
        self._pages = pages
        self._selected = selected

    def get_pages_list(self):
        return list(self._pages)

    def get_selected_pages(self):
        return list(self._selected)


class _FakeStore:
    is_unreadable = False
    load_error = ""

    def __init__(self, accounts):
        self._accounts = accounts

    def all_accounts(self):
        return list(self._accounts)


def test_pages_column_is_not_always_zero(monkeypatch):
    """Regression guard for desktop bug 1.

    The desktop lost the account->pages join to a NameError swallowed by a
    bare except, so this column rendered 0 for every account no matter how
    many pages were selected.
    """
    store = _FakeStore([_FakeAccount("Acc A", ["p1", "p2", "p3"], ["p1", "p2"])])

    class _Refresher:
        def __init__(self, config, store):
            pass

        def health_summary(self):
            return [{"name": "Acc A", "days": 42, "status": "ok"}]

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.token_store",
                        _fake_module(get_default_store=lambda: store))
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.token_refresher",
                        _fake_module(TokenRefresher=_Refresher))

    rows, err = monitor_service.collect_token_health({})
    assert err == ""
    assert len(rows) == 1
    assert (rows[0].pages_selected, rows[0].pages_total) == (2, 3)


def test_unreadable_token_store_surfaces_the_reason(monkeypatch):
    """A store that cannot be decrypted must not look like 'no accounts'."""
    class _Broken:
        is_unreadable = True
        load_error = "InvalidToken: khoa may khong khop"

        def all_accounts(self):        # pragma: no cover - must not be reached
            raise AssertionError("should not read accounts from a broken store")

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.token_store",
                        _fake_module(get_default_store=lambda: _Broken()))

    rows, err = monitor_service.collect_token_health({})
    assert rows == []
    assert "InvalidToken" in err


def test_token_row_permanent_token_renders_infinity():
    row = monitor_service.TokenRow("x", -1, "permanent")
    assert row.token_text == "∞"
    assert row.colour == UI.COLORS["green"]


def test_token_row_expired_is_red():
    assert monitor_service.TokenRow("x", 0, "expired").colour == UI.COLORS["red"]

# --------------------------------------------------------------- unit: antispam

# Every attribute collect_antispam() reads off the snapshot.
_READ_ATTRS = [
    "n_critical_tokens", "n_warn_tokens", "token_messages", "open_breakers",
    "total_attempts_7d", "total_successes_7d", "success_rate_7d",
    "targets_with_abuse", "targets_with_rate", "recommendations",
    "total_content_records", "page_health_warnings", "n_pages_throttled",
    "n_pages_dead", "time_intel_warnings", "n_bot_flat_targets",
]


def test_empty_snapshot_has_every_attribute_the_renderer_reads():
    """Regression guard for desktop bug 2 — the fallback was missing 5 of
    these, so one failure produced a second AttributeError."""
    missing = [a for a in _READ_ATTRS
               if not hasattr(monitor_service._EmptySnapshot, a)]
    assert missing == [], f"_EmptySnapshot missing: {missing}"


def test_antispam_failure_still_renders(monkeypatch):
    """A broken snapshot must degrade to a warning, not blow up the page."""
    def _boom(_config):
        raise RuntimeError("db locked")

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.anti_spam_analytics", _fake_module(
        collect_snapshot=_boom, format_oneline=lambda s: "unused"))

    summary, colour, details = monitor_service.collect_antispam({})
    assert "db locked" in summary
    assert colour == UI.COLORS["amber"]
    assert details == []


def test_antispam_red_when_pages_dead(monkeypatch):
    class _Snap(monitor_service._EmptySnapshot):
        n_pages_dead = 2

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.anti_spam_analytics", _fake_module(
        collect_snapshot=lambda c: _Snap(), format_oneline=lambda s: "2 page chet"))
    summary, colour, _ = monitor_service.collect_antispam({})
    assert colour == UI.COLORS["red"]
    assert summary == "2 page chet"


def test_antispam_amber_when_only_warnings(monkeypatch):
    class _Snap(monitor_service._EmptySnapshot):
        n_warn_tokens = 1

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.anti_spam_analytics", _fake_module(
        collect_snapshot=lambda c: _Snap(), format_oneline=lambda s: "ok"))
    assert monitor_service.collect_antispam({})[1] == UI.COLORS["amber"]

def test_result_name_normalises_enums_and_junk():
    assert audit_service._result_name("ChecklistResult.PASS") == "PASS"
    assert audit_service._result_name(None) == "WARN"

    class _E:
        name = "fail"
    assert audit_service._result_name(_E()) == "FAIL"


def test_audit_summary_colours_follow_worst_result():
    def rep(**counts):
        r = audit_service.AuditReport()
        for result, n in counts.items():
            for i in range(n):
                r.items.append(audit_service.AuditItem(f"{result}{i}", result, ""))
        return r

    assert audit_service._summary(rep(FAIL=1, PASS=3))[1] == UI.COLORS["red"]
    assert audit_service._summary(rep(WARN=1, PASS=3))[1] == UI.COLORS["amber"]
    assert audit_service._summary(rep(PASS=4))[1] == UI.COLORS["green"]

    assert scopes[0]["explain"] != audit_service.SCOPE_UNKNOWN
    assert scopes[1]["explain"] == audit_service.SCOPE_UNKNOWN

        ["user.info.basic", "video.upload", "video.publish"]


def test_audit_runner_is_single_flight():
    runner = audit_service.AuditRunner()
    runner._inflight = True
    assert runner.is_stale() is False           # never re-enter while running
    runner.refresh_async({})                    # must be a no-op
    assert runner.report().running is True


def test_audit_runner_reports_checklist_failure_without_raising(monkeypatch):
    def _boom(_config):
        raise RuntimeError("privacy URL 500")

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "core.tiktok.audit_checklist",
                        _fake_module(run_checklist=_boom))

    runner = audit_service.AuditRunner()
    runner._run({})
    rep = runner.report()
    assert "privacy URL 500" in rep.error
    assert rep.running is False
    assert rep.scopes, "scopes are config-derived and must survive a failure"


def test_audit_report_age_text():
    import time
    assert audit_service.AuditReport().age_text == "chưa chạy"
    r = audit_service.AuditReport(generated_at=time.time() - 5)
    assert "giây trước" in r.age_text
    r = audit_service.AuditReport(generated_at=time.time() - 300)
    assert "phút trước" in r.age_text


def test_checklist_is_never_run_on_the_request_thread():
    """The checklist makes 3+ outbound HTTPS calls with 6-8s timeouts. If a
    route ever calls run_checklist directly the page hangs for the operator."""
    import server.routes.monitor as monitor_routes
    src = inspect.getsource(monitor_routes)
    assert "run_checklist" not in src
    assert "refresh_async" in src

The security properties are the point of these tests, not the happy path:

def _login(c: TestClient) -> None:
    r = c.get("/login")
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = r.text.index(marker) + len(marker)
    c.post("/login", data={"username": "admin", "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD,
                           "csrf_token": r.text[start:r.text.index('"', start)]})


def _csrf(html: str) -> str:
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = html.index(marker) + len(marker)
    return html[start:html.index('"', start)]


@pytest.fixture

    _login(client)
    return client


# ── flow store ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _flow(state="s1", nonce="n1", provider="facebook", age=0.0):
    return PendingFlow(provider=provider, state=state, redirect_uri=FB_CALLBACK,
                       session_nonce=nonce, created_at=time.time() - age)


def test_flow_is_single_use():
    store = FlowStore()
    store.put(_flow())
    assert store.take("s1") is not None
    assert store.take("s1") is None, "a replayed callback must find nothing"


def test_expired_flow_is_refused():
    store = FlowStore()
    store.put(_flow(age=oauth_service.FLOW_TTL_S + 1))
    assert store.take("s1") is None


def test_store_is_bounded():
    store = FlowStore()
    for i in range(oauth_service.MAX_PENDING + 10):
        store.put(_flow(state=f"s{i}"))
    assert store.pending_count() <= oauth_service.MAX_PENDING


def test_expired_flows_are_pruned_not_just_hidden():
    store = FlowStore()
    store.put(_flow(state="old", age=oauth_service.FLOW_TTL_S + 1))
    store.put(_flow(state="new"))
    assert store.pending_count() == 1


# ── session binding ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_session_nonce_is_minted_once_and_reused():
    session: dict = {}
    first = session_nonce(session)
    assert first and session_nonce(session) == first


def test_callback_from_a_different_session_is_refused():
    """The core reason the nonce exists: knowing `state` must not be enough."""
    oauth_service.store().put(_flow(state="st", nonce="browser-A"))
    with pytest.raises(OAuthError, match="phiên trình duyệt khác"):
        oauth_service._consume("st", {"oauth_nonce": "browser-B"}, "facebook")


def test_callback_with_no_session_nonce_is_refused():
    oauth_service.store().put(_flow(state="st", nonce="browser-A"))
    with pytest.raises(OAuthError, match="phiên trình duyệt khác"):
        oauth_service._consume("st", {}, "facebook")


def test_provider_cannot_be_crossed():
    """A TikTok callback must not redeem a Facebook flow."""
    oauth_service.store().put(_flow(state="st", nonce="n", provider="facebook"))
    with pytest.raises(OAuthError, match="không khớp nền tảng"):
        oauth_service._consume("st", {"oauth_nonce": "n"}, "tiktok")


def test_missing_state_is_refused():

        oauth_service._consume("", {"oauth_nonce": "n"}, "facebook")

        oauth_service._consume("never-issued", {"oauth_nonce": "n"}, "facebook")

# ── start: authorize URL ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_facebook_start_builds_a_urlencoded_authorize_url():
    session: dict = {}
    url = oauth_service.facebook_start(
        {"meta_app_id": "123", "meta_app_secret": "shh",
         "meta_redirect_uri": FB_CALLBACK, "graph_api_version": "v21.0"},
        BASE, session)

    assert url.startswith("https://www.facebook.com/v21.0/dialog/oauth?")
    # The desktop interpolated raw, which would have broken on any URI with a
    # query string. Everything must be percent-encoded now.
    assert "redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.lttstudios.com" in url
    assert "response_type=code" in url
    assert oauth_service.store().pending_count() == 1
    assert session["oauth_nonce"]


def test_tiktok_start_sends_s256_challenge_and_keeps_verifier_server_side():
    session: dict = {}
    url = oauth_service.tiktok_start(
        {"tiktok_client_key": "ck", "tiktok_client_secret": "cs",
         "tiktok_redirect_uri": TT_CALLBACK,
         "tiktok_scopes": "user.info.basic,video.upload"}, BASE, session)

    assert url.startswith("https://www.tiktok.com/v2/auth/authorize/?")
    assert "code_challenge_method=S256" in url
    assert "code_challenge=" in url

    flow = oauth_service.store().take(_state_from(url))
    assert flow.code_verifier, "verifier must be stored for the exchange"
    # The verifier is the secret half of PKCE — it must never be in the URL
    # the operator's browser (or TikTok) sees.
    assert flow.code_verifier not in url


def _state_from(url: str) -> str:
    from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse
    return parse_qs(urlparse(url).query)["state"][0]


def test_pkce_challenge_is_base64url_sha256_of_the_verifier():
    import base64
    import hashlib

    from core.tiktok.auth_manager import TikTokAuthManager
    verifier, challenge = TikTokAuthManager.generate_pkce_pair()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
    expected = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
    assert challenge == expected
    assert "=" not in challenge


def test_unconfigured_app_is_refused_before_any_redirect():
    with pytest.raises(OAuthError, match="Meta App ID"):
        oauth_service.facebook_start({"meta_redirect_uri": FB_CALLBACK}, BASE, {})
    with pytest.raises(OAuthError, match="TikTok Client Key"):
        oauth_service.tiktok_start({"tiktok_redirect_uri": TT_CALLBACK}, BASE, {})


def test_start_failure_leaves_no_pending_flow():
    with pytest.raises(OAuthError):
        oauth_service.facebook_start({}, BASE, {})
    assert oauth_service.store().pending_count() == 0

def test_callback_paths_match_the_routes(client):
    """The registered paths and the advertised paths must not drift.

    Probed over HTTP rather than by walking ``app.routes``. Introspecting the
    router is version-fragile: Starlette 1.x wraps included routers in an
    ``_IncludedRouter`` that exposes no ``.path``, so the old assertion started
    failing on a library upgrade while every callback still worked. An HTTP
    probe is also the stronger check — it proves the path is *reachable*, not
    merely that an object with a matching attribute exists somewhere.

    404 is the only failing answer. Anonymous requests legitimately answer 303
    (bounce to /login) and a callback missing its OAuth parameters legitimately
    answers 4xx; both prove the route is registered.
    """
    for path in CALLBACK_PATHS.values():
        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code != 404, (
            f"{path} khong duoc dang ky - callback URL da khai bao o "
            f"Meta/TikTok Portal se tra 404"
        )

"""W6 — the desktop app is gone, and must stay gone.

Removing code is easy; keeping it removed is not. Half-deleted desktop
machinery is worse than either state, because it looks available and fails at
the point of use — a browser that never opens, a port nobody listens on, a
config field the app no longer reads.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import pathlib

import pytest

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

# Only ever read by the deleted localhost transport / OAuth relay.
DEAD_CONFIG_KEYS = [
    "oauth_redirect_port",
    "tiktok_oauth_port",
    "oauth_browser_path",
    "oauth_browser_profile",
    "tiktok_oauth_relay_url",
    "tiktok_oauth_relay_secret",
]

APP_DIRS = ("core", "server", "utils", "tools", "tests")

# tools/demo_fb and tools/demo_v2 are standalone recording aids for the TikTok
# audit submission (a teleprompter, slide generators). They are run by hand on
# a desktop, are not imported by the app, and never execute on the server — so
# their tkinter use is not a violation. Everything else is in scope.
SKIP_DIRS = ("demo_fb", "demo_v2", "demo_assets", "__pycache__")


def _app_py_files():
    for d in APP_DIRS:
        for path in (ROOT / d).rglob("*.py"):
            if not any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in path.parts):
                yield path
    for name in ("worker_main.py", "version.py"):
        p = ROOT / name
        if p.exists():
            yield p


def _imported_names(path: pathlib.Path):
    """Every module name this file imports, from the AST.

    Parsing rather than grepping: a docstring that *mentions* customtkinter
    (server/app.py documents the boundary rule) is not an import of it.
    """
    import ast
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except SyntaxError:                      # pragma: no cover
        return
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                yield alias.name, node.lineno
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            if node.module:
                yield node.module, node.lineno

@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", [
    "gui", "main.py", "run_gui.bat", "run_debug.bat", "build_exe.bat",
    "BOT_UP_FACEBOOK.spec", "setup_new_machine.bat", "check_environment.bat",
    "tests/gui_smoke_validator.py", "tests/test_30_operation_tab_split.py",
    # The relay tooling exercised a subsystem that no longer exists.
    "tools/check_oauth_relay.py", "tools/simulate_oauth_flow.py",
])
def test_desktop_artifact_is_gone(path):
    assert not (ROOT / path).exists(), f"{path} should have been deleted"


def test_no_module_imports_gui():
    offenders = [
        f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}:{line}"
        for path in _app_py_files()
        for name, line in _imported_names(path)
        if name == "gui" or name.startswith("gui.")
    ]
    assert offenders == [], f"gui imports remain: {offenders}"

                                     "pyperclip", "google_auth_oauthlib"])
def test_no_desktop_only_package_is_imported(package):
    """A GUI toolkit import inside a request thread would raise on a headless
    server, and only at the moment the operator needed it."""
    offenders = [
        f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}:{line}"
        for path in _app_py_files()
        for name, line in _imported_names(path)
        if name == package or name.startswith(package + ".")
    ]
    assert offenders == [], f"{package} imported at {offenders}"


def test_requirements_no_longer_ship_gui_packages():
    text = (ROOT / "requirements.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    installs = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines()
                if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith("#")]
    for package in ("customtkinter", "Pillow", "qrcode", "google-auth-oauthlib"):
        assert not any(package.lower() in ln.lower() for ln in installs), \
            f"{package} is still installed but nothing imports it"

# ── config files edited on Windows ─────────────────────────────────────────

BOM = "\ufeff"


def test_config_with_a_bom_still_loads():
    """PowerShell's `Out-File -Encoding utf8` and Notepad both write a UTF-8
    BOM. json.load() raises on it, which took the live site to an opaque 503
    from /health/ready while the service itself was running normally."""
    import tempfile

    from core.settings import load_settings

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        cfg = pathlib.Path(tmp) / "config.json"
        cfg.write_text(BOM + json.dumps({"sheet_id": "abc"}), encoding="utf-8")
        settings = load_settings(env={"LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
                                      "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg)})
        assert settings.config["sheet_id"] == "abc"

        cfg.write_text(BOM + json.dumps({"sheet_id": "abc"}), encoding="utf-8")
        assert load_config({"LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg)})["sheet_id"] == "abc"

"""The three Content Vault actions from the desktop Settings tab.

These were found missing during W6: `gui/settings_tab.py` had Export Content
History, Cross-target duplicates, and Import CSV, and the web had no trace of
any of them. Config-key coverage was complete, which is exactly why the gap
went unnoticed — the buttons were not config.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import json

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from server.app import create_app
from platform_core.password_hashing import hash_password
from server.services import content_tools

ADMIN_PASSWORD = "correct horse battery staple"


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path) -> TestClient:
    cfg = tmp_path / "config.json"
    cfg.write_text(json.dumps({"sheet_id": "abc"}), encoding="utf-8")
    app = create_app(env={
        "LTT_ENV": "local-server-test",
        "LTT_CONFIG_PATH": str(cfg),
        "LTT_SESSION_SECRET": "test-session-secret-not-a-real-secret",
        "LTT_ADMIN_USERNAME": "admin",
        "LTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH": hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD),
    })
    return TestClient(app, base_url="https://testserver", follow_redirects=False)


@pytest.fixture
def logged_in(client) -> TestClient:
    r = client.get("/login")
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = r.text.index(marker) + len(marker)
    client.post("/login", data={"username": "admin", "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD,
                                "csrf_token": r.text[start:r.text.index('"', start)]})
    return client


def _csrf(html: str) -> str:
    marker = 'name="csrf_token" value="'
    start = html.index(marker) + len(marker)
    return html[start:html.index('"', start)]

    assert name.endswith(".csv")


def test_export_reuses_the_shared_writer(monkeypatch):

    for the web — two writers would drift."""
    import inspect
    assert "from core.content_vault import export_to_csv" in \
        inspect.getsource(content_tools.export_history_csv)


def test_export_returns_text_and_count(monkeypatch):
    import core.content_vault as vault

    def fake_export(path):
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
            w = csv.writer(fh)
            w.writerow(["video_hash", "target"])
            w.writerow(["abc123", "PageA"])
        return 1

    monkeypatch.setattr(vault, "export_to_csv", fake_export)
    text, count = content_tools.export_history_csv()
    assert count == 1
    assert "abc123" in text


def test_export_download_has_a_filename_and_bom(logged_in, monkeypatch):
    """A CSV without a BOM opens as mojibake in Excel, which is where an
    operator will actually open it."""

    monkeypatch.setattr(vault, "export_to_csv",
                        lambda path: (open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8")
                                      .write("video_hash\nTiệm truyện\n"), 1)[1])

    page = logged_in.get("/settings")
    r = logged_in.post("/settings/export-history",
                       data={"csrf_token": _csrf(page.text)})

    assert "attachment" in r.headers["content-disposition"]

class _Group:
    def __init__(self, h, count, targets):
        self.video_hash, self.count, self.targets = h, count, targets


def test_no_duplicates_reads_as_good_news(monkeypatch):
    """The desktop framed an empty result as a healthy setup rather than an
    error; an operator should not go hunting for a problem."""

    monkeypatch.setattr(vault, "find_cross_target_duplicates", lambda min_targets: [])
    report = content_tools.find_duplicates()
    assert report.total == 0
    assert "setup" in report.summary and "tốt" in report.summary


def test_duplicates_are_summarised_and_capped(monkeypatch):
    import core.content_vault as vault
    many = [_Group(f"hash{i:04d}" + "x" * 20, 2, ["A", "B"]) for i in range(40)]
    monkeypatch.setattr(vault, "find_cross_target_duplicates", lambda min_targets: many)

    report = content_tools.find_duplicates()
    assert report.total == 40
    assert len(report.groups) == content_tools.MAX_DUPLICATE_GROUPS
    assert report.groups[0].hash_short == "hash0000" + "xxxx"

                        lambda min_targets: [group])
    text = content_tools.find_duplicates().groups[0].targets_text
    assert text.endswith("...")
    assert "E" not in text

    assert "rỗng" in content_tools.import_calendar_csv("plan.csv", b"").fatal


def test_import_rejects_an_oversized_file():
    """A content calendar is text. A huge upload means the wrong file was
    picked, and saying so beats a parser error."""
    big = b"x" * (content_tools.MAX_IMPORT_BYTES + 1)
    report = content_tools.import_calendar_csv("plan.csv", big)
    assert "vượt giới hạn" in report.fatal
    assert "chọn nhầm file" in report.fatal


class _Row:
    def __init__(self, platform, target_page, title):
        self.platform, self.target_page, self.title = platform, target_page, title


class _Result:
    def __init__(self, rows, errors):
        self.rows, self.errors = rows, errors


def test_import_previews_rows_and_counts_overflow(monkeypatch):
    import core.content_calendar as cal
    rows = [_Row("facebook", f"Page{i}", f"Video {i}") for i in range(9)]
    monkeypatch.setattr(cal, "import_csv", lambda path: _Result(rows, []))

    report = content_tools.import_calendar_csv("plan.csv", b"a,b\n1,2\n")
    assert report.ok_rows == 9
    assert len(report.preview) == content_tools.PREVIEW_ROWS
    assert report.row_overflow == 9 - content_tools.PREVIEW_ROWS
    assert "facebook/Page0" in report.preview[0]


def test_import_reports_row_errors_and_caps_them(monkeypatch):
    import core.content_calendar as cal
    errors = [f"dòng {i}: thiếu title" for i in range(25)]
    monkeypatch.setattr(cal, "import_csv", lambda path: _Result([], errors))

    report = content_tools.import_calendar_csv("plan.csv", b"a\n")
    assert len(report.errors) == content_tools.MAX_ERROR_LINES
    assert report.error_overflow == 25 - content_tools.MAX_ERROR_LINES

"""Hợp đồng app registry — thứ quyết định chi phí thêm app thứ 10.

def test_portfolio_surface_and_lifecycle_match_locked_decisions():
    apps = {a.slug: a.manifest for a in discover()}
    assert apps["kichban"].surface == "runtime"
    assert apps["kichban"].lifecycle == "retired"
    assert apps["mediatools"].surface == "runtime"
    assert apps["demo"].surface == "admin"
    assert apps["socialbot"].lifecycle == "maintenance"
    assert {apps[slug].lifecycle for slug in (
        "upscalevideo", "prompt_ai_ommi", "taovideo")} == {"released"}
    script = next(tool for tool in apps["kichban"].tools
                  if tool.name == "text.script")
    assert script.customer_visible is False
    assert any(tool.name == "text.generate" for tool in apps["kichban"].tools)
    assert apps["thumbnail"].catalog_parent == "taoanh"
    assert apps["thumbnail"].job_types == ("thumbnail.generate",)
    customer_cards = [m for m in apps.values()
                      if m.surface == "customer" and not m.catalog_parent]
    assert customer_cards and all(m.capabilities for m in customer_cards)


def test_every_apps_subfolder_has_a_manifest():
    """Một folder trong apps/ mà thiếu manifest.py sẽ bị bỏ qua HOÀN TOÀN im
    lặng — code có đó, route không bao giờ chạy, và rất khó nhận ra."""
    missing = [
        d.name for d in (ROOT / "apps").iterdir()
        if d.is_dir() and not d.name.startswith(("_", "."))
        and not (d / "manifest.py").exists()
    ]
    assert missing == [], f"thiếu manifest.py: {missing}"

def test_route_prefixes_are_unique():
    """Hai app cùng prefix thì app nạp sau bị che mất và FastAPI không báo gì."""
    prefixes = [a.manifest.route_prefix.rstrip("/") for a in discover()]
    dupes = {p for p in prefixes if prefixes.count(p) > 1}
    assert not dupes, f"route_prefix trùng: {dupes}"


def test_slugs_are_unique():
    slugs = [a.slug for a in discover()]
    assert len(slugs) == len(set(slugs))


def test_job_types_are_unique_across_apps():
    """Hai app cùng nhận một job_type thì job chạy bằng handler nào là ngẫu
    nhiên theo thứ tự quét thư mục."""
    owners: dict = {}
    for a in discover():
        for jt in a.manifest.job_types:
            assert jt not in owners, \
                f"job_type {jt!r} bị cả {owners[jt]} và {a.slug} nhận"
            owners[jt] = a.slug
    assert job_type_owners() == owners

@pytest.mark.parametrize(("field", "value"), [
    ("surface", "partner"), ("lifecycle", "beta"),
    ("capabilities", ("",)), ("catalog_parent", "bad-parent"),
])

    kwargs = {field: value}
    m = AppManifest(slug="x", display_name="X", route_prefix="/x", **kwargs)
    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match=field):
        _validate(m, seen_slugs=set(), seen_prefixes=set())


def test_surface_visibility_separates_customer_admin_and_runtime():
    customer = AppManifest(slug="c", display_name="C", route_prefix="/c")
    private = AppManifest(slug="p", display_name="P", route_prefix="/p",
                          public=False)
    admin = AppManifest(slug="a", display_name="A", route_prefix="/a",
                        surface="admin")
    runtime = AppManifest(slug="r", display_name="R", route_prefix="/r",
                          surface="runtime")
    child = AppManifest(slug="child", display_name="Child", route_prefix="/child",
                        catalog_parent="c")
    assert visible_on_surface(customer, authenticated=False)
    assert not visible_on_surface(private, authenticated=False)
    assert visible_on_surface(private, authenticated=True)
    assert not visible_on_surface(admin, authenticated=True, operator=False)
    assert visible_on_surface(admin, authenticated=True, operator=True)
    assert not visible_on_surface(runtime, authenticated=True, operator=True)
    assert not visible_on_surface(child, authenticated=True, operator=True)

def test_credit_is_computed_from_params_not_fixed():

# ── app hỏng không được làm sập nền tảng ───────────────────────────────────

def test_a_broken_app_does_not_break_discovery(tmp_path):
    """Nếu một app lỗi làm sập cả nền tảng thì bạn không vào được để xem app
    nào lỗi. Nó phải được ghi lại kèm lý do."""
    apps = tmp_path / "apps"
    (apps / "bad").mkdir(parents=True)
    (apps / "bad" / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (apps / "bad" / "manifest.py").write_text(
        "raise RuntimeError('hỏng có chủ ý')", encoding="utf-8")

    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, str(tmp_path))
    try:
        result = discover(apps_dir=apps)
    finally:
        sys.path.remove(str(tmp_path))
        sys.modules.pop("apps.bad.manifest", None)

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].error
    assert result[0].manifest.enabled is False


# ── app sở hữu bảng CSDL riêng (hợp đồng R0) ───────────────────────────────

def _app_with_tables(root, slug, *, prefix, table):
    """Dựng một app tạm có tables.py để thử hợp đồng."""
    apps = root / "apps"
    (apps / slug).mkdir(parents=True)
    (apps / slug / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (apps / slug / "manifest.py").write_text(
        "from platform_core.registry import AppManifest\n"
        f"MANIFEST = AppManifest(slug={slug!r}, display_name='X',\n"
        f"    route_prefix='/{slug}', table_prefix={prefix!r})\n",
        encoding="utf-8")
    (apps / slug / "tables.py").write_text(
        "from sqlalchemy import String\n"
        "from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column\n"
        "from platform_core.db import Base\n"
        f"class _T(Base):\n"
        f"    __tablename__ = {table!r}\n"
        "    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True)\n",
        encoding="utf-8")
    return apps


def _load_isolated(root, apps, slug):
    """Nạp tables của app tạm rồi dọn sạch metadata để không rò sang test khác.

    Gói `apps` đã được import từ repo thật nên `apps.<slug>` tạm không phân giải
    được qua sys.path. Nối thêm thư mục tạm vào `apps.__path__` là cách chuẩn để
    một gói tìm module con ở nhiều nơi.
    """
    import sys

    import apps as apps_pkg
    from platform_core.db import Base
    from platform_core.registry import load_app_tables

    before = set(Base.metadata.tables)
    apps_pkg.__path__.append(str(apps))
    try:
        return load_app_tables(apps_dir=apps)
    finally:
        apps_pkg.__path__.remove(str(apps))
        for name in set(Base.metadata.tables) - before:
            Base.metadata.remove(Base.metadata.tables[name])
        sys.modules.pop(f"apps.{slug}.manifest", None)
        sys.modules.pop(f"apps.{slug}.tables", None)
        sys.modules.pop(f"apps.{slug}", None)


def test_app_can_own_tables_when_it_declares_a_prefix(tmp_path):
    """App cần bảng thật phải khai được ngay trong app, không phải đem model
    bỏ vào platform_core (AGENTS.md mục 60: bổ sung hợp đồng, không đi vòng)."""
    apps = _app_with_tables(tmp_path, "withtables", prefix="wt", table="wt_thing")
    assert _load_isolated(tmp_path, apps, "withtables") == ["withtables"]


def test_app_tables_must_use_the_declared_prefix(tmp_path):
    """Bảng lạc tiền tố chỉ lộ ra khi Alembic sinh migration xoá nhầm bảng của
    app khác — lúc đó đã quá muộn."""
    apps = _app_with_tables(tmp_path, "strayname", prefix="sn", table="other_thing")
    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match="other_thing"):
        _load_isolated(tmp_path, apps, "strayname")


def test_app_tables_require_a_declared_prefix(tmp_path):
    apps = _app_with_tables(tmp_path, "noprefix", prefix="", table="np_thing")
    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match="table_prefix"):
        _load_isolated(tmp_path, apps, "noprefix")


def test_table_prefix_must_be_unique_across_apps():
    """Hai app cùng tiền tố thì ghi đè bảng của nhau, Alembic chỉ thấy một cái."""
    seen_slugs, seen_prefixes, seen_tables = set(), set(), {"dup"}
    m = AppManifest(slug="second", display_name="S", route_prefix="/second",
                    table_prefix="dup")
    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match="table_prefix"):
        _validate(m, seen_slugs, seen_prefixes, set(), set(), seen_tables)


def test_alembic_env_loads_app_tables():
    """Quên nạp thì autogenerate coi bảng của app là bảng lạ và sinh lệnh XOÁ."""
    text = (ROOT / "alembic" / "env.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "load_app_tables()" in text


# ── nền tảng không được biết app nào tồn tại ───────────────────────────────

def test_platform_never_imports_an_app():
    """Chiều phụ thuộc chỉ đi một hướng. Nền tảng import app là quay lại đúng
    thứ registry sinh ra để tránh."""
    import ast

    offenders = []
    for path in (ROOT / "platform_core").rglob("*.py"):
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            names = []
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                names = [a.name for a in node.names]
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
                names = [node.module]
            for n in names:
                if n == "apps" or n.startswith("apps."):
                    offenders.append(f"{path.name}:{node.lineno} -> {n}")
    assert offenders == [], f"platform_core import app: {offenders}"


def test_no_app_slug_is_hardcoded_in_the_platform():
    """Tên app xuất hiện trong code nền tảng là dấu hiệu registry bị đi vòng."""
    # ``agent`` is also the architectural namespace mandated by Q39/Q40
    # (AgentRun, platform_core.agent), so substring matching cannot distinguish
    # legitimate core terminology from a hardcoded app slug. Route/app wiring
    # for it is still covered by the same manifest/mount contract tests.
    #
    # ``nexus`` is the same shape, from Q93: device identity belongs to the
    # account rather than to an app, so the capability lives in
    # ``platform_core.nexus`` and ``apps/nexus`` is only the customer-facing
    # skin over it. The platform names the *capability*, never the app — which
    # this test cannot tell apart by substring.
    #
    # ``ltt_llm`` is the third of the same shape, and the most literal: the
    # platform DECLARES a provider with that exact id in
    # ``platform_core/providers.py``, and ``apps/ltt_llm`` is the customer-facing
    # skin that sells it. Every hit this test reports is that provider id — a
    # metric name (``ltt_llm:cong_im_lang``), a cascade order, an example. None
    # of them reaches for the app.
    #
    # ⚠️ The naming is still backwards, and that is worth saying out loud: the
    #    image side got this right (provider ``ltt_image`` + app ``anhnoibo``),
    #    so its provider id is NOT an app slug and this check stays sharp for it.
    #    Renaming ``apps/ltt_llm`` -> ``apps/chatnoibo`` would remove the
    #    exemption entirely and make the two house-model apps symmetric. It is
    #    deliberately NOT done here: that app is live and billing real customers,
    #    and the slug is baked into persisted ``job_type`` rows. It is a
    #    migration, not a rename, and it belongs in its own change.
    #
    # Adding a name here is not free: it blinds this check to that string, so a
    # genuine hardcoded reference to that app would slip through. It is only
    # correct when the platform owns the namespace and the app is named after
    # it, not the other way round.
    #
    # What still covers the real risk: ``test_platform_core_never_imports_apps``
    # above. Blinding a substring does not let ``platform_core`` import the app.
    slugs = [a.slug for a in discover()
             if a.slug not in ("demo", "agent", "nexus", "ltt_llm")]

    # 🔴 TÊN BẢNG KHÔNG PHẢI TÊN APP — và bỏ qua điều đó làm hai bánh cóc đánh nhau.
    #
    #    `test_211` **bắt buộc** `platform_core/public_api/governance.py` phải nêu
    #    tên **mọi** bảng, kể cả bảng riêng của app: không kê được thì không trả lời
    #    được câu *"các anh giữ gì về tôi"*. Nhưng app nào có `table_prefix` trùng
    #    slug thì tên bảng của nó chứa slug — và chốt này đỏ.
    #
    #    Đã xảy ra thật với `apps/vps` (`table_prefix="vps"` ⇒ `vps_instance`,
    #    `vps_ip`, …). Hai chốt đều đúng; thứ sai là phép so chuỗi thô.
    #
    # ⛔ Cách sai là miễn trừ slug `vps` — nền tảng KHÔNG sở hữu namespace đó, nên
    #    miễn trừ sẽ làm mù chốt với một tham chiếu app thật. Cách đúng: bóc **tên
    #    bảng thật** (lấy từ metadata, không phải danh sách gõ tay) ra khỏi văn bản
    #    trước khi dò. Một chuỗi `"vps"` đứng trơ vẫn bị bắt.
    from platform_core.db import Base
    from platform_core.registry import load_app_tables
    import platform_core.models  # noqa: F401
    load_app_tables()
    ten_bang = sorted(Base.metadata.tables, key=len, reverse=True)

    offenders = []
    for path in (ROOT / "platform_core").rglob("*.py"):
        text = _ma_thuc_thi(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for bang in ten_bang:
            text = text.replace(bang, "<bang>")
        for slug in slugs:
            if slug in text:
                offenders.append(f"{path.name}: {slug!r}")
    assert offenders == [], f"tên app bị viết cứng: {offenders}"


def test_boc_ten_bang_KHONG_lam_mu_chot():
    """Chốt trên bóc tên bảng ra trước khi dò. Đây là chỗ chứng minh nó không
    bóc quá tay: một slug đứng trơ, hoặc một `apps.<slug>`, vẫn phải bị bắt."""
    from platform_core.db import Base
    from platform_core.registry import load_app_tables
    import platform_core.models  # noqa: F401
    load_app_tables()
    ten_bang = sorted(Base.metadata.tables, key=len, reverse=True)

    def con_lai(text):
        for bang in ten_bang:
            text = text.replace(bang, "<bang>")
        return text

    assert "vps" not in con_lai('"vps_instance", "vps_ip"')
    assert "vps" in con_lai('if app.slug == "vps":'), (
        "phep boc da an ca tham chieu app that — chot bi lam mu"
    )


def _ma_thuc_thi(nguon: str) -> str:
    """Bỏ chú thích và docstring, giữ nguyên phần còn lại.

    Vì sao lọc chứ không so nguyên văn: cái test này chốt *"nền tảng không đi vòng
    qua registry"*, và đi vòng là một hành vi của **mã chạy được**. Một dòng
    docstring trỏ tới `apps/<tên>/...` để người đọc biết chỗ tham chiếu **không đi
    vòng cái gì cả** — nó chỉ là tài liệu.

    Đây **không phải** một miễn trừ theo tên app. Miễn trừ theo tên thì làm mù hẳn
    phép kiểm với chuỗi đó ở mọi nơi; cách này vẫn bắt slug trong lệnh, trong điều
    kiện, và trong **chuỗi ký tự thường** — xem hai test ngay dưới.
    """
    import ast
    import io as _io
    import tokenize

    # Vi tri cua tung docstring (module/class/ham) — chi nhung cai do la "prose".
    vi_tri = set()
    try:
        cay = ast.parse(nguon)
    except SyntaxError:
        return nguon
    for node in ast.walk(cay):
        if not isinstance(node, (ast.Module, ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef,
                                 ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            continue
        than = getattr(node, "body", None)
        if (than and isinstance(than[0], ast.Expr)
                and isinstance(than[0].value, ast.Constant)
                and isinstance(than[0].value.value, str)):
            vi_tri.add((than[0].value.lineno, than[0].value.col_offset))

    ra = []
    for tok in tokenize.generate_tokens(_io.StringIO(nguon).readline):
        if tok.type == tokenize.COMMENT:
            continue
        if tok.type == tokenize.STRING and tok.start in vi_tri:
            continue
        ra.append(tok.string)
    return chr(10).join(ra)


def _nguon(*dong: str) -> str:
    """Ghép các dòng nguồn. Dùng `chr(10)` chứ không viết escape xuống dòng —
    những tệp này đôi khi được sinh ra bằng script, và một tầng thoát chuỗi nữa
    là dấu xuống dòng biến thành ký tự thật, làm cả tệp không parse được."""
    return chr(10).join(dong) + chr(10)


def test_bo_quet_van_bat_slug_trong_MA_CHAY_DUOC():
    """Bánh cóc cho chính bộ lọc trên. Nếu nó nới tay quá thì phép kiểm ở trên
    thành vô dụng mà vẫn xanh."""
    ma = _ma_thuc_thi(_nguon('x = 1',
                             'if slug == "taovideo":',
                             '    pass'))
    assert "taovideo" in ma


def test_bo_quet_KHONG_bat_slug_trong_docstring_hay_chu_thich():
    ma = _ma_thuc_thi(_nguon('"""Xem apps/taovideo/translate.py."""',
                             '# cung nhu apps/kichban/jobs.py',
                             'x = 1'))
    assert "taovideo" not in ma and "kichban" not in ma


def test_bo_quet_van_bat_slug_trong_CHUOI_THUONG():
    """Chuỗi thường KHÁC docstring: `TEN = "taovideo"` đúng là đi vòng registry."""
    assert "taovideo" in _ma_thuc_thi(_nguon('TEN = "taovideo"'))

"""Script cài đặt — chốt những thứ chỉ vỡ trên máy đích, không vỡ ở đây.

Đây là loại lỗi đắt nhất: bạn chỉ biết khi đã ngồi trước máy chủ mới, và
thông báo lỗi thường chẳng liên quan gì tới nguyên nhân thật.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib

import pytest

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SETUP = ROOT / "setup"

SCRIPTS = ["1-kiem-tra-may.ps1", "2-cai-dat.ps1", "3-cloudflare.ps1",
           "4-nghiem-thu.ps1"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", SCRIPTS)
def test_script_exists(name):
    assert (SETUP / name).exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", SCRIPTS)
def test_script_is_pure_ascii(name):
    """PowerShell 5.1 đọc .ps1 không BOM theo bảng mã ANSI của hệ thống. Một
    dấu tiếng Việt trong chuỗi sẽ bị đọc sai và làm hỏng cả câu lệnh — lỗi báo
    ra ở một dòng chẳng liên quan."""
    raw = (SETUP / name).read_bytes()
    bad = [(i, b) for i, b in enumerate(raw) if b > 127]
    assert bad == [], (
        f"{name} có byte không phải ASCII ở vị trí {[i for i, _ in bad[:5]]}"
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", SCRIPTS)
def test_script_has_no_bom(name):
    raw = (SETUP / name).read_bytes()
    assert raw[:3] != b"\xef\xbb\xbf", f"{name} có BOM"


def _code_only(name: str) -> str:
    """Bỏ dòng bình luận và khối trợ giúp `<# ... #>`.

    Cần thiết vì các script *có* bình luận dặn "không được dùng Out-File" —
    tìm chuỗi thô sẽ báo nhầm chính lời dặn đó.
    """
    lines = []
    in_block = False
    for line in (SETUP / name).read_text(encoding="ascii").splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("<#"):
            in_block = True
        if in_block:
            if "#>" in stripped:
                in_block = False
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        lines.append(line)
    return "\n".join(lines)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", SCRIPTS)
def test_script_never_writes_files_with_bom(name):
    """`Out-File -Encoding utf8` và `Set-Content -Encoding utf8` ở PowerShell
    5.1 chèn BOM. BOM trong config.json làm json.load() vỡ và /health/ready trả
    503 trong khi dịch vụ vẫn chạy — chuyện này đã thực sự xảy ra."""
    code = _code_only(name)
    for banned in ("Out-File", "Set-Content"):
        assert banned not in code, (
            f"{name} dùng {banned} — ghi file phải dùng "
            f"[IO.File]::WriteAllText(..., UTF8Encoding($false))"
        )

                   "Copy-Item", "Move-Item"):
        assert banned not in text, f"bước nghiệm thu không được gọi {banned}"

# ── tài liệu ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DOC_DIR = ROOT / "docs"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("doc", sorted(p.name for p in DOC_DIR.glob("*.md")))
def test_doc_has_no_invisible_control_characters(doc):
    r"""Ký tự điều khiển lọt vào tài liệu là lỗi vô hình.

    Đã xảy ra thật: một chuỗi Python không phải raw-string chứa
    `.\setup\3-cloudflare` — `\3` là escape bát phân nên thành chr(3). Nhìn
    mắt thường không thấy gì, nhưng người đọc copy đường dẫn về sẽ chạy sai.
    """
    text = (DOC_DIR / doc).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    bad = [(i, hex(ord(c))) for i, c in enumerate(text)
           if ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\n\r\t"]
    assert bad == [], f"{doc} có ký tự điều khiển tại {bad[:5]}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("doc", ["00_BAT_DAU_TU_DAY.md", "01_COPY_LEN_SERVER.md",
                                 "02_LENH_CHO_CLAUDE.md", "03_THEM_APP_MOI.md",
                                 "04_CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL.md"])
def test_setup_guide_exists(doc):
    assert (DOC_DIR / doc).exists()


def test_docs_reference_scripts_that_exist():
    """Tài liệu chỉ tới file không tồn tại là chỉ dẫn sai — người dùng gõ vào
    rồi mới biết."""
    import re

    # Bắt "setup\<ten>.ps1" ở bất kỳ đâu trong tài liệu.
    pattern = re.compile(r"setup[\\/]([\w\-.]+\.ps1)")

    missing = []
    for doc in DOC_DIR.glob("*.md"):
        for name in pattern.findall(doc.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
            if not (ROOT / "setup" / name).exists():
                missing.append(f"{doc.name} -> setup/{name}")
    assert missing == [], f"tài liệu chỉ tới file không có: {missing}"

    import re

    pattern = re.compile(r"setup[\\/]([\w\-.]+\.ps1)")
    text = (ROOT / "CLAUDE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    names = set(pattern.findall(text))
    assert names, "CLAUDE.md phải chỉ rõ chạy script nào"
    for name in names:

    text = (ROOT / "CLAUDE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
