"""
Tải video từ Google Drive public share link về thư mục local.
Hỗ trợ file lớn (>100 MB) qua confirmation token (virus scan warning).
Retry tự động 3 lần. Cache theo file_id.
Không dùng gdown — dùng requests thuần để kiểm soát tốt hơn.

CHANGELOG (2026-05-26):
  - Fix virus-scan flow mới (2024+): parse HTML form để lấy UUID và
    endpoint mới `drive.usercontent.google.com/download`. Code cũ chỉ
    thử `confirm=t` → Google trả lại HTML virus warning lần 2 → bot
    lưu HTML 2-3 KB thành .mp4 → log thấy "0.0 MB" giả successfully.
  - Validate magic bytes (MP4/MOV/WebM/MKV/AVI/FLV) sau khi tải.
  - Min size threshold 10 KB — chặn HTML error pages lọt qua.
  - Distinguish retryable (network) vs fatal (logic) errors — fail
    nhanh khi không thể tải, không retry vô ích.
  - Re-check Content-Type của response thứ 2 — fail rõ ràng thay vì
    lưu rác. Error messages chỉ rõ nguyên nhân + cách fix.
  - Cache cleanup tự động xóa file rác từ lần fail trước.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import html
import logging
import os
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_DOWNLOAD_BASE       = "https://drive.google.com/uc"
_USERCONTENT_BASE    = "https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download"
_CHUNK_SIZE          = 1024 * 1024  # 1 MB
_MAX_RETRIES         = 3
_RETRY_DELAY         = 5.0

# File nhỏ hơn ngưỡng này coi là không phải video hợp lệ (likely HTML error page).
# Threshold 10 KB: HTML virus-scan warning ~2-5 KB, HTML 404 page ~1-2 KB,
# trong khi video MP4 nhỏ nhất hợp lệ (ftyp box + 1 sample) cũng > 10 KB.
_MIN_VIDEO_SIZE      = 10 * 1024

# Magic bytes của các định dạng video phổ biến (whitelist).
# Tham khảo: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_file_signatures
_VIDEO_SIGNATURES = (
    # (offset, signature_bytes, format_name)
    (4,  b"ftyp",           "MP4/MOV/M4V"),         # ISO Base Media (MP4, MOV, M4V)
    (0,  b"\x1a\x45\xdf\xa3", "WebM/MKV"),          # EBML (WebM, MKV)
    (0,  b"RIFF",           "AVI"),                  # AVI (full check at offset 8 = "AVI ")
    (0,  b"FLV",            "FLV"),                  # Flash Video
    (0,  b"\x00\x00\x01\xba", "MPEG-PS"),           # MPEG Program Stream
    (0,  b"\x00\x00\x01\xb3", "MPEG-VS"),           # MPEG Video Stream
)


class DriveDownloadError(RuntimeError):
    """Lỗi tải file Drive. retryable=False → không retry (lỗi logic, 4xx, content sai)."""
    def __init__(self, message: str, retryable: bool = False):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.retryable = retryable


def _extract_file_id(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Trích xuất Google Drive file ID từ các dạng URL phổ biến."""
    if not url or not url.strip():
        return None
    url = url.strip()

    # /file/d/{id}  (phổ biến nhất)
    m = re.search(r"/file/d/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)", url)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)

    # id={id} trong query string
    try:
        qs = parse_qs(urlparse(url).query)
        if "id" in qs:
            return qs["id"][0]
    except Exception:
        pass

    # [?&]id=... dạng regex fallback
    m = re.search(r"[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)", url)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)

    return None


def _is_valid_video_file(path: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Kiểm tra file có phải video hợp lệ qua magic bytes.
    Trả về (is_valid, format_or_reason).

    HTML thường bắt đầu bằng b"<!DOC", b"<html", b"<HTML" → không match
    bất kỳ signature video nào → reject.
    """
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            head = f.read(16)
    except OSError as exc:
        return False, f"không đọc được file: {exc}"

    if len(head) < 8:
        return False, f"file quá ngắn ({len(head)} bytes)"

    for offset, sig, fmt in _VIDEO_SIGNATURES:
        if head[offset:offset + len(sig)] == sig:
            # AVI cần check thêm "AVI " tại offset 8
            if fmt == "AVI" and head[8:12] != b"AVI ":
                continue
            return True, fmt

    # Cung cấp hex của 8 byte đầu để debug
    head_hex = head[:8].hex(" ")
    # Phát hiện HTML để báo lỗi rõ hơn
    head_lower = head[:8].lower()
    if head_lower.startswith((b"<!doc", b"<html", b"<head", b"<?xml")):
        return False, f"HTML error page (header={head_hex})"
    return False, f"không phải video (header={head_hex})"


def _parse_virus_scan_form(html_text: str) -> tuple[Optional[str], dict]:
    """
    Parse HTML form trả về từ Google Drive virus scan warning.

    Form mẫu (2024+):
        <form action="https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download" method="get">
          <input name="id"      value="...">
          <input name="export"  value="download">
          <input name="confirm" value="t">
          <input name="uuid"    value="<UUID>">
          <input name="at"      value="...">  (đôi khi có)
        </form>

    Trả về (action_url, params_dict). action_url=None nếu không tìm thấy form.
    """
    # Tìm action của form download (Google đôi khi có nhiều form trong cùng HTML)
    action: Optional[str] = None
    m_action = re.search(
        r'<form[^>]*\bid=["\']?download-form["\']?[^>]*\baction=["\']([^"\']+)["\']',
        html_text, re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if not m_action:
        # Fallback: form đầu tiên có action chứa "download"
        m_action = re.search(
            r'<form[^>]*\baction=["\']([^"\']*download[^"\']*)["\']',
            html_text, re.IGNORECASE,
        )
    if m_action:
        action = html.unescape(m_action.group(1))

    # Extract tất cả <input name="X" value="Y"> (cả 2 thứ tự attr)
    params: dict = {}
    for m in re.finditer(
        r'<input\b[^>]*\bname=["\']([^"\']+)["\'][^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']*)["\']',
        html_text, re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        params[m.group(1)] = html.unescape(m.group(2))
    # Thử chiều ngược lại: value trước, name sau
    for m in re.finditer(
        r'<input\b[^>]*\bvalue=["\']([^"\']*)["\'][^>]*\bname=["\']([^"\']+)["\']',
        html_text, re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        params.setdefault(m.group(2), html.unescape(m.group(1)))

    return action, params


class DriveDownloader:
    """
    Tải file từ Google Drive public share link.
    Xử lý confirmation token cho file lớn bị Google chặn virus scan.
    Cache theo file_id — tải lại nếu file đã tồn tại và là video hợp lệ.

    Usage:
        dl = DriveDownloader(config)
        local_path = dl.download(drive_url, on_progress=cb, on_log=log_fn)
    """

    def __init__(self, config: dict):
        self.dest_dir = config.get("temp_video_dir", "temp_videos")
        os.makedirs(self.dest_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # ─── Public ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def download(
        self,
        url: str,
        on_progress: Optional[Callable[[float, float], None]] = None,
        on_log: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Tải file từ Drive URL.

        on_progress(downloaded_mb, total_mb) — gọi mỗi chunk
        on_log(message)                       — gọi khi có log

        Trả về đường dẫn file local.
        Raises DriveDownloadError với message tiếng Việt rõ ràng.
        """
        log = on_log or (lambda m: None)

        if not url or not url.strip():
            raise DriveDownloadError("URL video Drive bị rỗng", retryable=False)

        file_id = _extract_file_id(url.strip())
        if not file_id:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"Không trích xuất được file ID từ URL: {url}", retryable=False,
            )

        # Dùng cache nếu đã tải (đã validate magic bytes + size)
        cached = self._find_cached(file_id, log)
        if cached:
            log(f"Dùng file đã tải: {os.path.basename(cached)}")
            return cached

        dest = os.path.join(self.dest_dir, f"{file_id}.mp4")
        log(f"Bắt đầu tải từ Drive (ID: {file_id})")

        self._download_with_retry(file_id, dest, on_progress, log)

        size_mb = os.path.getsize(dest) / (1024 * 1024)
        log(f"Tải xong {size_mb:.1f} MB → {os.path.basename(dest)}")
        return dest

    @staticmethod
    def delete(path: str):
        """Xóa file tạm sau khi upload xong."""
        try:
            if path and os.path.exists(path):
                os.remove(path)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ─── Internal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _download_with_retry(
        self,
        file_id: str,
        output_path: str,
        on_progress: Optional[Callable],
        log: Callable,
    ):
        import requests

        last_exc: Optional[Exception] = None
        for attempt in range(1, _MAX_RETRIES + 1):
            try:
                self._do_download(file_id, output_path, on_progress, requests, log)
                return
            except DriveDownloadError as exc:
                last_exc = exc
                # Lỗi logic (4xx, HTML response, magic bytes sai) → fail nhanh
                if not exc.retryable:
                    log(f"❌ Lỗi không thể retry: {exc}")
                    break
                log(f"Lần {attempt}/{_MAX_RETRIES} thất bại (retryable): {exc}")
                if attempt < _MAX_RETRIES:
                    wait = _RETRY_DELAY * attempt
                    log(f"Thử lại sau {wait:.0f}s...")
                    time.sleep(wait)
            except Exception as exc:
                # Network/timeout/connection errors → retry
                last_exc = exc
                log(f"Lần {attempt}/{_MAX_RETRIES} thất bại: {exc}")
                if attempt < _MAX_RETRIES:
                    wait = _RETRY_DELAY * attempt
                    log(f"Thử lại sau {wait:.0f}s...")
                    time.sleep(wait)

        # Cleanup file dở (nếu có) — tránh cache rác
        if os.path.exists(output_path):
            try:
                os.remove(output_path)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Bóc DriveDownloadError ra thay vì wrap thêm tầng
        if isinstance(last_exc, DriveDownloadError):
            raise last_exc
        raise DriveDownloadError(
            f"Tải từ Drive thất bại sau {_MAX_RETRIES} lần (ID={file_id}): {last_exc}",
            retryable=False,
        )

    def _do_download(
        self,
        file_id: str,
        output_path: str,
        on_progress: Optional[Callable],
        requests_mod,
        log: Callable,
    ):
        Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        session = requests_mod.Session()
        # User-Agent giống browser — Google đôi khi trả flow khác cho bot signature
        session.headers.update({
            "User-Agent": (
                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
                "Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
            ),
        })

        params = {"export": "download", "id": file_id}

        try:
            response = session.get(
                _DOWNLOAD_BASE, params=params, stream=True, timeout=60,
            )
        except requests_mod.exceptions.RequestException as exc:
            # Lỗi network → retryable
            raise DriveDownloadError(f"Lỗi kết nối Drive: {exc}", retryable=True)

        # 4xx → fatal (file không tồn tại / bị restrict)
        if 400 <= response.status_code < 500:
            self._raise_fatal_for_status(response, file_id)
        # 5xx → retryable
        if response.status_code >= 500:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"Drive server lỗi {response.status_code}", retryable=True,
            )

        content_type = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")

        # ── File lớn → Google trả HTML virus-scan warning, cần parse form ──
        if "text/html" in content_type:
            log("Phát hiện trang virus-scan warning — xử lý form xác nhận...")
            response = self._handle_virus_scan(
                session, response, file_id, requests_mod, log,
            )
            # Sau khi handle, response phải là binary stream — nếu vẫn HTML thì fail
            ct2 = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
            if "text/html" in ct2:
                # Đọc 1 phần để log debug
                preview = response.text[:200] if hasattr(response, "text") else ""
                raise DriveDownloadError(
                    "Drive vẫn trả HTML sau bước xác nhận virus-scan. "
                    "Kiểm tra: (1) link còn tồn tại, "
                    "(2) đã share 'Anyone with the link' (không phải Restricted), "
                    "(3) file không bị Google flag vi phạm. "
                    f"Preview: {preview[:120]}",
                    retryable=False,
                )

        # ── Stream chunks vào file ──
        total = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
        done  = 0

        try:
            with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
                for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=_CHUNK_SIZE):
                    if chunk:
                        f.write(chunk)
                        done += len(chunk)
                        if on_progress and total > 0:
                            on_progress(done / (1024 * 1024), total / (1024 * 1024))
        except requests_mod.exceptions.RequestException as exc:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"Lỗi network khi stream chunks: {exc}", retryable=True,
            )

        # ── Validate file sau khi tải (Layer 2 + 3) ──
        size_bytes = os.path.getsize(output_path)

        # Layer 3: size threshold
        if size_bytes < _MIN_VIDEO_SIZE:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"File chỉ {size_bytes/1024:.1f} KB (< {_MIN_VIDEO_SIZE/1024:.0f} KB tối thiểu) — "
                f"có thể là HTML error page. Kiểm tra quyền chia sẻ Drive.",
                retryable=False,
            )

        # Layer 2: magic bytes
        is_valid, fmt_or_reason = _is_valid_video_file(output_path)
        if not is_valid:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"File tải về không phải video hợp lệ: {fmt_or_reason}. "
                "Drive có thể đã trả error page thay vì video.",
                retryable=False,
            )
        log(f"Định dạng video: {fmt_or_reason} ✓")

    # ── Virus scan handler (Google Drive 2024+ flow) ────────────────────────

    def _handle_virus_scan(
        self,
        session,
        first_response,
        file_id: str,
        requests_mod,
        log: Callable,
    ):
        """
        Xử lý trang virus-scan warning của Google Drive.

        Flow (2024+):
          1. Parse form trong HTML body → lấy action URL + params (gồm UUID)
          2. GET action URL với đầy đủ params
          3. Nếu thành công → response là binary stream của video
          4. Nếu vẫn HTML → throw DriveDownloadError (xử lý ở caller)

        Fallback (Google flow cũ ~2020-2022):
          - Tìm cookie `download_warning_*` → dùng làm confirm token
          - Hoặc thử `confirm=t` rỗng
        """
        action, form_params = _parse_virus_scan_form(first_response.text)

        # ── Strategy 1: Modern flow — submit form với UUID ──
        if action and "uuid" in form_params:
            log(f"Form params: {list(form_params.keys())}")
            try:
                response = session.get(
                    action, params=form_params, stream=True, timeout=120,
                )
            except requests_mod.exceptions.RequestException as exc:
                raise DriveDownloadError(
                    f"Lỗi network khi submit form virus-scan: {exc}",
                    retryable=True,
                )
            if 400 <= response.status_code < 500:
                self._raise_fatal_for_status(response, file_id)
            if response.status_code >= 500:
                raise DriveDownloadError(
                    f"Drive server lỗi {response.status_code} sau confirm",
                    retryable=True,
                )
            return response

        # ── Strategy 2: Legacy flow — cookie download_warning_* ──
        legacy_token = self._extract_confirm_token(first_response)

        if legacy_token:
            log(f"Dùng legacy confirm token: {legacy_token[:8]}...")
            params = {"export": "download", "id": file_id, "confirm": legacy_token}
            try:
                response = session.get(
                    _DOWNLOAD_BASE, params=params, stream=True, timeout=120,
                )
            except requests_mod.exceptions.RequestException as exc:
                raise DriveDownloadError(
                    f"Lỗi network khi confirm legacy: {exc}", retryable=True,
                )
            if 400 <= response.status_code < 500:
                self._raise_fatal_for_status(response, file_id)
            return response

        # ── Cả 2 strategy đều fail → có thể Google đổi format ──
        raise DriveDownloadError(
            "Không parse được form virus-scan của Drive (không tìm thấy UUID "
            "và không có legacy confirm token). Google có thể đã đổi format — "
            "cần update bot.",
            retryable=False,
        )

    # ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @staticmethod
    def _extract_confirm_token(response) -> Optional[str]:
        """Extract a legacy Drive confirmation token from cookies or HTML."""
        for key, val in getattr(response, "cookies", {}).items():
            if key.startswith("download_warning"):
                return val
        match = re.search(
            r"confirm=([^&\"'<>\s]+)",
            str(getattr(response, "text", "")),
        )
        return match.group(1) if match else None

    @staticmethod
    def _raise_fatal_for_status(response, file_id: str):
        """Ném DriveDownloadError(retryable=False) cho 4xx với message thân thiện."""
        code = response.status_code
        if code == 404:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"Drive trả 404 — file ID {file_id} không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa. "
                "Kiểm tra link còn hoạt động không.",
                retryable=False,
            )
        if code == 403:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"Drive trả 403 — không có quyền truy cập file {file_id}. "
                "Đổi quyền chia sẻ thành 'Anyone with the link → Viewer'.",
                retryable=False,
            )
        if code == 401:
            raise DriveDownloadError(
                f"Drive trả 401 — yêu cầu đăng nhập. File {file_id} "
                "không public, hoặc đang yêu cầu OAuth.",
                retryable=False,
            )
        raise DriveDownloadError(
            f"Drive trả lỗi {code} cho file {file_id}", retryable=False,
        )

    def _find_cached(self, file_id: str, log: Callable = None) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Tìm file đã tải trong cache. CHỈ trả về nếu:
          - File tồn tại
          - Size >= MIN_VIDEO_SIZE
          - Magic bytes là video hợp lệ

        Tự động cleanup file rác (size nhỏ hoặc không phải video) từ lần fail trước.
        """
        log = log or (lambda m: None)
        if not os.path.isdir(self.dest_dir):
            return None
        for fname in os.listdir(self.dest_dir):
            if not fname.startswith(file_id):
                continue
            full = os.path.join(self.dest_dir, fname)
            try:
                size = os.path.getsize(full)
            except OSError:
                continue

            # Cleanup file rác
            if size < _MIN_VIDEO_SIZE:
                try:
                    os.remove(full)
                    log(f"Dọn cache rác: {fname} ({size} bytes)")
                except Exception:
                    pass
                continue

            is_valid, _ = _is_valid_video_file(full)
            if not is_valid:
                try:
                    os.remove(full)
                    log(f"Dọn cache file không hợp lệ: {fname}")
                except Exception:
                    pass
                continue

            return full
        return None

import logging
import os
import re
from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
from threading import Lock

# ─── Sensitive data redaction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Patterns that must NEVER appear in log files.
# Each pattern is replaced with the corresponding redacted label.
_REDACT_RULES: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    # Bearer token in Authorization header
    (re.compile(r"Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{10,}", re.IGNORECASE), "Bearer ***"),
    # access_token key-value (JSON, query string, or keyword arg)
    (re.compile(r'access_token["\':\s=]+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{10,}', re.IGNORECASE),
     "access_token=***"),
    # refresh_token key-value
    (re.compile(r'refresh_token["\':\s=]+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{10,}', re.IGNORECASE),
     "refresh_token=***"),
    # client_secret key-value
    (re.compile(r'client_secret["\':\s=]+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{10,}', re.IGNORECASE),
     "client_secret=***"),
    # TikTok open_id (format: "open_id": "xxx") — not a token but PII
    # Intentionally NOT redacted — needed for debugging account issues.
]


def _redact(text: str) -> str:
    """Replace sensitive patterns in *text* with redacted placeholders."""
    for pattern, replacement in _REDACT_RULES:
        text = pattern.sub(replacement, text)
    return text


# Keys that must never appear in raw form when an API response dict is
# stringified for logging or exception messages.
_SENSITIVE_RESPONSE_KEYS = frozenset({
    "access_token", "refresh_token", "client_secret", "open_id",
    "code", "code_verifier", "code_challenge", "upload_url",
})


def safe_response_repr(payload, *, max_len: int = 300) -> str:
    """
    Render an API response dict for inclusion in logs/exceptions with all
    sensitive fields ([[redacted]]). Non-dict inputs are passed through
    str() and still scrubbed by the regex redaction layer.
    """
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        scrubbed = {
            k: ("***" if k in _SENSITIVE_RESPONSE_KEYS else v)
            for k, v in payload.items()
        }
        text = str(scrubbed)
    else:
        text = str(payload)
    text = _redact(text)
    if len(text) > max_len:
        text = text[: max_len - 3] + "..."
    return text


def _setup_file_logger(log_dir: str = "logs") -> logging.Logger:
    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    log_file = os.path.join(log_dir, "app.log")
    logger = logging.getLogger("FacebookBot")
    if not logger.handlers:
        handler = RotatingFileHandler(
            log_file, maxBytes=5 * 1024 * 1024, backupCount=3, encoding="utf-8"
        )
        handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(message)s"))
        logger.addHandler(handler)
        logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    return logger


# Global in-memory ring-buffer shared across all BotLogger instances.
# Allows MonitorTab to display recent activity without reading the log file.
_GLOBAL_BUFFER: deque = deque(maxlen=500)
_GLOBAL_LOCK = Lock()


class BotLogger:
    ICONS: dict[str, str] = {
        "info":    "ℹ️",
        "success": "✅",
        "warning": "⚠️",
        "error":   "❌",
        "debug":   "🔍",
        "upload":  "📤",
        "browser": "🌐",
        "login":   "🔐",
        "wait":    "⏳",
        "done":    "🏁",
        "video":   "🎬",
        "link":    "🔗",
        "retry":   "🔄",
        "page":    "📄",
        "thumb":   "🖼",
        "fb":      "📘",
        "sheet":   "📊",
        "drive":   "☁️",
        "queue":   "📋",
    }

    def __init__(self, callback=None, log_dir: str = "logs"):
        self._callback = callback
        self._file_logger = _setup_file_logger(log_dir)

    def _emit(self, level: str, msg: str) -> str:
        icon = self.ICONS.get(level, "•")
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        # Redact sensitive data BEFORE writing to any output
        safe_msg = _redact(str(msg))
        formatted = f"[{ts}] {icon} {safe_msg}"
        self._file_logger.info(formatted)
        # Append to global ring-buffer (skip debug to keep buffer clean)
        if level != "debug":
            with _GLOBAL_LOCK:
                _GLOBAL_BUFFER.append({"ts": ts, "level": level, "msg": safe_msg,
                                        "formatted": formatted})
        if self._callback:
            self._callback(formatted, level)
        return formatted

    def info(self, msg: str)    -> str: return self._emit("info",    msg)
    def success(self, msg: str) -> str: return self._emit("success", msg)
    def warning(self, msg: str) -> str: return self._emit("warning", msg)
    def error(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("error",   msg)
    def debug(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("debug",   msg)
    def upload(self, msg: str)  -> str: return self._emit("upload",  msg)
    def browser(self, msg: str) -> str: return self._emit("browser", msg)
    def login(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("login",   msg)
    def wait(self, msg: str)    -> str: return self._emit("wait",    msg)
    def done(self, msg: str)    -> str: return self._emit("done",    msg)
    def video(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("video",   msg)
    def link(self, msg: str)    -> str: return self._emit("link",    msg)
    def retry(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("retry",   msg)
    def page(self, msg: str)    -> str: return self._emit("page",    msg)
    def thumb(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("thumb",   msg)
    def fb(self, msg: str)      -> str: return self._emit("fb",      msg)
    def sheet(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("sheet",   msg)
    def drive(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("drive",   msg)
    def queue(self, msg: str)   -> str: return self._emit("queue",   msg)


def get_recent_logs(n: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
    """Return the last *n* log entries from the global ring-buffer."""
    with _GLOBAL_LOCK:
        entries = list(_GLOBAL_BUFFER)
    return entries[-n:]

"""
Telegram notification helper.

Sends bot messages via the Telegram Bot API (no extra dependencies — uses
urllib from stdlib).

Architecture (P1 upgrade):
  - Single background sender thread drains a bounded Queue (maxsize=50).
  - `_send_async()` does non-blocking queue.put_nowait(); drops silently if full
    (flood protection when many workers fail simultaneously).
  - Rate-limit sleep is inside the sender thread — no lock held while sleeping.

Config keys (all optional — notifier silently does nothing if bot_token is empty):
    telegram_bot_token      : "123456:ABC-DEF..."
    telegram_chat_id        : "-100123456789"
    notify_on_error         : true/false   (default true)
    notify_on_token_expiry  : true/false   (default true)
    notify_on_complete      : true/false   (default false)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import queue
import re
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from typing import Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_DEFAULT_NOTIFIER: Optional["TelegramNotifier"] = None
_NOTIFIER_LOCK = threading.Lock()

_TELEGRAM_API = "https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage"

# Rate-limit: at most 1 message per 3 s (Telegram limits ~30 msg/s to group)
_MIN_SEND_INTERVAL_S = 3.0

# P3: characters that must be escaped in MarkdownV2 content (not in format markers)
_MD2_ESCAPE_RE = re.compile(r'([_\[\]()~>#\+\-=|{}.!\\])')


def _escape_md2(text: str) -> str:
    """Escape special chars inside user-supplied content for MarkdownV2."""
    return _MD2_ESCAPE_RE.sub(r'\\\1', str(text))


class TelegramNotifier:
    """
    Sends Telegram messages via Bot API using stdlib urllib.
    P1: single sender thread + bounded queue (maxsize=50) replaces thread-per-message.
    P3: MarkdownV2 parse mode with proper escaping.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: dict):
        self._token    = str(config.get("telegram_bot_token", "")).strip()
        self._chat_id  = str(config.get("telegram_chat_id",  "")).strip()
        self._on_error    = bool(config.get("notify_on_error",        True))
        self._on_expiry   = bool(config.get("notify_on_token_expiry", True))
        self._on_complete = bool(config.get("notify_on_complete",     False))
        self._last_sent   = 0.0
        self._enabled     = bool(self._token and self._chat_id)

        # P1: bounded queue + single sender thread
        self._queue: queue.Queue[str] = queue.Queue(maxsize=50)
        self._sender_thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._sender_loop, daemon=True, name="TelegramSender"
        )
        self._sender_thread.start()

    # ── Public notification helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────

    def notify_token_expiry(self, account_name: str, days_left: int):
        if not self._on_expiry:
            return
        emoji = "⚠️" if days_left > 3 else "🔴"
        name = _escape_md2(account_name)
        self._send_async(
            f"{emoji} *Token sắp hết hạn*\n"
            f"Tài khoản: `{name}`\n"
            f"Còn lại: *{days_left} ngày*\n"
            f"→ Vào tab Tài khoản FB để làm mới\\."
        )

    def notify_token_expired(self, account_name: str):
        if not self._on_expiry:
            return
        name = _escape_md2(account_name)
        self._send_async(
            f"❌ *Token đã hết hạn*\n"
            f"Tài khoản: `{name}`\n"
            f"Bot đã dừng upload cho tài khoản này\\.\n"
            f"→ Kết nối lại ngay\\!"
        )

    def notify_job_error(self, page_name: str, row_idx: int, error: str):
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        page = _escape_md2(page_name)
        short_err = _escape_md2(error[:200])
        self._send_async(
            f"⚠️ *Lỗi upload*\n"
            f"Page: `{page}`  •  Row: \\#{row_idx}\n"
            f"```\n{short_err}\n```"
        )

    def notify_worker_crash(self, worker_idx: int, error: str):
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        short_err = _escape_md2(error[:200])
        self._send_async(
            f"💥 *Worker W{worker_idx} crash*\n"
            f"```\n{short_err}\n```"
        )

    def notify_batch_done(self, jobs_done: int, jobs_error: int):
        if not self._on_complete:
            return
        self._send_async(
            f"✅ *Batch hoàn tất*\n"
            f"Thành công: *{jobs_done}*\n"
            f"Lỗi: *{jobs_error}*"
        )

    # ── Anti-Spam alerts (GAP-7) — routed via notify_on_error so they share
    # the same enable toggle as other operational warnings. ─────────────────

    def notify_circuit_open(self, target: str, cooldown_s: float):
        """Circuit breaker tripped for *target* — bot is auto-pausing."""
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        t = _escape_md2(target)
        mins = max(1, int(cooldown_s / 60))
        self._send_async(
            f"⏸ *Circuit breaker OPEN*\n"
            f"Target: `{t}`\n"
            f"Bot tạm dừng *{mins} phút* để tránh leo thang lỗi\\."
        )

    def notify_abuse_signal(self, target: str, error_code: str, message: str):
        """FB returned an abuse-grade error (368, 322, …) for *target*."""
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        t = _escape_md2(target)
        m = _escape_md2(message[:200])
        self._send_async(
            f"🚨 *FB ABUSE SIGNAL*\n"
            f"Target: `{t}`  •  Code: `{_escape_md2(str(error_code))}`\n"
            f"```\n{m}\n```\n"
            f"→ Page có thể bị shadow ban\\. DỪNG upload page này ngay\\."
        )

    def notify_page_throttled(self, page_name: str, drop_pct: float):
        """Page-health detector flagged a reach drop ≥ threshold."""
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        p = _escape_md2(page_name)
        self._send_async(
            f"🔻 *Page reach giảm bất thường*\n"
            f"Page: `{p}`\n"
            f"Reach giảm *{drop_pct:.0f}%* so với baseline 7 ngày\\.\n"
            f"→ Nghi FB throttle\\. Giảm tần suất post hoặc đổi content\\."
        )

    # ── TikTok-specific alerts (Sprint TT-1.8) ────────────────────────────

    def notify_tiktok_compliance_violation(
        self, account: str, code: str, message: str,
    ):
        """TikTok compliance guard rejected a publish before upload."""
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        a = _escape_md2(account)
        c = _escape_md2(code)
        m = _escape_md2(message[:200])
        self._send_async(
            f"⛔ *TikTok Compliance Violation*\n"
            f"Account: `{a}`  •  Code: `{c}`\n"
            f"```\n{m}\n```\n"
            f"→ Sửa content / cấu hình trước khi thử lại\\."
        )

    def notify_tiktok_audit_required(
        self, account: str, action: str,
    ):
        """TikTok returned an error that requires the user to complete an
        audit step (Sandbox→Production, scope upgrade, etc.)."""
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        a = _escape_md2(account)
        x = _escape_md2(action[:200])
        self._send_async(
            f"🪪 *TikTok cần audit*\n"
            f"Account: `{a}`\n"
            f"Hành động cần làm:\n"
            f"```\n{x}\n```"
        )

    def notify_tiktok_post_blocked(
        self, account: str, reason: str,
    ):
        """TikTok blocked a specific upload (spam_risk_*, daily_cap, etc.).
        Different from full abuse_signal: this is per-post, not account-wide."""
        if not self._on_error:
            return
        a = _escape_md2(account)
        r = _escape_md2(reason[:200])
        self._send_async(
            f"🚫 *TikTok post bị chặn*\n"
            f"Account: `{a}`\n"
            f"Lý do:\n"
            f"```\n{r}\n```\n"
            f"→ Tạm dừng acc này để tránh leo thang\\."
        )

    # ── Core send logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _send_async(self, text: str):
        """Non-blocking: enqueue the message; drop silently if queue is full."""
        if not self._enabled:
            return
        try:
            self._queue.put_nowait(text)
        except queue.Full:
            logger.warning("[Telegram] Queue đầy — bỏ qua thông báo")

    def _sender_loop(self):
        """Single daemon thread: drains the queue, rate-limited."""
        while True:
            try:
                text = self._queue.get(timeout=1.0)
            except queue.Empty:
                continue
            try:
                self._send(text)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning("[Telegram] Sender loop lỗi: %s", exc)
            finally:
                self._queue.task_done()

    def _send(self, text: str):
        """Blocking send with rate-limit and retry (called from sender thread)."""
        elapsed = time.time() - self._last_sent
        if elapsed < _MIN_SEND_INTERVAL_S:
            time.sleep(_MIN_SEND_INTERVAL_S - elapsed)
        self._last_sent = time.time()

        url = _TELEGRAM_API.format(token=self._token)
        payload = json.dumps({
            "chat_id":    self._chat_id,
            "text":       text,
            "parse_mode": "MarkdownV2",   # P3: upgraded from legacy Markdown
        }).encode("utf-8")

        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request(
                    url,
                    data=payload,
                    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                    method="POST",
                )
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                    if resp.status == 200:
                        return
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                logger.warning("[Telegram] HTTP %d: %s", exc.code, exc.reason)
                if exc.code == 429:
                    time.sleep(5 * (attempt + 1))
                else:
                    return  # non-retryable HTTP error
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning("[Telegram] Send lỗi lần %d: %s", attempt + 1, exc)
                time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))

    # ── Properties ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        return self._enabled


# ── Module-level singleton ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

def init_notifier(config: dict) -> "TelegramNotifier":
    """Create / replace the global notifier singleton."""
    global _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER
    with _NOTIFIER_LOCK:
        _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER = TelegramNotifier(config)
    return _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER


def get_notifier() -> "TelegramNotifier":
    """Return the global notifier (creates a no-op one if not yet initialised)."""
    global _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER
    with _NOTIFIER_LOCK:
        if _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER is None:
            _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER = TelegramNotifier({})
    return _DEFAULT_NOTIFIER

"""
Google Sheets client: Sheets API v4 + dual auth (Service Account / OAuth2).

Lần đầu chạy với OAuth2 sẽ mở browser để xác thực.
Token cache tại {credentials_path}.token.json (cùng thư mục credentials).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo, ZoneInfoNotFoundError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SCOPES = [
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly",
]

_MAX_RETRIES    = 5
_RETRY_BASE_SEC = 2.0
_QUOTA_CODES    = {429, 503}

_SCHEDULE_FORMATS = [
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",

def _idx_to_col_letter(zero_based: int) -> str:
    result, n = "", zero_based + 1
    while n > 0:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        result = chr(65 + r) + result
    return result


class SheetClient:
    """
    Đọc/ghi Google Sheet qua Sheets API v4.

    Config keys cần thiết:
        google_credentials_path  : credentials.json hoặc service_account.json
        sheet_id                 : ID sheet (lấy từ URL)
        sheet_tab                : tên tab mặc định
        timezone                 : vd 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
        skip_overdue_minutes     : bỏ qua job trễ hơn N phút (0 = không giới hạn)
        col_*                    : tên header của từng cột trong sheet
    """

    def __init__(self, config: dict, sheet_id_override: Optional[str] = None):
        self.config = config
        # Per-instance override — multi-sheet workers pass the spreadsheet id
        # they should address; falls back to config["sheet_id"] when None.
        self._sheet_id_override: Optional[str] = (
            sheet_id_override.strip() if isinstance(sheet_id_override, str) and sheet_id_override.strip()
            else None
        )
        self._service = None
        self._cred_type: Optional[str] = None
        self._header_map: dict[str, int] = {}   # header_name → 0-based index
        self._sheet_id_int_cache: dict[str, int] = {}  # tab_name → internal sheetId
        self._current_tab: str = config.get("sheet_tab", "").strip()

    # ─── Auth & connect ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def connect(self):
        """Xác thực + khởi tạo Sheets API service. OAuth2 mở browser lần đầu."""
        creds_path = self.config.get("google_credentials_path", "").strip()
        if not creds_path:
            raise ValueError("Chưa cấu hình đường dẫn credentials trong Cài đặt")
        if not os.path.isfile(creds_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Không tìm thấy credentials tại: {creds_path}\n"
                "Tải về từ Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials"
            )

        creds = self._load_credentials(creds_path)
        from googleapiclient.discovery import build
        self._service = build("sheets", "v4", credentials=creds, cache_discovery=False)

        if self._current_tab:
            self._refresh_header_map()

    def _load_credentials(self, path: str):
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        if data.get("type") == "service_account":
            from google.oauth2 import service_account
            creds = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file(
                path, scopes=SCOPES
            )
            self._cred_type = "service_account"
            logger.info("Service Account: %s", data.get("client_email", "?"))
            return creds

        # OAuth2 ("installed" / "web" client).
        #
        # A pre-authorised token beside the client file still works, and is
        # refreshed while its refresh_token holds. What is gone is the
        # interactive fallback: `InstalledAppFlow.run_local_server()` binds a
        # local port and waits for a browser to visit it. On a headless server
        # that never happens, so the call blocked forever — and it blocked
        # inside a request, with no error and no log line explaining why the
        # page had stopped responding. Refusing with an explanation is the
        # only honest option here.
        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
        from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials

        token_file = Path(path).with_suffix(".token.json")
        creds = None

        if token_file.exists():
            try:
                creds = Credentials.from_authorized_user_file(str(token_file), SCOPES)
            except Exception:
                creds = None

        if not creds or not getattr(creds, "valid", False):
            if creds and getattr(creds, "expired", False) and creds.refresh_token:
                creds.refresh(Request())
                token_file.write_text(creds.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
            else:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"File credentials `{path}` là OAuth client (type="
                    f"{data.get('type', '?')!r}), cần mở trình duyệt để người "
                    f"dùng bấm đồng ý — không làm được trên máy chủ.\n"
                    f"Hãy dùng Service Account: vào Cài đặt → tải lên file "
                    f"JSON của Service Account, rồi chia sẻ Google Sheet cho "
                    f"địa chỉ email trong file đó (quyền Editor)."
                )

        self._cred_type = "oauth2"
        logger.info("OAuth2 credentials loaded từ %s", path)
        return creds

    # ─── Tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def get_all_tabs(self) -> list[str]:
        meta = self._retry(
            lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets()
            .get(spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(), fields="sheets.properties.title")
            .execute()
        )
        return [s["properties"]["title"] for s in meta.get("sheets", [])]

    def switch_tab(self, tab_name: str):
        self._current_tab = tab_name
        self._refresh_header_map()

    def test_connection(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        try:
            self.connect()
            tabs = self.get_all_tabs()
            snippet = ", ".join(tabs[:5])
            return True, f"OK ({self._cred_type}) — {len(tabs)} tab: {snippet}"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, str(e)

    # ─── Header map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _refresh_header_map(self):
        """Đọc hàng 1 và build map header → 0-based index."""
        tab = self._current_tab
        result = self._retry(
            lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets().values()
            .get(
                spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(),
                range=f"'{tab}'!A1:ZZ1",
                valueRenderOption="UNFORMATTED_VALUE",
            )
            .execute()
        )
        rows = result.get("values", [[]])
        headers = rows[0] if rows else []
        self._header_map = {
            str(h).strip(): i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if str(h).strip()
        }
        logger.debug("Header map (%s): %s", tab, self._header_map)

    def _col_idx(self, config_key: str) -> Optional[int]:
        name = self.config.get(config_key, "").strip()
        if not name:
            return None
        return self._header_map.get(name)

    # P1-10 fix: public alias for external callers (GUI etc.)
    # Underscore-prefixed methods are private; this is the stable API.
    def get_column_index(self, config_key: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Return the 0-based column index for a column name in config.

        Returns None if the column is not configured or not found in the sheet.
        Stable public API — _col_idx may be renamed in future refactors.
        """
        return self._col_idx(config_key)

    def get_header_names(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return the actual header names present in the current tab.

        Used by core.preflight to tell an operator which column names the
        sheet really has when a configured name does not match.
        """
        return list(self._header_map.keys())

    def get_all_rows(self) -> list[list]:
        """Return every data row (header excluded) of the current tab.

        Public bulk reader for callers that need the whole tab — e.g. the
        desktop queue-preview panel. Added because that panel previously
        reached for a non-existent `client.worksheet` attribute left over
        from the gspread migration (docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md finding D1).
        """
        return self._retry(
            lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets().values()
            .get(
                spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(),
                range=f"'{self._current_tab}'!A2:ZZ",
                valueRenderOption="UNFORMATTED_VALUE",
                dateTimeRenderOption="FORMATTED_STRING",
            )
            .execute()
        ).get("values", [])

    def _col_letter(self, config_key: str) -> Optional[str]:
        idx = self._col_idx(config_key)
        return _idx_to_col_letter(idx) if idx is not None else None

    def _get_val(self, row: list, config_key: str) -> str:
        idx = self._col_idx(config_key)
        if idx is None or idx >= len(row):
            return ""
        return str(row[idx]).strip()

    # ─── Đọc dữ liệu ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def get_next_pending_row(self, platform_filter: str = "") -> Optional[dict]:
        """
        Tìm hàng đầu tiên đủ điều kiện:
          - status ∉ DONE / RUNNING / SKIPPED / ERROR
          - có video Drive URL
          - schedule_time có giá trị hợp lệ VÀ <= now (BẮT BUỘC)
          - (NEW) platform của row khớp platform_filter (nếu provided)

        platform_filter:
          ""          → mọi platform (backwards compat)
          "facebook"  → chỉ row có col_platform = facebook (hoặc empty → default FB)
          "tiktok"    → chỉ row có col_platform = tiktok

        Trả về dict task, hoặc None nếu không có.
        """
        platform_filter = (platform_filter or "").strip().lower()
        self._refresh_header_map()

        status_idx = self._col_idx("col_status")
        if status_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Không tìm thấy cột status '{self.config.get('col_status')}' "
                "trong header row. Kiểm tra tên cột trong Cài đặt."
            )

        tz = self._get_tz()
        now = datetime.now(tz)
        skip_min = int(self.config.get("skip_overdue_minutes", 60))
        sched_idx = self._col_idx("col_schedule_time")
        if sched_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Không tìm thấy cột schedule_time "
                f"'{self.config.get('col_schedule_time')}' trong header row. "
                "Cột này BẮT BUỘC — bot chỉ xử lý row khi đã đặt lịch."
            )

        all_rows: list[list] = self._retry(
            lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets().values()
            .get(
                spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(),
                range=f"'{self._current_tab}'!A2:ZZ",
                valueRenderOption="UNFORMATTED_VALUE",
                dateTimeRenderOption="FORMATTED_STRING",
            )
            .execute()
        ).get("values", [])

        # P1.2 — Random row ordering. Default ON. The original first-row-first
        # behaviour is preserved when anti_spam_random_order=false.
        # Anti-pattern protection: posting in sheet order every day = bot
        # signature. Shuffling rows that are all "ready now" breaks that.
        row_iter = list(enumerate(all_rows))
        if self.config.get("anti_spam_random_order", True):
            import random as _random
            _random.shuffle(row_iter)

        for rel, row in row_iter:
            row_num = rel + 2  # 1-based, skip header

            if not any(str(c).strip() for c in row):
                continue

            status = ""
            if status_idx < len(row):
                status = str(row[status_idx]).strip().upper()
            if status in ("DONE", "RUNNING", "SKIPPED", "ERROR") or status.startswith("RETRY"):
                continue

            video_url = self._get_val(row, "col_video_drive")
            if not video_url:
                continue

            # Platform filter: skip rows whose target platform doesn't match.
            # Empty col_platform defaults to "facebook" — same as the row dict below.
            if platform_filter:
                row_platform = (
                    self._get_val(row, "col_platform") or "facebook"
                ).strip().lower()
                if row_platform != platform_filter:
                    continue

            # Kiểm tra schedule_time — BẮT BUỘC. Row chỉ được pickup khi:
            #   (a) ô có giá trị,
            #   (b) đúng định dạng parse được,
            #   (c) đã đến giờ (sched_dt <= now),
            #   (d) chưa quá hạn skip_overdue_minutes.
            raw = str(row[sched_idx]).strip() if sched_idx < len(row) else ""
            if not raw:
                continue  # chưa điền lịch → bot chưa "quét tới"
            sched_dt = self._parse_schedule(raw, tz)
            if not sched_dt:
                self.mark_skipped(
                    row_num,
                    f"schedule_time không hợp lệ: {raw[:40]}",
                )
                continue
            if sched_dt > now:
                continue  # chưa đến giờ
            if skip_min > 0:
                diff = (now - sched_dt).total_seconds() / 60
                if diff > skip_min:
                    self.mark_skipped(row_num, f"Quá hạn {diff:.0f} phút")
                    continue

            return {
                "row_idx":        row_num,
                "video_url":      video_url,
                "schedule":       self._get_val(row, "col_schedule_time"),
                "title":          self._get_val(row, "col_title"),
                "description":    self._get_val(row, "col_description"),
                "keywords":       self._get_val(row, "col_keywords"),
                "thumbnail_url":  self._get_val(row, "col_thumbnail_url"),
                "comment":        self._get_val(row, "col_comment"),
                "target_page":    self._get_val(row, "col_target_page"),
                "post_type":      self._get_val(row, "col_post_type") or "feed",
                # Multi-platform fields (default to facebook for backward compat)
                "platform":       self._get_val(row, "col_platform") or "facebook",
                "tiktok_account": self._get_val(row, "col_tiktok_account"),
            }

        return None

    def count_pending(self, platform_filter: str = "") -> int:
        """Count rows in PENDING state. Optionally filter by platform.

        platform_filter same semantics as get_next_pending_row():
          ""         → all rows
          "facebook" → only col_platform=facebook (or empty → defaults to FB)
          "tiktok"   → only col_platform=tiktok
        """
        platform_filter = (platform_filter or "").strip().lower()
        try:
            self._refresh_header_map()
            status_idx = self._col_idx("col_status")
            if status_idx is None:
                return 0
            sched_idx = self._col_idx("col_schedule_time")
            if sched_idx is None:
                return 0
            rows = self._retry(
                lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets().values()
                .get(
                    spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(),
                    range=f"'{self._current_tab}'!A2:ZZ",
                    valueRenderOption="UNFORMATTED_VALUE",
                )
                .execute()
            ).get("values", [])

            def _row_pending(row):
                if not any(str(c).strip() for c in row):
                    return False
                if status_idx < len(row):
                    s = str(row[status_idx]).strip().upper()
                    if s in ("DONE", "RUNNING", "SKIPPED", "ERROR") or s.startswith("RETRY"):
                        return False
                if platform_filter:
                    rp = (self._get_val(row, "col_platform") or "facebook").strip().lower()
                    if rp != platform_filter:
                        return False
                # schedule_time bắt buộc — row không có lịch không tính pending
                raw = str(row[sched_idx]).strip() if sched_idx < len(row) else ""
                if not raw:
                    return False
                return True

            return sum(1 for row in rows if _row_pending(row))
        except Exception:
            return 0

    # ─── Ghi trạng thái ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def mark_running(self, row_idx: int):
        updates = {}
        col = self._col_letter("col_status")
        if col:
            updates[col] = "RUNNING"
        self._batch_write(row_idx, updates)
        self._color_row(row_idx, "running")

    def mark_done(
        self,
        row_idx: int,
        video_link: str,
        *,
        fb_video_id: str = "",
        uploaded_at: str = "",
        duration_s: float = 0.0,
        platform: str = "",       # "facebook" | "tiktok" | "tiktok_draft" …
        confirmed_at: str = "",   # TikTok: write consent timestamp if column is empty
        tiktok_status: str = "",  # TikTok: "DRAFT_UPLOADED" | "PRIVATE_POSTED" | "PUBLISHED" …
    ):
        updates = {}
        for key, val in [
            ("col_status",  "DONE"),
            ("col_fb_link", video_link),
            ("col_error",   ""),
        ]:
            col = self._col_letter(key)
            if col:
                updates[col] = val
        # Optional metadata columns (only written if column header exists in sheet)
        if fb_video_id:
            col = self._col_letter("col_fb_video_id")
            if col:
                updates[col] = fb_video_id
        if uploaded_at:
            col = self._col_letter("col_uploaded_at")
            if col:
                updates[col] = uploaded_at
        if duration_s > 0:
            col = self._col_letter("col_upload_duration")
            if col:
                updates[col] = round(duration_s, 1)
        # TikTok-specific write-back (additive — does not change FB behaviour)
        if platform and platform.lower().startswith("tiktok"):
            if video_link:
                col = self._col_letter("col_tiktok_link")
                if col:
                    updates[col] = video_link
            if fb_video_id:
                col = self._col_letter("col_tiktok_id")
                if col:
                    updates[col] = fb_video_id
            # Write user_confirmed_at timestamp for TikTok audit trail.
            # Only written when the caller supplies the value (i.e. the field
            # was empty in the sheet — we do not overwrite a user-set consent time).
            if confirmed_at:
                col = self._col_letter("col_tiktok_confirmed_at")
                if col:
                    updates[col] = confirmed_at
            # Write TikTok-specific publish status for fine-grained tracking.
            # Values: "DRAFT_UPLOADED" | "PRIVATE_POSTED" | "FOLLOWERS_POSTED" | "PUBLISHED"
            if tiktok_status:
                col = self._col_letter("col_tiktok_status")
                if col:
                    updates[col] = tiktok_status
        self._batch_write(row_idx, updates)
        self._color_row(row_idx, "done")

    def mark_error(self, row_idx: int, error: str):
        updates = {}
        for key, val in [("col_status", "ERROR"), ("col_error", error[:300])]:
            col = self._col_letter(key)
            if col:
                updates[col] = val
        self._batch_write(row_idx, updates)
        self._color_row(row_idx, "error")

    def mark_retry(self, row_idx: int, attempt: int, max_retries: int, error: str):
        """Mark row as pending-retry (skipped by get_next_pending_row until reset)."""
        updates = {}
        col = self._col_letter("col_status")
        if col:
            updates[col] = f"RETRY {attempt}/{max_retries}"
        col = self._col_letter("col_error")
        if col:
            updates[col] = f"[Retry {attempt}/{max_retries}] {error[:200]}"
        self._batch_write(row_idx, updates)
        self._color_row(row_idx, "error")   # amber-ish via error color for visibility

    def clear_retry_status(self, row_idx: int):
        """Reset RETRY row back to pending so it gets picked up again."""
        updates = {}
        col = self._col_letter("col_status")
        if col:
            updates[col] = ""
        self._batch_write(row_idx, updates)
        self._color_row(row_idx, "default")

    def mark_skipped(self, row_idx: int, reason: str):
        updates = {}
        for key, val in [("col_status", "SKIPPED"), ("col_error", reason[:200])]:
            col = self._col_letter(key)
            if col:
                updates[col] = val
        self._batch_write(row_idx, updates)
        self._color_row(row_idx, "skipped")

    # ─── Helpers nội bộ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _batch_write(self, row_idx: int, updates: dict[str, Any]):
        if not updates:
            return
        tab = self._current_tab
        data = [
            {"range": f"'{tab}'!{col}{row_idx}", "values": [[val]]}
            for col, val in updates.items()
        ]
        try:
            self._retry(
                lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets().values()
                .batchUpdate(
                    spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(),
                    body={"valueInputOption": "USER_ENTERED", "data": data},
                )
                .execute()
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Batch write row %d thất bại: %s", row_idx, e)

    def _color_row(self, row_num: int, color_key: str):
        try:
            color = _ROW_COLORS.get(color_key, _ROW_COLORS["default"])
            int_id = self._get_internal_sheet_id(self._current_tab)
            self._retry(
                lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets()
                .batchUpdate(
                    spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(),
                    body={
                        "requests": [{
                            "repeatCell": {
                                "range": {
                                    "sheetId": int_id,
                                    "startRowIndex": row_num - 1,
                                    "endRowIndex":   row_num,
                                    "startColumnIndex": 0,
                                    "endColumnIndex": 26,
                                },
                                "cell": {
                                    "userEnteredFormat": {"backgroundColor": color}
                                },
                                "fields": "userEnteredFormat.backgroundColor",
                            }
                        }]
                    },
                )
                .execute()
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug("Tô màu row %d bỏ qua: %s", row_num, e)

    def _get_internal_sheet_id(self, tab_name: str) -> int:
        if tab_name not in self._sheet_id_int_cache:
            meta = self._retry(
                lambda: self._svc().spreadsheets()
                .get(spreadsheetId=self._sheet_id(), fields="sheets.properties")
                .execute()
            )
            for s in meta.get("sheets", []):
                p = s.get("properties", {})
                self._sheet_id_int_cache[p.get("title", "")] = p.get("sheetId", 0)
        return self._sheet_id_int_cache.get(tab_name, 0)

    def _sheet_id(self) -> str:
        # Override (multi-sheet workers) takes priority over global config.
        sid = self._sheet_id_override or self.config.get("sheet_id", "").strip()
        if not sid:
            raise ValueError("Chưa nhập Sheet ID trong Cài đặt")
        return sid

    def _svc(self):
        if self._service is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Chưa connect — gọi connect() trước")
        return self._service

    def _get_tz(self):
        tz_name = self.config.get("timezone", "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")
        try:
            return ZoneInfo(tz_name)
        except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, Exception):
            try:
                import pytz
                return pytz.timezone(tz_name)
            except Exception:
                return ZoneInfo("UTC")

    def _retry(self, fn, max_retries: int = _MAX_RETRIES):
        last_exc = None
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                return fn()
            except Exception as exc:
                last_exc = exc
                http_code = getattr(getattr(exc, "resp", None), "status", None)
                if http_code and int(http_code) not in _QUOTA_CODES:
                    raise
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait = _RETRY_BASE_SEC * (2 ** attempt)
                    logger.warning(
                        "Sheets API retry %d/%d sau %.1fs: %s",
                        attempt + 1, max_retries, wait, exc,
                    )
                    time.sleep(wait)
        raise last_exc  # type: ignore[misc]

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_schedule(s: str, tz) -> Optional[datetime]:
        """Thử nhiều format ngày giờ → datetime có timezone."""
        s = s.strip()

        # Google Sheets serial date float
        try:
            val = float(s)
            if 40000 < val < 60000:
                epoch = datetime(1899, 12, 30)
                dt = epoch + timedelta(days=val)
                if hasattr(tz, "localize"):
                    return tz.localize(dt)
                return dt.replace(tzinfo=tz)
        except ValueError:
            pass

        for fmt in _SCHEDULE_FORMATS:
            try:
                dt = datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
                if hasattr(tz, "localize"):
                    return tz.localize(dt)
                return dt.replace(tzinfo=tz)
            except ValueError:
                continue
        return None

"""
Tải ảnh thumbnail từ URL về thư mục temp.
Trả về đường dẫn local hoặc None nếu URL rỗng.
"""

import os
import re
import hashlib

import requests

_THUMB_DIR = "temp_thumbnails"
_IMAGE_EXTS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif", ".bmp"}


def fetch(url: str, log=None) -> str | None:
    """
    Tải thumbnail từ URL.

    - URL rỗng → trả về None (FB dùng thumbnail tự động)
    - URL là đường dẫn file local → trả về ngay
    - URL bắt đầu http(s) → tải về temp_thumbnails/
    """
    _log = log or (lambda m: None)

    if not url or not url.strip():
        return None

    url = url.strip()

    # File local
    if os.path.exists(url):
        return url

    if not url.startswith("http"):
        _log(f"Thumbnail URL không hợp lệ: {url}")
        return None

    os.makedirs(_THUMB_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    # Tên file theo hash URL → cache
    url_hash = hashlib.md5(url.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    ext = _guess_ext(url)
    dest = os.path.join(_THUMB_DIR, f"thumb_{url_hash}{ext}")

    if os.path.exists(dest) and os.path.getsize(dest) > 0:
        _log(f"Dùng thumbnail cache: {os.path.basename(dest)}")
        return dest

    try:
        _log(f"Tải thumbnail: {url[:60]}...")
        resp = requests.get(url, timeout=30, stream=True)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        with open(dest, "wb") as f:
            for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=65536):
                f.write(chunk)
        _log(f"Thumbnail OK: {os.path.basename(dest)}")
        return dest
    except Exception as e:
        _log(f"Lỗi tải thumbnail: {e} — sẽ dùng thumbnail tự động")
        if os.path.exists(dest):
            os.remove(dest)
        return None


def _guess_ext(url: str) -> str:
    path = url.split("?")[0].split("#")[0]
    ext  = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()
    return ext if ext in _IMAGE_EXTS else ".jpg"


def cleanup_old(max_files: int = 50):
    """Xóa thumbnail cũ nếu vượt quá max_files."""
    if not os.path.isdir(_THUMB_DIR):
        return
    files = sorted(
        [os.path.join(_THUMB_DIR, f) for f in os.listdir(_THUMB_DIR)],
        key=os.path.getmtime
    )
    for f in files[:-max_files]:
        try:
            os.remove(f)
        except Exception:
            pass

"""
worker_main.py — headless CLI entry point for the publishing worker (P1).

Starts the same SheetRunner/ConcurrentRunner pipeline the desktop GUI uses,
without importing customtkinter or any gui.* module. Intended for future
server/service use, driven by the same store the web app writes
until a later phase's exit gate.

Usage:
    python worker_main.py [--config data/config.json] [--workers workers.json]
                           [--platform facebook|tiktok]

Without --workers, the worker list comes from data/workers.json — the same
store the desktop Sheet Runner tab writes, so a headless run reproduces
exactly what the operator configured in the GUI. If neither source yields
a worker, this exits with code 3 rather than guessing.

--workers points to a JSON file containing a list of worker dicts, e.g.:
    [{"tab": "Tab1", "page": "Page A", "sheet_id": "...", "page_id": "...",
      "account_id": "..."}]

Stops cleanly on SIGINT/SIGTERM: signals set the stop event, workers finish
their current step, and the process exits after all workers report stopped.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import signal
import sys
import threading

from core.worker_app import WorkerApplication, WorkerOwnershipError
from platform_core.observability import configure_logging

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
)
configure_logging(component="publisher-worker")
log = logging.getLogger("worker_main")


def load_config(path: str) -> dict:
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Config not found: {path}")
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


class NoWorkersError(RuntimeError):
    """No worker list could be resolved — refuse to guess."""


def resolve_workers(path: str | None, platform: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Resolve the worker list, in precedence order:

      1. an explicit --workers file;
      2. the shared store the web app writes (data/workers.json).

    There is deliberately NO fallback to the legacy top-level
    `sheet_tab`/`sheet_id` config keys. The 2026-07-29 audit
    (docs/_luutru/AUDIT_REPORT.md) showed that guess targeted a tab whose columns
    did not match the configured mapping, so the "fallback" produced a run
    that connected successfully and then failed mid-flight. Failing loudly
    here is strictly better than silently running the wrong tab.
    """
    if path:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            workers = json.load(f)
        if not isinstance(workers, list) or not workers:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{path} must contain a non-empty JSON array of worker dicts"
            )
        return workers

    from core.worker_store import default_path, load_workers as load_stored
    stored = load_stored(platform=platform or None)
    if stored:
        return stored

    raise NoWorkersError(
        "Không tìm thấy worker nào để chạy.\n"
        f"  - Chưa có worker đã lưu trong {default_path()}\n"
        "  - Và không có --workers <file.json>\n"
        "Cách sửa: mở trang Sheet FB / Sheet TikTok trên web → thêm worker "
        "(sẽ tự lưu), "
        "hoặc truyền --workers với một file JSON."
    )


def _on_log(msg: str, level: str) -> None:
    getattr(log, level if level in ("debug", "info", "warning", "error") else "info")(msg)


def _on_worker_update(idx: int, status) -> None:
    log.info("[W%d] %s | job=%s done=%d error=%s", idx + 1, status.state,
              status.current_job, status.jobs_done, status.jobs_error)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Headless publishing worker")
    # Mac dinh phai giai qua ranh gioi duong dan, khong phai chuoi tuong doi
    # theo thu muc lam viec: worker chay nhu mot dich vu Windows, thu muc lam
    # viec cua no la app\ chu khong phai goc du an.
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=None,
                        help="Mac dinh: LTT_CONFIG_PATH, hoac data/config.json "
                             "trong thu muc du lieu dang chay")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", default=None, help="Path to a JSON worker-list file")
    parser.add_argument("--platform", default="", choices=["", "facebook", "tiktok"])
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    config_path = args.config
    if config_path is None:
        from platform_core.runtime_paths import resolve_runtime_paths
        config_path = resolve_runtime_paths().config_path
    config = load_config(config_path)
    try:
        workers = resolve_workers(args.workers, args.platform)
    except NoWorkersError as exc:
        log.error("%s", exc)
        return 3

    stopped = threading.Event()
    app = WorkerApplication(
        workers          = workers,
        config           = config,
        platform_filter  = args.platform,
        on_log           = _on_log,
        on_worker_update = _on_worker_update,
        on_all_stopped   = stopped.set,
    )

    def _handle_signal(signum, _frame):
        log.info("Received signal %s — stopping workers...", signum)
        app.stop()

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _handle_signal)
    if hasattr(signal, "SIGTERM"):
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _handle_signal)

    try:
        app.start()
    except WorkerOwnershipError as exc:
        log.error("Cannot start — target already owned by another runner: %s", exc)
        return 2

    log.info("Worker started. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
    stopped.wait()
    log.info("All workers stopped.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
